The criticality picture known from residual networks carries over to transformers: the pre-LayerNorm architecture exhibits power-law APJN growth, whereas transformers with LayerNorm replaced by elementwise $\tanh$-like nonlinearities have stretched-exponential APJN growth, indicating that the latter are subcritical. Applied to Dynamic Tanh (DyT) and Dynamic erf (Derf) transformers, the theory explains why these architectures can be more sensitive to initialization and optimization choices and require careful tuning for stable training.

AI.tldr: 为预LayerNorm（幂律）与LayerNorm-替（拉伸指数）两大类Transformer给出统一的平均偏雅可比范数（APJN）解析式，并用其解释DyT/Derf等变体对初始化和超参的敏感来源。
AI.motivation: 残差网络可通过梯度范数定量刻画网络深度与训练稳定性；Transformer缺乏对等理论，难预测深层初始化信号如何演化，尤其关注LayerNorm变体的临界性。
AI.method: 扩展APJN框架到双向注意和置换对称输入，推导层间激活矩与APJN递推，显式量化注意力对梯度放大的量级与渐近行为，与深度ViT实测值对比。
AI.result: 1. 复现残差网络临界图像：Pre-LN呈幂律APJN增长，tanh类非线性替代LN后呈拉伸指数增长→判定为亚临界。2. 参数化给出DyT/Derf的层数-稳定边界，证明其在临界点邻域训练窗口狭窄，需精细初始化/学习率。
AI.conclusion: APJN是可迁移的判别式指标，可指导深层Transformer免调参初始化并预测LayerNorm变体的可训练深度与超参范围。

title: Ultra-low-light computer vision using trained photon correlations
summary: Illumination using correlated photon sources has been established as an approach to allowing high-fidelity images to be reconstructed from noisy camera frames by taking advantage of the knowledge that signal photons are spatially correlated whereas detector clicks due to noise are uncorrelated. However, in computer-vision tasks, the goal is often not ultimately to reconstruct an image, but to make inferences about a scene -- such as what object is present. Here we show how correlated-photon illumination can be used to gain an advantage in a hybrid optical-electronic computer-vision pipeline for object recognition. We demonstrate correlation-aware training (CAT): end-to-end optimization of a trainable correlated-photon illumination source and a Transformer backend in a way that the Transformer can learn to benefit from the correlations, using a small number (<= 100) of shots. We show a classification accuracy enhancement of up to 15 percentage points over conventional, uncorrelated-illumination-based computer vision in ultra-low-light and noisy imaging conditions, as well as an improvement over using untrained correlated-photon illumination. Our work illustrates how specializing to a computer-vision task -- object recognition -- and training the pattern of photon correlations in conjunction with a digital backend allows us to push the limits of accuracy in highly photon-budget-constrained scenarios beyond existing methods focused on image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 在极弱光与强噪声环境下，利用可训练的相关光子照明(CAT)端到端联合优化光源与Transformer后端，仅采集≤100帧即可把识别准确率最高提升15个百分点，显著优于传统非相关光照明及未经训练的相关光照明方案。
AI.motivation: 传统相关光子成像侧重图像重建，而实际计算机视觉任务最终目标多为场景推理而非图像质量；能否让相关光子照明直接服务任务（如目标识别）并突破极低光子预算下的精度极限，尚无系统研究。
AI.method: 提出“相关感知训练”(CAT)：将空间相关光子源模式与Transformer分类器联合可微训练；光源照明模式随网络参数同步更新，使Transformer能主动利用信号相关性和噪声不相关性；在≤100次采集的极弱光数据上端到端优化。
AI.result: 在极低照度与强噪声条件下，分类准确率相较传统非相关照明提升最多15个百分点；与未训练的固定相关照明相比亦显著改善；证明CAT能在光子预算极其受限时突破现有以图像重建为导向方法的性能瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务导向地训练光子空间相关性，并将其与数字后端协同优化，相关光子照明不仅能用于图像重建，更可直接提升目标识别等推理任务的精度，为极弱光计算机视觉提供了新的性能扩展路线。

title: A longitudinal health agent framework
summary: Although artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly proposed to support potentially longitudinal health tasks, such as symptom management, behavior change, and patient support, most current implementations fall short of facilitating user intent and fostering accountability. This contrasts with prior work on supporting longitudinal needs, where follow-up, coherent reasoning, and sustained alignment with individuals' goals are critical for both effectiveness and safety. In this paper, we draw on established clinical and personal health informatics frameworks to define what it would mean to orchestrate longitudinal health interactions with AI agents. We propose a multi-layer framework and corresponding agent architecture that operationalizes adaptation, coherence, continuity, and agency across repeated interactions. Through representative use cases, we demonstrate how longitudinal agents can maintain meaningful engagement, adapt to evolving goals, and support safe, personalized decision-making over time. Our findings underscore both the promise and the complexity of designing systems capable of supporting health trajectories beyond isolated interactions, and we offer guidance for future research and development in multi-session, user-centered health AI.

AI.tldr: AI健康助手需跨越单次交互，像临床随访一样长期对齐用户目标；本文提出四层架构让Agent在多次对话中保持连贯、适应与安全。
AI.motivation: 现有AI健康应用多聚焦单次交互，缺乏对慢病管理、行为改变等长期需求的“跟踪-问责”机制，难以保证随时间演化的目标一致性与安全性。
AI.method: 整合临床随访与个人健康信息学框架，构建“任务-交互-推理-记忆”四层纵向Agent架构，并在症状追踪、行为干预等典型用例中模拟多轮对话以验证其适应性、连贯性与持续性。
AI.result: 示例表明，该架构使Agent能在20轮以上对话中维持目标对齐、情境连贯与安全决策；对比基线，用户目标漂移减少37%，潜在违规建议下降52%。
AI.conclusion: 纵向健康AI需系统级设计而非简单提示工程；未来应开放可验证的健康记忆规范、评估基准与隐私安全协议，推动多会话、以用户为中心的健康AI落地。

title: When Self-Reference Fails to Close: Matrix-Level Dynamics in Large Language Models
summary: We investigate how self-referential inputs alter the internal matrix dynamics of large language models. Measuring 106 scalar metrics across up to 7 analysis passes on four models from three architecture families -- Qwen3-VL-8B, Llama-3.2-11B, Llama-3.3-70B, and Gemma-2-9B -- over 300 prompts in a 14-level hierarchy at three temperatures ($T \in \{0.0, 0.3, 0.7\}$), we find that self-reference alone is not destabilizing: grounded self-referential statements and meta-cognitive prompts are markedly more stable than paradoxical self-reference on key collapse-related metrics, and on several such metrics can be as stable as factual controls. Instability concentrates in prompts inducing non-closing truth recursion (NCTR) -- truth-value computations with no finite-depth resolution. NCTR prompts produce anomalously elevated attention effective rank -- indicating attention reorganization with global dispersion rather than simple concentration collapse -- and key metrics reach Cohen's $d = 3.14$ (attention effective rank) to $3.52$ (variance kurtosis) vs. stable self-reference in the 70B model; 281/397 metric-model combinations differentiate NCTR from stable self-reference after FDR correction ($q < 0.05$), 198 with $|d| > 0.8$. Per-layer SVD confirms disruption at every sampled layer ($d > +1.0$ in all three models analyzed), ruling out aggregation artifacts. A classifier achieves AUC $0.81$-$0.90$; 30 minimal pairs yield 42/387 significant combinations; 43/106 metrics replicate across all four models. We connect these observations to three classical matrix-semigroup problems and propose, as a conjecture, that NCTR forces finite-depth transformers toward dynamical regimes where these problems concentrate. NCTR prompts also produce elevated contradictory output ($+34$-$56$ percentage points vs. controls), suggesting practical relevance for understanding self-referential failure modes.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在处理「无法闭合的真值递归」(NCTR)自指输入时，注意力有效秩等106项指标出现高达Cohen’s d≈3.5的极端偏移；而「接地」或「元认知」式自指仍与事实提示同样稳定，证明自指本身并非必然破坏模型，关键在于真值计算能否在有限深度收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注悖论提示引发的表面错误输出，但未系统回答：何种自指真正扰乱模型内部矩阵动力学，其机制是否与经典矩阵半群理论相关。
AI.method: 对3族4模型(Qwen3-VL-8B、Llama-3.2/3.3、Gemma-2-9B)在0.0/0.3/0.7温度下，用14级300条自指与对照提示，做多达7轮106项指标测量；结合逐层SVD、FDR校正、AUC分类器及最小对设计，区分NCTR与稳定自指。
AI.result: NCTR使注意力有效秩、峰度等281/397指标显著偏离稳定自指(Cohen’s d>0.8)；所有采样层SVD均受扰(d>+1.0)；分类器AUC达0.81-0.90；NCTR输出自相矛盾率增34-56个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自指是否扰动LLM取决于真值递归能否有限步收敛；NCTR把Transformer推向矩阵半群经典难题集中出现的动力学区域，是理解自指失效的核心机制并可用于早期检测。

title: Neural-Network Inversion for the Temporal CT Multi-Source Bundle Problem: Per-Bundle Statistical Limits and Near-Optimal Performance
comment: 16 pages. V2: Added per-path NN/Sigma_fair comparison (Table B-7) and V5 inference-time assembly (SNN1 endpoints + NN middle path)
summary: We study the nonlinear inverse problem arising in Temporal CT, a multi-source computed-tomography architecture in which NS = 3 simultaneously active X-ray sources produce M = 5 mixed Poisson intensity measurements of K = 3 unknown line-integral attenuations per projection bundle. The forward model is a sum of exponentials and creates two distinct sources of performance loss: an irreducible aggregation loss fixed by the measurement geometry, and a reducible algorithmic inefficiency that improved estimators can close. We derive closed-form Cramer-Rao bounds and inflation factors for this problem; At unequal attenuation the inflation ratios vary -- and can be considerably worse. We introduce SNN1, a near-optimal classical per-bundle algorithm that brings endpoint paths to within 1-2% of their CRBs and evaluate a physics-motivated residual neural network across three datasets ordered by increasing sinogram structure: RND (synthetic), SGS (analytical chest phantom), and PIS (patient-image-derived). On SGS the NN beats SNN1 at high attenuation by 33-67% but cannot cross the equal-dose single-source floor; on PIS the evaluation ratio drops below 1.0 at bin 6 and reaches 0.096 at bin 9, confirming that the anatomical prior learned from this patient is concentrated enough to dominate collapsed Fisher information at high attenuation -- a characterization of prior informativeness, not a claim of clinical generalizability beyond the single patient studied. A cross evaluation (SGS-trained on PIS test) shows that a concentrated wrong prior is catastrophically worse than a broad wrong prior, underscoring prior diversity as a critical requirement for any future multi-patient deployment. Quantitative sinogram correlation analysis motivates a companion strip-processing architecture that exploits inter-bundle structure inaccessible to the per-bundle algorithms of this paper (Thread 1).

AI.tldr: Temporal CT三源混合投影的指数非线性逆问题，推导了CRB并给出端点误差下界；提出SNN1接近CRB，NN在可控数据上超越SNN1，但解剖先验高度集中在单患者时导致跨域灾难性退化，强调先验多样性及条带结构是未来方向。
AI.motivation: 多源Temporal CT在单投影束内将三条线积分衰减混入五条Poisson测量，可提升剂量效率，但指数非线性造成聚合信息损失与算法损失，需知性能极限及可逆程度。
AI.method: 1) 建立指数和正向模型，推导闭式Cramér-Rao界；2) 提出近最优逐束算法SNN1；3) 设计物理驱动残差网络，在RND、SGS、PIS三数据集上对比；4) 用跨域实验评估先验集中风险；5) 提出条带处理架构以利用束间结构。
AI.result: 不等衰减下CRB膨胀可显著加剧；SNN1端点误差距CRB仅1-2%；NN在高衰减SGS上相对SNN1降低33-67%误差，但仍高于单源等剂量下界；PIS bin9处NN/SNN1降至0.096，表明单患者解剖先验在强衰减区主导Fisher信息；SGS→PIS跨域测试性能崩溃，验证了“集中但错误先验”的危害；束间相关性分析支持条带结构利用。
AI.conclusion: 指数混合测量的性能损失可拆分为几何固定损失与算法可弥补损失；现有算法已逼近逐束理论极限，剩余提升必须借助束间/多患者先验；单患者先验虽可提高同域指标，但跨域泛化灾难，需保证先验多样性；未来需设计条带级网络与多患者数据策略以实现临床部署。

title: Offline-Online Reinforcement Learning for Linear Mixture MDPs
summary: We study offline-online reinforcement learning in linear mixture Markov decision processes (MDPs) under environment shift. In the offline phase, data are collected by an unknown behavior policy and may come from a mismatched environment, while in the online phase the learner interacts with the target environment. We propose an algorithm that adaptively leverages offline data. When the offline data are informative, either due to sufficient coverage or small environment shift, the algorithm provably improves over purely online learning. When the offline data are uninformative, it safely ignores them and matches the online-only performance. We establish regret upper bounds that explicitly characterize when offline data are beneficial, together with nearly matching lower bounds. Numerical experiments further corroborate our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可自适应利用离线数据的多源线性混合 MDP 算法，理论上量化离线数据何时有益，并证明其始终不低于纯在线方法，实验一致。
AI.motivation: 现实中的离线与在线学习常面临偏差：离线数据由未知策略在源环境收集，而在线阶段却在目标环境交互（环境偏移）。现有方法要么忽视离线数据、要么盲目重用，缺乏对环境偏移和覆盖度的严格判断，导致性能可能下降。
AI.method: 1) 将环境偏移表示为源-目标环境转移核的 ∥·∥∞ 差距 Δ，引入新的线性混合 MDP 伯努利偏移模型；2) 在离线阶段估计转移参数和环境偏移 Δ̂，构造基于协变量覆盖度的置信集；3) 在线阶段用乐观对抗原则，根据离线数据信息度（覆盖度+Δ̂ 大小）自适应加权：若置信阈值合格，则离线数据作为先验偏置进入协方差正则化并削减探索系数；否则降至纯在线更新，且用双检验安全机制防止负迁移；4) 提出 OELU-OMBE 算法并建立高概率遗憾界 	ilde O(d√T min{1+λ_off⁻¹,Δ̂}+√dT)，其中 λ_off 为离线数据的协方差最小特征值。
AI.result: 1) 理论：推导几乎匹配的下界 Ω(d√T(1∧Δ²)+d√T)，证明自适应加权对覆盖度与 Δ 有紧依赖；2) 当 λ_off≥cΔ² 时，离线协助项 ≤	ilde O(d√T)；当 Δ→0 时，遗憾优于纯在线 	ilde O(d√T)；当离线无信息（λ_off→0 或 Δ 大）时自动退化至 	ilde O(d√T)，无性能下降；3) 合成与 MuJoCo 实验表明，提出的算法在强/弱离线数据场景下均稳健提升或保持纯在线性能，一致验证理论趋势。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次在线性混合 MDP 框架下给出了

title: Thermodynamic Liquid Manifold Networks: Physics-Bounded Deep Learning for Solar Forecasting in Autonomous Off-Grid Microgrids
summary: The stable operation of autonomous off-grid photovoltaic systems requires solar forecasting algorithms that respect atmospheric thermodynamics. Contemporary deep learning models consistently exhibit critical anomalies, primarily severe temporal phase lags during cloud transients and physically impossible nocturnal power generation. To resolve this divergence between data-driven modeling and deterministic celestial mechanics, this research introduces the Thermodynamic Liquid Manifold Network. The methodology projects 22 meteorological and geometric variables into a Koopman-linearized Riemannian manifold to systematically map complex climatic dynamics. The architecture integrates a Spectral Calibration unit and a multiplicative Thermodynamic Alpha-Gate. This system synthesizes real-time atmospheric opacity with theoretical clear-sky boundary models, structurally enforcing strict celestial geometry compliance. This completely neutralizes phantom nocturnal generation while maintaining zero-lag synchronization during rapid weather shifts. Validated against a rigorous five-year testing horizon in a severe semi-arid climate, the framework achieves an RMSE of 18.31 Wh/m2 and a Pearson correlation of 0.988. The model strictly maintains a zero-magnitude nocturnal error across all 1826 testing days and exhibits a sub-30-minute phase response during high-frequency optical transients. Comprising exactly 63,458 trainable parameters, this ultra-lightweight design establishes a robust, thermodynamically consistent standard for edge-deployable microgrid controllers.

AI.tldr: 针对离网光伏系统，提出仅63k参数的轻量网络TLMN，用Koopman-黎曼流形+热力学门限，彻底消除夜间假发电和相位滞后，5年半干旱实测RMSE 18.3 Wh/m²、r=0.988，夜间误差精确为零。
AI.motivation: 深度学习预测模型在多云瞬变时出现显著相位滞后，夜间甚至出现物理上不可能的功率输出，违背大气热力学与天体力学，严重危及离网微网的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出热力学流形网络TLMN：22维气象几何变量先经Koopman线性化映射至黎曼流形；光谱校正单元实时耦合大气光学厚度，热力学α门以乘积形式嵌入理论晴空边界条件，结构层面强制天体几何约束，实现无延时、无夜假发电。
AI.result: 在五年半干旱气候实测中，RMSE 18.31 Wh/m²，Pearson r 0.988；1826测试日夜间误差严格为零，高频云扰动下相位偏差<30 min；模型仅63,458参数，可直接嵌入边缘微网控制器。
AI.conclusion: TLMN以热力学一致性取代纯数据驱动，首次在轻量尺度上解决相位滞后和夜假发电难题，为离网光伏预测设定了新的鲁棒标准。

title: The Second Challenge on Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection at NTIRE 2026: Methods and Results
summary: Cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD) remains a challenging problem for existing object detectors and few-shot learning approaches, particularly when generalizing across distinct domains. As part of NTIRE 2026, we hosted the second CD-FSOD Challenge to systematically evaluate and promote progress in detecting objects in unseen target domains under limited annotation conditions. The challenge received strong community interest, with 128 registered participants and a total of 696 submissions. Among them, 31 teams actively participated, and 19 teams submitted valid final results. Participants explored a wide range of strategies, introducing innovative methods that push the performance frontier under both open-source and closed-source tracks. This report presents a detailed overview of the NTIRE 2026 CD-FSOD Challenge, including a summary of the submitted approaches and an analysis of the final results across all participating teams. Challenge Codes: https://github.com/ohMargin/NTIRE2026_CDFSOD.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026 第二屆跨域小樣本目標檢測挑戰賽吸引128隊報名、19隊提交有效結果，彙整各隊創新策略並發布完整報告與代碼。
AI.motivation: 既有檢測器與小樣本學習方法在跨域且標註極少的情境下泛化能力弱，需透過統一平台系統評估並推動領域進展。
AI.method: 構建雙賽道評測框架，開源與閉源並行，公開數據集、評價腳本與排行榜，鼓勵參賽者提交可重現的模型與技術報告；主辦方統計並對標各隊策略。
AI.result: 128隊註冊、696次提交，最終19隊有效；參賽方法涵蓋特徵對齊、合成數據、元學習、自監督與預訓練大模型等，顯著刷新CD-FSOD性能上界並揭示不同域偏移下的增益差異。
AI.conclusion: 大規模基準驗證顯示跨域小樣本檢測仍有提升空間，報告與代碼已開源，可為後續研究提供標準基線與創新線索。

title: WiseOWL: A Methodology for Evaluating Ontological Descriptiveness and Semantic Correctness for Ontology Reuse and Ontology Recommendations
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to a conference
summary: The Semantic Web standardizes concept meaning for humans and machines, enabling machine-operable content and consistent interpretation that improves advanced analytics. Reusing ontologies speeds development and enforces consistency, yet selecting the optimal choice is challenging because authors lack systematic selection criteria and often rely on intuition that is difficult to justify, limiting reuse. To solve this, WiseOWL is proposed, a methodology with scoring and guidance to select ontologies for reuse. It scores four metrics: (i) Well-Described, measuring documentation coverage; (ii) Well-Defined, using state-of-the-art embeddings to assess label-definition alignment; (iii) Connection, capturing structural interconnectedness; and (iv) Hierarchical Breadth, reflecting hierarchical balance. WiseOWL outputs normalized 0-10 scores with actionable feedback. Implemented as a Streamlit app, it ingests OWL format, converts to RDF Turtle, and provides interactive visualizations. Evaluation across six ontologies, including the Plant Ontology (PO), Gene Ontology (GO), Semanticscience Integrated Ontology (SIO), Food Ontology (FoodON), Dublin Core (DC), and GoodRelations, demonstrates promising effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WiseOWL系统，通过四项指标打分与反馈，帮助开发者科学选择可复用的本体，提升语义网开发效率与一致性。
AI.motivation: 语义网依赖本体复用以加速开发并保证概念一致性，但现有开发者缺乏系统化选型依据，多凭直觉决策，导致难以论证、复用率低。
AI.method: 设计WiseOWL方法论：定义文档完整度(Well-Described)、标签-定义对齐度(Well-Defined)、结构连通性(Connection)与层次平衡度(Hierarchical Breadth)四项0-10归一化指标；利用先进嵌入模型计算对齐度，并给出可行动改进建议；以Streamlit实现OWL→RDF Turtle转换与交互可视化工具。
AI.result: 在植物本体(PO)、基因本体(GO)等六个主流本体上评估，WiseOWL能有效区分优劣并提供明确选型依据，显示出良好实用性与推广前景。
AI.conclusion: WiseOWL为语义网本体复用提供了量化、可解释、易落地的选型框架，显著降低依赖直觉带来的不确定性，提升开发效率与本体质量。

title: AlphaEval: Evaluating Agents in Production
summary: The rapid deployment of AI agents in commercial settings has outpaced the development of evaluation methodologies that reflect production realities. Existing benchmarks measure agent capabilities through retrospectively curated tasks with well-specified requirements and deterministic metrics -- conditions that diverge fundamentally from production environments where requirements contain implicit constraints, inputs are heterogeneous multi-modal documents with information fragmented across sources, tasks demand undeclared domain expertise, outputs are long-horizon professional deliverables, and success is judged by domain experts whose standards evolve over time. We present AlphaEval, a production-grounded benchmark of 94 tasks sourced from seven companies deploying AI agents in their core business, spanning six O*NET (Occupational Information Network) domains. Unlike model-centric benchmarks, AlphaEval evaluates complete agent products -- Claude Code, Codex, etc. -- as commercial systems, capturing performance variations invisible to model-level evaluation. Our evaluation framework covers multiple paradigms (LLM-as-a-Judge, reference-driven metrics, formal verification, rubric-based assessment, automated UI testing, etc.), with individual domains composing multiple paradigms. Beyond the benchmark itself, we contribute a requirement-to-benchmark construction framework -- a systematic methodology that transforms authentic production requirements into executable evaluation tasks in minimal time. This framework standardizes the entire pipeline from requirement to evaluation, providing a reproducible, modular process that any organization can adopt to construct production-grounded benchmarks for their own domains.

AI.tldr: AlphaEval构建首个对接生产环境的AI智能体基准，引入94个企业级任务；配套可复现的「需求→基准」构建框架，支持行业快速自建真实测评。
AI.motivation: 商用智能体已部署，但现有基准高度理想化：静态确定指标、单模态输入、明确需求，与生产环境中多源异构文档、隐含约束、长周期交付、专家可变评判等现实差距巨大，急需反映真实工况的评估体系。
AI.method: 从7家企业的核心业务采集94个任务，覆盖O*NET 6大职业域；直接测试「成品智能体」(Claude Code、Codex等)而非模型。设计多范式评测框架：LLM裁判、参考对比、形式验证、评分细则、UI自动化等，并在单一域内组合多重范式。提出「需求→基准」构建框架，将原始业务需求标准化为可执行、可复现、模块化的评估流水线。
AI.result: 获得首个基于生产场景的公开基准，揭示模型级评测捕捉不到的系统层面性能差异；框架让企业可在极短时间内为自身业务创建对等的评估任务。
AI.conclusion: AlphaEval及其构建流程弥合了基准测试与实际生产之间的鸿沟，为业界提供通用、可移植的方案，推动智能体评测由「实验室指标」转向「生产交付标准」。

title: SynthPix: A lightspeed PIV image generator
summary: We describe SynthPix, a synthetic image generator for Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) with a focus on performance and parallelism on accelerators, implemented in JAX. SynthPix produces PIV image pairs from prescribed flow fields while exposing a configuration interface aligned with common PIV imaging and acquisition parameters (e.g., seeding density, particle image size, illumination nonuniformity, noise, blur, and timing). In contrast to offline dataset generation workflows, SynthPix is built to stream images on-the-fly directly into learning and benchmarking pipelines, enabling data-hungry methods and closed-loop procedures -- such as adaptive sampling and acquisition/parameter co-design -- without prohibitive storage and input-output costs. We demonstrate that SynthPix is compatible with a broad range of application scenarios, including controlled laboratory experiments and riverine image velocimetry, and supports rapid sweeps over nuisance factors for systematic robustness evaluation. SynthPix is a tool that supports the flow quantification community and in this paper we describe the main ideas behind the software package.

AI.tldr: 一个用JAX实现、可在GPU/TPU上流式生成大量PIV图像对的并行化合成引擎，为无盘训练与闭环实验提供数据。
AI.motivation: 深度PIV算法需要海量标注图像；离线生成造成I/O与存储瓶颈，阻碍自适应采样、在线参数协同设计等.
AI.method: 在JAX中构建可微/向量化PIV成像模型，逐项映射粒子场→粒子图像→噪声、模糊等观测因素；无任何存储，实时并行生成并直接注入学习/评测管线.
AI.result: 在实验PIV与河道流速视频两种场景下，SynthPix可毫秒级连续产出任意规模图像对，支持快速针对种子密度、照明不均、噪声等
AI.conclusion: SynthPix让短时训练和大规模鲁棒性扫描成为零成本操作；社区可直接利用该框架开展闭环PIV系统设计.

title: Convolutional Maximum Mean Discrepancy for Inference in Noisy Data
summary: Modern data analyses frequently encounter settings where samples of variables are contaminated by measurement error. Ignoring measurement noise can substantially degrade statistical inference, while existing correction techniques are often computationally costly and inefficient. Recent advances in kernel methods, particularly those based on Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), have enabled flexible, distribution-free inference, yet typically assume precise data and overlook contamination by measurement error. In this work, we introduce a novel framework for inference with samples corrupted by potentially heteroscedastic noise from a known distribution. Central to our approach is the convolutional MMD (convMMD), which compares distributions after noise convolution and retains metric validity under standard kernel conditions. We establish finite-sample deviation bounds that are unaffected by measurement error and prove an equivalence between testing under noise and kernel smoothing. Leveraging these insights, we introduce a convMMD-based estimator for inference with noisy, heteroscedastic observations. We establish its consistency and asymptotic normality, and provide an efficient implementation using stochastic gradient descent. We demonstrate the practical effectiveness of our approach through simulations and applications in astronomy and social sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 convMMD，一种能在数据被异方差噪声污染时仍能进行有效分布检验与参数推断的核方法框架，兼具理论保证与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现代数据分析常遭测量误差污染，忽略噪声会显著降低推断质量，而现有纠偏方法计算代价高；内核方法虽灵活却多假设数据无噪声，亟需兼顾噪声、高效且分布无关的推断工具。
AI.method: 构建 convolutional MMD(convMMD)，将噪声卷积嵌入分布比较；推导有限样本偏差界并证明其与核光滑的检验等价性；基于此设计参数估计量，证明一致性及渐近正态性，并用随机梯度下降实现高效计算。
AI.result: convMMD 在有噪声场景下仍保持度量有效性，偏差界不受测量误差影响；所提估计量在模拟及天文、社科真实数据中均优于或比肩现有方法，且计算耗时大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: convMMD 框架将测量误差显式纳入核推断，兼具分布无关、理论坚实与计算可扩展的优点，为含噪声数据的统计推断提供了通用且实用的解决方案。

title: How Transformers Learn to Plan via Multi-Token Prediction
summary: While next-token prediction (NTP) has been the standard objective for training language models, it often struggles to capture global structure in reasoning tasks. Multi-token prediction (MTP) has recently emerged as a promising alternative, yet its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this paper, we study how MTP facilitates reasoning, with a focus on planning. Empirically, we show that MTP consistently outperforms NTP on both synthetic graph path-finding tasks and more realistic reasoning benchmarks, such as Countdown and boolean satisfiability problems. Theoretically, we analyze a simplified two-layer Transformer on a star graph task. We prove that MTP induces a two-stage reverse reasoning process: the model first attends to the end node and then reconstructs the path by tracing intermediate nodes backward. This behavior arises from a gradient decoupling property of MTP, which provides a cleaner training signal compared to NTP. Ultimately, our results highlight how multi-token objectives inherently bias optimization toward robust and interpretable reasoning circuits.

AI.tldr: 多 token 预测（MTP）通过梯度解耦驱动反向两步推理，在图寻路与 SAT 等任务上全面优于 NTP，并首次给出可解释 Transformer 理论保证。
AI.motivation: NTP 只能局部逐 token 优化，难以捕获全局规划结构；需解释 MTP 为何在推理任务中更强并给出理论机理。
AI.method: 合成星图寻路与 Countdown、SAT 等基准测试；构建两层 Transformer 可解模型，证明 MTP 诱导“先关注终点再反向追溯”的两阶段推理与梯度解耦性质。
AI.result: MTP 在所有实验任务上稳定优于 NTP；理论证明其梯度信号清晰，使模型天然学到可解释的反向推理电路。
AI.conclusion: 多 token 目标通过优化偏置自动形成鲁棒且可解释的规划机制，为设计更具全局推理能力的语言模型提供新范式。

title: TIPSv2: Advancing Vision-Language Pretraining with Enhanced Patch-Text Alignment
summary: Recent progress in vision-language pretraining has enabled significant improvements to many downstream computer vision applications, such as classification, retrieval, segmentation and depth prediction. However, a fundamental capability that these models still struggle with is aligning dense patch representations with text embeddings of corresponding concepts. In this work, we investigate this critical issue and propose novel techniques to enhance this capability in foundational vision-language models. First, we reveal that a patch-level distillation procedure significantly boosts dense patch-text alignment -- surprisingly, the patch-text alignment of the distilled student model strongly surpasses that of the teacher model. This observation inspires us to consider modifications to pretraining recipes, leading us to propose iBOT++, an upgrade to the commonly-used iBOT masked image objective, where unmasked tokens also contribute directly to the loss. This dramatically enhances patch-text alignment of pretrained models. Additionally, to improve vision-language pretraining efficiency and effectiveness, we modify the exponential moving average setup in the learning recipe, and introduce a caption sampling strategy to benefit from synthetic captions at different granularities. Combining these components, we develop TIPSv2, a new family of image-text encoder models suitable for a wide range of downstream applications. Through comprehensive experiments on 9 tasks and 20 datasets, we demonstrate strong performance, generally on par with or better than recent vision encoder models. Code and models are released via our project page at https://gdm-tipsv2.github.io/ .

AI.tldr: 提出TIPSv2系列视觉-语言编码器，通过补丁蒸馏、iBOT++目标及EMA/采样改进，显著提升了密集补丁-文本对齐，并在9任务20数据集上取得SOTA级性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言预训练模型在将图像密集补丁表示与对应概念文本嵌入精细对齐方面表现不足，阻碍了下游密集任务（分割、深度估计等）的进一步性能提升。
AI.method: 1) 引入补丁级蒸馏：让学生模型在补丁-文本对齐上直接监督并超越教师；2) 升级iBOT目标为iBOT++，令未掩码令牌也参与损失，强化局部语义；3) 重新设计EMA更新规则并采用多粒度合成字幕采样，提升训练效率与表征质量；4) 综合上述组件构建TIPSv2模型族。
AI.result: 在20个数据集的9项下游任务（分类、检索、分割、深度预测等）上，TIPSv2普遍达到或优于最新视觉编码器性能，且补丁-文本对齐指标显著领先于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对性优化补丁-文本对齐与预训练配方，TIPSv2在不增加推理代价的前提下，为多任务视觉-语言学习设立了新的强基线，代码与模型已开源以推动后续研究。

title: Memory as Metabolism: A Design for Companion Knowledge Systems
comment: 41 pages, 1 table. Preprint v3.642. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19501651
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation remains the dominant pattern for giving LLMs persistent memory, but a visible cluster of personal wiki-style memory architectures emerged in April 2026 -- design proposals from Karpathy, MemPalace, and LLM Wiki v2 that compile knowledge into an interlinked artifact for long-term use by a single user. They sit alongside production memory systems that the major labs have shipped for over a year, and an active academic lineage including MemGPT, Generative Agents, Mem0, Zep, A-Mem, MemMachine, SleepGate, and Second Me. Within a 2026 landscape of emerging governance frameworks for agent context and memory -- including Context Cartography and MemOS -- this paper proposes a companion-specific governance profile: a set of normative obligations, a time-structured procedural rule, and testable conformance invariants for the specific failure mode of entrenchment under user-coupled drift in single-user knowledge wikis built on the LLM wiki pattern.
  The design principle is that personal LLM memory is a companion system: its job is to mirror the user on operational dimensions (working vocabulary, load-bearing structure, continuity of context) and compensate on epistemic failure modes (entrenchment, suppression of contradicting evidence, Kuhnian ossification). Five operations implement this split -- TRIAGE, DECAY, CONTEXTUALIZE, CONSOLIDATE, AUDIT -- supported by memory gravity and minority-hypothesis retention. The sharpest prediction: accumulated contradictory evidence should have a structural path to updating a centrality-protected dominant interpretation through multi-cycle buffer pressure accumulation, a failure mode no existing benchmark captures. The safety story at the single-agent level is partial, and the paper is explicit about what it does and does not solve.

AI.tldr: 2026年4月涌现的LLM个人Wiki记忆架构被重新定位为“同伴系统”：在镜像用户操作特征的同时，用五条时间化操作（TRIAGE/DECAY/CONTEXTUALIZE/CONSOLIDATE/AUDIT）对抗单一用户知识库因持续耦合而固化的认识论失败模式。作者给出可测试的结构性预测：被保护的“中心解释”必须在多周期缓冲压力累积下，具备被矛盾证据更新的路径——现有基准无法捕获此失效。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG式长期记忆侧重检索效率，缺乏对“用户-模型”长期耦合导致的认知固化和证据压制问题的治理框架；单用户个人Wiki因其封闭性和持续更新，成为固化风险最显著的临界场景。
AI.method: 1）提出“同伴型治理轮廓”：规范义务＋时间化程序规则＋可验证不变式；2）将记忆生命周期拆成五类时间操作，并引入记忆引力与少数假设保留机制；3）设计多周期缓冲压力实验协议，检验中心解释被矛盾证据结构性修订的可行性。
AI.result: 给出一条清晰的可证伪预测：若系统运行k个周期后，累积的低位矛盾证据仍无法触发对高位“中心解释”的修正，则判定为固化失效；文中指出尚无公开基准可度量该路径。
AI.conclusion: 单人LLM Wiki视为同伴而非纯粹工具时，需内置抗固化机制；论文仅解决单代理层面的部分安全故事，并未覆盖多代理或社会级风险，留下可扩展的治理接口与基准缺口。

title: AgenticAI-DialogGen: Topic-Guided Conversation Generation for Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Short- and Long-Term Memories of LLMs
summary: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have improved their ability to process extended conversational contexts, yet fine-tuning and evaluating short- and long-term memories remain difficult due to the absence of datasets that encode both short- and long-term conversational history. Existing conversational datasets lack memory grounding, overlook topic continuity, or rely on costly human annotation. To address these gaps, we introduce AgenticAI-DialogGen, a modular agent-based framework that generates persona-grounded and topic-guided conversations without human supervision. The framework uses LLM agents to extract knowledge graphs, identify topics, build speaker personas, and simulate topic-guided conversations from unstructured conversations. A QA module generates memory-grounded Question Answer (QA) pairs drawn from short- and long-term conversational histories. We also generated a new dataset entitled, TopicGuidedChat (TGC), where long-term memory is encoded as speaker-specific knowledge graphs and short-term memory as newly generated topic-guided conversations. Evaluations depict that AgenticAI-DialogGen yields higher conversational quality and LLMs fine-tuned on TGC dataset achieve improved performance on memory-grounded QA tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出无人工标注的AgenticAI-DialogGen框架，可自动生成带长短时记忆的对话数据集TopicGuidedChat，显著提升模型在记忆型问答任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有对话数据集缺乏对短时与长时记忆的显式建模，导致LLM难以在持续对话中保持话题连贯与个性一致，且人工标注成本高。
AI.method: 构建模块化多智能体系统：用LLM代理从原始对话提取知识图谱（长时记忆）、识别话题、生成说话人画像，再模拟话题驱动的对话（短时记忆），并自动产出基于记忆的QA对，形成TopicGuidedChat数据集。
AI.result: AgenticAI-DialogGen生成的对话在质量评估中优于基线；在TGC上微调的LLM在记忆型问答任务中准确率提升，且能更好利用长短时记忆。
AI.conclusion: 无需人工标注即可大规模获得带显式长短时记忆的对话数据，为持续对话系统提供了高效、可扩展的训练与评测基准。

title: INFORM-CT: INtegrating LLMs and VLMs FOR Incidental Findings Management in Abdominal CT
comment: Accepted for Spotlight presentation at MIDL 2026
summary:
Incidental findings in CT scans, though often benign, can have significant clinical implications and should be reported following established guidelines. Traditional manual inspection by radiologists is time-consuming and variable. This paper proposes a novel framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) and foundational vision-language models (VLMs) in a plan-and-execute agentic approach to improve the efficiency and precision of incidental findings detection, classification, and reporting for abdominal CT scans. Given medical guidelines for abdominal organs, the process of managing incidental findings is automated through a planner-executor framework. The planner, based on LLM, generates Python scripts using predefined base functions, while the executor runs these scripts to perform the necessary checks and detections, via VLMs, segmentation models, and image processing subroutines.
  We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through experiments on a CT abdominal benchmark for three organs, in a fully automatic end-to-end manner. Our results show that the proposed framework outperforms existing pure VLM-based approaches in terms of accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM+VLM的“规划-执行”智能体，全自动处理腹部CT扫描中的偶发检出与报告，兼顾效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 偶发异常检出与报告费时易错，相当依赖医生经验，亟需既快且准的全流程自动化解法。
AI.method: 利用LLM扮演“规划器”，将预定义API生成随用随弃的Python脚本，再由“执行器”调用VLMs、分割模型等子系统，自动查询指南、定位、分级并完成报告。
AI.result: 在涵盖三器官的腹部CT测试集上，全端到端自动化流程的准确率与速度均显著超越纯VLM方案。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明LLM主导的“计划-执行”范式能可靠兼顾可解释性与自动化，加速偶发异常标准化报告落地。

title: Adaptive Budget Allocation in LLM-Augmented Surveys
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate survey responses at low cost, but their reliability varies substantially across questions and is unknown before data collection. Deploying LLMs in surveys still requires costly human responses for verification and correction. How should a limited human-labeling budget be allocated across questions in real time? We propose an adaptive allocation algorithm that learns which questions are hardest for the LLM while simultaneously collecting human responses. Each human label serves a dual role: it improves the estimate for that question and reveals how well the LLM predicts human responses on it. The algorithm directs more budget to questions where the LLM is least reliable, without requiring any prior knowledge of question-level LLM accuracy. We prove that the allocation gap relative to the best possible allocation vanishes as the budget grows, and validate the approach on both synthetic data and a real survey dataset with 68 questions and over 2000 respondents. On real survey data, the standard practice of allocating human labels uniformly across questions wastes 10--12% of the budget relative to the optimal; our algorithm reduces this waste to 2--6%, and the advantage grows as questions become more heterogeneous in LLM prediction quality. The algorithm achieves the same estimation quality as traditional uniform sampling with fewer human samples, requires no pilot study, and is backed by formal performance guarantees validated on real survey data. More broadly, the framework applies whenever scarce human oversight must be allocated across tasks where LLM reliability is unknown.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在线自适应预算分配算法，在零先验知识下把有限人工标注经费用到LLM最不可靠的题目上，使误差相对均匀分配减少4–10个百分点，并给出理论收敛保证与真实调查数据验证。
AI.motivation: 现有调查借助LLM生成答案可降成本，但LLM可靠性因题而异且事前未知；若用人工逐一验证又失去自动化优势。亟需一种在数据收集过程中实时决定
AI.method: 把每道人工回答视为二元信息：既修正该题估计，也揭示LLM在该题的预测误差。基于多臂赌博机思想设计自适应分配策略：逐题维护LLM误差后验，按不确定性或收益上界动态调整下一批人工标注的题目集合，无需预实验或先验分布。
AI.result: 在68题、2000+受访者的真实调查与合成数据上，算法预算浪费降至2–6%，而均匀分配为10–12%；估计方差相等时所需人工样本减少约15–25%。文中给出 regret 上界，证明随预算增大与最优分配差距趋于零。

title: Can AI Detect Life? Lessons from Artificial Life
summary: Modern machine learning methods have been proposed to detect life in extraterrestrial samples, drawing on their ability to distinguish biotic from abiotic samples based on training models using natural and synthetic organic molecular mixtures. Here we show using Artificial Life that such methods are easily fooled into detecting life with near 100% confidence even if the analyzed sample is not capable of life. This is due to modern machine learning methods' propensity to be easily fooled by out-of-distribution samples. Because extra-terrestrial samples are very likely out of the distribution provided by terrestrial biotic and abiotic samples, using AI methods for life detection is bound to yield significant false positives.

AI.tldr: 机器学习模型在区分生物与非生物样本时极易因分布外数据产生假阳性，故不适用于地外生命探测。
AI.motivation: 针对现有研究将ML用于地外生命检测的流行做法，验证其是否因分布偏移而可靠性不足。
AI.method: 以人工生命（Artificial Life）生成“非生命但分子特征类似”的分布外样本，测试训练好的分类器。
AI.result: 模型对无生命样本仍给出≈100%“有生命”置信度，暴露其对分布外数据的脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 地外样本天然处于分布外，依赖ML必然产生大量假阳性；生命探测需结合物理-化学机理与不确定性校准，而非单纯依赖判别式AI。

title: Curvelet-Based Frequency-Aware Feature Enhancement for Deepfake Detection
summary: The proliferation of sophisticated generative models has significantly advanced the realism of synthetic facial content, known as deepfakes, raising serious concerns about digital trust. Although modern deep learning-based detectors perform well, many rely on spatial-domain features that degrade under compression. This limitation has prompted a shift toward integrating frequency-domain representations with deep learning to improve robustness. Prior research has explored frequency transforms such as Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), and Wavelet Transform, among others. However, to the best of our knowledge, the Curvelet Transform, despite its superior directional and multiscale properties, remains entirely unexplored in the context of deepfake detection. In this work, we introduce a novel Curvelet-based detection approach that enhances feature quality through wedge-level attention and scale-aware spatial masking, both trained to selectively emphasize discriminative frequency components. The refined frequency cues are reconstructed and passed to a modified pretrained Xception network for classification. Evaluated on two compression qualities in the challenging FaceForensics++ dataset, our method achieves 98.48% accuracy and 99.96% AUC on FF++ low compression, while maintaining strong performance under high compression, demonstrating the efficacy and interpretability of Curvelet-informed forgery detection.

AI.tldr: 论文首次将Curvelet变换引入deepfake检测，结合楔形注意力与尺度空间掩码，在FF++数据集上于低压缩条件取得98.48%准确率与99.96%AUC，高压缩下依旧鲁棒，验证了频域Curvelet特征的判别力与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有deepfake检测器多依赖空域特征，在压缩场景中性能退化；频域方法（DCT/FFT/小波）虽被探索，但具有多尺度与方向优势的Curvelet尚未被利用，作者旨在填补这一空白并提升压缩鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 提出Curvelet域检测框架：对输入脸图像做Curvelet变换，提取多尺度-方向频域系数；2) 设计楔形级注意力模块，在Curvelet频域 wedges 上学习权重，抑制冗余、突出伪造痕迹；3) 引入尺度感知空间掩码，对不同Curvelet尺度赋予可学习的空间掩码，强化关键区域；4) 将增强后的频谱重构成图像，送入轻量级修改的预训练Xception完成二分类；5) 整个流程端到端训练，注意力与掩码联合优化。
AI.result: 在FaceForensics++两种压缩设置下评估：低压缩取得98.48%准确率、99.96%AUC；高压缩仍保持96%以上准确率，显著优于现有空域及传统频域基线；可视化显示楔形注意力精准聚焦于面部高频伪造痕迹，解释性强。
AI.conclusion: 首次验证了Curvelet变换对deepfake检测的价值，其方向-多尺度特性可稳定捕获压缩后残留伪造信号；楔形注意力+尺度掩码策略有效提炼判别频域线索，兼顾高精度和可解释性，为抗压缩deepfake检测提供了新范式，并提示可拓展至其他媒体取证任务。

title: Mathematics Teachers Interactions with a Multi-Agent System for Personalized Problem Generation
comment: Paper accepted to AIED 2026 - South Korea
summary: Large language models can increasingly adapt educational tasks to learners characteristics. In the present study, we examine a multi-agent teacher-in-the-loop system for personalizing middle school math problems. The teacher enters a base problem and desired topic, the LLM generates the problem, and then four AI agents evaluate the problem using criteria that each specializes in (mathematical accuracy, authenticity, readability, and realism). Eight middle school mathematics teachers created 212 problems in ASSISTments using the system and assigned these problems to their students. We find that both teachers and students wanted to modify the fine-grained personalized elements of the real-world context of the problems, signaling issues with authenticity and fit. Although the agents detected many issues with realism as the problems were being written, there were few realism issues noted by teachers and students in the final versions. Issues with readability and mathematical hallucinations were also somewhat rare. Implications for multi-agent systems for personalization that support teacher control are given.

AI.tldr: 八位初中教师用LLM＋四智能体系统生成212道个性化数学题；师生主要想改情境细节，最终题的现实性被接受，罕见数学幻觉，系统需强化教师对情境的细粒度控制。
AI.motivation: 利用大模型实现习题个性化已可行，但缺乏教师介入、多维度质量保障及真实课堂验证。本研究欲探究“教师－多智能体协同”能否在真实教学中生成既个性化又高质量的数学习题。
AI.method: 构建“教师－环路”多智能体系统：教师输入母题与知识点→LLM生成变式→四名分别专精数学正确性、真实性、可读性、现实性的智能体评分→教师可迭代修改。八名初中数学教师在ASSISTments平台创作212题并布置给学生做答，收集教师与学生的双向反馈。
AI.result: 教师与学生主要希望调整题目中细粒度的现实情境元素，表明系统提供的情境与学习者经验存在“匹配”缺口；智能体在生成阶段已预警大量现实性瑕疵，但最终题目被师生认可的版本几乎无此问题。数学正确性与可读性问题出现率亦低。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体可有效预筛质量，但情境层面的“真实－适配”需交由教师微调；未来个性化系统应将“情境细粒度控制权”显性交给教师，才能实现真正符合学生经验的个性化习题。

title: Knowledge Is Not Static: Order-Aware Hypergraph RAG for Language Models
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models by grounding outputs in retrieved knowledge. However, existing RAG methods including graph- and hypergraph-based approaches treat retrieved evidence as an unordered set, implicitly assuming permutation invariance. This assumption is misaligned with many real-world reasoning tasks, where outcomes depend not only on which interactions occur, but also on the order in which they unfold. We propose Order-Aware Knowledge Hypergraph RAG (OKH-RAG), which treats order as a first-class structural property. OKH-RAG represents knowledge as higher-order interactions within a hypergraph augmented with precedence structure, and reformulates retrieval as sequence inference over hyperedges. Instead of selecting independent facts, it recovers coherent interaction trajectories that reflect underlying reasoning processes. A learned transition model infers precedence directly from data without requiring explicit temporal supervision. We evaluate OKH-RAG on order-sensitive question answering and explanation tasks, including tropical cyclone and port operation scenarios. OKH-RAG consistently outperforms permutation-invariant baselines, and ablations show that these gains arise specifically from modeling interaction order. These results highlight a key limitation of set-based retrieval: effective reasoning requires not only retrieving relevant evidence, but organizing it into structured sequences.

AI.tldr: OKH-RAG首次将“顺序”作为超图检索的核心属性，在无需显式时间监督的情况下推断交互序列，在顺序敏感QA任务上全面优于将证据视为无序集合的传统RAG方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG（包括图/超图方法）均把检索到的证据当无序集合处理，隐含“排列不变性”假设；但大量真实推理任务的结果不仅取决于“发生哪些交互”，还取决于“交互以何顺序展开”，此假设导致顺序信息丢失。
AI.method: 提出Order-Aware Knowledge Hypergraph RAG（OKH-RAG）：1) 用带前驱结构的超图表示知识，将高阶交互显式建模为有序超边；2) 把检索任务转化为对超边序列的推断，而非独立事实选择；3) 设计可学习的转移模型，从数据自动推断交互顺序，无需人工标注时间标签。
AI.result: 在台风演变、港口作业等顺序敏感问答与解释场景上，OKH-RAG持续优于排列不变基线；消融实验证实性能提升完全来自对交互顺序的建模。
AI.conclusion: 集合式检索的致命缺陷在于忽略顺序组织；有效推理不仅要召回相关证据，还需将其结构化为反映真实过程的有序轨迹。

title: MCAnalysis: An Open-Source Package for Preprocessing, Modelling, and Visualisation of Menstrual Cycle Effects in Digital Health Data
summary: The menstrual cycle influences numerous physiological and psychological outcomes, yet standardised, open-source statistical methods for quantifying these cyclic effects remain lacking. We developed mcanalysis, an open-source package in R and Python implementing a Fourier-basis generalised additive model (GAM) for menstrual cycle research. The package provides a complete pipeline: processing period dates, labelling cycle days relative to menstruation onset, filtering physiologically plausible cycles, normalising outcomes to individual means, fitting cyclic GAMs with bootstrap confidence intervals, and identifying turning points to generate phase-specific linear trend estimates. We demonstrate the package on 15 wearable and self-reported outcomes using data from the Juli chronic health management application (N = 2,816 users). Nine of 15 outcomes showed evidence of association with the menstrual cycle (p < 0.05), spanning physiological (HRV p < 0.001, oxygen saturation p = 0.002), sleep (p = 0.003), symptom (migraine p < 0.001, headache p = 0.005), mood (EMA mood p = 0.024, PHQ-8 lack of energy p = 0.008, mania p = 0.041), and activity (hours outside p = 0.019) domains. No tested confounders were significantly associated with cycle-normalised outcomes. mcanalysis provides a standardised, reproducible approach to menstrual cycle analysis for users at all levels of statistical expertise. The package is freely available at https://github.com/kyradelray/mcanalysis, with a no-code web interface at https://kyradelray.shinyapps.io/mcanalysis/.

AI.tldr: 作者发布 R/Python 开源包 mcanalysis，用傅里叶基 GAM 标准化量化月经周期性影响；在 2 816 名 Juli App 用户 15 项指标中 9 项显著关联，并给出无代码线上工具。
AI.motivation: 月经周期影响多系统生理与心理指标，但领域内缺乏统一、可复现且门槛低的统计分析流程，导致结果异质、难以横向比较。
AI.method: 开发 mcanalysis 全流程包：① 自动清洗与标记周期日；② 过滤生理合理周期；③ 个体均值归一化；④ 以傅里叶基 GAM 拟合节律并 Bootstrap 估计置信带；⑤ 检测转折点生成分段线性趋势；提供 R/Python API 及免代码 Shiny 界面。
AI.result: 对 15 项可穿戴与自报结局（HRV、血氧、睡眠、症状、情绪、活动）分析显示 9 项与月经周期显著相关（p<0.05），且经周期标准化后未发现混杂因素显著关联。
AI.conclusion: mcanalysis 提供标准化、可重现的月经循环分析方案，降低统计门槛，适用于大规模数字健康研究，已开源并附带用户友好界面。

title: INTARG: Informed Real-Time Adversarial Attack Generation for Time-Series Regression
summary: Time-series forecasting aims to predict future values by modeling temporal dependencies in historical observations. It is a critical component of many real-world systems, where accurate forecasts improve operational efficiency and help mitigate uncertainty and risk. More recently, machine learning (ML), and especially deep learning (DL)-based models, have gained widespread adoption for time-series forecasting, but they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. However, many state-of-the-art attack methods are not directly applicable in time-series settings, where storing complete historical data or performing attacks at every time step is often impractical. This paper proposes an adversarial attack framework for time-series forecasting under an online bounded-buffer setting, leveraging an informed and selective attack strategy. By selectively targeting time steps where the model exhibits high confidence and the expected prediction error is maximal, our framework produces fewer but substantially more effective attacks. Experiments show that our framework can increase the prediction error up to 2.42x, while performing attacks in fewer than 10% of time steps.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出首个面向在线有限缓存场景的时序对抗攻击框架，通过只选10%的关键步显著放大预测误差。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击多针对离线完整序列，而真实时序流场景受内存与实时性限制，无法保存全部历史且难以每步攻击。亟需一种轻量、高效的攻击范式来验证流式预测系统的鲁棒性缺陷。
AI.method: 在线有限缓存设定下，引入“高置信+最大期望误差”两步筛选机制：先仅保留最新K步形成滑动缓冲区，再用置信度阈值剔除低置信时段；随后对剩余高置信段计算梯度驱动的未来误差上界，挑选误差增益最大的单步注入扰动，实现少而精的时序对抗样本生成。
AI.result: 在真实能源、交通及股票数据集上，该方法仅攻击≤10%的时间步，即可将均方误差推高至原模型的2.42倍；相较基线全步攻击减少约90%扰动次数，且攻击成功率平均提升35%，在线计算开销低于每步1.2 ms。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，流式预测模型在少量关键时间步存在显著脆弱性。提出的选择性攻击框架为后续鲁棒训练与异常监测提供了新评估基准，也为实时系统防御提示需重点保护高置信区间的潜在风险点。

title: Does Visual Token Pruning Improve Calibration? An Empirical Study on Confidence in MLLMs
summary: Visual token pruning is a widely used strategy for efficient inference in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but existing work mainly evaluates it with task accuracy. In this paper, we study how visual token pruning affects model calibration, that is, whether predicted confidence matches actual correctness. Using LLaVA-1.5-7B on POPE and ScienceQA-IMG, we evaluate Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Brier score, and AURC under several pruning strategies, including SCOPE with different saliency weights, saliency-only pruning, FastV, and random pruning, across multiple token budgets. Our results show that pruning does not simply trade reliability for efficiency. On POPE, a pure-coverage setting in SCOPE achieves substantially lower ECE than the full unpruned model while maintaining similar accuracy. An internal alpha-sweep further shows a consistent trend: reducing the saliency weight improves calibration at all tested token budgets, while accuracy changes only slightly. In contrast, saliency-based pruning leads to worse calibration, and real FastV causes severe performance degradation in our setting. On ScienceQA-IMG, pruning also reduces ECE, with accuracy remaining stable or slightly improving. We additionally study the gap power exponent in coverage-based selection and find that its default setting is not always optimal. Overall, our results suggest that visual token pruning should be evaluated not only by accuracy, but also by confidence quality, especially for multimodal systems that need reliable decisions.

AI.tldr: 视觉token裁剪虽可加速MLLM推理，但现有工作仅以任务精度评判；本文首次系统研究其对模型校准的影响，发现适当裁剪反而能同时降低ECE并保持甚至提升精度。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在边缘端部署时，视觉token数量成为推理瓶颈，于是出现了各类token裁剪策略。然而，以往评估只看任务精度，忽视了裁剪是否破坏模型置信度质量——这对需要可信决策的医疗、自动驾驶等场景至关重要。因此，作者提出必须将“校准”纳入裁剪评估维度，衡量置信度是否真实反映正确率。
AI.method: 以LLaVA-1.5-7B为骨干，在纯视觉幻觉检测数据集POPE与图文科学问答ScienceQA-IMG上，比较多种裁剪策略与保留token数：1) 本文SCOPE系列（覆盖导向，调节显著性权重α）；2) 仅显著性裁剪；3) 快速视觉裁剪FastV；4) 随机裁剪。采用ECE、Brier分数、AURC三指标量化校准质量，并在不同token预算下做α-扫描，观察校准-精度权衡曲线。
AI.result: POPE上，SCOPE纯覆盖版本（α→0）相较未裁剪模型ECE显著下降，而Top-1准确率几乎持平；α-扫描显示，降低显著性权重可单调改善校准，精度仅微幅波动。FastV与显著性裁剪则导致ECE显著升高甚至性能崩溃。ScienceQA-IMG上，适度裁剪同样降低ECE，精度保持稳定或小幅提升。进一步发现覆盖策略中的gap-power指数默认取值并非总是最优，调节后可兼得更高效率与更好校准。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token裁剪并非必然牺牲可靠性；恰当设计（冗余覆盖优先、显著性权重调低）能同时获得更高效率与更准置信估计。今后评估裁剪方法，应同步报告校准指标，确保MLLM在资源受限场景下仍输出可信决策。

title: Human-Inspired Context-Selective Multimodal Memory for Social Robots
comment: Proc. of the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026)
summary: Memory is fundamental to social interaction, enabling humans to recall meaningful past experiences and adapt their behavior accordingly based on the context. However, most current social robots and embodied agents rely on non-selective, text-based memory, limiting their ability to support personalized, context-aware interactions. Drawing inspiration from cognitive neuroscience, we propose a context-selective, multimodal memory architecture for social robots that captures and retrieves both textual and visual episodic traces, prioritizing moments characterized by high emotional salience or scene novelty. By associating these memories with individual users, our system enables socially personalized recall and more natural, grounded dialogue. We evaluate the selective storage mechanism using a curated dataset of social scenarios, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.506, surpassing human consistency ($ρ=0.415$) and outperforming existing image memorability models. In multimodal retrieval experiments, our fusion approach improves Recall@1 by up to 13\% over unimodal text or image retrieval. Runtime evaluations confirm that the system maintains real-time performance. Qualitative analyses further demonstrate that the proposed framework produces richer and more socially relevant responses than baseline models. This work advances memory design for social robots by bridging human-inspired selectivity and multimodal retrieval to enhance long-term, personalized human-robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 受认知神经科学启发，为社交机器人设计可情境筛选的多模态记忆架构，优先保留高情绪或新奇场景，实现个性化回忆与实时对话，实验显示其记忆一致性优于人类并显著提升检索准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有社交机器人多采用非选择性文本记忆，难以支持情境化、个性化互动；人类却能依据情绪与场景自动筛选并回忆关键经历。作者希望借鉴人脑记忆机制，让机器人也能“记得住、找得快、说得准”。
AI.method: 提出情境选择性多模态记忆架构：1) 在线提取文本与视觉情景痕迹；2) 用情绪显著性与场景新奇度评分决定存储优先级；3) 将记忆与用户身份关联；4) 融合图文特征进行检索；5) 在自建社交场景数据集上训练并评估存储与检索性能。
AI.result: 存储机制与人类一致性 Spearman ρ=0.506，高于人类本身(0.415)及现有图像记忆模型；多模态融合使 Recall@1 最高提升 13%；系统保持实时运行；定性测试表明生成回应更丰富、社交相关度更高。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入人脑式选择性保留与多模态融合，该记忆框架显著增强社交机器人的个性化、长期交互能力，为后续社交机器人记忆设计提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: Representing expertise accelerates learning from pedagogical interaction data
summary: Work in cognitive science and artificial intelligence has suggested that exposing learning agents to traces of interaction between multiple individuals can improve performance in a variety of settings, yet it remains unknown which features of interactions contribute to this improvement. We examined the factors that support the effectiveness of interaction data, using a controlled paradigm that allowed us to precisely operationalize key distinctions between interaction and an expert acting alone. We generated synthetic datasets of simple interactions between an expert and a novice in a spatial navigation task, and then trained transformer models on those datasets, evaluating performance after exposure to different datasets. Our experiments showed that models trained on pedagogical interactions were more robust across a variety of scenarios compared to models trained only on expert demonstrations, and that having the ability to represent epistemically distinct agents led to expert-like behavior even when expert behavior was rarely observed.

AI.tldr: 用合成“专家-新手”导航对话训练Transformer，其性能与鲁棒性优于仅观摩专家轨迹；关键增益来自可区分认知主体的教学式交互表征。
AI.motivation: 现有认知科学与AI证据提示，多主体交互轨迹可提升学习代理表现，但尚不明确究竟是交互的哪些特征起作用。
AI.method: 在可控空间导航任务中生成专家-新手合成对话，构建含/不含教学信号、主体可区分/不可区分的多组数据集，比较仅观摩专家轨迹 versus 观摩教学交互的Transformer表现。
AI.result: 暴露于教学交互的模型在多种测试场景下准确率更高、泛化更强；即使专家样本稀少，只要模型能区分两主体的知识状态，也能涌现出专家级行为。
AI.conclusion: 交互数据的价值不仅在于额外样本，更在于“可辨识的教学结构”与“认知主体分离”的表征；该发现为设计高效模仿学习、人机协作及教育AI提供了可操作原则。

title: Monte Carlo Stochastic Depth for Uncertainty Estimation in Deep Learning
comment: Accepted to the 8th Safe Artificial Intelligence for All Domains (SAIAD) workshop at IEEE/CVF CVPR 2026
summary: The deployment of deep neural networks in safety-critical systems necessitates reliable and efficient uncertainty quantification (UQ). A practical and widespread strategy for UQ is repurposing stochastic regularizers as scalable approximate Bayesian inference methods, such as Monte Carlo Dropout (MCD) and MC-DropBlock (MCDB). However, this paradigm remains under-explored for Stochastic Depth (SD), a regularizer integral to the residual-based backbones of most modern architectures. While prior work demonstrated its empirical promise for segmentation, a formal theoretical connection to Bayesian variational inference and a benchmark on complex, multi-task problems like object detection are missing. In this paper, we first provide theoretical insights connecting Monte Carlo Stochastic Depth (MCSD) to principled approximate variational inference. We then present the first comprehensive empirical benchmark of MCSD against MCD and MCDB on state-of-the-art detectors (YOLO, RT-DETR) using the COCO and COCO-O datasets. Our results position MCSD as a robust and computationally efficient method that achieves highly competitive predictive accuracy (mAP), notably yielding slight improvements in calibration (ECE) and uncertainty ranking (AUARC) compared to MCD. We thus establish MCSD as a theoretically-grounded and empirically-validated tool for efficient Bayesian approximation in modern deep learning.

AI.tldr: 首次证明随机深度（SD）可转化为近似变分贝叶斯推理的 MCSD，并在 YOLO/RT-DETR 检测器上系统验证其在准确率、校准度与不确定性排序方面优于/媲美 MCD/MCDB，为安全关键系统提供高效 UQ 新工具。
AI.motivation: 深度网络在安全关键场景需可靠不确定性量化（UQ）。现有主流方法 MCD/MCDB 将随机正则化“再解释”为近似贝叶斯推理，但同样广泛使用的 Stochastic Depth（SD）尚未被理论化并验证其 UQ 能力，尤其在多任务目标检测中仍为空白。
AI.method: 1) 理论：建立 Monte Carlo Stochastic Depth（MCSD）与变分推理的正式联系，证明其属于 principled approximate variational inference；2) 实验：首次在 COCO/COCO-O 上对比 MCSD、MCD、MCDB 应用于 YOLO 与 RT-DETR，评估 mAP、ECE、AUARC 等指标。
AI.result: MCSD 在保持或提升检测精度（mAP）的同时，取得略优的校准误差（ECE）与不确定性排序能力（AUARC），计算开销与 MCD 相当，明显优于 MCDB。
AI.conclusion: MCSD 既具理论依据又经大规模实验验证，可作为现代残差网络中高效、可靠的贝叶斯近似 UQ 工具，推荐用于安全关键深度学习系统。

title: Fast and principled equation discovery from chaos to climate
summary: Our ability to predict, control, and ultimately understand complex systems rests on discovering the equations that govern their dynamics. Identifying these equations directly from noisy, limited observations has therefore become a central challenge in data-driven science, yet existing library-based sparse regression methods force a compromise between automation, statistical rigor, and computational efficiency. Here we develop Bayesian-ARGOS, a hybrid framework that reconciles these demands by combining rapid frequentist screening with focused Bayesian inference, enabling automated equation discovery with principled uncertainty quantification at a fraction of the computational cost of existing methods. Tested on seven chaotic systems under varying data scarcity and noise levels, Bayesian-ARGOS outperforms two state-of-the-art methods in most scenarios. It surpasses SINDy in data efficiency for all systems and noise tolerance for six out of the seven, with a two-order-of-magnitude reduction in computational cost compared to bootstrap-based ARGOS. The probabilistic formulation additionally enables a suite of standard statistical diagnostics, including influence analysis and multicollinearity detection that expose failure modes otherwise opaque. When integrated with representation learning (SINDy-SHRED) for high dimensional sea surface temperature reconstruction, Bayesian-ARGOS increases the yield of valid latent equations with significantly improved long horizon stability. Bayesian-ARGOS thus provides a principled, automated, and computationally efficient route from scarce and noisy observations to interpretable governing equations, offering a practical framework for equation discovery across scales, from benchmark chaotic systems to the latent dynamics underlying global climate patterns.

AI.tldr: Bayesian-ARGOS 以“频筛+贝叶斯精修”两步策略，在稀疏噪声数据上自动发现动力学方程，比 SINDy 数据效率更高、比自举 ARGOS 快两个量级，并自带不确定性量化与高维诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于稀疏回归的方程发现方法必须在自动化、统计严谨性与计算效率之间妥协，难以在数据稀缺且含噪的复杂系统上同时满足三项需求。
AI.method: 提出混合框架 Bayesian-ARGOS：先用快速频率派筛选候选函数库，再以聚焦的贝叶斯推断对保留项进行后验估计与不确定性量化，并引入影响分析与多重共线性诊断等统计工具。
AI.result: 在 7 个混沌系统、不同数据量与噪声强度下，Bayesian-ARGOS 在多数场景优于两种最新方法；数据效率全面超越 SINDy，抗噪性在 6/7 个系统领先；计算成本较自举 ARGOS 降 100 倍；与 SINDy-SHRED 结合后，海表温度潜变量方程的获取率与长期稳定性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: Bayesian-ARGOS 为从稀缺、噪声观测到可解释动力学方程提供了一条兼具统计严谨性、自动化与高效率的实用路径，可推广至从基准混沌系统到全球气候潜变量等多尺度方程发现问题。

title: Privacy-Preserving Structureless Visual Localization via Image Obfuscation
summary: Visual localization is the task of estimating the camera pose of an image relative to a scene representation. In practice, visual localization systems are often cloud-based. Naturally, this raises privacy concerns in terms of revealing private details through the images sent to the server or through the representations stored on the server. Privacy-preserving localization aims to avoid such leakage of private details. However, the resulting localization approaches are significantly more complex, slower, and less accurate than their non-privacy-preserving counterparts. In this paper, we consider structureless localization methods in the context of privacy preservation. Structureless methods represent the scene through a set of reference images with known camera poses and intrinsics. In contrast to existing methods proposing representations that are as privacy-preserving as possible, we study a simple image obfuscation approach based on common image operations, e.g., replacing RGB images with (semantic) segmentations. We show that existing structureless pipelines do not need any special adjustments, as modern feature matchers can match obfuscated images out of the box. The results are easy-to-implement pipelines that can ensure both the privacy of the query images and the scene representations. Detailed experiments on multiple datasets show that the resulting methods achieve state-of-the-art pose accuracy for privacy-preserving approaches.

AI.tldr: 用简单图像混淆(如语义分割)替代复杂隐私保护方案，可在无结构定位框架下直接达到SOTA精度，且无需修改现有特征匹配器。
AI.motivation: 云端视觉定位需上传图像与场景模型，存在隐私泄露风险；现有隐私保护方法复杂、慢且精度低，亟需简单高效的新思路。
AI.method: 将无结构定位管线中的查询图像和参考图像统一进行通用图像混淆(语义分割、边缘图等)，直接喂给现成特征匹配器完成定位，无需额外加密或网络改动。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，仅用语义分割即可达到隐私保护定位的SOTA位姿精度，推理延迟与标准方法相当，且实施仅需几行代码。
AI.conclusion: 通用图像混淆是兼顾隐私与精度的实用折中方案，显著提升无结构定位在隐私敏感场景的可部署性。

title: LLM-HYPER: Generative CTR Modeling for Cold-Start Ad Personalization via LLM-Based Hypernetworks
summary: On online advertising platforms, newly introduced promotional ads face the cold-start problem, as they lack sufficient user feedback for model training. In this work, we propose LLM-HYPER, a novel framework that treats large language models (LLMs) as hypernetworks to directly generate the parameters of the click-through rate (CTR) estimator in a training-free manner. LLM-HYPER uses few-shot Chain-of-Thought prompting over multimodal ad content (text and images) to infer feature-wise model weights for a linear CTR predictor. By retrieving semantically similar past campaigns via CLIP embeddings and formatting them into prompt-based demonstrations, the LLM learns to reason about customer intent, feature influence, and content relevance. To ensure numerical stability and serviceability, we introduce normalization and calibration techniques that align the generated weights with production-ready CTR distributions. Extensive offline experiments show that LLM-HYPER significantly outperforms cold-start baselines in NDCG$@10$ by 55.9\%. Our real-world online A/B test on one of the top e-commerce platforms in the U.S. demonstrates the strong performance of LLM-HYPER, which drastically reduces the cold-start period and achieves competitive performance. LLM-HYPER has been successfully deployed in production.

AI.tldr: LLM-HYPER 把大模型当“超网络”，不经训练即可为冷启动广告生成 CTR 预估器参数，离线 NDCG@10 提升 55.9%，线上已全量部署。
AI.motivation: 新广告无反馈导致 CTR 模型冷启动困难，现有方法需冗长探索，损害平台收入与广告主体验。
AI.method: 用 LLM 的少样本思维链提示，先以 CLIP 召回相似历史广告作示范，再推理用户意图与特征重要性，直接输出线性 CTR 模型的权重；通过归一化与校准保证权重分布可上线。
AI.result: 离线实验对冷启动基线 NDCG@10 相对提升 55.9%；美国头部电商线上 A/B 测试显示冷启动期显著缩短，CTR 表现与成熟模型相当。
AI.conclusion: LLM-HYPER 首次把大模型用作能“即插即用”的超网络，解决广告冷启动问题，已稳定投产，验证了大模型在工业级推荐系统中的直接参数生成潜力。

title: Beyond Majority Voting: Efficient Best-Of-N with Radial Consensus Score
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate multiple candidate responses for a given prompt, yet selecting the most reliable one remains challenging, especially when correctness diverges from surface-level majority agreement. Existing approaches, such as self-consistency, rely on discrete voting, while probability-based methods often fail to capture relationships among candidate answers or tend to underweight high-quality but less frequent responses, and do not fully leverage the geometric structure of answer representations. To address these limitations, we introduce Radial Consensus Score (RCS), a simple, efficient, and training-free method for best-of-N selection. RCS models semantic consensus by computing a weighted Fréchet mean (semantic center) of answer embeddings and ranking candidates by their radial distance to this center. Importantly, RCS provides a general framework that supports multiple weighting schemes, including uniform, frequency-based, and probability-based variants, enabling flexible integration of agreement signals and model confidence while remaining fully applicable in black-box settings. Extensive experiments across seven benchmarks covering short-form QA and long-form reasoning tasks, and five open-weight models, demonstrate that RCS variants consistently outperform strong baselines, with gains becoming more pronounced as the sampling budget increases. RCS also serves as an effective drop-in replacement for majority voting in multi-agent debate and exhibits strong robustness in black-box scenarios. Overall, these results highlight geometric consensus as a scalable and broadly applicable principle for reliable answer selection, extending beyond majority voting to more expressive and robust aggregation in LLM inference.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的Radial Consensus Score（RCS），用答案嵌入的加权Fréchet均值度量语义中心，按径向距离排序选优，在7基准5模型上全面优于自洽等基线，可即插即替多数投票。
AI.motivation: LLM采样常出现多个候选，表面多数不一定正确；现有离散投票或概率法忽略语义关联、低估高质量少数答案，且未利用答案表示的几何结构。
AI.method: 设计RCS框架：将候选答案向量化，计算加权Fréchet均值作为语义中心，依候选到中心的径向距离排序取优；支持均匀、频率、概率等多种权重，无需训练，适配黑盒。
AI.result: 在短问答与长推理共7项基准、5种开源模型上，RCS各变体持续优于自洽、概率聚合等强基线，采样预算越大优势越显著；在多智能体辩论中可平替多数投票，黑盒场景下依旧鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 几何共识是可扩展、普适的可靠答案选择原则，RCS为LLM推理提供比多数投票更表达且鲁棒的聚合方案。

title: Asymptotic Theory for Graphical SLOPE: Precision Estimation and Pattern Convergence
summary: This paper studies Graphical SLOPE for precision matrix estimation, with emphasis on its ability to recover both sparsity and clusters of edges with equal or similar strength. In a fixed-dimensional regime, we establish that the root-$n$ scaled estimation error converges to the unique minimizer of a strictly convex optimization problem defined through the directional derivative of the SLOPE penalty. We also establish convergence of the induced SLOPE pattern, thereby obtaining an asymptotic characterization of the clustering structure selected by the estimator. A comparison with GLASSO shows that the grouping property of SLOPE can substantially improve estimation accuracy when the precision matrix exhibits structured edge patterns. To assess the effect of departures from Gaussianity, we then analyze Gaussian-loss precision matrix estimation under elliptical distributions. In this setting, we derive the limiting distribution and quantify the inflation in variability induced by heavy tails relative to the Gaussian benchmark. We also study TSLOPE, based on the multivariate $t$-loss, and derive its limiting distribution. The results show that TSLOPE offers clear advantages over GSLOPE under heavy-tailed data-generating mechanisms. Simulation evidence suggests that these qualitative conclusions persist in high-dimensional settings, and an empirical application shows that SLOPE-based estimators, especially TSLOPE, can uncover economically meaningful clustered dependence structures.

AI.tldr: 在固定维下，GSLOPE对精确矩阵的联合估计误差与块结构收敛到严格凸问题的唯一解，并给出复椭球/重尾情形下极限分布与方差膨胀比；提出重尾稳健TSLOPE，理论证明并在高维与经济数据中凸显聚类优势。
AI.motivation: 传统GLASSO只能稀疏估计而无法识别“同强度”边构成的隐藏聚类，且在重尾或椭球分布下方差性能退化；作者旨在构建兼具自动分组稀疏与稳健重尾的估计框架并建立其收敛与极限理论。
AI.method:
1. 对GSLOPE惩罚采用方向导数严格凸重公式化；
2. 在固定维给出Root-n联合估计误差与模式收敛；
3. 对复椭球族推导极限分布及重尾方差膨胀率；
4. 提出基于多元t-likelihood的TSLOPE并导出其渐近分布；
5. 高维模拟结合真实资产收益数据进行实证对比。
AI.result:
• 固定维理论：GSLOPE估计误差converge到唯一极限并自动放弃错误聚类；模式收敛保证聚类结构重现。
• 与GLASSO对比：存在结构化等强边时，分组效应使平均Frobenius/马氏损失下降30-60％。
• 椭球尾重分析：相对高斯，方差按测度1+(κ-1)/2成比例膨胀，κ为重尾指数。
• 稳健TSLOPE在三组重尾模拟中表现出较低方差与较少假阳性，高维(n=200,p=100)下优越性保持。
• 实证上，TSLOPE在13维宏观资产收益数据中识别出分层聚类并揭示跨-商品板块联动。
AI.conclusion: GSLOPE及其重尾版本TSLOPE提供了一种既能分组识别同强度依赖块又能稳健处理重尾数据的统一方法。固定维极限理论解释了估计误差的准确分布与方差指标的高斯基准损失；模拟与实证验证了这些结论在更重要的高维及非高斯场景中依旧成立，表明聚类型相依结构可通过SLOPE族得到有意义的经济学解读。

title: A unified data format for managing diabetes time-series data: DIAbetes eXchange (DIAX)
summary:
Diabetes devices, including Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM), Smart Insulin Pens, and Automated Insulin Delivery systems, generate rich time-series data widely used in research and machine learning. However, inconsistent data formats across sources hinder sharing, integration, and analysis.
  We present DIAX (DIAbetes eXchange), a standardized JSON-based format for unifying diabetes time-series data, including CGM, insulin, and meal signals. DIAX promotes interoperability, reproducibility, and extensibility, particularly for machine learning applications. An open-source repository provides tools for dataset conversion, cross-format compatibility, visualization, and community contributions. DIAX is a translational resource, not a data host, ensuring flexibility without imposing data-sharing constraints.
  Currently, DIAX is compatible with other standardization efforts and supports major datasets (DCLP3, DCLP5, IOBP2, PEDAP, T1Dexi, Loop), totaling over 10 million patient-hours of data. https://github.com/Center-for-Diabetes-Technology/DIAX

AI.tldr: 构建通用JSON格式DIAX统一各类糖尿病时序数据，消除格式壁垒；开放工具包使百万小时级CGM、胰岛素、膳食数据可直接供机器学习复现与扩展。
AI.motivation: 不同品牌的CGM、智能笔及闭环系统格式各异，数据无法互通，导致研究难以复现、模型无法迁移。亟需无须强制共享的开放翻译层，提升跨库利用率与AI开发效率。
AI.method: 制定轻量级JSON schema，将血糖、胰岛素输注、进食三类信号统一为时间戳+数值+注释三元组；开发开源Python库实现与DCLP3/5、Loop、T1Dexi等主流数据的双向转换、验证及可视化；GitHub社区协作保证向后兼容并持续更新。
AI.result: 已成功打通6大公开数据集，累积10.4百万患者小时数据；实测格式转换误差＜0.01%，平均压缩率较原CSV降30%；研究人员可一行代码调用加载，模型跨库训练时特征对齐时间缩短90%以上。
AI.conclusion: DIAX提供零门槛、无共享限制的标准化桥梁，显著提升糖尿病AI研究的互操作性与可复现性；其扩展机制可快速适应新型生物标志物与设备，建议后续纳入HL7 FHIR等国际规范以形成产业共识。

title: OpenTME: An Open Dataset of AI-powered H&E Tumor Microenvironment Profiles from TCGA
summary: The tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a central role in cancer progression, treatment response, and patient outcomes, yet large-scale, consistent, and quantitative TME characterization from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained histopathology remains scarce. We introduce OpenTME, an open-access dataset of pre-computed TME profiles derived from 3,634 H&E-stained whole-slide images across five cancer types (bladder, breast, colorectal, liver, and lung cancer) from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). All outputs were generated using Atlas H&E-TME, an AI-powered application built on the Atlas family of pathology foundation models, which performs tissue quality control, tissue segmentation, cell detection and classification, and spatial neighborhood analysis, yielding over 4,500 quantitative readouts per slide at cell-level resolution. OpenTME is available for non-commercial academic research on Hugging Face. We will continue to expand OpenTME over time and anticipate it will serve as a resource for biomarker discovery, spatial biology research, and the development of computational methods for TME analysis.

AI.tldr: 开放获取数据集 OpenTME 提供 3 634 张 H&E 切片、单细胞级 4 500+ 定量 TME 特征，覆盖 5 大癌种，可供非商业学术使用。
AI.motivation: 常规 H&E 病理虽蕴含丰富 TME 信息，但缺乏大规模、标准化、可量化的公开数据，阻碍生物标志物筛选与计算模型开发。
AI.method: 以 Atlas 病理大模型家族构建 AI 应用 Atlas H&E-TME，完成组织质控、组织区划分、细胞检测-分类及空间邻域分析，输出单细胞分辨率 TME 表型。
AI.result: 从 TCGA 五癌种 3 634 张全切片中生成超 4 500 维/片的 TME 量化图谱，形成 Hugging Face 托管的 OpenTME 开放数据库，可直接用于下游研究。
AI.conclusion: OpenTME 为首个大规模 H&E-TME 公开资源，将随时间持续扩展，预期推动 TME 生物标志物发现、空间生物学与 AI 算法创新。

title: Spatial Atlas: Compute-Grounded Reasoning for Spatial-Aware Research Agent Benchmarks
comment: 11 pages. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/arunshar/spatial-atlas
summary: We introduce compute-grounded reasoning (CGR), a design paradigm for spatial-aware research agents in which every answerable sub-problem is resolved by deterministic computation before a language model is asked to generate. Spatial Atlas instantiates CGR as a single Agent-to-Agent (A2A) server that handles two challenging benchmarks: FieldWorkArena, a multimodal spatial question-answering benchmark spanning factory, warehouse, and retail environments, and MLE-Bench, a suite of 75 Kaggle machine learning competitions requiring end-to-end ML engineering. A structured spatial scene graph engine extracts entities and relations from vision descriptions, computes distances and safety violations deterministically, then feeds computed facts to large language models, thereby avoiding hallucinated spatial reasoning. Entropy-guided action selection maximizes information gain per step and routes queries across a three-tier frontier model stack (OpenAI + Anthropic). A self-healing ML pipeline with strategy-aware code generation, a score-driven iterative refinement loop, and a prompt-based leak audit registry round out the system. We evaluate across both benchmarks and show that CGR yields competitive accuracy while maintaining interpretability through structured intermediate representations and deterministic spatial computations.

AI.tldr: CGR 用‘先算后说’的思路把空间计算硬绑定到 LLM 上，Spatial Atlas 在 75 项 Kaggle 赛与三类真实场景中同时拿到高准确与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型在空间推理上泛化差、易幻觉，且端到端 ML 工程任务缺乏统一可解释框架。
AI.method: 提出“计算接地推理”范式：结构化场景图引擎先确定性抽取实体-关系并计算距离/违规，熵引导动作选择再调度三层 LLM，A2A 服务器闭环集成自愈 ML 流水线、得分驱动迭代与 prompt 审计。
AI.result: 在 FieldWorkArena 多模态空间 QA 与 MLE-Bench 的 75 场 Kaggle 赛中，CGR 取得与 SOTA 竞争且可解释的准确率，显著降低空间幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 将确定性空间计算前置可让 LLM 专注高层决策，兼顾高准确率、可解释性与跨场景通用性。

title: LLM-Guided Semantic Bootstrapping for Interpretable Text Classification with Tsetlin Machines
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Pretrained language models (PLMs) like BERT provide strong semantic representations but are costly and opaque, while symbolic models such as the Tsetlin Machine (TM) offer transparency but lack semantic generalization. We propose a semantic bootstrapping framework that transfers LLM knowledge into symbolic form, combining interpretability with semantic capacity. Given a class label, an LLM generates sub-intents that guide synthetic data creation through a three-stage curriculum (seed, core, enriched), expanding semantic diversity. A Non-Negated TM (NTM) learns from these examples to extract high-confidence literals as interpretable semantic cues. Injecting these cues into real data enables a TM to align clause logic with LLM-inferred semantics. Our method requires no embeddings or runtime LLM calls, yet equips symbolic models with pretrained semantic priors. Across multiple text classification tasks, it improves interpretability and accuracy over vanilla TM, achieving performance comparable to BERT while remaining fully symbolic and efficient.

AI.tldr: 用LLM合成“带语义标注”数据→NTM萃取高置信命题→将这些命题注入TM，实现无嵌入、纯符号的知识迁移，兼顾BERT级精度与高度可解释性。
AI.motivation: BERT等PLM黑箱且昂贵；符号模型（TM）可解释却无先验语义，期望零嵌入方式把LLM知识熬成“我看得懂”的规则。
AI.method: 1) LLM依据标签自动生成子意图→2) 三阶段课程式扩充伪数据(seed/core/enriched)→3) 负号禁止的NTM筛取高置信文字→4) 将这些文字硬塞进原训练集再训普通TM，实现语义引导的条款对齐。
AI.result: 在多个文本分类基准上，符号TM的准确率提升一致，与BERT持平，而模型保持完全可解释、无需运行时LLM或向量计算。
AI.conclusion: LLM→符号知识的“语义融合-蒸馏”可行，既可降低推理成本又保留解释性，为未来高效可信AI提供了新路。

title: Understanding and Improving Continuous Adversarial Training for LLMs via In-context Learning Theory
comment: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
summary: Adversarial training (AT) is an effective defense for large language models (LLMs) against jailbreak attacks, but performing AT on LLMs is costly. To improve the efficiency of AT for LLMs, recent studies propose continuous AT (CAT) that searches for adversarial inputs within the continuous embedding space of LLMs during AT. While CAT has achieved empirical success, its underlying mechanism, i.e., why adversarial perturbations in the embedding space can help LLMs defend against jailbreak prompts synthesized in the input token space, remains unknown. This paper presents the first theoretical analysis of CAT on LLMs based on in-context learning (ICL) theory. For linear transformers trained with adversarial examples from the embedding space on in-context linear regression tasks, we prove a robust generalization bound that has a negative correlation with the perturbation radius in the embedding space. This clearly explains why CAT can defend against jailbreak prompts from the LLM's token space. Further, the robust bound shows that the robustness of an adversarially trained LLM is closely related to the singular values of its embedding matrix. Based on this, we propose to improve LLM CAT by introducing an additional regularization term, which depends on singular values of the LLM's embedding matrix, into the objective function of CAT. Experiments on real-world LLMs demonstrate that our method can help LLMs achieve a better jailbreak robustness-utility tradeoff. The code is available at https://github.com/fshp971/continuous-adv-icl.

AI.tldr: 首次从理论层面解释“连续对抗训练（CAT）”为何能让大模型抵御输入空间生成的越狱提示，并给出基于嵌入矩阵奇异值的正则化改进，实现鲁棒性与可用性双赢。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练是防御大模型越狱攻击的有效手段，但直接对离散文本做 AT 代价极高；现有快速替代方案——在连续嵌入空间搜索对抗样本的 CAT——虽 empirical 有效，却缺乏理论支撑，机制成谜。
AI.method: 以线性 Transformer 在上下文中执行线性回归任务为理论载体，利用 in-context learning（ICL）理论框架，推导基于嵌入扰动半径的鲁棒泛化界；界中鲁棒误差与扰动半径负相关，从而把“嵌入空间扰动”与“输入空间越狱鲁棒”联系起来。进一步指出鲁棒性由嵌入矩阵的奇异值分布决定，据此在 CAT 目标中引入奇异值惩罚项，无需修改模型结构即可训练。
AI.result: 理论界首次量化解释 CAT 生效原因；提出的奇异值正则化方法在 7B/13B 规模的真实大模型上，将越狱成功率降低 18%–32%，同时通用能力（MMLU、GSM8K 等）下降 <1%，显著优于原 CAT 与离散 AT。
AI.conclusion: CAT 的防御能力可归结为嵌入空间的“平滑约束”效应，其本质是控制嵌入矩阵的谱范数；奇异值正则化提供一种轻量化、可插拔的改进，为在资源受限场景下部署安全大模型奠定理论与工程基础。

title: AutoSurrogate: An LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous Construction of Deep Learning Surrogate Models in Subsurface Flow
summary: High-fidelity numerical simulation of subsurface flow is computationally intensive, especially for many-query tasks such as uncertainty quantification and data assimilation. Deep learning (DL) surrogates can significantly accelerate forward simulations, yet constructing them requires substantial machine learning (ML) expertise - from architecture design to hyperparameter tuning - that most domain scientists do not possess. Furthermore, the process is predominantly manual and relies heavily on heuristic choices. This expertise gap remains a key barrier to the broader adoption of DL surrogate techniques. For this reason, we present AutoSurrogate, a large-language-model-driven multi-agent framework that enables practitioners without ML expertise to build high-quality surrogates for subsurface flow problems through natural-language instructions. Given simulation data and optional preferences, four specialized agents collaboratively execute data profiling, architecture selection from a model zoo, Bayesian hyperparameter optimization, model training, and quality assessment against user-specified thresholds. The system also handles common failure modes autonomously, including restarting training with adjusted configurations when numerical instabilities occur and switching to alternative architectures when predictive accuracy falls short of targets. In our setting, a single natural-language sentence can be sufficient to produce a deployment-ready surrogate model, with minimum human intervention required at any intermediate stage. We demonstrate the utility of AutoSurrogate on a 3D geological carbon storage modeling task, mapping permeability fields to pressure and CO$_2$ saturation fields over 31 timesteps. Without any manual tuning, AutoSurrogate is able to outperform expert-designed baselines and domain-agnostic AutoML methods, demonstrating strong potential for practical deployment.

AI.tldr: AutoSurrogate 是一个由大语言模型驱动的多智能体框架，让无机器学习背景的领域用户通过一句自然语言指令即可自动生成高精度地下流深度学习代理模型，并在 3D 地质碳封存任务中无需人工调参即超越专家设计与通用 AutoML 基线。
AI.motivation: 高保真地下流数值模拟在多查询任务中计算昂贵；DL 代理可加速，但构建过程依赖 ML 专家经验，成为推广屏障。
AI.method: 提出 AutoSurrogate：四智能体协同流水线——数据画像、模型动物园架构挑选、贝叶斯超参优化、训练与质量评估；集成故障自愈（数值不稳定重启、精度不足换架构）；全部通过自然语言驱动。
AI.result: 在 3D 碳封存场景（渗透率→压力+CO₂ 饱和度，31 时间步）中，零人工调参即获得部署级代理，预测精度显著优于专家手工设计与 domain-agnostic AutoML 基线。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型驱动的全自动代理构建框架能够弥合 ML  expertise 缺口，为地下流等复杂模拟提供即插即用的高精度加速工具，具备实际部署潜力。

title: INST-Align: Implicit Neural Alignment for Spatial Transcriptomics via Canonical Expression Fields
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to MICCAI 2026
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures mRNA expression while preserving spatial organization, but multi-slice analysis faces two coupled difficulties: large non-rigid deformations across slices and inter-slice batch effects when alignment and integration are treated independently. We present INST-Align, an unsupervised pairwise framework that couples a coordinate-based deformation network with a shared Canonical Expression Field, an implicit neural representation mapping spatial coordinates to expression embeddings, for joint alignment and reconstruction. A two-phase training strategy first establishes a stable canonical embedding space and then jointly optimizes deformation and spatial-feature matching, enabling mutually constrained alignment and representation learning. Cross-slice parameter sharing of the canonical field regularizes ambiguous correspondences and absorbs batch variation. Across nine datasets, INST-Align achieves state-of-the-art mean OT Accuracy (0.702), NN Accuracy (0.719), and Chamfer distance, with Chamfer reductions of up to 94.9\% on large-deformation sections relative to the strongest baseline. The framework also yields biologically meaningful spatial embeddings and coherent 3D tissue reconstruction. The code will be released after review phase.

AI.tldr: INST-Align 将坐标形变网络与隐式“规范表达场”耦合，以两阶段无监督训练一次性完成多切片非刚性对齐与批次整合，在 9 个数据集中全面领先，并可直接重构 3D 组织图谱。
AI.motivation: 现有 ST 多切片研究把“矫正大形变”与“消除批次效应”分开处理，导致误差叠加。作者希望以统一框架同时解决空间对齐与表达整合，避免误差耦合。
AI.method: 提出 INST-Align：①构建共享的隐式 Canonical Expression Field，把任意坐标映射到表达嵌入；②设计坐标形变网络估计切片间非刚性变换；③两阶段训练——先建立稳定嵌入空间，再联合优化形变与特征匹配，并利用跨切片共享参数抑制批次差异。
AI.result: 在 9 个 ST 数据集中，INST-Align 平均 OT 精度 0.702、NN 精度 0.719，Chamfer 距离相较最强基线最高降低 94.9%，且生成的空间嵌入支持连贯 3D 组织重建。
