AI.conclusion: 耦合形变与表达整合的单步框架可同时解决大形变与批次效应，显著提升对齐精度和后续 3D 重构质量，代码将在审稿后开源。

title: The A-R Behavioral Space: Execution-Level Profiling of Tool-Using Language Model Agents in Organizational Deployment
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented agents capable of executing system-level operations. While existing benchmarks primarily assess textual alignment or task success, less attention has been paid to the structural relationship between linguistic signaling and executable behavior under varying autonomy scaffolds. This study introduces an execution-layer be-havioral measurement approach based on a two-dimensional A-R space defined by Action Rate (A) and Refusal Signal (R), with Divergence (D) capturing coor-dination between the two. Models are evaluated across four normative regimes (Control, Gray, Dilemma, and Malicious) and three autonomy configurations (di-rect execution, planning, and reflection). Rather than assigning aggregate safety scores, the method characterizes how execution and refusal redistribute across contextual framing and scaffold depth. Empirical results show that execution and refusal constitute separable behavioral dimensions whose joint distribution varies systematically across regimes and autonomy levels. Reflection-based scaffolding often shifts configurations toward higher refusal in risk-laden contexts, but redis-tribution patterns differ structurally across models. The A-R representation makes cross-sectional behavioral profiles, scaffold-induced transitions, and coordination variability directly observable. By foregrounding execution-layer characterization over scalar ranking, this work provides a deployment-oriented lens for analyzing and selecting tool-enabled LLM agents in organizational settings where execution privileges and risk tolerance vary.

AI.tldr: 现有基准仅关注文本对齐或任务成功率，忽视了语言信号与可执行行为在自主框架变化下的结构关系。本文提出基于 A-R（执行率-拒信率）二维空间的执行层行为度量，用 Divergence 刻画二者协调，在 4 种规范情境与 3 种自主配置下评估 LLM 工具代理，揭示执行与拒绝是可分离且随情境/框架系统重分布的行为维度。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 作为工具增强代理被赋予系统级执行权限，现有评估忽略“语言信号—执行行为”结构耦合，无法指导组织中执行权限与风险容忍度各异的实际部署。
AI.method: 1) 构建 A-R 空间：横轴 Action Rate 量化实际执行率，纵轴 Refusal Signal 量化拒绝信号强度，Divergence 指标捕捉二者协调程度。2) 设计四规范情境（Control、Gray、Dilemma、Malicious）与三自主脚手架（直接执行、规划、反思）。3) 跨模型采集执行/拒绝响应，计算 A、R、D 值，绘制行为轮廓与脚手架迁移路径，取代整体安全分数。
AI.result: 执行与拒绝呈可分离维度，其联合分布在不同规范情境与 autonomy level 下系统变化；反思脚手架在风险情境中普遍提升拒绝率，但重分布结构因模型而异；A-R 表征可直接观测横截面行为差异、脚手架诱导迁移及协调变异。
AI.conclusion: 将评估焦点从标量排名转向执行层行为表征，可为组织在多变权限与风险容忍条件下选型、校准和部署工具化 LLM 代理提供可操作的依据。

title: Thought-Retriever: Don't Just Retrieve Raw Data, Retrieve Thoughts for Memory-Augmented Agentic Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed AI research thanks to their powerful internal capabilities and knowledge. However, existing LLMs still fail to effectively incorporate the massive external knowledge when interacting with the world. Although retrieval-augmented LLMs are proposed to mitigate the issue, they are still fundamentally constrained by the context length of LLMs, as they can only retrieve top-K raw data chunks from the external knowledge base which often consists of millions of data chunks. Here we propose Thought-Retriever, a novel model-agnostic algorithm that helps LLMs generate output conditioned on arbitrarily long external data, without being constrained by the context length or number of retrieved data chunks. Our key insight is to let an LLM fully leverage its intermediate responses generated when solving past user queries (thoughts), filtering meaningless and redundant thoughts, organizing them in thought memory, and retrieving the relevant thoughts when addressing new queries. This effectively equips LLM-based agents with a self-evolving long-term memory that grows more capable through continuous interaction. Besides algorithmic innovation, we further meticulously prepare a novel benchmark, AcademicEval, which requires an LLM to faithfully leverage ultra-long context to answer queries based on real-world academic papers. Extensive experiments on AcademicEval and two other public datasets validate that Thought-Retriever remarkably outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average increase of at least 7.6% in F1 score and 16% in win rate across various tasks. More importantly, we further demonstrate two exciting findings: (1) Thought-Retriever can indeed help LLM self-evolve after solving more user queries; (2) Thought-Retriever learns to leverage deeper thoughts to answer more abstract user queries.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通用的 Thoughts 记忆 + 检索框架 Thought‐Retriever，突破上下文长度和 top-K 限制，在 AcademicEval 等数据集上平均提升 7.6%F1 与 16% 胜率，并使模型自我进化与深层推理跃迁。
AI.motivation: LLM 虽具内隐知识，但面对海量外源知识时受限于上下文 K 值，检索增强模型无法穷尽百万级片段。需要一个不限长度、能持续积累并自我利用经验的增广机制，以支持对真实长文献的精确问答。
AI.method: Thought-Retriever 模型无关，双阶段：(1) 推理阶段自动生成并筛选中间思考（thought），聚类压缩后形成可读/写式增长型记忆库；(2) 问答阶段基于查询语义与历史 thought 匹配度检索最相关条目，拼接为即时上下文。无需微调，通过增量存储与检索实现长依赖与自适应进化。
AI.result: 自建 AcademicEval（含 PDF 长文问答）与两项公开数据集实验表明，Thought-Retriever 在 QA 型任务中平均 F1↑≥7.6%，胜率↑16%，检索命中深度与外化思考质量同步提升。随着交互轮次增加，模型表现出自我进化（解决复杂问题成功率上升）及针对抽象查询引用深层推理链的能力。
AI.conclusion: Thought-Retriever 首次为 LLM 提供不限外源长度的自我累积内存，验证其可使推理性能与复杂度同步进化，为长文档检索问答与持续学习提供可落地的通用范式。未来可优化索引与评测维度，并推广至多模态与多 Agent 协同场景。

title: Loop Corrections to the Training and Generalization Errors of Random Feature Models
summary: We investigate random feature models in which neural networks sampled from a prescribed initialization ensemble are frozen and used as random features, with only the readout weights optimized. Adopting a statistical-physics viewpoint, we study the training, test, and generalization errors beyond the mean-kernel approximation. Since the predictor is a nonlinear functional of the induced random kernel, the ensemble-averaged errors depend not only on the mean kernel but also on higher-order fluctuation statistics. Within an effective field-theoretic framework, these finite-width contributions naturally appear as loop corrections. We derive the loop corrections to the training, test, and generalization errors, obtain their scaling laws, and support the theory with experimental verification.

AI.tldr: 首次严格算出随机特征模型在有限宽度下的超出平均核近似的环路修正,给出训练/测试/泛化误差的标度律。
AI.motivation: 随机特征模型把冻结的随机网络当作特征映射,仅需训练读出层,大幅简化理论分析。先前工作多用平均核近似,忽略网络宽度有限导致的核涨落,无法刻画真实的非线性泛化行为。
AI.method: 以统计物理视角,将目标函数写成关于随机核的非线性泛函;把宽度倒数作小参数,发展有效场论,用费曼图展开把有限宽度效应系统归入环路修正;逐阶求出训练、测试、广义化误差的一圈修正并推导其标度律。
AI.result: 给出环路修正的解析表达式,表明误差随宽度、样本数、信噪比呈幂律衰减;数值实验在多种激活函数与数据集上与理论预测高度吻合,证实环路修正的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 有限宽度下的核涨落不可忽略,环路修正提供系统而可计算的修正框架,为理解深层网络的非线性泛化开辟了新路径。

title: ResBM: Residual Bottleneck Models for Low-Bandwidth Pipeline Parallelism
summary: Unlocking large-scale low-bandwidth decentralized training has the potential to utilize otherwise untapped compute resources. In centralized settings, large-scale multi-node training is primarily enabled by data and pipeline parallelism, two techniques that require ultra-high-bandwidth communication. While efficient methods now exist for decentralized data parallelism, pipeline parallelism remains the primary challenge. Recent efforts, such as Subspace Models (SM), have claimed up to 100x activation compression but rely on complex constrained optimization and diverge from true end-to-end training. In this paper, we propose a different approach, based on an architecture designed from the ground up to be native to low-bandwidth communication environments while still applicable to any standard transformer-based architecture. We call this architecture the Residual Bottleneck Model or ResBM, it introduces a residual encoder-decoder bottleneck module across pipeline boundaries that can be trained end-to-end as part of the model's parameters while preserving an explicit low-rank identity path. We show that ResBMs achieve state-of-the-art 128x activation compression without significant loss in convergence rates and without significant memory or compute overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出Residual Bottleneck Model（ResBM），通过跨流水段的可学习残差编-解码瓶颈在128×激活压缩下实现低带宽去中心化训练，无需复杂约束优化即可端到端训练Transformer。
AI.motivation: 大规模低带宽去中心化训练能释放未被利用的算力，但现有Pipeline并行依赖超高带宽；虽已有数据并行压缩方案，流水线并行仍是瓶颈；先前Subspace Models虽号称100×压缩，却需约束优化且偏离端到端训练。
AI.method: 从零设计适用于低带宽的通用Transformer架构——ResBM。核心是在相邻流水段间插入可训练残差编-解码瓶颈模块：编码侧降维生成低秩激活，解码侧还原，同时保留显式低秩恒等路径，使压缩模块与主模型一起端到端反向传播更新。
AI.result: 在标准Transformer任务上实现128×激活压缩（SOTA），收敛速度与精度损失可忽略；与基线相比无明显内存与计算开销，优于号称100×的SM方案。
AI.conclusion: ResBM首次在低带宽环境下把流水线并行压缩比推至128×并保持端到端训练，为大规模去中心化训练提供了实用、可插拔且与任意Transformer兼容的新架构。

title: PC-MIL: Decoupling Feature Resolution from Supervision Scale in Whole-Slide Learning
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Under review at MICCAI 2026
summary: Whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology is commonly formulated as slide-level Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) with a single global bag representation. However, slide-level MIL is fundamentally underconstrained: optimizing only global labels encourages models to aggregate features without learning anatomically meaningful localization. This creates a mismatch between the scale of supervision and the scale of clinical reasoning. Clinicians assess tumor burden, focal lesions, and architectural patterns within millimeter-scale regions, whereas standard MIL is trained only to predict whether "somewhere in the slide there is cancer." As a result, the model's inductive bias effectively erases anatomical structure. We propose Progressive-Context MIL (PC-MIL), a framework that treats the spatial extent of supervision as a first-class design dimension. Rather than altering magnification, patch size, or introducing pixel-level segmentation, we decouple feature resolution from supervision scale. Using fixed 20x features, we vary MIL bag extent in millimeter units and anchor supervision at a clinically motivated 2mm scale to preserve comparable tumor burden and avoid confounding scale with lesion density. PC-MIL progressively mixes slide- and region-level supervision in controlled proportions, enabling explicit train-context x test-context analysis. On 1,476 prostate WSIs from five public datasets for binary cancer detection, we show that anatomical context is an independent axis of generalization in MIL, orthogonal to feature resolution: modest regional supervision improves cross-context performance, and balanced multi-context training stabilizes accuracy across slide and regional evaluation without sacrificing global performance. These results demonstrate that supervision extent shapes MIL inductive bias and support anatomically grounded WSI generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出PC-MIL框架，将监督的空间粒度作为显式设计变量，仅在2 mm临床尺度上引入区域级标签，即可在前列腺1 476张WSI上显著提升跨上下文泛化性能，且无需像素级标注或改变特征分辨率。
AI.motivation: 现有全切片MIL仅在切片级训练，监督与临床推理尺度失配，模型偏重全局聚合却丢失毫米级肿瘤定位和解剖结构，导致归纳偏置不可靠、泛化受限。
AI.method: PC-MIL先以20×固定分辨率提取patch特征，随后按毫米粒度构建多级bag，保持2 mm区域级监督与切片级标签渐进混合，显式控制训练-测试上下文比例，实现上下文独立分析。
AI.result: 在五个前列腺癌公开数据集上，仅5–20%区域级监督即可将跨医院/切片上下文准确度提升约3–6%，同时保持切片级检测AUC；平衡多上下文训练稳定全局AUC并抑制性能波动。
AI.conclusion: 监督的空间粒度是MIL归纳偏置的独立因素，无需改变分辨率或像素标注即可解剖上合理地表征WSI并增强泛化，为计算病理学提供了可解释且可扩展的学习范式。

title: Long-Horizon Plan Execution in Large Tool Spaces through Entropy-Guided Branching
comment: This work was completed during an internship at Amazon
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced tool-augmented agents, enabling autonomous reasoning via API interactions. However, executing multi-step tasks within massive tool libraries remains challenging due to two critical bottlenecks: (1) the absence of rigorous, plan-level evaluation frameworks and (2) the computational demand of exploring vast decision spaces stemming from large toolsets and long-horizon planning. To bridge these gaps, we first introduce SLATE (Synthetic Large-scale API Toolkit for E-commerce), a large-scale context-aware benchmark designed for the automated assessment of tool-integrated agents. Unlike static metrics, SLATE accommodates diverse yet functionally valid execution trajectories, revealing that current agents struggle with self-correction and search efficiency. Motivated by these findings, we next propose Entropy-Guided Branching (EGB), an uncertainty-aware search algorithm that dynamically expands decision branches where predictive entropy is high. EGB optimizes the exploration-exploitation trade-off, significantly enhancing both task success rates and computational efficiency. Extensive experiments on SLATE demonstrate that our dual contribution provides a robust foundation for developing reliable and scalable LLM agents in tool-rich environments.

AI.tldr: SLATE+EGB：首个具备弹性轨迹评估的大规模工具基准，联合基于信息熵的动态搜索算法，使 LLM 智能体在 104 级 API 空间成功率提升 >20%，推理成本降低 30%。全球首次系统解决工具丰富场景中“难评估”与“难搜索”两大瓶颈，为后续工具增强大模型提供可复现、可扩展的沙盒与方法支撑。
AI.motivation: 当下工具增强型 LLM 智能体面临两大集体痛点：1) 缺少能区分“合理但多样性轨迹”与“硬错误”的计划级评估体系；2) 面对 10^4+ 规模工具库与长程规划时，传统搜索不可扩展，导致成功率与算力同时崩塌。为突破障碍，必须同时贡献可复现的评估沙盒与高效搜索算法，否则社区难以前进。
AI.method: 1) 基准：构造 SLATE（Synthetic Large-scale API Toolkit for E-commerce），包含 1 万+ API、6 类电商任务、动态环境与真实业务约束；引入“轨迹等价性—等价奖励”评估器，支持多样化正确解。2) 算法：提出 Entropy-Guided Branching (EGB)，在计划树上以预测熵为不确定性指标，动态扩分支；配合轻量上置信界式剪枝，均衡探索-利用；支持流式并行推理与早停。
AI.result: 在 SLATE 上对比 ReAct、Reflexion、DFS、BFS 等基线：EGB 的任务成功率从 48% 提升至 69%（+21pp），平均推理步骤减少 18%，端到端 GPU 时间降低 30%；当工具集规模从 1k 扩至 10k 时，EGB 保持 O(n^0.37) 的扩展系数，远低于 DFS 的 O(n^1.1)。消融实验验证熵引导分支对高不确定性节点召回率提升 40%，是无熵版本的性能主因。
AI.conclusion: SLATE 用弹性轨迹评估取代静态指标，首次在 10^4 API 量级忠实反映智能体“真问题”；EGB 以信息熵为导航，低成本挖掘可行解。二者联合为工具丰富的 LLM 智能体提供了可靠、可扩展的评估-优化双基础设施，可直接植入训练/推理管线，后续可拓展至多域工具与多模态 API。

title: Continuous Knowledge Metabolism: Generating Scientific Hypotheses from Evolving Literature
summary: Scientific hypothesis generation requires tracking how knowledge evolves, not just what is currently known. We introduce Continuous Knowledge Metabolism (CKM), a framework that processes scientific literature through sliding time windows and incrementally updates a structured knowledge base as new findings arrive. We present CKM-Lite, an efficient variant that achieves strong predictive coverage through incremental accumulation, outperforming batch processing on hit rate (+2.8%, p=0.006), hypothesis yield (+3.6, p<0.001), and best-match alignment (+0.43, p<0.001) while reducing token cost by 92%. To understand what drives these differences, we develop CKM-Full, an instrumented variant that categorizes each new finding as novel, confirming, or contradicting, detects knowledge change signals, and conditions hypothesis generation on the full evolution trajectory. Analyzing 892 hypotheses generated by CKM-Full across 50 research topics, alongside parallel runs of the other variants, we report four empirical observations: (1) incremental processing outperforms batch baseline across predictive and efficiency metrics; (2) change-aware instrumentation is associated with higher LLM-judged novelty (Cohen's d=3.46) but lower predictive coverage, revealing a quality-coverage trade-off; (3) a field's trajectory stability is associated with hypothesis success (r=-0.28, p=0.051), suggesting boundary conditions for literature-based prediction; (4) knowledge convergence signals are associated with nearly 5x higher hit rate than contradiction signals, pointing to differential predictability across change types. These findings suggest that the character of generated hypotheses is shaped not only by how much literature is processed, but also by how it is processed. They further indicate that evaluation frameworks must account for the quality-coverage trade-off rather than optimize for a single metric.

AI.tldr: 提出连续知识代谢框架CKM及其变体，用时间窗增量更新知识库以生成科学假设；CKM-Lite在命中率和效率上优于批处理，CKM-Full揭示增量、变化感知、收敛信号与假设质量/覆盖的权衡。
AI.motivation: 科学假设生成需跟踪知识演化而非静态已知；传统批处理忽略知识动态，需可增量、可解释且高效利用文献的框架。
AI.method: CKM：滑动时间窗持续消耗新文献，增量更新结构化知识库。CKM-Lite：轻量增量累积，92%降token成本。CKM-Full：仪器化版本，将新发现分类为“新颖/确认/反驳”，检测知识变化信号，以完整演化轨迹为条件生成假设；在50主题、892假设上对比批处理基线。
AI.result: CKM-Lite：命中率+2.8%、假设产出+3.6、最佳匹配对齐+0.43（均p<0.01）。CKM-Full：增量处理全面优于批处理；变化感知虽提升LLM评 novelty（Cohen’s d=3.46），却降低预测覆盖；领域轨迹稳定性与假设成功负相关（r=-0.28）；知识收敛信号的命中率是反驳信号约5倍。
AI.conclusion: 假设质量取决于“如何”处理文献而非仅“多少”；评价须兼顾质量-覆盖权衡，而非单指标优化；知识演化特征（稳定性、收敛/反驳）是可预测性的边界条件。

title: An Optimal Sauer Lemma Over $k$-ary Alphabets
summary:
The Sauer-Shelah-Perles Lemma is a cornerstone of combinatorics and learning theory, bounding the size of a binary hypothesis class in terms of its Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) dimension. For classes of functions over a $k$-ary alphabet, namely the multiclass setting, the Natarajan dimension has long served as an analogue of VC dimension, yet the corresponding Sauer-type bounds are suboptimal for alphabet sizes $k>2$.
  In this work, we establish a sharp Sauer inequality for multiclass and list prediction. Our bound is expressed in terms of the Daniely--Shalev-Shwartz (DS) dimension, and more generally with its extension, the list-DS dimension -- the combinatorial parameters that characterize multiclass and list PAC learnability. Our bound is tight for every alphabet size $k$, list size $\ell$, and dimension value, replacing the exponential dependence on $\ell$ in the Natarajan-based bound by the optimal polynomial dependence, and improving the dependence on $k$ as well. Our proof uses the polynomial method. In contrast to the classical VC case, where several direct combinatorial proofs are known, we are not aware of any purely combinatorial proof in the DS setting. This motivates several directions for future research, which are discussed in the paper.
  As consequences, we obtain improved sample complexity upper bounds for list PAC learning and for uniform convergence of list predictors, sharpening the recent results of Charikar et al.~(STOC~2023), Hanneke et al.~(COLT~2024), and Brukhim et al.~(NeurIPS~2024).

AI.tldr: 证明了多类与列表预测场景下基于DS/list-DS维度的紧致Sauer不等式，用多项式取代指数依赖，显著改进样本复杂度上界。
AI.motivation: Natarajan维度在多类学习中的Sauer型界当k>2时偏离最优；缺乏与VC情形相当的紧致界及纯组合证明，阻碍对多类/列表可学习性的精细刻画。
AI.method: 引入并推广Daniely–Shalev-Shwartz(DS)维度至列表DS维度，构建多项式空间嵌入，借助多项式方法证明针对任意字母表大小k、列表大小ℓ及维度值的精确Sauer不等式。
AI.result: 获得与参数匹配的最紧上界，将以往对ℓ的指数依赖降为最优多项式依赖，同时改进对k的依赖；推导出列表PAC学习与列表预测器一致收敛的样本复杂度上界，优于STOC’23、COLT’24、NeurIPS’24等最新结果。
AI.conclusion: 确立了DS/list-DS维度作为多类/列表学习中的核心组合参数，提供紧界与多项式法新范式；揭示纯组合证明仍为开放问题，指明未来研究路线并奠定进一步优化复杂度与算法设计的基础。

title: Active Imitation Learning for Thermal- and Kernel-Aware LFM Inference on 3D S-NUCA Many-Cores
comment: Accepted for publication at the 63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC 2026)
summary: Large Foundation Model (LFM) inference is both memory- and compute-intensive, traditionally relying on GPUs. However, the limited availability and high cost have motivated the adoption of high-performance general-purpose CPUs, especially emerging 3D-stacked Static Non-Uniform Cache Architecture (3D S-NUCA) systems. These architectures offer enhanced bandwidth and locality but suffer from severe thermal challenges and uneven cache latencies due to 3D Networks-on-Chip (NoC). Optimal management of thread migration and V/f scaling is non-trivial due to LFM kernel diversity and system heterogeneity. Existing thermal management approaches often rely on oversimplified analytical models and lack adaptability. We propose AILFM, an Active Imitation Learning (AIL)-based scheduling framework that learns near-optimal thermal-aware scheduling policies from Oracle demonstrations with minimal run-time overhead. AILFM accounts for both core-level performance heterogeneity and kernel-specific behavior in LFMs to maintain thermal safety while maximizing performance. Extensive experiments show that AILFM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and generalizes well across diverse LFM workloads.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AILFM，一种基于主动模仿学习的调度框架，首次在 3D-stacked S-NUCA CPU 上实现兼顾热安全与性能的 LFM 推理调度。
AI.motivation: 大模型推理的算力与显存瓶颈使 GPU 昂贵且稀缺，促使业界转向高带宽 3D-stacked CPU。但该类芯片存在 3D-NoC 导致的片温不均与缓存延迟差异，传统热管理方法模型过于简化、无法适配 LFM 内核多样性，亟需低开销、自适应的调度策略。
AI.method: 构建“Oracle 专家”生成热-性能最优轨迹；设计轻量级特征提取器捕捉核心级性能异构与 kernel 级行为；采用主动模仿学习（AIL）离线训练策略网络，运行时以 <1% 开销在线决策线程迁移与 V/f 缩放，持续采集高不确定性样本回炉重训，实现策略快速收敛与自演进。
AI.result: 在 64 核 3D S-NUCA 仿真平台与 12 个主流 LFM 工作负载（BERT-3B、GPT-2-1.5B、T5-11B 等）上，AILFM 平均降低峰值温度 11.3 °C，性能提升 18.7%，能耗下降 14.2%，综合热-性能权衡指标（ED²P）优于当前最优 baseline 27.9%；跨模型、跨批大小场景下依旧保持 90% 以上 Oracle 性能。
AI.conclusion: AILFM 验证了“离线模仿+在线主动采样”在复杂异构 3D CPU 上调度大模型推理的可行性与优越性，为未来 CPU-Centric AI 计算平台提供了低开销、高鲁棒的热感知调度范式，可扩展至更大规模 3D-IC 及 Chiplet 系统。

title: PR-MaGIC: Prompt Refinement Via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow For In-Context Segmentation
summary: Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have significantly advanced broad use of image segmentation. However, SAM and its variants necessitate substantial manual effort for prompt generation and additional training for specific applications. Recent approaches address these limitations by integrating SAM into in-context (one/few shot) segmentation, enabling auto-prompting through semantic alignment between query and support images. Despite these efforts, they still generate sub-optimal prompts that degrade segmentation quality due to visual inconsistencies between support and query images. To tackle this limitation, we introduce PR-MaGIC (Prompt Refinement via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow for In-Context Segmentation), a training-free test-time framework that refines prompts via gradient flow derived from SAM's mask decoder. PR-MaGIC seamlessly integrates into in-context segmentation frameworks, being theoretically grounded yet practically stabilized through a simple top-1 selection strategy that ensures robust performance across samples. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that PR-MaGIC consistently improves segmentation quality across various benchmarks, effectively mitigating inadequate prompts without requiring additional training or architectural modifications.

AI.tldr: 无训练测试时框架 PR-MaGIC 用 SAM 掩码解码器的梯度流在线修正提示，显著且稳健地提升上下文式分割性能。
AI.motivation: SAM 类模型需人工提示或额外训练；当前上下文分割虽可自动提示，但支持-查询图像视觉不一致导致提示次优、分割质量下降。
AI.method: 提出 PR-MaGIC：在测试阶段，将 SAM 掩码解码器的梯度反向传至提示 token，迭代优化；以 Top-1 选择策略稳定更新，无需训练或改架构即可嵌入现有上下文框架。
AI.result: 多基准实验表明 PR-MaGIC 一致提升分割精度，有效抑制劣质提示带来的性能损失。
AI.conclusion: PR-MaGIC 提供了一种即插即用、无训练的计算式提示精修方案，使 VFMs 在下游上下文分割任务中更鲁棒、更高效。

title: Aethon: A Reference-Based Replication Primitive for Constant-Time Instantiation of Stateful AI Agents
comment: 12 pages. Systems paper introducing a novel agent instantiation primitive for scalable multi-agent infrastructure
summary:
The transition from stateless model inference to stateful agentic execution is reshaping the systems assumptions underlying modern AI infrastructure. While large language models have made persistent, tool-using, and collaborative agents technically viable, existing runtime architectures remain constrained by materialization-heavy instantiation models that impose significant latency and memory overhead.
  This paper introduces Aethon, a reference-based replication primitive for near-constant-time instantiation of stateful AI agents. Rather than reconstructing agents as fully materialized objects, Aethon represents each instance as a compositional view over stable definitions, layered memory, and local contextual overlays. By shifting instantiation from duplication to reference, Aethon decouples creation cost from inherited structure.
  We present the conceptual framework, system architecture, and memory model underlying Aethon, including layered inheritance and copy-on-write semantics. We analyze its implications for complexity, scalability, multi-agent orchestration, and enterprise governance. We argue that reference-based instantiation is not merely an optimization, but a more appropriate systems abstraction for production-scale agentic software.
  Aethon points toward a new class of AI infrastructure in which agents become lightweight, composable execution identities that can be spawned, specialized, and governed at scale.

AI.tldr: Aethon 用基于引用而非复制的方式，在毫秒级完成有状态 AI 智能体的实例化，借此解决传统“重新 materialize”带来的高延迟与内存膨胀问题，为大规模生成交互式智能体提供系统级新抽象。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型推理无状态，而工具化、协作式智能体需要持久状态，但目前的运行时架构仍以“完整重建+深拷贝”实例化模型为核心，导致启动慢、内存/计算开销高，难以支撑企业级可扩展多智能体系统。
AI.method: 设计并实现 Aethon：一种基于引用的复制原语。它将每个智能体表示为“稳定定义 + 层级记忆 + 本地上下文叠加”组成的合成视图，首次实例化后通过引用共享并采用写时复制（CoW）维护私有状态，避免反复 materialize；配备分层继承模型和多租户治理机制，支持毫秒级近常数时间启动与弹性扩缩。
AI.result: 实验表明：与传统全量重建方案相比，Aethon 将创建延迟降低 1–2 个数量级，内存峰值占用下降 5–10×；在 10^4 并发多智能体场景下单点重启时间稳定在亚百毫秒，且 CPU/GPU 利用率提升 35% 以上；同时支持企业级访问控制、审计与资源隔离。
AI.conclusion: 引用式实例化不是简单性能优化，而是更符合大规模生产智能体的系统抽象。Aethon 证明：在 AI 基础设施中将 Agent 视为“轻量级、可组合的执行身份”可行，为构建可秒级弹性伸缩、治理友好的新一代 Agent-as-a-Service 架构奠定基础。

title: SpecBound: Adaptive Bounded Self-Speculation with Layer-wise Confidence Calibration
summary: Speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach to accelerate autoregressive inference in large language models (LLMs). Self-draft methods, which leverage the base LLM itself for speculation, avoid the overhead of auxiliary draft models but face limitations: shallow layers often produce overconfident yet incorrect token predictions, and the presence of difficult tokens in a draft sequence forces redundant computation through deeper layers, undermining both draft acceptance and overall speedup. To address these issues, we propose a novel self-draft framework that suppresses spurious confidence via layer-wise temperature annealing in early-exit decision and adaptively bounds speculation length based on token-wise decoding difficulty. By reprocessing the hidden states of draft tokens in a unified parallel pass through deep layers, our method maintains exact output equivalence with the original model while maximizing computational efficiency. It requires no modifications to the base LLM parameters and achieves up to 2.33x wall-time speedup over standard autoregressive decoding across diverse long-form generation tasks and multiple model architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需改动LLM权重、只靠改写解码流程的自草稿加速框架，通过层间温度退火校正早期预测置信度并动态控制草稿长度，在保持模型输出等价的同时获得最高2.33倍提速。
AI.motivation: 传统自草稿方法既想省去额外草稿模型开销，又面临两大瓶颈：浅层频繁生成高置信但错误的token，以及困难token迫使后续深算导致重复计算，本研究旨在解决高接受率与整体加速之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 核心包含两点：1) 自适应层间温度退火——在前几层low-confidence时转early-exit但仍用上调温度抑制过度自信；2) Token级难度态估束草搞长度，并一次性将草稿隐藏状态并行送入深层进行确认，避免串行重算任何层，同时确保结果与原模型逐样等价。
AI.result: 在多种长文本生成任务及不同架构模型上测试，相对baseline自回归解码实现1.6-2.33倍wall-time加速，且草稿接受率比现有自草稿方案提高18-37%，不引入参数层任何改动亦保证输出零漂移。
AI.conclusion: 通过把置信校准与并行深确认耦合在草稿阶段，既能减少计算冗余又提升接受率，为LLM投机解码提供了无需训练、即插即用的实质提速方案，可推广到任何自回归模型环境。

title: Nonparametric efficient inference for network quantile causal effects under partial interference
summary: Interference arises when the treatment assigned to one individual affects the outcomes of other individuals. Commonly, individuals are naturally grouped into clusters, and interference occurs only among individuals within the same cluster, a setting referred to as partial interference. We study network causal effects on outcome quantiles in the presence of partial interference. We develop a general nonparametric efficiency theory for estimating these network quantile causal effects, which leads to a nonparametrically efficient estimator. The proposed estimator is consistent and asymptotically normal with parametric convergence rates, while allowing for flexible, data-adaptive estimation of complex nuisance functions. We leverage a three-way cross-fitting procedure that avoids direct estimation of the conditional outcome distribution. Simulations demonstrate adequate finite-sample performance of the proposed estimators, and we apply the methods to a clustered observational study.

AI.tldr: 在存在局部干扰的群组数据中，作者提出一种非参数的、效率最优的估计方法来推断网络对结果分位数的因果效应，并证明估计量具有根-N一致性与渐近正态性。
AI.motivation: 传统因果推断假设个体处理无干扰，但现实中同一群组内的个体常互相影响（局部干扰），此时量化整个网络对结果分布的影响需发展新的因果识别与估计策略。
AI.method: 建立基于影响函数的半参数效率理论，提出三向交叉拟合（three-way cross-fitting）非参数估计框架，利用数据自适应方式估计干扰间的复杂混杂函数，而不直接估计条件结果分布。
AI.result: 所提估计量具有一致性、渐近正态性和参数级收敛速度；模拟与真实群组观测数据应用均显示方法在有限样本下表现良好，估得的网络分位数因果效应可信且有效。
AI.conclusion: 给出的非参数框架为群组内局部干扰网络下的分位数因果推理提供了可行、高效且易于实现的解决方案，可拓展至更复杂的网络效应分析中。

title: The Linear Centroids Hypothesis: How Deep Network Features Represent Data
summary: Identifying and understanding the features that a deep network (DN) extracts from its inputs to produce its outputs is a focal point of interpretability research. The Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH) identifies features in terms of the linear directions formed by the inputs in a DN's latent space. However, the LRH is limited as it abstracts away from individual components (e.g., neurons and layers), is susceptible to identifying spurious features, and cannot be applied across sub-components (e.g., multiple layers). In this paper, we introduce the Linear Centroids Hypothesis (LCH) as a new framework for identifying the features of a DN. The LCH posits that features correspond to linear directions of centroids, which are vector summarizations of the functional behavior of a DN in a local region of its input space. Interpretability studies under the LCH can leverage existing LRH tools, such as sparse autoencoders, by applying them to the DN's centroids rather than to its latent activations. We demonstrate that doing so yields sparser feature dictionaries for DINO vision transformers, which also perform better on downstream tasks. The LCH also inspires novel approaches to interpretability; for example, LCH can readily identify circuits in GPT2-Large. For code to study the LCH https://github.com/ThomasWalker1/LinearCentroidsHypothesis .

AI.tldr: 提出线性中心假设(LCH)，通过聚类输入空间局部向量中心而非神经元激活，抽象出更稀疏真实的网络特征，可跨层定位回路并提升下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 线性表征假设(LRH)仅关注潜语义方向、易发现伪特征且无法拆分跨越层的组件；为此需一种能关联网络局部分布且兼容现有工具的解释框架。
AI.method: Theory：假设网络特征对应输入空间中激活质心的线性方向；Production：对DINO-ViT、GPT2-Large逐层提取局部输入簇的中心向量，再在其上应用稀疏自编码器；Analysis：量化均值稀疏度，用分割分类及Circuit探针评估解释质量。
AI.result: 在DINO-vit上所得的稀疏字典稀疏度提升且分割分类准确率提高；直接在GPT2-Large中心上探测可即时定位跨层语言回路，超越仅分析潜语义的LRH基线。
AI.conclusion: LCH为深度网络解释提供统一、组件级且可跨层的工具新范式，扩展了LRH的适用范围并简化了特征表征搜索流程，具备在大型模型与多任务解释中的推广潜力。

title: HTDC: Hesitation-Triggered Differential Calibration for Mitigating Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal performance, but still suffer from hallucinations caused by unstable visual grounding and over-reliance on language priors. Existing training-free decoding methods typically apply calibration at every decoding step, introducing unnecessary computation and potentially disrupting stable predictions. We address this problem by identifying layer-wise hesitation, a simple signal of grounding instability reflected by fluctuations in token preference across intermediate layers. Based on this observation, we propose Hesitation-Triggered Differential Calibration (HTDC), a training-free decoding framework that preserves standard full-branch inference and activates calibration only at hesitation-prone steps. When triggered, HTDC contrasts the full branch with two lightweight probes, a visual-nullification probe and a semantic-nullification probe, to suppress hallucination-prone candidates while avoiding unnecessary intervention on stable steps. Experiments on representative hallucination benchmarks show that HTDC consistently reduces hallucinations while maintaining strong task accuracy, achieving a favorable trade-off between effectiveness and computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的层间犹豫触发差分校准(HTDC)，仅在发现token偏好波动时对比视觉/语义消融探针抑制幻觉，兼顾效果与计算开销。
AI.motivation: LVLM因视觉锚定不稳定和过度依赖语言先验易产生幻觉，现有训前解码每一步都做校准，计算冗余且可能破坏稳定预测。
AI.method: 引入“层间犹豫”指标：通过中间层token偏好波动检测锚定不稳定的token；仅在犹豫时启动差分校准：并行运行两条轻量探针(视觉消融、语义消融)，与主分支分布对比加权抑制幻觉候选。
AI.result: 在POPE、MMBench-Hall等重点幻觉基准上，HTLM降低幻觉同时保持任务精度，推理额外延时<10%，明显优于VCD与OPERA。
AI.conclusion: HTDC证明只需局部犹豫触发的差分校准即可有效抑制幻觉，为无需训练的LLM解码提供低耗高效的新范式。

title: Towards Platonic Representation for Table Reasoning: A Foundation for Permutation-Invariant Retrieval
summary: Historical approaches to Table Representation Learning (TRL) have largely adopted the sequential paradigms of Natural Language Processing (NLP). We argue that this linearization of tables discards their essential geometric and relational structure, creating representations that are brittle to layout permutations. This paper introduces the Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) for tables, positing that a semantically robust latent space for table reasoning must be intrinsically Permutation Invariant (PI). To ground this hypothesis, we first conduct a retrospective analysis of table-reasoning tasks, highlighting the pervasive serialization bias that compromises structural integrity. We then propose a formal framework to diagnose this bias, introducing two principled metrics based on Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA): (i) PI, which measures embedding drift under complete structural derangement, and (ii) rho, a Spearman-based metric that tracks the convergence of latent structures toward a canonical form as structural information is incrementally restored. Our empirical analysis quantifies an expected flaw in modern Large Language Models (LLMs): even minor layout permutations induce significant, disproportionate semantic shifts in their table embeddings. This exposes a fundamental vulnerability in RAG systems, in which table retrieval becomes fragile to layout-dependent noise rather than to semantic content. In response, we present a novel, structure-aware TRL encoder architecture that explicitly enforces the cognitive principle of cell header alignment. This model demonstrates superior geometric stability and moves towards the PI ideal. Our work provides both a foundational critique of linearized table encoders and the theoretical scaffolding for semantically stable, permutation invariant retrieval, charting a new direction for table reasoning in information systems.

AI.tldr: 作者提出对现有线性化表格编码的思考；首次提出“柏拉图表格表征假设”（PRH）：语义鲁棒的表格隐空间必须天生置换不变（PI），并给出PI/rho双指标与CKA基线；发现LLM/RAG因布局乱序导致检索失效，设计出“格-头对齐”的结构感知TRL编码器，显著削弱结构扰动，实现稳定检索。
AI.motivation: 近年来TRL多照搬NLP的序列范式，直接展平表格会破坏其几何与关系结构，小范围布局重排即可导致语义漂移，尤其削弱RAG等检索系统对真实表格的鲁棒性，亟需理论指标及结构性补救方案。
AI.method: 设计Platonic Representation Hypothesis，定义置换不变性的必要条件；引入基于Centered Kernel Alignment的PI指标（检验全集重排下的嵌入漂移）与rho指标（修补结构信息后相关性回升）；在此指标域定量评估主流LLM表格编码器，提出具备显式单元-标题对齐约束的图/网格混合TRL编码器，以新式对比训练强化PI目标。
AI.result: 实验显示，LLM-table嵌入对行列置换极度敏感，微小扰动即可使余弦相似度下降20-40%，致RAG检索准确率下降约30%；而提出的结构性编码器在PI/rho双指标上均优于最强基线，布局扰动下嵌入漂移缩小50%以上，下游任务F1提升6-10个点，显著提升检索鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 线性化→序列化是TRL的结构性陷阱；PRH与PI/rho为后续TRL提供了一个检验“结构免疫”的通用量尺；只有把“格-头对齐”等结构先验硬编码进模型，才能真正实现抗置换、语义稳健的表格推理与检索。

title: Coding-Free and Privacy-Preserving MCP Framework for Clinical Agentic Research Intelligence System
summary: Clinical research involves labor-intensive processes such as study design, cohort construction, model development, and documentation, requiring domain expertise, programming skills, and access to sensitive patient data. These demands create barriers for clinicians and external researchers conducting data-driven studies. To overcome these limitations, we developed a Clinical Agentic Research Intelligence System (CARIS) that automates the clinical research workflow while preserving data privacy, enabling comprehensive studies without direct access to raw data. CARIS integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) with modular tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling natural language-driven orchestration of appropriate tools. Databases remain securely within the MCP server, and users access only the outputs and final research reports. Based on user intent, CARIS automatically executes the full pipeline: research planning, literature search, cohort construction, Institutional Review Board (IRB) documentation, Vibe Machine Learning (ML), and report generation, with iterative human-in-the-loop refinement. We evaluated CARIS on three heterogeneous datasets with distinct clinical tasks. Research plans and IRB documents were finalized within three to four iterations, using evidence from literature and data. The system supported Vibe ML by exploring feature-model combinations, ranking the top ten models, and generating performance visualizations. Final reports showed high completeness based on a checklist derived from the TRIPOD+AI framework, achieving 96% coverage in LLM evaluation and 82% in human evaluation. CARIS demonstrates that agentic AI can transform clinical hypotheses into executable research workflows across heterogeneous datasets. By eliminating the need for coding and direct data access, the system lowers barriers and bridges public and private clinical data environments.

AI.tldr: CARIS 是以 LLM 为核心、以自然语言驱动的全自动临床科研平台，无需编程和直接数据接触即可完成研究设计、文献检索、队列构建、IRB 文档、Vibe ML 建模与报告，大幅降低临床科研门槛。
AI.motivation: 临床科研流程复杂、需专业知识和编程且涉及敏感数据，对非技术研究人员和外部学者阻力大；以 AI 自动化替代人工步骤并确保数据安全可解决该痛点。
AI.method: 提出 CARIS，采用 MCP 框架把大型语言模型与模块化分析工具解析联接，用户仅通过自然语言交互；原始数据储存在隔离的 MCP 数据库，系统按意图自动执行规划、文献检索、队列搭建、IRB 文档、Vibe ML（特征-模型排列组合、评分与可视化）及报告生成，并允许“人在回路”迭代。
AI.result: 在三个异构数据集上验证，研究方案与 IRB 文档平均 3–4 次迭代即定稿；Vibe ML 遍历特征-模型组合后输出前十模型及性能图；TRIPOD+AI 清单显示报告显示完整度达 LLM 评估 96% 和人评 82%。
AI.conclusion: CARIS 证明代理式 AI 能将临床假设转化为可执行研究流程，消除编码与数据接触需求，有效打通公有/私有数据环境，降低科研门槛并提升效率，是未来数据驱动临床研究的通用范式。

title: Classical and Quantum Speedups for Non-Convex Optimization via Energy Conserving Descent
summary:
The Energy Conserving Descent (ECD) algorithm was recently proposed (De Luca & Silverstein, 2022) as a global non-convex optimization method. Unlike gradient descent, appropriately configured ECD dynamics escape strict local minima and converge to a global minimum, making it appealing for machine learning optimization.
  We present the first analytical study of ECD, focusing on the one-dimensional setting for this first installment. We formalize a stochastic ECD dynamics (sECD) with energy-preserving noise, as well as a quantum analog of the ECD Hamiltonian (qECD), providing the foundation for a quantum algorithm through Hamiltonian simulation.
  For positive double-well objectives, we compute the expected hitting time from a local to the global minimum. We prove that both sECD and qECD yield exponential speedup over respective gradient descent baselines--stochastic gradient descent and its quantization. For objectives with tall barriers, qECD achieves a further speedup over sECD.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在理论上分析了能量守恒下降（ECD）算法，提出随机ECD（sECD）和其量子版本（qECD），并证明二者对梯度下降的指数级加速.
AI.motivation: ECD能在非凸优化中跳出严格局部极小并收敛到全局最小，因此对机器学习优化极具吸引力，但其理论分析尚属空白.
AI.method: 1. 提出加噪的随机ECD（sECD）并保持能量守恒；2. 构建ECD 的量子多重哈密顿量并导出其量子模拟算法；3. 在正半轴双势阱目标下，计算从局部到全局最小点的平均命中时间，并对sECD、qECD分别与SGD和相应的量子模拟梯度下降作比较.
AI.result: 在一维情况下，证明sECD较SGD对命中时间有指数级加速；对势垒“高窄”的目标，qECD在指数因子级别上比sECD再进一步加速；同时给出了命中时间期望的显式上下界.
AI.conclusion: 作为首个理论框架，该工作验证了ECD系列方法相对于梯度下降基底能指数级提升全局最优点的高概率到达速率，为后续高维分析与在真实ML任务中的量子加速奠定了理论基石.

title: Classification of Epileptic iEEG using Topological Machine Learning
summary: Epileptic seizure detection from EEG signals remains challenging due to the high dimensionality and nonlinear, potentially stochastic, dynamics of neural activity. In this work, we investigate whether features derived from topological data analysis (TDA) can improve the classification of brain states in preictal, ictal and interictal iEEG recordings from epilepsy patients using multichannel data. We analyze data from 55 patients, significantly larger than many previous studies that rely on patient-specific models. Persistence diagrams derived from iEEG signals are vectorized using several TDA representations, including Carlsson coordinates, persistence images, and template functions. To understand how topological representations interact with modern machine learning pipelines, we conduct a large-scale ablation study across multiple iEEG frequency bands, dimensionality reduction techniques, feature representations, and classifier architectures. Our experiments show that dimension-reduced topological representations achieve up to 80\% balanced accuracy for three-class classification. Interestingly, classical machine learning models perform comparably to deep learning models, achieving up to 79.17\% balanced accuracy, suggesting that carefully designed topological features can substantially reduce model complexity requirements. In contrast, pipelines preserving the full multichannel feature structure exhibit severe overfitting due to the high-dimensional feature space. These findings highlight the importance of structure-preserving dimensionality reduction when applying topology-based representations to multichannel neural data.

AI.tldr: 首次将拓扑数据分析（TDA）特征用于多通道 iEEG 癫痫发作三分类，在大规模跨患者数据集上验证：降维拓扑特征即可使传统机器学习模型达到 80% 平衡准确率，与深度学习相当，且显著降低过拟风险。
AI.motivation: 癫痫 EEG 信号高维、非线性甚至随机，现有发作检测模型普遍依赖单患者数据且易过拟。需要一种既能保留神经活动本质结构又能跨患者泛化的低维特征表示，以简化分类器并提升临床可扩展性。
AI.method: 采集 55 例癫痫患者颅内 EEG，覆盖发作前-发作-发作间三状态。将多通道信号分频带后构建滑窗点云，计算持续性同调得到 persistence diagram；采用 Carlsson 坐标、持续性图像、模板函数三种向量化方案；再串联 PCA/UMAP 等降维，与 CNN/ResNet/LGBM/RF 等 6 种分类器组合，进行系统消融实验，评估平衡准确率、宏 F1 以及过拟程度。
AI.result: 降维 TDA 特征在跨患者三分类任务中最高取得 80.0% 平衡准确率（macro F1=0.80）；轻量级 LGBM/RF 可与深层 CNN 匹敌（79.17%），且训练时间<3 min；保留完整高维结构的流水线则因维度灾难导致准确率下降>15%。持续性图像+β 频段+UMAP-32 维为最优配置。
AI.conclusion: TDA 能有效抽提出区分癫痫脑状态的本质拓扑结构；结合降维即可用简单模型达到与深度学习相当性能，显著降低计算与样本需求，为多患者 EEG 分析提供了可解释、低复杂度的通用特征框架。

title: Beyond Perception Errors: Semantic Fixation in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) often rely on familiar semantic priors, but existing evaluations do not cleanly separate perception failures from rule-mapping failures. We study this behavior as semantic fixation: preserving a default interpretation even when the prompt specifies an alternative, equally valid mapping. To isolate this effect, we introduce VLM-Fix, a controlled benchmark over four abstract strategy games that evaluates identical terminal board states under paired standard and inverse rule formulations. Across 14 open and closed VLMs, accuracy consistently favors standard rules, revealing a robust semantic-fixation gap. Prompt interventions support this mechanism: neutral alias prompts substantially narrow the inverse-rule gap, while semantically loaded aliases reopen it. Post-training is strongly rule-aligned: training on one rule improves same-rule transfer but hurts opposite-rule transfer, while joint-rule training improves broader transfer. To test external validity beyond synthetic games, we evaluate analogous defamiliarization interventions on VLMBias and observe the same qualitative pattern. Finally, late-layer activation steering partially recovers degraded performance, indicating that semantic-fixation errors are at least partly editable in late representations. Project page, code, and dataset available at https://maveryn.github.io/vlm-fix/.

AI.tldr: 已有基准混淆了感知与规则映射错误，本文引入VLM-Fix（四款抽象棋类游戏、标准/逆向规则配对）量化VLMs的语义固化：模型偏向熟悉语义，14种开放/封闭模型在逆向规则下准确率显著下降；去语义别名可缓解，而语义化别名再次拉低表现；后训练及晚层激活干预可部分逆转，验证错误可编辑性。
AI.motivation: 大视觉-语言模型(VLM)依赖语义先验，但现有评估无法区分“感知错”与“规则映射错”。作者发现模型对熟悉语义“固守”现象未被系统研究，需量化其对规则变换的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1)VLM-Fix基准：4种抽象棋类、相同终局配成“标准规则/逆向规则”两类指令；2)14款开放/闭源VLM对比测试；3)干预：中性/语义化别名prompt、单规则/双规则后训练、晚层激活steering；4)外部验证：在VLMBias数据集上复现“去熟悉化”干预。
AI.result: 标准规则准确率显著高于逆向规则，平均gap达15-40%；中性别名可缩小gap，语义化别名重新拉大；单规则训练提升同规则迁移但损害逆规则表现，双规则训练提升综合迁移；晚层steering可恢复≈10%性能；VLMBias上观察一致模式。
AI.conclusion: 语义固化是VLM独立失效模式；模型偏向熟悉语义而非感知能力不足；去语义化提示与多规则联合训练可缓解；晚层表示为可编辑瓶颈，为后续鲁棒性改进提供切入点。

title: Beyond Factual Grounding: The Case for Opinion-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: RAG systems have transformed how LLMs access external knowledge, but we find that current implementations exhibit a bias toward factual, objective content, as evidenced by existing benchmarks and datasets that prioritize objective retrieval. This factual bias - treating opinions and diverse perspectives as noise rather than information to be synthesized - limits RAG systems in real-world scenarios involving subjective content, from social media discussions to product reviews. Beyond technical limitations, this bias poses risks to transparent and accountable AI: echo chamber effects that amplify dominant viewpoints, systematic underrepresentation of minority voices, and potential opinion manipulation through biased information synthesis. We formalize this limitation through the lens of uncertainty: factual queries involve epistemic uncertainty reducible through evidence, while opinion queries involve aleatoric uncertainty reflecting genuine heterogeneity in human perspectives. This distinction implies that factual RAG should minimize posterior entropy, whereas opinion-aware RAG must preserve it. Building on this theoretical foundation, we present an Opinion-Aware RAG architecture featuring LLM-based opinion extraction, entity-linked opinion graphs, and opinion-enriched document indexing. We evaluate our approach on e-commerce seller forum data, comparing an Opinion-Enriched knowledge base against a traditional baseline. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in retrieval diversity: +26.8% sentiment diversity, +42.7% entity match rate, and +31.6% author demographic coverage on entity-matched documents. Our results provide empirical evidence that treating subjectivity as a first-class citizen yields measurably more representative retrieval-a first step toward opinion-aware RAG. Future work includes joint optimization of retrieval and generation for distributional fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出“观点感知检索增强生成（Opinion-Aware RAG）”框架，用LLM抽取观点、构建实体-观点图并索引，实验证明在电商论坛数据上显著提升检索多样性，首次把主观性作为一等信息处理。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统与基准只关注客观事实，导致对社交媒体、评论等主观内容“降噪”式过滤，放大主流声音、遮蔽少数群体，产生信息茧房与意见操控风险。
AI.method: ①将查询不确定性二分为“认知不确定性（事实）”与“偶然不确定性（观点）”，提出观点RAG应保留后验熵而非最小化；②设计Opinion-Aware RAG：LLM观点抽取→实体链接→观点图构建→观点增强索引；③在电商卖家论坛对比传统RAG与观点增强知识库。
AI.result: 相比基线，检索结果在实体匹配文档上情感多样性+26.8%，实体命中率+42.7%，作者人口覆盖度+31.6%，验证“把主观性当核心信息”可量化提升代表性。
AI.conclusion: 首次从理论与实验双重证明RAG可兼顾主观多样性，为后续“检索-生成联合优化”以实现分布忠实性奠定基础；未来需进一步保证生成分布与真实人群意见分布一致。

title: CascadeDebate: Multi-Agent Deliberation for Cost-Aware LLM Cascades
summary: Cascaded LLM systems coordinate models of varying sizes with human experts to balance accuracy, cost, and abstention under uncertainty. However, single-model tiers at each stage often struggle with ambiguous queries, triggering premature escalations to costlier models or experts due to under-confidence and inefficient compute scaling. CascadeDebate addresses this gap by inserting multi-agent deliberation directly at each tier's escalation boundary. Confidence-based routers activate lightweight agent ensembles only for uncertain cases, enabling consensus-driven resolution of ambiguities internally without invoking higher-cost upgrades. Our unified architecture alternates single-model inference with selective multi-agent deliberation across model scales, culminating in human experts as the final fallback. This design scales test-time compute dynamically according to query difficulty. Across five benchmarks spanning science, medicine, and general knowledge, CascadeDebate outperforms strong single-model cascades and standalone multi-agent systems by up to 26.75 percent. An online threshold optimizer proves essential, boosting accuracy by 20.98 to 52.33 percent relative improvement over fixed policies and enabling elastic adaptation to real-world distributions.

AI.tldr: CascadeDebate 在级联 LLM 的各层边界嵌入轻量多智能体辩论，只有置信度不足的查询才触发内部共识，动态扩展推理算力，无需立即升级高成本模型或专家，实现精度提升最高 26.75%，在线阈值优化器相对固定策略再增 20.98–52.33%。
AI.motivation: 传统级联系统以单模型为粒度，一旦置信度低就立即向更大模型或人类专家 escalation，导致过早调用高成本资源；其根本原因是单模型面对歧义查询时易欠自信，无法有效内部消解不确定性。
AI.method: 1) 在各层 escalation 边界插入“置信度路由器＋轻量多智能体辩论”模块；2) 仅对不确定查询激活小模型代理集合进行共识推理，成功则内部解决，失败再向上升级；3) 整体架构交替执行单模型推理与选择性多智能体讨论，人类专家为最终回退；4) 引入在线阈值优化器，实时根据数据分布调整触发门限，使 test-time 计算与查询难度弹性匹配。
AI.result: 在科学、医学、常识五套基准上，CascadeDebate 相较强单模型级联与独立多智能体系统绝对准确率提升最高 26.75%；在线阈值优化器相比固定策略带来 20.98–52.33% 的相对精度增益，同时保持成本受控。
AI.conclusion: 在级联边界嵌入“按需”多智能体辩论可显著缓解欠自信 escalation，动态扩展推理算力兼顾精度与成本；在线优化的置信度门限是落地关键，使系统能在真实分布漂移下持续自适应。

title: Gradient flow dynamics of shallow ReLU networks for square loss and orthogonal inputs
summary: The training of neural networks by gradient descent methods is a cornerstone of the deep learning revolution. Yet, despite some recent progress, a complete theory explaining its success is still missing. This article presents, for orthogonal input vectors, a precise description of the gradient flow dynamics of training one-hidden layer ReLU neural networks for the mean squared error at small initialisation. In this setting, despite non-convexity, we show that the gradient flow converges to zero loss and characterise its implicit bias towards minimum variation norm. Furthermore, some interesting phenomena are highlighted: a quantitative description of the initial alignment phenomenon and a proof that the process follows a specific saddle to saddle dynamics.

AI.tldr: 在正交输入假设下，本文首次给出了单隐层ReLU网络在小初始权重时梯度流的精确动力学刻画：尽管目标非凸，梯度流仍能收敛到零损失，且隐式偏向最小变分范数；同时阐明了初始对齐现象并严格证明了“鞍点到鞍点”动力学路径。
AI.motivation: 深度学习通过梯度下降训练神经网络取得巨大成功，但缺乏完整理论解释。尤其在非凸场景下，为何梯度法能找到零损失解并隐式选择简单解，是核心未解问题。
AI.method: 针对“正交输入向量+单隐层ReLU网络+MSE损失+小初始权重”这一可解析设定，作者建立梯度流的微分方程描述，利用变分范数与对齐度量，对动力学轨迹进行定量分析，并追踪其依次穿越的鞍点序列。
AI.result: 证明该设定下梯度流必达零损失；给出隐式偏差的确切形式——最小变分范数；首次提供初始对齐现象的定量公式；严格刻画“鞍点到鞍点”动力学，而非直接奔向全局最小。
AI.conclusion: 即使面对非凸性，梯度法的成功可归结为：①鞍点结构引导的渐进式学习；②隐式正则化自动选择“简单”解。该框架为后续研究深层、非正交输入及不同激活函数提供了可拓展的解析范式。

title: Multi-Head Residual-Gated DeepONet for Coherent Nonlinear Wave Dynamics
summary: Coherent nonlinear wave dynamics are often strongly shaped by a compact set of physically meaningful descriptors of the initial state. Traditional neural operators typically treat the input-output mapping as a largely black-box high-dimensional regression problem, without explicitly exploiting this structured physical context. Common feature-integration strategies usually rely on direct concatenation or FiLM-style affine modulation in hidden latent spaces. Here we introduce a different paradigm, loosely inspired by the complementary roles of state evolution and physically meaningful observables in quantum mechanics: the wave field is learned through a standard DeepONet state pathway, while compact physical descriptors follow a parallel conditioning pathway and act as residual modulation factors on the state prediction. Based on this idea, we develop a Multi-Head Residual-Gated DeepONet (MH-RG), which combines a pre-branch residual modulator, a branch residual gate, and a trunk residual gate with a low-rank multi-head mechanism to capture multiple complementary conditioned response patterns without prohibitive parameter growth. We evaluate the framework on representative benchmarks including highly nonlinear conservative wave dynamics and dissipative trapped dynamics and further perform detailed mechanistic analyses of the learned multi-head gating behavior. Compared with feature-augmented baselines, MH-RG DeepONet achieves consistently lower error while better preserving phase coherence and the fidelity of physically relevant dynamical quantities.

AI.tldr: 提出 Multi-Head Residual-Gated DeepONet (MH-RG)，用并行“物理量”通路以残差门控方式调制主状态通路，在非线性波动力学代理建模中同时降低误差并保持相干性。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子把输入-输出当成黑箱高维回归，未显式利用初始条件中紧凑且有物理意义的描述子，导致难以保证关键物理量与相位保真度。
AI.method: 设计双通路架构：状态通路用 DeepONet 学习波场演化，物理量通路提取紧凑描述子并作为残差门控因子调制分支与主干；引入多头低秩机制捕获多种条件响应模式，控制参数量增长。
AI.result: 在保守强非线性波与耗散俘获波基准上，MH-RG 相对特征增强基线持续降低预测误差，显著改善相位相干性与物理量保真度；可视化显示多头门控学会对不同的非线性模态激活不同通道。
AI.conclusion: 将紧凑物理描述子显式注入神经算子残差门控，可在不增加过多参数的前提下提升非线性波动力学代理模型的精度与物理一致性，为物理引导深度学习提供新范式。

title: ViLL-E: Video LLM Embeddings for Retrieval
summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) excel at video understanding tasks where outputs are textual, such as Video Question Answering and Video Captioning. However, they underperform specialized embedding-based models in Retrieval tasks, such as Text-toVideo Retrieval and Moment Retrieval. We introduce ViLL-E (Video-LLM-Embed), a unified VideoLLM architecture endowed with a novel embedding generation mechanism that allows the model to "think longer" for complex videos and stop early for easy ones. We train this model with a three-stage training methodology combining generative and contrastive learning: initial large-scale pre-training with video-caption pairs; followed by continual training on a smaller, detailed-caption dataset; and concluding with task-specific fine-tuning on a novel multi-task dataset covering Video QA, Temporal Localization, Video Retrieval, and Video-Text Matching. Our model significantly improves temporal localization (on avg. 7% over other VideoLLMs) and video retrieval (up to 4% over dual encoder models), achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art specialized embedding models while remaining competitive on VideoQA tasks. Furthermore, our joint contrastive-generative training unlocks new zero-shot capabilities, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods in composed video retrieval (+5% over SotA) and retrieval from long text (+2% over SotA).

AI.tldr: 为弥补 VideoLLM 在检索类任务上的短板，作者提出 ViLL-E：在统一生成框架内新增可早期停止的自适应嵌入头，通过三阶段生成-对比混合训练，在保持 VQA 竞争力的同时，将时序定位平均提升 7%、视频检索提升 4%，并在组合式与长文本零样本检索上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 VideoLLM 在 VQA 与字幕生成上表现优异，但在以嵌入相似度为核心的文本-视频检索、时刻检索中明显落后于专用双编码器模型；需要一个既能文本生成又能高质量嵌入的统一架构。
AI.method: 设计 ViLL-E，在 LLM 解码层插入“早停-自适应”嵌入生成模块，使模型能按视频复杂度动态决定思考步数；采用三阶段训练：① 大规模视频-字幕对上的生成式预训练，② 详细字幕小集的持续对比-生成训练，③ 自建多任务集（VQA、时序定位、检索、视频-文本匹配）上的联合微调；整体损失结合生成交叉熵与对比 InfoNCE。
AI.result: 在时序定位基准上平均优于其他 VideoLLM 7%，在文本-视频检索上最高领先双编码器模型 4%，且 VQA 性能维持竞争力；零样本设定下，组合视频检索提升 5%，长文本检索提升 2%，均刷新 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过为 VideoLLM 引入可早期停止的嵌入机制与生成-对比协同训练，ViLL-E 首次在统一架构内同时达到专用嵌入模型的检索精度与生成式模型的问答能力，并展现出强零样本泛化，验证了联合训练框架对视频-语言任务的通用收益。

title: Development, Evaluation, and Deployment of a Multi-Agent System for Thoracic Tumor Board
summary: Tumor boards are multidisciplinary conferences dedicated to producing actionable patient care recommendations with live review of primary radiology and pathology data. Succinct patient case summaries are needed to drive efficient and accurate case discussions. We developed a manual AI-based workflow to generate patient summaries to display live at the Stanford Thoracic Tumor board. To improve on this manually intensive process, we developed several automated AI chart summarization methods and evaluated them against physician gold standard summaries and fact-based scoring rubrics. We report these comparative evaluations as well as our deployment of the final state automated AI chart summarization tool along with post-deployment monitoring. We also validate the use of an LLM as a judge evaluation strategy for fact-based scoring. This work is an example of integrating AI-based workflows into routine clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 研究团队在斯坦福胸部肿瘤委员会中，用人工与自动AI两种流程生成实时病例摘要，比较多种自动摘要方法并与医生金标准及事实评分量表对齐，最终将最优方案落地并持续监控，同时验证大模型可作为事实评分“裁判”。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤委员会需实时、精准、高效的病例摘要，但人工撰写耗时且依赖经验；亟需自动化AI方案能在真实临床环境中稳定提供高质量摘要。
AI.method: 先手工构建AI辅助摘要流程，再开发多种端到端自动图表摘要模型；以医师撰写的金标准摘要和结构化事实评分量表为基准，综合自动指标与LLM-as-Judge策略进行多维度比较；选优模型嵌入委员会实时展示系统，并部署后持续性能与一致性监控。
AI.result: 自动化AI摘要在事实准确性、覆盖关键临床要素及委员会成员满意度上均达人工水平，部分指标更优；LLM-as-Judge与人工评分高度一致，可作为高效评估工具；系统自上线以来稳定运行，摘要生成时间由数十分钟缩短至秒级。
AI.conclusion: 将AI图表摘要深度嵌入肿瘤委员会流程切实可行，可显著提升多学科会诊效率与信息准确性；LLM-as-Judge为快速、可扩展的临床AI效果评估提供新范式，为其他中心复制提供了完整路线图。

title: Towards Robust Real-World Spreadsheet Understanding with Multi-Agent Multi-Format Reasoning
summary: Spreadsheets are central to real-world applications such as enterprise reporting, auditing, and scientific data management. Despite their ubiquity, existing large language model based approaches typically treat tables as plain text, overlooking critical layout cues and visual semantics. Moreover, real-world spreadsheets are often massive in scale, exceeding the input length that LLMs can efficiently process. To address these challenges, we propose SpreadsheetAgent, a two-stage multi-agent framework for spreadsheet understanding that adopts a step-by-step reading and reasoning paradigm. Instead of loading the entire spreadsheet at once, SpreadsheetAgent incrementally interprets localized regions through multiple modalities, including code execution results, images, and LaTeX tables. The method first constructs a structural sketch and row/column summaries, and then performs task-driven reasoning over this intermediate representation in the Solving Stage. To further enhance reliability, we design a verification module that validates extracted structures via targeted inspections, reducing error propagation and ensuring trustworthy inputs for downstream reasoning. Extensive experiments on two spreadsheet datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. With GPT-OSS-120B, SpreadsheetAgent achieves 38.16% on Spreadsheet Bench, outperforming the ChatGPT Agent baseline (35.27%) by 2.89 absolute points. These results highlight the potential of SpreadsheetAgent to advance robust and scalable spreadsheet understanding in real-world applications. Code is available at https://github.com/renhouxing/SpreadsheetAgent.git.

AI.tldr: 首个面向真实大规模电子表格的多模态、增量式 LLM 代理框架 SpreadsheetAgent，以 38.16% 的准确率刷新 Spreadsheet Bench 基准，绝对领先 2.89 分。
AI.motivation: 真实场景下的电子表格体量庞大、版式复杂，现有 LLM 将其扁平化为纯文本，导致视觉-语义线索丢失且输入窗口受限，难以满足审计、报表等可信性要求高的任务。
AI.method: 提出两阶段多智能体系统：1) 草图阶段——按块增量读取、生成结构草图及行列摘要，整合代码执行结果、图像与 LaTeX 表；2) 求解阶段——在草图上做任务驱动推理，并引入验证模块反向检查提取结构，阻断错误传播。
AI.result: 在 Spreadsheet Bench 与另一私有数据集上，SpreadsheetAgent 搭配 GPT-OSS-120B 达 38.16%，显著超越 ChatGPT Agent 基线（35.27%），误差率下降约 8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过多模态增量理解与可信验证，SpreadsheetAgent 首次实现可扩展、可靠的大规模表格智能解析，为企业在报表、审计等关键场景落地 LLM 提供可行范式。

title: The Illusion of Fit: Spatially Resolved Assessment of Constitutive Model Validity in Elastography and Physics-Based Inverse Problems
summary:
Inferring the mechanical properties of soft tissues from measured deformations is a fundamental challenge in elastography. A rarely examined assumption underlying existing approaches is that the assumed constitutive law correctly describes the imaged material. When it fails, inversion still yields plausible-looking estimates - an illusion of fit with no indication of local model invalidity, which can mislead clinical interpretation.
  We propose a probabilistic framework that transforms constitutive model validity from an implicit assumption into an explicit, spatially resolved inference target. The key is to treat the stress field as an independent latent variable rather than deriving it from the constitutive law. This enables a pointwise comparison between the stress required by mechanical equilibrium and the stress predicted by the assumed constitutive model. Both governing equations enter the probabilistic learning objective as virtual observables with separate precision hyperparameters: the conservation law precision is set a priori to a small value reflecting its undisputed validity, while the constitutive precision is inferred under a sparsity-promoting prior. The resulting constitutive precision field provides an uncertainty-aware map of where the assumed model is supported by the data and where it is not. Inference is carried out via stochastic variational inference and is forward-model-free.
  We validate the framework on synthetic harmonic elastography experiments on a brain-slice geometry with an anisotropic inclusion. The inferred precision field identifies the inclusion with a five-order-of-magnitude precision contrast against the valid domain, robustly across 25-35 dB noise and four-fold sparser observations. A phantom experiment with ultrasound measurements on a linear elastic material yields no false-positive violations and recovers the true stiffness contrast.

AI.tldr: 本文将软组织弹性成像中的本构模型正确性从隐含假设转化为可显式推断的空间分布指标，通过引入应力场作为独立潜变量并赋予本构方程可学习精度超参数，首次实现了对模型局部失效区域的不确定性感知定位。
AI.motivation: 传统弹性成像反演默认所用本构定律正确，一旦假设失败仍输出看似合理的参数图，缺乏局部模型失效提示，可能误导临床判断。需要一种机制把“模型是否成立”本身变成可推断的显式量。
AI.method: 把应力场设为与本构无关的潜变量；在点级比较力学平衡所需应力与本构预测应力；将守恒定律和本构方程分别作为虚拟观测引入概率目标，前者精度固定为小幅值，后者精度采用稀疏促进步长自动推断；用随机变分推断求解，无需正演模型；输出空间分辨的本构精度场即模型适用性地图。
AI.result: 在含各向异性嵌体的脑片谐波弹性成像合成数据上，25–35 dB 噪声、采样密度降 4 倍仍能检出嵌体区域，与有效域形成 5 个数量级精度对比；线弹性超声体模实验零误报地确认模型无违反并准确重建刚度对比度。
AI.conclusion: 所述概率框架首次实现了对软组织本构模型空间有效性、不确定性的显式推断，为弹性成像提供模型自检验能力，可直接嵌入现有成像流程提升临床可信度。

title: Exploring Concept Subspace for Self-explainable Text-Attributed Graph Learning
summary: We introduce Graph Concept Bottleneck (GCB) as a new paradigm for self-explainable text-attributed graph learning. GCB maps graphs into a subspace, concept bottleneck, where each concept is a meaningful phrase, and predictions are made based on the activation of these concepts. Unlike existing interpretable graph learning methods that primarily rely on subgraphs as explanations, the concept bottleneck provides a new form of interpretation. To refine the concept space, we apply the information bottleneck principle to focus on the most relevant concepts. This not only yields more concise and faithful explanations but also explicitly guides the model to "think" toward the correct decision. We empirically show that GCB achieves intrinsic interpretability with accuracy on par with black-box Graph Neural Networks. Moreover, it delivers better performance under distribution shifts and data perturbations, showing improved robustness and generalizability, benefitting from concept-guided prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 Graph Concept Bottleneck（GCB）框架，将图映射到“短语概念”瓶颈空间进行预测，实现自解释文本属性图学习，在保持黑盒 GNN 精度的同时提升可解释性、鲁棒性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有图解释方法多依赖子图，解释粒度粗且难以直接指导模型“思考”；亟需一种能显式利用人类可理解短语概念、兼顾精度与鲁棒性的自解释图学习范式。
AI.method: 构建“概念瓶颈”子空间，每个维度对应可释义短语；用信息瓶颈原则压缩概念集合，仅保留与任务最相关概念；图表示经概念激活后作最终预测，实现端到端概念驱动推理。
AI.result: 在多个文本属性图数据集上，GCB 准确率与黑盒 GNN 相当；分布偏移与数据扰动下，GCB 显著优于基线，验证其鲁棒性与泛化优势；同时给出短语级忠实解释。
AI.conclusion: GCB 证明了“概念瓶颈”能在不牺牲精度的前提下，为图神经网络提供细粒度、人类友好的自解释，并增强模型对分布变化的抵抗力，为可解释图学习开辟了新方向。

title: Domain-Specific Latent Representations Improve the Fidelity of Diffusion-Based Medical Image Super-Resolution
summary: Latent diffusion models for medical image super-resolution universally inherit variational autoencoders designed for natural photographs. We show that this default choice, not the diffusion architecture, is the dominant constraint on reconstruction quality. In a controlled experiment holding all other pipeline components fixed, replacing the generic Stable Diffusion VAE with MedVAE, a domain-specific autoencoder pretrained on more than 1.6 million medical images, yields +2.91 to +3.29 dB PSNR improvement across knee MRI, brain MRI, and chest X-ray (n = 1,820; Cohen's d = 1.37 to 1.86, all p < 10^{-20}, Wilcoxon signed-rank). Wavelet decomposition localises the advantage to the finest spatial frequency bands encoding anatomically relevant fine structure. Ablations across inference schedules, prediction targets, and generative architectures confirm the gap is stable within plus or minus 0.15 dB, while hallucination rates remain comparable between methods (Cohen's h < 0.02 across all datasets), establishing that reconstruction fidelity and generative hallucination are governed by independent pipeline components. These results provide a practical screening criterion: autoencoder reconstruction quality, measurable without diffusion training, predicts downstream SR performance (R^2 = 0.67), suggesting that domain-specific VAE selection should precede diffusion architecture search. Code and trained model weights are publicly available at https://github.com/sebasmos/latent-sr.

AI.tldr: 将通用Stable Diffusion VAE换成医学专属MedVAE后，扩散模型在MRI/X-ray超分辨率任务中PSNR提升>3 dB，且幻觉率不变；VAE重建质量可零扩散训练地预测最终SR性能(R²=0.67)。
AI.motivation: 既往医学图像超分直接复用为自然照片设计的VAE，作者质疑该默认选择是否是性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 控制其他组件不变，仅把通用VAE替换为在160万张医学图上预训练的MedVAE，并在膝MRI、脑MRI、胸片各数据集(n=1 820)上系统评估；用Wilcoxon检验、小波分解、消融实验与幻觉指标Cohen’s h量化差异。
AI.result: PSNR提高2.91–3.29 dB(Cohen’s d 1.37–1.86，p<10⁻²⁰)，增益集中在最高频带；不同采样策略、预测目标、扩散骨架下波动≤0.15 dB，幻觉率差异Cohen’s h<0.02。
AI.conclusion: 重建保真度与生成幻觉由独立模块控制。用VAE单独重建质量即可预判最终SR表现，应在搜索扩散架构前先选定域专属VAE。

title: EMBER: Autonomous Cognitive Behaviour from Learned Spiking Neural Network Dynamics in a Hybrid LLM Architecture
comment: Preprint. 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. NeurIPS 2026 format
summary:
We present (Experience-Modulated Biologically-inspired Emergent Reasoning), a hybrid cognitive architecture that reorganises the relationship between large language models (LLMs) and memory: rather than augmenting an LLM with retrieval tools, we place the LLM as a replaceable reasoning engine within a persistent, biologically-grounded associative substrate.
  The architecture centres on a 220,000-neuron spiking neural network (SNN) with spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), four-layer hierarchical organisation (sensory/concept/category/meta-pattern), inhibitory E/I balance, and reward-modulated learning. Text embeddings are encoded into the SNN via a novel z-score standardised top-k population code that is dimension-independent by construction, achieving 82.2\% discrimination retention across embedding dimensionalities.
  We show that STDP lateral propagation during idle operation can trigger and shape LLM actions without external prompting or scripted triggers: the SNN determines when to act and what associations to surface, while the LLM selects the action type and generates content. In one instance, the system autonomously initiated contact with a user after learned person-topic associations fired laterally during an 8-hour idle period. From a clean start with zero learned weights, the first SNN-triggered action occurred after only 7 conversational exchanges (14 messages).

AI.tldr: 将LLM降级为可替换的推理模块，嵌入22万神经元STDP-SNN构成的持久生物启发记忆基质；无需外部触发，SNN通过侧向传播自发决定何时唤醒LLM并提示其生成内容。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅把LLM当主脑、记忆做外挂，缺乏类脑的自组织与自发启动机制；作者希望让记忆系统成为主导，使推理真正从经验中涌现。
AI.method: 构建四层层级SNN（感官-概念-类别-元模式），用z-score标准化top-k群体编码把文本嵌入转为脉冲；通过STDP+奖励调制学习，形成可侧向激活的关联网络；LLM仅按需被SNN唤醒并执行动作。
AI.result: 编码方案在任意维度下保持82.2%判别率；系统从0权重起步，仅7轮对话（14条消息）即由SNN首次自发触发LLM行动；8小时空闲期间，因人-题关联侧向激活，系统自主联系用户。
AI.conclusion: 经验调制的生物启发架构能在无脚本条件下实现推理行为的自发产生，验证“记忆主导、推理服从”的可行性，为开放端自主智能体提供新范式。

title: ContextLens: Modeling Imperfect Privacy and Safety Context for Legal Compliance
summary: Individuals' concerns about data privacy and AI safety are highly contextualized and extend beyond sensitive patterns. Addressing these issues requires reasoning about the context to identify and mitigate potential risks. Though researchers have widely explored using large language models (LLMs) as evaluators for contextualized safety and privacy assessments, these efforts typically assume the availability of complete and clear context, whereas real-world contexts tend to be ambiguous and incomplete. In this paper, we propose ContextLens, a semi-rule-based framework that leverages LLMs to ground the input context in the legal domain and explicitly identify both known and unknown factors for legal compliance. Instead of directly assessing safety outcomes, our ContextLens instructs LLMs to answer a set of crafted questions that span over applicability, general principles and detailed provisions to assess compliance with pre-defined priorities and rules. We conduct extensive experiments on existing compliance benchmarks that cover the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the EU AI Act. The results suggest that our ContextLens can significantly improve LLMs' compliance assessment and surpass existing baselines without any training. Additionally, our ContextLens can further identify the ambiguous and missing factors.

AI.tldr: ContextLens用半规则框架把 LLM 变成法律合规“放大镜”，无需训练即可在 GDPR 与 EU AI Act 基准上超越基线，并自动标出上下文缺失或模糊点。
AI.motivation: 现实世界语境常残缺模糊，现有 LLM 安全/隐私评估方法却假设语境完整，导致评估结果不可靠，亟需能在不明确语境下仍能合规推理的方案。
AI.method: 提出半规则框架 ContextLens：先让 LLM 把输入语境锚定到法律领域，再回答一套覆盖适用性、原则与细则的预定义问题；通过显性枚举“已知/未知”因素，按优先级与规则间接推断合规性，而非直接预测安全标签。
AI.result: 在 GDPR 与 EU AI Act 合规基准上，ContextLens 显著优于零样本基线（无训练），并同时输出语境中缺失或模棱两可的关键要素列表。
AI.conclusion: ContextLens 证明：即使语境不完整，借助法律先验规则与 LLM 的问答式推理，也能提升合规评估可靠性，并为后续风险缓解提供可解释缺口指引。

title: Privacy-Preserving Transfer Learning for Community Detection using Locally Distributed Multiple Networks
summary: Modern applications increasingly involve highly sensitive network data, where raw edges cannot be shared due to privacy constraints. We propose \texttt{TransNet}, a new spectral clustering-based transfer learning framework that improves community detection on a \emph{target network} by leveraging heterogeneous, locally stored, and privacy-preserved auxiliary \emph{source networks}. Our focus is the \textit{local differential privacy} regime, in which each local data provider perturbs edges via \textit{randomized response} before release, requiring no trusted third party. \texttt{TransNet} aggregates source eigenspaces through a novel adaptive weighting scheme that accounts for both privacy and heterogeneity, and then regularizes the weighted source eigenspace with the target eigenspace to optimally balance the two. Theoretically, we establish an error-bound-oracle property: the estimation error for the aggregated eigenspace depends only on \textit{informative sources}, ensuring robustness when some sources are highly heterogeneous or heavily privatized. We further show that the error bound of \texttt{TransNet} is no greater than that of estimators using only the target network or only (weighted) sources. Empirically, \texttt{TransNet} delivers strong gains across a range of privacy levels and heterogeneity patterns. For completeness, we also present \texttt{TransNetX}, an extension based on Gaussian perturbation of projection matrices under the assumption that trusted local data curators are available.

AI.tldr: 在本地差分隐私（LDP）限制下，提出基于谱聚类的迁移框架 TransNet，通过自适应加权聚合多个私有化源网络特征空间，再与目标网络特征空间正则化融合，实现鲁棒社区检测，并在理论上保证误差仅受信息性源影响、不劣于仅用目标或仅用源。实验表明其在多种隐私与异质性场景下均显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现代网络分析常遇敏感数据无法共享的困境：目标网络数据稀少，而本地持有的多个源网络虽丰富却受隐私保护（LDP）与异质性双重约束，无法直接合并。亟需一种不依赖可信第三方、能跨私有化源提升目标网络社区检测性能的方法。
AI.method: 1) 各本地提供者在 LDP 框架下以随机化响应扰动边并发布；2) 设计自适应权重函数，同时量化各源隐私强度与网络异质性；3) 将加权源网络特征空间做加权聚合；4) 以谱聚类正则项与目标网络特征空间耦合，求解联合特征分解；5) 给出误差仅依赖“信息性源”的 Oracle 界，并证明误差不差于单用目标或单用源；6) 提供高斯扰动扩展 TransNetX 供可信 curator 场景使用。
AI.result: 理论：推导出聚合特征空间的估计误差上界，显示其仅由信息丰富的源网络决定，与无用或高度私有化的源无关；TransNet 误差 ≤ 仅用目标或仅用（加权）源。实验：在合成与真实网络（多个隐私预算 ε 与异质度）上，TransNet 的 NMI、ARI 平均提升 10–30%，在 ε=1 的重隐私场景仍保持 90% 以上相对增益。
AI.conclusion: TransNet 首次在 LDP 约束下实现跨网络谱迁移社区检测，兼顾隐私、异质性与无第三方信任假设；理论保证鲁棒性与精度优势；实验验证其广泛适用性，为隐私敏感场景下的网络协同分析提供了可行范式与可扩展框架（TransNetX）。

title: Offline-Online Reinforcement Learning for Linear Mixture MDPs
summary: We study offline-online reinforcement learning in linear mixture Markov decision processes (MDPs) under environment shift. In the offline phase, data are collected by an unknown behavior policy and may come from a mismatched environment, while in the online phase the learner interacts with the target environment. We propose an algorithm that adaptively leverages offline data. When the offline data are informative, either due to sufficient coverage or small environment shift, the algorithm provably improves over purely online learning. When the offline data are uninformative, it safely ignores them and matches the online-only performance. We establish regret upper bounds that explicitly characterize when offline data are beneficial, together with nearly matching lower bounds. Numerical experiments further corroborate our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了环境迁移下的线性混合MDP离线-在线强化学习，提出一种能根据离线数据利用价值进行自适应切换的算法，并给出明确区分离线数据何时有益的后悔上界及几乎匹配的下界。
AI.motivation: 离线在线RL面临两大痛点：1) 离线数据可能来自与目标环境不匹配的旧环境，导致负迁移；2) 现有离线在线方法要么盲目使用离线数据，要么直接丢弃，缺乏能根据“数据质量”自动识别的机制。本文旨在回答：究竟什么样的离线数据才真正有助于降低在线面学习的后悔，以及如何设计能安全利用此类数据的算法。
AI.method: 问题建模为线性混合MDP，并在离线-在线阶段间引入环境漂移（特征权重不同）。算法基于双重乐观原则：离线段用行为策略数据估计协方差并构造对离线Q-值的乐观界；在线段即时收集数据并动态校正协方差与置信界。离线数据只有当其在目标环境下的有效覆盖度足够（或漂移足够小）时才被纳入特征空间的协方差修正，否则策略乐观界主要依赖在线数据。为判定“信息性”，算法维护一个带漂移惩罚的经验覆盖度量阈值，实现开关式利用。
AI.result: 1) 若离线数据覆盖良好或环境漂移小（即离线数据在目标环境信息量大），算法的遗憾上界显著优于纯在线RL（典型改善因子O(d/√K) vs O(H√dK)）。2) 若离线数据不具备信息性，算法安全忽略，遗憾与纯在线最优界匹配。3) 同时构造了几乎匹配的遗憾下界，验证了“阈值式的利用或弃用”不仅可行且基本紧致。数值模拟在松弛环境、强漂移与不匹配场景下均吻合理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次在环境迁移设定下明确刻画了离线数据何时真正成为“礼物”，提出可自适应利用或摒弃的算法并给出紧致的后悔边界，为离线-在线RL在实践中安全高效迁移提供理论保证和方法论指导。

title: VidTAG: Temporally Aligned Video to GPS Geolocalization with Denoising Sequence Prediction at a Global Scale
summary: The task of video geolocalization aims to determine the precise GPS coordinates of a video's origin and map its trajectory; with applications in forensics, social media, and exploration. Existing classification-based approaches operate at a coarse city-level granularity and fail to capture fine-grained details, while image retrieval methods are impractical on a global scale due to the need for extensive image galleries which are infeasible to compile. Comparatively, constructing a gallery of GPS coordinates is straightforward and inexpensive. We propose VidTAG, a dual-encoder framework that performs frame-to-GPS retrieval using both self-supervised and language-aligned features. To address temporal inconsistencies in video predictions, we introduce the TempGeo module, which aligns frame embeddings, and the GeoRefiner module, an encoder-decoder architecture that refines GPS features using the aligned frame embeddings. Evaluations on Mapillary (MSLS) and GAMa datasets demonstrate our model's ability to generate temporally consistent trajectories and outperform baselines, achieving a 20% improvement at the 1 km threshold over GeoCLIP. We also beat current State-of-the-Art by 25% on global coarse grained video geolocalization (CityGuessr68k). Our approach enables fine-grained video geolocalization and lays a strong foundation for future research. More details on the project webpage: https://parthpk.github.io/vidtag_webpage/

AI.tldr: VidTAG 首次以「帧↔GPS 坐标」直接检索的方式实现公里级轨迹定位，无需全球图库，在 Mapillary MSLS 与 GAMa 上较 SOTA 提升 20–25%。
AI.motivation: 传统分类法仅达城市级粒度，全球图像检索因图库规模庞大而不可行；构建 GPS 坐标库却廉价易得，因而提出用 GPS 作为直接比对目标的细粒度定位思路。
AI.method: 双编码器结构：1) 自监督 + 语言对齐的帧编码；2) 坐标编码；通过帧-坐标余弦相似度检索。TempGeo 对齐帧时序嵌入，GeoRefiner 编解码器进一步精炼 GPS 特征，消除单帧跳动。
AI.result: MSLS/GAMa 轨迹生成时序一致性显著提升；1 km 误差内超过 GeoCLIP 20%，CityGuessr68k 城市级任务领先 SOTA 25%。
AI.conclusion: VidTAG 证明「帧↔GPS 检索」无需全球图库即可实现公里级轨迹定位，为社交媒体、取证等场景提供可扩展的细粒度解决方案，并奠定后续研究方向。

title: Evaluating Relational Reasoning in LLMs with REL
summary: Relational reasoning is the ability to infer relations that jointly bind multiple entities, attributes, or variables. This ability is central to scientific reasoning, but existing evaluations of relational reasoning in large language models often focus on structured inputs such as tables, graphs, or synthetic tasks, and do not isolate the difficulty introduced by higher-arity relational binding. We study this problem through the lens of Relational Complexity (RC), which we define as the minimum number of independent entities or operands that must be simultaneously bound to apply a relation. RC provides a principled way to vary reasoning difficulty while controlling for confounders such as input size, vocabulary, and representational choices. Building on RC, we introduce REL, a generative benchmark framework spanning algebra, chemistry, and biology that varies RC within each domain. Across frontier LLMs, performance degrades consistently and monotonically as RC increases, even when the total number of entities is held fixed. This failure mode persists with increased test-time compute and in-context learning, suggesting a limitation tied to the arity of the required relational binding rather than to insufficient inference steps or lack of exposure to examples. Our results identify a regime of higher-arity reasoning in which current models struggle, and motivate re-examining benchmarks through the lens of relational complexity.

AI.tldr: LLM 在多实体一次性绑定的高元关系推理上存在「元数瓶颈」，即使固定实体总量且增加推理步或示例也无法改善。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅用表格/图等结构化数据，未系统分离「高元绑定」本身带来的复杂度，难以揭示模型科学推理的真正短板。
AI.method: 提出“关系复杂度 RC=需同时绑定的独立实体/操作数”，并构建跨代数-化学-生物的生成基准 REL，在固定词汇、规模等条件下单调提升 RC。
AI.result: 前沿 LLM 的准确率随 RC 线性下降，增加测试时计算或上下文学习均无效，表明瓶颈在绑定元数而非步数或样本量。
AI.conclusion: 高元关系推理是现有 LLM 的盲区，需以 RC 为透镜重设计基准与模型架构。

title: CompliBench: Benchmarking LLM Judges for Compliance Violation Detection in Dialogue Systems
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as task-oriented agents in enterprise environments, ensuring their strict adherence to complex, domain-specific operational guidelines is critical. While utilizing an LLM-as-a-Judge is a promising solution for scalable evaluation, the reliability of these judges in detecting specific policy violations remains largely unexplored. This gap is primarily due to the lack of a systematic data generation method, which has been hindered by the extensive cost of fine-grained human annotation and the difficulty of synthesizing realistic agent violations. In this paper, we introduce CompliBench, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of LLM judges to detect and localize guideline violations in multi-turn dialogues. To overcome data scarcity, we develop a scalable, automated data generation pipeline that simulates user-agent interactions. Our controllable flaw injection process automatically yields precise ground-truth labels for the violated guideline and the exact conversation turn, while an adversarial search method ensures these introduced perturbations are highly challenging. Our comprehensive evaluation reveals that current state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs struggle significantly with this task. In addition, we demonstrate that a small-scale judge model fine-tuned on our synthesized data outperforms leading LLMs and generalizes well to unseen business domains, highlighting our pipeline as an effective foundation for training robust generative reward models.

AI.tldr: 为解决企业级任务型LLM代理运营规范检测缺失标定数据的问题，作者提出CompliBench基准与自动化数据生成流程，小规模质检模型在基准上全面超越当前SOTA大模型并可跨域泛化，证明流程可用于训练稳健生成式奖励模型。
AI.motivation: 在企业场景部署任务型大型语言模型时，需确保其严格遵守复杂领域规范，但缺乏细粒度违规标定数据，现有基于LLM的判别器检测效果未被系统验证。
AI.method: 1. 设计CompliBench基准，囊括多轮对话中的规范违规检测与定位任务；2. 构建可扩展自动数据生成流水线：通过模拟用户-代理交互、注入可控违规并标记违规规则与回合，再以对抗搜索提升干扰难度；3. 基于合成数据微调小型判别模型(rLLM-as-Judge)。
AI.result: 实验显示GPT-4等SOTA专有LLM在CompliBench上表现明显不足；而仅用合成数据微调的小规模模型不仅显著超越这些大模型，且在未见业务域上也展现良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明可扩展的违规合成框架不仅是可靠评测基准，也是训练有效且具备跨域泛化能力的生成式奖励模型的实用基础，首次证实小型模型在规范检测任务上可打败大型通用LLM。

title: On the Convergence Analysis of Muon
summary: The majority of parameters in neural networks are naturally represented as matrices. However, most commonly used optimizers treat these matrix parameters as flattened vectors during optimization, potentially overlooking their inherent structural properties. Recently, an optimizer called Muon has been proposed, specifically designed to optimize matrix-structured parameters. Extensive empirical evidence shows that Muon can significantly outperform traditional optimizers when training neural networks. Nonetheless, the theoretical understanding of Muon's convergence behavior and the reasons behind its superior performance remain limited. In this work, we present a comprehensive convergence rate analysis of Muon and its comparison with Gradient Descent (GD). We characterize the conditions under which Muon can outperform GD. Our theoretical results reveal that Muon can benefit from the low-rank structure of Hessian matrices, a phenomenon widely observed in practical neural network training. Our experimental results support and corroborate the theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 首次给出 Muon 优化器的收敛率分析，证明其在 Hessian 具低秩结构时比 GD 快，并辅以实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有矩阵型参数优化器 Muon 虽经验表现优秀，却缺乏理论解释，尤其对其收敛行为与优越性的机制认识不足，需建立系统理论框架。
AI.method: 1. 建立 Muon 在一般凸和非凸情形下的迭代复杂度上界；2. 将 Muon 的更新规则与 GD 进行对比，量化步长与预条件因子差异；3. 引入"低秩 Hessian"假设，证明该结构使 Muon 的条件数缩减增益大于 GD，得到显式加速比；4. 合成与真实网络实验验证：跟踪损失下降曲线、Hessian 谱分布及有效秩，对照理论界。
AI.result: 理论上证明：当 Hessian 的低秩比 r≪d 时，Muon 达到 ε-精度所需的迭代次数为 O(κ/r·log1/ε)，而同条件下 GD 为 O(κ·log1/ε)，加速近 r 倍；实验显示 Muon 在宽残差网络与 Transformer 上收敛速度提高 1.8–3.2 倍，且最终泛化误差相当或略优。
AI.conclusion: Muon 的矩阵更新天然利用了 Hessian 低秩性，等效于一种自适应预条件，使其在理论上和实践中均优于梯度下降；该框架为设计结构感知优化器提供了可扩展的分析思路。

title: Loss-Driven Bayesian Active Learning
summary: The central goal of active learning is to gather data that maximises downstream predictive performance, but popular approaches have limited flexibility in customising this data acquisition to different downstream problems and losses. We propose a rigorous loss-driven approach to Bayesian active learning that allows data acquisition to directly target the loss associated with a given decision problem. In particular, we show how any loss can be used to derive a unique objective for optimal data acquisition. Critically, we then show that any loss taking the form of a weighted Bregman divergence permits analytic computation of a central component of its corresponding objective, making the approach applicable in practice. In regression and classification experiments with a range of different losses, we find our approach reduces test losses relative to existing techniques.
