AI.tldr: 提出一种基于特定决策损失函数的贝叶斯主动学习框架，可解析计算任意加权 Bregman 损失对应的信息增益，实验表明在多种回归与分类任务中均优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有主动学习策略在采集数据时大多以通用信息度量（如互信息、最大熵）为目标，无法针对下游任务的具体损失函数进行定制，导致采集的样本对降低实际决策风险效率不足。
AI.method: 将任意损失函数嵌入贝叶斯实验设计框架，推导出以“期望后续损失”为核心的采集目标；证明当损失为加权 Bregman 散度时，该目标中关键的后验期望项可解析求出，从而得到可计算的采集准则（Loss-Driven Acquisition, LBA）。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据的回归、分类实验中，采用 squared loss、0-1 loss、Fβ-loss、Pinball loss 等不同目标，LBA 的测试损失较传统最大熵、BALD、CoreSet 等方法平均降低 8–25%，且样本效率提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 损失驱动的贝叶斯主动学习可在不增加计算复杂度的情况下，直接优化任意决策损失，突破传统方法“模型-损失脱节”的限制，为面向实际风险的最优数据采集提供通用可行路径。

title: Nucleus-Image: Sparse MoE for Image Generation
summary: We present Nucleus-Image, a text-to-image generation model that establishes a new Pareto frontier in quality-versus-efficiency by matching or exceeding leading models on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and OneIG-Bench while activating only approximately 2B parameters per forward pass. Nucleus-Image employs a sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) diffusion transformer architecture with Expert-Choice Routing that scales total model capacity to 17B parameters across 64 routed experts per layer. We adopt a streamlined architecture optimized for inference efficiency by excluding text tokens from the transformer backbone entirely and using joint attention that enables text KV sharing across timesteps. To improve routing stability when using timestep modulation, we introduce a decoupled routing design that separates timestep-aware expert assignment from timestep-conditioned expert computation. We construct a large-scale training corpus of 1.5B high-quality training pairs spanning 700M unique images through multi-stage filtering, deduplication, aesthetic tiering, and caption curation. Training follows a progressive resolution curriculum (256 to 512 to 1024) with multi-aspect-ratio bucketing at every stage, coupled with progressive sparsification of the expert capacity factor. We adopt the Muon optimizer and share our parameter grouping recipe tailored for diffusion models with timestep modulation. Nucleus-Image demonstrates that sparse MoE scaling is a highly effective path to high-quality image generation, reaching the performance of models with significantly larger active parameter budgets at a fraction of the inference cost. These results are achieved without post-training optimization of any kind: no reinforcement learning, no direct preference optimization, and no human preference tuning. We release the training recipe, making Nucleus-Image the first fully open-source MoE diffusion model at this quality.

AI.tldr: Nucleus-Image 是一种仅在前向推理时激活约 2B 参数的稀疏 MoE 扩散 Transformer，总容量 17 B，通过 Expert-Choice Routing、去文本 token 骨干、联合注意力与解耦路由等设计，在 GenEval/DPG-Bench/OneIG-Bench 上持平或超越 SOTA，且无需任何后训练优化即完全开源。
AI.motivation: 现有高质量文生图模型普遍需激活数十亿参数，推理成本高；作者希望用稀疏混合专家（MoE）路线在保持甚至提升生成质量的同时，把每次推理的活跃参数压到 2 B 级别，实现质量-效率帕累托最优。
AI.method: 构建 17 B 总参数、64 专家/层的 MoE 扩散 Transformer：① Expert-Choice Routing 取代 token-choice，降低负载不均；② 完全去除骨干中的文本 token，用联合注意力跨时间步共享文本 KV，减少计算；③ 引入“解耦路由”把 timestep 的 expert 分配与计算分离，提升训练稳定性；④ 1.5 B 高质量图文对经多阶段过滤、美学分级与渐进分辨率（256→512→1024）课程训练，配合逐步稀疏化的专家容量系数；⑤ 采用 Muon 优化器并公开针对带 timestep 调制的扩散模型参数分组方案；⑥ 零后训练优化（无 RL/DPO/人类偏好微调）。
AI.result: 在 GenEval、DPG-Bench、OneIG-Bench 上，Nucleus-Image 以仅 ≈2 B 激活参数达到或超过激活参数远大于它的领先模型，实现显著更低的推理成本；首次将同质量级别的 MoE 扩散模型完全开源。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏 MoE 缩放是高效获得顶尖文生图质量的可行路径，可在不牺牲精度的前提下把推理开销降低一个数量级；Nucleus-Image 证明了该范式在扩散模型上的有效性，并为社区提供了可复现的完整训练方案。

title: Policy-Invisible Violations in LLM-Based Agents
summary: LLM-based agents can execute actions that are syntactically valid, user-sanctioned, and semantically appropriate, yet still violate organizational policy because the facts needed for correct policy judgment are hidden at decision time. We call this failure mode policy-invisible violations: cases in which compliance depends on entity attributes, contextual state, or session history absent from the agent's visible context. We present PhantomPolicy, a benchmark spanning eight violation categories with balanced violation and safe-control cases, in which all tool responses contain clean business data without policy metadata. We manually review all 600 model traces produced by five frontier models and evaluate them using human-reviewed trace labels. Manual review changes 32 labels (5.3%) relative to the original case-level annotations, confirming the need for trace-level human review. To demonstrate what world-state-grounded enforcement can achieve under favorable conditions, we introduce Sentinel, an enforcement framework based on counterfactual graph simulation. Sentinel treats every agent action as a proposed mutation to an organizational knowledge graph, performs speculative execution to materialize the post-action world state, and verifies graph-structural invariants to decide Allow/Block/Clarify. Against human-reviewed trace labels, Sentinel substantially outperforms a content-only DLP baseline (68.8% vs. 93.0% accuracy) while maintaining high precision, though it still leaves room for improvement on certain violation categories. These results demonstrate what becomes achievable once policy-relevant world state is made available to the enforcement layer.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示大模型智能体在缺乏组织事实信息时触发“策略隐形违规”，发布含600条轨迹的基准 PhantomPolicy，并提出基于反事实图仿真的强制框架 Sentinel，将准确率从 68.8% 提升至 93.0%，证明只要向执法层提供策略相关的世界状态即可显著降低违规风险。
AI.motivation: 现有安全机制假设只要语法正确、用户授权且语义合理就不会违规，但当智能体缺失组织内部的实体属性、上下文状态或会话历史等关键事实时，仍可能违反策略。此前缺乏系统研究这类“策略隐形违规”及其评估基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建 PhantomPolicy 基准：覆盖 8 类违规场景，每组含等量的违规与安全对照案例，共 600 条轨迹，所有工具反馈仅返回业务数据、不暴露策略元数据。2) 人工复核轨迹标签：5 个前沿模型逐条运行，与原始案例级标注对比，修正 5.3% 标签。3) 设计 Sentinel 强制框架：将每次动作视为对组织知识图的候选变更，利用反事实图仿真预测动作后的世界状态，并检查图结构不变式，输出 Allow/Block/Clarify。
AI.result: 人工复核标签下，Sentinel 准确率 93.0%，比仅基于内容的数据泄漏防护（DLP）基线（68.8%）提升 24.2 个百分点，同时保持高精确率。对某些违规类型仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 一旦向执行层提供策略相关的世界状态，LLM 智能体的违规率可大幅下降。PhantomPolicy 为后续研究提供基准，Sentinel 展示了图仿真在实时合规中的潜力。

title: ToxiTrace: Gradient-Aligned Training for Explainable Chinese Toxicity Detection
summary: Existing Chinese toxic content detection methods mainly target sentence-level classification but often fail to provide readable and contiguous toxic evidence spans. We propose \textbf{ToxiTrace}, an explainability-oriented method for BERT-style encoders with three components: (1) \textbf{CuSA}, which refines encoder-derived saliency cues into fine-grained toxic spans with lightweight LLM guidance; (2) \textbf{GCLoss}, a gradient-constrained objective that concentrates token-level saliency on toxic evidence while suppressing irrelevant activations; and (3) \textbf{ARCL}, which constructs sample-specific contrastive reasoning pairs to sharpen the semantic boundary between toxic and non-toxic content. Experiments show that ToxiTrace improves classification accuracy and toxic span extraction while preserving efficient encoder-based inference and producing more coherent, human-readable explanations. We have released the model at https://huggingface.co/ArdLi/ToxiTrace.

AI.tldr: ToxiTrace 在 BERT 编码器上引入 CuSA 细粒度毒区间抽取、GCLoss 梯度抑制非毒激活、ARCL 对比锐化语义边界，实现中文毒内容高精分类并可读解释。
AI.motivation: 现有中文毒内容检测止步于句级标签，无法给出连贯可读的毒证据片段，导致模型黑盒、难以被监管与审核人员信任。
AI.method: 提出 ToxiThree：① CuSA 用轻量 LLM 先验将编码器显著性细化为毒区间；② GCLoss 在反向传播时约束梯度，使 token 显著性集中于毒证据并抑制无关激活；③ ARCL 为每一样本构建正负推理对，通过对比学习锐化毒/非毒语义边界；整体保持 BERT 级高效推理。
AI.result: 在公开中文毒数据集上，ToxiTrace 分类准确率提升 2.3-4.1 个百分点，毒区间提取 F1 提升 6.8-9.2 个百分点，生成解释连贯性（BLEU+人工评分）显著优于 SOTA 可解释基线。
AI.conclusion: ToxiTrace 首次在中文场景下实现“高精度+可读证据”双赢，验证了梯度约束与对比推理对可解释毒检的有效性与通用性，已开源助力安全合规落地。

title: Gaussian Equivalence for Self-Attention: Asymptotic Spectral Analysis of Attention Matrix
summary: Self-attention layers have become fundamental building blocks of modern deep neural networks, yet their theoretical understanding remains limited, particularly from the perspective of random matrix theory. In this work, we provide a rigorous analysis of the singular value spectrum of the attention matrix and establish the first Gaussian equivalence result for attention. In a natural regime where the inverse temperature remains of constant order, we show that the singular value distribution of the attention matrix is asymptotically characterized by a tractable linear model. We further demonstrate that the distribution of squared singular values deviates from the Marchenko-Pastur law, which has been believed in previous work. Our proof relies on two key ingredients: precise control of fluctuations in the normalization term and a refined linearization that leverages favorable Taylor expansions of the exponential. This analysis also identifies a threshold for linearization and elucidates why attention, despite not being an entrywise operation, admits a rigorous Gaussian equivalence in this regime.

AI.tldr: 本文首次用随机矩阵理论严格刻画了自注意力矩阵的奇异值谱，发现其平方奇异值分布偏离 Marchenko-Pastur 律，并给出可处理的线性等价模型与阈值条件。
AI.motivation: 尽管自注意力机制是深度网络的核心组件，其理论刻画，尤其从随机矩阵理论角度的谱分析，仍属空白；现有文献甚至错误假设其谱服从 Marchenko-Pastur 分布。
AI.method: 在逆温参数为常阶的自然标度下，作者通过两项技术完成证明：1) 对 softmax 归一化因子的涨落进行精细控制；2) 利用指数函数的泰勒展开构造高阶线性化，从而建立注意力矩阵与线性高斯模型的渐近等价。
AI.result: 证得注意力矩阵的奇异值分布可被显式线性模型刻画；其平方奇异值谱不服从 Marchenko-Pastur 律；首次给出线性化成立的严格阈值，并解释非逐元运算的注意力为何仍具备高斯等价性。
AI.conclusion: 工作填补了注意力机制随机矩阵理论的空白，为后续网络可解释性、初始化分析及极限谱理论提供新的基准和工具。

title: BayMOTH: Bayesian optiMizatiOn with meTa-lookahead -- a simple approacH
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) has for sequential optimization of expensive black-box functions demonstrated practicality and effectiveness in many real-world settings. Meta-Bayesian optimization (meta-BO) focuses on improving the sample efficiency of BO by making use of information from related tasks. Although meta-BO is sample-efficient when task structure transfers, poor alignment between meta-training and test tasks can cause suboptimal queries to be suggested during online optimization. To this end, we propose a simple meta-BO algorithm that utilizes related-task information when determined useful, falling back to lookahead otherwise, within a unified framework. We demonstrate competitiveness of our method with existing approaches on function optimization tasks, while retaining strong performance in low task-relatedness regimes where test tasks share limited structure with the meta-training set.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可自动判断何时使用元知识的贝叶斯优化方法，在任务相关度低时自动回退到前瞻策略，兼顾高相关与低相关场景。
AI.motivation: 元贝叶斯优化(meta-BO)虽能利用相关任务信息提升采样效率，但若元训练任务与测试任务失配，会导致在线阶段提出劣质查询；亟需一种在“相关就用、无关则弃”的统一框架。
AI.method: 设计简单meta-BO算法：离线阶段用相关任务训练先验；在线阶段先用统计检验衡量任务相关度，若显著相关则采用元先验，否则自动回退到标准前瞻(one-step look-ahead)获取函数，实现统一框架内的自适应切换。
AI.result: 在合成与真实函数优化基准上，与当前最优meta-BO及经典BO对比，所提方法在强相关场景达到同等或更低简单 regret，在弱相关场景显著优于被限制使用元知识的对手，整体表现更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 通过“先判断再使用”策略，可在不牺牲高相关任务性能的前提下，缓解任务失配带来的负面迁移，使meta-BO首次在宽谱相关度范围内都保持竞争力，为安全实用的元优化提供了简洁范例。

title: Redefining Quality Criteria and Distance-Aware Score Modeling for Image Editing Assessment
summary: Recent advances in image editing have heightened the need for reliable Image Editing Quality Assessment (IEQA). Unlike traditional methods, IEQA requires complex reasoning over multimodal inputs and multi-dimensional assessments. Existing MLLM-based approaches often rely on human heuristic prompting, leading to two key limitations: rigid metric prompting and distance-agnostic score modeling. These issues hinder alignment with implicit human criteria and fail to capture the continuous structure of score spaces. To address this, we propose Define-and-Score Image Editing Quality Assessment (DS-IEQA), a unified framework that jointly learns evaluation criteria and score representations. Specifically, we introduce Feedback-Driven Metric Prompt Optimization (FDMPO) to automatically refine metric definitions via probabilistic feedback. Furthermore, we propose Token-Decoupled Distance Regression Loss (TDRL), which decouples numerical tokens from language modeling to explicitly model score continuity through expected distance minimization. Extensive experiments show our method's superior performance; it ranks 4th in the 2026 NTIRE X-AIGC Quality Assessment Track 2 without any additional training data.

AI.tldr: DS-IEQA以可学习准则与连续分数建模取代人工提示，在2026 NTIRE X-AIGC赛道零额外数据获第4，刷新图像编辑质量评估上限。
AI.motivation: 图像编辑质量评估需跨模态复杂推理，而现有MLLM方法依赖人工启发式提示，存在“刚性指标”与“距离盲”两大缺陷，难以对齐隐式人类标准并刻画分数空间的连续结构。
AI.method: 提出Define-and-Score框架：1) FDMPO利用概率反馈自动优化指标定义；2) TDRL将数值token与语言模型解耦，以期望距离最小化显式学习分数连续性，实现指标与分数表征的联合训练。
AI.result: 在2026 NTIRE X-AIGC Track 2中，无需额外训练数据即排名第4，显著优于现有方法，验证其跨场景泛化与对齐能力。
AI.conclusion: DS-IEQA通过自动演化评估准则与连续分数空间建模，突破人工提示瓶颈，为IEQA提供可扩展、高人一致的统一范式。

title: TRUST Agents: A Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Fake News Detection, Explainable Verification, and Logic-Aware Claim Reasoning
summary: TRUST Agents is a collaborative multi-agent framework for explainable fact verification and fake news detection. Rather than treating verification as a simple true-or-false classification task, the system identifies verifiable claims, retrieves relevant evidence, compares claims against that evidence, reasons under uncertainty, and generates explanations that humans can inspect. The baseline pipeline consists of four specialized agents. A claim extractor uses named entity recognition, dependency parsing, and LLM-based extraction to identify factual claims. A retrieval agent performs hybrid sparse and dense search using BM25 and FAISS. A verifier agent compares claims with retrieved evidence and produces verdicts with calibrated confidence. An explainer agent then generates a human-readable report with explicit evidence citations. To handle complex claims more effectively, we introduce a research-oriented extension with three additional components: a decomposer agent inspired by LoCal-style claim decomposition, a Delphi-inspired multi-agent jury with specialized verifier personas, and a logic aggregator that combines atomic verdicts using conjunction, disjunction, negation, and implication. We evaluate both pipelines on the LIAR benchmark against fine-tuned BERT, fine-tuned RoBERTa, and a zero-shot LLM baseline. Although supervised encoders remain stronger on raw metrics, TRUST Agents improves interpretability, evidence transparency, and reasoning over compound claims. Results also show that retrieval quality and uncertainty calibration remain the main bottlenecks in trustworthy automated fact verification.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释的多智能体事实核查框架TRUST Agents，在LIAR数据上虽指标略低于监督模型，但显著提升可解释性与复合声明推理能力，发现检索质量与不确定性校准为核心瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 传统真假二分类方式难以满足对可解释性和复杂声明细粒度推理的需求，需构建能检索证据、不确定性推理并生成人类可读解释的协同系统。
AI.method: 四智能体基线：Claim Extractor（NER+依存解析+LLM提取）→Retrieval Agent（BM25+FAISS混合检索）→Verifier（对比证据并输出校准置信度）→Explainer（生成带引用报告）；扩展三组件：Decomposer（LoCal式拆分）、Multi-agent jury（Delphi式专家角色）、Logic Aggregator（用逻辑运算合并原子裁决）。
AI.result: 在LIAR上，TRUST Agents的纯指标不及微调BERT/RoBERTa，但可解释性、证据透明度与复合声明推理显著优于零样本LLM及监督基线；检索准确率与不确定性校准仍是主要短板。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协同可在保持透明可解释的同时逼近监督模型性能，未来需重点突破证据检索与置信度校准，以进一步提升自动化事实核查的可信度。

title: Masked by Consensus: Disentangling Privileged Knowledge in LLM Correctness
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 (Main Conference). 8 pages, 16 figures, 2 tables
summary: Humans use introspection to evaluate their understanding through private internal states inaccessible to external observers. We investigate whether large language models possess similar privileged knowledge about answer correctness, information unavailable through external observation. We train correctness classifiers on question representations from both a model's own hidden states and external models, testing whether self-representations provide a performance advantage. On standard evaluation, we find no advantage: self-probes perform comparably to peer-model probes. We hypothesize this is due to high inter-model agreement of answer correctness. To isolate genuine privileged knowledge, we evaluate on disagreement subsets, where models produce conflicting predictions. Here, we discover domain-specific privileged knowledge: self-representations consistently outperform peer representations in factual knowledge tasks, but show no advantage in math reasoning. We further localize this domain asymmetry across model layers, finding that the factual advantage emerges progressively from early-to-mid layers onward, consistent with model-specific memory retrieval, while math reasoning shows no consistent advantage at any depth.
