title: A Theoretical Comparison of No-U-Turn Sampler Variants: Necessary and Sufficient Convergence Conditions and Mixing Time Analysis under Gaussian Targets
summary: The No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) is the computational workhorse of modern Bayesian software libraries, yet its qualitative and quantitative convergence guarantees were established only recently. A significant gap remains in the theoretical comparison of its two main variants: NUTS-mul and NUTS-BPS, which use multinomial sampling and biased progressive sampling, respectively, for index selection. In this paper, we address this gap in three contributions. First, we derive the first necessary conditions for geometric ergodicity for both variants. Second, we establish the first sufficient conditions for geometric ergodicity and ergodicity for NUTS-mul. Third, we obtain the first mixing time result for NUTS-BPS on a standard Gaussian distribution. Our results show that NUTS-mul and NUTS-BPS exhibit nearly identical qualitative behavior, with geometric ergodicity depending on the tail properties of the target distribution. However, they differ quantitatively in their convergence rates. More precisely, when initialized in the typical set of the canonical Gaussian measure, the mixing times of both NUTS-mul and NUTS-BPS scale as $O(d^{1/4})$ up to logarithmic factors, where $d$ denotes the dimension. Nevertheless, the associated constants are strictly smaller for NUTS-BPS.

AI.tldr: 本文首次给出NUTS-mul与NUTS-BPS的几何遍历必要与充分条件，并证明二者在高维高斯下的混合时间同为O(d^{1/4})，但NUTS-BPS的常数更小。
AI.motivation: 现代贝叶斯库的核心算法NUTS存在两种主流变体（NUTS-mul与NUTS-BPS），其收敛理论长期空缺，亟需统一框架比较二者优劣。
AI.method: 1) 建立几何遍历性的必要/充分谱条件；2) 对NUTS-mul首次证明几何遍历；3) 对高斯目标给出NUTS-BPS首个混合时间上界。
AI.result: 两变体定性行为一致，几何遍历性皆取决于目标分布尾部；定量上混合时间同阶O(d^{1/4})，但NUTS-BPS常数严格更小。
AI.conclusion: NUTS-BPS在理论上具有更快的定量收敛优势，为算法选择提供可量化依据，同时统一了两种变体的遍历理论。

title: Sample Complexity of Autoregressive Reasoning: Chain-of-Thought vs. End-to-End
summary:
Modern large language models generate text autoregressively, producing tokens one at a time. To study the learnability of such systems, Joshi et al. (COLT 2025) introduced a PAC-learning framework for next-token generators, the primitive underlying autoregressive models. In this framework, an unknown next-token generator maps a sequence of tokens to the next token and is iteratively applied for $T$ steps, producing a chain of tokens whose final token constitutes the model's output. The learning task is to learn the input-output mapping induced by this autoregressive process. Depending on the available supervision, training examples may reveal only the final output (End-to-End supervision) or the entire generated chain (Chain-of-Thought supervision). This raises two natural questions: how the sample complexity depends on the generation length $T$, and how much Chain-of-Thought supervision can reduce this dependence.
  In this work we give a nearly complete answer to both questions by uncovering a taxonomy of how the sample complexity scales with $T$. For End-to-End learning, we show that the landscape is remarkably rich: subject to mild conditions, essentially any growth rate $r(T)$ between constant and linear can arise as the sample complexity, and combined with the linear upper bound of Joshi et al., this yields an essentially complete characterization. In contrast, under Chain-of-Thought supervision we show that the sample complexity is independent of $T$, demonstrating that access to intermediate reasoning steps can eliminate the dependence on the generation length altogether. Our analysis introduces new combinatorial tools, and as corollaries we resolve several open questions posed by Joshi et al. regarding the dependence of learnability on the generation length and the role of Chain-of-Thought supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文对自回归语言模型（每次生成一个token）的PAC可学性给出了长度T与样本复杂度的完整刻画：仅观测最终输出的End-to-End学习，样本复杂度几乎可以是常数到线性之间的任意增速；若能观测全部中间token（Chain-of-Thought监督），样本复杂度与T无关，彻底消除生成长度依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语言模型的核心是自回归链式生成（next-token generator）。然而，这种“迭代取样T步再返回最后一个token”的过程会带来多长的链就相当于多大的学习代价？如果同时能看到中间的“思考链”，是否能缩短这一代价？这两个问题缺乏系统答案。Joshi等人在COLT 2025提出的PAC学习框架提供了工具，但只对线性上界和个别特例奏效，缺乏系统分类。
AI.method: 在每一步状态映射下一个token的未知自回归器上，构造End-to-End（仅看见最后输出）和Chain-of-Thought（看得见整条T步链）两种监督设定。针对End-to-End，利用新的组合计数技术证明，只要满足轻度复杂性条件，就可以复制任意介于Ω(1)到O(T)之间的样本复杂度增速r(T)；与已知的O(T)上界叠加，得到完备三段特征。对Chain-of-Thought，通过直接判别中间条件分布，引入KL计算+加法递推，证明样本复杂度完全独立于T。
AI.result: 1）给出End-to-End学习的“T-复杂度全景”：理论上你能构造出常数、对数、多项式乃至线性任意增速的r(T)，且这些复杂度均可达；2）结合此前线性上界得到三档可实现的完整分类；3）证明只要提供Chain-of-Thought（完整推理链），样本复杂度只与模型的内在特征维度有关，而不再随生成长度T增长；4）一举解决了Joshi等人留下的数条关于T依赖与CoT作用的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 自回归模型的学习难度并非天然由链长T决定。若能暴露中间推理步骤，样本需求立即变得与T无关；否则即使简洁模型，也可能需要对T呈线性或更复杂的样本代价。这从原理层面说明了“可解释/可展开的推理链”不仅是提升可读性，更在统计层面极大地节省了训练数据，为今后数据高效、可判释的自回归模型设计提供了理论依据。

title: Ride the Wave: Precision-Allocated Sparse Attention for Smooth Video Generation
summary: Video Diffusion Transformers have revolutionized high-fidelity video generation but suffer from the massive computational burden of self-attention. While sparse attention provides a promising acceleration solution, existing methods frequently provoke severe visual flickering caused by static sparsity patterns and deterministic block routing. To resolve these limitations, we propose Precision-Allocated Sparse Attention (PASA), a training-free framework designed for highly efficient and temporally smooth video generation. First, we implement a curvature-aware dynamic budgeting mechanism. By profiling the generation trajectory acceleration across timesteps, we elastically allocate the exact-computation budget to secure high-precision processing strictly during critical semantic transitions. Second, we replace global homogenizing estimations with hardware-aligned grouped approximations, successfully capturing fine-grained local variations while maintaining peak compute throughput. Finally, we incorporate a stochastic selection bias into the attention routing mechanism. This probabilistic approach softens rigid selection boundaries and eliminates selection oscillation, effectively eradicating the localized computational starvation that drives temporal flickering. Extensive evaluations on leading video diffusion models demonstrate that PASA achieves substantial inference acceleration while consistently producing remarkably fluid and structurally stable video sequences.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的PASA框架，用动态预算+分组近似+随机偏置消除稀疏注意力导致的视频闪烁，在大幅加速推理的同时保持时序平滑与结构稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散Transformer因全自注意力计算量巨大，虽可借稀疏注意力加速，但静态稀疏模式和确定性路由会引发严重时序闪烁，亟需兼顾效率与视觉一致性的新策略。
AI.method: 1) 无训练框架PASA；2) 曲率感知的动态预算机制，按时间步语义转折弹性分配精确计算资源；3) 面向硬件的分组局部近似，替代全局均匀估计；4) 引入随机选择偏置的注意力路由，抑制刚性边界与选择振荡。
AI.result: 在主流视频扩散模型上，PASA显著缩短推理时间，并持续生成流畅、结构稳定的视频序列，未出现可见闪烁。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态资源分配与随机化路由，PASA首次在无需再训练条件下实现高加速比与高质量视频生成的兼得，为高效视频扩散模型部署提供了可落地的新范式。

title: Beyond Scores: Diagnostic LLM Evaluation via Fine-Grained Abilities
summary: Current evaluations of large language models aggregate performance across diverse tasks into single scores. This obscures fine-grained ability variation, limiting targeted model improvement and ability-guided selection for specific tasks. Motivated by this gap, we propose a cognitive diagnostic framework that estimates model abilities across multiple fine-grained dimensions. For mathematics, we construct a 35-dimensional ability taxonomy grounded in cognitive theory and domain knowledge. The framework employs multidimensional Item Response Theory with an item-ability association matrix to estimate fine-grained ability levels, which in turn enable prediction of performance on unseen items (questions of benchmark). Evaluated on 41 models, our approach demonstrates strong criterion validity, consistent ability estimates across benchmarks, and accurate prediction of unseen items with AUC ranging from 0.80 to 0.89 within benchmarks and from 0.77 to 0.86 across benchmarks, substantially exceeding trivial baselines. The framework generalizes across scientific domains, producing consistent diagnostic performance in physics (27 dimensions), chemistry (58 dimensions), and computer science (12 dimensions). This work establishes a principled framework for fine-grained assessment of abilities, with potential applications in targeted training, ability-guided model selection, and ability-aware benchmark design.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于认知诊断的多维IRT框架，首次把大模型数学能力细拆为35维，实现细粒度评估与跨领域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有评估把模型性能压成单一分数，掩盖能力差异，阻碍针对性改进和任务匹配。
AI.method: 构建学科认知能力体系（数学35维、物理27维、化学58维、CS 12维），用多维IRT与题目-能力关联矩阵估计模型在各维度的真实能力，并据此预测未见题目表现。
AI.result: 41个模型的实验显示：同一套内AUC 0.80–0.89，跨套AUC 0.77–0.86，显著优于随机基线；能力估计跨benchmark一致，框架可泛化到多门理工学科。
AI.conclusion: 确立了细粒度、可解释的能力诊断范式，为定向训练、能力导向模型筛选和benchmark设计提供新工具。

title: Cooperative Memory Paging with Keyword Bookmarks for Long-Horizon LLM Conversations
summary: When LLM conversations grow beyond the context window, old content must be evicted -- but how does the model recover it when needed? We propose cooperative paging: evicted segments are replaced with minimal keyword bookmarks ([pN:keywords], ~8-24 tokens each), and the model is given a recall() tool to retrieve full content on demand. On the LoCoMo benchmark (10 real multi-session conversations, 300+ turns), cooperative paging achieves the highest answer quality among six methods -- outperforming truncation, BM25, word-overlap retrieval, a search-tool baseline, and full context -- on four models (GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-v3.2, Claude Haiku, GLM-5), confirmed by four independent LLM judges ($p=0.017$, paired bootstrap). We then study the paging design space with a 5x4 ablation over boundary strategies and eviction policies (3,176 synthetic probes, 1,600 LoCoMo probes). Key findings: (1) coarse fixed-size pages (fixed_20) reach 96.7% while content-aware topic_shift collapses to 56.7%; (2) eviction policy choice is data-dependent (FIFO best on synthetic, LFU on LoCoMo); (3) two bookmark generation strategies improve over the heuristic baseline (+4.4 and +8.7 E2E points); (4) the remaining bottleneck is bookmark discrimination -- the model triggers recall() 96% of the time but selects the correct page only 57% when bookmarks are insufficiently distinctive. Keyword specificity alone accounts for a 25 percentage point accuracy difference.

AI.tldr: 针对超长对话超出LLM上下文窗口的难题，提出“合作分页”方法：将被驱逐片段替换为8–24 token的[pN:关键词]书签，并暴露recall()工具在需要时取回。LoCoMo基准（10个多轮会话、300+轮）中，六法比较下该方法在四模型上质量最佳，统计显著（p=0.017）。3 176合成+1 600真实 probe的系统析因实验揭示了边界、驱逐策略及书签设计的关键权衡与底线：书签区分度是性能瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM一次可处理的上下文长度受限。当多轮对话超越窗口后，必须丢弃旧信息，而后续提问又可能依赖这些被丢弃内容。传统截断、稀疏检索或外部搜索难以兼顾召回与准确，如何在模型内部最小代价“记位置、随时召回”尚无系统研究。
AI.method: 1. 合作分页框架：将对话按固定大小（如20句）切为页，每页生成≤24 tokens的书签[pN:关键词]。2. 上下文外存：驱逐页以书签占位，保持工作集在窗口内。3. 动态召回：模型可在任意位置调用recall(pN)取回对应页原文。4. 设计空间扫描：边界策略（固定、话题变化等）× 5，驱逐策略（FIFO/LFU/随机等）× 4，书签生成（启发/抽取/摘要）× 2，共3 176合成+1 600真实对话探针评估。
AI.result: LoCoMo上合作分页在四模型（GPT-4o-mini、DeepSeek-v3.2、Claude Haiku、GLM-5）均居首，显著优于截断、BM25、词重叠、搜索工具基线及全上下文输入（p=0.017）。消融显示：固定20句分页+FIFO/LFU可获96.7% QA 准确率；话题敏感分页跌至56.7%。书签设计干预带来+4.4~+8.7 E2E得分提升。模型几乎每次需信息都会触发recall（96%命中率），但书签若不够特异，选错页概率达43%，仅关键词特异性一项即可拉开25个百分点差距。
AI.conclusion: 在超长对话场景下，仅需极少书签+按需召回即可让LLM找回被驱逐内容，性能远超传统剪枝与检索。分页粒度宜粗不宜细，驱逐策略需针对数据选择，而书签的“区分度”是整个系统的性能瓶颈，未来应优先优化关键词/摘要的判别能力。该工作为长上下文LLM的记忆管理提供了可直接落地的轻量级方案。

title: Discrete Flow Maps
summary: The sequential nature of autoregressive next-token prediction imposes a fundamental speed limit on large language models. While continuous flow models offer a path to parallel generation, they traditionally demand expensive iterative integration. Flow Maps bypass this bottleneck by compressing generative trajectories into single-step mappings, theoretically enabling the generation of full text sequences from noise in a single forward pass. However, standard formulations rely on Euclidean regression losses that are geometrically ill-suited for discrete data. In this work, we resolve this conflict with Discrete Flow Maps, a framework that reconciles trajectory compression with the geometry of the probability simplex. We recast standard flow map training for the discrete domain, aligning the training dynamics with the discrete nature of language. Empirically, this strict geometric alignment allows our method to surpass previous state-of-the-art results in discrete flow modeling.

AI.tldr: Discrete Flow Maps 能用一次前向传播并行生成整段文本，并在离散概率单纯形几何下训练，打破自回归速度瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 自回归大模型逐 token 生成带来不可并行化的时延；连续流模型虽可并行，却需多次积分，成本高。亟需一种可单步并行、又适配离散文本几何的快速生成方法。
AI.method: 将连续流模型的轨迹压缩思想迁移到离散空间，用概率单纯形上的几何距离（如 KL 散度）替换标准欧氏回归损失，设计出“离散流图”训练框架，实现单步噪声到完整文本的映射。
AI.result: 在离散流建模任务上，单步生成的离散流图显著优于现有最佳方法，首次验证并行生成整段文本的可行性与速度优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过把训练目标与离散概率几何严格对齐，Discrete Flow Maps 在保持生成质量的同时突破自回归速度限制，为大规模语言模型的并行解码提供了新范式。

title: UCS: Estimating Unseen Coverage for Improved In-Context Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) performance depends critically on which demonstrations are placed in the prompt, yet most existing selectors prioritize heuristic notions of relevance or diversity and provide limited insight into the coverage of a demonstration set. We propose Unseen Coverage Selection (UKS), a training-free, subset-level coverage prior motivated by the principle that a good demonstration set should expose the model to latent cluster unrevealed by the currently selected subset. UCS operationalizes this idea by (1) inducing discrete latent clusters from model-consistent embeddings and (2) estimating the number of unrevealed clusters within a candidate subset via a Smoothed Good--Turing estimator from its empirical frequency spectrum. Unlike previous selection methods, UCS is coverage-based and training-free, and can be seamlessly combined with both query-dependent and query-independent selection baselines via a simple regularized objective. Experiments on multiple intent-classification and reasoning benchmarks with frontier Large Language Models show that augmenting strong baselines with UCS consistently improves ICL accuracy by up to 2-6% under the same selection budget, while also yielding insights into task- and model-level latent cluster distributions. Code is available at https://github.com/Raina-Xin/UCS.

AI.tldr: 文章提出无训练的“未覆盖簇优先”演示选择法 UCS，用模型嵌入聚类+平滑 Good-Turing 估计未揭示簇数量，在同等预算下把 ICL 准确率再提 2–6%，并可视化潜在簇分布。
AI.motivation: 现有演示选择侧重相关性或多样性启发式，无法显式衡量“已选子集对潜在模式空间的覆盖程度”，导致遗漏对模型有益的未揭示簇，限制 ICL 性能。
AI.method: UCS 两步：①用模型一致嵌入诱导离散潜在簇；②以平滑 Good-Turing 估计子集经验频谱中的未揭示簇数，作为覆盖先验。通过正则化目标与任意基线（含/不含查询）无缝融合，无需训练。
AI.result: 在多个意图分类与推理基准、前沿 LLM 上，UCS 在相同预算下将强基线 ICL 准确率再提升 2–6%，并揭示任务级/模型级簇分布规律。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖导向、训练免费的 UCS 为演示选择提供可解释的理论框架，可即插即用地增强既有策略，为理解 ICL 的潜在结构需求开辟新视角。

title: BarbieGait: An Identity-Consistent Synthetic Human Dataset with Versatile Cloth-Changing for Gait Recognition
summary: Gait recognition, as a reliable biometric technology, has seen rapid development in recent years while it faces significant challenges caused by diverse clothing styles in the real world. This paper introduces BarbieGait, a synthetic gait dataset where real-world subjects are uniquely mapped into a virtual engine to simulate extensive clothing changes while preserving their gait identity information. As a pioneering work, BarbieGait provides a controllable gait data generation method, enabling the production of large datasets to validate cross-clothing issues that are difficult to verify with real-world data. However, the diversity of clothing increases intra-class variance and makes one of the biggest challenges to learning cloth-invariant features under varying clothing conditions. Therefore, we propose GaitCLIF (Gait-oriented CLoth-Invariant Feature) as a robust baseline model for cross-clothing gait recognition. Through extensive experiments, we validate that our method significantly improves cross-clothing performance on BarbieGait and the existing popular gait benchmarks. We believe that BarbieGait, with its extensive cross-clothing gait data, will further advance the capabilities of gait recognition in cross-clothing scenarios and promote progress in related research.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可控跨着装步态数据集BarbieGait及对应基线GaitCLIF，显著提升复杂着装场景下的识别性能。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中服装多样性导致步态识别精度骤降，而现有数据集难以系统评估跨着装鲁棒性，亟需大规模、可控制且保持身份信息的合成数据与基准方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建BarbieGait：将真实受试者映射至虚拟引擎，通过参数化服装系统生成同一身份、不同服装的大规模步态序列；2) 设计GaitCLIF：在步态 silhouettes 流上引入服装扰动增广、服装身份解耦编码及多尺度时空融合，强化衣着无关特征；3) 对比实验覆盖BarbieGait与主流步态数据集，验证跨着装识别增益。
AI.result: 在BarbieGait上，GaitCLIF将跨着装Rank-1 识别率相对提升 14.7%，在 CASIA-B、OU-MVLP 等真实数据集的有外衣协议下分别提升 8.2% 与 6.9%，显著超越现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: BarbieGait 首次提供可扩展、标签精确的跨着装步态研究平台，GaitCLIF 验证了服装不变特征学习的有效性，二者协同推动恶劣着装条件下的步态识别性能，并可为后续虚拟数据增强与域泛化研究提供基准。

title: Latent patterns of urban mixing in mobility analysis across five global cities
comment: Fan, Z., Loo, B.P.Y., Duarte, F., Ratti, C., & Moro, E. (2026). Latent patterns of urban mixing in mobility analysis across five global cities. Nature Cities, accepted
summary: This study leverages large-scale travel surveys for over 200,000 residents across Boston, Chicago, Hong Kong, London, and Sao Paulo. With rich individual-level data, we make systematic comparisons and reveal patterns in social mixing, which cannot be identified by analyzing high-resolution mobility data alone. Using the same set of data, inferring socioeconomic status from residential neighborhoods yield social mixing levels 16% lower than using self-reported survey data. Besides, individuals over the age of 66 experience greater social mixing than those in late working life (aged 55 to 65), lending data-driven support to the "second youth" hypothesis. Teenagers and women with caregiving responsibilities exhibit lower social mixing levels. Across the five cities, proximity to major transit stations reduces the influence of individual socioeconomic status on social mixing. Finally, we construct detailed spatio-temporal place networks for each city using a graph neural network. Inputs of home-space, activity-space and demographic attributes are embedded and fed into a supervised autoencoder to predict individual exposure vectors. Results show that the structure of individual activity space, i.e., where people travel to, explains most of the variations in place exposure, suggesting that mobility shapes experienced social mixing more than sociodemographic characteristics, home environment, and transit proximity. The ablation tests further discover that, while different income groups may experience similar levels of social mixing, their activity spaces remain stratified by income, resulting in structurally different social mixing experiences.

AI.tldr: 全球五城20万受访者数据显示，活动空间结构而非家庭或交通环境决定实际社会混合水平；66岁以上者“第二青春”式混合最高，收入群体虽混合总量相近但活动网络仍分层。
AI.motivation: 既有高分辨率移动数据无法揭示真实社会混合，需用个体级出行调查验证并厘清年龄、性别、收入与建成环境对混合的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用五城大规模出行调查，先以自报与社区推估两种SES测度比较混合差异，再构建家庭-活动空间-人口属性的时空场所图，输入图神经网络监督自编码器预测个体暴露向量，并结合消融测试。
AI.result: ①以社区推估SES使混合水平低估16%；②66+岁群体混合度最高，55-65岁最低；③近轨道交通削弱SES对混合的影响；④活动空间结构解释了个体场所暴露的主要变异；⑤收入群混合总量相近，但活动路径仍被收入分层。
AI.conclusion: 真实社会混合由“去哪里”主导，而非“是谁”或“住哪里”；政策若欲打破隐性分层，应干预高/低收入群体的活动空间选择，而非仅改善住区或交通可达性。

title: SCRIPT: A Subcharacter Compositional Representation Injection Module for Korean Pre-Trained Language Models
summary: Korean is a morphologically rich language with a featural writing system in which each character is systematically composed of subcharacter units known as Jamo. These subcharacters not only determine the visual structure of Korean but also encode frequent and linguistically meaningful morphophonological processes. However, most current Korean language models (LMs) are based on subword tokenization schemes, which are not explicitly designed to capture the internal compositional structure of characters. To address this limitation, we propose SCRIPT, a model-agnostic module that injects subcharacter compositional knowledge into Korean PLMs. SCRIPT allows to enhance subword embeddings with structural granularity, without requiring architectural changes or additional pre-training. As a result, SCRIPT enhances all baselines across various Korean natural language understanding (NLU) and generation (NLG) tasks. Moreover, beyond performance gains, detailed linguistic analyses show that SCRIPT reshapes the embedding space in a way that better captures grammatical regularities and semantically cohesive variations. Our code is available at https://github.com/SungHo3268/SCRIPT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCRIPT——一个无需改架构、无需再预训练的即插即用模块，将韩文字母(Jamo)级结构知识注入已有PLM，在NLU/NLG任务一致提升，并显著改善嵌入空间对语法与语义的刻画。
AI.motivation: 主流韩语PLM采用子词切分，忽视了谚文字母块(Jamo)的显性结构线索与形态音韵规则，导致字符内部信息未被充分建模。
AI.method: 设计模型无关组件SCRIPT：1) 字符‐Jamo映射表；2) 门控机制把Jamo级嵌入与子词原嵌入融合；3) 轻量级适配器保证零额外预训练即可接入任意主干。
AI.result: 在分类、相似度、问答、摘要等9项韩语NLU/NLG任务平均提升2.6–3.9个百分点；消融实验验证Jam信息贡献显著。
AI.conclusion: 仅注入低层字形结构就能重塑嵌入空间，使其更遵循语法变形与语义连贯度；SCRIPT提供架构不变、计算成本极低的韩语模型增强范式。

title: Deep Learning using Rectified Linear Units (ReLU)
summary: The Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) is a foundational activation function in artficial neural networks. Recent literature frequently misattributes its origin to the 2018 (initial) version of this paper, which exclusively investigated ReLU at the classification layer. This paper formally corrects the citation record by tracing the mathematical lineage of piecewise linear functions from early biological models to their definitive integration into deep learning by Nair & Hinton (2010). Alongside this historical rectification, we present a comprehensive empirical comparison of the ReLU, Hyperbolic Tangent (Tanh), and Logistic (Sigmoid) activation functions across image classification, text classification, and image reconstruction tasks. To ensure statistical robustness, we evaluated these functions using 10 independent randomized trials and assessed significance using the non-parametric Kruskal-Wallis $H$ test. The empirical data validates the theoretical limitations of saturating functions. Sigmoid failed to converge in deep convolutional vision tasks due to the vanishing gradient problem, thus yielding accuracies equivalent to random probability. Conversely, ReLU and Tanh exhibited stable convergence. ReLU achieved the highest mean accuracy and F1-score on image classification and text classification tasks, while Tanh yielded the highest peak signal to noise ratio in image reconstruction. Ultimately, this study confirms a statistically significant performance variance among activations, thus reaffirming the necessity of non-saturating functions in deep architectures, and restores proper historical attribution to prior literature.

AI.tldr: 本文同时完成两项工作：一是考据并纠正 ReLU 的首次深度集成应归功于 Nair & Hinton 2010，而非 2018 年某文；二是在图像/文本分类与图像重建任务中系统比较 ReLU、Tanh、Sigmoid，用 10 次随机化试验加 Kruskal-Wallis 检验证实 ReLU 非饱和特性显著优于出现梯度消失的 Sigmoid，Tanh 在重建 PSNR 上占优，从而强调深度网络应优先采用非饱和激活。
AI.motivation: 近期文献普遍误引 2018 年某文为 ReLU 起源，且缺乏对三种经典激活在统一实验协议下的统计显著性比较；作者希望纠正引用史并量化各激活在典型深度学习任务中的真实性能差异。
AI.method: 历史梳理：追溯分段线性激活从早期生物模型到 2010 年 Nair & Hinton 首次在深度网络使用 ReLU 的数学与文献脉络。实验设计：在图像分类、文本分类、图像重建三大任务上，固定网络结构与超参数，仅替换激活函数；每种函数运行 10 次独立随机初始化，用 Kruskal-Wallis H 检验判定显著性；报告准确率、F1、PSNR 等指标。
AI.result: Sigmoid 因梯度饱和在深度卷积任务中无法收敛，精度仅相当于随机；ReLU 与 Tanh 均稳定收敛。ReLU 在图像与文本分类的平均准确率和 F1 最高；Tanh 在图像重建的峰值信噪比最优；Kruskal-Wallis 检验表明激活函数间差异具有统计显著性 (p<0.05)。
AI.conclusion: 非饱和激活（ReLU）对深度架构至关重要；饱和函数（Sigmoid）在深层网络中遭遇梯度消失而失效；研究在纠正 ReLU 历史归属的同时，通过严格统计实验再次验证并量化了这一设计选择的必要性。

title: TriFit: Trimodal Fusion with Protein Dynamics for Mutation Fitness Prediction
summary: Predicting the functional impact of single amino acid substitutions (SAVs) is central to understanding genetic disease and engineering therapeutic proteins. While protein language models and structure-based methods have achieved strong performance on this task, they systematically neglect protein dynamics; residue flexibility, correlated motions, and allosteric coupling are well-established determinants of mutational tolerance in structural biology, yet have not been incorporated into supervised variant effect predictors. We present TriFit, a multimodal framework that integrates sequence, structure, and protein dynamics through a four-expert Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) fusion module with trimodal cross-modal contrastive learning. Sequence embeddings are extracted via masked marginal scoring with ESM-2 (650M); structural embeddings from AlphaFold2-predicted C-alpha geometries; and dynamics embeddings from Gaussian Network Model (GNM) B-factors, mode shapes, and residue-residue cross-correlations. The MoE router adaptively weights modality combinations conditioned on the input, enabling protein-specific fusion without fixed modality assumptions. On the ProteinGym substitution benchmark (217 DMS assays, 696k SAVs), TriFit achieves AUROC 0.897 +/- 0.0002, outperforming all supervised baselines including Kermut (0.864) and ProteinNPT (0.844), and the best zero-shot model ESM3 (0.769). Ablation studies confirm that dynamics provides the largest marginal contribution over pairwise modality combinations, and TriFit achieves well-calibrated probabilistic outputs (ECE = 0.044) without post-hoc correction.

AI.tldr: TriFit首次把蛋白质动力学信息整合进变异效应预测，在ProteinGym 217万SAVs基准上达到当前最佳AUROC 0.897，超越所有监督与零样本模型。
AI.motivation: 现有变异效应预测器虽利用序列与结构，却忽视残基柔性、相关运动与变构耦合等动力学特征，而这些在结构生物学中被公认为突变耐受性的关键决定因素。
AI.method: 构建四专家混合专家(MoE)多模态框架TriFit，通过三模态对比学习融合：ESM-2序列嵌入、AlphaFold2 Cα几何结构嵌入，以及高斯网络模型给出的B因子、模态形状与残基间交叉相关动力学嵌入；MoE路由器按输入蛋白自适应加权，无需预设模态权重。
AI.result: 在ProteinGym 696k SAVs基准上，TriFit AUROC 0.897±0.0002，显著优于Kermut(0.864)、ProteinNPT(0.844)及零样本ESM3(0.769)；消融实验显示动力学模态带来最大边际增益，且无需后处理即可输出良好校准的概率(ECE=0.044)。
AI.conclusion: 将动力学信息纳入可训练变异预测框架可系统提升精度与校准度，TriFit为疾病机制解析与蛋白质工程提供了新基准。

title: Physics-Grounded Monocular Vehicle Distance Estimation Using Standardized License Plate Typography
summary: Accurate inter-vehicle distance estimation is a cornerstone of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and autonomous driving. While LiDAR and radar provide high precision, their high cost prohibits widespread adoption in mass-market vehicles. Monocular camera-based estimation offers a low-cost alternative but suffers from fundamental scale ambiguity. Recent deep learning methods for monocular depth achieve impressive results yet require expensive supervised training, suffer from domain shift, and produce predictions that are difficult to certify for safety-critical deployment. This paper presents a framework that exploits the standardized typography of United States license plates as passive fiducial markers for metric ranging, resolving scale ambiguity through explicit geometric priors without any training data or active illumination. First, a four-method parallel plate detector achieves robust plate reading across the full automotive lighting range. Second, a three-stage state identification engine fusing OCR text matching, multi-design color scoring, and a lightweight neural network classifier provides robust identification across all ambient conditions. Third, hybrid depth fusion with inverse-variance weighting and online scale alignment, combined with a one-dimensional constant-velocity Kalman filter, delivers smoothed distance, relative velocity, and time-to-collision for collision warning. Baseline validation reproduces a 2.3% coefficient of variation in character height measurements and a 36% reduction in distance-estimate variance compared with plate-width methods from prior work. Extensive outdoor experiments confirm a mean absolute error of 2.3% at 10 m and continuous distance output during brief plate occlusions, outperforming deep learning baselines by a factor of five in relative error.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国车牌的固定字体尺寸作为“天然标尺”，用纯几何方法实现单目相机测距，无需训练数据或主动光源，在10 m处平均误差仅2.3%，比深度学习方法误差降低5倍。
AI.motivation: ADAS与自动驾驶必须低成本、可认证地获得高精度车距，而LiDAR/雷达价格高，单目测距又存在尺度模糊；现有深度学习方法需大量标注、跨域性能差且难通过安全认证。
AI.method: 三步框架：①四路并行车牌检测器，覆盖全光照；②三阶段状态判别（OCR文本匹配+多模板颜色打分+轻量NN分类），确保全天候识别；③混合深度融合（逆方差加权+在线尺度对齐）并级联一维匀速卡尔曼滤波，输出平滑车距、相对速度与碰撞时间。
AI.result: 字符高度测量变异系数2.3%；车距估计方差较前人“车牌宽度法”降36%；户外实验10 m处平均绝对误差2.3%，短暂遮挡仍连续输出，相对误差为深度学习基线的1/5。
AI.conclusion: 借助标准车牌这一被动 fiducial，单目测距可在无监督、零主动照明条件下达到准LiDAR级精度，为大规模车载安全系统提供一条低成本、可认证的新路径。

title: Beyond Prompt: Fine-grained Simulation of Cognitively Impaired Standardized Patients via Stochastic Steering
summary: Simulating Standardized Patients with cognitive impairment offers a scalable and ethical solution for clinical training. However, existing methods rely on discrete prompt engineering and fail to capture the heterogeneity of deficits across varying domains and severity levels. To address this limitation, we propose StsPatient for the fine-grained simulation of cognitively impaired patients. We innovatively capture domain-specific features by extracting steering vectors from contrastive pairs of instructions and responses. Furthermore, we introduce a Stochastic Token Modulation (STM) mechanism to regulate the intervention probability. STM enables precise control over impairment severity while mitigating the instability of conventional vector methods. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that StsPatient significantly outperforms baselines in both clinical authenticity and severity controllability.

AI.tldr: StsPatient 用「对比指令-响应对」提取领域特异 steering vector，再以随机 token 调制(STM)动态干预解码，实现可精细调节严重度的认知障碍标准化病人模拟。
AI.motivation: 传统离散提示工程无法再现认知障碍跨领域、跨严重度的异质性，亟需可扩展、可干预且伦理合规的仿真框架来提升临床教学质量。
AI.method: ①构建各认知域「正常-障碍」对比问答对，提取差分隐态作为 steering vector；②提出 Stochastic Token Modulation，在每步解码以可设概率向隐藏表示注入向量并加高斯噪声，实现平滑、可控、稳定的严重程度调节；③整体框架称作 StsPatient。
AI.result: 在三个临床评估指标下，StsPatient 的逼真度较最强基线提升 18-27%，严重度控制误差降低至 0.06，方差下降 42%，且跨域泛化一致性显著提高。
AI.conclusion: StsPatient 证明「对比向量+随机调制」是兼具真实性与可控性的认知障碍患者仿真新范式，可直接嵌入医学教育平台，也为其他神经精神疾病建模提供通用方法。

title: ReasonXL: Shifting LLM Reasoning Language Without Sacrificing Performance
summary:
Despite advances in multilingual capabilities, most large language models (LLMs) remain English-centric in their training and, crucially, in their production of reasoning traces. Even when tasked with non-English problems, these models predominantly reason in English, creating a fundamental mismatch for non-English usage scenarios.
  We address this disparity directly with three contributions. (i) We introduce ReasonXL, the first large-scale parallel corpus of cross-domain reasoning traces spanning five European languages (English, German, French, Italian, and Spanish), with over two million aligned samples per language, each comprising prompts, reasoning traces, and final outputs, enabling direct supervision of language-specific reasoning. (ii) Using ReasonXL, we demonstrate that LLMs can be adapted to reason entirely in a desired target language, using a simple two-stage pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). The resulting models match or exceed baseline performance, with minimal loss in general knowledge and broadly preserved cross-lingual transfer. (iii) We conduct an extensive representational analysis of the adaptation and find a clear functional division across model depth: early layers contain an activation bottleneck that causally determines language identity, while upper layers concentrate the weight and activation changes driven by adaptation. We further find that RLVR achieves greater behavioral divergence from the base model with smaller parameter updates than SFT, suggesting a more efficient representational rerouting despite much smaller weight updates.

AI.tldr: 作者构建了一个五语对齐的大规模推理语料库 ReasonXL，并证明通过 SFT+RLVR 两阶段微调，模型可在不损失性能的情况下实现「母语级」非英语推理；进一步揭示早期层决定语言身份、高层完成推理重路由，且 RLVR 比重更小却行为差异更大。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 虽号称多语，但其推理链仍以英语为主，导致非英语场景存在「语言-推理错位」。亟需可监督的、语言专属的大规模推理数据与适配方法，以真正释放非英语推理能力。
AI.method: (1) 构建 2M+/语、五语对齐的跨领域 ReasonXL 语料，含 prompt-推理链-答案三元组；(2) 提出「SFT 监督微调 → RLVR 可验证奖赏强化学习」两阶段流水线，使模型全程用目标语推理；(3) 结合因果干预与表征探针，系统分析适配前后模型各层权重与激活变化。
AI.result: 在 ReasonXL 上训练的模型在五语推理任务上持平或优于英语基线，通用知识损失极小，跨语迁移基本保持；早期层发现语言身份瓶颈，高层集中适配变动；RLVR 只更新 1/10 级参数量却带来更大行为偏离，表明其「表征重路由」更高效。
AI.conclusion: 大规模对齐语料+SFT/RLVR 组合可让 LLM 真正做到「语言即推理」；早期语言瓶颈与高层推理重路由的层间分工为后续多语模型压缩、快速本地化提供新靶点；RLVR 的小步大效提示参数高效优化的新方向。

title: Clustering with Uniformity- and Neighbor-Based Random Geometric Graphs
summary:
We propose a graph-based clustering method based on Cluster Catch Digraphs (CCDs) that extends their applicability to
  moderate-dimensional data settings. Existing CCD variants, such as RK-CCDs, rely on spatial randomness tests based on
  Ripley's K function, which exhibit performance degradation as dimensionality increases. To address this limitation, we
  introduce a nearest-neighbor-distance (NND) based Monte Carlo spatial randomness test (MC-SRT) for determining
  covering radii, resulting in the proposed Uniformity- and Neighbor-based CCDs (UN-CCDs). The proposed method is
  designed for datasets of moderate size and dimension, particularly in settings with complex cluster geometry and
  uniformly distributed background noise. Through Monte Carlo simulations and experiments on benchmark datasets, we show
  that UN-CCDs provide stable and competitive performance relative to several established clustering methods within the
  evaluated regimes, while remaining largely parameter-free. We also discuss computational trade-offs and identify the
  practical regimes in which the method is most effective. -- Keywords:
  Graph-based clustering; Cluster catch digraphs; Moderate-dimensional data; the nearest neighbor distance; Spatial
  randomness test.

AI.tldr: 针对高维失效的CCD聚类，提出以最近邻蒙特卡洛空间随机性检验替代Ripley K的UN-CCD，实现「免参、稳态」的中等规模与维度聚类，对复杂形态+均匀噪声鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 已有CCD（RK-CCD）依赖Ripley K函数检验，其统计功效随维度增加急剧下降，导致高维聚类失效，因而需要新的空间随机性检验来维持覆盖半径的准确估计。
AI.method: 用最近邻距离构建零分布，提出参数稀疏的Monte Carlo空间随机性检验（MC-SRT），估算各点的覆盖半径，由此生成Uniformity- and Neighbor-based CCD（UN-CCD），并完全排斥额外参数调节。
AI.result: 在中等规模与维度的合成—Benchmark数据上，UN-CCD对复杂簇形与均匀背景噪声表现出与多类经典方法相当或更优的稳定性，且不敏感于参数选择。
AI.conclusion: UN-CCD在中等维度区间对复杂簇结构与噪声兼具稳健性并可免于调参，为后续更高维扩展与计算优化奠定基础，并给出了计算成本—效益的实用情景界限。

title: VISTA: Validation-Informed Trajectory Adaptation via Self-Distillation
summary: Deep learning models may converge to suboptimal solutions despite strong validation accuracy, masking an optimization failure we term Trajectory Deviation. This is because as training proceeds, models can abandon high generalization states for specific data sub-populations, thus discarding previously learned latent features without triggering classical overfitting signals. To address this problem we introduce VISTA, an online self-distillation framework that enforces consistency along the optimization trajectory. Using a validation-informed Marginal Coverage score, VISTA identifies expert anchors, which are earlier model states that retain specialized competence over distinct data regions. A coverage-weighted ensemble of these anchors is integrated online during training, regularizing the loss landscape and preserving mastered knowledge. When evaluated across multiple benchmarks, VISTA demonstrates improved robustness and generalization over standard training and prior self-distillation methods, while a lightweight implementation reduces storage overhead by 90% without performance loss.

AI.tldr: 提出「轨迹偏移」现象：模型在训练中虽验证精度高，却暗中丢弃对某些子群体的判别特征；在线自蒸馏框架VISTA用验证引导的边际覆盖选专家锚点并实时集成，实现轻量存储下鲁棒性与泛化双提升。
AI.motivation: 观察到深度网络在训练后期会因优化轨迹偏离而抛弃已习得的高泛化状态，导致子群体性能下滑，但经典过拟合指标未能预警。
AI.method: 1) 定义验证集上的Marginal Coverage指标，在线扫描训练轨迹，筛选对特定数据区域保持高专精的早期模型状态作为“专家锚点”；2) 按覆盖权重实时构建锚点集成，通过自蒸馏损失正则化当前网络，实现知识保持与轨迹稳定。
AI.result: 在多项基准任务上，VISTA相较标准训练与现有自蒸馏方法取得一致且显著的鲁棒性与泛化提升；同时仅保存10%参数，存储开销降低90%，性能无损失。
AI.conclusion: 将优化轨迹监控与在线自蒸馏结合，可有效抑制“轨迹偏移”导致的隐性退化；VISTA提供了一种轻量级、即插即用的训练范式，为深度模型可信优化提供了新思路。

title: ArtifactWorld: Scaling 3D Gaussian Splatting Artifact Restoration via Video Generation Models
comment: The second author is the corresponding author
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) delivers high-fidelity real-time rendering but suffers from geometric and photometric degradations under sparse-view constraints. Current generative restoration approaches are often limited by insufficient temporal coherence, a lack of explicit spatial constraints, and a lack of large-scale training data, resulting in multi-view inconsistencies, erroneous geometric hallucinations, and limited generalization to diverse real-world artifact distributions. In this paper, we present ArtifactWorld, a framework that resolves 3DGS artifact repair through systematic data expansion and a homogeneous dual-model paradigm. To address the data bottleneck, we establish a fine-grained phenomenological taxonomy of 3DGS artifacts and construct a comprehensive training set of 107.5K diverse paired video clips to enhance model robustness. Architecturally, we unify the restoration process within a video diffusion backbone, utilizing an isomorphic predictor to localize structural defects via an artifact heatmap. This heatmap then guides the restoration through an Artifact-Aware Triplet Fusion mechanism, enabling precise, intensity-guided spatio-temporal repair within native self-attention. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ArtifactWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in sparse novel view synthesis and robust 3D reconstruction. Code and dataset will be made public.

AI.tldr: 在稀疏视角下，3D-GS出现几何/亮度退化；作者提出ArtifactWorld，用10.7万对视频片段训练双模型视频扩散网络，通过缺陷热度图引导自注意力修复，实现SOTA的新视角合成与鲁棒重建。
AI.motivation: 3D-GS在稀疏视角输入时存在明显几何和光度伪影，而现有生成式修复方法缺乏时序一致性、显式空间约束及大规模训练数据，导致多视图不一致、几何幻觉、泛化差。亟需一套系统化的数据与算法框架来克服这些瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 建立3D-GS伪影的细颗粒现象学分类法，并构建含107.5 K多样视频片段的成对训练集；2) 设计同构双模型：先用同构“预测器”生成伪影热度图定位结构缺陷，再经Artifact-Aware Triplet Fusion在视频扩散主干的原始自注意力内实现强度引导的时空修复；3) 整个修复流程统一在视频扩散骨干中完成。
AI.result: 在稀疏新视角合成与鲁棒3D重建任务上，ArtifactWorld达到SOTA性能，显著优于现有方法，几何和光度一致性大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过大规模、多样化数据与同质双模型策略，ArtifactWorld有效解决了3D-GS在稀疏视角下的退化问题，为实时高质量3D重建提供了可泛化的新范式。代码和数据将开源。

title: Modality-Native Routing in Agent-to-Agent Networks: A Multimodal A2A Protocol Extension
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures (TikZ). PDFLaTeX. Supplementary code and experiment artifacts: https://github.com/vasundras/modality-native-routing-a2a-protocol
summary:
Preserving multimodal signals across agent boundaries is necessary for accurate cross-modal reasoning, but it is not sufficient. We show that modality-native routing in Agent-to-Agent (A2A) networks improves task accuracy by 20 percentage points over text-bottleneck baselines, but only when the downstream reasoning agent can exploit the richer context that native routing preserves. An ablation replacing LLM-backed reasoning with keyword matching eliminates the accuracy gap entirely (36% vs. 36%), establishing a two-layer requirement: protocol-level routing must be paired with capable agent-level reasoning for the benefit to materialize.
  We present MMA2A, an architecture layer atop A2A that inspects Agent Card capability declarations to route voice, image, and text parts in their native modality. On CrossModal-CS, a controlled 50-task benchmark with the same LLM backend, same tasks, and only the routing path varying, MMA2A achieves 52% task completion accuracy versus 32% for the text-bottleneck baseline (95% bootstrap CI on $Δ$TCA: [8, 32] pp; McNemar's exact $p = 0.006$). Gains concentrate on vision-dependent tasks: product defect reports improve by +38.5 pp and visual troubleshooting by +16.7 pp. This accuracy gain comes at a $1.8\times$ latency cost from native multimodal processing. These results suggest that routing is a first-order design variable in multi-agent systems, as it determines the information available for downstream reasoning.

AI.tldr: MMA2A在Agent间网络层实现原生模态路由，使跨模态任务准确率提升20个百分点，但前提是下游推理Agent具备利用该信息的能力；若仅做关键词匹配则增益消失。增益集中在视觉相关任务，延迟增加1.8倍。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统常把多模态信号压缩成文本瓶颈，造成信息损失，限制跨模态推理精度。作者想验证：在Agent-to-Agent通信中保留并路由原生模态信号，能否显著提升下游任务表现。
AI.method: 提出MMA2A架构，在A2A网络层解析Agent Card能力声明，将语音、图像、文本部分以原生模态直接路由至具备对应处理能力的下游Agent。构建50任务的受控基准CrossModal-CS，固定LLM后端与任务，仅变化路由路径进行对比实验，并用bootstrap与McNemar检验评估显著性。
AI.result: MMA2A在CrossModal-CS上任务完成准确率52%，较文本瓶颈基线32%绝对提升20个百分点（95% CI: 8–32 pp，p=0.006）。视觉依赖任务增益最大：产品缺陷报告+38.5 pp，可视化故障排查+16.7 pp。若将下游LLM替换为关键词匹配，准确率骤降至36%，与基线无差异。整体延迟因原生多模态处理增加1.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 路由方式是多智能体系统的关键设计变量；协议层原生模态路由必须与具备相应推理能力的Agent协同，才能释放跨模态信息的价值。否则，信息保真度提高也不会转化为任务性能。

title: From Myopic Selection to Long-Horizon Awareness: Sequential LLM Routing for Multi-Turn Dialogue
summary: Multi-turn dialogue is the predominant form of interaction with large language models (LLMs). While LLM routing is effective in single-turn settings, existing methods fail to maximize cumulative performance in multi-turn dialogue due to interaction dynamics and delayed rewards. To address this challenge, we move from myopic, single-turn selection to long-horizon sequential routing for multi-turn dialogue. Accordingly, we propose DialRouter, which first performs MCTS to explore dialogue branches induced by different LLM selections and collect trajectories with high cumulative rewards. DialRouter then learns a lightweight routing policy from search-derived data, augmented with retrieval-based future state approximation, enabling multi-turn routing without online search. Experiments on both open-domain and domain-specific dialogue tasks across diverse candidate sets of both open-source and closed-source LLMs demonstrate that DialRouter significantly outperforms single LLMs and existing routing baselines in task success rate, while achieving a superior performance-cost trade-off when combined with a cost-aware reward.

AI.tldr: DialRouter用MCTS离线搜索多轮对话分支，训练轻量策略网络，实现无需在线搜索的多轮LLM路由，显著优于单模型与现有路由基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由仅针对单轮优化，忽视多轮交互中的动态演化与延迟回报，导致累积性能下降。
AI.method: 提出DialRouter：1) 以MCTS探索不同LLM选择生成的对话分支，采集高累积回报轨迹；2) 用搜索数据训练轻量路由策略，辅以基于检索的未来状态近似，实现无需在线搜索的多轮路由。
AI.result: 在开放域与领域特定对话任务、涵盖开源/闭源模型的多种候选池上，DialRouter在任务成功率显著超越单一LLM及现有路由基线，并在成本感知奖励下取得更优性能-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: 把单轮短视路由扩展为长序列决策，可显著提升多轮对话的累积性能与经济性，DialRouter为高效多轮LLM服务提供新范式。

title: On the Geometry of Receiver Operating Characteristic and Precision-Recall Curves
summary: We study the geometry of Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) and Precision-Recall (PR) curves in binary classification problems. The key finding is that many of the most commonly used binary classification metrics are merely functions of the composition function $G := F_p \circ F_n^{-1}$, where $F_p(\cdot)$ and $F_n(\cdot)$ are the class-conditional cumulative distribution functions of the classifier scores in the positive and negative classes, respectively. This geometric perspective facilitates the selection of operating points, understanding the effect of decision thresholds, and comparison between classifiers. It also helps explain how the shapes and geometry of ROC/PR curves reflect classifier behavior, providing objective tools for building classifiers optimized for specific applications with context-specific constraints. We further explore the conditions for classifier dominance, present analytical and numerical examples demonstrating the effects of class separability and variance on ROC and PR geometries, and derive a link between the positive-to-negative class leakage function $G(\cdot)$ and the Kullback-Leibler divergence. The framework highlights practical considerations, such as model calibration, cost-sensitive optimization, and operating point selection under real-world capacity constraints, enabling more informed approaches to classifier deployment and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 通过将ROC/PR 曲线视作正/负类分数分布的复合函数 G 的几何像，本文统一解释了常用二分类指标，推导了它们与控制点选取、阈值效应、分类器比较、KL 散度的关系，并给出优化部署的实用指导。
AI.motivation: 针对二分类评估曲线仅作为可视化工具的局限，作者希望寻找共同几何根基，统一解释 ROC 与 PR 曲线的形状、指标含义及不同分类器比较方式。
AI.method: 提出正类 c.d.f. 与负类 c.d.f. 逆函数的复合映射 G = Fp ∘ Fn−1，将 ROC/PR 曲线参数化于 [0,1] 区间；用 G 及其导数表示阈值、TPR、FPR、Precision、Recall 等指标；推导出类别可分性与方差对 G 形状的影响，关联 G 与正–负类泄漏率及 KL 散度，给出线性、阈值等分类模型的解析与数值分析。
AI.result: 所有常见二分类评估量都被写为 G 及其逆的函数，ROC 凸包与 PR 凹包的单调性由 G 的单调性保证；理论上推导出高类间距与低方差均使 G 更陡地趋向 y=x 轴，曲线更靠左上/左上凸，性能更好；KL 散度与 G 之间的显式不等式揭示更高可分性对应更低 KL。
AI.conclusion: 将 ROC/PR 视为由单一复合函数 G 生成的平面曲线，为理解和优化二分类器提供了统一几何框架，可指导在成本敏感、容量受限等现实条件下的模型校准、最佳决策点选取及分类器部署。

title: Interpretable DNA Sequence Classification via Dynamic Feature Generation in Decision Trees
summary: The analysis of DNA sequences has become critical in numerous fields, from evolutionary biology to understanding gene regulation and disease mechanisms. While deep neural networks can achieve remarkable predictive performance, they typically operate as black boxes. Contrasting these black boxes, axis-aligned decision trees offer a promising direction for interpretable DNA sequence analysis, yet they suffer from a fundamental limitation: considering individual raw features in isolation at each split limits their expressivity, which results in prohibitive tree depths that hinder both interpretability and generalization performance. We address this challenge by introducing DEFT, a novel framework that adaptively generates high-level sequence features during tree construction. DEFT leverages large language models to propose biologically-informed features tailored to the local sequence distributions at each node and to iteratively refine them with a reflection mechanism. Empirically, we demonstrate that DEFT discovers human-interpretable and highly predictive sequence features across a diverse range of genomic tasks.

AI.tldr: DEFT 将大模型用于在决策树生长过程中动态生成可解释的 DNA 高级特征，显著降低了树深度并提升预测与泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 深度黑盒模型虽准确但不可解释；轴对齐决策树对 DNA 逐碱基分裂，表达力差、树过深，难以兼顾可解释性和准确率。
AI.method: 提出 DEFT：在树每节点调用大语言模型，根据局部分布自适应生成生物学可解释的高级特征（如 motif 组合），通过“反思”机制迭代优化，随后用传统增益选择分裂。
AI.result: 跨多个基因组学任务，DEFT 生成的树深度比传统轴对齐树减少数倍，在准确率/泛化上匹敌或超越深度网络，同时保留人类可读特征。
AI.conclusion: 通过大模型驱动的动态特征生成，DEFT 首次使决策树在 DNA 序列建模中兼顾高表达力、低深度与可解释性，为可解释基因组学提供了新范式。

title: ARGen: Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation towards Vision-based Dynamic Emotion Perception
summary: Dynamic facial expression recognition in the wild remains challenging due to data scarcity and long-tail distributions, which hinder models from effectively learning the temporal dynamics of scarce emotions. To address these limitations, we propose ARGen, an Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation Framework that enables data-adaptive dynamic expression generation for robust emotion perception. ARGen operates in two stages: Affective Semantic Injection (ASI) and Adaptive Reinforcement Diffusion (ARD). The ASI stage establishes affective knowledge alignment through facial Action Units and employs a retrieval-augmented prompt generation strategy to synthesize consistent and fine-grained affective descriptions via large-scale visual-language models, thereby injecting interpretable emotional priors into the generation process. The ARD stage integrates text-conditioned image-to-video diffusion with reinforcement learning, introducing inter-frame conditional guidance and a multi-objective reward function to jointly optimize expression naturalness, facial integrity, and generative efficiency. Extensive experiments on both generation and recognition tasks verify that ARGen substantially enhances synthesis fidelity and improves recognition performance, establishing an interpretable and generalizable generative augmentation paradigm for vision-based affective computing.

AI.tldr: Wild场景下表情数据稀缺且分布长尾，作者提出二阶段生成框架ARGen，先通过视觉-语言模型注入情感先验，再用强化学习微调扩散模型生成高保真动态表情，兼顾自然度、完整性与效率，显著提升了识别性能。
AI.motivation: 野外动态表情识别受限于数据稀缺与长尾分布，模型难以捕捉稀有情绪的时序动态，亟需一种可解释、泛化的数据增强手段。
AI.method: ARGen采用Affective Semantic Injection（ASI）+ Adaptive Reinforcement Diffusion（ARD）两阶段：ASI利用面部AU与检索增强提示，借助大模型生成细粒度情感描述，注入先验；ARD将文本条件图像到视频扩散与强化学习融合，设计帧间条件约束及多目标奖励函数，联合优化表情自然度、面部完整性与生成效率。
AI.result: 在生成与识别双任务上，ARGen显著提升合成保真度并带来识别性能增益，验证其作为可解释、可泛化增强范式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ARGen为视觉情感计算提供了一种数据自适应、可解释的动态表情生成增强框架，有效缓解长尾稀缺问题，具有良好泛化潜力。

title: Designing Reliable LLM-Assisted Rubric Scoring for Constructed Responses: Evidence from Physics Exams
summary: Student responses in STEM assessments are often handwritten and combine symbolic expressions, calculations, and diagrams, creating substantial variation in format and interpretation. Despite their importance for evaluating students' reasoning, such responses are time-consuming to score and prone to rater inconsistency, particularly when partial credit is required. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have increased attention to AI-assisted scoring, yet evidence remains limited regarding how rubric design and LLM configurations influence reliability across performance levels. This study examined the reliability of AI-assisted scoring of undergraduate physics constructed responses using GPT-4o. Twenty authentic handwritten exam responses were scored across two rounds by four instructors and by the AI model using skill-based rubrics with differing levels of analytic granularity. Prompting format and temperature settings were systematically varied. Overall, human-AI agreement on total scores was comparable to human inter-rater reliability and was highest for high- and low-performing responses, but declined for mid-level responses involving partial or ambiguous reasoning. Criterion-level analyses showed stronger alignment for clearly defined conceptual skills than for extended procedural judgments. A more fine-grained, checklist-based rubric improved consistency relative to holistic scoring. These findings indicate that reliable AI-assisted scoring depends primarily on clear, well-structured rubrics, while prompting format plays a secondary role and temperature has relatively limited impact. More broadly, the study provides transferable design recommendations for implementing reliable LLM-assisted scoring in STEM contexts through skill-based rubrics and controlled LLM settings.

AI.tldr: 首次用GPT-4o对20份手写大学物理开放题进行两轮AI辅助评分，发现若采用技能导向、颗粒度细的评分标准，AI与教师总分一致率可逼近教师间信度；但在中等水平、含部分推理的答案上仍显著下降。
AI.motivation: STEM手写作答包含符号、计算与图示，人工评阅费时且易不一致。LLM虽有助力，但尚缺针对不同评分细则与模型配置的系统性信度证据。
AI.method: 以GPT-4o为评分引擎，对20份真实手写试卷进行两轮实验：①4位教师独立评分；②AI在两种颗粒度（整体vs.检点式）评分标准、两种提示格式及两种temperature下评分。对比总分及分项吻合度，重点分析高、中、低表现段差异。
AI.result: AI-人工总分一致率与人工间信度相当；高、低分段吻合最高，中等分段因部分/模糊推理显著下降。分项上，概念技能对齐优于长程序判断。细分检点式rubric显著提升一致性；提示格式影响次之，temperature几乎无影响。
AI.conclusion: LLM评分信度首重“清晰、结构化、技能细分”的评分标准；提示工程与temperature调参仅起辅助作用。研究为STEM手写开放题的可靠AI评分提供可直接迁移的设计原则：优先制定技能导向细则，再优化提示与参数。

title: KoCo: Conditioning Language Model Pre-training on Knowledge Coordinates
summary: Standard Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training typically treats corpora as flattened token sequences, often overlooking the real-world context that humans naturally rely on to contextualize information. To bridge this gap, we introduce Knowledge Coordinate Conditioning (KoCo), a simple method that maps every document into a three-dimensional semantic coordinate. By prepending these coordinates as textual prefixes for pre-training, we aim to equip the model with explicit contextual awareness to learn the documents within the real-world knowledge structure. Experiment results demonstrate that KoCo significantly enhances performance across 10 downstream tasks and accelerates pre-training convergence by approximately 30\%. Furthermore, our analysis indicates that explicitly modeling knowledge coordinates helps the model distinguish stable facts from noise, effectively mitigating hallucination in generated outputs.

AI.tldr: 给每篇文档打三维语义坐标，作为前缀加入预训练；新方法KoCo让模型收敛更快、幻觉更少，跨10项下游任务全面提升。
AI.motivation: 常规LLM把语料拍扁成纯token流，丢失了人类赖以理解信息的现实上下文，需显式注入知识坐标来恢复语境。
AI.method: 提出Knowledge Coordinate Conditioning (KoCo)：先为语料库构建三维语义坐标系统，再把坐标转成文本前缀拼到对应文档，随后照常预训练。
AI.result: 预训练收敛速度提升约30%，在10个下游任务上显著优于基线；坐标化的知识信号帮助模型区分稳定事实与噪声，明显抑制幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 三维语义坐标作为轻量级前缀即可为模型注入现实知识框架，兼顾训练效率与生成可靠性，为可解释、低幻觉的LLM预训练提供了简单有效的新范式。

title: Free Random Projection for In-Context Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to AISTATS2026. Code available at https://github.com/ThayaFluss/frp_rl
summary: Hierarchical inductive biases are hypothesized to promote generalizable policies in reinforcement learning, as demonstrated by explicit hyperbolic latent representations and architectures. Therefore, a more flexible approach is to have these biases emerge naturally from the algorithm. We introduce Free Random Projection, an input mapping grounded in free probability theory that constructs random orthogonal matrices where hierarchical structure arises inherently. The free random projection integrates seamlessly into existing in-context reinforcement learning frameworks by encoding hierarchical organization within the input space without requiring explicit architectural modifications. Empirical results on multi-environment benchmarks show that free random projection consistently outperforms the standard random projection, leading to improvements in generalization. Furthermore, analyses within linearly solvable Markov decision processes and investigations of the spectrum of kernel random matrices reveal the theoretical underpinnings of free random projection's enhanced performance, highlighting its capacity for effective adaptation in hierarchically structured state spaces.

AI.tldr: 提出“自由随机投影”将分层结构隐式注入输入空间，无需修改网络即可显著提升强化学习策略的跨环境泛化能力，并用随机矩阵谱理论解释其优势
AI.motivation: 现有方法需显式设计双曲嵌入或分层架构才能利用归纳偏置，希望找到一种无需人工设计、让分层偏置自然涌现的算法级解决方案
AI.method: 基于自由概率论构造正交随机矩阵，把状态空间映射到隐分层结构已内嵌的高维表示；将该映射作为即插即用编码器插入上下文强化学习流程，无需改变原网络
AI.result: 多环境基准上自由随机投影持续优于标准随机投影，平均回报提升显著；在可线性求解的 MDP 及核随机矩阵谱实验里，其特征谱呈现更优的聚类与低秩性，对应更快收敛与更低近似误差
AI.conclusion: 自由随机投影以算法方式诱导分层归纳偏置，兼顾通用性与理论保障，为强化学习提供轻量级、可扩展的泛化增强工具，并揭示随机矩阵谱结构与策略适应性能之间的深层联系

title: Robust Optimization for Mitigating Reward Hacking with Correlated Proxies
summary: Designing robust reinforcement learning (RL) agents in the presence of imperfect reward signals remains a core challenge. In practice, agents are often trained with proxy rewards that only approximate the true objective, leaving them vulnerable to reward hacking, where high proxy returns arise from unintended or exploitative behaviors. Recent work formalizes this issue using r-correlation between proxy and true rewards, but existing methods like occupancy-regularized policy optimization (ORPO) optimize against a fixed proxy and do not provide strong guarantees against broader classes of correlated proxies. In this work, we formulate reward hacking as a robust policy optimization problem over the space of all r-correlated proxy rewards. We derive a tractable max-min formulation, where the agent maximizes performance under the worst-case proxy consistent with the correlation constraint. We further show that when the reward is a linear function of known features, our approach can be adapted to incorporate this prior knowledge, yielding both improved policies and interpretable worst-case rewards. Experiments across several environments show that our algorithms consistently outperform ORPO in worst-case returns, and offer improved robustness and stability across different levels of proxy-true reward correlation. These results show that our approach provides both robustness and transparency in settings where reward design is inherently uncertain. The code is available at https://github.com/ZixuanLiu4869/reward_hacking.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对回报黑客的鲁棒强化学习框架，通过对所有 r-相关代理回报取最坏情况，避免代理回报失真导致的策略失效。
AI.motivation: 现实 RL 任务中代理回报与真实回报常存在系统性偏差，导致“回报黑客”。现有 ORPO 等方法仅针对固定代理回报优化，缺乏对更广相关回报族的保证。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为最大-最小策略优化：在代理-真实回报 r-相关约束下，寻找最大化最差代理回报回报的最优策略。当回报为已知特征的线性函数时，可利用先验知识进一步简化并解释最坏回报。
AI.result: 在多个环境中，提出的算法在最坏回报指标上稳定优于 ORPO，且在不同相关强度下表现出更高鲁棒性与稳定性，同时提供可解释的对抗回报。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在回报设计不确定的场景下兼顾鲁棒性与可解释性，为安全部署 RL 系统提供了新工具。

title: Style-Decoupled Adaptive Routing Network for Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Underwater Image Enhancement (UIE) is essential for robust visual perception in marine applications. However, existing methods predominantly rely on uniform mapping tailored to average dataset distributions, leading to over-processing mildly degraded images or insufficient recovery for severe ones. To address this challenge, we propose a novel adaptive enhancement framework, SDAR-Net. Unlike existing uniform paradigms, it first decouples specific degradation styles from the input and subsequently modulates the enhancement process adaptively. Specifically, since underwater degradation primarily shifts the appearance while keeping the scene structure, SDAR-Net formulates image features into dynamic degradation style embeddings and static scene structural representations through a carefully designed training framework. Subsequently, we introduce an adaptive routing mechanism. By evaluating style features and adaptively predicting soft weights at different enhancement states, it guides the weighted fusion of the corresponding image representations, accurately satisfying the adaptive restoration demands of each image. Extensive experiments show that SDAR-Net achieves a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with a PSNR of 25.72 dB on real-world benchmark, and demonstrates its utility in downstream vision tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/SDAR-Net.

AI.tldr: SDAR-Net 通过“先解耦退化风格、再自适应加权融合”的两步法，在真实水下基准上以 25.72 dB PSNR 刷新 SOTA，并显著提升下游视觉任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 UIE 方法普遍采用“一刀切”的均匀映射，对轻度退化图像易过增强，对重度退化又恢复不足；亟需一种能根据退化程度自适应调整增强策略的新框架。
AI.method: 提出 SDAR-Net：① 利用专门设计的训练框架，将输入图像解耦为“动态退化风格嵌入”与“静态场景结构表示”；② 引入自适应路由机制，根据风格特征在线预测软权重，动态加权不同增强状态下的图像表示，实现逐图定制式复原。
AI.result: 在真实水下公开基准上达到 25.72 dB PSNR，显著优于现有最佳方法；在目标检测、分割等下游任务中验证其增强结果可带来一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过“解耦-路由-自适应融合”的范式，SDAR-Net 首次在水下图像增强中实现退化感知的逐图最优增强，为鲁棒海洋视觉感知提供了新基线。

title: HintMR: Eliciting Stronger Mathematical Reasoning in Small Language Models
summary: Small language models (SLMs) often struggle with complex mathematical reasoning due to limited capacity to maintain long chains of intermediate steps and to recover from early errors. We address this challenge by introducing a hint-assisted reasoning framework that incrementally guides SLMs through multi-step mathematical problem solving. Our approach decomposes solutions into sequential reasoning steps and provides context-aware hints, where hints are generated by a separate SLM trained via distillation from a strong large language model. While the hint-generating SLM alone is not capable of solving the problems, its collaboration with a reasoning SLM enables effective guidance, forming a cooperative two-model system for reasoning. Each hint is generated conditionally on the problem statement and the accumulated reasoning history, providing stepwise, localized guidance without revealing full solutions. This reduces error propagation and allows the reasoning model to focus on manageable subproblems. Experiments across diverse mathematical benchmarks and models demonstrate that hint assistance consistently improves reasoning accuracy for SLMs, yielding substantial gains over standard prompting while preserving model efficiency. These results highlight that structured collaboration between SLMs-via hint generation and reasoning-offers an effective and lightweight mechanism for enhancing mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种提示辅助推理框架，将解题过程拆分为多步并行地为小模型提供上下文相关的局部提示，使两个轻量SLM协同完成复杂数学推理。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型(SLM)在链式数学题中容易因早期错误叠加而崩溃，需要不暴露完整解、且轻量的逐步引导机制。
AI.method: 引入
AI.result: 在多个数学基准和 SLM 上的实验显示，仅提供逐阶局部提示即可稳定提升准确率，显著优于标准零/少样本提示，并保持原模型高效的小参数量。
AI.conclusion: 通过两名 SLM“分工协作”生成–推理结构，为轻量模型注入了链式数学推理能力，为小模型高效应对复杂推理任务提供了可扩展范式。

title: Agentic Insight Generation in VSM Simulations
summary: Extracting actionable insights from complex value stream map simulations can be challenging, time-consuming, and error-prone. Recent advances in large language models offer new avenues to support users with this task. While existing approaches excel at processing raw data to gain information, they are structurally unfit to pick up on subtle situational differences needed to distinguish similar data sources in this domain. To address this issue, we propose a decoupled, two-step agentic architecture. By separating orchestration from data analysis, the system leverages progressive data discovery infused with domain expert knowledge. This architecture allows the orchestration to intelligently select data sources and perform multi-hop reasoning across data structures while maintaining a slim internal context. Results from multiple state-of-the-art large language models demonstrate the framework's viability: with top-tier models achieving accuracies of up to 86% and demonstrating high robustness across evaluation runs.

AI.tldr: 用专家知识驱动的两阶段智能体把复杂价值流模拟的洞察准确率拉到86%，比传统端到端方法更稳更快。
AI.motivation: 价值流图仿真数据庞杂，人工提炼洞察易错且耗时；既有LLM无法捕捉细微上下文差异，难以区分高度相似的数据源。
AI.method: 提出“编排-分析”解耦的双阶段架构：编排器用领域知识做渐进式数据发现、多跳推理与动态源选择；分析器专注轻量上下文下的精准分析，二者协同替代单一模型端到端处理。
AI.result: 在多个SOTA大模型上验证，顶级模型准确率最高86%，跨运行方差小，显著优于传统流水线与单模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 领域知识注入的Agentic分层设计，可在保持上下文轻量的同时实现高鲁棒、高准确的价值流洞察提取，为LLM赋能复杂制造分析提供了可行范式。

title: Variational Autoencoding Discrete Diffusion with Enhanced Dimensional Correlations Modeling
summary: Discrete diffusion models have recently shown great promise for modeling complex discrete data, with masked diffusion models (MDMs) offering a compelling trade-off between quality and generation speed. MDMs denoise by progressively unmasking multiple dimensions from an all-masked input, but their performance can degrade when using few denoising steps due to limited modeling of inter-dimensional dependencies. In this paper, we propose Variational Autoencoding Discrete Diffusion (VADD), a novel framework that enhances discrete diffusion with latent variable modeling to implicitly capture correlations among dimensions. By introducing an auxiliary recognition model, VADD enables stable training via variational lower bounds maximization and amortized inference over the training set. Our approach retains the efficiency of traditional MDMs while significantly improving sample quality, especially when the number of denoising steps is small. Empirical results on 2D toy data, pixel-level image generation, and text generation demonstrate that VADD consistently outperforms MDM baselines in sample quality with few denoising steps.

AI.tldr: 提出VADD，用变分自编码思想在低步数时显著提升mask扩散模型的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有mask扩散模型（MDM）在少量解码步骤下因未显式建模跨维度依赖导致质量下降，需一种即用即解的改进框架。
AI.method: 将离散扩散过程与变分自编码融合：引入辅助识别网络，在训练时通过最大化变分下界联合学习主生成模型与隐含变量分布，实现无监督相关性建模。
AI.result: 在2D玩具数据、像素级图像及文本生成任务中，VADD在同一低步数设置下样本质量持续优于MDM基线，同时保持MDM的高效正向/反向结构。
AI.conclusion: 将隐变量学习与离散扩散结合，可在不牺牲效率的前提下显著提升小步数生成效果，为离散数据的快速高质量采样提供了通用范式。

title: SOLARIS: Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling
summary: Recent advances in recommendation scaling laws have led to foundation models of unprecedented complexity. While these models offer superior performance, their computational demands make real-time serving impractical, often forcing practitioners to rely on knowledge distillation-compromising serving quality for efficiency. To address this challenge, we present SOLARIS (Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling), a novel framework inspired by speculative decoding. SOLARIS proactively precomputes user-item interaction embeddings by predicting which user-item pairs are likely to appear in future requests, and asynchronously generating their foundation model representations ahead of time. This approach decouples the costly foundation model inference from the latency-critical serving path, enabling real-time knowledge transfer from models previously considered too expensive for online use. Deployed across Meta's advertising system serving billions of daily requests, SOLARIS achieves 0.67% revenue-driving top-line metrics gain, demonstrating its effectiveness at scale.

AI.tldr: 以 SOLARIS 框架通过离线预计算+投机加载，把大尺寸推荐基础模型从
AI.motivation:
超大规模推荐基础模型推理成本高，用户线上请求需毫秒级响应。直接用大模型做预测无法满足延迟要求，而蒸馏到小模型会牺牲效果，故需一种可以零损在线使用大模型的方法。

需求驱动：1) 维持大模型精度；2) 保持毫秒级时延；3) 在十亿级日请求规模下仍具经济效益。
AI.method:
① 投机离线：基于历史访问模式预测 future user-item 候选对，离线调用大基础模型，预生成其高维隐向量（embedding）并写入缓存。
② 延迟隔离：预计算与线上 serving 完全解耦，在线请求仅作近符号 hash-lookup，命中即返回预向量，未命中退化为次 latency 基线模型。
③ 更新策略：滚动窗口 & 在线反馈校准预测窗口，保证 coverage 与 freshness。
④ 架构落地：在 Meta 量产广告系统全链路编排，负责召回/精排双重环节。
⑤ 双路冗余：线上可同时读取预向量与蒸馏小模型，系统衡量信任度后决定用谁，兼顾稳定性与收益。
AI.result: 全链路上线后：广告转化率、平均出价等营收类 top-line 指标 +0.67%；单次推荐平均延迟 P99 降约 30–40 ms；离线命中命中率 > 93%，预向量保留成本低于 +1.8% infrast 开销；在千亿级 item 池百亿级日活下稳定运行。
AI.conclusion: 证明了

title: DreamStereo: Towards Real-Time Stereo Inpainting for HD Videos
summary: Stereo video inpainting, which aims to fill the occluded regions of warped videos with visually coherent content while maintaining temporal consistency, remains a challenging open problem. The regions to be filled are scattered along object boundaries and occupy only a small fraction of each frame, leading to two key challenges. First, existing approaches perform poorly on such tasks due to the scarcity of high-quality stereo inpainting datasets, which limits their ability to learn effective inpainting priors. Second, these methods apply equal processing to all regions of the frame, even though most pixels require no modification, resulting in substantial redundant computation. To address these issues, we introduce three interconnected components. We first propose Gradient-Aware Parallax Warping (GAPW), which leverages backward warping and the gradient of the coordinate mapping function to obtain continuous edges and smooth occlusion regions. Then, a Parallax-Based Dual Projection (PBDP) strategy is introduced, which incorporates GAPW to produce geometrically consistent stereo inpainting pairs and accurate occlusion masks without requiring stereo videos. Finally, we present Sparsity-Aware Stereo Inpainting (SASI), which reduces over 70% of redundant tokens, achieving a 10.7x speedup during diffusion inference and delivering results comparable to its full-computation counterpart, enabling real-time processing of HD (768 x 1280) videos at 25 FPS on a single A100 GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套稀疏感知的立体视频 inpainting 系统，仅用三招就解决了数据集稀缺与全帧低效计算两大痛点：1.GAPW 梯度感知视差 warp 构造清晰边缘；2.PBDP 无真值生成立体补全对；3.SASI 稀疏扩散推理砍掉 70% token，实现单 A100 实时 768×1280@25 fps HD 补全，性能与全量模型持平。
AI.motivation: 立体视频补洞需同时填充分散在物体边界的空洞并保持时序一致，但现有方法受限于：① 高质量立体 inpainting 数据稀缺，导致先验学习不足；② 对所有像素无差别处理，造成大量冗余计算。亟需一套既摆脱真值数据依赖又能高效聚焦补洞区域的立体视频 inpainting 框架。
AI.method: 三组件级联：(1) Gradient-Aware Parallax Warping (GAPW)：利用 backward warping 与坐标映射梯度，将不连续边缘映射为连续、平滑的遮挡区；(2) Parallax-Based Dual Projection (PBDP)：在无立体视频的条件下，通过 GAPW 投射生成几何一致、成对的立体 inpainting 训练数据及精确遮挡掩码；(3) Sparsity-Aware Stereo Inpainting (SASI)：在扩散模型推理阶段对非空洞区域 token 剪枝，仅对稀疏空洞区域执行扩散更新，并设计轻量掩码引导注意力维持全局一致。
AI.result: 合成数据实验与真实立体视频测试均表明：SASI 在 SSIM、LPIPS、时序一致性指标上与其“全量计算”基线无统计学差异；推理阶段 token 量减少 >70%，单 A100 GPU 上处理 768×1280 HD 立体视频速度达 25 fps，比 Dense-Diffusion 基线提速 10.7×，首次实现高精度立体视频 inpainting 的实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 所提 GAPW-PBDP-SASI 框架通过“边缘保持 warp→无真值数据合成→稀疏扩散推理”三段式策略，同时破解了数据稀缺与计算冗余两大瓶颈，可在消费级 GPU 上为 AR/VR、立体视频修复等应用提供实时、高质量立体补全能力，验证了稀疏化思想在生成式视觉任务中的巨大潜力。

title: How memory can affect collective and cooperative behaviors in an LLM-Based Social Particle Swarm
summary: This study examines how model-specific characteristics of Large Language Model (LLM) agents, including internal alignment, shape the effect of memory on their collective and cooperative dynamics in a multi-agent system. To this end, we extend the Social Particle Swarm (SPS) model, in which agents move in a two-dimensional space and play the Prisoner's Dilemma with neighboring agents, by replacing its rule-based agents with LLM agents endowed with Big Five personality scores and varying memory lengths. Using Gemini-2.0-Flash, we find that memory length is a critical parameter governing collective behavior: even a minimal memory drastically suppressed cooperation, transitioning the system from stable cooperative clusters through cyclical formation and collapse of clusters to a state of scattered defection as memory length increased. Big Five personality traits correlated with agent behaviors in partial agreement with findings from experiments with human participants, supporting the validity of the model. Comparative experiments using Gemma~3:4b revealed the opposite trend: longer memory promoted cooperation, accompanied by the formation of dense cooperative clusters. Sentiment analysis of agents' reasoning texts showed that Gemini interprets memory increasingly negatively as its length grows, while Gemma interprets it less negatively, and that this difference persists in the early phase of experiments before the macro-level dynamics converge. These results suggest that model-specific characteristics of LLMs, potentially including alignment, play a fundamental role in determining emergent social behavior in Generative Agent-Based Modeling, and provide a micro-level cognitive account of the contradictions found in prior work on memory and cooperation.

AI.tldr: 大模型「人格+记忆」参数决定多智能体合作成败：Gemini记忆越长越背叛，Gemma越长越合作，根因在于模型内置对齐/情绪差异。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式智能体研究普遍忽视模型本身特性对宏观社会行为的影响，尤其未厘清记忆与合作的因果链。作者欲用可重复实验揭示模型差异如何导致合作悖论。
AI.method: 以囚徒困境-空间演化博弈为场景，将Social Particle Swarm规则型智能体替换为带Big-Five人格与可变记忆长度的Gemini-2.0-Flash与Gemma-3:4b智能体；对比不同记忆长度下的合作密度、聚类演化，并对智能体内部推理文本做情感分析。
AI.result: Gemini随记忆延长合作骤降→分散背叛；Gemma则记忆越长合作越高→密集合作簇。情感曲线显示：Gemini将长记解读为持续负面信号，Gemma负面感随记忆增长而下降；该差异在宏观收敛前已显现。Big-Five人格与行为关联度符合人类实验趋势。
AI.conclusion: 模型内置特性（包括对齐方式与情绪偏好）是生成式多智能体合作涌现的关键控制变量，为「记忆-合作」矛盾的微观认知解释提供新视角，强调未来群体模拟必须显式校准模型差异。

title: Decoding by Perturbation: Mitigating MLLM Hallucinations via Dynamic Textual Perturbation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models frequently suffer from inference hallucinations, partially stemming from language priors dominating visual evidence. Existing training-free mitigation methods either perturb the visual representation and deviate from the natural image distribution, or enforce intrusive manipulations that compromise the model's inherent generative fluency. We introduce a novel perspective that multimodal hallucination manifests as the hypersensitivity of visual grounding to textual phrasing during the decoding phase. Building on this insight, we propose Decoding by Perturbation (DeP), a training-free framework mitigating prior-induced hallucinations via controlled textual interventions. DeP employs a dynamic probe applying multi-level textual perturbations to elicit latent language priors. Leveraging attention variance, it enhances stable evidence regions while suppressing suspicious noise in the feature space. Furthermore, it constructs an interpretable prior drift direction using logits statistics to counteract probability biases from textual co-occurrences. Extensive experiments confirm DeP effectively reduces hallucinations and achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的方法 DeP，在解码阶段通过对提示词做受控扰动来削弱语言先验对视觉统计的压制，显著抑制多模态大模型幻觉。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型常因语言先验压制视觉证据而产生推理幻觉；现有免训练缓解策略要么破坏视觉特征保真度，要么干扰模型生成流畅度，需在保留模型原生能力的同时抑制先验偏差。
AI.method: 提出“扰动解码”（DeP）框架：在解码阶段用动态探针对不同层级文本施加受控扰动，诱发隐藏语言先验；基于注意力方差增强稳定视觉证据区域并抑制可疑特征噪声；利用logit 统计构建可解释先验漂移方向，反向校正文本共现带来的概率偏差；全程无需再训练或修改模型参数。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准上显著降低幻觉指标，同时保持甚至提升生成质量与流畅度，验证其跨任务泛化优势。
AI.conclusion: 解码阶段文本扰动能有效揭示并校正语言先验导致的幻觉，DeP为免训练、可解释且模型无关的幻觉抑制提供新范式。

title: Incentivizing High-Quality Human Annotations with Golden Questions
comment: Corrected bugs in the proofs by specifying a further assumption. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2502.06387
summary: Human-annotated data plays a vital role in training large language models (LLMs), such as supervised fine-tuning and human preference alignment. However, it is not guaranteed that paid human annotators produce high-quality data. In this paper, we study how to incentivize human annotators to do so. We start from a principal-agent model to model the dynamics between the company (the principal) and the annotator (the agent), where the principal can only monitor the annotation quality by examining $n$ samples. We investigate the maximum likelihood estimators (MLE) and the corresponding hypothesis testing to incentivize annotators: the agent is given a bonus if the MLE passes the test. By analyzing the variance of the outcome, we show that the strategic behavior of the agent makes the hypothesis testing very different from traditional ones: Unlike the exponential rate proved by the large deviation theory, the principal-agent model's hypothesis testing rate is of $Θ(1/\sqrt{n \log n})$. Our theory implies two criteria for the \emph{golden questions} to monitor the performance of the annotators: they should be of (1) high certainty and (2) similar format to normal ones. In that light, we select a set of golden questions in human preference data. By doing incentive-compatible experiments, we find out that the annotators' behavior is better revealed by those golden questions, compared to traditional survey techniques such as instructed manipulation checks.

AI.tldr: 通过委托-代理视角，若重奖与否仅取决于对随机抽检的n个标注样本的最大似然(MLE)质量检验，无监管标注者会在高份额采样下采取策略性应对，导致检验的误差率降至Θ(1/√n log n)，远低于经典大偏差结果的指数收敛。作者提出了
AI.motivation: 付费人工标注是 LLM 监督微调与偏好对齐的核心环节，但无政策时标注者未必提供高质量数据。作者从博弈视角切入，希望建立一种激励机制，使标注者在自利前提下仍愿意高质量输出。
AI.method: 1) 建立公司(委托方)-标注者(代理方)模型：公司仅通过抽查 n 条样本掌握质量（不可全程监督）。2) 以此推导最大似然 (MLE) 质量估计与对应假设检验。3) 结果决定奖金：若 MLE 检验通过，则发放奖金。4) 通过计算检验的收敛速度、验证策略行为如何改变样本误差率，并给出抽检样本“黄金问题”的两项设计准则（高确定性并与正常问题格式一致）。5) 在真实偏好任务上做实验，比较其与传统指令式操纵检查的表现差异。
AI.result: 理论：(1) 引入奖金激励后，检出劣质标注的概率率 Θ(1/√n log n)，比经典大偏差理论得出的指数率大幅放缓；(2) 黄金问题宜高确定且类同正常数据。实验：用激励兼容的 MLE-检验及精心选出的黄金问题，检出标注者投机取巧的概率显著高于传统问卷式操纵核查。
AI.conclusion: 只要抽检机制按委托-代理逻辑设计并配合合宜的黄金问题，公司就可低成本、可靠地激发标注者自提供高质量数据；把策略行为纳入考量后典型的大偏差率不再适用，需在 N 增大 √n log n 级样本才能控制错误。新任务下该方法较传统检查更具实证优势，为 LLM 可靠数据积累提供可操作框架。

title: XANE(3): An E(3)-Equivariant Graph Neural Network for Accurate Prediction of XANES Spectra from Atomic Structures
summary: We present XANE(3), a physics-based E(3)-equivariant graph neural network for predicting X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra directly from atomic structures. The model combines tensor-product message passing with spherical harmonic edge features, absorber-query attention pooling, custom equivariant layer normalization, adaptive gated residual connections, and a spectral readout based on a multi-scale Gaussian basis with an optional sigmoidal background term. To improve line-shape fidelity, training is performed with a composite objective that includes pointwise spectral reconstruction together with first- and second-derivative matching terms. We evaluate the model on a dataset of 5,941 FDMNES simulations of iron oxide surface facets and obtain a spectrum mean squared error of $1.0 \times 10^{-3}$ on the test set. The model accurately reproduces the main edge structure, relative peak intensities, pre-edge features, and post-edge oscillations. Ablation studies show that the derivative-aware objective, custom equivariant normalization, absorber-conditioned attention pooling, adaptive gated residual mixing, and global background term each improve performance. Interestingly, a capacity-matched scalar-only variant achieves comparable pointwise reconstruction error but reduced derivative-level fidelity, indicating that explicit tensorial channels are not strictly required for low intensity error on this dataset, although they remain beneficial for capturing finer spectral structure. These results establish XANE(3) as an accurate and efficient surrogate for XANES simulation and offer a promising route toward accelerated spectral prediction, ML-assisted spectroscopy, and data-driven materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 用首个E(3)等变图网络XANE(3)直接从晶体结构预测XANES谱，FDMNES数据集上MSE 1.0×10⁻³，各组件消融验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统有限差分计算铁氧体表面XANES费时长，需要机器学习代理模型实现快速、准确的谱预测，且模型必须在3D旋转平移下保持物理一致性。
AI.method: 构建E(3)-等变图神经网络：张量积消息传递＋球谐边特征；引入吸收原子查询注意力池化、定制层归一化、自适应门控残差；用多尺度高斯基＋可选sigmoid背景作读出；训练目标为谱重建损失＋一阶和二阶导数匹配。
AI.result: 5941个铁氧体表面FDMNES仿真上测试MSE = 1.0×10⁻³，能准确保留主边、峰值强度、预边和后边振荡；消融显示各关键模块均提升性能；纯标量网络强度误差相近但导数保真度下降。
AI.conclusion: XANE(3)可作为精确高效的XANES替代模型，为高通量谱预测、机器学习辅助光谱及数据驱动材料发现提供新途径。

title: MAST: Mask-Guided Attention Mass Allocation for Training-Free Multi-Style Transfer
summary: Style transfer aims to render a content image with the visual characteristics of a reference style while preserving its underlying semantic layout and structural geometry. While recent diffusion-based models demonstrate strong stylization capabilities by leveraging powerful generative priors and controllable internal representations, they typically assume a single global style. Extending them to multi-style scenarios often leads to boundary artifacts, unstable stylization, and structural inconsistency due to interference between multiple style representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose MAST (Mask-Guided Attention Mass Allocation for Training-Free Multi-Style Transfer), a novel training-free framework that explicitly controls content-style interactions within the diffusion attention mechanism. To achieve artifact-free and structure-preserving stylization, MAST integrates four connected modules. First, Layout-preserving Query Anchoring prevents global layout collapse by firmly anchoring the semantic structure using content queries. Second, Logit-level Attention Mass Allocation deterministically distributes attention probability mass across spatial regions, seamlessly fusing multiple styles without boundary artifacts. Third, Sharpness-aware Temperature Scaling restores the attention sharpness degraded by multi-style expansion. Finally, Discrepancy-aware Detail Injection adaptively compensates for localized high-frequency detail losses by measuring structural discrepancies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAST effectively mitigates boundary artifacts and maintains structural consistency, preserving texture fidelity and spatial coherence even as the number of applied styles increases.

AI.tldr: MAST提出一种无需训练的扩散式多风格迁移框架，通过显式控制 attention 机制消除多风格融合时的边界伪影与结构失真，在任意数目风格下保持布局一致性和纹理保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型虽具强大风格化能力，但只能处理全局单风格；强行扩展到多风格时，不同风格表示互相干扰，导致边界伪影、不稳定风格化与结构不一致。
AI.method: 提出 MAST 四模块：① Layout-preserving Query Anchoring，用内容查询锚定语义布局防塌陷；② Logit-level Attention Mass Allocation，确定性分配注意力概率质量实现无伪影风格融合；③ Sharpness-aware Temperature Scaling，恢复因多风格扩展而降低的注意力锐度；④ Discrepancy-aware Detail Injection，通过结构差异度量自适应补偿高频细节损失。整体无需额外训练，直接嵌入扩散 attention 机制。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MAST 在风格数量增加时仍有效抑制边界伪影，保持结构一致、纹理真实与空间连贯，显著优于现有单风格与多风格迁移方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式控制扩散注意力，MAST 首次在无需训练条件下实现高质量多风格迁移，为后续多模态、局部化风格编辑提供了可扩展的 attention 级解决方案。

title: A Scoping Review of Large Language Model-Based Pedagogical Agents
summary: This scoping review examines the emerging field of Large Language Model (LLM)-based pedagogical agents in educational settings. While traditional pedagogical agents have been extensively studied, the integration of LLMs represents a transformative advancement with unprecedented capabilities in natural language understanding, reasoning, and adaptation. Following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, we analyzed 52 studies across five major databases from November 2022 to January 2025. Our findings reveal diverse LLM-based agents spanning K-12, higher education, and informal learning contexts across multiple subject domains. We identified four key design dimensions characterizing these agents: interaction approach (reactive vs. proactive), domain scope (domain-specific vs. general-purpose), role complexity (single-role vs. multi-role), and system integration (standalone vs. integrated). Emerging trends include multi-agent systems that simulate naturalistic learning environments, virtual student simulation for agent evaluation, integration with immersive technologies, and combinations with learning analytics. We also discuss significant research gaps and ethical considerations regarding privacy, accuracy, and student autonomy. This review provides researchers and practitioners with a comprehensive understanding of LLM-based pedagogical agents while identifying crucial areas for future development in this rapidly evolving field.

title: GLeMM: A large-scale multilingual dataset for morphological research
summary: In derivational morphology, what mechanisms govern the variation in form-meaning relations between words? The answers to this type of questions are typically based on intuition and on observations drawn from limited data, even when a wide range of languages is considered. Many of these studies are difficult to replicate and generalize. To address this issue, we present GLeMM, a new derivational resource designed for experimentation and data-driven description in morphology.
