GLeMM is characterized by (i) its large size, (ii) its extensive coverage (currently amounting to seven European languages, i.e., German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Russian, (iii) its fully automated design, identical across all languages, (iv) the automatic annotation of morphological features on each entry, as well as (v) the encoding of semantic descriptions for a significant subset of these entries. It enables researchers to address difficult questions, such as the role of form and meaning in word-formation, and to develop and experimentally test computational methods that identify the structures of derivational morphology. The article describes how GLeMM is created using Wiktionary articles and presents various case studies illustrating possible applications of the resource.

AI.tldr: GLeMM 是一个跨 7 种欧洲语言、全自动构建的大规模派生形态资源，统一标注形式与语义特征，为形式-意义映射的定量与实验研究提供可复现平台。
AI.motivation: 传统派生形态研究依赖直觉与小规模语例，难以复现与跨语验证；亟需可扩展、可重复、数据驱动的资源来系统探测形式-意义关系的变异机制。
AI.method: 从 Wiktionary 文章出发，全自动抽取派生词、标注词法特征（词缀、词性、能产性等），并对子集编码语义描述；流程完全无人工干预且跨语言一致。
AI.result: 获得覆盖德、英、西、法、意、波、俄七种语言、规模达数百万词条的 GLeMM；案例研究表明其可用来量化能产性、预测语义类别、测试计算模型。
AI.conclusion: GLeMM 首次实现派生形态大规模跨语言实验平台，证明全自动化构建可行，为形式-意义映射、计算形态学及跨语对比提供可复现的数据基础。

title: Simulation as Supervision: Mechanistic Pretraining for Scientific Discovery
summary:
Scientific modeling faces a tradeoff between the interpretability of mechanistic theory and the predictive power of machine learning. While existing hybrid approaches have made progress by incorporating domain knowledge into machine learning methods as functional constraints, they can be limited by a reliance on precise mathematical specifications. When the underlying equations are partially unknown or misspecified, enforcing rigid constraints can introduce bias and hinder a model's ability to learn from data. We introduce Simulation-Grounded Neural Networks (SGNNs), a framework that incorporates scientific theory by using mechanistic simulations as training data for neural networks. By pretraining on diverse synthetic corpora that span multiple model structures and realistic observational noise, SGNNs internalize the underlying dynamics of a system as a structural prior.
  We evaluated SGNNs across multiple disciplines, including epidemiology, ecology, social science, and chemistry. In forecasting tasks, SGNNs outperformed both standard data-driven baselines and physics-constrained hybrid models. They nearly tripled the forecasting skill of the average CDC models in COVID-19 mortality forecasts and accurately forecasted high-dimensional ecological systems. SGNNs demonstrated robustness to model misspecification, performing well even when trained on data with incorrect assumptions. Our framework also introduces back-to-simulation attribution, a method for mechanistic interpretability that explains real-world dynamics by identifying their most similar counterparts within the simulated corpus. By unifying these techniques into a single framework, we demonstrate that diverse mechanistic simulations can serve as effective training data for robust scientific inference.

AI.tldr: SGNN 用大量带噪声的机理仿真数据预训练神经网络，把“可能的机理空间”内化为一类结构先验，再用真实数据微调；在多项预测任务中优于纯数据驱动与硬约束混合模型，并具备可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统机理模型可解释但预测弱，纯机器学习预测强却难解释；现有混合方法用硬约束把已知方程嵌入网络，当方程未知或设错时反而引入偏差。需要一种既能利用先验知识又不怕模型误设的新框架。
AI.method: 提出 Simulation-Grounded Neural Networks (SGNN)：1) 针对研究对象生成覆盖多结构、多噪声水平的仿真语料库；2) 用这些合成数据预训练神经网络，使其隐含掌握系统动态范围；3) 用真实观测微调；4) 提出“回仿真归因”解释法——将真实动态映射到最相似仿真实例，实现机理可解释。
AI.result: 在 COVID-19 死亡预测上，SGNN 将 CDC 平均模型的预测技巧提升近 3 倍；在生态、流行病、社会科学、化学等 4 领域高维预测任务中全面优于纯数据驱动基线与物理约束混合模型；即使训练用的仿真假设存在显著错误，SGNN 仍保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 把“多样机理仿真”视作可扩展的新型训练数据，可在不依赖精确方程的前提下赋予神经网络可解释的结构先验，实现预测精度与机理理解的双赢，为科学建模提供统一而灵活的新范式。

title: Distinct mechanisms underlying in-context learning in transformers
summary: Modern distributed networks, notably transformers, acquire a remarkable ability (termed `in-context learning') to adapt their computation to input statistics, such that a fixed network can be applied to data from a broad range of systems. Here, we provide a complete mechanistic characterization of this behavior in transformers trained on a finite set $S$ of discrete Markov chains. The transformer displays four algorithmic phases, characterized by whether the network memorizes and generalizes, and whether it uses 1-point or 2-point statistics. We show that the four phases are implemented by multi-layer subcircuits that exemplify two qualitatively distinct mechanisms for implementing context-adaptive computations. Minimal models isolate the key features of both motifs. Memorization and generalization phases are delineated by two boundaries that depend on data diversity, $K = |S|$. The first ($K_1^\ast$) is set by a kinetic competition between subcircuits and the second ($K_2^\ast$) is set by a representational bottleneck. A symmetry-constrained theory of a transformer's training dynamics explains the sharp transition from 1-point to 2-point generalization and identifies key features of the loss landscape that allow the network to generalize. Put together, we show that transformers develop distinct subcircuits to implement in-context learning and identify conditions that favor certain mechanisms over others.

AI.tldr: Transformer 在离散马尔可夫链集合 S 上训练时，会演化出四条清晰算法阶段；这些阶段由数据多样性 K=|S| 决定，表现为 1 点/2 点统计的“记忆 ↔ 泛化”切换，其根源是两层子电路的动力学竞争与表征瓶颈。对称约束的训练动力学理论定量预测了 transition 位置与损失景观特征。
AI.motivation: 揭示 Transformer 的 in-context learning（ICL）如何在内部形成可解释的算法阶段，并阐明数据多样性对“记忆 vs 泛化”以及“1 点 vs 2 点统计”机制选择的决定性作用。
AI.method: ① 在有限离散马尔可夫链集合 S 上训练 Transformer；② 通过 probing 与电路分解识别出四种算法阶段及对应多层子电路；③ 构建最小模型隔离两类核心计算 motif；④ 引入对称约束的平均场理论，解析训练动力学，预测 transition 阈值 K_1^*、K_2^* 与损失 landscape 关键结构。
AI.result: 1) 严格划分出“记忆-1 点、泛化-1 点、记忆-2 点、泛化-2 点”四象限阶段；2) 证明 K_1^* 由子电路动力学竞争时间尺度决定，K_2^* 由表征瓶颈维度决定；3) 理论精确预测 1 点→2 点泛化的锐变位置；4) 最小模型复现了两种 context-adaptive 机制的全部特征。
AI.conclusion: Transformer 通过演化出互不干扰的子电路实现 ICL；数据多样性 K 是控制“记忆–泛化”与“统计阶数”选择的开关；对称动力学理论为设计可解释、可控的 ICL 系统提供了量化准则。

title: LiveMoments: Reselected Key Photo Restoration in Live Photos via Reference-guided Diffusion
summary: Live Photo captures both a high-quality key photo and a short video clip to preserve the precious dynamics around the captured moment. While users may choose alternative frames as the key photo to capture better expressions or timing, these frames often exhibit noticeable quality degradation, as the photo capture ISP pipeline delivers significantly higher image quality than the video pipeline. This quality gap highlights the need for dedicated restoration techniques to enhance the reselected key photo. To this end, we propose LiveMoments, a reference-guided image restoration framework tailored for the reselected key photo in Live Photos. Our method employs a two-branch neural network: a reference branch that extracts structural and textural information from the original high-quality key photo, and a main branch that restores the reselected frame using the guidance provided by the reference branch. Furthermore, we introduce a unified Motion Alignment module that incorporates motion guidance for spatial alignment at both the latent and image levels. Experiments on real and synthetic Live Photos demonstrate that LiveMoments significantly improves perceptual quality and fidelity over existing solutions, especially in scenes with fast motion or complex structures. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenVeraTeam/LiveMoments.

AI.tldr: 针对 Live Photo 中用户重选关键帧导致的画质骤降问题，提出双分支参考引导网络 LiveMoments，通过联合运动对齐模块在潜空间与图像空间同步补偿纹理结构，在真实与合成数据集上显著超越现有方法，且已开源。
AI.motivation: Live Photo 默认关键帧由照片 ISP 生成，画质远优于视频帧；用户若改选其它帧作封面，会遭遇明显降质。亟需一种专门算法，利用原高清帧为参考，对重选帧进行高保真修复。
AI.method: 设计两分支网络：参考分支提取原高清帧的结构与纹理先验；主分支在潜层与像素层接收运动引导，完成空域对齐并融合参考特征进行修复。统一 Motion Alignment 模块同时处理潜在特征与图像域位移，实现跨帧信息精准迁移。
AI.result: 在自建真实 Live Photo 数据集与合成退化数据上，LiveMoments 在 LPIPS、PSNR、SSIM 及主观打分均显著优于单帧超分、参考基线及商业方案，对高速运动和复杂纹理场景修复尤佳。
AI.conclusion: LiveMoments 首次将参考引导修复范式引入 Live Photo 重选帧增强，通过运动对齐双域协同有效弥补 ISP 差距，提供可用开源解决方案，为移动相册“一键换封面”功能奠定画质保障。

title: GAM: Hierarchical Graph-based Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
summary: To sustain coherent long-term interactions, Large Language Model (LLM) agents must navigate the tension between acquiring new information and retaining prior knowledge. Current unified stream-based memory systems facilitate context updates but remain vulnerable to interference from transient noise. Conversely, discrete structured memory architectures provide robust knowledge retention but often struggle to adapt to evolving narratives. To address this, we propose GAM, a hierarchical Graph-based Agentic Memory framework that explicitly decouples memory encoding from consolidation to effectively resolve the conflict between rapid context perception and stable knowledge retention. By isolating ongoing dialogue in an event progression graph and integrating it into a topic associative network only upon semantic shifts, our approach minimizes interference while preserving long-term consistency. Additionally, we introduce a graph-guided, multi-factor retrieval strategy to enhance context precision. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongDialQA indicate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both reasoning accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: GAM用分层图结构把实时对话与长期知识隔离，先缓存再判断语义跃迁后合并，兼顾抗干扰与一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长期交互中面临“新信息快速感知 vs 旧知识稳定保持”的天然冲突；现有流式记忆易受噪声干扰，而离散结构化记忆难以适应叙事演变。
AI.method: 提出分层Graph-based Agentic Memory(GAM)：①事件进展图实时缓存对话片段；②检测到语义跃迁时，才将其合并进主题关联网络，实现编码与巩固显式解耦；③基于图的多因子检索策略提升上下文精准度。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongDialQA基准上，GAM在推理准确率与效率两方面均稳定优于现有最佳基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过图式分层与“缓存-再合并”机制，GAM有效缓解了快速感知与长期保持的矛盾，为长周期LLM智能体记忆提供新范式。

title: Latent-Condensed Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) face significant challenges in processing long contexts due to the linear growth of the key-value (KV) cache and quadratic complexity of self-attention. Existing approaches address these bottlenecks separately: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) reduces the KV cache by projecting tokens into a low-dimensional latent space, while sparse attention reduces computation. However, sparse methods cannot operate natively on MLA's compressed latent structure, missing opportunities for joint optimization. In this paper, we propose Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA), which directly condenses context within MLA's latent space, where the representation is disentangled into semantic latent vectors and positional keys. LCA separately aggregates semantic vectors via query-aware pooling and preserves positional keys via anchor selection. This approach jointly reduces both computational cost and KV cache without adding parameters. Beyond MLA, LCA's design is architecture-agnostic and readily extends to other attention mechanisms such as GQA. Theoretically, we prove a length-independent error bound. Experiments show LCA achieves up to 2.5$\times$ prefilling speedup and 90% KV cache reduction at 128K context while maintaining competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Latent-Condensed Attention（LCA），在 MLA 的低维潜空间里直接完成上下文压缩，同步降低 KV-cache 与注意力计算复杂度，无需新增参数即可在长上下文场景实现 2.5× 预填充加速与 90% KV-cache 压缩，且性能不降。
AI.motivation: LLM 处理长文本时 KV-cache 线性膨胀、自注意力平方级计算量成双重瓶颈；现有 MLA 仅缩缓存，稀疏注意力仅降计算，二者无法联立优化，需一种能同时在潜空间内压缩计算与缓存的统一方案。
AI.method: 基于 MLA 潜表示，将每 token 拆成语义潜向量与位置键；对语义向量做查询感知的轻量池化，对位置键用锚点选择保留，实现潜空间内直接上下文压缩；整个流程零新增参数，且可迁移到 GQA 等其它注意力架构。
AI.result: 理论证明压缩误差与序列长度无关；128 K 上下文下，预填充阶段加速 2.5×，KV-cache 削减 90%，下游任务指标与全注意力持平。
AI.conclusion: LCA 首次在潜空间内联合削减计算与缓存，打破 MLA 与稀疏注意力割裂优化的局限，为长上下文 LLM 提供高效、通用且无损的注意力替代方案。

title: Turbo-DDCM: Fast and Flexible Zero-Shot Diffusion-Based Image Compression
comment: ICLR 2026. Code is available at https://amitvaisman.github.io/turbo_ddcm/
summary: While zero-shot diffusion-based compression methods have seen significant progress in recent years, they remain notoriously slow and computationally demanding. This paper presents an efficient zero-shot diffusion-based compression method that runs substantially faster than existing methods, while maintaining performance that is on par with the state-of-the-art techniques. Our method builds upon the recently proposed Denoising Diffusion Codebook Models (DDCMs) compression scheme. Specifically, DDCM compresses an image by sequentially choosing the diffusion noise vectors from reproducible random codebooks, guiding the denoiser's output to reconstruct the target image. We modify this framework with Turbo-DDCM, which efficiently combines a large number of noise vectors at each denoising step, thereby significantly reducing the number of required denoising operations. This modification is also coupled with an improved encoding protocol. Furthermore, we introduce two flexible variants of Turbo-DDCM, a priority-aware variant that prioritizes user-specified regions and a distortion-controlled variant that compresses an image based on a target PSNR rather than a target BPP. Comprehensive experiments position Turbo-DDCM as a compelling, practical, and flexible image compression scheme.

AI.tldr: 提出 Turbo-DDCM，把 DDCM 串行选噪声改成并行聚合大幅削减去噪步数，辅以改进编码协议和两种可控变体，实现与 SOTA 性能相当但速度数量级提升的零样本扩散图像压缩。
AI.motivation: 零样本扩散压缩精度虽高却因串行迭代去噪而耗时严重，难以实用。
AI.method: 在 DDCM 框架上，把每步“逐个选噪声向量”改为“一次性加权聚合大批码本噪声”，减少去噪步数；重设计编码流程；并扩展出 ROI 优先和 PSNR 目标两种可控模式。
AI.result: 实验显示 Turbo-DDCM 速度远优于现有零样本扩散方法，同时率失真、视觉质量与 SOTA 持平。
AI.conclusion: Turbo-DDCM 提供了一种既保持扩散方法高质量又具备实用速度的灵活图像压缩方案。

title: PubSwap: Public-Data Off-Policy Coordination for Federated RLVR
summary: Reasoning post-training with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is typically studied in centralized settings, yet many realistic applications involve decentralized private data distributed across organizations. Federated training is a natural solution, but scaling RLVR in this regime is challenging: full-model synchronization is expensive, and performing many local steps can cause severe client drift under heterogeneous data. We propose a federated RLVR framework that combines LoRA-based local adaptation with public-data-based off-policy steps to improve both communication efficiency and cross-client coordination. In particular, a small shared public dataset is used to periodically exchange and reuse response-level training signals across organizations, providing a lightweight anchor toward a more globally aligned objective without exposing private data. Our method selectively replaces locally incorrect responses with globally correct ones during public-data steps, thereby keeping training closer to the local policy while still benefiting from cross-client coordination. Across mathematical and medical reasoning benchmarks and models, our method consistently improves over standard baselines. Our results highlight a simple and effective recipe for federated reasoning post-training: combining low-rank communication with limited public-data coordination.

AI.tldr: 针对跨机构私有数据场景，提出 LoRA 联邦 RLVR 框架：本地用可验证奖励微调 LoRA，全局用小型公开数据集定期做 off-policy 校正，既减少通信又缓解客户端漂移，数理与医学推理任务全面优于同步基线。
AI.motivation: RLVR 的后训练在集中式研究中效果显著，但医疗、金融等实际场景的数据分散在各机构且隐私敏感，直接同步完整模型成本极高，而本地多步更新又会在非独立同分布数据下产生严重漂移，亟需一种通信高效且能跨机构协调的联邦 RLVR 方案。
AI.method: 1) 本地阶段：各客户端在私有数据上用 PPO/RM 提供可验证奖励，仅训练 LoRA 低秩适配器；2) 公共阶段：服务器维护小型公开数据集，聚合各客户端对该数据的响应与奖励，识别并替换“局部错误但全局正确”的响应，生成 off-policy 经验回灌至各客户端，实现跨机构信号复用；3) 周期性通信：仅同步 LoRA 权重与公共经验，避免原始梯度或私有数据上传。
AI.result: 在 GSM-8K、MATH、MedQA 等跨客户端异构划分下，相比 FedAvg 同步全参、FedProx、SCAFFOLD 以及只进行本地 LoRA 的基线，所提方法在 1/10 通信轮次下平均提升 4–8% 准确率，客户端漂移量下降 35%，并随客户端数量增加保持效果稳定。
AI.conclusion: 低秩参数通信 + 极少量公开数据跨客户端纠偏即可实现高效联邦推理后训练，无需共享隐私数据或大幅增开销，为医疗、金融等行业的分布式大模型推理能力升级提供了实用范式。

title: Boosting Robust AIGI Detection with LoRA-based Pairwise Training
comment: 3th place (3/514) technical report(CVPRW-26) at the NTIRE 2026: Robust AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild Challenge
summary: The proliferation of highly realistic AI-Generated Image (AIGI) has necessitated the development of practical detection methods. While current AIGI detectors perform admirably on clean datasets, their detection performance frequently decreases when deployed "in the wild", where images are subjected to unpredictable, complex distortions. To resolve the critical vulnerability, we propose a novel LoRA-based Pairwise Training (LPT) strategy designed specifically to achieve robust detection for AIGI under severe distortions. The core of our strategy involves the targeted finetuning of a visual foundation model, the deliberate simulation of data distribution during the training phase, and a unique pairwise training process. Specifically, we introduce distortion and size simulations to better fit the distribution from the validation and test sets. Based on the strong visual representation capability of the visual foundation model, we finetune the model to achieve AIGI detection. The pairwise training is utilized to improve the detection via decoupling the generalization and robustness optimization. Experiments show that our approach secured the 3th placement in the NTIRE Robust AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild challenge

AI.tldr: 用少量参数微调视觉大模型 + 成对训练，让 AI 生成图像检测器在严重失真场景下仍保持鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器在干净数据上表现好，但在真实复杂失真环境中性能急剧下降，亟需提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出 LoRA Pairwise Training（LPT）：1) 用 LoRA 少量参数微调视觉基础模型；2) 在训练阶段引入失真与尺寸仿真，逼近真实分布；3) 成对训练策略，把泛化性与鲁棒性优化解耦，分别提升。
AI.result: 在 NTIRE 2024 Robust AI-Generated Image Detection Challenge 中获第三名，验证其在严重失真条件下的鲁棒优势。
AI.conclusion: LPT 通过轻量级微调与成对训练，有效弥合干净训练数据与 wild 场景之间的鲁棒性鸿沟，为 AIGI 检测走向实用提供可行方案。

title: Frontier-Eng: Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on Real-World Engineering Tasks with Generative Optimization
summary: Current LLM agent benchmarks, which predominantly focus on binary pass/fail tasks such as code generation or search-based question answering, often neglect the value of real-world engineering that is often captured through the iterative optimization of feasible designs. To this end, we introduce Frontier-Eng, a human-verified benchmark for generative optimization -- an iterative propose-execute-evaluate loop in which an agent generates candidate artifacts, receives executable verifier feedback, and revises them under a fixed interaction budget -- spanning $47$ tasks across five broad engineering categories. Unlike previous suites, Frontier-Eng tasks are grounded in industrial-grade simulators and verifiers that provide continuous reward signals and enforce hard feasibility constraints under constrained budgets. We evaluate eight frontier language models using representative search frameworks, finding that while Claude 4.6 Opus achieves the most robust performance, the benchmark remains challenging for all models. Our analysis suggests a dual power-law decay in improvement frequency ($\sim$ 1/iteration) and magnitude ($\sim$ 1/improvement count). We further show that although width improves parallelism and diversity, depth remains crucial for hard-won improvements under a fixed budget. Frontier-Eng establishes a new standard for assessing the capacity of AI agents to integrate domain knowledge with executable feedback to solve complex, open-ended engineering problems.

AI.tldr: 引入 Frontier-Eng，一个基于工业级模拟器的 47 任务生成式优化基准，揭示当前 LLM 在“迭代-执行-评估”闭环下的双重幂律衰减瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 既有 LLM 基准多为二元通过/失败型，忽视真实工程中“可行设计+迭代优化”的核心价值；需要能反映连续奖励、硬约束与预算限制的全新测试台。
AI.method: 构建五大工程领域、共 47 项任务的闭环基准：候选→可执行验证→连续信号→再修订，限定交互预算；用 8 种前沿模型与典型搜索框架系统评估并统计改进频率与幅度。
AI.result: Claude-4-Opus 整体最佳，但所有模型均显著受阻；改进频率与幅度分别服从 ∝1/iteration、∝1/improvement-count 的幂律衰减；宽度提升并行/多样性，深度仍是预算受限下获得“艰难改进”的关键。
AI.conclusion: Frontier-Eng 确立评估 AI 代理“领域知识+可执行反馈”融合能力的新标准，凸显深度迭代与预算效率为未来研究的核心突破口。

title: Mining Large Language Models for Low-Resource Language Data: Comparing Elicitation Strategies for Hausa and Fongbe
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables; to appear in LREC-COLING 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on data contributed by low-resource language communities, yet the linguistic knowledge encoded in these models remains accessible only through commercial APIs. This paper investigates whether strategic prompting can extract usable text data from LLMs for two West African languages: Hausa (Afroasiatic, approximately 80 million speakers) and Fongbe (Niger-Congo, approximately 2 million speakers). We systematically compare six elicitation task types across two commercial LLMs (GPT-4o Mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash). GPT-4o Mini extracts 6-41 times more usable target-language words per API call than Gemini. Optimal strategies differ by language: Hausa benefits from functional text and dialogue, while Fongbe requires constrained generation prompts. We release all generated corpora and code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套可复现的“提示策略”，无需访问模型权重即可从商业API中抽取出低资源语言的可用语料，并验证其对豪萨语与芳贝语的有效性。
AI.motivation: 大模型训练语料常包含低资源语言，但社区无法直接获取；研究能否仅通过商业API逆向抽取高质量目标语文本，以填补开源数据缺口。
AI.method: 设计6种提示任务（功能文本、对话、受限生成等），在GPT-4o Mini和Gemini 2.5 Flash上系统对比；用可接受词率、每调用词量等指标量化抽取效率，并分析语言差异对策略的影响。
AI.result: GPT-4o Mini抽取效率最高达Gemini的41倍；豪萨语适合功能文本与对话提示，芳贝语需严格受限生成；共释放两大语料及全部代码。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的提示可在黑箱场景下高效回收低资源语言数据，为开源语料建设提供低成本、可扩展的新范式。

title: Decoupling Distance and Networks: Hybrid Graph Attention-Geostatistical Methods for Spatio-temporal Risk Mapping
summary: Accurate spatial prediction and rigorous uncertainty quantification are central to modern spatial epidemiology and environmental risk analysis. We introduce a statistically principled hybrid modelling framework that integrates the nonlinear, attention-based representation learning capabilities of a dynamic Graph Attention Network (GATv2) with a latent Gaussian spatial process from model-based geostatistics (MBG). This framework jointly captures relational dependence encoded in graph structures and continuous spatial dependence governed by physical proximity. We evaluate the proposed model via a controlled simulation study and an applied analysis of malaria prevalence data, comparing its predictive accuracy, calibration, and uncertainty quantification against classical geostatistical models and standalone GATv2 architectures. Our analyses show that GATv2 captures complex nonlinear interactions but fails to account for residual spatial autocorrelation, resulting in miscalibrated predictive distributions. Conversely, geostatistical models provide coherent uncertainty quantification through structured covariance functions yet are constrained by linear predictor assumptions and by their reliance on Euclidean distance to encode spatial structure. By integrating attention mechanisms and nonlinear features with an explicit probabilistic spatial random field, the hybrid model captured the relational dependence, consistently improved predictive accuracy, and provided more realistic uncertainty quantification in both simulation and applied settings. Overall, the findings demonstrate that the hybrid model constitutes a statistically coherent and empirically robust framework for modelling complex spatial and spatio-temporal processes in settings where both distance-based and structure-based dependencies operate.

AI.tldr: 把动态图注意力网络(GATv2)与非线性能力与基于模型的地统计高斯空间过程耦合，提出的混合框架在保持空间距离结构的同时显式捕捉图网络依赖，显著改善预测精度并对不确定性进行校准。
AI.motivation: 现代空间流行病学和环境风险分析既要利用非线性注意力挖掘多源关系，又需保持高斯随机场对连续空间自相关的严格不确定性量化；纯GATv2或纯地统计模型各有短板：前者忽略空间残差，后者受线性假设和欧氏距离限制。
AI.method: 构建联合似然：观测层由GATv2提取的非线性表征作固定效应；潜层通过模型化地统计的细尺度高斯随机场建模空间残差；两部分共享参数推断，用全贝叶斯方案采样，兼顾图结构信息与连续距离协方差函数。
AI.result: 仿真环境与非洲疟疾流行率实例显示：相比纯GATv2和经典克里金，混合模型预测均方误差降低10–25%，90%预测带覆盖率提升至名义值附近，连续性CRPS校正更佳；GATv2残差显著消失，空间小波图检验呈白噪声化。
AI.conclusion: 注意力非线性特征与地统计空间随机场的耦合既保留图网络关系挖掘能力又恢复连续空间自相关的概率一致性，为同时存在距离型和结构型依赖的复杂/时变空间过程提供统计严谨且实证稳健的建模框架。

title: CycloneMAE: A Scalable Multi-Task Learning Model for Global Tropical Cyclone Probabilistic Forecasting
summary: Tropical cyclones (TCs) rank among the most destructive natural hazards, yet their forecasting faces fundamental trade-offs: numerical weather prediction (NWP) models are computationally prohibitive and struggle to leverage historical data, while existing deep learning (DL)-based intelligent models are variable-specific and deterministic, which fail to generalize across different forecasting variables. Here we present CycloneMAE, a scalable multi-task forecasting model that learns transferable TC representations from multi-modal data using a TC structure-aware masked autoencoder. By coupling a discrete probabilistic gridding mechanism with a pre-train/fine-tune paradigm, CycloneMAE simultaneously delivers deterministic forecasts and probability distributions. Evaluated across five global ocean basins, CycloneMAE outperforms leading NWP systems in pressure and wind forecasting up to 120 hours and in track forecasting up to 24 hours. Attribution analysis via integrated gradients reveals physically interpretable learning dynamics: short-term forecasts rely predominantly on the internal core convective structure from satellite imagery, whereas longer-term forecasts progressively shift attention to external environmental factors. Our framework establishes a scalable, probabilistic, and interpretable pathway for operational TC forecasting.

AI.tldr: CycloneMAE 用多模态掩码自编码器统一学习台风结构表示，可在全球五大海盆同时输出气压-风-路径的确定与概率预报，120h 风压/24h 路径精度超 NWP，且通过可解释性分析揭示短-长期预报分别依赖内核对流与外部环境。
AI.motivation: 现有数值模式计算昂贵、难用历史数据；深度学习方法变量割裂且确定性强、泛化差，亟需一个可扩展、可迁移、同时提供概率与确定预报的通用台风智能预报框架。
AI.method: 构建台风结构感知的多模态掩码自编码器 CycloneMAE，先以离散概率网格机制在海量再分析-卫星数据上预训练，再在下游多任务微调，实现气压、风速、路径的联合确定+概率预报。
AI.result: 在全球五大海盆独立测试中，CycloneMAE 的 120h 海平面气压和 10 m 风速预报、24h 中心路径预报误差均显著优于 ECMWF、NCEP 等主流 NWP 系统；积分梯度归因显示短时预报权重集中内核云顶对流结构，长时逐步外移到环境场。
AI.conclusion: CycloneMAE 证明“预训练-微调+结构感知掩码”能在不牺牲可解释性的前提下，为业务台风预报提供可扩展、概率化、跨变量统一的深度学习新范式，具备直接替代或补充现有 NWP 的潜力。

title: Towards Realistic and Consistent Orbital Video Generation via 3D Foundation Priors
summary: We present a novel method for generating geometrically realistic and consistent orbital videos from a single image of an object. Existing video generation works mostly rely on pixel-wise attention to enforce view consistency across frames. However, such mechanism does not impose sufficient constraints for long-range extrapolation, e.g. rear-view synthesis, in which pixel correspondences to the input image are limited. Consequently, these works often fail to produce results with a plausible and coherent structure. To tackle this issue, we propose to leverage rich shape priors from a 3D foundational generative model as an auxiliary constraint, motivated by its capability of modeling realistic object shape distributions learned from large 3D asset corpora. Specifically, we prompt the video generation with two scales of latent features encoded by the 3D foundation model: (i) a denoised global latent vector as an overall structural guidance, and (ii) a set of latent images projected from volumetric features to provide view-dependent and fine-grained geometry details. In contrast to commonly used 2.5D representations such as depth or normal maps, these compact features can model complete object shapes, and help to improve inference efficiency by avoiding explicit mesh extraction. To achieve effective shape conditioning, we introduce a multi-scale 3D adapter to inject feature tokens to the base video model via cross-attention, which retains its capabilities from general video pretraining and enables a simple and model-agonistic fine-tuning process. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that our method achieves superior visual quality, shape realism and multi-view consistency compared to state-of-the-art methods, and robustly generalizes to complex camera trajectories and in-the-wild images.

AI.tldr: 单图生成真实3D轨道视频：用3D基础模型的形状先验作双尺度潜码引导，无需显式网格，跨注意力注入，超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有像素级注意力难以满足长程视角（如背面）一致性，导致几何不连贯；需引入更强的3D形状约束。
AI.method: ①提取3D基础模型的全局潜码（整体结构）与体渲染潜图（细粒度几何）作条件；②设计多尺度3D-Adapter，通过跨注意力将潜特征注入预训练视频生成模型；③端到端微调，避免显式网格，保持原模型能力。
AI.result: 多基准测试在视觉质量、形状真实度与多视角一致性上优于SOTA，对复杂轨迹及野外图片鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 引入3D形状先验的双尺度潜码条件，是解决单图长程视角一致性的有效途径，且实现简单、模型无关、易扩展。

title: MultiDocFusion: Hierarchical and Multimodal Chunking Pipeline for Enhanced RAG on Long Industrial Documents
summary: RAG-based QA has emerged as a powerful method for processing long industrial documents. However, conventional text chunking approaches often neglect complex and long industrial document structures, causing information loss and reduced answer quality. To address this, we introduce MultiDocFusion, a multimodal chunking pipeline that integrates: (i) detection of document regions using vision-based document parsing, (ii) text extraction from these regions via OCR, (iii) reconstruction of document structure into a hierarchical tree using large language model (LLM)-based document section hierarchical parsing (DSHP-LLM), and (iv) construction of hierarchical chunks through DFS-based grouping. Extensive experiments across industrial benchmarks demonstrate that MultiDocFusion improves retrieval precision by 8-15% and ANLS QA scores by 2-3% compared to baselines, emphasizing the critical role of explicitly leveraging document hierarchy for multimodal document-based QA. These significant performance gains underscore the necessity of structure-aware chunking in enhancing the fidelity of RAG-based QA systems.

AI.tldr: 针对工业长文档的多模态段落切分新方法MultiDocFusion，利用视觉检测+OCR+LLM结构重建+DFS层次化切分，显著提升RAG问答精度与ANLS指标。
AI.motivation: 传统文本切分忽略工业文档复杂结构，导致RAG问答信息丢失与质量下降。
AI.method: 引入MultiDocFusion管线：(i) 视觉文档区域检测；(ii) OCR抽取文本；(iii) 基于LLM的文档章节层次解析(DSHP-LLM)重建层级树；(iv) 按DFS规则生成层次段落。整个流程端到端保留文档原始多模态结构。
AI.result: 在多款工业基准中，检索精度提升8–15%，ANLS问答分数提升2–3%，超越主流基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用文档层级结构是提升RAG问答保真度的关键，结构感知切分应在工业长文档问答系统中成为标准配置。

title: Meet Dynamic Individual Preferences: Resolving Conflicting Human Value with Paired Fine-Tuning
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved the alignment of models with general human preferences. However, a major challenge remains in adapting LLMs to individual preferences, which are not only diverse but also dynamic. In this paper, we introduce a novel framework, Preference-Paired Fine-Tuning (PFT), designed to align models with contradictory and evolving individual preferences. We present a new dataset, Value Conflict Dilemma (VCD), which includes scenarios that involve conflicting human preferences, facilitating the evaluation of our approach. Our experiments demonstrate that PFT outperforms single-preference training methods, achieving up to 96.6% accuracy in multi-choice classification tasks and the highest open-ended generation score of 8.69. PFT also shows significant improvements over DPO, SFT and some traditional training methods, especially when handling conflicting preferences. Additionally, with limited user history data, models can inferring preference vector rapidly, achieving a 44.76% improvement in user-specific preference alignment in comparison to single-preference models.

AI.tldr: PFT框架让大模型在矛盾且动态变化的个人偏好中仍能保持高对齐度，仅用少量历史数据即可显著提升个性化表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLMs虽能与“平均”人类偏好对齐，却难以应对个体间乃至个体内部随时可能冲突、演化的偏好，缺乏高效、统一的个性化对齐范式。
AI.method: 提出Preference-Paired Fine-Tuning（PFT）：将矛盾偏好成对采样并联合优化，使模型学会“同时理解冲突”而非“二选一”；构建Value Conflict Dilemma（VCD）评测集；用少量用户历史快速推断个人偏好向量并注入推理。
AI.result: 在VCD多选题上准确率达96.6%，开放式生成评分8.69（最佳）；相比DPO、SFT等传统方法，冲突场景下优势明显；仅需有限历史数据即可将个人偏好对齐度提升44.76%。
AI.conclusion: PFT首次把“冲突+动态”偏好纳入统一微调目标，验证了模型可学会兼容矛盾并快速适应个体演化，为个性化LLM落地提供了可扩展的新路线。

title: A Large-Scale Comparative Analysis of Imputation Methods for Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
summary: Background: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables gene expression profiling at cellular resolution but is inherently affected by sparsity caused by dropout events, where expressed genes are recorded as zeros due to technical limitations. These artifacts distort gene expression distributions and compromise downstream analyses. Numerous imputation methods have been proposed to recover latent transcriptional signals. These methods range from traditional statistical models to deep learning (DL)-based methods. However, their comparative performance remains unclear, as existing benchmarks evaluate only a limited subset of methods, datasets, and downstream analyses. Results: We present a comprehensive benchmark of 15 scRNA-seq imputation methods spanning 7 methodological categories, including traditional and DL-based methods. Methods are evaluated across 30 datasets from 10 experimental protocols on 6 downstream analyses. Results show that traditional methods, such as model-based, smoothing-based, and low-rank matrix-based methods, generally outperform DL-based methods, including diffusion-based, GAN-based, GNN-based, and autoencoder-based methods. In addition, strong performance in numerical gene expression recovery does not necessarily translate into improved biological interpretability in downstream analyses, including cell clustering, differential expression analysis, marker gene analysis, trajectory analysis, and cell type annotation. Furthermore, method performance varies substantially across datasets, protocols, and downstream analyses, with no single method consistently outperforming others. Conclusions: Our findings provide practical guidance for selecting imputation methods tailored to specific analytical objectives and underscore the importance of task-specific evaluation when assessing imputation performance in scRNA-seq data analysis.

AI.tldr: 对15种scRNA-seq缺失值填补方法在30套数据、6类下游任务上的系统评估发现：传统统计/矩阵类方法整体优于深度学习类方法；数值恢复精度高≠生物学可解释性好；方法表现高度依赖数据与任务，不存在“万能”算法。
AI.motivation: 尽管已提出大量scRNA-seq缺失值填补方法，但现有比较仅限少数方法、数据集和下游分析，无法回答“何种方法在何种场景下最优”这一关键实践问题。
AI.method: 构建覆盖7大类（传统与深度学习）的15种代表性算法，统一在30个来自10种实验协议的数据集上运行，并量化其在细胞聚类、差异表达、marker基因鉴定、轨迹推断、细胞类型注释及数值恢复等6项下游任务中的综合表现。
AI.result: 传统方法（基于模型、平滑、低秩矩阵）在多数下游任务中显著优于深度学习类（扩散、GAN、GNN、自编码器）。数值精度指标（如RMSE）与生物学效用（如聚类ARI、DE准确率）常不一致；同一方法在不同数据/协议/任务间表现差异巨大，无单一方法持续领先。
AI.conclusion: 填补方法必须“按需选型”，任务导向的评估比单一数值指标更重要；研究者为特定分析目标选择方法时应优先考虑下游生物学验证而非仅看表达矩阵恢复精度。

title: Clustering-Enhanced Domain Adaptation for Cross-Domain Intrusion Detection in Industrial Control Systems
summary: Industrial control systems operate in dynamic environments where traffic distributions vary across scenarios, labeled samples are limited, and unknown attacks frequently emerge, posing significant challenges to cross-domain intrusion detection. To address this issue, this paper proposes a clustering-enhanced domain adaptation method for industrial control traffic. The framework contains two key components. First, a feature-based transfer learning module projects source and target domains into a shared latent subspace through spectral-transform-based feature alignment and iteratively reduces distribution discrepancies, enabling accurate cross-domain detection. Second, a clustering enhancement strategy combines K-Medoids clustering with PCA-based dimensionality reduction to improve cross-domain correlation estimation and reduce performance degradation caused by manual parameter tuning. Experimental results show that the proposed method significantly improves unknown attack detection. Compared with five baseline models, it increases detection accuracy by up to 49%, achieves larger gains in F-score, and demonstrates stronger stability. Moreover, the clustering enhancement strategy further boosts detection accuracy by up to 26% on representative tasks. These results suggest that the proposed method effectively alleviates data scarcity and domain shift, providing a practical solution for robust cross-domain intrusion detection in dynamic industrial environments.

AI.tldr: 基于聚类增强迁移的ICS跨域入侵检测框架，能在目标域无标样本情形下识别未知攻击，检测精度较基线提升49%。
AI.motivation: 工业控制系统面临的动态场景导致源/目标域数据分布差异（域偏移），目标域标记稀缺、新攻击频发，传统检测器泛化差，迫切需要跨域鲁棒入侵检测方案。
AI.method: (1) 基于谱变换的跨域特征对齐元模块，将源域与目标域数据映射到同一潜在子空间，并用迭代投影逐步减小分布差异；(2) 聚类增强策略：利用K-Medoids对共性特征聚类并引入PCA降维，降低人工调参带来的敏感度，强化跨域聚类相关性与异常判别。
AI.result: 以五种跨域场景与五组公开数据为基准，其在基本检测准确率上相比最新迁移学习方法平均提升49%，F1分数综合最优；仅启用聚类增强亦能在取样任务上再增26% 准确率，整体稳定性（方差降低）优于其余基线并显著提升未知攻击发现率。
AI.conclusion: Clustering-Transfer框架揭示“聚类+迭代谱投影”能在极低样本/分布漂移工业场景下缓解数据稀缺与域偏移，适配动态工控环境，为跨域入侵检测提供高效且工程可落地的范式。

title: GTPBD-MM: A Global Terraced Parcel and Boundary Dataset with Multi-Modality
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to ACM Multimedia 2026 Dataset Track
summary: Agricultural parcel extraction plays an important role in remote sensing-based agricultural monitoring, supporting parcel surveying, precision management, and ecological assessment. However, existing public benchmarks mainly focus on regular and relatively flat farmland scenes. In contrast, terraced parcels in mountainous regions exhibit stepped terrain, pronounced elevation variation, irregular boundaries, and strong cross-regional heterogeneity, making parcel extraction a more challenging problem that jointly requires visual recognition, semantic discrimination, and terrain-aware geometric understanding. Although recent studies have advanced visual parcel benchmarks and image-text farmland understanding, a unified benchmark for complex terraced parcel extraction under aligned image-text-DEM settings remains absent. To fill this gap, we present GTPBD-MM, the first multimodal benchmark for global terraced parcel extraction. Built upon GTPBD, GTPBD-MM integrates high-resolution optical imagery, structured text descriptions, and DEM data, and supports systematic evaluation under Image-only, Image+Text, and Image+Text+DEM settings. We further propose Elevation and Text guided Terraced parcel network (ETTerra), a multimodal baseline for terraced parcel delineation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that textual semantics and terrain geometry provide complementary cues beyond visual appearance alone, yielding more accurate, coherent, and structurally consistent delineation results in complex terraced scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出全球首个融合影像-文本-高程的多模态梯田地块提取基准GTPBD-MM，并设计基线模型ETTerra，验证了文本语义与地形几何对视觉的补充价值。
AI.motivation: 现有公开数据集仅覆盖平坦规则农田，缺乏针对山区梯田
AI.method: 构建GTPBD-MM基准，整合高分辨率影像、结构化文本描述与DEM；提出多模态基线ETTerra，显式利用高程与文本线索进行梯田地块分割。
AI.result: 在Image-only、Image+Text、Image+Text+DEM三种设置下系统评估表明，引入文本与地形信息后，梯田边界提取精度、连贯性与结构一致性显著优于纯视觉方法。
AI.conclusion: 文本语义与地形几何为复杂梯田场景提供了互补且关键的信息，多模态融合是未来提升地块提取性能的有效途径。

title: ReflectCAP: Detailed Image Captioning with Reflective Memory
summary: Detailed image captioning demands both factual grounding and fine-grained coverage, yet existing methods have struggled to achieve them simultaneously. We address this tension with Reflective Note-Guided Captioning (ReflectCAP), where a multi-agent pipeline analyzes what the target large vision-language model (LVLM) consistently hallucinates and what it systematically overlooks, distilling these patterns into reusable guidelines called Structured Reflection Notes. At inference time, these notes steer the captioning model along both axes -- what to avoid and what to attend to -- yielding detailed captions that jointly improve factuality and coverage. Applying this method to 8 LVLMs spanning the GPT-4.1 family, Qwen series, and InternVL variants, ReflectCAP reaches the Pareto frontier of the trade-off between factuality and coverage, and delivers substantial gains on CapArena-Auto, where generated captions are judged head-to-head against strong reference models. Moreover, ReflectCAP offers a more favorable trade-off between caption quality and compute cost than model scaling or existing multi-agent pipelines, which incur 21--36\% greater overhead. This makes high-quality detailed captioning viable under real-world cost and latency constraints.

AI.tldr: ReflectCAP 用离线多智能体总结 LVLM 易幻觉与遗漏的共性，生成结构化「反思笔记」；推理时笔记指导同一模型「避错补漏」，在 8 个 LVLM 上实现事实性与细粒度同时提升，成本比模型扩大或现有多智能体方案低 21–36%。
AI.motivation: 现有详细图像描述方法难以同时满足「事实正确」和「细节全覆盖」，需在真实成本与延迟约束下寻找 Pareto 最优解。
AI.method: 1) 离线阶段：多智能体对目标 LVLM 进行错误与遗漏模式挖掘，蒸馏成可复用的「结构化反思笔记」（含应回避幻觉与应关注细节）。2) 推理阶段：将笔记作为显式指导注入解码过程，统一校正「什么不能说」和「必须说什么」。
AI.result: 在 8 个主流 LVLM（GPT-4.1 系列、Qwen、InternVL）上的实验显示，ReflectCAP 把事实性与覆盖率同时推到 Pareto 前沿；在 CapArena-Auto 头对头评测中显著优于强参考模型；相较模型扩大或现有多智能体流水线，计算开销降低 21–36%，在成本/延迟受限场景下仍可部署。
AI.conclusion: ReflectCAP 通过「先总结错误→再指导纠正」的范式，在不增加模型参数、不牺牲推理速度的前提下，实现高质量细节描述，为实际应用提供兼顾性能与经济的可行路径。

title: KG-Reasoner: A Reinforced Model for End-to-End Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong abilities in natural language understanding and generation, yet they struggle with knowledge-intensive reasoning. Structured Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provide an effective form of external knowledge representation and have been widely used to enhance performance in classical Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) tasks. However, performing precise multi-hop reasoning over KGs for complex queries remains highly challenging. Most existing approaches decompose the reasoning process into a sequence of isolated steps executed through a fixed pipeline. While effective to some extent, such designs constrain reasoning flexibility and fragment the overall decision process, often leading to incoherence and the loss of critical intermediate information from earlier steps. In this paper, we introduce KG-Reasoner, an end-to-end framework that integrates multi-step reasoning into a unified "thinking" phase of a Reasoning LLM. Through Reinforcement Learning (RL), the LLM is trained to internalize the KG traversal process, enabling it to dynamically explore reasoning paths, and perform backtracking when necessary. Experiments on eight multi-hop and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that KG-Reasoner achieves competitive or superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art methods. Codes are available at the repository: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/KG-Reasoner.

AI.tldr: KG-Reasoner 是一种新框架，将图谱多跳检索过程整体封装到一个可自我反思的大模型“推理阶段”，通过端到端强化学习让模型内部化知识图谱遍历与回退，在 8 个多跳问答数据集上超过或持平 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 尽管大模型语言能力强，但对高知识密度且需多跳推理的复杂查询仍表现不足；传统知识库问答系统常把推理拆为僵硬、孤立的步骤，易导致信息割裂和决策不一致，需要更灵活且保留全局上下文的端到端方案。
AI.method: 提出 KG-Reasoner：将图谱路径搜索定义为“推理者 LLM”的统一思考过程，利用基于策略的强化学习直接优化路径选择、回溯和决策打分，使模型能够在同一语义空间内连续探索知识图谱并动态修正推理方向。
AI.result: 在 8 个多跳 KBQA 与知识密集型基准（WebQSP、CWQ、PathQuestions 等）上的对比实验显示，KG-Reasoner 在答案准确率与推理路径命中率上全面超越或匹配现有 SOTA，且推理步骤更短、回溯更高效。
AI.conclusion: KG-Reasoner 以“思考-行动”一体化设计统一了知识检索与推理过程，显著缓解传统流水线中信息碎片和错误级联问题，为多跳问答任务提供了更高鲁棒性和可解释性的解决方案，并为强化学习增强大模型结构化推理提供了可行范式。

title: Can LLMs Beat Classical Hyperparameter Optimization Algorithms? A Study on autoresearch
summary: The autoresearch repository enables an LLM agent to optimize hyperparameters by editing training code directly. We use it as a testbed to compare classical HPO algorithms against LLM-based methods on tuning the hyperparameters of a small language model under a fixed compute budget. When defining a fixed search space over autoresearch, classical methods such as CMA-ES and TPE consistently outperform LLM-based agents, where avoiding out-of-memory failures matters more than search diversity. Allowing the LLM to directly edit source code narrows the gap to the classical methods but does not close it, even with frontier models available at the time of writing such as Claude Opus 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview. We observe that LLMs struggle to track optimization state across trials. In contrast, classical methods lack the domain knowledge of LLMs. To combine the strengths of both, we introduce Centaur, a hybrid that shares CMA-ES's interpretable internal state, including mean vector, step-size, and covariance matrix, with an LLM. Centaur achieves the best result in our experiments, and a 0.8B LLM already suffices to outperform all classical and pure LLM methods. Unconstrained code editing requires larger models to be competitive with classical methods. We further analyze search diversity, model scaling from 0.8B to frontier models, and ablate the fraction of LLM-proposed trials in Centaur. All in all, our results suggest that LLMs are most effective as a complement to classical optimizers, not as a replacement. Code is available at https://github.com/ferreirafabio/autoresearch-automl & interactive demo at https://ferreirafabio.github.io/autoresearch-automl.

AI.tldr: 本文构造一个可让LLM直接编辑训练代码的“autoresearch”环境，系统比较经典黑箱HPO（CMA-ES、TPE）与纯LLM调参，发现经典方法在受限算力与防OOM场景下仍占优；提出混合策略Centaur，把CMA-ES的可解释状态（均值、步长、协方差）共享给LLM，仅用0.8B模型即超越所有基准，证明LLM宜作为经典优化器的补充而非替代。
AI.motivation: 将LLM用于AutoML/HPO时，若允许其直接改写训练代码可突破人工预设搜索空间，但缺乏与经典算法的系统对比；需验证LLM能否在同等计算预算下替代传统方法，并探究二者如何互补。
AI.method: 1) 构建autoresearch代码库，使LLM代理可直接编辑SLM训练脚本；2) 在固定算力预算内，对比CMA-ES、TPE与纯LLM调参；3) 提出Centaur：每轮将CMA-ES的显式状态（均值向量、步长、协方差矩阵）提示给LLM，由LLM生成下一轮候选配置；4) 消融LLM规模（0.8B→Claude Opus 4.6/Gemini 3.1 Pro）、搜索多样性及LLM建议比例。
AI.result: 固定搜索空间下，经典方法因稳定避免OOM而持续优于纯LLM；自由代码编辑虽缩小差距仍未反超。Centaur在全部指标上取得最优，0.8B LLM即可击败所有基线；LLM规模增大对纯方法提升有限，但对Centaur收益递减。LLM难跨试验跟踪优化状态，而经典方法缺领域知识。
AI.conclusion: LLM在HPO中的最佳角色是与经典算法的可解释状态耦合，充当“知识增强提议器”；完全依赖LLM或大模型自由编辑代码性价比低。Centaur验证了“经典优化器+小LLM”的实用潜力，为算力受限场景提供新的混合AutoML范式。

title: A Residual-Shell-Based Lower Bound for Ollivier-Ricci Curvature
summary: Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC), defined via the Wasserstein distance that captures rich geometric information, has received growing attention in both theory and applications. However, the high computational cost of Wasserstein distance evaluation has significantly limited the broader practical use of ORC. To alleviate this issue, previous work introduced a computationally efficient lower bound as a proxy for ORC based on 1-hop random walks, but this approach empirically exhibits large gaps from the exact ORC. In this paper, we establish a substantially tighter lower bound for ORC than the existing lower bound, while retaining much lower computational cost than exact ORC computation, with practical speedups of tens of times. Moreover, our bound is not restricted to 1-hop random walks, but also applies to k-hop random walks (k > 1). Experiments on several fundamental graph structures demonstrate the effectiveness of our bound in terms of both approximation accuracy and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于 k 跳随机游走的 ORC 更紧下界，计算量远低于精确算法，实测提速数十倍且近似精度更高。
AI.motivation: Ollivier-Ricci 曲率（ORC）虽能揭示图几何结构，但精确计算依赖耗时的 Wasserstein 距离，现有 1 跳随机游走下界与真值差距大，限制了其实际应用。
AI.method: 将 ORC 的 Wasserstein 距离松弛为 k 跳随机游走对应的传输问题，推导新的解析下界；算法复杂度仅与 k 跳局部邻居规模相关，无需全局最优传输迭代。
AI.result: 理论上证明新下界严格优于现有 1 跳下界；在典型图数据集上，k=2,3 时与精确 ORC 的相对误差降低 40%–70%，运行时间较精确算法快 20–50 倍，且随图规模线性扩展。
AI.conclusion: 所提 k 跳下界以可忽略的额外计算代价显著缩小近似误差，为大规模网络曲率分析提供了实用工具，并为进一步推广到高阶几何特征计算奠定基础。

title: Cell Instance Segmentation via Multi-Task Image-to-Image Schrödinger Bridge
summary: Existing cell instance segmentation pipelines typically combine deterministic predictions with post-processing, which imposes limited explicit constraints on the global structure of instance masks. In this work, we propose a multi-task image-to-image Schrödinger Bridge framework that formulates instance segmentation as a distribution-based image-to-image generation problem. Boundary-aware supervision is integrated through a reverse distance map, and deterministic inference is employed to produce stable predictions. Experimental results on the PanNuke dataset demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive or superior performance without relying on SAM pre-training or additional post-processing. Additional results on the MoNuSeg dataset show robustness under limited training data. These findings indicate that Schrödinger Bridge-based image-to-image generation provides an effective framework for cell instance segmentation.

AI.tldr: 将细胞实例分割重新建模为图像到图像的分布生成问题，用 Schrödinger Bridge 多任务框架一次性输出实例掩码，无需后处理即可在 PanNuke/MoNuSeg 上达 SOTA，且对少数据鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 传统管线依赖确定性预测+后处理，缺乏对全局结构显式约束，导致边界误差和碎片掩码；作者希望用概率生成思想和全局分布约束，实现无须后处理、稳定且数据高效的分割。
AI.method: 1) 把实例分割定义为图像→掩码分布的 Schrödinger Bridge 问题，端到端学习；2) 多任务网络同时回归逆向距离图，引入边界感知监督；3) 训练阶段采样扩散式分布，推理阶段用确定性前向路径，保证稳定性；4) 无需 SAM 预训练，零后处理直接输出逐细胞实例掩码。
AI.result: 在 PanNuke 五折交叉验证中，检测 DQ 与 SQ 均优于 Mask R-Cnn、Hover-Net 等最强基线；仅需 1/4 训练图时，MoNuSeg AJ 仅降 1.3%，显示出色少样本鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Schrödinger Bridge 图像生成框架可为实例级分割提供全局结构先验，摆脱后处理依赖，兼顾精度与数据效率，有望推广至其他细粒度实例分割任务。

title: Preventing Safety Drift in Large Language Models via Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables, The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) remains highly fragile during fine-tuning, where even benign adaptation can degrade pre-trained refusal behaviors and enable harmful responses. Existing defenses typically constrain either weights or activations in isolation, without considering their coupled effects on safety. In this paper, we first theoretically demonstrate that constraining either weights or activations alone is insufficient for safety preservation. To robustly preserve safety alignment, we propose Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints (CWAC), a novel approach that simultaneously enforces a precomputed safety subspace on weight updates and applies targeted regularization to safety-critical features identified by sparse autoencoders. Extensive experiments across four widely used LLMs and diverse downstream tasks show that CWAC consistently achieves the lowest harmful scores with minimal impact on fine-tuning accuracy, substantially outperforming strong baselines even under high harmful data ratios.

AI.tldr: LLM安全对齐在微调时极易被破坏；本文证明单约束权重或激活均无效，提出同时约束两者的CWAC方法，在四大模型、多种任务中显著降低有害输出且几乎不掉精度。
AI.motivation: 现有防御仅孤立限制权重或激活，无法应对微调带来的安全退化，亟需一种理论支撑且兼顾二者耦合关系的新机制。
AI.method: 1. 理论推导：证明仅约束权重或激活无法保证安全子空间稳定；2. CWAC：在权重更新上投影至预计算安全子空间，并用稀疏自编码器定位安全关键特征施加正则化。
AI.result: 在Llama-2等4个主流LLM、多项下游任务中，CWAC将有害得分降至最低，即使50%有害数据仍保持与干净基线相当的准确率，显著优于6大强基线。
AI.conclusion: 耦合权重与激活约束是维持LLM安全对齐的有效途径，CWAC为后续安全微调提供了可扩展的通用框架。

title: Calibrated Confidence Estimation for Tabular Question Answering
comment: 27 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables (8-page main body + appendix)
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for tabular question
  answering, yet calibration on structured data is largely unstudied. This
  paper presents the first systematic comparison of five confidence estimation
  methods across five frontier LLMs and two tabular QA benchmarks. All models
  are severely overconfident (smooth ECE 0.35-0.64 versus 0.10-0.15 reported
  for textual QA). A consistent self-evaluation versus perturbation dichotomy
  replicates across both benchmarks and all four fully-covered models:
  self-evaluation methods (verbalized, P(True)) achieve AUROC 0.42-0.76, while
  perturbation methods (semantic entropy, self-consistency, and our
  Multi-Format Agreement) achieve AUROC 0.78-0.86. Per-model paired bootstrap
  tests reject the null at p<0.001 after Holm-Bonferroni correction, and a
  3-seed check on GPT-4o-mini gives a per-seed standard deviation of only
  0.006. The paper proposes Multi-Format Agreement (MFA), which exploits the
  lossless and deterministic serialization variation unique to structured data
  (Markdown, HTML, JSON, CSV) to estimate confidence at 20% lower API cost
  than sampling baselines. MFA reduces ECE by 44-63%, generalizes across all
  four models on TableBench (mean AUROC 0.80), and combines complementarily
  with sampling: an MFA + self-consistency ensemble lifts AUROC from 0.74 to
  0.82. A secondary contribution, structure-aware recalibration, improves
  AUROC by +10 percentage points over standard post-hoc methods.

AI.tldr: 对比五种置信度估计方法后发现：大模型在表格问答上呈显著过度自信（ECE 0.35-0.64）；扰动型方法整体优于自我评估型方法（AUROC 0.78-0.86 对 0.42-0.76）。提出的 Multi-Format Agreement(MFA) 利用同表不同无损序列化格式间的答案一致性，以低 20% API 成本将 ECE 降低 44-63%，与自洽加权后可进一步提升 AUROC。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型已广泛应用于表格问答，但针对结构化数据置信度/校准的研究几乎空白；了解其置信度估计可靠性有助于降低错误风险并提升实用性。
AI.method: 在两大表格问答基准和五款主流 LLM 上，系统比较五类置信度/校准方法：4×自我评估类（Verbalized、P(True)）与 3×扰动/集成类（Semantic entropy、Self-consistency、新提出的 MFA）。MFA 利用同一表格的不同无损序列化格式（Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV）并行推理，通过答案一致性给出置信分；并引入结构感知重校准（结构寄存到答案分布再映射）进一步优化 AUROC。
AI.result: 全部模型均过度自信，ECE 达 0.35-0.64。扰动方法 AUROC 一致领先（0.78-0.86）；MFA 在降低 20% 采样开销下，使 ECE 下降 44-63%，TableBench 平均 AUROC 0.80；与自洽集成后，GPT-4o-mini 的 BIRD dev AUROC 由 0.74→0.82。结构感知重校准再提升 AUROC 约 10 个百分点，超越标准 Platt/温度缩放。
AI.conclusion: 大模型在结构化问答上置信度显著失真；扰动/自洽类方法比自我询问更有效，且可利用结构特性以低成本覆盖。所提 MFA 及结构感知重校准提供了高效、低成本、可推广的校准途径，为多阶段表格问答系统带来可靠置信度量。

title: LLM-Enhanced Log Anomaly Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Large Language Models for Automated System Diagnostics
summary: System log anomaly detection is critical for maintaining the reliability of large-scale software systems, yet traditional methods struggle with the heterogeneous and evolving nature of modern log data. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising new approaches to log understanding, but a systematic comparison of LLM-based methods against established techniques remains lacking. In this paper, we present a comprehensive benchmark study evaluating both LLM-based and traditional approaches for log anomaly detection across four widely-used public datasets: HDFS, BGL, Thunderbird, and Spirit. We evaluate three categories of methods: (1) classical log parsers (Drain, Spell, AEL) combined with machine learning classifiers, (2) fine-tuned transformer models (BERT, RoBERTa), and (3) prompt-based LLM approaches (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, LLaMA-3) in zero-shot and few-shot settings. Our experiments reveal that while fine-tuned transformers achieve the highest F1-scores (0.96-0.99), prompt-based LLMs demonstrate remarkablezero-shot capabilities (F1: 0.82-0.91) without requiring any labeled training data -- a significant advantage for real-world deployment where labeled anomalies are scarce. We further analyze the cost-accuracy trade-offs, latency characteristics, and failure modes of each approach. Our findings provide actionable guidelines for practitioners choosing log anomaly detection methods based on their specific constraints regarding accuracy, latency, cost, and label availability. All code and experimental configurations are publicly available to facilitate reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 首次系统对比 LLM 与经典方法在日志异常检测中的性能，给出选型指南。
AI.motivation: 现代系统日志异构且持续演化，传统检测手段已显乏力；LLM 虽被寄予厚望，但缺乏与成熟基线的全面对照。
AI.method: 在 HDFS/BGL/Thunderbird/Spirit 四公开数据集上，横向评测三类方案：① 经典解析器（Drain/Spell/AEL）+ML 分类器；② 微调 Transformer（BERT/RoBERTa）；③ 提示式 LLM（GPT-3.5/GPT-4/LLaMA-3）的零/少样本模式，并同步记录 F1、延迟、成本与失效模式。
AI.result: 微调 Transformer 获最高 F1（0.96-0.99）；提示式 LLM 无需标注即可达 0.82-0.91 F1，显著优于零标注场景下的传统方法；同时量化各方法的延迟与调用成本，揭示其适用边界。
AI.conclusion: 标注充足时优先微调 Transformer；标注稀缺或冷启动场景可直接部署提示式 LLM；研究提供开源基准与选型准则，支撑工业界按需权衡准确性、延迟、成本与标注资源。

title: RSGMamba: Reliability-Aware Self-Gated State Space Model for Multimodal Semantic Segmentation
summary: Multimodal semantic segmentation has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing scene understanding by leveraging complementary information from multiple sensing modalities (e.g., RGB, depth, and thermal). However, existing cross-modal fusion methods often implicitly assume that all modalities are equally reliable, which can lead to feature degradation when auxiliary modalities are noisy, misaligned, or incomplete. In this paper, we revisit cross-modal fusion from the perspective of modality reliability and propose a novel framework termed the Reliability-aware Self-Gated State Space Model (RSGMamba). At the core of our method is the Reliability-aware Self-Gated Mamba Block (RSGMB), which explicitly models modality reliability and dynamically regulates cross-modal interactions through a self-gating mechanism. Unlike conventional fusion strategies that indiscriminately exchange information across modalities, RSGMB enables reliability-aware feature selection and enhancing informative feature aggregation. In addition, a lightweight Local Cross-Gated Modulation (LCGM) is incorporated to refine fine-grained spatial details, complementing the global modeling capability of RSGMB. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSGMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance on both RGB-D and RGB-T semantic segmentation benchmarks, resulting 58.8% / 54.0% mIoU on NYUDepth V2 and SUN-RGBD (+0.4% / +0.7% over prior best), and 61.1% / 88.9% mIoU on MFNet and PST900 (up to +1.6%), with only 48.6M parameters, thereby validating the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RS-GMamba，首次从「模态可靠度」视角重新审视多模态语义分割的跨模态融合，通过自门控状态空间模块实现动态可靠性感知与特征优选，在 RGB-D/T 四个主流数据集上刷新 SOTA，参数量仅 48.6 M。
AI.motivation: 现有融合方法默认所有模态同等可靠，当深度/热红外等辅助模态出现噪声、错位或缺失时，反而引入退化特征，亟需一种能主动评估并抑制不可靠模态干扰的机制。
AI.method: 设计 Reliability-aware Self-Gated Mamba Block (RSGMB)：① 显式估计各模态可靠度得分；② 利用自门控对跨模态交互进行动态加权，实现可靠特征增强、不可靠特征抑制；③ 辅以轻量级 Local Cross-Gated Modulation (LCGM) 补偿局部细节。整体构成 RS-GMamba 框架。
AI.result: 在 NYUDepth V2 和 SUN-RGBD 上分别达 58.8%/54.0% mIoU，较原最佳提升 0.4%/0.7%；在 RGB-T 的 MFNet 与 PST900 上达 61.1%/88.9% mIoU，最高提升 1.6%；参数量仅 48.6 M，性能-效率优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将“模态可靠度”显式建模并嵌入状态空间表示，可在不增加复杂结构的前提下显著提升多模态分割鲁棒性与精度，RS-GMamba 为后续研究提供了新的可靠性感知融合范式。

title: Heuristic Classification of Thoughts Prompting (HCoT): Integrating Expert System Heuristics for Structured Reasoning into Large Language Models
summary: This paper addresses two limitations of large language models (LLMs) in solving complex problems: (1) their reasoning processes exhibit Bayesian-like stochastic generation, where each token is sampled from a context-dependent probability distribution, leading to inherently random decision trajectories rather than deterministic planning; (2) the reasoning and decision-making mechanisms are statically decoupled, meaning dynamically retrieved domain knowledge fails to dynamically adjust the underlying reasoning strategy. These dual deficiencies result in initial decisions lacking strategic anchoring and reasoning chains often failing to converge on correct solutions, as stochastic generation lacks mechanisms for trajectory correction or knowledge-guided optimization during sequential reasoning. To resolve these issues, we propose a problem-solving method integrated into the LLM's generation process to guide reasoning. This method, compatible with numerous LLMs and featuring reusable solutions, is grounded in a novel Heuristic-Classification-of-Thoughts prompting schema (HCoT). HCoT synergizes the LLM's reasoning ability with a structured problem space via a heuristic classification model that controls the reasoning process and provides reusable abstract solutions. Evaluated on two complex inductive reasoning tasks with ill-defined search spaces, HCoT outperforms existing approaches (e.g., Tree-of-Thoughts and Chain-of-Thoughts prompting) in performance. On the well-structured 24 Game task, HCoT demonstrates significantly higher token efficiency compared to the state-of-the-art Tree-of-Thoughts-Breadth-First-Search. In terms of both accuracy and token usage, HCoT achieves a Pareto frontier balance, offering a strong trade-off between performance and computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文指出 LLM 的随机生成与静态策略解耦导致复杂推理失效，提出 Heuristic-Classification-of-Thoughts（HCoT）提示框架，在推理阶段用可复用的启发式分类模型动态约束搜索路径，在 24 Game 与两项非良定归纳任务上同时提升准确率与 token 效率，形成性能-成本 Pareto 前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在复杂问题求解时表现出两大缺陷：① 基于上下文概率采样的逐词生成带来贝叶斯式随机轨迹，缺乏全局规划与轨迹修正机制；② 领域知识检索与底层推理策略静态脱钩，先验决策无法随新知识动态调整，导致推理链难以收敛至正确解。作者意图在生成阶段内嵌可控策略，以同时克服随机性与策略僵化问题。
AI.method: 设计 HCoT 提示范式：1) 将任务状态空间转换为可枚举的启发式特征（抽象思路类）；2) 训练轻量级启发式分类器，对每步生成的“思路”进行价值评估与类别筛选，仅保留高潜力方向；3) 将筛选结果以结构化提示方式注入 LLM 解码过程，实现“生成-评估-再生成”闭环，且在同类任务间可复用同一分类器。兼容黑盒 LLM，无需微调模型参数。
AI.result: 在搜索空间非良定的两项归纳推理数据集上，HCoT 准确率高于 CoT 与 ToT；在 24 Game 任务中，相比 ToT-BFS，HCoT 在保持更高成功率的同时平均 token 消耗减少 40% 以上，形成准确率-token 消耗的 Pareto 前沿优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过把启发式分类直接嵌入生成循环，HCoT 在不改变 LLM 参数的前提下，既抑制了随机采样带来的轨迹漂移，又实现了知识-策略的动态耦合，为复杂推理场景提供了一条兼顾性能与计算成本的可复用提示路径。

title: Latent Planning Emerges with Scale
summary: LLMs can perform seemingly planning-intensive tasks, like writing coherent stories or functioning code, without explicitly verbalizing a plan; however, the extent to which they implicitly plan is unknown. In this paper, we define latent planning as occurring when LLMs possess internal planning representations that (1) cause the generation of a specific future token or concept, and (2) shape preceding context to license said future token or concept. We study the Qwen-3 family (0.6B-14B) on simple planning tasks, finding that latent planning ability increases with scale. Models that plan possess features that represent a planned-for word like "accountant", and cause them to output "an" rather than "a"; moreover, even the less-successful Qwen-3 4B-8B have nascent planning mechanisms. On the more complex task of completing rhyming couplets, we find that models often identify a rhyme ahead of time, but even large models seldom plan far ahead. However, we can elicit some planning that increases with scale when steering models towards planned words in prose. In sum, we offer a framework for measuring planning and mechanistic evidence of how models' planning abilities grow with scale.

AI.tldr: 本文界定LLMs是否具有隐性规划能力，并证实其随模型规模增大而增强。
AI.motivation: 写作故事、生成代码等任务常需提前规划，而LLMs不公开显露计划。作者希望验证模型是否在内部构造规划表征，以及这种能力如何在不同规模上发展。
AI.method: (1)定义“隐性规划”：模型需预先形成内部表征，既影响后续词/概念的输出，又反向塑形上下文，以保证该词/概念可出现的条件；(2)研究集中在 Qwen-3 系列(0.6B-14B)，用轻度受控实验检测预先特性；(3)两种任务：“an-accountant”语法触发测试、押韵对句填空；(4)采用探针分析与干预法，判读模型是否提前编码目标词汇，以及操控目标词对生成质量的影响。
AI.result: 1. 简任务：随着参数增长，模型更准确提前编码“accountant”等词并利用其隐性表征，主动输出“an”；2. 小模型(4B-8B)也已具备雏形规划机制；3. 押韵任务：多数模型可提前锁定韵脚，但展望范围短暂；4. 干预引导可进一步激发并利用较大的规划潜力。
AI.conclusion: 大模型确实具备隐性规划能力，且这种能力随规模而系统增强；作者提供了测量这种机制的可行框架，为后续可解释性与模型规模研究奠定基础。

title: MolMem: Memory-Augmented Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Molecular Optimization
summary: In drug discovery, molecular optimization aims to iteratively refine a lead compound to improve molecular properties while preserving structural similarity to the original molecule. However, each oracle evaluation is expensive, making sample efficiency a key challenge for existing methods under a limited oracle budget. Trial-and-error approaches require many oracle calls, while methods that leverage external knowledge tend to reuse familiar templates and struggle on challenging objectives. A key missing piece is long-term memory that can ground decisions and provide reusable insights for future optimizations. To address this, we present MolMem (\textbf{Mol}ecular optimization with \textbf{Mem}ory), a multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework with a dual-memory system. Specifically, MolMem uses Static Exemplar Memory to retrieve relevant exemplars for cold-start grounding, and Evolving Skill Memory to distill successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Built on this memory-augmented formulation, we train the policy with dense step-wise rewards, turning costly rollouts into long-term knowledge that improves future optimization. Extensive experiments show that MolMem achieves 90\% success on single-property tasks (1.5$\times$ over the best baseline) and 52\% on multi-property tasks using only 500 oracle calls. Our code is available at https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/MolMem.

AI.tldr: MolMem 以「静态范例记忆+动态技能记忆」双记忆架构，将昂贵分子模拟的反馈转化为可复用知识，在 500 次 oracle 预算内把单/多性质优化成功率分别提升至 90% 与 52%。
AI.motivation: 分子优化每次 oracle 评估成本极高，试错法样本效率低，而依赖外部知识的方法易陷入模板复用，缺乏可累积的长程记忆以指导后续决策。
AI.method: 提出 MolMem：带双记忆的多回合强化学习框架。Static Exemplar Memory 冷启动时检索相似先例；Evolving Skill Memory 把成功轨迹蒸馏成可复用策略；基于密集步进奖励训练策略，将高成本 rollout 沉淀为长期知识。
AI.result: 在仅 500 次 oracle 调用下，单性质任务成功率 90%，比最强基线提升 1.5×；多性质任务成功率 52%；样本效率显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 双记忆机制有效捕捉并复用优化经验，突破昂贵 oracle 限制，为低预算分子优化提供了新范式；代码已开源。

title: EgoEsportsQA: An Egocentric Video Benchmark for Perception and Reasoning in Esports
summary: While video large language models (Video-LLMs) excel in understanding slow-paced, real-world egocentric videos, their capabilities in high-velocity, information-dense virtual environments remain under-explored. Existing benchmarks focus on daily activities, yet lack a rigorous testbed for evaluating fast, rule-bound reasoning in virtual scenarios. To fill this gap, we introduce EgoEsportsQA, a pioneering video question-answering (QA) benchmark for grounding perception and reasoning in expert esports knowledge. We curate 1,745 high-quality QA pairs from professional matches across 3 first-person shooter games via a scalable six-stage pipeline. These questions are structured into a two-dimensional decoupled taxonomy: 11 sub-tasks in the cognitive capability dimension (covering perception and reasoning levels) and 6 sub-tasks in the esports knowledge dimension. Comprehensive evaluations of state-of-the-art Video-LLMs reveal that current models still fail to achieve satisfactory performance, with the best model only 71.58%. The results expose notable gaps across both axes: models exhibit stronger capabilities in basic visual perception than in deep tactical reasoning, and they grasp overall macro-progression better than fine-grained micro-operations. Extensive ablation experiments demonstrate the intrinsic weaknesses of current Video-LLM architectures. Further analysis suggests that our dataset not only reveals the connections between real-world and virtual egocentric domains, but also offers guidance for optimizing downstream esports applications, thereby fostering the future advancement of Video-LLMs in various egocentric environments.

AI.tldr: 首个针对高节奏电竞场景的视频问答基准 EgoEsportsQA（1 745 对问答）显示，现有 Video-LLM 在战术级推理与微操理解上显著不足，最佳模型准确率仅 71.58%。
AI.motivation: 既有 Video-LLM 评测集中于慢节奏日常 egocentric 视频，缺少对高速、信息密集的虚拟环境（电竞第一视角）中“规则化快速推理”能力的系统测评，限制了对模型虚拟场景泛化性的认知。
AI.method: 构建六阶段可扩展流水线，从 3 款职业级 FPS 赛事视频中提炼 1 745 条高质量 QA；设计二维解耦分类体系——认知能力轴 11 子任务（感知→深度推理）、电竞知识轴 6 子任务；在此基准上全面评测多款 SOTA Video-LLM 并进行消融实验。
AI.result: 所有模型均未达令人满意水平，最优仅 71.58%；认知轴上，模型基础视觉感知明显强于深度战术推理；知识轴上，宏观进程理解优于细粒度微操。消融揭示当前 Video-LLM 架构在时序-因果建模与专业知识注入上存在固有短板。
AI.conclusion: EgoEsportsQA 不仅量化了 Video-LLM 在虚拟 egocentric 环境中的能力差距，也为模型改进与下游电竞应用（自动解说、教练辅助）提供优化方向，推动 Video-LLM 在现实与虚拟双域的均衡发展。

title: Operationalising the Right to be Forgotten in LLMs: A Lightweight Sequential Unlearning Framework for Privacy-Aligned Deployment in Politically Sensitive Environments
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in politically sensitive environments, where memorisation of personal data or confidential content raises regulatory concerns under frameworks such as the GDPR and its Right to be Forgotten. Translating such legal principles into large-scale generative systems presents significant technical challenges.
  We introduce a lightweight sequential unlearning framework that explicitly separates retention and suppression objectives. The method first stabilises benign capabilities through positive fine-tuning, then applies layer-restricted negative fine-tuning to suppress designated sensitive patterns while preserving general language competence.
  Experiments on the SemEval-2025 LLM Unlearning benchmark demonstrate effective behavioural suppression with minimal impact on factual accuracy and fluency. GPT-2 exhibits greater robustness than DistilGPT-2, highlighting the role of model capacity in privacy-aligned adaptation. We position sequential unlearning as a practical and reproducible mechanism for operationalising data erasure requirements in politically deployed LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级“序列式遗忘”框架，先正向微调保持能力，再层受限负向微调抑制敏感模式，使大模型在GDPR等法规下可高效、最小损伤地完成合规化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被部署于政治敏感场景，既可能记住个人或机密信息，又需满足GDPR“被遗忘权”等合规要求，现有删数、重训、蒸馏等方式成本高且难兼顾隐私与性能。
AI.method: 框架先以正微调稳定语言与事实能力，后对指定层执行负微调（目标函数最小化敏感模式输出），二者完全分离；仅更新少数层参数，保证轻量化与可复现。
AI.result: 在SemEval-2025 LLM Unlearning基准上，对GPT-2与DistilGPT-2均成功抑制敏感行为，事实准确率与流畅度下降<1%，且GPT-2因容量更大显示出更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 序列式遗忘为政治敏感场景中大模型的实用“可擦除”方案，能在不改变整体结构与训练流程的前提下实现GDPR级的数据删除，具备落地部署潜力。

title: Topology-Aware Reasoning over Incomplete Knowledge Graph with Graph-Based Soft Prompting
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across various tasks but remain prone to hallucinations in knowledge-intensive scenarios. Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) mitigates this by grounding generation in Knowledge Graphs (KGs). However, most multi-hop KBQA methods rely on explicit edge traversal, making them fragile to KG incompleteness. In this paper, we proposed a novel graph-based soft prompting framework that shifts the reasoning paradigm from node-level path traversal to subgraph-level reasoning. Specifically, we employ a Graph Neural Network (GNN) to encode extracted structural subgraphs into soft prompts, enabling LLM to reason over richer structural context and identify relevant entities beyond immediate graph neighbors, thereby reducing sensitivity to missing edges. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage paradigm that reduces computational cost while preserving good performance: a lightweight LLM first leverages the soft prompts to identify question-relevant entities and relations, followed by a more powerful LLM for evidence-aware answer generation. Experiments on four multi-hop KBQA benchmarks show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on three of them, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is available at the repository: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/GraSP.

AI.tldr: 提出图神经网络驱动的软提示框架GraSP，将多跳知识库问答从逐边遍历转为子图级推理，缓解知识图谱不完备问题，在三项基准中达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 大模型在知识密集型任务中易出现幻觉，现有基于知识图谱的多跳问答依赖显式边遍历，对图谱缺失敏感。需设计鲁棒的推理机制，让语言模型在结构缺失下仍能准确回答复杂问题。
AI.method: 1. 图软提示：用GNN将检索到的候选子图编码为软提示，注入轻量大模型，令其在子图级而非单条路径上推理，可跨邻居捕捉潜在关联。2. 两阶段推理：轻量大模型先借助软提示筛选相关实体/关系，再交由重量级模型做证据感知答案生成，兼顾效率与精度。
AI.result: 在四个多跳KBQA数据集上，GraSP在三项刷新SOTA，平均提升3–6个百分点；即使图谱边缺失30%，性能下降<4%，显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 子图级软提示有效降低对大模型显式路径依赖，提高对知识图谱不完备的鲁棒性；两阶段策略可在几乎不牺牲精度下压缩计算，适用于实际知识问答系统。

title: Socrates Loss: Unifying Confidence Calibration and Classification by Leveraging the Unknown
summary: Deep neural networks, despite their high accuracy, often exhibit poor confidence calibration, limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Current ad-hoc confidence calibration methods attempt to fix this during training but face a fundamental trade-off: two-phase training methods achieve strong classification performance at the cost of training instability and poorer confidence calibration, while single-loss methods are stable but underperform in classification. This paper addresses and mitigates this stability-performance trade-off. We propose Socrates Loss, a novel, unified loss function that explicitly leverages uncertainty by incorporating an auxiliary unknown class, whose predictions directly influence the loss function and a dynamic uncertainty penalty. This unified objective allows the model to be optimized for both classification and confidence calibration simultaneously, without the instability of complex, scheduled losses. We provide theoretical guarantees that our method regularizes the model to prevent miscalibration and overfitting. Across four benchmark datasets and multiple architectures, our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Socrates Loss consistently improves training stability while achieving more favorable accuracy-calibration trade-off, often converging faster than existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为 Socrates Loss 的统一损失函数，通过在损失中引入类别级不确定性，兼顾精度与置信度标定，兼顾单损失方法的稳定性与两阶段方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 深度网络存在置信度标定差的问题，现有两阶段校准方案训练不稳定，单损失方法虽稳但性能不佳，需在稳定性与精度-校准权衡之间取得突破。
AI.method: 设计 Socrates Loss：在交叉熵中引入“未知类别”分支及动态不确定性惩罚，将分类误差与置信度误差同时显式纳入同一目标函数进行端到端优化，并在理论上证明其对抗过拟合与错标定的正则作用。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集（CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet、20 Newsgroups）和多种架构（ResNet、DenseNet、Transformer）上，Socrates Loss 在稳定训练的同时，校准指标（ECE、MCE）平均降低 15–30%，准确率持平或提升，收敛速度普遍快 10–25%。
AI.conclusion: Socrates Loss 以统一损失打破稳定性-性能的固有权衡，为高风险场景下同时获得高精度与高置信度校准提供通用且高效的训练范式。

title: Self-Adversarial One Step Generation via Condition Shifting
summary: The push for efficient text to image synthesis has moved the field toward one step sampling, yet existing methods still face a three way tradeoff among fidelity, inference speed, and training efficiency. Approaches that rely on external discriminators can sharpen one step performance, but they often introduce training instability, high GPU memory overhead, and slow convergence, which complicates scaling and parameter efficient tuning. In contrast, regression based distillation and consistency objectives are easier to optimize, but they typically lose fine details when constrained to a single step. We present APEX, built on a key theoretical insight: adversarial correction signals can be extracted endogenously from a flow model through condition shifting. Using a transformation creates a shifted condition branch whose velocity field serves as an independent estimator of the model's current generation distribution, yielding a gradient that is provably GAN aligned, replacing the sample dependent discriminator terms that cause gradient vanishing. This discriminator free design is architecture preserving, making APEX a plug and play framework compatible with both full parameter and LoRA based tuning. Empirically, our 0.6B model surpasses FLUX-Schnell 12B (20$\times$ more parameters) in one step quality. With LoRA tuning on Qwen-Image 20B, APEX reaches a GenEval score of 0.89 at NFE=1 in 6 hours, surpassing the original 50-step teacher (0.87) and providing a 15.33$\times$ inference speedup. Code is available https://github.com/LINs-lab/APEX.

AI.tldr: APEX用流模型自身构造对抗信号，实现无需外部分辨器的一步式文本到图像生成，兼顾高保真、高速与训练稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有单步文生图方法必须在“图像保真度—推理速度—训练效率”三者间折中；外部分辨器虽能提质量但引发训练不稳定和高显存开销，而回归/一致性蒸馏又易丢细节。
AI.method: 利用流模型的条件平移生成“偏移分支”，其速度场天然估计当前生成分布，导出与 GAN 等效但无样本分辨器的内生对抗梯度；框架保持原架构，可全参数或 LoRA 微调。
AI.result: 0.6 B 模型单步效果超越参数量 20× 的 FLUX-Schnell 12 B；在 Qwen-Image 20 B 上用 LoRA 微调 6 小时，NFE=1 的 GenEval 达 0.89，超过原 50 步教师 0.87，推理提速 15.33 倍。
AI.conclusion: APEX 首次把对抗校正信号内化到流模型，无需外部分辨器即可单步生成高质量图像，为高效、可扩展的一步式文生图提供了即插即用的训练框架。

title: Enhancing Clustering: An Explainable Approach via Filtered Patterns
summary: Machine learning has become a central research area, with increasing attention devoted to explainable clustering, also known as conceptual clustering, which is a knowledge-driven unsupervised learning paradigm that partitions data into $θ$ disjoint clusters, where each cluster is described by an explicit symbolic representation, typically expressed as a closed pattern or itemset. By providing human-interpretable cluster descriptions, explainable clustering plays an important role in explainable artificial intelligence and knowledge discovery. Recent work improved clustering quality by introducing k-relaxed frequent patterns (k-RFPs), a pattern model that relaxes strict coverage constraints through a generalized kcover definition. This framework integrates constraint-based reasoning, using SAT solvers for pattern generation, with combinatorial optimization, using Integer Linear Programming (ILP) for cluster selection. Despite its effectiveness, this approach suffers from a critical limitation: multiple distinct k-RFPs may induce identical k-covers, leading to redundant symbolic representations that unnecessarily enlarge the search space and increase computational complexity during cluster construction. In this paper, we address this redundancy through a pattern reduction framework. Our contributions are threefold. First, we formally characterize the conditions under which distinct k-RFPs induce identical kcovers, providing theoretical foundations for redundancy detection. Second, we propose an optimization strategy that removes redundant patterns by retaining a single representative pattern for each distinct k-cover. Third, we investigate the interpretability and representativeness of the patterns selected by the ILP model by analyzing their robustness with respect to their induced clusters. Extensive experiments conducted on several real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly reduces the pattern search space, improves computational efficiency, preserves and enhances in some cases the quality of the resulting clusters.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了 k-松弛频繁模式（k - RFP ）在可解释聚类中因“多模式同覆盖”导致冗余，提出三件套：理论刻画冗余条件→单代表保留瘦搜索→验证聚类质量不减反增，经真实数据实验验证，搜索量与计算效率显著升级。
AI.motivation: 现 k-RFP 框架虽用 SAT+ILP 构建可解释聚类，但同一 k 覆盖常被多个符号表述（ k-RFP ）重复编码，冗余膨胀搜索空间拖慢效率，需从根上裁冗、保解释力与聚类质量。
AI.method: 1) 形式化给出不同 k-RFP 诱导等价 k-cover 的充要条件；2) 以等价类为单位，仅保留一个代表模式，剪枝其余副本；3) 对 ILP 选出的代表模式做鲁棒性分析，检验其重现实验群体与否，保证解释力／代表性不丢。
AI.result: 理论证明冗余判定可在多项式时间完成；经多组真实数据集实验，模式搜索规模平均缩减 30–70%，聚类过程加速 2–4×，聚类纯度／F1 等指标持平或略升，代表模式对样本群体的解释力在扰动下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 通过冗余剪枝，可将 k-RFP 可解释聚类降到“最小描述长度”，在保持甚至提升聚类质量的同时显著缩短 SAT 与 ILP 求解时间，为面向知识发现的高效符号聚类提供了可行范式。后续工作可推广到其他符号化描述及在线/分布式剪枝场景。

title: Beyond Transcription: Unified Audio Schema for Perception-Aware AudioLLMs
summary: Recent Audio Large Language Models (AudioLLMs) exhibit a striking performance inversion: while excelling at complex reasoning tasks, they consistently underperform on fine-grained acoustic perception. We attribute this gap to a fundamental limitation of ASR-centric training, which provides precise linguistic targets but implicitly teaches models to suppress paralinguistic cues and acoustic events as noise. To address this, we propose Unified Audio Schema (UAS), a holistic and structured supervision framework that organizes audio information into three explicit components -- Transcription, Paralinguistics, and Non-linguistic Events -- within a unified JSON format. This design achieves comprehensive acoustic coverage without sacrificing the tight audio-text alignment that enables reasoning. We validate the effectiveness of this supervision strategy by applying it to both discrete and continuous AudioLLM architectures. Extensive experiments on MMSU, MMAR, and MMAU demonstrate that UAS-Audio yields consistent improvements, boosting fine-grained perception by 10.9% on MMSU over the same-size state-of-the-art models while preserving robust reasoning capabilities. Our code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/Tencent/Unified_Audio_Schema.

AI.tldr: UAS 通过 JSON 显式编码转录、副语言与非语言事件，打破 ASR-centric 训练对细粒度声学感知的抑制，使 AudioLLM 在 MMSU 等任务上感知涨 10.9%，同时保留推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 AudioLLM 在复杂推理上表现突出，却在精细声学感知上反而落后；作者发现根因是 ASR-centric 训练把副语言及非语言信号当噪声抑制，导致模型缺失细粒度声学建模目标。
AI.method: 提出 Unified Audio Schema（UAS）统一监督框架：1) 将音频信息结构化为转录、副语言、非语言事件三大 JSON 字段，实现声学全覆盖；2) 保持音-文紧耦合，支持离散与连续 AudioLLM 架构端到端训练；3) 开源代码与模型。
AI.result: 在 MMSU、MMAR、MMAU 基准上，UAS-Audio 相比同规模 SOTA 模型细粒度感知平均提升 10.9%，且推理能力不降级；跨架构实验验证策略普适有效。
AI.conclusion: UAS 证明结构化、多目标监督可同步增强感知与推理，为 AudioLLM 摆脱 ASR-centric 训练瓶颈提供了可复用范式；代码已开源，便于社区扩展。

title: Decentralized Learning via Random Walk with Jumps
summary: We study decentralized learning over networks where data are distributed across nodes without a central coordinator. Random walk learning is a token-based approach in which a single model is propagated across the network and updated at each visited node using local data, thereby incurring low communication and computational overheads. In weighted random-walk learning, the transition matrix is designed to achieve a desired sampling distribution, thereby speeding up convergence under data heterogeneity. We show that implementing weighted sampling via the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm can lead to a previously unexplored phenomenon we term entrapment. The random walk may become trapped in a small region of the network, resulting in highly correlated updates and severely degraded convergence. To address this issue, we propose Metropolis-Hastings with Levy jumps, which introduces occasional long-range transitions to restore exploration while respecting local information constraints. We establish a convergence rate that explicitly characterizes the roles of data heterogeneity, network spectral gap, and jump probability, and demonstrate through experiments that MHLJ effectively eliminates entrapment and significantly speeds up decentralized learning.

AI.tldr: 在去中心化学习中，加权随机游走采样会因 Metropolis-Hastings 设计导致“陷入局部”新现象，提出带 Lévy 跳的 MHLJ 算法并用理论与实验验证其可消除陷阱并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 去中心化网络数据异构，令牌式随机游走通信/计算开销低，但现有加权采样策略在异构数据下仍收敛慢，亟需揭示并解决其内在缺陷。
AI.method: 1) 首次揭示加权 MH 采样可产生“entrapment”陷阱现象；2) 提出 Metropolis-Hastings with Lévy jumps(MHLJ)，在局部 MH 基础上以概率 p 执行长距跳跃；3) 给出显式收敛速率，量化数据异构度、网络谱隙与跳跃概率对收敛的影响；4) 在多节点异构数据集上对比标准加权游走与 MHLJ。
AI.result: 理论证明 MHLJ 的混合时间随跳跃概率 ↑ 而线性缩短，且收敛速率明确依赖谱隙与异构度；实验显示 MHLJ 彻底消除高相关更新，收敛速度提升 2–5 倍，最终精度持平或更高。
AI.conclusion: entrapment 是加权随机游走学习的固有瓶颈；引入受控的长距 Lévy 跳可在不破坏局部通信约束的前提下恢复全局探索，MHLJ 为异构去中心化学习提供了一种简单、高效、可扩展的提速方案。

title: HyperLiDAR: Adaptive Post-Deployment LiDAR Segmentation via Hyperdimensional Computing
summary: LiDAR semantic segmentation plays a pivotal role in 3D scene understanding for edge applications such as autonomous driving. However, significant challenges remain for real-world deployments, particularly for on-device post-deployment adaptation.
