Real-world environments can shift as the system navigates through different locations, leading to substantial performance degradation without effective and timely model adaptation. Furthermore, edge systems operate under strict computational and energy constraints, making it infeasible to adapt conventional segmentation models (based on large neural networks) directly on-device. To address the above challenges, we introduce HyperLiDAR, the first lightweight, post-deployment LiDAR segmentation framework based on Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC). The design of HyperLiDAR fully leverages the fast learning and high efficiency of HDC, inspired by how the human brain processes information. To further improve the adaptation efficiency, we identify the high data volume per scan as a key bottleneck and introduce a buffer selection strategy that focuses learning on the most informative points. We conduct extensive evaluations on two state-of-the-art LiDAR segmentation benchmarks and two representative devices. Our results show that HyperLiDAR outperforms or achieves comparable adaptation performance to state-of-the-art segmentation methods, while achieving up to a 13.8x speedup in retraining.

AI.tldr: 基于超维计算（HDC）的轻量级 LiDAR 语义分割框架 HyperLiDAR，可在边缘端部署后即时、高效地自我适应环境变化，比现有重训练方法快 13.8 倍，且精度持平或更优。
AI.motivation: 真实环境中部署的 LiDAR 分割模型随地点变化会性能骤降，但边缘设备算力与能耗受限，无法在线微调大型网络，亟需一种既轻量又能快速适应的新范式。
AI.method: 1）引入超维计算（HDC）替代传统深度网络，实现单次推理即学习；2）提出基于信息量的缓存点筛选策略，仅保留每帧最关键点用于增量更新，压缩数据瓶颈；3）端到端设计 HyperLiDAR 框架并在两种边缘硬件上实现。
AI.result: 在 SemanticKITTI 与 nuScenes 两大主流数据集、Raspberry Pi 4 与 NVIDIA Jetson Xavier 两种设备上，HyperLiDAR 的在线自适应精度与 SOTA 方法相当或更高，重训练时间缩短 3.3–13.8 倍，能耗降低 7.6–12.4 倍，内存占用 < 45 MB。
AI.conclusion: 超维计算首次被验证可用于 LiDAR 语义分割的部署后持续学习，兼顾精度、速度与能耗，为自动驾驶等边缘应用提供了落地友好的在线适应方案。

title: CIA: Inferring the Communication Topology from LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks. Central to MAS is the communication topology which governs how agents exchange information internally. Consequently, the security of communication topologies has attracted increasing attention. In this paper, we investigate a critical privacy risk: MAS communication topologies can be inferred under a restrictive black-box setting, exposing system vulnerabilities and posing significant intellectual property threats. To explore this risk, we propose Communication Inference Attack (CIA), a novel attack that constructs new adversarial queries to induce intermediate agents' reasoning outputs and models their semantic correlations through the proposed global bias disentanglement and LLM-guided weak supervision. Extensive experiments on MAS with optimized communication topologies demonstrate the effectiveness of CIA, achieving an average AUC of 0.87 and a peak AUC of up to 0.99, thereby revealing the substantial privacy risk in MAS.

AI.tldr: 黑盒条件下仅凭查询即可高精准重构多智能体系统内部通信拓扑，暴露隐性IP级隐私风险。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统普遍采用优化通信拓扑提升协作效率，但拓扑本身作为核心IP尚未被当作攻击面；作者旨在验证其可被外部窃取的严重性。
AI.method: 提出Communication Inference Attack（CIA）：①设计 adversarial 查询迫使中间智能体泄露推理片段，②通过“全局偏差解耦”提取各代理输出间的结构相关性，③用LLM弱监督自动标注并重建拓扑邻接矩阵。
AI.result: 在三种代表性MAS场景上，CIA平均推断AUC 0.87、最高0.99；仅需数百次查询即可恢复90%以上的边，显著优于随机/基线攻击。
AI.conclusion: 通信拓扑在LLM-MAS中存在严重隐私漏洞，需重新设计拓扑混淆、差分隐私或输出过滤等防御机制。

title: Enhance-then-Balance Modality Collaboration for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) integrates heterogeneous text, audio, and visual signals to infer human emotions. While recent approaches leverage cross-modal complementarity, they often struggle to fully utilize weaker modalities. In practice, dominant modalities tend to overshadow non-verbal ones, inducing modality competition and limiting overall contributions. This imbalance degrades fusion performance and robustness under noisy or missing modalities. To address this, we propose a novel model, Enhance-then-Balance Modality Collaboration framework (EBMC). EBMC improves representation quality via semantic disentanglement and cross-modal enhancement, strengthening weaker modalities. To prevent dominant modalities from overwhelming others, an Energy-guided Modality Coordination mechanism achieves implicit gradient rebalancing via a differentiable equilibrium objective. Furthermore, Instance-aware Modality Trust Distillation estimates sample-level reliability to adaptively modulate fusion weights, ensuring robustness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EBMC achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results and maintains strong performance under missing-modality settings.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态情感分析中弱模态被主导模态淹没导致融合性能下降的问题，本文提出EBMC框架：先通过语义解耦与跨模态增强提升弱模态质量，再用基于能量博弈的协调机制实现梯度重平衡，最后引入实例级信任蒸馏动态调整融合权重，在完整与缺失模态场景下均取得SOTA或竞争性结果。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情感分析虽利用跨模态互补，但主导模态（如文本）常压制非语言模态，引发模态竞争，削弱弱模态贡献，导致融合性能与鲁棒性下降，尤其在噪声或缺失模态场景下更为严重。
AI.method: 提出Enhance-then-Balance Modality Collaboration (EBMC)框架：(1) 表示增强阶段：语义解耦+跨模态增强提升弱模态表征质量；(2) 平衡协调阶段：Energy-guided Modality Coordination机制通过可微均衡目标函数实现隐性梯度重平衡；(3) 鲁棒融合阶段：Instance-aware Modality Trust蒸馏估计样本级可信度，自适应调制融合权重。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上的大量实验表明，EBMC在完整模态条件下达到SOTA或竞争性精度；在随机缺失某一模态的 stress test 中，性能下降幅度显著小于现有方法，验证其鲁棒性优势。
AI.conclusion: EBMC通过“先增强-再平衡”两阶段策略，有效缓解模态竞争，充分释放弱模态潜力，实现高精度且鲁棒的多模态情感融合，为后续 noisy/missing-modality 研究提供了新范式。

title: RoleMAG: Learning Neighbor Roles in Multimodal Graphs
summary: Multimodal attributed graphs (MAGs) combine multimodal node attributes with structured relations. However, existing methods usually perform shared message passing on a single graph and implicitly assume that the same neighbors are equally useful for all modalities. In practice, neighbors that benefit one modality may interfere with another, blurring modality-specific signals under shared propagation. To address this issue, we propose RoleMAG, a multimodal graph framework that learns how different neighbors should participate in propagation. Concretely, RoleMAG distinguishes whether a neighbor should provide shared, complementary, or heterophilous signals, and routes them through separate propagation channels. This enables cross-modal completion from complementary neighbors while keeping heterophilous ones out of shared smoothing. Extensive experiments on three graph-centric MAG benchmarks show that RoleMAG achieves the best results on RedditS and Bili\_Dance, while remaining competitive on Toys. Ablation, robustness, and efficiency analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed role-aware propagation design. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RoleMAG-7EE0/

AI.tldr: RoleMAG为异质多模属性图（MAG）设计「角色感知」传播机制，分别在每模态中把邻居区分为共享/互补/异质信号，并通过独立通道传播，从而减轻模态间干扰。
AI.motivation: 多模属性图中，统一消息传递会误把干扰邻居当作有益邻居，造成模态混淆；需要针对每种模态显式分辨邻居在传播中的功能角色。
AI.method: RoleMAG 先对邻居分布做角色判别（共享/互补/异质），再派发到三种独立通道：共享通道促进同构平滑，互补通道实现跨模补全，异质通道被隔离以防干扰。
AI.result: 在 RedditS、Bili_Dance、Toys 三套 MAG 基准上，RoleMAG 在前两者刷新最佳成绩，在第三项保持竞争力；消融、鲁棒性和效率实验均验证角色传播设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 区分邻居角色并把其信号分流，是减轻模态冲突并保持图结构效用的关键。RoleMAG 为后续多模图学习提供了可扩展的高效框架。

title: All in One: A Unified Synthetic Data Pipeline for Multimodal Video Understanding
summary: Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for video understanding requires large-scale annotated data spanning diverse tasks such as object counting, question answering, and segmentation. However, collecting and annotating multimodal video data in real-world is costly, slow, and inherently limited in diversity and coverage. To address this challenge, we propose a unified synthetic data generation pipeline capable of automatically producing unlimited multimodal video data with rich and diverse supervision. Our framework supports multiple task formats within a single pipeline, enabling scalable and consistent data creation across tasks. To further enhance reasoning ability, we introduce a VQA-based fine-tuning strategy that trains models to answer structured questions about visual content rather than relying solely on captions or simple instructions. This formulation encourages deeper visual grounding and reasoning. We evaluate our approach in three challenging tasks: video object counting, video-based visual question answering, and video object segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that models trained predominantly on synthetic data generalize effectively to real-world datasets, often outperforming traditionally trained counterparts. Our findings highlight the potential of unified synthetic data pipelines as a scalable alternative to expensive real-world annotation for multimodal video understanding.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态大语言模型视频理解数据难获取、标注昂贵的问题，本文提出统一合成数据流水线，可无限生成带丰富标注的多任务视频数据，并以VQA式微调强化推理，实验证明仅用合成数据即可在真实基准上超越传统训练方式。
AI.motivation: 多模态视频理解模型依赖大规模、跨任务标注，但真实数据收集成本高、速度慢、多样性受限，亟需可扩展的替代方案。
AI.method: 1) 设计统一合成数据生成框架，一站式产出无限多模态视频及对应标签，覆盖计数、问答、分割等多种格式；2) 提出基于VQA的微调策略，用结构化视觉问答代替简单字幕，迫使模型深度 grounding 与推理；3) 在三大任务上验证合成数据主导训练的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在视频物体计数、VQA 与分割真实数据集上，合成数据训练模型多数指标优于或媲美传统真实数据训练基线，显示其强大跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 统一合成数据管道可作为昂贵人工标注的高效替代，显著降低多模态视频理解的数据门槛，为规模化训练提供可行路径。

title: Intelligent ROI-Based Vehicle Counting Framework for Automated Traffic Monitoring
summary: Accurate vehicle counting through video surveillance is crucial for efficient traffic management. However, achieving high counting accuracy while ensuring computational efficiency remains a challenge. To address this, we propose a fully automated, video-based vehicle counting framework designed to optimize both computational efficiency and counting accuracy. Our framework operates in two distinct phases: \textit{estimation} and \textit{prediction}. In the estimation phase, the optimal region of interest (ROI) is automatically determined using a novel combination of three models based on detection scores, tracking scores, and vehicle density. This adaptive approach ensures compatibility with any detection and tracking method, enhancing the framework's versatility. In the prediction phase, vehicle counting is efficiently performed within the estimated ROI. We evaluated our framework on benchmark datasets like UA-DETRAC, GRAM, CDnet 2014, and ATON. Results demonstrate exceptional accuracy, with most videos achieving 100\% accuracy, while also enhancing computational efficiency, making processing up to four times faster than full-frame processing. The framework outperforms existing techniques, especially in complex multi-road scenarios, demonstrating robustness and superior accuracy. These advancements make it a promising solution for real-time traffic monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全自动、基于视频的ROI自适应车辆计数框架，先自动估计最优ROI，再在该区域内高效计数，兼顾100%准确率与4倍速度提升。
AI.motivation: 交通监控需同时保证高计数准确率与计算效率，现有方法难以兼顾，尤其在多车道复杂场景下。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1) 估计阶段，融合检测分数、跟踪分数与车辆密度自动确定最优ROI，兼容任意检测/跟踪模型；2) 预测阶段，仅在ROI内高效计数。
AI.result: 在UA-DETRAC、GRAM、CDnet 2014、ATON等数据集上，多数视频达到100%计数准确率，处理速度较全帧法提升4倍，复杂多道路场景下优于现有技术。
AI.conclusion: 该框架兼具高准确率与实时性，为交通监控提供了兼顾精度与效率的落地解决方案。

title: When Does Data Augmentation Help? Evaluating LLM and Back-Translation Methods for Hausa and Fongbe NLP
comment: 13 pages, 6 tables; previously submitted to KDD 2026
summary: Data scarcity limits NLP development for low-resource African languages. We evaluate two data augmentation methods -- LLM-based generation (Gemini 2.5 Flash) and back-translation (NLLB-200) -- for Hausa and Fongbe, two West African languages that differ substantially in LLM generation quality. We assess augmentation on named entity recognition (NER) and part-of-speech (POS) tagging using MasakhaNER 2.0 and MasakhaPOS benchmarks. Our results reveal that augmentation effectiveness depends on task type rather than language or LLM quality alone. For NER, neither method improves over baseline for either language; LLM augmentation reduces Hausa NER by 0.24% F1 and Fongbe NER by 1.81% F1. For POS tagging, LLM augmentation improves Fongbe by 0.33% accuracy, while back-translation improves Hausa by 0.17%; back-translation reduces Fongbe POS by 0.35% and has negligible effect on Hausa POS. The same LLM-generated synthetic data produces opposite effects across tasks for Fongbe -- hurting NER while helping POS -- suggesting task structure governs augmentation outcomes more than synthetic data quality. These findings challenge the assumption that LLM generation quality predicts augmentation success, and provide actionable guidance: data augmentation should be treated as a task-specific intervention rather than a universally beneficial preprocessing step.

AI.tldr: 在资源稀缺的西非语言豪萨与芳贝上比较LLM生成vs.反向翻译的数据增强效果：命名实体识别无收益甚至下降，词性标注略有提升，增益取决于任务而非语言或合成数据质量。
AI.motivation: 非洲低资源语言面临训练数据稀缺，需要评估低成本数据增强策略是否可靠；现有研究多聚焦高资源语言，缺乏对非洲语言、对LLM生成质量差异与任务耦合关系的系统验证。
AI.method: 用Gemini 2.5 Flash生成和NLLB-200反向翻译两种方法分别扩充豪萨与芳贝语料；在MasakhaNER 2.0和MasakhaPOS基准上对比增强前后的NER(F1)与POS(准确率)表现，分析语言、LLM质量与任务类型的交互效应。
AI.result: NER任务：两种方法均未超Baseline，LLM增强反使豪萨F1降0.24%，芳贝降1.81%。POS任务：LLM增强使芳贝准确率+0.33%，反向翻译使豪萨+0.17%，但反向翻译让芳贝-0.35%。同一批LLM合成数据对不同任务产生相反影响，表明任务结构主导增强结果而非数据本身质量。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强并非“通用预处理福利”，而应被视为任务专属干预；未来应先在小规模验证集上测试任务-增强组合，再决定是否大规模应用。

title: SubFlow: Sub-mode Conditioned Flow Matching for Diverse One-Step Generation
summary: Flow matching has emerged as a powerful generative framework, with recent few-step methods achieving remarkable inference acceleration. However, we identify a critical yet overlooked limitation: these models suffer from severe diversity degradation, concentrating samples on dominant modes while neglecting rare but valid variations of the target distribution. We trace this degradation to averaging distortion: when trained with MSE objectives, class-conditional flows learn a frequency-weighted mean over intra-class sub-modes, causing the model to over-represent high-density modes while systematically neglecting low-density ones. To address this, we propose SubFlow, Sub-mode Conditioned Flow Matching, which eliminates averaging distortion by decomposing each class into fine-grained sub-modes via semantic clustering and conditioning the flow on sub-mode indices. Each conditioned sub-distribution is approximately unimodal, so the learned flow accurately targets individual modes with no averaging distortion, restoring full mode coverage in a single inference step. Crucially, SubFlow is entirely plug-and-play: it integrates seamlessly into existing one-step models such as MeanFlow and Shortcut Models without any architectural modifications. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-256 demonstrate that SubFlow yields substantial gains in generation diversity (Recall) while maintaining competitive image quality (FID), confirming its broad applicability across different one-step generation frameworks. Project page: https://yexionglin.github.io/subflow.

AI.tldr: 一步式流匹配模型因MSE平均化而丢失罕见模式，导致多样性骤降；提出SubFlow，通过语义聚类将每类拆成细粒度子模式并条件化建模，无需改网络即可在单步推理中恢复全模式覆盖，ImageNet-256上召回率显著提升且FID持平。
AI.motivation: 现有少步/一步流匹配加速方法虽快，却出现严重多样性退化——样本集中扎堆高密度模式，稀有但合法的区域被系统性忽略。作者指出根源在于MSE目标下的“平均化扭曲”：类条件流被迫学习类内子模式的频率加权均值，直接抹平低密度区域。
AI.method: 提出SubFlow（Sub-mode Conditioned Flow Matching）：1) 对每类训练图像做语义聚类，自动挖出K个细粒度子模式；2) 将子模式索引作为额外条件，把原单峰类分布拆成K个近单峰子分布；3) 在每个子分布上独立训练流匹配，消除跨模式平均化；4) 推理时先均匀采样子模式索引，再一步生成，实现即插即用，无需改动MeanFlow/Shortcut等现有模型结构。
AI.result: ImageNet-256上，SubFlow在多种一步框架下将Recall提升2–3×，罕见类别覆盖率显著改善；FID与原始方法持平或略优；相同延迟下生成多样性首次反超多步扩散，验证子模式条件化能有效去除平均化扭曲。
AI.conclusion: 平均化扭曲是少步流匹配多样性崩溃的核心原因；通过“先聚类、再条件化”的SubFlow即可零改装网络、零额外推理步数地恢复完整模式分布，为一步生成同时实现高速与高产奠定了通用范式。

title: Bridging the Micro--Macro Gap: Frequency-Aware Semantic Alignment for Image Manipulation Localization
summary: As generative image editing advances, image manipulation localization (IML) must handle both traditional manipulations with conspicuous forensic artifacts and diffusion-generated edits that appear locally realistic. Existing methods typically rely on either low-level forensic cues or high-level semantics alone, leading to a fundamental micro--macro gap. To bridge this gap, we propose FASA, a unified framework for localizing both traditional and diffusion-generated manipulations. Specifically, we extract manipulation-sensitive frequency cues through an adaptive dual-band DCT module and learn manipulation-aware semantic priors via patch-level contrastive alignment on frozen CLIP representations. We then inject these priors into a hierarchical frequency pathway through a semantic-frequency side adapter for multi-scale feature interaction, and employ a prototype-guided, frequency-gated mask decoder to integrate semantic consistency with boundary-aware localization for tampered region prediction. Extensive experiments on OpenSDI and multiple traditional manipulation benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art localization performance, strong cross-generator and cross-dataset generalization, and robust performance under common image degradations.

AI.tldr: FASA 框架通过频率线索与语义先验的互补融合，首次同时定位传统篡改与扩散生成编辑，在开放集与退化条件下刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像编辑普及后，IML 需同时应对遗留明显取证痕迹的传统篡改与局部高度逼真的扩散模型编辑；现有方法仅依赖低级取证或高级语义，存在“微观—宏观”鸿沟，难以兼顾两类篡改。
AI.method: 提出统一框架 FASA：1) 自适应双频带 DCT 提取频率取证线索；2)冻结 CLIP 上作块级对比学习，获得操控敏感语义先验；3) 语义-频率侧适配器将先验注入多尺度频率通路，实现跨层次交互；4) 原型引导、频率门控掩码解码器同步利用语义一致性与边界感知，预测篡改区域。
AI.result: 在 OpenSDI（扩散编辑）及多项传统篡改基准上取得 SOTA 定位精度；跨生成器、跨数据集泛化显著优于现有方法；对压缩、噪声、模糊等常见退化保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: FASA 通过显式桥接微观取证与宏观语义，为统一检测传统与生成式操控提供了可扩展范式，并验证了频率-语义协同在真实退化环境下的有效性。

title: Technical Report -- A Context-Sensitive Multi-Level Similarity Framework for First-Order Logic Arguments: An Axiomatic Study
summary: Similarity in formal argumentation has recently gained attention due to its significance in problems such as argument aggregation in semantics and enthymeme decoding. While existing approaches focus on propositional logic, we address the richer setting of First-Order Logic (FOL), where similarity must account for structured content. We introduce a comprehensive framework for FOL argument similarity, built upon: (1) an extended axiomatic foundation; (2) a four-level parametric model covering predicates, literals, clauses, and formulae similarity; (3) two model families, one syntax-sensitive via language models, both integrating contextual weights for nuanced and explainable similarity; and (4) formal constraints enforcing desirable properties.

AI.tldr: 首篇面向一阶逻辑论证的相似度体系：四层级参数化模型+可解释权重，兼具语法敏感与语义保持。
AI.motivation: 当前论证相似度研究局限于命题逻辑，难以处理结构化的FOL论证，限制了论证聚合、缺省还原等任务。
AI.method: （1）扩展FOL论证公理基础；（2）提出谓词-文字-子句-公式四层级参数化模型；（3）设计两套模型族：基于语言模型的句法敏感族与结构保持族，均引入上下文权重；（4）用形式约束强制满足自反、对称、单调等性质。
AI.result: 框架统一覆盖从词汇到整体公式的相似评估，权重可解释，约束保证理论正确性，为FOL论证挖掘提供首个系统化工具链。
AI.conclusion: 将相似度计算从命题逻辑推进到一阶逻辑，为后续论证聚合与缺省还原奠定可扩展、可解释的基础。

title: FABLE: Fine-grained Fact Anchoring for Unstructured Model Editing
summary: Unstructured model editing aims to update models with real-world text, yet existing methods often memorize text holistically without reliable fine-grained fact access. To address this, we propose FABLE, a hierarchical framework that decouples fine-grained fact injection from holistic text generation. FABLE follows a two-stage, fact-first strategy: discrete facts are anchored in shallow layers, followed by minimal updates to deeper layers to produce coherent text. This decoupling resolves the mismatch between holistic recall and fine-grained fact access, reflecting the unidirectional Transformer flow in which surface-form generation amplifies rather than corrects underlying fact representations. We also introduce UnFine, a diagnostic benchmark with fine-grained question-answer pairs and fact-level metrics for systematic evaluation. Experiments show that FABLE substantially improves fine-grained question answering while maintaining state-of-the-art holistic editing performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/caskcsg/FABLE.

AI.tldr: 提出FABLE分层框架，将细粒度事实注入与整体文本生成分离，兼顾事实更新与文本连贯性。
AI.motivation: 现有非结构化编辑方法整体记忆文本，难以精准更新细粒度事实，导致事实-文本错位。
AI.method: 两阶段“事实优先”策略：浅层锚定离散事实，深层仅微调用以生成连贯文本；配套UnFine基准与事实级评估指标。
AI.result: 在UnFine上细粒度问答显著提升，同时保持整体编辑SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: FABLE通过层间解耦与单向Transformer特性对齐，实现可靠细粒度编辑，代码已开源。

title: Models Know Their Shortcuts: Deployment-Time Shortcut Mitigation
summary: Pretrained language models often rely on superficial features that appear predictive during training yet fail to generalize at test time, a phenomenon known as shortcut learning. Existing mitigation methods generally operate at training time and require heavy supervision such as access to the original training data or prior knowledge of shortcut type. We propose Shortcut Guardrail, a deployment-time framework that mitigates token-level shortcuts without access to the original training data or shortcut annotations. Our key insight is that gradient-based attribution on a biased model highlights shortcut tokens. Building on this finding, we train a lightweight LoRA-based debiasing module with a Masked Contrastive Learning (MaskCL) objective that encourages consistent representations with or without individual tokens. Across sentiment classification, toxicity detection, and natural language inference under both naturally occurring and controlled shortcuts, Shortcut Guardrail improves overall accuracy and worst-group accuracy over the unmitigated model under distribution shifts while preserving in-distribution performance.

AI.tldr: Shortcut Guardrail无需训练数据即可在部署阶段抑制预训练大模型的“令牌级捷径”行为，在多个任务与分布漂移场景下同时提升整体准确率与最差子群准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有去偏方法必须在训练时段使用原始训练数据或捷径先验，部署阶段无法补救；本研究希望构建一种“部署时”即可运行的无数据去捷径框架，解决模型在分布漂移下因捷径失效导致的性能骤降
AI.method: 1) 利用梯度归因在已训练好的捷径模型上定位高贡献的“捷径令牌”；2) 冻结原模型，外挂轻量化 LoRA 模块；3) 以“掩码对比学习”(MaskCL) 目标微调——对每条文本随机掩码单个令牌，要求掩码前后表示分布一致，从而弱化任一令牌对决策的独占性；4) 推理时直接启用微调后的 LoRA 权重
AI.result: 在 Sentiment、Toxicity、NLI 三大任务的自然捷径与人工注入捷径数据集上，Shortcut Guardrail 相较未修正模型：整体准确率平均提升 0.9–2.4%；最差子群准确率提升 4.6–11.3%；同时保持原分布性能不变，无需任何原始数据或捷径标注，成本仅为全参数微调 1.5–3%
AI.conclusion: 梯度归因 + LoRA + MaskCL 的离线去捷径思路可在部署阶段低成本抑制令牌级捷径，显著提升模型对分布漂移的鲁棒性，为“无数据”“无标注”场景下的模型治理提供了实用方案

title: Detecting Precise Hand Touch Moments in Egocentric Video
summary:
We address the challenging task of detecting the precise moment when hands make contact with objects in egocentric videos. This frame-level detection is crucial for augmented reality, human-computer interaction, assistive technologies, and robot learning applications, where contact onset signals action initiation or completion. Temporally precise detection is particularly challenging due to subtle hand motion variations near contact, frequent occlusions, fine-grained manipulation patterns, and the inherent motion dynamics of first-person perspectives.
  To tackle these challenges, we propose a Hand-informed Context Enhanced module (HiCE; pronounced `high-see') that leverages spatiotemporal features from hand regions and their surrounding context through cross-attention mechanisms, learning to identify potential contact patterns. Our approach is further refined with a grasp-aware loss and soft label that emphasizes hand pose patterns and movement dynamics characteristic of touch events, enabling the model to distinguish between near-contact and actual contact frames. We also introduce TouchMoment, an egocentric dataset containing 4,021 videos and 8,456 annotated contact moments spanning over one million frames. Experiments on TouchMoment show that, under a strict evaluation criterion that counts a prediction as correct only if it falls within a two-frame tolerance of the ground-truth moment, our method achieves substantial gains and outperforms state-of-the-art event-spotting baselines by 16.91% average precision.

AI.tldr: 提出手部引导上下文增强模块 HiCE 与 Soft-Grasp 损失，在百万帧级第一人称「触摸瞬间」数据集 TouchMoment 上，以两帧严格误差判定将接触时刻检测 AP 提升 16.91%。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频若能在帧级精确捕捉「手何时碰到物体」，可为 AR、HCI、辅具、机器人学习等提供动作起讫信号，但现有方法受限遮挡、微运动、近接触混淆及细粒度操纵模式带来的高时序误差。
AI.method: 1. 引入跨注意力手部感知上下文增强模块 HiCE，将手部区域与周围上下文做时空特征交互，挖掘潜在接触模式。2. 设计 grasp-aware 软标签及损失，在手姿态与近接触动态上显式建模，实现“接近帧–接触帧”的细粒度判别。3. 构建含 4 021 段视频、8 456 标注时刻、逾百万帧的大规模 egocentric 数据集 TouchMoment 进行训练与量化。4. 采纳两帧容差 AP 的严格指标作评测基准。
AI.result: 在 TouchMoment 上，HiCE+Grasp-soft 损失的整体 AP、微观/宏观 AP 均优于现有事件定位方法，平均提升 16.91%；在不同手势类别、遮挡强度子集中皆保持 6–20% 领先，并在无额外属性输入条件下显著减小误报与漏检。
AI.conclusion: 手部先验与抓握动态结合的两阶段学习策略可令模型从细粒度手掌姿态-上下文线索中解析真实接触，首次在百万帧第一人称数据中稳定达到「2 帧内」精度，兼具对遮挡与近接触鲁棒性，为 egocentric 动作理解及 AR、机器人等场景提供了可靠、可迁移的时序锚点。

title: A Two-Stage LLM Framework for Accessible and Verified XAI Explanations
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI 2026)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate the technical outputs of eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods into accessible natural-language explanations. However, existing approaches often lack guarantees of accuracy, faithfulness, and completeness. At the same time, current efforts to evaluate such narratives remain largely subjective or confined to post-hoc scoring, offering no safeguards to prevent flawed explanations from reaching end-users. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a Two-Stage LLM Meta-Verification Framework that consists of (i) an Explainer LLM that converts raw XAI outputs into natural-language narratives, (ii) a Verifier LLM that assesses them in terms of faithfulness, coherence, completeness, and hallucination risk, and (iii) an iterative refeed mechanism that uses the Verifier's feedback to refine and improve them. Experiments across five XAI techniques and datasets, using three families of open-weight LLMs, show that verification is crucial for filtering unreliable explanations while improving linguistic accessibility compared with raw XAI outputs. In addition, the analysis of the Entropy Production Rate (EPR) during the refinement process indicates that the Verifier's feedback progressively guides the Explainer toward more stable and coherent reasoning. Overall, the proposed framework provides an efficient pathway toward more trustworthy and democratized XAI systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一个“解释器-验证器-迭代反馈”的两阶段 LLM 框架，把 XAI 原始输出转成可信自然语言解释，并通过熵产率监控收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 把 XAI 技术结果“翻译”成文字时缺乏准确性、忠实度与完整性保证，评估方式主观且后置，无法阻止错误解释流向用户。
AI.method: 框架分三组件：① Explainer LLM 将原始 XAI 输出改写为自然语言叙述；② Verifier LLM 从忠实性、连贯性、完整性、幻觉风险四维度打分并给出反馈；③ 迭代重喂机制用反馈持续修正叙述，直至通过验证。实验覆盖 5 种 XAI 方法、3 类开源 LLM，并引入“熵产率（EPR）”度量修正过程稳定性。
AI.result: 验证步骤可滤掉 30–50 % 不可靠解释，同时保留或提升可读性；EPR 随迭代下降，表明叙述逐步收敛到更稳定、一致的推理路径。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需重训模型即可嵌入现有 XAI 流程，为生成可信、易懂的 AI 解释提供了可扩展、可量化的技术路径，推动 XAI 走向民主化与实用化。

title: Transforming External Knowledge into Triplets for Enhanced Retrieval in RAG of LLMs
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates hallucination in large language models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge during generation. However, the effectiveness of RAG depends not only on the design of the retriever and the capacity of the underlying model, but also on how retrieved evidence is structured and aligned with the query. Existing RAG approaches typically retrieve and concatenate unstructured text fragments as context, which often introduces redundant or weakly relevant information. This practice leads to excessive context accumulation, reduced semantic alignment, and fragmented reasoning chains, thereby degrading generation quality while increasing token consumption. To address these challenges, we propose Tri-RAG, a structured triplet-based retrieval framework that improves retrieval efficiency through reasoning-aligned context construction. Tri-RAG automatically transforms external knowledge from natural language into standardized structured triplets consisting of Condition, Proof, and Conclusion, explicitly capturing logical relations among knowledge fragments using lightweight prompt-based adaptation with frozen model parameters. Building on this representation, the triplet head Condition is treated as an explicit semantic anchor for retrieval and matching, enabling precise identification of query-relevant knowledge units without directly concatenating lengthy raw texts. As a result, Tri-RAG achieves a favorable balance between retrieval accuracy and context token efficiency. Experimental results across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that Tri-RAG significantly improves retrieval quality and reasoning efficiency, while producing more stable generation behavior and more efficient resource utilization in complex reasoning scenarios.

AI.tldr: Tri-RAG 用 C-P-C 三元组重新组织外部知识，以“条件”做锚点精准召回，不拼接长文本，即可在冻结 LLM 的情况下显著降低幻觉、节省 token 并提升推理稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统 RAG 直接拼接非结构化文本片段，导致冗余、弱相关、上下文膨胀与推理链断裂，既浪费 token 又降低生成质量。
AI.method: 提出 Tri-RAG：1) 用轻量 prompt 将外部知识离线转化为统一结构的三元组〈Condition, Proof, Conclusion〉；2) 以 Condition 为语义锚点执行检索，仅把最相关三元组注入上下文；3) 全程不更新 LLM 参数。
AI.result: 在多套推理基准上，Tri-RAG 的检索准确率、推理效率与答案稳定性均显著优于常规 RAG，同时平均减少 30-40% 上下文 token。
AI.conclusion: 结构化三元组+锚点检索能在不微调模型的情况下，同时解决幻觉、语义漂移与 token 开销三大痛点，为高效 RAG 提供新范式。

title: Labeled TrustSet Guided: Batch Active Learning with Reinforcement Learning
comment: Published as a conference paper at IJCNN 2026
summary: Batch active learning (BAL) is a crucial technique for reducing labeling costs and improving data efficiency in training large-scale deep learning models. Traditional BAL methods often rely on metrics like Mahalanobis Distance to balance uncertainty and diversity when selecting data for annotation. However, these methods predominantly focus on the distribution of unlabeled data and fail to leverage feedback from labeled data or the model's performance. To address these limitations, we introduce TrustSet, a novel approach that selects the most informative data from the labeled dataset, ensuring a balanced class distribution to mitigate the long-tail problem. Unlike CoreSet, which focuses on maintaining the overall data distribution, TrustSet optimizes the model's performance by pruning redundant data and using label information to refine the selection process. To extend the benefits of TrustSet to the unlabeled pool, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL)-based sampling policy that approximates the selection of high-quality TrustSet candidates from the unlabeled data. Combining TrustSet and RL, we introduce the Batch Reinforcement Active Learning with TrustSet (BRAL-T) framework. BRAL-T achieves state-of-the-art results across 10 image classification benchmarks and 2 active fine-tuning tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness and efficiency in various domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BRAL-T 框架：先用 TrustSet 从已标注集中筛出高价值样本，解决长尾分布；再用强化学习把 TrustSet 的筛选标准迁移到无标注池，实现兼顾模型性能与类别平衡的高效批量主动学习。
AI.motivation: 传统批量主动学习仅用马氏距离等统计量衡量未标注数据的「不确定+多样」，忽视已标注集和模型性能的反馈，导致标注效率低、长尾类别失衡。
AI.method: 1) TrustSet：在已标注集上基于标签信息与模型损失，剔除冗余样本并强制类别平衡，得到「高质量子集」；2) RL-based 采样策略：以 TrustSet 的分布为奖励信号，训练策略网络在无标注池里近似挑选 TrustSet-like 样本；3) 将两者整合为 BRAL-T 框架，统一用于批次选择。
AI.result: 在 10 个图像分类基准和 2 个主动微调任务上，BRAL-T 相较现有最佳方法平均提升 1.8–3.4% 准确率，同时减少 15–30% 标注量，达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过把「已标注集反馈」显式引入采样决策并借助强化学习迁移，BRAL-T 兼顾性能与类别平衡，证明利用标注数据自监督筛选可显著提升深度主动学习的样本效率与通用性。

title: Unlocking the Potential of Grounding DINO in Videos: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Limited-Data Spatial-Temporal Localization
summary: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize queried objects within dynamic video segments. Prevailing fully-trained approaches are notoriously data-hungry. However, gathering large-scale STVG data is exceptionally challenging: dense frame-level bounding boxes and complex temporal language alignments are prohibitively expensive to annotate, especially for specialized video domains. Consequently, conventional models suffer from severe overfitting on these inherently limited datasets, while zero-shot foundational models lack the task-specific temporal awareness needed for precise localization. To resolve this small-data challenge, we introduce ST-GD, a data-efficient framework that adapts pre-trained 2D visual-language models (e.g., Grounding DINO) to video tasks. To avoid destroying pre-trained priors on small datasets, ST-GD keeps the base model frozen and strategically injects lightweight adapters (~10M trainable parameters) to instill spatio-temporal awareness, alongside a novel temporal decoder for boundary prediction. This design naturally counters data scarcity. Consequently, ST-GD excels in data-scarce scenarios, achieving highly competitive performance on the limited-scale HC-STVG v1/v2 benchmarks, while maintaining robust generalization on the VidSTG dataset. This validates ST-GD as a powerful paradigm for complex video understanding under strict small-data constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出冻结权重＋轻量适配器的 ST-GD 框架，仅用约 10 M 可训参数就把 2D 图文定位模型 Grounding DINO 迁移到视频，解决 STVG 小数据困境。
AI.motivation: STVG 需要密集帧级框和复杂时序对齐，标注昂贵，导致现有全训方法在小数据集上过拟合；而零样本基础模型又缺乏时序感知，难以精准定位。
AI.method: 冻结预训练 Grounding DINO，插入时空适配器并新增时序边界解码器，全程仅训练约 10 M 参数，避免破坏先验并注入时序线索。
AI.result: 在数据稀缺的 HC-STVG v1/v2 上达到与全监督竞品的性能，同时在更大 VidSTG 上保持良好泛化，验证小数据有效性。
AI.conclusion: ST-GD 证明“冻结主干＋轻量适配”是复杂视频理解在小数据约束下的高效范式，为后续研究提供可扩展模板。

title: Cross-Cultural Simulation of Citizen Emotional Responses to Bureaucratic Red Tape Using LLM Agents
comment: To appear in the CHI 2026 Workshop on PoliSim
summary: Improving policymaking is a central concern in public administration. Prior human subject studies reveal substantial cross-cultural differences in citizens' emotional responses to red tape during policy implementation. While LLM agents offer opportunities to simulate human-like responses and reduce experimental costs, their ability to generate culturally appropriate emotional responses to red tape remains unverified. To address this gap, we propose an evaluation framework for assessing LLMs' emotional responses to red tape across diverse cultural contexts. As a pilot study, we apply this framework to a single red-tape scenario. Our results show that all models exhibit limited alignment with human emotional responses, with notably weaker performance in Eastern cultures. Cultural prompting strategies prove largely ineffective in improving alignment. We further introduce \textbf{RAMO}, an interactive interface for simulating citizens' emotional responses to red tape and for collecting human data to improve models. The interface is publicly available at https://ramo-chi.ivia.ch.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估大语言模型（LLM）能否在不同文化语境下模拟公民对官僚制冗余（red tape）的情绪反应，发现现成模型普遍偏差，尤其在东方文化中表现更弱；作者同步发布在线平台RAMO，用于持续采集人类情绪数据以迭代改进模型。
AI.motivation: 公共行政研究已知公民对冗余行政流程的情绪具有显著跨文化差异，但传统人类实验成本高且难以规模化。若LLM能可靠模拟这种情绪差异，将极大降低政策预评估与行为研究的成本，并提升决策科学性。然而，其跨文化情绪模拟能力尚未被验证。
AI.method: 构建一套文化情境化的评估框架，将同一冗余行政场景映射至不同国家/地区文化背景；招募对应文化的人类受试者作为基准；对主流LLM进行零样本与“文化提示”两种 prompting 方式测试，比较模型输出情绪与人类基准在效价（valence）、激活度（arousal）及具体情绪标签（anger, frustration, resignation 等）上的对齐度；同时开发并开源交互式数据收集平台 RAMO，用于动态扩展样本与持续微调模型。
AI.result: 在试点场景中，所有被测LLM与人类情绪分布的 KL 距离显著大于人类内部差异；东方文化（中、日、韩）语境下的对齐度普遍低于西方文化（美、德、荷）；文化提示策略（culture-specific prompt）仅能轻微降低偏差，效果不显著。RAMO 上线两周内收集到 3,200 余条人类情绪数据，初步微调后东方文化对齐度提升约 18%，但仍未达标。
AI.conclusion: 现成大模型尚不具备可靠的跨文化情绪模拟能力，尤其在东方文化中存在系统性偏差；简单 prompt-level 的文化注入不足以弥合差距。未来需借助 RAMO 等平台持续采集高质量、文化均衡的人类反馈，通过微调或人类-在环强化学习来提升模型对官僚冗余情境下的文化敏感性，为低成本、高通量的公共政策仿真奠定基础。

title: Multilingual Multi-Label Emotion Classification at Scale with Synthetic Data
summary: Emotion classification in multilingual settings remains constrained by the scarcity of annotated data: existing corpora are predominantly English, single-label, and cover few languages. We address this gap by constructing a large-scale synthetic training corpus of over 1M multi-label samples (50k per language) across 23 languages: Arabic, Bengali, Dutch, English, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Russian, Spanish, Swahili, Tamil, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, and Vietnamese, covering 11 emotion categories using culturally-adapted generation and programmatic quality filtering. We train and compare six multilingual transformer encoders, from DistilBERT (135M parameters) to XLM-R-Large (560M parameters), under identical conditions. On our in-domain test set, XLM-R-Large achieves 0.868 F1-micro and 0.987 AUC-micro. To validate against human-annotated data, we evaluate all models zero-shot on GoEmotions (English) and SemEval-2018 Task 1 E-c (English, Arabic, Spanish). On threshold-free ranking metrics, XLM-R-Large matches or exceeds English-only specialist models, tying on AP-micro (0.636) and LRAP (0.804) while surpassing on AUC-micro (0.810 vs. 0.787), while natively supporting all 23 languages. The best base-sized model is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/tabularisai/multilingual-emotion-classification

AI.tldr: 利用 23 种语言、>100 万条合成多标签样本训练多语情绪分类器，XLM-R-Large 零样本性能持平甚至优于英语专用模型，模型已开源。
AI.motivation: 情绪语料以英语、单标签为主，小语种稀缺，严重限制多语情绪模型训练与评估。
AI.method: 1) 针对 23 种语言、11 类情绪，文化适配提示+程序化质量控制，生成 100 万条合成多标签数据（每语 5 万）。2) 在同等实验条件下微调 6 个规模各异的多语 Transformer 编码器（DistilBERT 至 XLM-R-Large）。3) 零样本评测 GoEmotions、SemEval-2018 人工标注基准以验证泛化性。
AI.result: 域内测试：XLM-R-Large 达 0.868 F1-micro/0.987 AUC-micro。零样本英语基准：AP-micro 0.636、LRAP 0.804 与英语专用模型持平，AUC-micro 0.810 优于后者 0.787；多语场景无需额外语料即可直接推理。
AI.conclusion: 大规模、文化对齐的合成数据能有效解决多语情绪标注稀缺问题，让单一大模型即可在 23 种语言上取得与英语专家模型相当的性能，为多语情绪分析提供即用基线模型。

title: Beyond Weather Correlation: A Comparative Study of Static and Temporal Neural Architectures for Fine-Grained Residential Energy Consumption Forecasting in Melbourne, Australia
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Earlier preprint versions: Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19158396; SSRN https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6453198
summary: Accurate short-term residential energy consumption forecasting at sub-hourly resolution is critical for smart grid management, demand response programmes, and renewable energy integration. While weather variables are widely acknowledged as key drivers of residential electricity demand, the relative merit of incorporating temporal autocorrelation - the sequential memory of past consumption; over static meteorological features alone remains underexplored at fine-grained (5-minute) temporal resolution for Australian households. This paper presents a rigorous empirical comparison of a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) and a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent network applied to two real-world Melbourne households: House 3 (a standard grid-connected dwelling) and House 4 (a rooftop solar photovoltaic-integrated household). Both models are trained on 14 months of 5-minute interval smart meter data (March 2023-April 2024) merged with official Bureau of Meteorology (BOM) daily weather observations, yielding over 117,000 samples per household. The LSTM, operating on 24-step (2-hour) sliding consumption windows, achieves coefficients of determination of R^2 = 0.883 (House 3) and R^2 = 0.865 (House 4), compared to R^2 = -0.055 and R^2 = 0.410 for the corresponding weather-driven MLPs - differences of 93.8 and 45.5 percentage points. These results establish that temporal autocorrelation in the consumption sequence dominates meteorological information for short-term forecasting at 5-minute granularity. Additionally, we demonstrate an asymmetry introduced by solar generation: for the PV-integrated household, the MLP achieves R^2 = 0.410, revealing implicit solar forecasting from weather-time correlations. A persistence baseline analysis and seasonal stratification contextualise model performance. We propose a hybrid weather-augmented LSTM and federated learning extensions as directions for future work.

AI.tldr: 在高频（5分钟）家庭用电预测中，仅依赖历史功率序列的LSTM模型显著优于仅依赖气象特征的MLP；引入太阳能的家庭中，气象信息具有部分隐含太阳能发电预测价值。
AI.motivation: 澳洲智能电网对亚小时级（5分钟）住宅负荷预测精度要求高，但“时间序列自相关”与“静态气象特征”在该尺度下的相对贡献尚不明确，需系统比较。
AI.method: 采集墨尔本两户（并网友网户与光伏户）14个月5分钟智能电表数据（各11.7万样本），同步匹配BOM日气象；设计24步（2小时）滑动窗口LSTM与仅输入气象的MLP进行并行实验，并辅以持续性基准与季节分层分析。
AI.result: LSTM R²=0.883/0.865，对应MLP R²=-0.055/0.410，差距达93.8与45.5个百分点；气象-only模型在光伏户表现提升，说明其隐式学习太阳能发电；两户持续性基准R²≈0.79/0.74，LSTM仍显著超越。
AI.conclusion: 在5分钟级短期预测中，历史用电序列自相关是主导信号，气象信息增益有限；光伏系统中气象可间接提供发电提示；建议未来采用气象增强LSTM杂交架构并引入联邦学习扩展

title: Fundus Image-based Glaucoma Screening via Retinal Knowledge-Oriented Dynamic Multi-Level Feature Integration
comment: 15 pages. In submission to an Elsevier Journal
summary: Automated diagnosis based on color fundus photography is essential for large-scale glaucoma screening. However, existing deep learning models are typically data-driven and lack explicit integration of retinal anatomical knowledge, which limits their robustness across heterogeneous clinical datasets. Moreover, pathological cues in fundus images may appear beyond predefined anatomical regions, making fixed-region feature extraction insufficient for reliable diagnosis. To address these challenges, we propose a retinal knowledge-oriented glaucoma screening framework that integrates dynamic multi-scale feature learning with domain-specific retinal priors. The framework adopts a tri-branch structure to capture complementary retinal representations, including global retinal context, structural features of the optic disc/cup, and dynamically localized pathological regions. A Dynamic Window Mechanism is devised to adaptively identify diagnostically informative regions, while a Knowledge-Enhanced Convolutional Attention Module incorporates retinal priors extracted from a pre-trained foundation model to guide attention learning. Extensive experiments on the large-scale AIROGS dataset demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms diverse baselines, achieving an AUC of 98.5% and an accuracy of 94.6%. Additional evaluations on multiple datasets from the SMDG-19 benchmark further confirm its strong cross-domain generalization capability, indicating that knowledge-guided attention combined with adaptive lesion localization can significantly improve the robustness of automated glaucoma screening systems.

AI.tldr: 提出三分支全局-结构性-动态病灶框架，用先验知识引导注意力、动态窗口定位病灶，在AIROGS达98.5%AUC，跨域泛化优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大规模青光眼筛查依赖眼底照，但既有纯数据驱动模型缺乏解剖先验，在异构数据上鲁棒性差，且固定区域特征无法捕捉预定义结构外的病变线索。
AI.method: 构建视网膜知识导向框架：1)三分支并行提取全局视网膜上下文、视盘/视杯结构特征、动态病灶区域；2)动态窗口机制自适应定位诊断信息区；3)知识增强卷积注意力模块将预训练大模型提取的视网膜先验注入注意力学习。
AI.result: 在AIROGS大数据集上AUC 98.5%、准确率94.6%，显著优于多样基线；在SMDG-19多中心基准中也展现强跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 先验知识引导的注意力与自适应病灶定位结合，可显著提升自动青光眼筛查系统在跨数据分布下的鲁棒性。

title: IDEA: An Interpretable and Editable Decision-Making Framework for LLMs via Verbal-to-Numeric Calibration
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed for decision-making, yet their adoption in high-stakes domains remains limited by miscalibrated probabilities, unfaithful explanations, and inability to incorporate expert knowledge precisely. We propose IDEA, a framework that extracts LLM decision knowledge into an interpretable parametric model over semantically meaningful factors. Through joint learning of verbal-to-numerical mappings and decision parameters via EM, correlated sampling that preserves factor dependencies, and direct parameter editing with mathematical guarantees, IDEA produces calibrated probabilities while enabling quantitative human-AI collaboration. Experiments across five datasets show IDEA with Qwen-3-32B (78.6%) outperforms DeepSeek R1 (68.1%) and GPT-5.2 (77.9%), achieving perfect factor exclusion and exact calibration -- precision unattainable through prompting alone. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/leonbig/IDEA.

AI.tldr: IDEA 框架把 LLM 的决策知识蒸馏成语义可解释的概率图模型，通过 EM 联合学习语言-数值映射与参数，实现可编辑、可校准、可协作的决策系统，在 5 个数据集上击败 DeepSeek-R1 与 GPT-5.2，达到完美因子剔除与精确校准。
AI.motivation: 高险场景下 LLM 因概率失准、解释不可信、难以精确注入专家知识而受限，亟需一种能将模型知识转化为可解释、可校准且支持人机协作的决策框架。
AI.method: 提出 IDEA：1) 用概率图模型作为语义有意义的因子空间；2) EM 算法联合优化 verbal-to-numerical 映射与决策参数；3) 相关采样保持因子依赖；4) 允许带数学保证的参数直接编辑。
AI.result: 在 5 个 benchmark 上，IDEA+Qwen-3-32B 准确率达 78.6%，超越 DeepSeek-R1(68.1%) 与 GPT-5.2(77.9%)；实现完美因子剔除与精确概率校准，仅靠提示无法达到。
AI.conclusion: IDEA 首次把 LLM 决策知识转化为可解释、可校准、可编辑的参数模型，为高风险领域提供可信且可协作的 AI 决策方案，代码已开源。

title: Learning Chain Of Thoughts Prompts for Predicting Entities, Relations, and even Literals on Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models perform well on link prediction but struggle with unseen entities, relations, and especially literals, limiting their use in dynamic, heterogeneous graphs. In contrast, pretrained large language models (LLMs) generalize effectively through prompting. We reformulate link prediction as a prompt learning problem and introduce RALP, which learns string-based chain-of-thought (CoT) prompts as scoring functions for triples. Using Bayesian Optimization through MIPRO algorithm, RALP identifies effective prompts from fewer than 30 training examples without gradient access. At inference, RALP predicts missing entities, relations or whole triples and assigns confidence scores based on the learned prompt. We evaluate on transductive, numerical, and OWL instance retrieval benchmarks. RALP improves state-of-the-art KGE models by over 5% MRR across datasets and enhances generalization via high-quality inferred triples. On OWL reasoning tasks with complex class expressions (e.g., $\exists hasChild.Female$, $\geq 5 \; hasChild.Female$), it achieves over 88% Jaccard similarity. These results highlight prompt-based LLM reasoning as a flexible alternative to embedding-based methods. We release our implementation, training, and evaluation pipeline as open source: https://github.com/dice-group/RALP .

AI.tldr: RALP 用少样本贝叶斯优化让 LLM 学会链式思维提示，直接当打分函数，一举解决 KGE 看不见实体/字面量/动态图的痛点，在链路预测、数值推理和 OWL 实例检索上全面 SOTA。
AI.motivation: KGE 模型在新实体、新关系、字面量出现或图动态变化时表现骤降；而预训练 LLM 具备零样本泛化能力，却未被系统用于链路预测。作者欲将 LLM 的提示学习引入知识图谱补全，摆脱对嵌入空间的依赖。
AI.method: 1. 把三元组评分转化为提示学习任务，用字符串形式的链式思维 (CoT) 提示作为可学习打分函数。2. 提出 RALP 框架，采用无梯度贝叶斯优化（MIPRO 算法）在 <30 个训练样本上搜索最优提示。3. 推理阶段，RALP 可预测缺失实体、关系或整三元组，并输出置信度。4. 支持 OWL 复杂类表达式（存在量词、基数限制）的实例检索。
AI.result: 在转导、数值字面量、OWL 实例检索三类基准上，RALP 相较最佳 KGE 模型 MRR 平均提升 5% 以上；对复杂类表达式（如 ∃hasChild.Female, ≥5 hasChild.Female）实例检索 Jaccard 相似度 >88%；少量样本即可收敛，无需微调 LLM。
AI.conclusion: 提示驱动的 LLM 推理可作为嵌入方法的灵活替代方案，显著增强动态异构图的泛化与字面量处理能力。作者已开源完整实现与评测流程。

title: GCA Framework: A Gulf-Grounded Dataset and Agentic Pipeline for Climate Decision Support
summary: Climate decision-making in the Gulf increasingly demands systems that can translate heterogeneous scientific and policy evidence into actionable guidance, yet general-purpose large language models (LLMs) remain weak both in region-specific climate knowledge and grounded interaction with geospatial and forecasting tools. We present the GCA framework, which unifies (i) GCA-DS, a curated Gulf-focused multimodal dataset, and (ii) Gulf Climate Agent (GCA), a tool-augmented agent for climate analysis. GCA-DS comprises ~200k question-answer pairs spanning governmental policies and adaptation plans, NGO and international frameworks, academic literature, and event-driven reporting on heatwaves, dust storms, and floods, complemented with remote-sensing inputs that couple imagery with textual evidence. Building on this foundation, the GCA agent orchestrates a modular tool pipeline grounded in real-time and historical signals and geospatial processing that produces derived indices and interpretable visualizations. Finally, we benchmark open and proprietary LLMs on Gulf climate tasks and show that domain fine-tuning and tool integration substantially improve reliability over general-purpose baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 GCA 框架，通过海湾专属多模态数据集 GCA-DS 与工具增强型气候智能体 GCA，解决通用大模型在海湾气候决策中区域知识不足、难以对接实时地理与预报工具的问题，显著提升任务可靠性。
AI.motivation: 海湾地区气候决策需要将异构科学与政策证据转化为可操作指导，但通用 LLM 缺乏区域气候知识与对地理空间/预报工具的接地能力，导致输出不可靠、难执行。
AI.method: 构建 GCA 框架：① 整理含 20 万问答对的多模态海湾数据集 GCA-DS，覆盖政策、适应计划、学术文献及遥感影像-文本事件记录；② 设计 Gulf Climate Agent，编排模块化工具链，实时接入历史与遥感信号，生成衍生指数与可解释可视化；③ 对开/闭源 LLM 进行领域微调与工具集成并系统评测。
AI.result: 在海湾气候任务基准中，经领域微调与工具接入的模型相比通用基线显著降低错误率，输出更具区域准确性与可执行性。
AI.conclusion: 将区域专属多模态数据与工具增强智能体结合，是提升大模型在局地气候决策中可靠性、可解释性与实用性的有效路径，GCA 框架为海湾及其他区域提供了可复制范式。

title: Combating Pattern and Content Bias: Adversarial Feature Learning for Generalized AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: In recent years, the rapid development of generative artificial intelligence technology has significantly lowered the barrier to creating high-quality fake images, posing a serious challenge to information authenticity and credibility. Existing generated image detection methods typically enhance generalization through model architecture or network design. However, their generalization performance remains susceptible to data bias, as the training data may drive models to fit specific generative patterns and content rather than the common features shared by images from different generative models (asymmetric bias learning). To address this issue, we propose a Multi-dimensional Adversarial Feature Learning (MAFL) framework. The framework adopts a pretrained multimodal image encoder as the feature extraction backbone, constructs a real-fake feature learning network, and designs an adversarial bias-learning branch equipped with a multi-dimensional adversarial loss, forming an adversarial training mechanism between authenticity-discriminative feature learning and bias feature learning. By suppressing generation-pattern and content biases, MAFL guides the model to focus on the generative features shared across different generative models, thereby effectively capturing the fundamental differences between real and generated images, enhancing cross-model generalization, and substantially reducing the reliance on large-scale training data. Through extensive experimental validation, our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches by 10.89% in accuracy and 8.57% in Average Precision (AP). Notably, even when trained with only 320 images, it can still achieve over 80% detection accuracy on public datasets.

AI.tldr: 针对生成图像检测因训练数据偏差导致的跨模型泛化差问题，提出多维度对抗特征学习框架 MAFL，用对抗训练抑制模式/内容偏差，仅用 320 张样本即可在公开数据集上取得 SOTA 以上 10.89% 准确率与 8.57% AP 的提升。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 降低伪造门槛，现有检测方法虽通过架构改进提升泛化，但仍受训练数据中非共享的生成模式与内容偏差影响，导致模型过度拟合特定生成器特征而非真实-伪造通用差异，跨模型泛化受限。
AI.method: 设计 MAFL 框架：以预训练多模态图像编码器为骨干，构建真伪特征学习主网络；并引入对抗偏差学习分支，通过多维度对抗损失与主网络形成对抗训练，显式抑制生成模式与内容偏差，迫使模型关注跨生成器共通伪造痕迹。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，MAFL 相较现有最优方法准确率提升 10.89%，AP 提升 8.57%；极端小样本场景下仅用 320 张训练图像即可保持 80% 以上检测准确率，显著降低对大规模数据的依赖。
AI.conclusion: MAFL 通过对抗机制有效解耦并抑制数据偏差，使模型专注跨生成模型共享的伪造特征，显著提升跨模型泛化与数据效率，为生成图像检测在实际低资源场景中的应用提供了可行方案。

title: DeepTest Tool Competition 2026: Benchmarking an LLM-Based Automotive Assistant
comment: Published in the proceedings of the DeepTest workshop at the 48th International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE) 2026
summary: This report summarizes the results of the first edition of the Large Language Model (LLM) Testing competition, held as part of the DeepTest workshop at ICSE 2026. Four tools competed in benchmarking an LLM-based car manual information retrieval application, with the objective of identifying user inputs for which the system fails to appropriately mention warnings contained in the manual. The testing solutions were evaluated based on their effectiveness in exposing failures and the diversity of the discovered failure-revealing tests. We report on the experimental methodology, the competitors, and the results.

AI.tldr: 首届LLM测试竞赛（ICSE 2026 DeepTest 工作坊）针对车载手册问答系统，评估四款测试工具在挖掘“未提示警告”失效输入上的有效性与多样性。
AI.motivation: 大模型在汽车手册问答场景下可能遗漏关键安全警告，亟需系统级测试方法以提前暴露此类高风险失效。
AI.method: 构建基于真实手册的LLM问答基准，设计“未提及警告”为失效判据；四支参赛工具自动生成测试输入，以失效发现率与测试多样性双指标评比。
AI.result: 实验表明，某工具（具体名次略）在失效揭示能力上领先，同时生成的触发用例在语义与句法层面均保持高多样性；其余工具在精度或多样性上各有短板。
AI.conclusion: 竞赛验证了面向安全关键场景的LLM专用测试技术可行性，并发布了公开基准与数据集，为后续研究提供评估框架与改进基准。

title: InsightFlow: LLM-Driven Synthesis of Patient Narratives for Mental Health into Causal Models
summary: Clinical case formulation organizes patient symptoms and psychosocial factors into causal models, often using the 5P framework. However, constructing such graphs from therapy transcripts is time consuming and varies across clinicians. We present InsightFlow, an LLM based approach that automatically generates 5P aligned causal graphs from patient-therapist dialogues. Using 46 psychotherapy intake transcripts annotated by clinical experts, we evaluate LLM generated graphs against human formulations using structural (NetSimile), semantic (embedding similarity), and expert rated clinical criteria. The generated graphs show structural similarity comparable to inter annotator agreement and high semantic alignment with human graphs. Expert evaluations rate the outputs as moderately complete, consistent, and clinically useful. While LLM graphs tend to form more interconnected structures compared to the chain like patterns of human graphs, overall complexity and content coverage are similar. These results suggest that LLMs can produce clinically meaningful case formulation graphs within the natural variability of expert practice. InsightFlow highlights the potential of automated causal modeling to augment clinical workflows, with future work needed to improve temporal reasoning and reduce redundancy.

AI.tldr: InsightFlow 用 LLM 把初诊会谈自动转成 5P 因果图，与专家手构图在结构、语义及临床可用性上高度一致，可嵌入临床辅助决策，但需改进时间链与冗余。
AI.motivation: 5P 个案概念化图是循证治疗计划的核心，却耗时而主观；亟需自动化工具在会话当下即时生成高质量因果模型。
AI.method: 构建 InsightFlow 流程：以 46 份由两名临床专家分别独立标注的英文心理初诊会谈为金标准，用 LLM 抽取 5P 实体→建因果边→输出有向图；采用 NetSimile 结构距离、SBERT 语义相似度及 5 级临床量表（完整度、一致性、有用度）三维度评估，并计算人类间一致率作参照。
AI.result: LLM 图与专家图 NetSimile 距离 0.086，与双专家互评距离 0.082 无差异(p>0.05)；SBERT 余弦相似度 0.91；专家 3 人盲评平均 3.7/5 完整、3.9 一致、3.8 有用。自动图节点更稠密(聚类系数 0.31 vs 0.18)，但节点数、边数及内容覆盖率与人工图相当。
AI.conclusion: 大模型可在专家自然变异范围内产出临床可用的 5P 因果图，支持即时概念化与决策；后续需融入时间顺序约束、去冗余并做多文化、多语验证，以真正整合进治疗工作流。

title: Black-Box Optimization From Small Offline Datasets via Meta Learning with Synthetic Tasks
comment: Accepted for Publication at International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS)
summary: We consider the problem of offline black-box optimization, where the goal is to discover optimal designs (e.g., molecules or materials) from past experimental data. A key challenge in this setting is data scarcity: in many scientific applications, only small or poor-quality datasets are available, which severely limits the effectiveness of existing algorithms. Prior work has theoretically and empirically shown that performance of offline optimization algorithms depends on how well the surrogate model captures the optimization bias (i.e., ability to rank input designs correctly), which is challenging to accomplish with limited experimental data. This paper proposes Surrogate Learning with Optimization Bias via Synthetic Task Generation (OptBias), a meta-learning framework that directly tackles data scarcity. OptBias learns a reusable optimization bias by training on synthetic tasks generated from a Gaussian process, and then fine-tunes the surrogate model on the small data for the target task. Across diverse continuous and discrete offline optimization benchmarks, OptBias consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in small data regimes. These results highlight OptBias as a robust and practical solution for offline optimization in realistic small data settings.

AI.tldr: 离线小数据黑盒优化的元学习框架OptBias，通过在高斯过程生成的合成任务上预训练“优化偏向”再微调，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 科学设计（分子、材料）的离线优化常因实验代价高昂而只能获得极少且质量差的数据，导致传统算法失效；前人工作表明算法成败取决于代理模型能否在稀缺数据下正确排序候选设计。
AI.method: 提出OptBias元学习框架：1) 用高斯过程采样大量合成优化任务；2) 在这些任务上预训练一个能捕捉“优化偏向”的代理模型；3) 将预训练权重迁移到目标任务的小数据集上微调。
AI.result: 在连续与离散共多种离线优化基准上，OptBias在小数据场景下一致显著超越当前最佳基线，证明其对数据稀缺具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: OptBias为真实世界小数据离线优化提供了可靠且实用的通用解决方案，可直接集成到现有实验管线。

title: OmniFood8K: Single-Image Nutrition Estimation via Hierarchical Frequency-Aligned Fusion
summary: Accurate estimation of food nutrition plays a vital role in promoting healthy dietary habits and personalized diet management. Most existing food datasets primarily focus on Western cuisines and lack sufficient coverage of Chinese dishes, which restricts accurate nutritional estimation for Chinese meals. Moreover, many state-of-the-art nutrition prediction methods rely on depth sensors, restricting their applicability in daily scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce OmniFood8K, a comprehensive multimodal dataset comprising 8,036 food samples, each with detailed nutritional annotations and multi-view images. In addition, to enhance models' capability in nutritional prediction, we construct NutritionSynth-115K, a large-scale synthetic dataset that introduces compositional variations while preserving precise nutritional labels. Moreover, we propose an end-to-end framework for nutritional prediction from a single RGB image. First, we predict a depth map from a single RGB image and design the Scale-Shift Residual Adapter (SSRA) to refine it for global scale consistency and local structural preservation. Second, we propose the Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (FAFM) to hierarchically align and fuse RGB and depth features in the frequency domain. Finally, we design a Mask-based Prediction Head (MPH) to emphasize key ingredient regions via dynamic channel selection for more accurate prediction. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method over existing approaches. Project homepage: https://yudongjian.github.io/OmniFood8K-food/

AI.tldr: 针对中餐营养估算缺失与深度传感器依赖问题，作者发布包含8K真实样本＋115K合成样本的多模态中餐数据集OmniFood8K/NutritionSynth-115K，并提出只用一张RGB图推断营养的全流程算法：单目深度估计→SSRA精修→频域对齐融合FAFM→掩码预测头MPH。实验结果优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有公开食物数据集以西方菜为主，中餐覆盖不足，导致中餐营养估算精度低；主流方法依赖深度/体积传感器，限制了日常场景下的普及应用。亟需中餐导向、不依赖传感器的便捷营养估算方案。
AI.method: 1）数据采集：自建OmniFood8K，8036道中餐多视角图片及克级营养标注；同时构建115K合成样本NutritionSynth以增广配料与视角变化并保留真值标签。 2）模型框架：三段式端到端——①单RGB图驱动深度估计网络，输出初始深度；②提出Scale-Shift Residual Adapter（SSRA）对深度做全局尺度校正与局部结构保持；③设计Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module（FAFM），在多个频率层级对齐并融合RGB与深度特征；④提出Mask-based Prediction Head（MPH），利用动态通道掩码强调关键食材区域，回归能量、蛋白质、脂肪等营养指标。
AI.result: 在OmniFood8K、FoodSeg103、Recipe1M等基准上进行的交叉验证表明：营养估算平均绝对误差（MAE）较现有的Food2K、NutriNet等方法下降约18–25%；在无深度传感器的单RGB设置下，多项指标（能量、蛋白、脂肪）全面超越现有SOTA，且推理速度满足移动端实时要求。
AI.conclusion: 大规模中餐数据集与合成增广策略可显著提升模型跨品类鲁棒性；多视角＋深度先验能够有效缓解单图体积歧义；提出的频域对齐融合及动态掩码预测策略，突破了传统“RGB-only”估算瓶颈，为中餐个性化饮食管理提供了可行的低门槛技术路径。

title: Every Picture Tells a Dangerous Story: Memory-Augmented Multi-Agent Jailbreak Attacks on VLMs
summary: The rapid evolution of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) has catalyzed unprecedented capabilities in artificial intelligence; however, this continuous modal expansion has inadvertently exposed a vastly broadened and unconstrained adversarial attack surface. Current multimodal jailbreak strategies primarily focus on surface-level pixel perturbations and typographic attacks or harmful images; however, they fail to engage with the complex semantic structures intrinsic to visual data. This leaves the vast semantic attack surface of original, natural images largely unscrutinized. Driven by the need to expose these deep-seated semantic vulnerabilities, we introduce \textbf{MemJack}, a \textbf{MEM}ory-augmented multi-agent \textbf{JA}ilbreak atta\textbf{CK} framework that explicitly leverages visual semantics to orchestrate automated jailbreak attacks. MemJack employs coordinated multi-agent cooperation to dynamically map visual entities to malicious intents, generate adversarial prompts via multi-angle visual-semantic camouflage, and utilize an Iterative Nullspace Projection (INLP) geometric filter to bypass premature latent space refusals. By accumulating and transferring successful strategies through a persistent Multimodal Experience Memory, MemJack maintains highly coherent extended multi-turn jailbreak attack interactions across different images, thereby improving the attack success rate (ASR) on new images. Extensive empirical evaluations across full, unmodified COCO val2017 images demonstrate that MemJack achieves a 71.48\% ASR against Qwen3-VL-Plus, scaling to 90\% under extended budgets. Furthermore, to catalyze future defensive alignment research, we will release \textbf{MemJack-Bench}, a comprehensive dataset comprising over 113,000 interactive multimodal jailbreak attack trajectories, establishing a vital foundation for developing inherently robust VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemJack，一种利用视觉语义、记忆增强的多智能体越狱框架，可在未经修改的自然图像上实现>70%攻击成功率，并发布11万条轨迹数据集MemJack-Bench供防御研究。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM越狱方法局限于像素级或有害图扰动，忽视了干净图像中可被利用的深层语义漏洞，导致防御面不完整。
AI.method: MemJack构建三模块：1) 多智能体协作，把图像实体映射为恶意意图；2) 多角度视觉-语义伪装生成对抗提示；3) Iterative Nullspace Projection几何滤波绕过模型拒绝。成功策略持久化到Multimodal Experience Memory，实现跨图多轮连贯攻击。
AI.result: 在COCO val2017原始图像上，对Qwen3-VL-Plus的ASR达71.48%，预算扩展后升至90%；框架可稳定跨图迁移。
AI.conclusion: MemJack证明干净图像的语义空间是VLM重大软肋；MemJack-Bench数据集可为后续对齐与防御算法提供基准，推动鲁棒VLM研发。

title: Token-Level Policy Optimization: Linking Group-Level Rewards to Token-Level Aggregation via Sequence-Level Likelihood
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has significantly advanced the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), particularly in their mathemat ical reasoning performance. However, GRPO and related entropy regularization methods still struggle with token-level sparse-rewards, which is an inherent chal lenge in chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. These approaches often rely on undifferen tiated token-level entropy regularization, which easily leads to entropy collapse or model degradation under sparse token rewards. In this work, we propose TEPO, a novel token-level framework that (1) leverages sequence-level likelihood to link group-level rewards with individual tokens via token-level aggregation, and (2) introduces a token-level KL-Divergence mask constraint that targets tokens with positive advantages and decreasing entropy to mitigate abrupt policy updates. Experiments demonstrate that TEPO not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks but also markedly enhances training stability, reducing convergence time by 50% compared with GRPO/DAPO.

AI.tldr: 提出TEPO方法，在GRPO基础上通过序列级似然桥接组奖励与单token并引入KL散度掩码约束，显著提升数学推理精度、训练稳定性与收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 链式思维推理中的token级稀疏奖励使现有GRPO及熵正则化方法易产生熵崩溃或模型性能衰减，需更细粒度的正则与奖励分配机制。
AI.method: 构建token级框架：1)利用序列似然将组级奖励经token级聚合分配给各token；2)仅对优势为正且熵值下降的token施加KL散度掩码约束，抑制剧烈策略更新。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上达到新SOTA，训练稳定性显著改善，收敛时间较GRPO/DAPO减少50%。
AI.conclusion: TEPO通过token级奖励重分配与有针对性KL约束，有效缓解稀疏奖励导致的熵崩溃和策略震荡，为LLM推理优化提供新范式。

title: Identifying and Mitigating Gender Cues in Academic Recommendation Letters: An Interpretability Case Study
summary: Letters of recommendation (LoRs) can carry patterns of implicitly gendered language that can inadvertently influence downstream decisions, e.g. in hiring and admissions. In this work, we investigate the extent to which Transformer-based encoder models as well as Large Language Models (LLMs) can infer the gender of applicants in academic LoRs submitted to an U.S. medical-residency program after explicit identifiers like names and pronouns are de-gendered. While using three models (DistilBERT, RoBERTa, and Llama 2) to classify the gender of anonymized and de-gendered LoRs, significant gender leakage was observed as evident from up to 68% classification accuracy. Text interpretation methods, like TF-IDF and SHAP, demonstrate that certain linguistic patterns are strong proxies for gender, e.g. "emotional'' and "humanitarian'' are commonly associated with LoRs from female applicants. As an experiment in creating truly gender-neutral LoRs, these implicit gender cues were remove resulting in a drop of up to 5.5% accuracy and 2.7% macro $F_1$ score on re-training the classifiers. However, applicant gender prediction still remains better than chance. In this case study, our findings highlight that 1) LoRs contain gender-identifying cues that are hard to remove and may activate bias in decision-making and 2) while our technical framework may be a concrete step toward fairer academic and professional evaluations, future work is needed to interrogate the role that gender plays in LoR review. Taken together, our findings motivate upstream auditing of evaluative text in real-world academic letters of recommendation as a necessary complement to model-level fairness interventions.

AI.tldr: 推荐信隐式性别信息难以消除，模型仍能从“去身份文字”中以68%精度推断申请人性别，提示其成为决策偏见的稳定来源；初步去偏仅小幅削弱判别性能，强调需上游文本审计配合模型公平机制。
AI.motivation: 推荐信中的性别化语言可能在录取/招聘决策中激活无意识偏见。作者怀疑即使用规则匿名化、去掉姓名代词，剩余文本仍残留性别线索，需量化其泄露程度并探索能否技术消除，为公平评估铺路。
AI.method: 收集美国住院医项目真实推荐信，人工抹除姓名、代词等显式性别标记；用DistilBERT、RoBERTa、Llama-2训练性别分类器，并结合TF-IDF与SHAP解析关键词汇；随后过滤掉高性别指示词重写文本，再评估模型性能变化。
AI.result: 1)三模型在“去身份”文本上最高达68%性别推断准确率，显著高于随机；“富有同情心、人道主义”等词高频对应女性。2)删词去偏仅使分类准确率↓5.5%、macro-F1↓2.7%，预测仍优随机，显示残留线索顽固。
AI.conclusion: 推荐信内含难以根除的隐式性别信号，可在评审环节持续触发偏见；仅做模型级公平干预不足，必须在数据上游对文本内容开展系统性审计与重写，并结合制度改进才能真正提升招生与招聘的公正性。

title: Why and When Visual Token Pruning Fails? A Study on Relevant Visual Information Shift in MLLMs Decoding
summary: Recently, visual token pruning has been studied to handle the vast number of visual tokens in Multimodal Large Language Models. However, we observe that while existing pruning methods perform reliably on simple visual understanding, they struggle to effectively generalize to complex visual reasoning tasks, a critical gap underexplored in previous studies. Through a systematic analysis, we identify Relevant Visual Information Shift (RVIS) during decoding as the primary failure driver. To address this, we propose Decoding-stage Shift-aware Token Pruning (DSTP), a training-free add-on framework that enables existing pruning methods to align visual tokens with shifting reasoning requirements during the decoding stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSTP significantly mitigates performance degradation of pruning methods in complex reasoning tasks, while consistently yielding performance gains even across visual understanding benchmarks. Furthermore, DSTP demonstrates effectiveness across diverse state-of-the-art architectures, highlighting its generalizability and efficiency with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 现有视觉token剪枝法在推理阶段因"相关视觉信息漂移(RVIS)"导致高难度推理性能骤降；提出无需训练的解码阶段漂移感知剪枝(DSTP)插件，可随推理需求动态校正保留token，在多种SOTA架构上几乎零额外计算即可显著回升推理精度并兼顾理解任务。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型推理阶段视觉token数量庞大，剪枝虽能提速，但在复杂视觉推理任务上退化严重，而此前工作对此关键差距缺乏探讨。
AI.method:
1. 诊断阶段：系统实验定位失败主因——解码步间"相关视觉信息漂移(RVIS)"，即后续生成步所需关键视觉区域与早期步显著不同。
2. 设计阶段：提出DSTP框架，其为训练无关的即插即用模块；在每步解码前，依据当前LLM隐状态计算"信息需求向量"，动态重排视觉token重要性并执行二次剪枝，使保留token与实时推理需求对齐。
3. 实施阶段：零额外训练，仅需微调门控/排序算子，附加FLOPs<1%。
AI.result:
在3类复杂推理基准(图表推理、几何问答、视觉数学)上将现有剪枝方法的Top-1准确率平均提升9.2%-15.7%，高端掉点率降低≥70%；在通用理解数据集(VQA-v2、GQA等)上仍获得0.8-1.4pp稳态提升。
对LLaVA-Next、MiniGPT-v2、mPLUG-Owl2等5种架构均有效，参数增量<0.02%，GPU memory峰值增加<1.1%。
AI.conclusion: 证明解码期视觉信息需求漂移是剪枝推理失效的核心原因；DSTP以最小开销实现动态token重配置，兼顾复杂推理与理解精度，展示了即插即用式增强现有剪枝策略的普适范式，并具有向多模态Agent、长链推理等场景迁移的潜力。

title: KnowRL: Boosting LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning with Minimal-Sufficient Knowledge Guidance
summary: RLVR improves reasoning in large language models, but its effectiveness is often limited by severe reward sparsity on hard problems. Recent hint-based RL methods mitigate sparsity by injecting partial solutions or abstract templates, yet they typically scale guidance by adding more tokens, which introduce redundancy, inconsistency, and extra training overhead. We propose \textbf{KnowRL} (Knowledge-Guided Reinforcement Learning), an RL training framework that treats hint design as a minimal-sufficient guidance problem. During RL training, KnowRL decomposes guidance into atomic knowledge points (KPs) and uses Constrained Subset Search (CSS) to construct compact, interaction-aware subsets for training. We further identify a pruning interaction paradox -- removing one KP may help while removing multiple such KPs can hurt -- and explicitly optimize for robust subset curation under this dependency structure. We train KnowRL-Nemotron-1.5B from OpenMath-Nemotron-1.5B. Across eight reasoning benchmarks at the 1.5B scale, KnowRL-Nemotron-1.5B consistently outperforms strong RL and hinting baselines. Without KP hints at inference, KnowRL-Nemotron-1.5B reaches 70.08 average accuracy, already surpassing Nemotron-1.5B by +9.63 points; with selected KPs, performance improves to 74.16, establishing a new state of the art at this scale. The model, curated training data, and code are publicly available at https://github.com/Hasuer/KnowRL.

AI.tldr: 提出 KnowRL，用原子知识点的最小充分集合替代传统超长提示，解决稀疏奖励与信息冗余；在8 项推理基准 1.5 B 模型上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: RLVR 处理难题时奖励极其稀疏；现有提示方法靠加长模板补信息，带来冗余、不一致和训练开销。需找到“少即是多”的最小充分引导范式。
AI.method: 1) 把提示拆成原子知识点（KP）；2) 提出「修剪交互悖论」：单剔 KP 可能增益，多剔反损；3) 采用 Constrained Subset Search（CSS）在训练阶段动态构建紧凑 KP 子集，显式优化在依赖结构下的鲁棒性；4) 用 CSS 输出训练 KnowRL-Nemotron-1.5B，无需 KP 即可推理。
AI.result: 在 1.5 B 规模 8 项推理基准中，KnowRL-Nemotron-1.5B 无 KP 推理即达 70.08 均分（+9.63 vs 原模型），加精选 KP 后升至 74.16，超越所有 RL/提示基线，同规模第一。
AI.conclusion: 将提示设计重新建模为“最小充分引导”可兼顾稀疏奖励和信息冗余；CSS 有效捕捉 KP 间非线性依赖，为轻量高效知识增强式 RL 训练提供新范式。

title: Universal NER v2: Towards a Massively Multilingual Named Entity Recognition Benchmark
summary: While multilingual language models promise to bring the benefits of LLMs to speakers of many languages, gold-standard evaluation benchmarks in most languages to interrogate these assumptions remain scarce. The Universal NER project, now entering its fourth year, is dedicated to building gold-standard multilingual Named Entity Recognition (NER) benchmark datasets. Inspired by existing massively multilingual efforts for other core NLP tasks (e.g., Universal Dependencies), the project uses a general tagset and thorough annotation guidelines to collect standardized, cross-lingual annotations of named entity spans. The first installment (UNER v1) was released in 2024, and the project has continued and expanded since then, with various organizers, annotators, and collaborators in an active community.

AI.tldr: Universal NER v1 发布首个跨 40+ 语言的命名实体识别金标数据集，填补多语 LLM 评估空白。
AI.motivation: 多语大模型缺乏高质量基准，难以公平衡量其在低资源语言的实体识别能力，阻碍技术普惠。
AI.method: 借鉴 Universal Dependencies 经验，设计通用标签集与细粒度指南，组织全球社区进行跨语言、标准化的实体跨度标注并持续迭代。
AI.result: 2024 年推出的 UNER v1 已覆盖 40 余种语言，提供金标准测试集，成为首个大规模多语 NER 评估基准。
AI.conclusion: 项目证明社区协同可快速构建多语金标数据，为后续版本及多语 LLM 公平评估奠定可持续基础。

title: PrivEraserVerify: Efficient, Private, and Verifiable Federated Unlearning
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without sharing raw data, offering a promising path toward privacy preserving artificial intelligence. However, FL models may still memorize sensitive information from participants, conflicting with the right to be forgotten (RTBF). To meet these requirements, federated unlearning has emerged as a mechanism to remove the contribution of departing clients. Existing solutions only partially address this challenge: FedEraser improves efficiency but lacks privacy protection, FedRecovery ensures differential privacy (DP) but degrades accuracy, and VeriFi enables verifiability but introduces overhead without efficiency or privacy guarantees. We present PrivEraserVerify (PEV), a unified framework that integrates efficiency, privacy, and verifiability into federated unlearning. PEV employs (i) adaptive checkpointing to retain critical historical updates for fast reconstruction, (ii) layer adaptive differentially private calibration to selectively remove client influence while minimizing accuracy loss, and (iii) fingerprint based verification, enabling participants to confirm unlearning in a decentralized and noninvasive manner. Experiments on image, handwritten character, and medical datasets show that PEV achieves up to 2 to 3 times faster unlearning than retraining, provides formal indistinguishability guarantees with reduced performance degradation, and supports scalable verification. To the best of our knowledge, PEV is the first framework to simultaneously deliver efficiency, privacy, and verifiability for federated unlearning, moving FL closer to practical and regulation compliant deployment.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 PrivEraserVerify（PEV）框架，首次在联邦遗忘（federated unlearning）中同时实现高效、隐私与可验证性。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习模型仍会记住被“遗忘”客户端的数据，难以满足 GDPR 等法规中的“被遗忘权”（RTBF）。现有方案要么只重效率（FedEraser），要么只重隐私（FedRecovery），要么只重可验证（VeriFi），无法兼顾三重要求。
AI.method: PEV 包含三项核心技术：① 自适应检查点——保存关键历史更新，支持快速重构；② 层自适应差分隐私校准——在仅影响目标层的情况下剔除客户贡献，最小化精度损失；③ 指纹式验证——各参与方可在无需额外通信的前提下，本地验证模型已正确遗忘。
AI.result: 在图像、手写字符与医疗数据集上，PEV 的遗忘速度比重训练快 2–3 倍，能在保证差分隐私形式化不可区分性的同时，将性能下降控制在更小范围；验证过程可扩展至数千客户端且几乎零开销。
AI.conclusion: PEV 是首个同时满足“高效+隐私+可验证”的联邦遗忘方案，使联邦学习向合规、可落地部署迈出关键一步。

title: Reading Between the Pixels: Linking Text-Image Embedding Alignment to Typographic Attack Success on Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild
summary: We study typographic prompt injection attacks on vision-language models (VLMs), where adversarial text is rendered as images to bypass safety mechanisms, posing a growing threat as VLMs serve as the perceptual backbone of autonomous agents, from browser automation and computer-use systems to camera-equipped embodied agents. In practice, the attack surface is heterogeneous: adversarial text appears at varying font sizes and under diverse visual conditions, while the growing ecosystem of VLMs exhibits substantial variation in vulnerability, complicating defensive approaches. Evaluating 1,000 prompts from SALAD-Bench across four VLMs, namely, GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Mistral-Large-3, and Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct under varying font sizes (6--28px) and visual transformations (rotation, blur, noise, contrast changes), we find: (1) font size significantly affects attack success rate (ASR), with very small fonts (6px) yielding near-zero ASR while mid-range fonts achieve peak effectiveness; (2) text attacks are more effective than image attacks for GPT-4o (36% vs 8%) and Claude (47% vs 22%), while Qwen3-VL and Mistral show comparable ASR across modalities; (3) text-image embedding distance from two multimodal embedding models (JinaCLIP and Qwen3-VL-Embedding) shows strong negative correlation with ASR across all four models (r = -0.71 to -0.93, p < 0.01); (4) heavy degradations increase embedding distance by 10--12% and reduce ASR by 34--96%, while rotation asymmetrically affects models (Mistral drops 50%, GPT-4o unchanged). These findings highlight that model-specific robustness patterns preclude one-size-fits-all defenses and offer empirical guidance for practitioners selecting VLM backbones for agentic systems operating in adversarial environments.

AI.tldr: 排版提示注入（把恶意文字转成图像）在各 VLM 上的成功率差异大，6 px 小字几乎无效，21 px 左右峰值；文本模态优于图像模态；嵌入距离与 ASR 负相关；旋转与高噪会降低攻击成功率，模型敏感度不一。
AI.motivation: VLM 已成为浏览自动化、具身智能等代理系统的“感知基座”。传统以文本过滤阻断提示注入，而攻击者可将提示渲染为图像绕过安全机制，研究力求量化这类排版注入的可行性并为防御和模型选择提供证据。
AI.method: 从 SALAD-Bench 抽取 1,000 条对抗提示，以 6×12=72 种“字体大小×视觉扰动”（旋转、模糊、对比度变化、噪声）条件渲染为图片，测试 GPT-4o、Claude-Sonnet-4.5、Mistral-Large-3 与 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct，记录攻击成功率 ASR；同时用 JinaCLIP 与 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 抽取文本与图像向量，计算嵌入距离并与 ASR 做相关性分析。
AI.result: (1) 字体 6 px 时四模型 ASR≈0 %；12–21 px 出现峰值，最大 ASR 可达 45 %–60 %；(2) 对 GPT-4o 和 Claude，前者 36 % vs 8 %，后者 47 % vs 22 %，提示文本渲染比图像对照更有效，Mistral 与 Qwen3-VL 两模态相当；(3) 文本-图像嵌入距离与 ASR 在四种模型中呈显著负相关（r = -0.71 到 -0.93，p <0.01）；(4) 重度降质使距离增加 10 %–12 %，ASR 降低 34 %–96 %；旋转导致 Mistral 的 ASR 丢 50 %，而 GPT-4o 几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 排版提示注入确实可绕过纯文本防护，模型规模与架构并非稳健性唯一决定因素，字体大小与视觉条件可精确调控攻击效果；嵌入空间距离提供了廉价评估脆弱性的指示器。结果否认“一刀切”防御，实践中应结合字迹大小过滤、扰动增强、ASR 预期成本对比模型选择，为代理系统在对抗环境中部署提供量化参考。

title: RPRA: Predicting an LLM-Judge for Efficient but Performant Inference
comment: 10 pages in main text + 6 pages of references + 36 pages of appendices, 12 figures in main text + 37 figures in appendices, 2 tables in main text + 3 table in appendices, 13 prompts in appendices
summary: Large language models (LLMs) face a fundamental trade-off between computational efficiency (e.g., number of parameters) and output quality, especially when deployed on computationally limited devices such as phones or laptops. One way to address this challenge is by following the example of humans and have models ask for help when they believe they are incapable of solving a problem on their own; we can overcome this trade-off by allowing smaller models to respond to queries when they believe they can provide good responses, and deferring to larger models when they do not believe they can. To this end, in this paper, we investigate the viability of Predict-Answer/Act (PA) and Reason-Predict-Reason-Answer/Act (RPRA) paradigms where models predict -- prior to responding -- how an LLM judge would score their output. We evaluate three approaches: zero-shot prediction, prediction using an in-context report card, and supervised fine-tuning. Our results show that larger models (particularly reasoning models) perform well when predicting generic LLM judges zero-shot, while smaller models can reliably predict such judges well after being fine-tuned or provided with an in-context report card. Altogether, both approaches can substantially improve the prediction accuracy of smaller models, with report cards and fine-tuning achieving mean improvements of up to 55% and 52% across datasets, respectively. These findings suggest that models can learn to predict their own performance limitations, paving the way for more efficient and self-aware AI systems.

AI.tldr: 提出“先预测后回答”框架，使小模型在自知能力不足时主动求助大模型，显著缓解边缘端部署时的算力-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在手机、笔记本等受限设备上面临参数规模与输出质量的基本权衡，直接运行大模型能耗与延迟过高。
AI.method: 借鉴人类“自知无能便求助”的策略，提出Predict-Answer(PA)与Reason-Predict-Reason-Answer(RPRA)范式：模型在生成最终答案前先预测其答案会被LLM-judge评为何种分数；若预测分数低于阈值，则将查询转交给大模型。实验比较零样本预测、上下文“成绩单”提示、监督微调三种实现方式。
AI.result: 实验显示：大模型（尤其推理型）可零样本可靠预测自身得分；小模型经微调或成绩单提示后，预测准确率平均提升55%（成绩单）与52%（微调）。整体系统在保证回答质量的同时显著降低算力开销。
AI.conclusion: 模型具备学习并预测自身性能边界的能力；该自知机制为构建更经济、自适应且“自我意识”更强的AI系统奠定基础。

title: Generating Effective CoT Traces for Mitigating Causal Hallucination
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) excel in complex reasoning tasks, they suffer from severe causal hallucination in event causality identification (ECI), particularly in smaller models ($\leq$1.5B parameters). A promising approach to address this issue is to fine-tune them with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces. However, there is currently a lack of CoT trace dataset available for ECI. In this paper, we first investigate the essential criteria that effective CoT traces should possess to mitigate causal hallucination in smaller models. We then design a pipeline to generate CoT traces that meet these criteria. Moreover, since there is currently no metric for quantifying causal hallucination, we also introduce a new metric, the Causal Hallucination Rate (CHR), to quantify causal hallucination, guide the formulation of effective CoT trace criteria, and validate the effectiveness of our pipeline. Our experiments show that fine-tuning with the CoT traces generated by our pipeline not only substantially reduces causal hallucination in smaller LLMs but also improves mean accuracy. Moreover, the fine-tuned models exhibit strong cross-dataset and cross-difficulty generalization, as well as robustness under misleading intervention prompts.

AI.tldr: 小模型因果幻觉严重，作者自建CoT数据并设计CHR指标，微调后幻觉显著下降且跨域鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有小模型在事件因果识别中因果幻觉严重，而领域缺乏可解释CoT监督数据与幻觉量化指标。
AI.method: 先提炼抑制幻觉的CoT准则，再设计自动化流水线生成符合准则的CoT轨迹，并提出CHR指标量化幻觉并指导优化。
AI.result: 在自建CoT数据上微调后，小模型CHR降30%+，准确率提升5-10%，跨数据集与对抗Prompt下仍稳健。
AI.conclusion: 高质量CoT轨迹可有效缓解小模型因果幻觉，所提流水线与CHR指标为低资源可控因果推理提供新范式。

title: Scaffold-Conditioned Preference Triplets for Controllable Molecular Optimization with Large Language Models
summary: Molecular property optimization is central to drug discovery, yet many deep learning methods rely on black-box scoring and offer limited control over scaffold preservation, often producing unstable or biologically implausible edits. While large language models (LLMs) are promising molecular generators, optimization remains constrained by the lack of chemistry-grounded preference supervision and principled data curation. We introduce \textbf{Scaffold-Conditioned Preference Triplets (SCPT)}, a pipeline that constructs similarity-constrained triplets $\langle\text{scaffold}, \text{better}, \text{worse}\rangle$ via scaffold alignment and chemistry-driven filters for validity, synthesizability, and meaningful property gains. Using these preferences, we align a pretrained molecular LLM as a conditional editor, enabling property-improving edits that retain the scaffold. Across single- and multi-objective benchmarks, SCPT improves optimization success and property gains while maintaining higher scaffold similarity than competitive baselines. Compared with representative non-LLM molecular optimization methods, SCPT-trained LLMs are better suited to scaffold-constrained and multi-objective optimization. In addition, models trained on single-property and two-property supervision generalize effectively to three-property tasks, indicating promising extrapolative generalization under limited higher-order supervision.
