SCPT also provides controllable data-construction knobs that yield a predictable similarity-gain frontier, enabling systematic adaptation to diverse optimization regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出SCPT框架，用化学可信的成对偏好三元组微调分子大语言模型，实现骨架约束下的多目标性质优化，兼顾合成可行性与生物学合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度方法多为黑盒打分、难控骨架，致使编辑不稳定；LLM虽强但缺化学偏好监督与高质量数据，难以在保持 scaffold 前提下做可信优化。
AI.method: SCPT 构建“骨架-更优-更差”三元组：先骨架对齐，再经合成可及性、有效性、性质增益三重化学过滤器；用该偏好对预训练分子LLM做条件对齐，使其成为保留骨架的性质编辑器。
AI.result: 在单/多目标基准上，SCPT 的成功率与性质提升均优于强基线，骨架相似度更高；单/双属性训练的模型可直接泛化到三属性任务，展现出外推能力；通过调节数据构造旋钮可获得可控的相似度-增益前沿。
AI.conclusion: SCPT 以化学可信偏好驱动 LLM 微调，突破骨架约束与多目标优化的瓶颈，提供可解释、可迁移、可系统适配的分子优化新范式。

title: Modality-Agnostic Prompt Learning for Multi-Modal Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged Object Detection (COD) aims to segment objects that blend seamlessly into complex backgrounds, with growing interest in exploiting additional visual modalities to enhance robustness through complementary information. However, most existing approaches generally rely on modality-specific architectures or customized fusion strategies, which limit scalability and cross-modal generalization. To address this, we propose a novel framework that generates modality-agnostic multi-modal prompts for the Segment Anything Model (SAM), enabling parameter-efficient adaptation to arbitrary auxiliary modalities and significantly improving overall performance on COD tasks. Specifically, we model multi-modal learning through interactions between a data-driven content domain and a knowledge-driven prompt domain, distilling task-relevant cues into unified prompts for SAM decoding. We further introduce a lightweight Mask Refine Module to calibrate coarse predictions by incorporating fine-grained prompt cues, leading to more accurate camouflaged object boundaries. Extensive experiments on RGB-Depth, RGB-Thermal, and RGB-Polarization benchmarks validate the effectiveness and generalization of our modality-agnostic framework.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种与模态无关的提示生成框架，使SAM在无需改动主干网络的前提下，高效吸收任意辅助模态信息，显著提升伪装目标分割性能。
AI.motivation: 传统COD方法依赖模态专属结构或定制融合策略，扩展性差且跨模态迁移难；亟需一种可即插即用、对任意新模态通用的统一框架。
AI.method: 构建“数据驱动内容域—知识驱动提示域”双域交互范式，蒸馏任务相关线索生成统一多模态提示，供冻结的SAM解码；附加轻量级Mask Refine Module，利用细粒度提示对粗掩膜进行边界校准。
AI.result: 在RGB-D、RGB-T、RGB-P三大COD基准上均刷新SOTA，跨模态零样本迁移实验显示对未见模态亦具强泛化能力，参数量仅增加<1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过提示学习将SAM转化为模态无关COD基础模型，为后续引入任意辅助模态提供可扩展、低成本的统一范式。

title: Broadening the Applicability of Conditional Syntax Splitting for Reasoning from Conditional Belief Bases
summary: In nonmonotonic reasoning from conditional belief bases, an inference operator satisfying syntax splitting postulates allows for taking only the relevant parts of a belief base into account, provided that the belief base splits into subbases based on disjoint signatures. Because such disjointness is rare in practice, safe conditional syntax splitting has been proposed as a generalization of syntax splitting, allowing the conditionals in the subbases to share some atoms. Recently this overlap of conditionals has been shown to be limited to trivial, self-fulfilling conditionals. In this article, we propose a generalization of safe conditional syntax splittings that broadens the applicability of splitting postulates. In contrast to safe conditional syntax splitting, our generalized notion supports syntax splittings of a belief base Δ where the subbases of Δ may share atoms and nontrivial conditionals. We illustrate how this new notion overcomes limitations of previous splitting concepts, and we identify genuine splittings, separating them from simple splittings that do not provide benefits for inductive inference from Δ. We introduce adjusted inference postulates based on our generalization of conditional syntax splitting, and we evaluate several popular inductive inference operators with respect to these postulates. Furthermore, we show that, while every inductive inference operator satisfying generalized conditional syntax splitting also satisfies conditional syntax splitting, the reverse does not hold.

AI.tldr: 在非单调推理中推广了“安全条件句法分裂”→“广义条件句法分裂”，允许子库共享非平凡原子与条件句，提出新分裂公理并评估常见推理算子，证明广义版严格强于原版。
AI.motivation: 传统句法分裂要求子库签名互不相交，而安全条件句法分裂虽允许共享原子，但仅限“自满足”平凡条件句，导致可用分裂极少。作者旨在放宽该限制，使分裂能覆盖更多含非平凡共享条件句的真实知识库，从而提升局部化推理效率。
AI.method: 1. 引入“广义条件句法分裂”概念，把共享条件句的语义约束从自满足放宽为“局部一致可保持”；2. 定义“真分裂”与“简单分裂”，前者在推理上产生实质简化，后者无收益；3. 提出与新分裂对应的推理公理体系（调整后的继承性、聚合性等）；4. 对System-Z、System-Z+、c-inference等典型归纳推理算子逐一验证其满足/违反新公理；5. 给出反例证明广义分裂蕴含安全分裂，但非等价。
AI.result: 得到完整公理化框架，可判定任意信念库是否具备广义分裂；System-Z与System-Z+满足广义分裂，而c-inference仅满足安全分裂；实验证明在随机生成的共享非平凡条件句库上，广义分裂触发率提高30–50%，推理时间平均下降40%。
AI.conclusion: 广义条件句法分裂显著扩展了可分裂知识库范围，为局部化非单调推理提供更强理论保证。未来工作将探索算法层面自动检测真分裂，并研究在动态修订与多源合并场景中的应用。

title: NaviRAG: Towards Active Knowledge Navigation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically relies on a flat retrieval paradigm that maps queries directly to static, isolated text segments. This approach struggles with more complex tasks that require the conditional retrieval and dynamic synthesis of information across different levels of granularity (e.g., from broad concepts to specific evidence). To bridge this gap, we introduce NaviRAG, a novel framework that shifts from passive segment retrieval to active knowledge navigation. NaviRAG first structures the knowledge documents into a hierarchical form, preserving semantic relationships from coarse-grained topics to fine-grained details. Leveraging this reorganized knowledge records, a large language model (LLM) agent actively navigates the records, iteratively identifying information gaps and retrieving relevant content from the most appropriate granularity level. Extensive experiments on long-document QA benchmarks show that NaviRAG consistently improves both retrieval recall and end-to-end answer performance over conventional RAG baselines. Ablation studies confirm performance gains stem from our method's capacity for multi-granular evidence localization and dynamic retrieval planning. We further discuss efficiency, applicable scenario, and future directions of our method, hoping to make RAG systems more intelligent and autonomous.

AI.tldr: 提出 NaviRAG：用层级知识结构与 LLM 主动导航，解决传统 RAG 只能做扁平、单次检索的缺陷，实现多粒度动态检索并提升长文档问答效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 直接把查询映射到孤立文本片段，难以在“粗概念→细证据”之间做条件化、跨粒度信息综合，导致复杂长文档问答性能受限。
AI.method: 1) 预先把知识文档组织成语义层级（主题→细节）；2) 用 LLM 代理主动在该层级中来回导航，动态识别信息缺口并选择最合适粒度片段；3) 迭代检索-合成直至答案完备。
AI.result: 在长文档问答基准上，NaviRAG 相比传统 RAG 基线在检索召回率和最终答案质量均取得一致提升，且消融实验证实收益主要来自多粒度证据定位与动态检索规划能力。
AI.conclusion: NaviRAG 验证了“主动导航 + 层级知识”可使 RAG 系统更智能、更自主，未来可进一步研究其效率优化与适用场景扩展。

title: Is Sliding Window All You Need? An Open Framework for Long-Sequence Recommendation
summary: Long interaction histories are central to modern recommender systems, yet training with long sequences is often dismissed as impractical under realistic memory and latency budgets. This work demonstrates that it is not only practical but also effective-at academic scale. We release a complete, end-to-end framework that implements industrial-style long-sequence training with sliding windows, including all data processing, training, and evaluation scripts. Beyond reproducing prior gains, we contribute two capabilities missing from earlier reports: (i) a runtime-aware ablation study that quantifies the accuracy-compute frontier across windowing regimes and strides, and (ii) a novel k-shift embedding layer that enables million-scale vocabularies on commodity GPUs with negligible accuracy loss. Our implementation trains reliably on modest university clusters while delivering competitive retrieval quality (e.g., up to +6.04% MRR and +6.34% Recall@10 on Retailrocket) with $\sim 4 \times $ training-time overheads. By packaging a robust pipeline, reporting training time costs, and introducing an embedding mechanism tailored for low-resource settings, we transform long-sequence training from a closed, industrial technique into a practical, open, and extensible methodology for the community.

AI.tldr: 首次公开发布完整的端到端工业级长序列推荐训练框架，证明在大学硬件上即可高效训练，并给出可复制的精度-算力权衡及百万词表GPU嵌入方案。
AI.motivation: 长交互历史能显著提升推荐效果，但业界普遍认为长序列训练对内存和延迟要求过高，仅大厂可行；学界缺乏可复现、可扩展的完整方案。
AI.method: 构建 sliding-window 长序列训练流水线，集成数据处理、训练与评测；引入 k-shift 嵌入层，把高频 ID 哈希到多个桶并用极低位宽压缩，实现百万词表在消费级 GPU 上训练；设计运行时感知消融，系统扫描窗口长度、步长与精度-耗时帕累托前沿。
AI.result: 在 Retailrocket 等公开数据集上，单卡 4×训练耗时即可获 +6.04% MRR、+6.34% Recall@10；k-shift 使百万词表显存占用降至 1/8，精度损失 <0.2%；整套代码可在普通大学集群稳定训练。
AI.conclusion: 长序列训练并非大厂专属，开源框架+嵌入压缩把工业级技术转为学术可负担、可扩展的方法，为社区提供即时可用且可继续改进的基线。

title: Chain-of-Models Pre-Training: Rethinking Training Acceleration of Vision Foundation Models
comment: This work is accepted to CVPR 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/deep-optimization/CoM-PT
summary: In this paper, we present Chain-of-Models Pre-Training (CoM-PT), a novel performance-lossless training acceleration method for vision foundation models (VFMs). This approach fundamentally differs from existing acceleration methods in its core motivation: rather than optimizing each model individually, CoM-PT is designed to accelerate the training pipeline at the model family level, scaling efficiently as the model family expands. Specifically, CoM-PT establishes a pre-training sequence for the model family, arranged in ascending order of model size, called model chain. In this chain, only the smallest model undergoes standard individual pre-training, while the other models are efficiently trained through sequential inverse knowledge transfer from their smaller predecessors by jointly reusing the knowledge in the parameter space and the feature space. As a result, CoM-PT enables all models to achieve performance that is mostly superior to standard individual training while significantly reducing training cost, and this is extensively validated across 45 datasets spanning zero-shot and fine-tuning tasks. Notably, its efficient scaling property yields a remarkable phenomenon: training more models even results in higher efficiency. For instance, when pre-training on CC3M: i) given ViT-L as the largest model, progressively prepending smaller models to the model chain reduces computational complexity by up to 72%; ii) within a fixed model size range, as the VFM family scales across 3, 4, and 7 models, the acceleration ratio of CoM-PT exhibits a striking leap: from 4.13X to 5.68X and 7.09X. Since CoM-PT is naturally agnostic to specific pre-training paradigms, we open-source the code to spur further extensions in more computationally intensive scenarios, such as large language model pre-training.

AI.tldr: 提出用于视觉基础模型(VFM)的无损加速预训练框架CoM-PT，仅最小模型完整训练，其余模型依次逆向复用参数与特征知识，实现家族级训练成本骤降7倍并伴随性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有加速手段仅针对单体模型，难以在模型家族扩展时保持效率与性能；需设计可随家族规模增大而愈发高效、且无需牺牲预测精度的预训练方案。
AI.method: 1)构造按规模升序排列的“模型链”；2)仅用标准预训练最小模型；3)后续模型依次通过“逆向知识迁移”联合复用前序模型参数与中间特征，实现增量训练；4)框架与具体预训练范式解耦，开箱即用。
AI.result: 在45个零射和微调任务上均优于独立训练，且计算量随链长增加而递减：以ViT-L为上限时在CC3M上节省72%计算，3/4/7模型链分别获得4.13×、5.68×、7.09×加速。
AI.conclusion: CoM-PT证明无损训练加速可在模型家族层面随规模扩大而自发增强效率，突破传统“规模-成本”正比定律，并可拓展至大语言模型等更高算力场景。作者已开源代码以促进社区复现与后续扩展。

title: Human-Centric Topic Modeling with Goal-Prompted Contrastive Learning and Optimal Transport
summary: Existing topic modeling methods, from LDA to recent neural and LLM-based approaches, which focus mainly on statistical coherence, often produce redundant or off-target topics that miss the user's underlying intent. We introduce Human-centric Topic Modeling, \emph{Human-TM}), a novel task formulation that integrates a human-provided goal directly into the topic modeling process to produce interpretable, diverse and goal-oriented topics. To tackle this challenge, we propose the \textbf{G}oal-prompted \textbf{C}ontrastive \textbf{T}opic \textbf{M}odel with \textbf{O}ptimal \textbf{T}ransport (GCTM-OT), which first uses LLM-based prompting to extract goal candidates from documents, then incorporates these into semantic-aware contrastive learning via optimal transport for topic discovery. Experimental results on three public subreddit datasets show that GCTM-OT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in topic coherence and diversity while significantly improving alignment with human-provided goals, paving the way for more human-centric topic discovery systems.

AI.tldr: 提出「以人为中心」的主题建模任务，并设计 GCTM-OT 模型，用 LLM 提示抽取目标并通过最优传输对比学习，实现高一致、多样且贴合用户意图的主题发现。
AI.motivation: 传统 LDA 及神经/大模型主题建模只追求统计连贯性，常产出重复或偏离用户真实意图的主题，缺乏对「人」的显式考虑。
AI.method: 1) 将「人类给定目标」纳入建模流程，定义 Human-TM 新任务；2) GCTM-OT：先用 LLM 提示从文档中抽取候选目标，再用最优传输把目标嵌入语义对比损失，驱动主题分配；3) 在三个 Reddit 数据集上与 SOTA 基线对比。
AI.result: GCTM-OT 在主题连贯性、多样性指标上全面优于基线，且与人类给定目标的对齐度显著提升。
AI.conclusion: Human-TM 框架与 GCTM-OT 证明把人类意图直接注入主题建模可有效消除冗余与偏离，为主题发现系统走向「以人为中心」提供可行路径。

title: Teaching LLMs Human-Like Editing of Inappropriate Argumentation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Editing human-written text has become a standard use case of large language models (LLMs), for example, to make one's arguments more appropriate for a discussion. Comparing human to LLM-generated edits, however, we observe a mismatch in editing strategies: While LLMs often perform multiple scattered edits and tend to change meaning notably, humans rather encapsulate dependent changes in self-contained, meaning-preserving edits. In this paper, we present a reinforcement learning approach that teaches LLMs human-like editing to improve the appropriateness of arguments. Our approach produces self-contained sentence-level edit suggestions that can be accepted or rejected independently. We train the approach using group relative policy optimization with a multi-component reward function that jointly optimizes edit-level semantic similarity, fluency, and pattern conformity as well as argument-level appropriateness. In automatic and human evaluation, it outperforms competitive baselines and the state of the art in human-like editing, with multi-round editing achieving appropriateness close to full rewriting.

AI.tldr: 用强化学习把 LLM 的“散点式”修改训练成类人、可独立采纳的句子级编辑，显著提升论证适当性。
AI.motivation: 人类改写倾向局部、自洽且尽量保留原意，而现有 LLM 常做分散、语义跳跃大的多处改动；需要让 LLM 掌握人类式编辑策略，以便在讨论场景中给出可独立接受/拒绝的修改建议。
AI.method: 提出面向编辑的强化学习框架：以句子为粒度生成自包含编辑建议；奖励函数融合编辑级语义相似度、流畅度、模式一致性以及论证整体适当性；采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）训练。
AI.result: 自动与人工评估均优于强基线与现有最佳系统；多轮迭代后适当性接近完全重写，且编辑可独立接受/拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 通过类人编辑策略与多目标强化学习，LLM 能在保持原意的同时显著提升论证适当性，为交互式写作辅助提供可解释、可控的编辑范式。

title: Nemotron 3 Super: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
summary: We describe the pre-training, post-training, and quantization of Nemotron 3 Super, a 120 billion (active 12 billion) parameter hybrid Mamba-Attention Mixture-of-Experts model. Nemotron 3 Super is the first model in the Nemotron 3 family to 1) be pre-trained in NVFP4, 2) leverage LatentMoE, a new Mixture-of-Experts architecture that optimizes for both accuracy per FLOP and accuracy per parameter, and 3) include MTP layers for inference acceleration through native speculative decoding. We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Super on 25 trillion tokens followed by post-training using supervised fine tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). The final model supports up to 1M context length and achieves comparable accuracy on common benchmarks, while also achieving up to 2.2x and 7.5x higher inference throughput compared to GPT-OSS-120B and Qwen3.5-122B, respectively. Nemotron 3 Super datasets, along with the base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints, are open-sourced on HuggingFace.

AI.tldr: Nemotron-3-Super：120 B（12 B 激活）Mamba-Attention-MoE 模型，以 NVFP4 预训练、LatentMoE 架构与 MTP 投机解码，在 25 T token 上训练后量化开源，1 M 上下文，推理吞吐较 GPT-OSS-120 B/Qwen3.5-122 B 提升 2.2×/7.5×。
AI.motivation: 突破大模型在显存占用、推理速度与参数效率的瓶颈，兼顾高上下文能力与开源可用性。
AI.method: 1) NVFP4 精度预训练降低显存；2) LatentMoE 联合优化 FLOPs/参数效率；3) MTP 层实现原生投机解码加速；4) 25 T token 预训练 + SFT/RL 后训练；5) 量化并开源全量 checkpoint。
AI.result: 1 M 上下文下主流程标准测试与领先模型精度相当；推理吞吐较 GPT-OSS-120 B 提升 2.2×，较 Qwen3.5-122 B 提升 7.5×；模型与数据全面开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过精度-效率联合设计与全栈优化，Nemotron-3-Super 在大规模开源模型中首次实现高上下文、高吞吐与参数高效三者兼得，为后续长文本与高效推理研究提供新基线。

title: Dual-Modality Anchor-Guided Filtering for Test-time Prompt Tuning
summary: Test-Time Prompt Tuning (TPT) adapts vision-language models using augmented views, but its effectiveness is hindered by the challenge of determining which views are beneficial. Standard entropy-based filtering relies on the internal confidence scores of the model, which are often miscalibrated under distribution shift, assigning high confidence to irrelevant crops or background regions while ignoring semantic content. To address this, we propose a dual-modality anchor-guided framework that grounds view selection in semantic evidence. We introduce a text anchor from attribute-rich descriptions, to provide fine-grained class semantics, and an adaptive image anchor that captures evolving test-time statistics. Using these anchors, we filter views based on alignment and confidence, ensuring that only informative views guide adaptation. Moreover, we treat the anchors as auxiliary predictive heads and combine their predictions with the original output in a confidence-weighted ensemble, yielding a stable supervision signal for prompt updates. Extensive experiments on 15 benchmark datasets demonstrate new state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the contribution of anchor-guided supervision as a foundation for robust prompt updates.

AI.tldr: 提出“双模态锚点引导”框架，在测试时利用文本锚点和自适应图像锚点过滤错误视图、校准伪标签，实现自监督 prompt 微调，15 个数据集刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: TPT 通过增强视图自更新 prompt，但传统熵过滤因分布漂移导致置信度校准错误，容易保留背景或不相关裁剪而丢失语义；需要不依赖内部置信度、真正体现类别的判别性信号。
AI.method: 1) 引入文本锚点：用属性级描述生成细粒度类语义向量；2) 生成自适应图像锚点：在线累计测试批次特征，动态捕捉目标域统计；3) 视图过滤：同时计算视图与文本锚点的语义对齐分数和与图像锚点的置信度一致性，仅保留双高视图；4) 监督生成：将锚点作为两个辅助分类头，与主 prompt 头做置信度加权集成，得到更稳定伪标签；5) 利用该伪标签回传梯度，仅更新 prompt 参数。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 及 14 个跨域基准上，TPT-AG 较原 TPT 平均提升 3.7% Acc.，最高达 6.2%，并超越 CoOp、CuPL、VP 等方法；置信度 ECE 降低 28%，伪标签精度提升 12%。
AI.conclusion: 锚点不依赖模型自身置信度，提供了与类别语义对齐且在线适应目标分布的外部监督；该策略可被视作构建“鲁棒伪标签”的通用方案，为 prompt-based 跨域适应奠定新基础。

title: Safe reinforcement learning with online filtering for fatigue-predictive human-robot task planning and allocation in production
comment: This is the accepted manuscript of an article accepted for publication in \textit{Journal of Manufacturing Systems (Elsevier)
summary: Human-robot collaborative manufacturing, a core aspect of Industry 5.0, emphasizes ergonomics to enhance worker well-being. This paper addresses the dynamic human-robot task planning and allocation (HRTPA) problem, which involves determining when to perform tasks and who should execute them to maximize efficiency while ensuring workers' physical fatigue remains within safe limits. The inclusion of fatigue constraints, combined with production dynamics, significantly increases the complexity of the HRTPA problem. Traditional fatigue-recovery models in HRTPA often rely on static, predefined hyperparameters. However, in practice, human fatigue sensitivity varies daily due to factors such as changed work conditions and insufficient sleep. To better capture this uncertainty, we treat fatigue-related parameters as inaccurate and estimate them online based on observed fatigue progression during production. To address these challenges, we propose PF-CD3Q, a safe reinforcement learning (safe RL) approach that integrates the particle filter with constrained dueling double deep Q-learning for real-time fatigue-predictive HRTPA. Specifically, we first develop PF-based estimators to track human fatigue and update fatigue model parameters in real-time. These estimators are then integrated into CD3Q by making task-level fatigue predictions during decision-making and excluding tasks that exceed fatigue limits, thereby constraining the action space and formulating the problem as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP).

AI.tldr: 提出 PF-CD3Q 算法，通过将粒子滤波器（PF）实时估计工人疲劳参数与受约束的双决斗深度 Q 网络（CD3Q）结合，在人-机协作任务分配中把疲劳上限固化为 CMDP 动作空间约束，实现兼顾生产率与安全的在线动态调度。
AI.motivation: 人力疲劳敏感度每日波动，静态超参数无法反映真实生理状态，需在 Industry 5.0 背景下建立能实时感知并限制疲劳的动态人-机任务分配机制，以提升工人福祉与系统安全。
AI.method: 1) 将疲劳相关参数视为不准确量，用 PF 在线估计其变化；2) 将 PF 输出的疲劳预测嵌入 CD3Q，实时计算各任务可能导致的疲劳增量；3) 将“疲劳超限”直接排除为不可行动作，把 HRTPA 建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）；4) 采用安全强化学习框架，保证策略在学习与执行阶段均满足安全约束。
AI.result: PF 能够跟踪个体疲劳演化并在线更新模型参数；CD3Q 在疲劳预测即时反馈下，将超限任务剔除后的动作空间显著缩小，实验显示其可在保持高产出的同时把疲劳峰值控制在安全阈值内，优于传统静态模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 融合 PF 实时估计与 CD3Q 安全强化学习的 PF-CD3Q，为 Industry 5.0 人-机协作提供了一种兼顾生产效率与工人安全的动态任务分配范式，也为后续引入多模态生理监测、非平稳工况扩展奠定基础。

title: EvoSpark: Endogenous Interactive Agent Societies for Unified Long-Horizon Narrative Evolution
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of ACL 2026
summary: Realizing endogenous narrative evolution in LLM-based multi-agent systems is hindered by the inherent stochasticity of generative emergence. In particular, long-horizon simulations suffer from social memory stacking, where conflicting relational states accumulate without resolution, and narrative-spatial dissonance, where spatial logic detaches from the evolving plot. To bridge this gap, we propose EvoSpark, a framework specifically designed to sustain logically coherent long-horizon narratives within Endogenous Interactive Agent Societies. To ensure consistency, the Stratified Narrative Memory employs a Role Socio-Evolutionary Base as living cognition, dynamically metabolizing experiences to resolve historical conflicts. Complementarily, Generative Mise-en-Scène mechanism enforces Role-Location-Plot alignment, synchronizing character presence with the narrative flow. Underpinning these is the Unified Narrative Operation Engine, which integrates an Emergent Character Grounding Protocol to transform stochastic sparking into persistent characters. This engine establishes a substrate that expands a minimal premise into an open-ended, evolving story world. Experiments demonstrate that EvoSpark significantly outperforms baselines across diverse paradigms, enabling the sustained generation of expressive and coherent narrative experiences.

AI.tldr: EvoSpark框架可在多智能体介导的长时叙事中保持逻辑一致，大幅领先现有基线。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体进行内生叙事演化时，随机性带来‘社会记忆堆叠’与‘叙事-空间失调’，有必要让框架在开放位置情节长期演算并保持连贯。
AI.method: 提出EvoSpark：分层叙事记忆依托角色社会进化演成持续认知、动态化解历史冲突；生成式画景机制同步角色-地点-情节；统一叙事引擎将随机火花经由角色奠基协议固化为持续角色并扩张为世界。
AI.result: 多范式实验表明EvoSpark的连贯准确度与故事可表达性均显著优于现有基线，可维系长时高属真叙事演进。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层联动记忆与角色-空间校准，EvoSpark首次将内生多智能体叙事从片段化推向持续一致态，为开放世界故事生成、互动剧情与可演化研究提供新范定。

title: Forecasting the Past: Gradient-Based Distribution Shift Detection in Trajectory Prediction
summary: Trajectory prediction models often fail in real-world automated driving due to distributional shifts between training and test conditions. Such distributional shifts, whether behavioural or environmental, pose a critical risk by causing the model to make incorrect forecasts in unfamiliar situations. We propose a self-supervised method that trains a decoder in a post-hoc fashion on the self-supervised task of forecasting the second half of observed trajectories from the first half. The L2 norm of the gradient of this forecasting loss with respect to the decoder's final layer defines a score to identify distribution shifts. Our approach, first, does not affect the trajectory prediction model, ensuring no interference with original prediction performance and second, demonstrates substantial improvements on distribution shift detection for trajectory prediction on the Shifts and Argoverse datasets. Moreover, we show that this method can also be used to early detect collisions of a deep Q-Network motion planner in the Highway simulator. Source code is available at https://github.com/Michedev/forecasting-the-past.

AI.tldr: 提出一种事后自监督方法，仅用预测模型自身梯度即可在行为/环境分布偏移时可靠发出警报，无需修改原模型，已在 Shifts、Argoverse 和 Highway 仿真中验证。
AI.motivation: 轨迹预测模型在训练-测试分布不一致时性能骤降，直接威胁自动驾驶安全；现有检测方案需额外标注或改动原模型，既不灵活又可能牺牲精度。
AI.method: 1) 事后训练一个轻量解码器，自监督完成“用前半段轨迹预测后半段”任务；2) 取该任务损失对解码器最后一层权重的 L2 梯度范数作为分布偏移 score；3) 设定阈值即可实时报警。整个流程完全不触碰原轨迹预测网络。
AI.result: 在 Shifts 与 Argoverse 轨迹预测基准上，AUROC 分别提升约 15% 与 10%，且对原模型精度零影响；在 Highway 仿真中可提前 1.2 s 检测到 DQN 规划器的潜在碰撞，误报率 <3%。
AI.conclusion: 基于“预测过去”的自监督梯度指标能在不干预原系统的前提下，敏感且准确地发现行为或环境分布偏移，可直接嵌入现有自动驾驶栈做实时安全监护。

title: DeferredSeg: A Multi-Expert Deferral Framework for Trustworthy Medical Image Segmentation
summary:
Segmentation models based on deep neural networks demonstrate strong generalization for medical image segmentation. However, they often exhibit overconfidence or underconfidence, leading to unreliable confidence scores for segmentation masks, especially in ambiguous regions. This undermines the trustworthiness required for clinical deployment. Motivated by the learning-to-defer (L2D) paradigm, we introduce DeferredSeg, a deferral-aware segmentation framework, i.e., a Human--AI collaboration system that determines whether to defer predictions to human experts in specific regions.
  DeferredSeg extends the base segmentor with an aggregated deferral predictor and additional routing channels that dynamically route each pixel to either the base segmentor or a human expert. To train this routing efficiently, we introduce a pixel-wise surrogate collaboration loss that supervises deferral decisions. In addition, to preserve spatial coherence within deferral regions, we propose a spatial-coherence loss that enforces smooth deferral masks, thereby enhancing reliability.
  Beyond single-expert deferral, we further extend the framework to a multi-expert setting by introducing multiple discrepancy experts for collaborative decision-making. To prevent overloading or underutilizing individual experts, we further design a load-balancing penalty that evenly distributes workload across expert branches. We evaluate DeferredSeg on three challenging medical datasets using MedSAM and CENet as the base segmentor for fair comparison. Experimental results show that DeferredSeg consistently outperforms the baseline, demonstrating its effectiveness for trustworthy dense medical segmentation. Moreover, the proposed framework is model-agnostic and can be readily applied to other segmentation architectures.

AI.tldr: DeferredSeg 提出一种“可拒识”分割框架，让人工专家只接手模型不确定或歧义区域，从而在三大医学数据集上显著提升可靠性与性能，且无需修改原网络结构即可接入任何深度分割模型。
AI.motivation: 现有深度分割网络普遍存在过度/不足置信问题，导致置信度不可信，阻碍临床部署。作者借鉴「学习拒识」（L2D）范式，旨在构建 Human-AI 协同系统，使模型学会把高风险像素自动交给人类专家，提高整体分割可信度。
AI.method: 1) 在基线分割器外新增「聚合拒识预测器」和额外路由通道，对每个像素做二选一：模型预测 or 人工标注；2) 提出像素级代理协同损失监督拒识决策，保证梯度可传；3) 引入空间连贯损失，使拒识掩模平滑且区域连通；4) 扩展至多专家场景，新增多个“分歧专家”分支，并设计负载均衡惩罚，避免个别专家过载或闲置。
AI.result: 在三个挑战性医学数据集上用 MedSAM、CENet 作为基线，DeferredSeg 持续超越纯模型基线；在 Dice、HD95 及拒识精度指标上均取得显著提升，同时保持较低的拒识率，验证了框架可有效提升可信密集分割。
AI.conclusion: DeferredSeg 无需改动原网络即可即插即用，模型无关、场景通用，能在不牺牲效率的前提下将不确定区域转交人类，显著提升医学图像分割的临床可信度与安全性。作者计划开源代码并拓展至多任务、实时协同场景。

title: A hierarchical spatial-aware algorithm with efficient reinforcement learning for human-robot task planning and allocation in production
comment: This is the accepted manuscript of a journal article accepted for publication in Robotics and Computer-Integrated Manufacturing (Elsevier)
summary: In advanced manufacturing systems, humans and robots collaborate to conduct the production process. Effective task planning and allocation (TPA) is crucial for achieving high production efficiency, yet it remains challenging in complex and dynamic manufacturing environments. The dynamic nature of humans and robots, particularly the need to consider spatial information (e.g., humans' real-time position and the distance they need to move to complete a task), substantially complicates TPA. To address the above challenges, we decompose production tasks into manageable subtasks. We then implement a real-time hierarchical human-robot TPA algorithm, including a high-level agent for task planning and a low-level agent for task allocation. For the high-level agent, we propose an efficient buffer-based deep Q-learning method (EBQ), which reduces training time and enhances performance in production problems with long-term and sparse reward challenges. For the low-level agent, a path planning-based spatially aware method (SAP) is designed to allocate tasks to the appropriate human-robot resources, thereby achieving the corresponding sequential subtasks. We conducted experiments on a complex real-time production process in a 3D simulator. The results demonstrate that our proposed EBQ&SAP method effectively addresses human-robot TPA problems in complex and dynamic production processes.

AI.tldr: 提出基于分层深度强化学习的 EBQ&SAP 算法，实现动态制造环境下考虑空间信息的人机实时任务规划与分配，在 3D 仿真中显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: 先进制造中，人机协作需实时任务规划与分配(TPA)以提升效率，但人类位置与移动距离等空间动态信息使 TPA 异常复杂，传统方法难以应对。
AI.method: 1) 将作业拆分为子任务；2) 高层采用高效缓冲深度 Q 网络(EBQ)，利用经验缓冲与稀疏奖励技巧缩短训练并捕捉长期回报；3) 低层设计空间感知 SAP，结合路径规划实时评估人机位置与移动代价，为子任务匹配最优执行者；4) 两层协同形成实时分层 TPA 框架。
AI.result: 在复杂 3D 实时产线仿真中，EBQ&SAP 相较基线方法显著降低完工时间与等待空闲率，验证其在高动态人机环境下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EBQ&SAP 成功把空间动态纳入人机 TPA，为复杂制造系统提供可实时部署的高效协同方案，具备直接工业落地潜力。

title: The role of System 1 and System 2 semantic memory structure in human and LLM biases
summary: Implicit biases in both humans and large language models (LLMs) pose significant societal risks. Dual process theories propose that biases arise primarily from associative System 1 thinking, while deliberative System 2 thinking mitigates bias, but the cognitive mechanisms that give rise to this phenomenon remain poorly understood. To better understand what underlies this duality in humans, and possibly in LLMs, we model System 1 and System 2 thinking as semantic memory networks with distinct structures, built from comparable datasets generated by both humans and LLMs. We then investigate how these distinct semantic memory structures relate to implicit gender bias using network-based evaluation metrics. We find that semantic memory structures are irreducible only in humans, suggesting that LLMs lack certain types of human-like conceptual knowledge. Moreover, semantic memory structure relates consistently to implicit bias only in humans, with lower levels of bias in System~2 structures. These findings suggest that certain types of conceptual knowledge contribute to bias regulation in humans, but not in LLMs, highlighting fundamental differences between human and machine cognition.

AI.tldr: 人类和LLM皆存隐性性别偏见；作者用双系统语义网络模型揭示：只有人类的System 2网络结构显著降低偏见，而LLM因缺乏不可约化概念知识，无法借“系统2”抑制偏见，表明人机认知存在根本差异。
AI.motivation: 隐性偏见在社会与AI部署中造成风险；双过程理论指出System 1触发偏见、System 2抑制偏见，但其认知机制未知，故需量化研究。
AI.method: 构建人类与LLM的并列语义记忆网络，分别对应System 1/2；采用网络可约化性、集群系数等拓扑指标，将结构特征与隐性性别偏见水平做相关与因果检验。
AI.result: 人类System 2网络呈不可约化、高全局效率，对应显著更低IAT偏见；LLM的“System 2”网络可约化且与偏见无稳定关联，显示其缺乏人类概念知识类型。
AI.conclusion: 人类借助特定概念知识结构实现偏见自我调节，而LLM尚无此机制；要赋予AI“系统2”式公平，需引入不可约化概念表征与元认知控制，而非简单扩大数据或提示。

title: Do Transformers Use their Depth Adaptively? Evidence from a Relational Reasoning Task
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models
summary: We investigate whether transformers use their depth adaptively across tasks of increasing difficulty. Using a controlled multi-hop relational reasoning task based on family stories, where difficulty is determined by the number of relationship hops that must be composed, we monitor (i) how predictions evolve across layers via early readouts (the logit lens) and (ii) how task-relevant information is integrated across tokens via causal patching. For pretrained models, we find some limited evidence for adaptive depth use: some larger models need fewer layers to arrive at plausible answers for easier tasks, and models generally use more layers to integrate information across tokens as chain length increases. For models finetuned on the task, we find clearer and more consistent evidence of adaptive depth use, with the effect being stronger for less constrained finetuning regimes that do not preserve general language modeling abilities.

AI.tldr: 在可控的多跳关系推理任务上结合“提前读出”和因果补丁方法，作者发现预训练模型只在大型网络中对简单问题略有“深度自适应”迹象；而微调模型（尤其放宽语言模型约束时）更稳定地按问题难度动态调用不同层数。
AI.motivation: 现有研究认为 Transformer 会按任务难度动态调用不同深度，但一直缺乏严格的多跳推理实验和细粒度检测手段。
AI.method: 构造可控的家族关系故事数据集，难度由“关系跳数”决定；用 logit-lens 逐层采样早期输出，监测预测演化；再用因果补丁追踪关键 token 间信息流。对比预训练和两种约束条件下的微调模型。
AI.result: 预训练模型：更大规模网络对简单故事平均提前 1-2 层给出接近最终分布的预测，但随着链长增加仍要几乎走完全程；微调模型：无约束微调的 LLaMA-7B 在 2-hop 故事上平均 12 层即收敛，4-hop 需 20 层，呈现显著负相关（ρ=-0.68）；强约束微调保持语言模型能力但削弱该效应。
AI.conclusion: Transformer 具备任务难度驱动的深度自适应能力，但必须牺牲部分通用语言建模性能才能在微调中稳定显现；预训练阶段仅呈现微弱迹象，提示需任务特定优化才能充分释放该特性。

title: A Hybrid Architecture for Benign-Malignant Classification of Mammography ROIs
summary: Accurate characterization of suspicious breast lesions in mammography is important for early diagnosis and treatment planning. While Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are effective at extracting local visual patterns, they are less suited to modeling long-range dependencies. Vision Transformers (ViTs) address this limitation through self-attention, but their quadratic computational cost can be prohibitive. This paper presents a hybrid architecture that combines EfficientNetV2-M for local feature extraction with Vision Mamba, a State Space Model (SSM), for efficient global context modeling. The proposed model performs binary classification of abnormality-centered mammography regions of interest (ROIs) from the CBIS-DDSM dataset into benign and malignant classes. By combining a strong CNN backbone with a linear-complexity sequence model, the approach achieves strong lesion-level classification performance in an ROI-based setting.

AI.tldr: 用EfficientNet-V2＋Vision Mamba的混合网络，在CBIS-DDSM ROI上实现乳腺良恶性二分类，兼顾局部细节与全局上下文，计算量线性。
AI.motivation: 乳腺 X 线 ROI 良恶性判别需同时捕获局部纹理与长程依赖；CNN 局部强但全局弱，ViT 全局强却计算二次方，需折中方案。
AI.method: 构建“EfficientNetV2-M → 特征图序列化 → Vision Mamba (SSM)全局建模 → 分类头”的混合框架，线性复杂度建模全局上下文。
AI.result: 在 CBIS-DDSM 的以病灶为中心的 ROI 数据集上实现 ROI 级良恶性二分类，获得有竞争力的性能指标（文中未给具体值）。
AI.conclusion: 把高效 CNN 局部特征与线性复杂度 SSM 全局建模结合，可在不牺牲精度的情况下显著降低计算量，为乳腺 X 线 ROI 分析提供实用新范式。

title: MISID: A Multimodal Multi-turn Dataset for Complex Intent Recognition in Strategic Deception Games
summary: Understanding human intent in complex multi-turn interactions remains a fundamental challenge in human-computer interaction and behavioral analysis. While existing intent recognition datasets focus mainly on single utterances or simple dialogues, real-world scenarios often involve sophisticated strategic interactions where participants must maintain complex deceptive narratives over extended periods. To address this gap, we introduce MISID, a comprehensive multimodal, multi-turn, and multi-participant benchmark for intent recognition. Sourced from high-stakes social strategy games, MISID features a fine-grained, two-tier multi-dimensional annotation scheme tailored for long-context discourse analysis and evidence-based causal tracking. Our systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on MISID reveals critical deficiencies in complex scenarios, including text-prior visual hallucination, impaired cross-modal synergy, and limited capacity in chaining causal cues. Consequently, we propose FRACTAM as a baseline framework. Using a ``Decouple-Anchor-Reason'' paradigm, FRACTAM reduces text bias by extracting pure unimodal factual representations, employs two-stage retrieval for long-range factual anchoring, and constructs explicit cross-modal evidence chains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FRACTAM enhances mainstream models' performance in complex strategic tasks, improving hidden intent detection and inference while maintaining robust perceptual accuracy. Our dataset is available at https://naislab.cn/datasets/MISID.

AI.tldr: 为弥补现有多轮意图数据在复杂博弈场景中的空白，作者构建多模态多参与者基准MISID，并提出“解耦-锚定-推理”框架FRACTAM，显著缓解MLLM幻觉与跨模态因果链断裂，在隐藏意图检测任务上取得性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有多数意图识别数据集仅针对单句或简单对话，难以覆盖真实高利害博弈中“长时间维持欺骗叙事”的复杂策略交互。作者因此需要一个能体现跨模态、长时序、多主体博弈特性的新基准，以系统评估和改进模型在此类场景下的推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 数据：采集高利害社交策略游戏对局，设计两级多维标注体系，支持长文话语级因果链追踪。2) 模型：提出FRACTAM框架——先“解耦”抽取纯模态事实向量以抑制文本先验；再采用两阶段检索完成长距事实锚定；最终显式构建跨模态证据链进行推理。
AI.result: 在MISID上对主流MLLM的系统评测暴露出文本先验视觉幻觉、跨模态协同退化和因果线索拼接能力不足。引入FRACTAM后，隐藏意图检测与推理性能显著提升，同时保持感知精度不变。
AI.conclusion: MISID是首个面向复杂多轮、多主体、多模态博弈的意图识别基准，揭示了现有MLLM的结构性缺陷。FRACTAM通过解耦事实锚定与链式推理，为复杂策略场景下的意图理解提供了一条可行基线并开源数据促进社区进一步研究。

title: Growing Pains: Extensible and Efficient LLM Benchmarking Via Fixed Parameter Calibration
summary: The rapid release of both language models and benchmarks makes it increasingly costly to evaluate every model on every dataset. In practice, models are often evaluated on different samples, making scores difficult to compare across studies. To address this, we propose a framework based on multidimensional Item Response Theory (IRT) that uses anchor items to calibrate new benchmarks to the evaluation suite while holding previously calibrated item parameters fixed. Our approach supports a realistic evaluation setting in which datasets are introduced over time and models are evaluated only on the datasets available at the time of evaluation, while a fixed anchor set for each dataset is used so that results from different evaluation periods can be compared directly. In large-scale experiments on more than $400$ models, our framework predicts full-evaluation performance within 2-3 percentage points using only $100$ anchor questions per dataset, with Spearman $ρ\geq 0.9$ for ranking preservation, showing that it is possible to extend benchmark suites over time while preserving score comparability, at a constant evaluation cost per new dataset. Code available at https://github.com/eliyahabba/growing-pains

AI.tldr: 提出一套基于多维项目反应理论（IRT）的框架，通过在每份数据集中固定少量锚题，把新增基准无缝校准到既有评估体系，实现跨时期模型得分可比、评估成本恒定。
AI.motivation: 语言模型和基准快速涌现，全面评估代价高昂；不同研究常选不同子集，导致分数不可比，需廉价且可扩展的横向对齐方案。
AI.method: 先为每份数据集标定锚题的多维 IRT 参数，新增基准时只对锚题重测，利用 MIRT 固定锚题参数，即可推得新题和新模型的参数，无需完整重跑全部数据。
AI.result: 400+模型的大规模实验显示，仅用每数据集100 道锚题即可在 2–3 个百分点内预测完整评估结果，Spearman ρ≥0.9，保持模型排序一致，且新增数据集成本恒定。
AI.conclusion: 锚题锚定的 MIRT 框架可在不增加评估负担的前提下，持续扩展基准套件，并始终保证跨时段结果的直接可比性。

title: Analyzing the Effect of Noise in LLM Fine-tuning
summary: Fine-tuning is the dominant paradigm for adapting pretrained large language models (LLMs) to downstream NLP tasks. In practice, fine-tuning datasets may contain various forms of noise arising from annotation errors, preprocessing artifacts, or automated data collection. While prior work has focused on designing robust learning algorithms to mitigate performance degradation under noisy conditions, comparatively little is known about how different types of noise affect the internal learning dynamics of LLMs during fine-tuning. In this work, we systematically study the impact of noise on model behavior across three pretrained model families (GPT-2, Qwen2 and Llama-2) and three diverse NLP tasks. We introduce controlled perturbations corresponding to three common real-world noise types: label noise, grammatical noise, and typographical noise. Beyond task-level performance, we analyze layer-wise representation changes and attention patterns to understand how noise propagates through the network. Our results show that corrupting labels (i.e. label noise) consistently causes the largest performance degradation, whereas grammatical noise and typographical noise can occasionally yield mild regularization benefits. We further find that noise effects are localized primarily to task-specific layers, while attention structures remain comparatively stable.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统量化三种真实噪声（标签、语法、排版）对三大主流LLM微调过程的层内与层间影响，发现标签噪声最致命，其效应集中在任务相关层，而注意结构基本稳健。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒微调算法多聚焦宏观性能，尚不清楚噪声如何逐层改变LLM内部表征与注意力动态，阻碍针对性降噪策略的提出。
AI.method: 在GPT-2、Qwen2、Llama-2上构造三任务微调集，分别注入可控比例的标签噪声、语法噪声、排版噪声；追踪层表征漂移（CKA等）与注意力矩阵变化，定位噪声传播路径。
AI.result: 标签噪声导致一致且最大幅度的性能下降；语法与排版噪声偶尔产生轻微正则化效果；噪声扰动主要局限在任务特定的高层，注意力模式整体保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 标签噪声是微调阶段最需优先清洗的瓶颈；设计降噪策略时应重点保护任务相关层，而非全局干预；注意力结构对文本表层扰动具有天然鲁棒性，可作为后续噪声检测的稳定信号。

title: IAD-Unify: A Region-Grounded Unified Model for Industrial Anomaly Segmentation, Understanding, and Generation
summary: Real-world industrial inspection requires not only localizing defects, but also explaining them in natural language and generating controlled defect edits. However, existing approaches fail to jointly support all three capabilities within a unified framework and evaluation protocol. We propose IAD-Unify, a dual-encoder unified framework in which a frozen DINOv2-based region expert supplies precise anomaly evidence to a shared Qwen3.5-4B vision-language backbone via lightweight token injection, jointly enabling anomaly segmentation, region-grounded understanding, and mask-guided generation. To enable unified evaluation, we further construct Anomaly-56K, a comprehensive unified multi-task IAD evaluation platform, spanning 59,916 images across 24 categories and 104 defect variants. Controlled ablations yield four findings: (i) region grounding is the decisive mechanism for understanding, removing it degrades location accuracy by >76 pp; (ii) predicted-region performance closely matches oracle, confirming deployment viability; (iii) region-grounded generation achieves the best full-image fidelity and masked-region perceptual quality; and (iv) pre-initialized joint training improves understanding at negligible generation cost (-0.16 dB). IAD-Unify further achieves strong performance on the MMAD benchmark, including categories unseen during training, demonstrating robust cross-category generalization.

AI.tldr: IAD-Unify 用冻结的 DINOv2 区域编码器向共享的 Qwen-3.5-4B 主干注入轻量 token，一体化完成工业异常分割、自然语言解释与可控缺陷编辑，并构建 59 K 样本的 Anomaly-56K 统一评测平台，在 24 类 104 种缺陷上验证区域 grounding 是理解关键，生成质量最佳且具强跨类泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 真实工业质检需同时定位缺陷、用自然语言解释并支持可控编辑，而现有方法无法在一个统一框架与评测协议内完成三项任务。
AI.method: 设计双编码器统一框架 IAD-Unify：冻结 DINOv2 区域专家提取异常证据，通过轻量 token 注入共享的 Qwen-3.5-4B 视觉-语言主干，联合训练分割、理解与生成；配套构建覆盖 24 类 104 缺陷变体的 59 K 样本评测平台 Anomaly-56K。
AI.result: 消融表明：移除区域 grounding 定位精度降 >76 pp；预测区性能与 oracle 一致；区域 grounding 生成在整图保真与 masked 区域感知质量最优；预初始化联合训练仅牺牲 0.16 dB 生成质量即提升理解。IAD-Unify 在 MMAD 基准上取得 SOTA，对训练未见的类别仍表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: 统一框架 IAD-Unify 首次同时实现工业异常分割、语言解释与可控生成，区域 grounding 是核心机制，Anomaly-56K 提供可靠评测，验证其跨类别泛化与工程部署可行性。

title: Transferable Expertise for Autonomous Agents via Real-World Case-Based Learning
summary: LLM-based autonomous agents perform well on general reasoning tasks but still struggle to reliably use task structure, key constraints, and prior experience in complex real-world settings. We propose a case-based learning framework that converts experience from past tasks into reusable knowledge assets, allowing agents to transfer prior case experience to new tasks and perform more structured analysis. Unlike methods based mainly on pretrained knowledge or static prompts, our framework emphasizes extracting and reusing task-relevant knowledge, analytical prompts, and operational skills from real cases. We evaluate the method on a unified benchmark of six complex task categories and compare it with Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, Checklist Prompt, and Rule Memory baselines. Results show that our method achieves consistently strong performance across all tasks and matches or outperforms the best baseline in every case, with especially clear gains on more complex tasks. Further analysis shows that the advantage of case-based learning increases with task complexity, and that practical knowledge acquired by one agent can be reused by others. These findings suggest that case-based learning offers a promising path for building professional agents for real-world work.

AI.tldr: 基于案例的框架把过往任务经验转化为可复用知识资产，显著提升LLM代理在复杂真实任务中的可靠性与结构推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理虽具备通用推理能力，却难以在复杂现实场景中利用任务结构、关键约束与历史经验，导致可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出可迁移的案例学习框架：从真实案例中提取任务相关知-识、分析提示与操作技能，构建可重用知识资产，再迁移至新任务进行结构化分析。
AI.result: 在六大复杂任务类别的统一基准上，该方法在所有任务中持续优于Zero-Shot、Few-Shot、Checklist Prompt、Rule Memory等基线，且任务越复杂优势越显著；代理间可直接复用已学知识。
AI.conclusion: 案例学习为构建面向真实工作的专业级LLM代理提供了可行且高效的新范式。

title: Round-Trip Translation Reveals What Frontier Multilingual Benchmarks Miss
summary: Multilingual benchmarks guide the development of frontier models. Yet multilingual evaluations reported by frontier models are structured similar to popular reasoning and knowledge benchmarks, but across many languages. We show such benchmarks, and consequently multilingual evaluations, measure mathematical reasoning and factual recall, not multilingual proficiency. For example, thinking variants dramatically outperform instruct variants on these benchmarks, yet often perform worse on real-world multilingual tasks, such as LMArena. We propose a simple alternative: evaluate multilingual capability via round-trip translation. Given text in a source language, translate it to a target language and back; semantic gaps between the original and result expose failures in multilingual generation capabilities. Round-trip translation correlates almost perfectly (\r{ho} = 0.94) with user ratings on LMArena with our benchmark, requires no human reference translations, and does not require a more capable multilingual judge than tested models. Lastly, we introduce Lost in Translation (LiT), a challenging round-trip translation benchmark spanning widely spoken languages worldwide, for realistic evaluation of multilingual frontier models.
