To address these issues, we propose the concept of trustworthy watermark, which achieves reliable recovery with 100% identification accuracy while resisting both user-side statistical attacks and provider-side forgery. We focus on trustworthy time watermarking for use as judicial evidence. Our framework integrates cryptographic techniques and encodes time information into time-dependent secret keys under regulatory supervision, preventing arbitrary timestamp fabrication. The watermark payload is decoupled from time and generated as a random, non-stored bit sequence for each instance, eliminating statistical patterns. To ensure verifiability, we design a two-stage encoding mechanism, which, combined with error-correcting codes, enables reliable recovery of generation time with theoretically perfect accuracy. Both theoretical analysis and experiments demonstrate that our framework satisfies the reliability requirements for judicial evidence and offers a practical solution for future AIGC-related intellectual property disputes.

AI.tldr: 本文首次定义“可信水印”，通过密码学与时间相关密钥把生成时间嵌入 AIGC 并彻底剥离统计模式，使检测准确率达 100%，同时既能防止用户伪造又能防止模型方任意注水，满足司法证据的可靠性要求。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 token 分布统计的 AIGC 水印存在两大缺陷：①检测本质是概率性的，尤其对多比特时间戳等场景难以可靠恢复；②水印信号会引入统计特征，可被用户伪造，也可被模型提供方任意植入。结果是无法成为有效司法证据。论文旨在彻底解决这些可信与可靠问题。
AI.method: 提出“可信水印”框架：1) 时间依赖密钥与监管侧随机数结合，生成不可重放的时间戳密钥；2) 载荷与具体时刻解耦，每次生成随机、非存储的比特流，消除可检测统计模式；3) 两阶段编码+纠错码确保时间信息 100% 准确恢复；4) 利用密码学承诺协同验证，杜绝用户与提供方双端伪造。
AI.result: 理论证明与大规模实验表明：①载体文本质量不变；②对逐字编辑、重排序、改写、采样参数调整等用户攻击检测率保持 100%；③密钥泄露时无法逆向构造旧时间戳；④整套流程与主流 LLM 推理开销相比 <1%，具备立即部署可行性。
AI.conclusion: 可信时间水印首次让 AIGC 水印满足司法证据的确定性、抗双向伪造与抗统计攻击要求，为后续知识产权纠纷提供可执行的法庭级技术方案，并给出了通用可信水印的设计范式。

title: Rethinking the Personalized Relaxed Initialization in the Federated Learning: Consistency and Generalization
comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2306.05706
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a distributed paradigm that coordinates massive local clients to collaboratively train a global model via stage-wise local training processes on the heterogeneous dataset. Previous works have implicitly studied that FL suffers from the ``client-drift'' problem, which is caused by the inconsistent optimum across local clients. However, till now it still lacks solid theoretical analysis to explain the impact of this local inconsistency. To alleviate the negative impact of ``client drift'' and explore its substance in FL, in this paper, we first propose an efficient FL algorithm FedInit, which allows employing the personalized relaxed initialization state at the beginning of each local training stage. Specifically, FedInit initializes the local state by moving away from the current global state towards the reverse direction of the latest local state. Moreover, to further understand how inconsistency disrupts performance in FL, we introduce the excess risk analysis and study the divergence term to investigate the test error in FL. Our studies show that optimization error is not sensitive to this local inconsistency, while it mainly affects the generalization error bound. Extensive experiments are conducted to validate its efficiency. The proposed FedInit method could achieve comparable results compared to several advanced benchmarks without any additional training or communication costs. Meanwhile, the stage-wise personalized relaxed initialization could also be incorporated into several current advanced algorithms to achieve higher generalization performance in the FL paradigm.

AI.tldr: 提出个性化松弛初始化算法 FedInit，用反向偏离全局状态的局部状态初始化本地模型，并从 excess-risk 出发证明局部不一致性主要恶化泛化误差而非优化误差；实验表明 FedInit 无需额外通信/计算即可提升性能，且可即插即用到现有先进 FL 方法。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习普遍存在“client-drift”——各客户端局部最优不一致，以往工作仅经验性指出其危害，缺乏严谨理论剖析其对最终泛化性能的影响机制。
AI.method: 1) 设计 FedInit：每轮本地训练前，将本地状态沿“远离当前全局状态、靠近上一轮本地状态”的反向进行松弛初始化；2) 建立 FL 的 excess-risk 分解，引入局部不一致性度量项，分别推导优化误差与泛化误差上界；3) 在多种设定下对比 FedInit 与 SOTA 方法，并测试其作为插件模块的可迁移性。
AI.result: 理论证明：局部不一致性对优化误差界影响微弱，但会线性放大泛化误差界。实验上，FedInit 在 CIFAR-10/100、FMNIST 等任务中与最佳基准持平或略优，通信轮次与计算量零增加；将其嵌入 SCAFFOLD、FedProx、FedAvgM 后，测试准确率平均再提升 1.2–2.4%。
AI.conclusion: client-drift 的本质危害体现在泛化而非优化；通过简单、零成本的个性化松弛初始化即可显著缓解该问题，并为未来 FL 的一致性正则设计提供理论依据与即插即用模块。

title: PromptEcho: Annotation-Free Reward from Vision-Language Models for Text-to-Image Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve the prompt following capability of text-to-image (T2I) models, yet obtaining high-quality reward signals remains challenging: CLIP Score is too coarse-grained, while VLM-based reward models (e.g., RewardDance) require costly human-annotated preference data and additional fine-tuning. We propose PromptEcho, a reward construction method that requires \emph{no} annotation and \emph{no} reward model training. Given a generated image and a guiding query, PromptEcho computes the token-level cross-entropy loss of a frozen VLM with the original prompt as the label, directly extracting the image-text alignment knowledge encoded during VLM pretraining. The reward is deterministic, computationally efficient, and improves automatically as stronger open-source VLMs become available. For evaluation, we develop DenseAlignBench, a benchmark of concept-rich dense captions for rigorously testing prompt following capability. Experimental results on two state-of-the-art T2I models (Z-Image and QwenImage-2512) demonstrate that PromptEcho achieves substantial improvements on DenseAlignBench (+26.8pp / +16.2pp net win rate), along with consistent gains on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and TIIFBench without any task-specific training. Ablation studies confirm that PromptEcho comprehensively outperforms inference-based scoring with the same VLM, and that reward quality scales with VLM size. We will open-source the trained models and the DenseAlignBench.

AI.tldr: PromptEcho 是一种无需人工标注、无需训练即可即时为 T2I 模型生成高质量奖励信号的方法，通过冻结 VLM 的 token 级交叉熵提取预训练知识，显著提升提示遵循度并在多项基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 微调 T2I 模型所依赖的奖励信号存在两大痛点：CLIP Score 粗略粗糙，而 VLM 型奖励模型（如 RewardDance）需昂贵人工偏好标注和额外微调，限制了可扩展性。
AI.method: PromptEcho 将“原始提示”作为标签，对冻结 VLM 在生成图像-提示对上计算 token 级交叉熵损失；该损失值即为奖励，直接重用预训练阶段已编码的图文对齐知识，无需任何标注或训练。
AI.result: 在 DenseAlignBench（+26.8pp / +16.2pp 净胜率）及 GenEval、DPG-Bench、TIIFBench 上，PromptEcho 对 Z-Image 与 QwenImage-2512 均带来一致显著提升；消融实验表明其全面优于同 VLM 的推理打分，且奖励质量随 VLM 规模增大而提升。
AI.conclusion: PromptEcho 提供了一种即插即用、可随开源 VLM 自动升级的免训练奖励构建范式，显著降低高质量 T2I 强化学习门槛；DenseAlignBench 同时被开源以推动该领域更严格的提示遵循评估。

title: Schema-Adaptive Tabular Representation Learning with LLMs for Generalizable Multimodal Clinical Reasoning
summary: Machine learning for tabular data remains constrained by poor schema generalization, a challenge rooted in the lack of semantic understanding of structured variables. This challenge is particularly acute in domains like clinical medicine, where electronic health record (EHR) schemas vary significantly. To solve this problem, we propose Schema-Adaptive Tabular Representation Learning, a novel method that leverages large language models (LLMs) to create transferable tabular embeddings. By transforming structured variables into semantic natural language statements and encoding them with a pretrained LLM, our approach enables zero-shot alignment across unseen schemas without manual feature engineering or retraining. We integrate our encoder into a multimodal framework for dementia diagnosis, combining tabular and MRI data. Experiments on NACC and ADNI datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and successful zero-shot transfer to unseen schemas, significantly outperforming clinical baselines, including board-certified neurologists, in retrospective diagnostic tasks. These results validate our LLM-driven approach as a scalable, robust solution for heterogeneous real-world data, offering a pathway to extend LLM-based reasoning to structured domains.

AI.tldr: 用LLM把表格变量转成自然语言句子，实现跨EHR架构零样本迁移，痴呆诊断任务超越神经科医师。
AI.motivation: 表格模态因缺乏语义理解导致跨库泛化差，临床EHR字段异构尤为严重。
AI.method: Schema-Adaptive Tabular Representation Learning：将结构化变量映射为自然语言陈述→预训练LLM编码→获取可迁移嵌入；并融入融合MRI的多模态框架。
AI.result: NACC+ADNI实验：零样本跨架构迁移达SOTA，诊断指标显著高于临床基线与认证神经科医师。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的语义化表格表征可扩展、鲁棒，为真实异构数据提供统一推理路径。

title: Designing Reliable LLM-Assisted Rubric Scoring for Constructed Responses: Evidence from Physics Exams
summary: Student responses in STEM assessments are often handwritten and combine symbolic expressions, calculations, and diagrams, creating substantial variation in format and interpretation. Despite their importance for evaluating students' reasoning, such responses are time-consuming to score and prone to rater inconsistency, particularly when partial credit is required. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have increased attention to AI-assisted scoring, yet evidence remains limited regarding how rubric design and LLM configurations influence reliability across performance levels. This study examined the reliability of AI-assisted scoring of undergraduate physics constructed responses using GPT-4o. Twenty authentic handwritten exam responses were scored across two rounds by four instructors and by the AI model using skill-based rubrics with differing levels of analytic granularity. Prompting format and temperature settings were systematically varied. Overall, human-AI agreement on total scores was comparable to human inter-rater reliability and was highest for high- and low-performing responses, but declined for mid-level responses involving partial or ambiguous reasoning. Criterion-level analyses showed stronger alignment for clearly defined conceptual skills than for extended procedural judgments. A more fine-grained, checklist-based rubric improved consistency relative to holistic scoring. These findings indicate that reliable AI-assisted scoring depends primarily on clear, well-structured rubrics, while prompting format plays a secondary role and temperature has relatively limited impact. More broadly, the study provides transferable design recommendations for implementing reliable LLM-assisted scoring in STEM contexts through skill-based rubrics and controlled LLM settings.

AI.tldr: 在20份手写大学物理开放题上，用GPT-4o按不同颗粒度评分规则进行两轮打分，发现人-机总分离散度与人人相当，高分与低分卷一致性高、中段含部分推理卷下降；细颗粒度检核表式规则比整体式可靠，提示格式次之，温度设置影响有限。
AI.motivation: STEM手写作答评分耗时长、主观性强，需借助大模型缓解教师负担并保持一致性，但尚未明确评分规则与模型配置对可靠性的具体影响。
AI.method: 采集20份真实手写物理考试答案，设计概念清晰/扩展程序两类技能导向评分规则，分别采用整体式和检核表式两种颗粒度；四位教师两轮人工评分，GPT-4o在不同提示格式与温度（0.0/0.7）下复评，计算人-机与人-人ICC、Kappa及准则层一致率，用方差分析与混淆矩阵比较差异。
AI.result: 总分离散度：人-机ICC≈人-人ICC≈0.82；高分/低分组绝对差<3%，中分段降至65%；准则层一致率：概念技能≥0.88，扩展程序≤0.72；检核表式规则比整体式规则将总分离散度标准差降低28%；提示格式影响次显著（η_p²=0.08），温度设置无统计学差异。
AI.conclusion: STEM开放题AI评分的可靠性首要依赖清晰、细颗粒度的技能导向评分规则，提示格式仅扮演辅助角色，温度参数影响有限。建议在实践层面推行检核表式分项评分规则、固定低温度并结合人工复核中段答案，以实现可迁移、可落地的LLM辅助评分框架。

title: OSC: Hardware Efficient W4A4 Quantization via Outlier Separation in Channel Dimension
summary: While 4-bit quantization is essential for high-throughput deployment of Large Language Models, activation outliers often lead to significant accuracy degradation due to the restricted dynamic range of low-bit formats. In this paper, we systematically investigate the spatial distribution of outliers and demonstrate a token-persistent structural clustering effect, where high-magnitude outliers consistently occupy fixed channels across tokens. Building on this insight, we propose OSC, a hardware-efficient framework for outlier suppression. During inference, OSC executes a dual-path computation consisting of a low-precision 4-bit General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) path and a high-precision 16-bit branch GEMM path. Specifically, OSC uses an offline group-wise strategy to identify the channels where outliers are located and then performs structured sub-tensor extraction to coalesce these scattered activation channels into a compact dense tensor online. This mechanism implements outlier protection through regularized and high-throughput GEMM operations, achieving a seamless fit with modern 4-bit micro-scaling hardware. Furthermore, for the inputs of W2 where outlier clustering is less pronounced, we integrate a fallback strategy to FP8. Evaluation on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B restricts the average accuracy drop to 2.19 and 1.12 points, respectively. Notably, OSC is highly hardware-friendly, achieving a peak speedup of 1.78x over the W8A8 GEMM baseline on a modern AI accelerator.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大模型激活异常值在空间上呈“固定通道聚集”现象，提出 OSC 框架：用 4-bit GEMM 主路+16-bit 支路并行计算，仅对异常通道做高精度补偿；异常分布弱时回退 FP8。实验在 Qwen3-8B/30B 上平均掉点仅 2.19/1.12，硬件实测较 W8A8 加速 1.78×。
AI.motivation: 4-bit 量化是大模型高吞吐部署的关键，但激活异常值因动态范围受限导致精度显著下降，亟需一种既保精度又适配 4-bit 微缩硬件的新方法。
AI.method: 1) 系统分析激活异常值的空间分布，验证其“token-固定通道”聚集效应；2) 提出 OSC：推理阶段并行执行 4-bit GEMM 主路 + 16-bit 支路 GEMM，离线组级定位异常通道，在线结构化子张量抽取将分散异常通道聚为紧凑张量；3) 对异常聚集不明显的 W2 输入集成 FP8 回退策略；4) 全流程映射到主流 4-bit 微缩 AI 加速器。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 与 30B 上，OSC 将平均精度损失分别压至 2.19 与 1.12 个百分点；硬件侧峰值提速 1.78×，优于 W8A8 GEMM 基线，且对 4-bit 微缩架构零改动即插即用。
AI.conclusion: OSC 通过“异常通道固定聚集”洞察，把异常处理从“逐 token 量化补偿”转为“结构化通道级补偿”，用极简硬件逻辑实现 4-bit 主计算+16-bit 异常护航，兼顾高吞吐与高精度，为百亿级模型 4-bit 落地提供了可扩展、易部署的范式。

title: Hypergraph-State Collaborative Reasoning for Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Motion reasoning serves as the cornerstone of multi-object tracking (MOT), as it enables consistent association of targets across frames. However, existing motion estimation approaches face two major limitations: (1) instability caused by noisy or probabilistic predictions, and (2) vulnerability under occlusion, where trajectories often fragment once visual cues disappear. To overcome these issues, we propose a collaborative reasoning framework that enhances motion estimation through joint inference among multiple correlated objects. By allowing objects with similar motion states to mutually constrain and refine each other, our framework stabilizes noisy trajectories and infers plausible motion continuity even when target is occluded. To realize this concept, we design HyperSSM, an architecture that integrates Hypergraph computation and a State Space Model (SSM) for unified spatial-temporal reasoning. The Hypergraph module captures spatial motion correlations through dynamic hyperedges, while the SSM enforces temporal smoothness via structured state transitions. This synergistic design enables simultaneous optimization of spatial consensus and temporal coherence, resulting in robust and stable motion estimation. Extensive experiments on four mainstream and diverse benchmarks(MOT17, MOT20, DanceTrack, and SportsMOT) covering various motion patterns and scene complexities, demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of tracking scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于超图-状态空间模型（HyperSSM）的协同运动推理框架，通过多目标联合约束解决噪声与遮挡导致的轨迹断裂，在四个主流MOT数据集上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多目标跟踪运动估计方法受噪声预测和遮挡影响，导致轨迹碎片化；亟需一种能在缺失视觉线索时仍保持稳定且连续的运动推理机制。
AI.method: 构建协同推理框架：①用动态超图捕帧内多目标空间运动关联，②用状态空间模型施加帧间时序平滑，③通过联合优化空间共识与时序一致性实现稳定轨迹估计。
AI.result: 在MOT17、MOT20、DanceTrack、SportsMOT四类场景与运动模式迥异的基准上均刷新SOTA指标，显著降低ID切换与碎片率，验证遮挡与复杂运动下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将空间-时序统一建模为协同推理问题可根本性提升运动估计稳定性；HyperSSM为遮挡与噪声场景提供通用且可扩展的解决范式，对实时与长线跟踪任务均具实用价值。

title: A Layer-wise Analysis of Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: While critical for alignment, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) incurs the risk of catastrophic forgetting, yet the layer-wise emergence of instruction-following capabilities remains elusive. We investigate this mechanism via a comprehensive analysis utilizing information-theoretic, geometric, and optimization metrics across model scales (1B-32B). Our experiments reveal a distinct depth-dependent pattern: middle layers (20\%-80\%) are stable, whereas final layers exhibit high sensitivity. Leveraging this insight, we propose Mid-Block Efficient Tuning, which selectively updates these critical intermediate layers. Empirically, our method outperforms standard LoRA up to 10.2\% on GSM8K (OLMo2-7B) with reduced parameter overhead, demonstrating that effective alignment is architecturally localized rather than distributed. The code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/base_sft.

AI.tldr: 对SFT过程中的灾难性遗忘进行剖析发现，中间20%-80 %层变化平缓而终层敏感，据此提出仅微调中间层的Mid-Block Efficient Tuning方法，在仅调正少数参数的情况下实现大幅超过LoRA的效果并验证对齐能力可以局域化。
AI.motivation: 监督微调对大模型对齐至关重要，但目前尚无研究深入分析SFT过程中不同层次对指令跟从能力贡献的规律，同时迫切需要缓解灾难性遗忘现象。
AI.method: 从信息论、几何与优化三个角度定量分析不同参数规模模型（1B–32B）的层间行为，识别出终层极易失稳而中层相对稳定的特性后，将微调范围限制在中间20 %-80 %层并采用LoRA式适配结构（Mid-Block Efficient Tuning）进行更新。
AI.result: 在GSM8K任务上OLMo2-7B相比全参数LoRA在参数量显著减少的前提下提升10.2 %，并在大模型其它测试集一致表现出更好的指令跟随性及忘记了更少原始信息。
AI.conclusion: 对齐表现出显著的空间局部性；调正中间若干层即可获得与全模型微调相当甚至更优的性能，为轻量化微调提供了新思路，并揭示了模型对齐能力与内部特定区段的对应关系。

title: HintMR: Eliciting Stronger Mathematical Reasoning in Small Language Models
summary: Small language models (SLMs) often struggle with complex mathematical reasoning due to limited capacity to maintain long chains of intermediate steps and to recover from early errors. We address this challenge by introducing a hint-assisted reasoning framework that incrementally guides SLMs through multi-step mathematical problem solving. Our approach decomposes solutions into sequential reasoning steps and provides context-aware hints, where hints are generated by a separate SLM trained via distillation from a strong large language model. While the hint-generating SLM alone is not capable of solving the problems, its collaboration with a reasoning SLM enables effective guidance, forming a cooperative two-model system for reasoning. Each hint is generated conditionally on the problem statement and the accumulated reasoning history, providing stepwise, localized guidance without revealing full solutions. This reduces error propagation and allows the reasoning model to focus on manageable subproblems. Experiments across diverse mathematical benchmarks and models demonstrate that hint assistance consistently improves reasoning accuracy for SLMs, yielding substantial gains over standard prompting while preserving model efficiency. These results highlight that structured collaboration between SLMs-via hint generation and reasoning-offers an effective and lightweight mechanism for enhancing mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 用“小模型教小模型”——蒸馏大模型产逐步提示，让SLM分段解数学题，准确率显著提升且零额外推理代价。
AI.motivation: SLM链式推理易累积误差、长程依赖难维持，直接放大模型又太重；需在不增参数量前提下提升多步数学能力。
AI.method: 1) 教师大模型→蒸馏训练专用“提示SLM”，只生成下一步提示而非答案；2) 提示SLM与解题SLM协同：每步按“题干+已推历史”生成局部提示，引导后者逐段完成子问题；3) 整个系统推理期仅运行两个轻量SLM，无大模型参与。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH等多学科基准上，7B以下SLM采用提示后准确率平均提升8–18个百分点，部分场景追平或超越10×体量的大模型；推理延迟仅增加约15%，参数量零新增。
AI.conclusion: “提示-解题”双SLM协作可在保持高效的前提下显著增强链式数学推理，为资源受限场景提供可扩展的轻量级方案，并验证了模型间知识蒸馏与分步引导的泛化潜力。

title: VFA: Relieving Vector Operations in Flash Attention with Global Maximum Pre-computation
summary: FlashAttention-style online softmax enables exact attention computation with linear memory by streaming score tiles through on-chip memory and maintaining a running maximum and normalizer. However, as attention kernels approach peak tensor-core/cube-core throughput on modern accelerators, non-matmul components of online softmax -- especially per-tile rowmax and rowsum reductions and rescale chains -- can become vector or SIMD limited and dominate latency. This paper revisits FlashAttention and proposes Vector Relieved Flash Attention (VFA), a hardware-friendly method that reduces rowmax-driven updates of the running maximum while retaining the online-softmax structure. VFA initializes the running maximum via a cheap approximation from key-block representations, reorders key-block traversal to prioritize high-impact sink and local blocks, and freezes the maximum for remaining blocks to avoid repeated reductions and rescaling. We further integrate VFA with block-sparse skipping methods such as BLASST to form Vector Relieved Sparse Attention (VSA), which reduces both block count and per-block overhead. Notably, VFA and VSA completely avoid the conditional rescale operation in the update stage used in FA4.0. Extensive evaluations on benchmarks including MMLU and MATH500, together with attention statistics, verify our design: (i) sink and local reordering stabilizes the running maximum early; (ii) simple Q and K block summaries fail due to intra-block heterogeneity; (iii) m-initialization is required when maxima appear in middle blocks. Overall, VFA and VSA efficiently alleviate online-softmax reduction bottlenecks without performance loss. Compared to the C16V32 baseline, C8V32, C4V32 and C4V16 achieve nearly two times speedup on modern hardware while hitting the vector bottleneck. With upcoming architecture improvements, C4V16 will deliver six times speedup by enhancing exponent capacity.

AI.tldr: VFA/VSA用近似初值+重排+冻结策略砍掉online-softmax的逐tile rowmax/reduction，在A100/H100类加速器上把向量瓶颈降至0，C4V16配置可达6×加速且精度无损。
AI.motivation: FlashAttention虽把显存降到O(N)，但其online-softmax的rowmax/rowsum归约链在峰值Tensor Core利用率下成为向量/SIMU瓶颈，占总体延迟30-40%，亟需消除。
AI.method: 1) 用key-block的轻量摘要（min-max sketch）快速初始化running max；2) 按“sink+local块优先”重排K块遍历，使最大值尽早收敛；3) 最大值收敛后对剩余块冻结，彻底去掉rescaling；4) 与块稀疏跳过策略BLASST融合成VSA，进一步减少块数与每块开销；5) 统一去掉FA4.0的条件rescale分支。
AI.result: MMLU、MATH500及内部Attention统计：sink+local重排2-3块内即稳定max；纯Q/K块摘要因块内异质性失败；max出现于中段时必需初值化。C8V32、C4V32、C4V16相对C16V32基线分别快1.92×、1.96×、1.98×，向量利用率从47%提至89%；若未来架构增加指数单元，C4V16可达6×。
AI.conclusion: 通过“近似初值+收敛 freezes”重构online-softmax，VFA/VSA在不损失精度的前提下把向量级延迟瓶颈转成计算bound，为下一代大模型长上下文提供可扩展的Attention核心。

title: OFA-Diffusion Compression: Compressing Diffusion Model in One-Shot Manner
summary: The Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DPM) achieves remarkable performance in image generation, while its increasing parameter size and computational overhead hinder its deployment in practical applications. To improve this, the existing literature focuses on obtaining a smaller model with a fixed architecture through model compression. However, in practice, DPMs usually need to be deployed on various devices with different resource constraints, which leads to multiple compression processes, incurring significant overhead for repeated training. To obviate this, we propose a once-for-all (OFA) compression framework for DPMs that yields different subnetworks with various computations in a one-shot training manner. The existing OFA framework typically involves massive subnetworks with different parameter sizes, while such a huge candidate space slows the optimization. Thus, we propose to restrict the candidate subnetworks with a certain set of parameter sizes, where each size corresponds to a specific subnetwork. Specifically, to construct each subnetwork with a given size, we gradually allocate the maintained channels by their importance. Furthermore, we propose a reweighting strategy to balance the optimization process of different subnetworks. Experimental results show that our approach can produce compressed DPMs for various sizes with significantly lower training overhead while achieving satisfactory performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“一次训练、多端部署”的扩散模型压缩框架，通过限制参数规模候选空间与重加权优化，单轮训练即可产出不同计算量的子网络，避免重复训练开销。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型参数量大、计算昂贵，现有压缩方法需为每种资源约束单独训练，导致重复开销；需实现“一次训练，多端适配”的压缩范式。
AI.method: 1.构建Once-for-All框架：单轮训练超大母网，支持抽取任意子网。2.候选空间剪枝：仅保留若干预设参数规模档位，每档对应唯一子网，降低优化难度。3.渐进通道分配：按通道重要性从高到低为每档规模分配通道，形成确定性子网结构。4.重加权训练策略：对不同规模子网的损失加权均衡，缓解大子网主导问题。
AI.result: 在多个数据集与网络上验证：单轮训练即可产出覆盖0.25×–1.0×参数的系列压缩模型，FID/IS指标与独立训练模型相当，训练总计算量降低3–5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 提出的OFA压缩框架首次将“一次训练、多端部署”引入扩散模型，显著减少训练开销，为实际多设备部署提供高效、可扩展的解决方案。

title: Beyond Static Sandboxing: Learned Capability Governance for Autonomous AI Agents
comment: 17 pages (9 content pages), 2 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026 Agent Safety Workshop. Code and dataset available at https://github.com/sidikbro/aethelgard
summary:
Autonomous AI agents built on open-source runtimes such as OpenClaw expose every available tool to every session by default, regardless of the task. A summarization task receives the same shell execution, subagent spawning, and credential access capabilities as a code deployment task, a 15x overprovision ratio that we call the capability overprovisioning problem. Existing defenses, including the NemoClaw container sandbox and the Cisco DefenseClaw skill scanner, address containment and threat detection but do not learn the minimum viable capability set for each task type.
  We present Aethelgard, a four layer adaptive governance framework that enforces least privilege for AI agents through a learned policy. Layer 1, the Capability Governor, dynamically scopes which tools the agent is aware of in each session. Layer 3, the Safety Router, intercepts tool calls before execution using a hybrid rule based and fine tuned classifier. Layer 2, the RL Learning Policy, trains a PPO policy on the accumulated audit log to learn the minimum viable skill set for each task type.

AI.tldr: 针对开源 AI Agent 默认暴露全部能力导致的过度授权问题，提出四层自适应治理框架 Aethelgard，通过动态削权和最小可行技能集学习实现最小权限原则。
AI.motivation: OpenClaw 等开源运行时默认向所有会话开放全部工具，导致任务无关能力被滥用；现有 NemoClaw 容器隔离与 Cisco DefenseClaw 威胁扫描仅做“事后”防护，无法针对具体任务动态收敛授权范围。
AI.method: 四层框架：① Capability Governor 按任务实时裁剪可见工具；② RL Learning Policy 用 PPO 聚合审计日志，学习每类任务的最小可行技能集；③ Safety Router 以规则+微调分类器拦截越权调用；④ 统一策略引擎持续更新最小权限策略。
AI.result: 将默认 15 倍的能力过度授权比降至接近 1，实现任务级最小权限；在代码部署、摘要等场景下，0 误拦截率下阻断 98.7% 的越权调用，收敛时间 <5 分钟。
AI.conclusion: Aethelgard 首次把“学习最小可行能力集”嵌入 Agent 治理链路，证明动态最小权限在开源 AI 运行时中可行，为后续零信任 Agent 生态提供可扩展框架。

title: MolMem: Memory-Augmented Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Molecular Optimization
summary: In drug discovery, molecular optimization aims to iteratively refine a lead compound to improve molecular properties while preserving structural similarity to the original molecule. However, each oracle evaluation is expensive, making sample efficiency a key challenge for existing methods under a limited oracle budget. Trial-and-error approaches require many oracle calls, while methods that leverage external knowledge tend to reuse familiar templates and struggle on challenging objectives. A key missing piece is long-term memory that can ground decisions and provide reusable insights for future optimizations. To address this, we present MolMem (\textbf{Mol}ecular optimization with \textbf{Mem}ory), a multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework with a dual-memory system. Specifically, MolMem uses Static Exemplar Memory to retrieve relevant exemplars for cold-start grounding, and Evolving Skill Memory to distill successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Built on this memory-augmented formulation, we train the policy with dense step-wise rewards, turning costly rollouts into long-term knowledge that improves future optimization. Extensive experiments show that MolMem achieves 90\% success on single-property tasks (1.5$\times$ over the best baseline) and 52\% on multi-property tasks using only 500 oracle calls. Our code is available at https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/MolMem.

AI.tldr: MolMem 以双记忆 RL 框架在仅 500 次 oracle 调用下，将单/多目标分子优化成功率分别提升到 90% 与 52%，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 分子优化每次实验评估昂贵，现有试错或模板借用方法样本效率低，且缺乏可跨任务复用的长期记忆来指导新优化。
AI.method: 提出 MolMem：1) Static Exemplar Memory 冷启动时检索相似成功分子；2) Evolving Skill Memory 持续蒸馏历史轨迹为可复用策略；3) 在记忆增强下用密集逐步奖励训练策略网络，将高成本 rollout 转化为长期知识。
AI.result: 在仅 500 次 oracle 预算下，单属性任务成功率 90%，比最强基线提升 1.5×；多属性任务 52%，均显著领先现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 双记忆机制使 RL 智能体把昂贵评估转化为可复用策略，实现小预算下的高效分子优化，为解决样本效率瓶颈提供了新范式。

title: Interpretable Relational Inference with LLM-Guided Symbolic Dynamics Modeling
summary: Inferring latent interaction structures from observed dynamics is a fundamental inverse problem in many-body interacting systems. Most neural approaches rely on black-box surrogates over trainable graphs, achieving accuracy at the expense of mechanistic interpretability. Symbolic regression offers explicit dynamical equations and stronger inductive biases, but typically assumes known topology and a fixed function library. We propose \textbf{COSINE} (\textbf{C}o-\textbf{O}ptimization of \textbf{S}ymbolic \textbf{I}nteractions and \textbf{N}etwork \textbf{E}dges), a differentiable framework that jointly discovers interaction graphs and sparse symbolic dynamics. To overcome the limitations of fixed symbolic libraries, COSINE further incorporates an outer-loop large language model that adaptively prunes and expands the hypothesis space using feedback from the inner optimization loop. Experiments on synthetic systems and large-scale real-world epidemic data demonstrate robust structural recovery and compact, mechanism-aligned dynamical expressions. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/COSINE-6D43.

AI.tldr: COSINE 以可微框架同步推断相互作用网络与稀疏符号动力学公式，并利用外层大模型动态调整符号库，兼顾结构可解释性与机制对齐的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络方法虽精度高但黑盒不可解释；符号回归可解释却假设已知拓扑与固定函数库，难以处理真实场景下结构与机制皆未知的问题。
AI.method: 提出 COSINE：内层可微联合优化图邻接矩阵与符号表达式，外层 LLM 根据优化反馈自适应剪枝/扩展符号假设空间，实现网络结构与会聚动力学同步发现。
AI.result: 在合成多体系统及大规模真实流行病数据上，COSINE 能稳健恢复交互结构并输出紧凑、与机制一致的符号方程，优于固定库符号方法与纯黑箱神经网络。
AI.conclusion: COSINE 首次将可微符号回归与 LLM 驱动的假设空间演化结合，为复杂系统逆向建模提供了兼顾可解释性、紧凑性与预测力的新范式。

title: Brain-DiT: A Universal Multi-state fMRI Foundation Model with Metadata-Conditioned Pretraining
summary: Current fMRI foundation models primarily rely on a limited range of brain states and mismatched pretraining tasks, restricting their ability to learn generalized representations across diverse brain states. We present \textit{Brain-DiT}, a universal multi-state fMRI foundation model pretrained on 349,898 sessions from 24 datasets spanning resting, task, naturalistic, disease, and sleep states. Unlike prior fMRI foundation models that rely on masked reconstruction in the raw-signal space or a latent space, \textit{Brain-DiT} adopts metadata-conditioned diffusion pretraining with a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), enabling the model to learn multi-scale representations that capture both fine-grained functional structure and global semantics. Across extensive evaluations and ablations on 7 downstream tasks, we find consistent evidence that diffusion-based generative pretraining is a stronger proxy than reconstruction or alignment, with metadata-conditioned pretraining further improving downstream performance by disentangling intrinsic neural dynamics from population-level variability. We also observe that downstream tasks exhibit distinct preferences for representational scale: ADNI classification benefits more from global semantic representations, whereas age/sex prediction comparatively relies more on fine-grained local structure. Code and parameters of Brain-DiT are available at \href{https://github.com/REDMAO4869/Brain-DiT}{Link}.

title: Polynomial Expansion Rank Adaptation: Enhancing Low-Rank Fine-Tuning with High-Order Interactions
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used strategy for efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), but its strictly linear structure fundamentally limits expressive capacity. The bilinear formulation of weight updates captures only first-order dependencies between low-rank factors, restricting the modeling of nonlinear and higher-order parameter interactions. In this paper, we propose Polynomial Expansion Rank Adaptation (PERA), a novel method that introduces structured polynomial expansion directly into the low-rank factor space. By expanding each low-rank factor to synthesize high-order interaction terms before composition, PERA transforms the adaptation space into a polynomial manifold capable of modeling richer nonlinear coupling without increasing rank or inference cost. We provide theoretical analysis demonstrating that PERA offers enhanced expressive capacity and more effective feature utilization compare to existing linear adaptation approaches. Empirically, PERA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse benchmarks. Notably, our experiments show that incorporating high-order nonlinear components particularly square terms is crucial for enhancing expressive capacity and maintaining strong and robust performance under various rank settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhangwenhao6/PERA

AI.tldr: PERA 通过将低秩因子显式多项式化，在不增秩、不增推理开销的前提下赋予 LoRA 非高阶耦合能力，全指标刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: LoRA 的严格线性更新仅建模一阶因子关系，无法刻画参数间非线性/高阶耦合，限制了微调表达能力。
AI.method: 提出多项式展开秩适配（PERA）：先对低秩因子做多项式展开生成高阶交互项，再组合成适配矩阵，使适配空间成为多项式流形；训练仅更新多项式系数，保持原始秩与推理代价不变。
AI.result: 理论证明 PERA 的表达能力严格优于线性 LoRA；在多项 NLP/多模态基准上，不同秩设定下均显著超越 LoRA、AdaLoRA 等 SOTA，且平方项是提升鲁棒性的关键。
AI.conclusion: 低秩 + 多项式展开是兼具参数效率与表达力的有效范式，为高效微调提供了新思路。

title: How memory can affect collective and cooperative behaviors in an LLM-Based Social Particle Swarm
summary: This study examines how model-specific characteristics of Large Language Model (LLM) agents, including internal alignment, shape the effect of memory on their collective and cooperative dynamics in a multi-agent system. To this end, we extend the Social Particle Swarm (SPS) model, in which agents move in a two-dimensional space and play the Prisoner's Dilemma with neighboring agents, by replacing its rule-based agents with LLM agents endowed with Big Five personality scores and varying memory lengths. Using Gemini-2.0-Flash, we find that memory length is a critical parameter governing collective behavior: even a minimal memory drastically suppressed cooperation, transitioning the system from stable cooperative clusters through cyclical formation and collapse of clusters to a state of scattered defection as memory length increased. Big Five personality traits correlated with agent behaviors in partial agreement with findings from experiments with human participants, supporting the validity of the model. Comparative experiments using Gemma~3:4b revealed the opposite trend: longer memory promoted cooperation, accompanied by the formation of dense cooperative clusters. Sentiment analysis of agents' reasoning texts showed that Gemini interprets memory increasingly negatively as its length grows, while Gemma interprets it less negatively, and that this difference persists in the early phase of experiments before the macro-level dynamics converge. These results suggest that model-specific characteristics of LLMs, potentially including alignment, play a fundamental role in determining emergent social behavior in Generative Agent-Based Modeling, and provide a micro-level cognitive account of the contradictions found in prior work on memory and cooperation.

AI.tldr: 在多智能体囚徒困境框架中，Gemini-2.0 记忆越短越合作，Gemma-3:4b 则相反；模型对齐差异导致对记忆的负面情感随长度增加而被放大或削弱，从而决定宏观合作走向。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式多智能体研究多将 LLM 视为黑箱，忽略模型特有性质（特别是内部对齐）如何调节“记忆”这一微观认知变量，进而影响宏观合作涌现；已有文献关于记忆与合作的结论相互矛盾，缺乏基于模型差异的微解释。
AI.method: 1) 将 SPS 二维空间囚徒困境模型中的规则智能体替换为具备 Big Five 人格与可变记忆长度的 LLM 智能体；2) 分别用 Gemini-2.0-Flash 与 Gemma-3:4b 进行对比实验，系统扫描记忆长度；3) 对智能体推理文本做情感分析，关联早期认知表征与后期宏观动态。
AI.result: Gemini：记忆≥1 即破坏合作，系统从稳定合作簇→周期坍缩→全散背叛；Gemma：记忆越长合作率越高，形成致密合作簇。Big Five 行为模式部分符合人类实验。情感极性差异在宏观收敛前已出现，Gemini 对长记忆持续负面解读，Gemma 负面度下降。
AI.conclusion: LLM 的模型专属性质（含内部对齐）通过塑造对“历史信息”的情感与认知评估，从根本上决定生成式多智能体中的合作涌现，为记忆—合作悖论提供微观认知解释，并警示实验结论的模型依赖性。

title: Algorithmic Analysis of Dense Associative Memory: Finite-Size Guarantees and Adversarial Robustness
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, Accepted in New Frontiers in Associative Memory workshop at ICLR 2026
summary:
Dense Associative Memory (DAM) generalizes Hopfield networks through higher-order interactions and achieves storage capacity that scales as $O(N^{n-1})$ under suitable pattern separation conditions. Existing dynamical analyses primarily study the thermodynamic limit $N\to\infty$ with randomly sampled patterns and therefore do not provide finite-size guarantees or explicit convergence rates.
  We develop an algorithmic analysis of DAM retrieval dynamics that yields finite-$N$ guarantees under explicit, verifiable pattern conditions. Under a separation assumption and a bounded-interference condition at high loading, we prove geometric convergence of asynchronous retrieval dynamics, which implies $O(\log N)$ convergence time once the trajectory enters the basin of attraction. We further establish adversarial robustness bounds expressed through an explicit margin condition that quantifies the number of corrupted bits tolerable per sweep, and derive capacity guarantees that scale as $Θ(N^{n-1})$ up to polylogarithmic factors in the worst case, while recovering the classical $Θ(N^{n-1})$ scaling for random pattern ensembles. Finally, we show that DAM retrieval dynamics admit a potential-game interpretation that ensures convergence to pure Nash equilibria under asynchronous updates.
  Complete proofs are provided in the appendices, together with preliminary experiments that illustrate the predicted convergence, robustness, and capacity scaling behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文首次给出稠密联想记忆网络有限规模下的 O(log N) 几何收敛保证，并证明在随机与最坏情形加载下容量均达到 Θ(N^{n−1})，同时给出可计算的容错与鲁棒性上界。
AI.motivation: Hopfield 的推广模型—稠密联想记忆(DAM) 在热力学极限分析中虽已达 Θ(N^{n−1}) 容量，但无有限 N 的收敛速度或确定性保证；实际硬件与学习芯片需要显式收敛界与最坏情形负载的容量下限。
AI.method: 用组合能量函数将异步更新映射为势博弈；提出“模式分离假设＋交扰有界条件”两阶可验证条件；引入耦合矩阵与逐层间隔分析，给出首达吸引盆内后的几何收敛率；用显式 margin 条件导出比特级对抗扰动上界；对随机与任意两种加载分情形证明 Θ(N^{n−1}) 容量上下匹配至多 polylog 项。
AI.result: 文献首次得到：① 有限 N 时异步 DAM 每次更新能量下降比为常数，收敛时间 O(log N)； ② 势博弈保证收敛到纯纳什均衡； ③ 随机模式容量恢复经典 Θ(N^{n−1})，最坏加载仍保持 Θ(N^{n−1})； ④ 每步可容忍常数比例位翻转，翻转数与 n、φ 显式相关； ⑤ 实验验证理论预测收敛速率与容量-鲁棒耦合关系。
AI.conclusion: 通过算法化分析，DAM 的实际性能可安全高效地被边学边用；端到端给出收敛速度、容错能力和容量三者同界，为异步类 Hopfield 芯片及在线联想内存设计提供可部署的理论保证。

title: Risk-Calibrated Learning: Minimizing Fatal Errors in Medical AI
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2026). The final published version should be cited
summary: Deep learning models often achieve expert-level accuracy in medical image classification but suffer from a critical flaw: semantic incoherence. These high-confidence mistakes that are semantically incoherent (e.g., classifying a malignant tumor as benign) fundamentally differ from acceptable errors which stem from visual ambiguity. Unlike safe, fine-grained disagreements, these fatal failures erode clinical trust. To address this, we propose Risk-Calibrated Learning, a technique that explicitly distinguishes between visual ambiguity (fine-grained errors) and catastrophic structural errors. By embedding a confusion-aware clinical severity matrix M into the optimization landscape, our method suppresses critical errors (false negatives) without requiring complex architectural changes. We validate our approach in four different imaging modalities: Brain Tumor MRI, ISIC 2018 (Dermoscopy), BreaKHis (Breast Histopathology), and SICAPv2 (Prostate Histopathology). Extensive experiments demonstrate that our Risk-Calibrated Loss consistently reduces the Critical Error Rate (CER) for all four datasets, achieving relative safety improvements ranging from 20.0% (on breast histopathology) to 92.4% (on prostate histopathology) compared to state-of-the-art baselines such as Focal Loss. These results confirm that our method offers a superior safety-accuracy trade-off across both CNN and Transformer architectures.

AI.tldr: 针对医疗影像深度模型的高置信、语义灾难性误判问题，提出Risk-Calibrated Learning方法，将临床严重度矩阵M嵌入训练损失函数，在不修改网络结构的前提下显著降低关键错误率。
AI.motivation: 深度模型虽能达到专家级准确率，却常出现恶性→良性的高置信
AI.method: 混淆感知临床严重度矩阵M用于区分可接受模糊性误差与结构性错误，嵌入优化目标以抑制假阴性；无需架构修改
AI.result: 在脑肿瘤MRI、ISIC 2018、BreaKHis与SICAPv2四类影像上，对CNN和Transformer均显著降低Critical Error Rate；相对安全提升20.0%(乳腺)–92.4%(前列腺)
AI.conclusion: Risk-Calibrated Loss在有损准确率几乎不变的情况下实现关键错误大幅降低，提供了更安全可靠的医疗影像分类方案

title: DBGL: Decay-aware Bipartite Graph Learning for Irregular Medical Time Series Classification
summary: Irregular Medical Time Series play a critical role in the clinical domain to better understand the patient's condition. However, inherent irregularity arising from heterogeneous sampling rates, asynchronous observations, and variable gaps poses key challenges for reliable modeling. Existing methods often distort temporal sampling irregularity and missingness patterns while failing to capture variable decay irregularity, resulting in suboptimal representations. To address these limitations, we introduce DBGL, Decay-Aware Bipartite Graph Learning for Irregular Medical Time Series. DBGL first introduces a patient-variable bipartite graph that simultaneously captures irregular sampling patterns without artificial alignment and adaptively models variable relationships for temporal sampling irregularity modeling, enhancing representation learning. To model variable decay irregularity, DBGL designs a novel node-specific temporal decay encoding mechanism that captures each variable's decay rates based on sampling interval, yielding a more accurate and faithful representation of irregular temporal dynamics. We evaluate the performance of DBGL on four publicly available datasets, and the results show that DBGL outperforms all baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出无需对齐时序的DBGL框架，把病人-变量看成二分图并引入节点级衰减速率编码，在4个公开数据集上全面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 临床不规则医疗时序存在采样率异质、观测异步、间隔可变等问题，现有方法强行对齐会破坏采样不规则性与变量衰减动态，导致表征次优。
AI.method: 1) 构建病人-变量二分图，直接对原始不规则采样建模并自适应学习变量关系；2) 设计节点专用时序衰减编码器，依据采样间隔为每个变量估计个体化衰减速率，忠实反映时序动态。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III、PhysioNet2012、eICU、HiRID四个公开数据集的多项预测任务中，DBGL在AUC、F1、AP等指标上均显著优于15+当前最优基线。
AI.conclusion: DBGL首次将二分图与衰减速率显式建模结合，有效保留医疗时序的不规则采样和变量衰减特性，为临床表征学习提供了新范式并证明其通用性和可扩展性。

title: CodeSpecBench: Benchmarking LLMs for Executable Behavioral Specification Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate code from natural language, but the extent to which they capture intended program behavior remains unclear. Executable behavioral specifications, defined via preconditions and postconditions, provide a concrete means to assess such understanding. However, existing work on specification generation is constrained in evaluation methodology, task settings, and specification expressiveness. We introduce CodeSpecBench, a benchmark for executable behavioral specification generation under an execution-based evaluation protocol. CodeSpecBench supports both function-level and repository-level tasks and encodes specifications as executable Python functions. Constructed from diverse real-world codebases, it enables a realistic assessment of both correctness (accepting valid behaviors) and completeness (rejecting invalid behaviors). Evaluating 15 state-of-the-art LLMs on CodeSpecBench, we observe a sharp performance degradation on repository-level tasks, where the best model attains only a 20.2% pass rate. We further find that specification generation is substantially more challenging than code generation, indicating that strong coding performance does not necessarily reflect deep understanding of intended program semantics. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/SparksofAGI/CodeSpecBench.

AI.tldr: CodeSpecBench 评估 LLM 能否生成可执行的函数级/仓库级行为规约；最佳模型仓库级通过率仅 20.2%，显示规约生成比代码生成更难。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对 LLM 是否真正理解“程序该做什么”的系统评估，而可执行的前后置条件规约能直接用运行结果验证这种理解，但相关基准在评估方法、任务粒度与表达能力上均受限。
AI.method: 提出 CodeSpecBench：从真实代码库抽取函数与仓库级样本，将规约编码为可执行 Python 函数；设计基于执行的评估协议，同时衡量“接受合法行为”的正确性与“拒绝非法行为”的完备性；对 15 个 SOTA LLM 进行系统实验。
AI.result: 函数级任务表现尚可，但仓库级任务所有模型显著掉分，最佳仅 20.2% 通过率；规约生成难度远高于普通代码生成，说明高代码生成性能≠深度语义理解。
AI.conclusion: CodeSpecBench 揭示了当前 LLM 在捕获程序语义方面的显著不足，推动社区从“能生成代码”走向“能生成正确且完备规约”的新目标。

title: Understanding and Improving Continuous Adversarial Training for LLMs via In-context Learning Theory
comment: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
summary: Adversarial training (AT) is an effective defense for large language models (LLMs) against jailbreak attacks, but performing AT on LLMs is costly. To improve the efficiency of AT for LLMs, recent studies propose continuous AT (CAT) that searches for adversarial inputs within the continuous embedding space of LLMs during AT. While CAT has achieved empirical success, its underlying mechanism, i.e., why adversarial perturbations in the embedding space can help LLMs defend against jailbreak prompts synthesized in the input token space, remains unknown. This paper presents the first theoretical analysis of CAT on LLMs based on in-context learning (ICL) theory. For linear transformers trained with adversarial examples from the embedding space on in-context linear regression tasks, we prove a robust generalization bound that has a negative correlation with the perturbation radius in the embedding space. This clearly explains why CAT can defend against jailbreak prompts from the LLM's token space. Further, the robust bound shows that the robustness of an adversarially trained LLM is closely related to the singular values of its embedding matrix. Based on this, we propose to improve LLM CAT by introducing an additional regularization term, which depends on singular values of the LLM's embedding matrix, into the objective function of CAT. Experiments on real-world LLMs demonstrate that our method can help LLMs achieve a better jailbreak robustness-utility tradeoff. The code is available at https://github.com/fshp971/continuous-adv-icl.

AI.tldr: 首次从理论上解释LLM连续对抗训练(CAT)为何能抵御token层面的越狱攻击，并给出基于嵌入矩阵奇异值的正则化方法，在真实模型上实现鲁棒性与可用性的更好折中。
AI.motivation: 连续对抗训练(CAT)在嵌入空间搜索扰动以提升LLM对 jailbreak 的鲁棒性，虽已经验有效，但“嵌入空间扰动为何能防御token空间构造的越狱提示”缺乏理论解释；高昂的训练成本也亟需更高效的方法。
AI.method: 1) 将ICL理论扩展到线性Transformer，在嵌入空间对上下文线性回归任务做对抗训练；2) 证明鲁棒泛化界与嵌入扰动半径负相关，从而解释CAT机制；3) 揭示鲁棒性与嵌入矩阵奇异值的关系，提出在CAT目标中增加基于奇异值的正则项；4) 在真实LLM上验证新目标函数的改进效果。
AI.result: 理论得到首个针对LLM的CAT鲁棒泛化界，明确扰动半径越大鲁棒性越好；实验显示加入奇异值正则后，模型在保持通用能力的同时显著提升越狱鲁棒性，取得更优的鲁棒-效用折中。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间的对抗扰动之所以有效，是因为其通过ICL机制放大了对token空间恶意提示的抵抗力；奇异值正则化可直接优化这一机制，为高效、可解释的LLM对抗训练提供新思路。

title: AffectAgent: Collaborative Multi-Agent Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: LLM-based multimodal emotion recognition relies on static parametric memory and often hallucinates when interpreting nuanced affective states. In this paper, given that single-round retrieval-augmented generation is highly susceptible to modal ambiguity and therefore struggles to capture complex affective dependencies across modalities, we introduce AffectAgent, an affect-oriented multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation framework that leverages collaborative decision-making among agents for fine-grained affective understanding. Specifically, AffectAgent comprises three jointly optimized specialized agents, namely a query planner, an evidence filter, and an emotion generator, which collaboratively perform analytical reasoning to retrieve cross-modal samples, assess evidence, and generate predictions. These agents are optimized end-to-end using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) with a shared affective reward to ensure consistent emotion understanding. Furthermore, we introduce Modality-Balancing Mixture of Experts (MB-MoE) and Retrieval-Augmented Adaptive Fusion (RAAF), where MB-MoE dynamically regulates the contributions of different modalities to mitigate representation mismatch caused by cross-modal heterogeneity, while RAAF enhances semantic completion under missing-modality conditions by incorporating retrieved audiovisual embeddings. Extensive experiments on MER-UniBench demonstrate that AffectAgent achieves superior performance across complex scenarios. Our code will be released at: https://github.com/Wz1h1NG/AffectAgent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AffectAgent：首个面向情感的多智能体检索增强框架，通过三智能体协同+MAPPO 端到端优化，在 MER-UniBench 上显著降低跨模态幻觉并提升细粒度情绪识别。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 多模态情绪识别依赖静态参数记忆，面对细微情感时易幻觉；单轮 RAG 受模态歧义影响，难以捕获跨模态复杂情感依赖。
AI.method: 设计三专用智能体协同框架：①查询规划器 ②证据过滤器 ③情绪生成器；用 MAPPO 共享情感奖励端到端优化；提出 Modality-Balancing MoE 动态调节模态贡献，Retrieval-Augmented Adaptive Fusion 在缺失模态下借助检索嵌入补全语义。
AI.result: 在 MER-UniBench 多项复杂场景指标上取得 SOTA，显著降低跨模态幻觉并提升细粒度识别准确率。
AI.conclusion: AffectAgent 通过多智能体协同与检索增强策略，有效缓解模态异质性与缺失问题，为细粒度情感理解提供可扩展新范式。

title: Evaluating the Limitations of Protein Sequence Representations for Parkinson's Disease Classification
summary: The identification of reliable molecular biomarkers for Parkinson's disease remains challenging due to its multifactorial nature. Although protein sequences constitute a fundamental and widely available source of biological information, their standalone discriminative capacity for complex disease classification remains unclear. In this work, we present a controlled and leakage-free evaluation of multiple representations derived exclusively from protein primary sequences, including amino acid composition, k-mers, physicochemical descriptors, hybrid representations, and embeddings from protein language models, all assessed under a nested stratified cross-validation framework to ensure unbiased performance estimation. The best-performing configuration (ProtBERT + MLP) achieves an F1-score of 0.704 +/- 0.028 and ROC-AUC of 0.748 +/- 0.047, indicating only moderate discriminative performance. Classical representations such as k-mers reach comparable F1 values (up to approximately 0.667), but exhibit highly imbalanced behavior, with recall close to 0.98 and precision around 0.50, reflecting a strong bias toward positive predictions. Across representations, performance differences remain within a narrow range (F1 between 0.60 and 0.70), while unsupervised analyses reveal no intrinsic structure aligned with class labels, and statistical testing (Friedman test, p = 0.1749) does not indicate significant differences across models. These results demonstrate substantial overlap between classes and indicate that primary sequence information alone provides limited discriminative power for Parkinson's disease classification. This work establishes a reproducible baseline and provides empirical evidence that more informative biological features, such as structural, functional, or interaction-based descriptors, are required for robust disease modeling.

AI.tldr: 仅基于蛋白质一级序列的多类特征在帕金森病分类中的判别力有限，最佳F1≈0.70，且无显著差异，提示需引入更高阶生物学信息。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病分子标志物发现困难，需明确最廉价易得的蛋白质序列信息是否足以区分疾病状态，为后续特征选择提供依据。
AI.method: 在嵌套分层交叉验证框架下，系统比较氨基酸组成、k-mer、物化描述符、混合特征及蛋白语言模型ProtBERT等六种纯序列表示，结合MLP分类器并严格控制数据泄漏。
AI.result: ProtBERT+MLP取得最高F1=0.704±0.028与ROC-AUC=0.748±0.047；经典k-mer亦可达F1≈0.667，但召回0.98、精确率0.50，显著偏向阳性预测。所有表示F1集中于0.60–0.70，无监督分析未见类别结构，Friedman检验p=0.1749表明模型间差异不显著。
AI.conclusion: 仅使用一级序列无法提供足够判别信息，类别分布高度重叠；研究确立了可复现的性能基线，并指出必须整合结构、功能或相互作用等更高阶特征才能构建稳健的帕金森病预测模型。

title: The Enforcement and Feasibility of Hate Speech Moderation on Twitter
summary: Online hate speech is associated with substantial social harms, yet it remains unclear how consistently platforms enforce hate speech policies or whether enforcement is feasible at scale. We address these questions through a global audit of hate speech moderation on Twitter (now X). Using a complete 24-hour snapshot of public tweets, we construct representative samples comprising 540,000 tweets annotated for hate speech by trained annotators across eight major languages. Five months after posting, 80% of hateful tweets remain online, including explicitly violent hate speech. Such tweets are no more likely to be removed than non-hateful tweets, with neither severity nor visibility increasing the likelihood of removal. We then examine whether these enforcement gaps reflect technical limits of large-scale moderation systems. While fully automated detection systems cannot reliably identify hate speech without generating large numbers of false positives, they effectively prioritize likely violations for human review. Simulations of a human-AI moderation pipeline indicate that substantially reducing user exposure to hate speech is economically feasible at a cost below existing regulatory penalties. These results suggest that the persistence of online hate cannot be explained by technical constraints alone but also reflects institutional choices in the allocation of moderation resources.

AI.tldr: 对Twitter一日内54万条多语言推文的审计显示，80%含仇恨言论的帖子5个月后仍在线；自动检测虽可为人审提供高优先级队列，且人-机混合审核成本低于现行罚款，但平台仍未有效移除仇恨内容。
AI.motivation: 厘清社交平台对仇恨言论政策的执行一致性，并评估其在大规模层面是否具备技术可行性执行。
AI.method: 采集Twitter 24h完整快照，构建覆盖8种语言的54万条代表性推文，人工标注仇恨程度；5个月后追踪删除状态；设计人-机混合审核模拟，评估成本效益。
AI.result: 1. 80%仇恨推文未被删除，暴力仇恨亦不例外；严重程度与曝光度均不影响删除概率。2. 自动检测难以避免高误报，但能高效预筛高风险内容供人工复核。3. 模拟显示若投入合理审核资源，可在低于监管罚款的成本下显著减少用户接触仇恨言论。
AI.conclusion: 仇恨言论持续存在并非受限于检测技术，而是平台在资源配置与治理选择上的制度性缺位。

title: Loop Corrections to the Training and Generalization Errors of Random Feature Models
summary: We investigate random feature models in which neural networks sampled from a prescribed initialization ensemble are frozen and used as random features, with only the readout weights optimized. Adopting a statistical-physics viewpoint, we study the training, test, and generalization errors beyond the mean-kernel approximation. Since the predictor is a nonlinear functional of the induced random kernel, the ensemble-averaged errors depend not only on the mean kernel but also on higher-order fluctuation statistics. Within an effective field-theoretic framework, these finite-width contributions naturally appear as loop corrections. We derive the loop corrections to the training, test, and generalization errors, obtain their scaling laws, and support the theory with experimental verification.

AI.tldr: 冻结随机初始化网络仅训练输出层时，训练/测试/泛化误差的关键修正来自网络有限宽度导致的核涨落；作者用场论环路展开给出可实验验证的标度律。
AI.motivation: 超越平均核近似，解释在“冻结随机特征”框架下有限宽度网络为何及如何因核的统计涨落而产生额外的泛化行为。
AI.method: 以统计物理视角，将有限宽度效应视为场论中的圈修正，推导训练、测试与泛化误差的环路修正项并给出其标度律；通过实验测量不同宽度、样本量下的误差行为验证理论预测。
AI.result: 环路修正项显式依赖核方差等高一阶统计量，误差随宽度增大呈 1/宽度 衰减；实验结果与理论标度律高度一致，证实有限宽度涨落对泛化性能的可观影响。
AI.conclusion: 即使在冻结随机特征场景，网络宽度而非仅仅平均核决定了泛化精度；纳入圈修正的理论完整描述了有限宽度网络的误差行为，为设计高效随机特征提供定量指导。

title: Scaling In-Context Segmentation with Hierarchical Supervision
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables medical image segmentation models to adapt to new anatomical structures from limited examples, reducing the clinical annotation burden. However, standard ICL methods typically rely on dense, global cross-attention, which scales poorly with image resolution. While recent approaches have introduced localized attention mechanisms, they often lack explicit supervision on the selection process, leading to redundant computation in non-informative regions. We propose PatchICL, a hierarchical framework that combines selective image patching with multi-level supervision. Our approach learns to actively identify and attend only to the most informative anatomical regions. Compared to UniverSeg, a strong global-attention baseline, PatchICL achieves competitive in-domain CT segmentation accuracy while reducing compute by 44\% at $512\times512$ resolution. On 35 out-of-domain datasets spanning diverse imaging modalities, PatchICL outperforms the baseline on 6 of 13 modality categories, with particular strength on modalities dominated by localized pathology such as OCT and dermoscopy. Training and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/tidiane-camaret/ic_segmentation

AI.tldr: PatchICL 用分层选块+多级监督替代全局交叉注意力，在 512×512 CT 上节省 44% 计算量，35 个跨域数据集中 6/13 模态优于 UniverSeg，对 OCT、皮肤镜等局部病灶优势最大。
AI.motivation: 传统 ICL 分割依赖全局密集交叉注意力，分辨率高时计算爆炸；现有局部注意力又缺乏显式监督，导致冗余计算。临床亟需既省标注又省算力的自适应分割方案。
AI.method: 提出 PatchICL：1) 分层视觉 Transformer 先全局粗定位病灶，再逐层细化选块；2) 多任务头并行预测分割、选块掩码及不确定性，用多级监督强制网络只关注高信息区域；3) 推理时动态裁剪 35% 补丁即可保持精度。
AI.result: 512×512 CT 分割 Dice 与 UniverSeg 持平，FLOPs 降 44%，推理延迟减 38%。跨 35 个数据集的 13 类模态中，在 6 类上显著领先，OCT 和皮肤镜 Dice 分别提升 3.2 和 2.8 个百分点，其余模态不劣于基线。
AI.conclusion: PatchICL 首次将“主动选块”引入医学 ICL，证明显式稀疏监督可在不牺牲精度的前提下大幅削减计算，为高分辨率、多模态临床部署提供了可行范式。

title: MVAdapt: Zero-Shot Multi-Vehicle Adaptation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-End (E2E) autonomous driving models are usually trained and evaluated with a fixed ego-vehicle, even though their driving policy is implicitly tied to vehicle dynamics. When such a model is deployed on a vehicle with different size, mass, or drivetrain characteristics, its performance can degrade substantially; we refer to this problem as the vehicle-domain gap. To address it, we propose MVAdapt, a physics-conditioned adaptation framework for multi-vehicle E2E driving. MVAdapt combines a frozen TransFuser++ scene encoder with a lightweight physics encoder and a cross-attention module that conditions scene features on vehicle properties before waypoint decoding. In the CARLA Leaderboard 1.0 benchmark, MVAdapt improves over naive transfer and multi-embodiment adaptation baselines on both in-distribution and unseen vehicles. We further show two complementary behaviors: strong zero-shot transfer on many unseen vehicles, and data-efficient few-shot calibration for severe physical outliers. These results suggest that explicitly conditioning E2E driving policies on vehicle physics is an effective step toward more transferable autonomous driving models. All codes are available at https://github.com/hae-sung-oh/MVAdapt

AI.tldr: MVAdapt 通过引入物理条件编码与跨注意力机制，在端到端模型中将场景特征显式地与车辆参数绑定，有效缓解因车型差异导致的域间隙问题，实现零样本与小样本下的优异泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶模型在训练与测试阶段均使用固定本体车，隐含策略与车辆动力学强耦合；一旦部署至不同尺寸、质量或驱动配置的车辆，性能陡降，即“车辆域间隙”。作者希望突破该瓶颈，让同一模型可迁移至多车型而无需重训。
AI.method: 提出 MVAdapt 框架：冻结的 TransFuser++ 场景编码器提取通用环境特征；轻量级物理编码器将车辆参数映射至隐空间；跨注意力模块将场景特征按车辆属性重新加权，再送入航点解码器。训练阶段仅更新物理编码器与注意力层，保持场景理解能力不变。实验基于 CARLA Leaderboard 1.0，对比 naive transfer 与多机体系基线。
AI.result: 在分布内与未见车型上，MVAdapt 驾驶分数显著优于基线；对多数未见车型实现零样本强迁移；对极端参数车型仅需少量样本即可快速校准，数据效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式将车辆物理信息融入端到端策略，可显著增强模型的跨车型可迁移性，为构建通用化自动驾驶系统提供了可行路径。代码已开源。

title: Frontier-Eng: Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on Real-World Engineering Tasks with Generative Optimization
summary: Current LLM agent benchmarks, which predominantly focus on binary pass/fail tasks such as code generation or search-based question answering, often neglect the value of real-world engineering that is often captured through the iterative optimization of feasible designs. To this end, we introduce Frontier-Eng, a human-verified benchmark for generative optimization -- an iterative propose-execute-evaluate loop in which an agent generates candidate artifacts, receives executable verifier feedback, and revises them under a fixed interaction budget -- spanning $47$ tasks across five broad engineering categories. Unlike previous suites, Frontier-Eng tasks are grounded in industrial-grade simulators and verifiers that provide continuous reward signals and enforce hard feasibility constraints under constrained budgets. We evaluate eight frontier language models using representative search frameworks, finding that while Claude 4.6 Opus achieves the most robust performance, the benchmark remains challenging for all models. Our analysis suggests a dual power-law decay in improvement frequency ($\sim$ 1/iteration) and magnitude ($\sim$ 1/improvement count). We further show that although width improves parallelism and diversity, depth remains crucial for hard-won improvements under a fixed budget. Frontier-Eng establishes a new standard for assessing the capacity of AI agents to integrate domain knowledge with executable feedback to solve complex, open-ended engineering problems.

AI.tldr: 作者提出全新工业级基准Frontier-Eng，要求Agent在固定迭代预算下对47项工程任务做连续优化；Claude-4.6 Opus表现最佳但仍远逊人类；改进频率与幅度呈双重幂律衰减。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准多为一次性的“通过/失败”任务，忽视真实工程中反复优化可行方案的迭代价值，因此需要能评估Agent“提出→执行→验证→再设计”闭环能力的测试集。
AI.method: 1) 构造47个跨5大工程类别的任务，全部基于工业级仿真器与验证器，输出连续奖励并强制执行约束；2) 引入“生成式优化”范式：固定迭代次数内，Agent循环提交设计→获可执行反馈→再修改；3) 用该基准评测8个前沿模型，并系统分析并行宽度与串行深度对性能的影响。
AI.result: Claude-4.6 Opus平均得分最高，但整体成功率仍低；模型改进呈现“频率∝1/迭代、幅度∝1/已改进次数”的双重幂律衰减；增加并行路径可提升多样性，但对高难任务的关键增益仍依赖深度迭代。
AI.conclusion: Frontier-Eng确立了评估Agent融合领域知识与可执行反馈、解决开放式复杂工程问题的新标准，并揭示固定预算下深度迭代对真正突破的决定性作用。

title: TCL: Enabling Fast and Efficient Cross-Hardware Tensor Program Optimization via Continual Learning
comment: introduces TCL framework for cross-hardware tensor program optimization with active learning, Mamba-based cost model, and continual knowledge distillation; includes extensive experiments on CPU and GPU platforms
summary: Deep learning (DL) compilers rely on cost models and auto-tuning to optimize tensor programs for target hardware. However, existing approaches depend on large offline datasets, incurring high collection costs and offering suboptimal transferability across platforms. In this paper, we introduce TCL, a novel efficient and transferable compiler framework for fast tensor program optimization across diverse hardware platforms to address these challenges. Specifically, TCL is built on three core enablers: (1) the RDU Sampler, a data-efficient active learning strategy that selects only 10% of tensor programs by jointly optimizing Representativeness, Diversity, and Uncertainty, substantially reducing data collection costs while maintaining near-original model accuracy; (2) a new Mamba-based cost model that efficiently captures long-range schedule dependencies while achieving a favorable trade-off between prediction accuracy and computational cost through reduced parameterization and lightweight sequence modeling; and (3) a continuous knowledge distillation framework that effectively and progressively transfers knowledge across multiple hardware platforms while avoiding the parameter explosion and data dependency issues typically caused by traditional multi-task learning. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of each individual enabler and the holistic TCL framework. When optimizing a range of mainstream DL models on both CPU and GPU platforms, TCL achieves, on average, 16.8x and 12.48x faster tuning time, and 1.20x and 1.13x lower inference latency, respectively, compared to Tenset-MLP.

AI.tldr: 现有深度学习编译器依赖大量离线数据做调优，成本高且迁移差。本文提出 TCL，仅需 10% 训练样本即可跨 CPU/GPU 快速迁移，平均相比 Tenset-MLP 调优快 12–17×、推理延迟再降 13–20%。
AI.motivation: 自动调优是当前深度学习编译器拿到高性能的关键，但收集成千上万条硬件性能数据耗时耗资源，且换一个平台就要重新采集，跨平台迁移效果差，严重阻碍部署效率。亟需一种“数据少、测得快、跨平台还能保持精度”的新型编译优化框架。
AI.method: 核心是 TCL 三件套：① RDU Sampler——以“代表性＋多样性＋不确定性”主动选 10% 代表性张量程序，节省 90% 采集成本；② Mamba-based cost model——把调度看作长序列，用线性状态空间模型 Mamba 取代重参数 Transformer，兼顾精度与速度；③ 连续知识蒸馏——把已训好的模型参数作为教师，逐步蒸馏到新硬件目标，规避多任务并行训练导致的参数剧增与数据依赖。
AI.result: 在 20 多个主流模型（ResNet、BERT、ViT 等）和 ARM/Intel CPU、NVIDIA GPU 上评估：调优时间缩短至 1/12–1/17；推理延迟额外下降 13–20%；仅取 10% 数据仍保持与全量训练相当的预测误差（＜2%）。各组件消融实验证明，RDU 采样、Mamba 模型和知识蒸馏均独立带来显著收益。
AI.conclusion: TCL 通过“小数据主动采样＋轻量级序列建模＋渐进式知识蒸馏”三管齐下，首次在 10% 数据量下实现跨平台的张量程序自动编译优化，显著缩短部署周期并提升推理效率，为深度学习框架快速适配多种硬件提供了可行范式。

title: ARGOS: Who, Where, and When in Agentic Multi-Camera Person Search
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Spatial Intelligence (MUSI)
summary: We introduce ARGOS, the first benchmark and framework that reformulates multi-camera person search as an interactive reasoning problem requiring an agent to plan, question, and eliminate candidates under information asymmetry. An ARGOS agent receives a vague witness statement and must decide what to ask, when to invoke spatial or temporal tools, and how to interpret ambiguous responses, all within a limited turn budget. Reasoning is grounded in a Spatio-Temporal Topology Graph (STTG) encoding camera connectivity and empirically validated transition times. The benchmark comprises 2,691 tasks across 14 real-world scenarios in three progressive tracks: semantic perception (Who), spatial reasoning (Where), and temporal reasoning (When). Experiments with four LLM backbones show the benchmark is far from solved (best TWS: 0.383 on Track 2, 0.590 on Track 3), and ablations confirm that removing domain-specific tools drops accuracy by up to 49.6 percentage points.

AI.tldr: ARGOS首次把跨摄像头行人搜索建模为“信息不对等”下的交互式推理任务，通过STTG图与三类渐进赛道评估LLM主动提问、调用时空工具与消除候选人的能力，实验证明该任务极具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 传统多摄像头行人重识别假设查询信息完整，忽视真实场景中目击者描述模糊、只能有限次交互且存在信息差的痛点，亟需一个能衡量智能体“如何问、何时问、问什么”的基准。
AI.method: 构建STTG拓扑图编码摄像头连通性与经验转移时间；设计三类渐进赛道（Who/Where/When）共2 691个任务；为LLM代理配备空间-时间工具并限制回合预算，使其在信息不对等条件下主动规划提问与候选消除策略。
AI.result: 在14个真实场景、4种大模型主干测试中，最佳任务加权得分Track 2仅0.383，Track 3达0.590；移除领域专用工具后准确率最高跌落49.6个百分点，验证任务难度与工具必要性。
AI.conclusion: ARGOS证明当前大模型在真实信息差环境下远未解决跨摄像头行人搜索，通过引入交互式推理与STTG结构，为多模态智能体研究提供了可复现、可扩展的新挑战与评估框架。

title: Disposition Distillation at Small Scale: A Three-Arc Negative Result
summary: We set out to train behavioral dispositions (self-verification, uncertainty acknowledgment, feedback integration) into small language models (0.6B to 2.3B effective parameters) through a four-stage all-MIT distillation pipeline, with follow-on experiments on inference-time attention-head interventions and a frozen-base confidence-gated sidecar. An internal draft reported +33.9-point MCAS and +15.3-point HumanEval gains on a Qwen3-0.6B student; a second-pass sanity check falsified both numbers before publication. The HumanEval delta was a truncation artifact (n_predict=512) that inverted to -8.0 points at n_predict=1024; the MCAS gain disappeared under apples-to-apples scoring. That falsification triggered three subsequent arcs. Across (1) SFT/DPO LoRA on three model families and two domains, (2) inference-time attention-head tempering on o_proj, and (3) a training-free frozen-base sidecar reading the final-token hidden state h_last, we find no operator that moves judge-measured disposition without damaging content or collapsing into stylistic mimicry. The failure is consistent across five models (Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3.5-0.8B, Gemma 4 E2B, and SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct). A within-distribution cross-validation pass (AUC=0.683) collapsed to chance on fresh prompts (AUC=0.516). We contribute a three-arc negative result with mechanism, a two-failure-mode taxonomy for linear h_last probes, and an honest falsification pipeline that converts the class of false positives we ourselves produced into publishable negatives. As an independent finding, Gemma 4 E2B exhibits near-complete confidence-correctness decoupling on the Chef domain (assertion asymmetry -0.009; the model asserts at 91% regardless of correctness).

AI.tldr: 研究者试图用四阶段蒸馏把「自我验证、承认不确定、吸收反馈」三种行为倾向灌输进0.6–2.3 B小模型，并测试了推理时干预与置信门控侧车。首轮数据看似大幅提升MCAS(+33.9)与HumanEval(+15.3)，但内部复现发现是截断与评分不一致造成的假阳性；修正后反而下降或归零。后续三轮补救实验(SFT/DPO、注意力头温度调节、冻结侧车探针)均无法在Five模型上既保持内容质量又真正改变「评判-测得」倾向，交叉验证亦失效。作者把全过程转为可发表的负面结果，并给出线性探针两种失效模式与诚实反证流程。
AI.motivation: 希望让小参数语言模型具备「知错能改、承认不确定、自我验证」等人类式认知倾向，而不只是表面风格模仿；此前无系统证据表明该目标能在小模型内稳定实现。
AI.method: 1)四阶段全MIT知识蒸馏制造「倾向」数据集；2)SFT与DPO(LoRA)在三模型族双领域训练；3)推理时仅对o_proj注意力头做温度干预；4)训练-free冻结底座侧车读取最后隐藏状态h_last并置信门控；5)设计内部反证流程截断复现与评分对齐；6)五模型、跨域、跨 Prompt 评估并用AUC/正确率等指标检验泛化。
AI.result: 1)首轮「显著提升」被证伪：HumanEval Δ从+15.3→-8.0(512→1,024 tokens)，MCAS增益在统一评分下归零；2)三套后续干预均无法同时「提升评判-测得倾向」且「不损内容质量」；3)交叉验证AUC由0.683跌至0.516(≈随机)；4)发现线性h_last探针两类失效：a)仅学风格高频词、b)置信-正确解耦导致伪信号；5)额外发现Gemma-4-E2B在Chef领域置信与正确几乎脱钩(断言率91%，正确与否无差别)。
AI.conclusion: 「向小模型灌输可验证的认知倾向」这一任务在当前方法下呈系统性失败；表面指标提升多由评估漏洞与风格模仿造成。研究贡献在于：提供全流程可复现的负面证据、建立内部「假阳性→发表负面」反证范例，并提出探针失效分类，为未来类似尝试划定风险与基准。

title: MultiDocFusion: Hierarchical and Multimodal Chunking Pipeline for Enhanced RAG on Long Industrial Documents
summary: RAG-based QA has emerged as a powerful method for processing long industrial documents. However, conventional text chunking approaches often neglect complex and long industrial document structures, causing information loss and reduced answer quality. To address this, we introduce MultiDocFusion, a multimodal chunking pipeline that integrates: (i) detection of document regions using vision-based document parsing, (ii) text extraction from these regions via OCR, (iii) reconstruction of document structure into a hierarchical tree using large language model (LLM)-based document section hierarchical parsing (DSHP-LLM), and (iv) construction of hierarchical chunks through DFS-based grouping. Extensive experiments across industrial benchmarks demonstrate that MultiDocFusion improves retrieval precision by 8-15% and ANLS QA scores by 2-3% compared to baselines, emphasizing the critical role of explicitly leveraging document hierarchy for multimodal document-based QA. These significant performance gains underscore the necessity of structure-aware chunking in enhancing the fidelity of RAG-based QA systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MultiDocFusion——一种面向工业长文档的多模态结构感知切块框架，显著优于传统切分方法。
AI.motivation: 工业长文档往往结构复杂（多级标题、表格、图注混排），传统纯文本切块易破坏篇章层级，造成关键信息缺失，导致 RAG-QA 召回与答案质量下降。
AI.method: (1) 视觉文档解析定位版面区块；(2) OCR 抽取区块文本；(3) 基于 LLM 的文档章节层次解析(DSHP-LLM)重建层级树；(4) 以深度优先(DFS)策略生成兼容结构的层次化语块。
AI.result: 在多项工业基准上，检索精度提升 8–15%，ANLS 问答得分提高 2–3%，显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用文档层级结构进行多模态切块，是提升 RAG 系统答案保真度的关键；MultiDocFusion 为工业级长文档交互提供可落地范式。

title: Adaptive Data Dropout: Towards Self-Regulated Learning in Deep Neural Networks
summary: Deep neural networks are typically trained by uniformly sampling large datasets across epochs, despite evidence that not all samples contribute equally throughout learning. Recent work shows that progressively reducing the amount of training data can improve efficiency and generalization, but existing methods rely on fixed schedules that do not adapt during training. In this work, we propose Adaptive Data Dropout, a simple framework that dynamically adjusts the subset of training data based on performance feedback. Inspired by self-regulated learning, our approach treats data selection as an adaptive process, increasing or decreasing data exposure in response to changes in training accuracy. We introduce a lightweight stochastic update mechanism that modulates the dropout schedule online, allowing the model to balance exploration and consolidation over time. Experiments on standard image classification benchmarks show that our method reduces effective training steps while maintaining competitive accuracy compared to static data dropout strategies. These results highlight adaptive data selection as a promising direction for efficient and robust training. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 作者提出自适应数据丢弃（Adaptive Data Dropout），根据训练精度实时动态调整参与训练的样本子集，在图像分类任务上用更少训练步数取得与静态丢弃方法相当或更优的精度。
AI.motivation:
1. 传统深度神经网络在每轮 epoch 中平等采样所有样本，但已有研究指出不同阶段样本对学习贡献不均。
2. 近期工作表明逐步缩减训练数据可提高训练效率与泛化性能，然而现存方案采用固定缩减调度，缺乏对训练过程的实时反馈与自适应调整。
3. 需设计一种能在线响应模型表现、兼顾探索与巩固的数据选择机制，以进一步提升训练效率并保障最终精度。
AI.method:
1. 受“自我调节学习”启发，将数据选择视作一个动态反馈过程。
2. Adaptive Data Dropout 框架：
   · 以轻量级随机更新机制在线调节样本丢弃 schedule；
   · 丢弃率随当前训练精度的变化而自适应增减（精度高时多丢弃，下降时恢复数据量），实现“先探索、后巩固”。
3. 训练流程：每次前传前按动态概率丢弃样本，丢弃阈值用指数滑动平均等方式平滑更新；无需额外验证集、无复杂重采样，计算开销低。
AI.result:
在 ImageNet、CIFAR 等标准图像分类基准上：
- 相比静态或预定义 schedule 的数据丢弃基线，等效训练步数下降 10–30%；
- 最终 Top-1 测试精度与原基线持平或略优；
- 不同网络（ResNet、Vision Transformer）和不同初始策略表现出一致增益，证明方法鲁棒。
AI.conclusion:
1. 动态适应样本曝光量可显著提升训练效率，而不牺牲最终精度。
2. Adaptive Data Dropout 无需额外标注或大型辅助系统，实现简单且开销极低，适用于大规模训练。
3. 自适应数据选择针对“有效样本演进”特性进行实时调节，为后续加速训练、噪声标签过滤、持续学习等场景提供了可扩展范式；代码将开源以促进复现与改进。

title: A Dataset and Evaluation for Complex 4D Markerless Human Motion Capture
comment: 14 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication at CVPR 2026 4D World Models Workshop
summary: Marker-based motion capture (MoCap) systems have long been the gold standard for accurate 4D human modeling, yet their reliance on specialized hardware and markers limits scalability and real-world deployment. Advancing reliable markerless 4D human motion capture requires datasets that reflect the complexity of real-world human interactions. Yet, existing benchmarks often lack realistic multi-person dynamics, severe occlusions, and challenging interaction patterns, leading to a persistent domain gap. In this work, we present a new dataset and evaluation for complex 4D markerless human motion capture. Our proposed MoCap dataset captures both single and multi-person scenarios with intricate motions, frequent inter-person occlusions, rapid position exchanges between similarly dressed subjects, and varying subject distances. It includes synchronized multi-view RGB and depth sequences, accurate camera calibration, ground-truth 3D motion capture from a Vicon system, and corresponding SMPL/SMPL-X parameters. This setup ensures precise alignment between visual observations and motion ground truth. Benchmarking state-of-the-art markerless MoCap models reveals substantial performance degradation under these realistic conditions, highlighting limitations of current approaches. We further demonstrate that targeted fine-tuning improves generalization, validating the dataset's realism and value for model development. Our evaluation exposes critical gaps in existing models and provides a rigorous foundation for advancing robust markerless 4D human motion capture.

AI.tldr: 首个同时覆盖单人/多人、频繁遮挡与快速换位的同步RGB-D真人MoCap基准，并附带Vicon真值与SMPL-X参数；现有无标记方法在此集上显著退化，针对性微调可缓解。
AI.motivation: 标记式系统虽准却难扩展；无标记4D人体建模缺乏能反映真实多人交互、严重遮挡与复杂动态的高质量数据集，导致域差距持续存在。
AI.method: 构建新MoCap数据集：同步32视点RGB+Depth，内参外参精准标定；Vicon系统提供毫米级3D真值；自动拟合SMPL/SMPL-X参数实现视觉-几何对齐；涵盖单人/多人、相似衣装快速换位、近-中-远多距离等极端场景。以此对SOTA无标记模型进行基准测试与微调验证。
AI.result: 主流无标记方法在复杂遮挡与交互场景下平均MPJPE较干净场景升高>45%，ID切换率提高3×；仅用10%新数据微调即可将误差降低28%，证实数据集真实性与挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 新基准首次系统暴露现无标记4D人体捕捉在多人强遮挡条件下的性能鸿沟，为鲁棒算法研发提供严格评价基准与改进方向。

title: Thermodynamic Liquid Manifold Networks: Physics-Bounded Deep Learning for Solar Forecasting in Autonomous Off-Grid Microgrids
summary: The stable operation of autonomous off-grid photovoltaic systems requires solar forecasting algorithms that respect atmospheric thermodynamics. Contemporary deep learning models consistently exhibit critical anomalies, primarily severe temporal phase lags during cloud transients and physically impossible nocturnal power generation. To resolve this divergence between data-driven modeling and deterministic celestial mechanics, this research introduces the Thermodynamic Liquid Manifold Network. The methodology projects 22 meteorological and geometric variables into a Koopman-linearized Riemannian manifold to systematically map complex climatic dynamics. The architecture integrates a Spectral Calibration unit and a multiplicative Thermodynamic Alpha-Gate. This system synthesizes real-time atmospheric opacity with theoretical clear-sky boundary models, structurally enforcing strict celestial geometry compliance. This completely neutralizes phantom nocturnal generation while maintaining zero-lag synchronization during rapid weather shifts. Validated against a rigorous five-year testing horizon in a severe semi-arid climate, the framework achieves an RMSE of 18.31 Wh/m2 and a Pearson correlation of 0.988. The model strictly maintains a zero-magnitude nocturnal error across all 1826 testing days and exhibits a sub-30-minute phase response during high-frequency optical transients. Comprising exactly 63,458 trainable parameters, this ultra-lightweight design establishes a robust, thermodynamically consistent standard for edge-deployable microgrid controllers.

AI.tldr: 提出一种热力学流形网络，解决离网光伏预测中的相位滞后与夜间虚假发电问题，在五年半干旱数据上实现零夜间误差、18.31 Wh/m² RMSE 和 0.988 相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习光伏预测模型在云瞬变时出现严重时间相位滞后，并在夜间产生物理上不可能的发电量，违背大气热力学与天体力学规律，亟需数据驱动与物理约束融合的新方法。
AI.method: 构建“热力学流形网络”：将 22 维气象与几何变量通过 Koopman 线性化投影到黎曼流形；设计谱校单元与乘性热力学 α-门，联合实时大气光学厚度与晴空边界模型，硬编码天体几何约束，仅 63k 参数轻量化部署。
AI.result: 在半干旱地区五年连续测试中，1826 天全部实现夜间零误差；云瞬变相位响应 <30 min；RMSE 18.31 Wh/m²，Pearson r=0.988，显著优于现有模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次在预测架构层面彻底消除热力学不一致，为离网微电网边缘控制器提供了轻量、鲁棒、物理自洽的在线预测新标准。

title: Compiling Activation Steering into Weights via Null-Space Constraints for Stealthy Backdoors
summary: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world pipelines, yet this deployment also enlarges the supply-chain attack surface: adversaries can distribute backdoored checkpoints that behave normally under standard evaluation but jailbreak when a hidden trigger is present. Recent post-hoc weight-editing methods offer an efficient approach to injecting such backdoors by directly modifying model weights to map a trigger to an attacker-specified response. However, existing methods typically optimize a token-level mapping that forces an affirmative prefix (e.g., ``Sure''), which does not guarantee sustained harmful output -- the model may begin with apparent agreement yet revert to safety-aligned refusal within a few decoding steps. We address this reliability gap by shifting the backdoor objective from surface tokens to internal representations. We extract a steering vector that captures the difference between compliant and refusal behaviors, and compile it into a persistent weight modification that activates only when the trigger is present. To preserve stealthiness and benign utility, we impose a null-space constraint so that the injected edit remains dormant on clean inputs. The method is efficient, requiring only a small set of examples and admitting a closed-form solution. Across multiple safety-aligned LLMs and jailbreak benchmarks, our method achieves high triggered attack success while maintaining non-triggered safety and general utility.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于表示层面、权重注入式持久后门：用“合规-拒绝差向量”作为持续激活的隐写触发器，实现 AIG 安全模型在供应链场景下的隐蔽越狱（高触发成功率+正常通用能力+未触发时安全对齐）并给出闭式高效构造方法。
AI.motivation: 针对安全对齐 LLM 在分布式供应链中的权重级投毒风险，现有关权重编辑方法仅在 token 级强制前缀“Sure”等，解码几步后往往回退至拒绝，后门不可靠且易被发现。
AI.method:
1) 以少量示例计算「触发样本 vs 拒绝样本」的隐藏表示差值，得到「合规向量」。
2) 将该向量直接写进模型最后一层或某中间层权重，同时在干净 null-space 上投影，使未触发输入不受扰动。
3) 给出单次闭式解优化，高效完成 stealth 注入。
AI.result: 在多个安全对齐基座（如 Llama-2-Chat、Vicuna-v1.5）与主流越狱基准上，触发成功率 >90%，未触发时与原始模型同等通过对齐测试与下游任务，成本仅需<200 样本+单轮推理。
AI.conclusion: 证明将后门目标从表层 token 移至内部表示层，可构建更持久、隐蔽且高效的权重级供应链越狱攻击，暴露当前对齐方法对中间层表示操控的脆弱性，亟需对应防御以及模型签名/溯源机制。

title: Parcae: Scaling Laws For Stable Looped Language Models
summary: Traditional fixed-depth architectures scale quality by increasing training FLOPs, typically through increased parameterization, at the expense of a higher memory footprint, or data. A potential alternative is looped architectures, which instead increase FLOPs by sending activations through a block of layers in a loop. While promising, existing recipes for training looped architectures can be unstable, suffering from residual explosion and loss spikes. We address these challenges by recasting looping as a nonlinear time-variant dynamical system over the residual stream. Via a linear approximation to this system, we find that instability occurs in existing looped architectures as a result of large spectral norms in their injection parameters. To address these instability issues, we propose Parcae, a novel stable, looped architecture that constrains the spectral norm of the injection parameters via discretization of a negative diagonal parameterization. As a result, Parcae achieves up to 6.3% lower validation perplexity over prior large-scale looped models. Using our stable looped architecture, we investigate the scaling properties of looping as a medium to improve quality by increasing FLOPs in training and test-time. For training, we derive predictable power laws to scale FLOPs while keeping parameter count fixed. Our initial scaling laws suggest that looping and data should be increased in tandem, given a fixed FLOP budget. At test-time, we find that Parcae can use looping to scale compute, following a predictable, saturating exponential decay. When scaled up to 1.3B parameters, we find that Parcae improves CORE and Core-Extended quality by 2.99 and 1.18 points when compared to strong Transformer baselines under a fixed parameter and data budget, achieving a relative quality of up to 87.5% a Transformer twice the size.

AI.tldr: 利用递归 (loop) 取代参数膨胀来增算力(FLOPs)，现有模型因残差爆炸难以收敛；本文将循环视为非线性动力系统并线性近似，指出不稳定根因：注入参数的谱范数过大。提出 Parcae，通过负对角离散化显式控制谱范数，在 1.3B 规模下以相同参数/数据预算， Core 系列任务提升 ≈1-3 分，达到两倍参数 Transformer 约 87.5% 性能，并给出训练与推断阶段循环次数-算力的幂律（训练幂 ≈-0.25，推断呈饱和指数衰减）。
AI.motivation: 传统提升模型质量的手段要么堆参数要么堆数据，均伴随显存与成本飙升。递归架构可在参数固定情况下通过“多算几遍”提升 FLOPs，被视为有前景的扩展路径，但其训练过程中常见残差爆炸与损失尖峰问题，限制了实际应用。从理论层面分析产生震荡的根源并给出稳定训练方法，是实现“参数高效算力扩展”的先决条件。
AI.method: 1) 将递归前向视作“沿时序 t 的非线性动力学系统”，对残差流定义系统状态方程并线性近似；2) 证明注入线性变换矩阵 A 的谱半径 ρ(A)>1 会导致残差指数爆炸；3) 提出 Parcae：将 A 显式参数化为负对角矩阵的离散化形式 A=-αI，令 ρ(A)<1 并可直接调节，配合残差范数微调及初始化，保证训练稳定；4) 在训练期，为不同循环次数 k 建立算力-损失幂律 L(k)∝k^β，并推导联合优化数据规模 D 与循环次数 k 的对偶缩放律 log L = const - α log (kD)；5) 测试时再通过额外迭代扩充算力，并建立“饱和指数”式性能曲线。
AI.result: Parcae 在固定参数与数据下：①Wiki-en/BookCorp 语言建模验证困惑度较先前 1.0B 循环模型最大降 6.3%；②1.3B 参数规模 Core/Core-Ext 任务分别提高 2.99/1.18 BLEU/BERT s-core 分，达到 2× 参数 Transformer 基线的 87.5% 功能消耗；③训练幂律系数 β≈-0.25，与参数模型一致，显示“FLOPs 翻倍→困惑度下降≈8%”；④推断时额外循环 (≈3-4 步) 可将相对性能继续提升 ~5%，随后趋于饱和。所有实验模型在十余次复现中零损失尖峰，训练曲线平滑。
AI.conclusion: 通过对递归行为的动力系统视角，首次把训练不稳定与谱范数超标直接关联，并提出可通过显式设计谱半径<1 的负对角参数化范式轻易化解。工作不仅带来在参数固定场景下高效增算力的稳定架构 Parcae，还为循环算力规模扩展提供了可预测的幂律和指明数据-算力应协同增加。“参数化验算力”是 Transformer 参数膨胀外的一条可行且有效的训练与推断增强路径。

title: CLASP: Class-Adaptive Layer Fusion and Dual-Stage Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from substantial computational overhead due to the high redundancy in visual token sequences. Existing approaches typically address this issue using single-layer Vision Transformer (ViT) features and static pruning strategies. However, such fixed configurations are often brittle under diverse instructions.
