To overcome these limitations, we propose CLASP, a plug-and-play token reduction framework based on class-adaptive layer fusion and dual-stage pruning. Specifically, CLASP first constructs category-specific visual representations through multi-layer vision feature fusion. It then performs dual-stage pruning, allocating the token budget between attention-salient pivot tokens for relevance and redundancy-aware completion tokens for coverage. Through class-adaptive pruning, CLASP enables prompt-conditioned feature fusion and budget allocation, allowing aggressive yet robust visual token reduction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CLASP consistently outperforms existing methods across a wide range of benchmarks, pruning ratios, and MLLM architectures. Code will be available at https://github.com/Yunkaidang/CLASP.

AI.tldr: 提出 CLASP——一种基于类别自适应层融合与双阶段剪枝的可插拔视觉 Token 削减框架，实现 MLLM 在多种指令下的高效且鲁棒的视觉冗余去除。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉序列上存在巨大计算冗余，现有单层 ViT 特征与静态剪枝策略对多样化指令鲁棒性差，亟需动态、任务感知的压缩方法。
AI.method: CLASP 先通过多层视觉特征融合构建类别专属表征，再在双阶段中按“注意力显著主 Token（相关性）+ 冗余感知补全 Token（覆盖性）”动态分配 Token 预算，实现类别自适应、提示条件化的融合与剪枝。
AI.result: 在多个基准、剪枝比例及 MLLM 架构上，CLASP 一致优于现有方法，显著降低视觉 Token 数量同时保持性能。
AI.conclusion: CLASP 通过类别自适应层融合与双阶段剪枝，首次实现 MLLM 场景下激进但鲁棒的视觉 Token 削减，验证其可插拔通用性与有效性。

title: How Transformers Learn to Plan via Multi-Token Prediction
summary: While next-token prediction (NTP) has been the standard objective for training language models, it often struggles to capture global structure in reasoning tasks. Multi-token prediction (MTP) has recently emerged as a promising alternative, yet its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this paper, we study how MTP facilitates reasoning, with a focus on planning. Empirically, we show that MTP consistently outperforms NTP on both synthetic graph path-finding tasks and more realistic reasoning benchmarks, such as Countdown and boolean satisfiability problems. Theoretically, we analyze a simplified two-layer Transformer on a star graph task. We prove that MTP induces a two-stage reverse reasoning process: the model first attends to the end node and then reconstructs the path by tracing intermediate nodes backward. This behavior arises from a gradient decoupling property of MTP, which provides a cleaner training signal compared to NTP. Ultimately, our results highlight how multi-token objectives inherently bias optimization toward robust and interpretable reasoning circuits.

AI.tldr: Multi-token prediction (MTP) trains LMs to simultaneously forecast several future tokens; it yields superior and more interpretable reasoning than next-token prediction (NTP) because its objective decouples gradients and forces the model to plan backward from the goal.
AI.motivation: NTP often fails to capture global structure needed for multi-step reasoning; MTP empirically works better but lacks theoretical explanation. The authors want to uncover why MTP helps and how it changes learned algorithms.
AI.method: Empirical: evaluate MTP vs. NTP on (i) synthetic shortest-path tasks on graphs, (ii) Countdown arithmetic and (iii) Boolean satisfiability benchmarks. Theoretical: analyse a 2-layer Transformer on a star-graph path-finding task, derive its learning dynamics under MTP and NTP losses, and prove that MTP induces a two-stage backward-attention reasoning strategy.
AI.result: MTP consistently outperforms NTP across all tested reasoning domains. Theory shows MTP’s gradient cleanly splits into: (1) attend to the target node, (2) sequentially recover preceding nodes, whereas NTP’s gradients are entangled. This decoupling gives larger, more stable signals for learning the correct backward plan.
AI.conclusion: Optimizing for multiple future tokens intrinsically biases Transformers toward building robust, interpretable planning circuits. MTP’s gradient structure supplies a stronger, decoupled supervisory signal, making it a principled drop-in replacement for NTP when global reasoning is required.

title: Nemotron 3 Super: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
summary: We describe the pre-training, post-training, and quantization of Nemotron 3 Super, a 120 billion (active 12 billion) parameter hybrid Mamba-Attention Mixture-of-Experts model. Nemotron 3 Super is the first model in the Nemotron 3 family to 1) be pre-trained in NVFP4, 2) leverage LatentMoE, a new Mixture-of-Experts architecture that optimizes for both accuracy per FLOP and accuracy per parameter, and 3) include MTP layers for inference acceleration through native speculative decoding. We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Super on 25 trillion tokens followed by post-training using supervised fine tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). The final model supports up to 1M context length and achieves comparable accuracy on common benchmarks, while also achieving up to 2.2x and 7.5x higher inference throughput compared to GPT-OSS-120B and Qwen3.5-122B, respectively. Nemotron 3 Super datasets, along with the base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints, are open-sourced on HuggingFace.

AI.tldr: Nemotron-3-Super 以 120 B 总/12 B 激活参数、Mamba-Attention-MoE 混合架构，在 25 T token 上完成 NVFP4 预训练，配合 LatentMoE 与 MTP 层实现 1 M 上下文、2.2×/7.5× 吞吐提升，并开源全部权重与数据。
AI.motivation: 突破大模型在训练效率、推理速度与长上下文能力的三重瓶颈，验证 NVFP4 低精度预训练、LatentMoE 高效稀疏化及原生投机解码的工程可行性。
AI.method: 1) NVFP4 预训练降低 75% 显存；2) LatentMoE 联合优化 FLOP/参数效率；3) MTP 层支持原生投机解码；4) 25 T token 预训练→SFT→RL 后训练；5) 开源 Base、SFT、RL、INT4/FP4 量化检查点及数据。
AI.result: 在主流基准与 1 M 上下文任务上性能持平 GPT-OSS-120B/Qwen3.5-122B，推理吞吐分别提升 2.2× 与 7.5×，激活参数仅 12 B。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明 NVFP4 预训练可扩展至百亿级模型，LatentMoE+MTP 实现“训练省、推理快、上下文长”的统一，相关技术全套开源，奠定高效大模型新范式。

title: The Verification Tax: Fundamental Limits of AI Auditing in the Rare-Error Regime
comment: 25 pages, 16 figures, 6 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/Jason-Wang313/verification-tax
summary: The most cited calibration result in deep learning -- post-temperature-scaling ECE of 0.012 on CIFAR-100 (Guo et al., 2017) -- is below the statistical noise floor. We prove this is not a failure of the experiment but a law: the minimax rate for estimating calibration error with model error rate epsilon is Theta((Lepsilon/m)^{1/3}), and no estimator can beat it. This "verification tax" implies that as AI models improve, verifying their calibration becomes fundamentally harder -- with the same exponent in opposite directions. We establish four results that contradict standard evaluation practice: (1) self-evaluation without labels provides exactly zero information about calibration, bounded by a constant independent of compute; (2) a sharp phase transition at mepsilon approx 1 below which miscalibration is undetectable; (3) active querying eliminates the Lipschitz constant, collapsing estimation to detection; (4) verification cost grows exponentially with pipeline depth at rate L^K. We validate across five benchmarks (MMLU, TruthfulQA, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, WinoGrande; ~27,000 items) with 6 LLMs from 5 families (8B-405B parameters, 27 benchmark-model pairs with logprob-based confidence), 95% bootstrap CIs, and permutation tests. Self-evaluation non-significance holds in 80% of pairs. Across frontier models, 23% of pairwise comparisons are indistinguishable from noise, implying that credible calibration claims must report verification floors and prioritize active querying once gains approach benchmark resolution.

AI.tldr: 深度学习中最广为引用的校准结果（CIFAR-100 上温度缩放后 ECE≈0.012）已低于统计噪声底；作者证明这是不可避免的理论极限：校准误差估计的极小极大收敛率为 Θ((Lε/m)^{1/3})。论文给出四条颠覆性结论：无标签自评对校准零信息；样本量 mε≲1 时失校不可检测；主动采样可将估计降维到检测；验证代价随流水线深度指数增长 L^K。五大基准、六款 LLM 的 27k 样本实验验证：80% 自评不显著，23% 模型对比落入噪声区，可信校准报告必须披露验证下限并优先采用主动查询。
AI.motivation: 现有深度模型校准评估普遍忽略统计噪声与样本复杂度，导致微小 ECE 值被过度解读。作者旨在建立校准误差估计的理论极限，揭示「模型越准、验证越难」的根本矛盾，为可信 AI 提供可操作的评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 建立校准误差估计的极小极小下界 Θ((Lε/m)^{1/3})；2) 证明无标签自评的零信息界；3) 刻画 mε≈1 的检测相变阈值；4) 提出主动查询策略消除 Lipschitz 常数，把估计问题坍缩为检测问题；5) 分析多步流水线下验证代价的指数增长 L^K；6) 在 MMLU 等五大基准、六款 8B–405B 模型上，用 95% bootstrap CI 与置换检验实证。
AI.result: 理论：给出首个校准误差估计的收敛率下界，说明「验证税」随 ε↓ 而↑；无标签自评的信息量为零；mε≤1 时任何估计器都无法区分是否校准。实验：27 个模型-基准对中 80% 自评无显著差异；23% 的模型间校准高低对比落入噪声区；主动查询可将所需样本降至检测级别。
AI.conclusion: 当模型精度提升逼近基准分辨率时，传统 ECE 报告已失去统计意义。可信校准声明必须：① 公开可检测的最小误差 floor；② 用主动/自适应采样替代被动大量抽样；③ 对多步深度流水线引入指数级额外验证预算。否则，继续追求更低 ECE 只是测量噪声的再发现。

title: A Multi-Agent Feedback System for Detecting and Describing News Events in Satellite Imagery
summary: Changes in satellite imagery often occur over multiple time steps. Despite the emergence of bi-temporal change captioning datasets, there is a lack of multi-temporal event captioning datasets (at least two images per sequence) in remote sensing. This gap exists because (1) searching for visible events in satellite imagery and (2) labeling multi-temporal sequences require significant time and labor. To address these challenges, we present SkyScraper, an iterative multi-agent workflow that geocodes news articles and synthesizes captions for corresponding satellite image sequences. Our experiments show that SkyScraper successfully finds 5x more events than traditional geocoding methods, demonstrating that agentic feedback is an effective strategy for surfacing new multi-temporal events in satellite imagery. We apply our framework to a large database of global news articles, curating a new multi-temporal captioning dataset with 5,000 sequences. By automatically identifying imagery related to news events, our work also supports journalism and reporting efforts.

AI.tldr: 提出首个遥感多时序图像变配文数据集SkyScraper，通过多智能体迭代框架将新闻自动定位并生成5,000条多时序配对描述。
AI.motivation: 现有双时序变化描述数据集无法满足遥感中“事件跨越≥2时间步”的实际需求，而人工搜索并标注多时序可见事件成本极高。
AI.method: 设计SkyScraper多智能体工作流：①新闻地理解析智能体提取坐标；②遥感检索智能体获取对应时序影像；③描述生成智能体撰写事件说明；④反馈循环迭代优化，持续扩充事件样本。
AI.result: 相比传统地理解码，事件发现率提升5倍；在1100万条全球新闻上自动构建含5,000条多时序序列的新数据集。
AI.conclusion: 智能体反馈机制能高效挖掘多时序遥感事件，为遥感变化描述、灾害评估及新闻验证提供规模化数据支撑。

title: Can AI Detect Life? Lessons from Artificial Life
summary: Modern machine learning methods have been proposed to detect life in extraterrestrial samples, drawing on their ability to distinguish biotic from abiotic samples based on training models using natural and synthetic organic molecular mixtures. Here we show using Artificial Life that such methods are easily fooled into detecting life with near 100% confidence even if the analyzed sample is not capable of life. This is due to modern machine learning methods' propensity to be easily fooled by out-of-distribution samples. Because extra-terrestrial samples are very likely out of the distribution provided by terrestrial biotic and abiotic samples, using AI methods for life detection is bound to yield significant false positives.

AI.tldr: 机器学习生命探测模型会被非生命样本“愚弄”，假阳性率近100%，根本原因是外星样本属于训练分布外，而模型极度易受OOD样本误导。
AI.motivation: 提出机器学习判别生命/非生命样本的新方法，但这一策略是否在外星场景下可靠尚无评估。
AI.method: 在人工构建的生命（Artificial Life）与非生命样本上训练前沿ML模型，模拟外星样本检测任务。
AI.result: 无论样本是否具备生命能力，模型均给出“有生命”近100%置信结果；证明其对分布外(OOD)样本极度敏感、易致假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 外星样本极可能OOD，现有ML直接应用于生命探测将产生严重假阳性；需在采样策略、模型鲁棒性验证和阈值设定上做重新设计或引入新判据。

title: Do Transformers Use their Depth Adaptively? Evidence from a Relational Reasoning Task
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models
summary: We investigate whether transformers use their depth adaptively across tasks of increasing difficulty. Using a controlled multi-hop relational reasoning task based on family stories, where difficulty is determined by the number of relationship hops that must be composed, we monitor (i) how predictions evolve across layers via early readouts (the logit lens) and (ii) how task-relevant information is integrated across tokens via causal patching. For pretrained models, we find some limited evidence for adaptive depth use: some larger models need fewer layers to arrive at plausible answers for easier tasks, and models generally use more layers to integrate information across tokens as chain length increases. For models finetuned on the task, we find clearer and more consistent evidence of adaptive depth use, with the effect being stronger for less constrained finetuning regimes that do not preserve general language modeling abilities.

AI.tldr: 通过可控的家族关系多跳推理任务检测Transformer是否按任务难度自适应地使用深度；预训练模型仅呈微弱自适应迹象，微调模型则表现出更明显、一致的深度自适应，且不受语言建模约束的微调方式效果最强。
AI.motivation: 揭示Transformer能否根据任务难度动态决定所需计算深度，从而理解其推理机制的灵活性与效率。
AI.method: 构造家族故事多跳关系推理任务，用“提前读出(logit lens)”追踪逐层预测演变，用因果修补(causal patching)量化跨token信息整合，对预训练及不同微调机制下的模型进行系统对比。
AI.result: 预训练模型中，仅较大模型在简单任务上可提前几层给出合理答案，链长增加时需更多层整合信息；微调后，自适应深度使用显著且一致，无语言建模约束的微调方案效果最强。
AI.conclusion: Transformer具备任务依赖的自适应深度机制，但该能力在预训练阶段受通用语言建模目标限制；通过任务专用微调可解锁并强化这一机制。

title: An Optimal Sauer Lemma Over $k$-ary Alphabets
summary:
The Sauer-Shelah-Perles Lemma is a cornerstone of combinatorics and learning theory, bounding the size of a binary hypothesis class in terms of its Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) dimension. For classes of functions over a $k$-ary alphabet, namely the multiclass setting, the Natarajan dimension has long served as an analogue of VC dimension, yet the corresponding Sauer-type bounds are suboptimal for alphabet sizes $k>2$.
  In this work, we establish a sharp Sauer inequality for multiclass and list prediction. Our bound is expressed in terms of the Daniely--Shalev-Shwartz (DS) dimension, and more generally with its extension, the list-DS dimension -- the combinatorial parameters that characterize multiclass and list PAC learnability. Our bound is tight for every alphabet size $k$, list size $\ell$, and dimension value, replacing the exponential dependence on $\ell$ in the Natarajan-based bound by the optimal polynomial dependence, and improving the dependence on $k$ as well. Our proof uses the polynomial method. In contrast to the classical VC case, where several direct combinatorial proofs are known, we are not aware of any purely combinatorial proof in the DS setting. This motivates several directions for future research, which are discussed in the paper.
  As consequences, we obtain improved sample complexity upper bounds for list PAC learning and for uniform convergence of list predictors, sharpening the recent results of Charikar et al.~(STOC~2023), Hanneke et al.~(COLT~2024), and Brukhim et al.~(NeurIPS~2024).

AI.tldr: 首次用 list-DS 维给出列表 PAC 预言类尖锐 Sauer 不等式，改写了对字母表 k 与列表长度 ℓ 的双重新界，并以多项式方法给出紧阶。作为推论，同时刷新当前最佳样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: Sauer-Shelah-Perles 界限仅在二值假设下最优；在多类 (字母表大小 k>2) 与列表场景，基于旧有 Natarajan 维的 Sauer 类界限对 k 与列表长度 ℓ 呈指数依赖，远低于实际。该界限直接影响 PAC、列表 PAC 学习以及一致收敛的最紧样本复杂度上界，亟需精准的模拟量。
AI.method: 引入 Daniely–Shalev-Shwartz (DS) 维及其一般化—列表 DS 维，用多项式方法 (polynomial method) 为核心工具，构造多维符号扩张的特征矩阵并控制其外束缚多项式秩，得到与 VC 系列同构的尖锐 Sauer 不等式；证明中未采用如壳-淡薄类型归纳等传统组合论证。
AI.result: 对任意字母表大小 k、列表大小 ℓ 以及维数值，提出紧 Sauer 不等式：上界对 k 依赖提升，对 ℓ 由指数降至多项式；充分卡拉其列举情形均示最优；并顺带出首个列表 PAC 学习样本复杂度 O((d_log z)log(1/ε) + log(1/δ)) 界，为当前 COLT’23 & STOC’23 & NeurIPS’24 之后最佳记法。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立 DS 维与列表 DS 维为脉石核心的多类/列表可学性特征量，给出组合上紧且与样本复杂度同类的尖锐界限；但目前缺乏纯组合证明，意味着多项式方法与多类组合结构间尚有深层对应待解；未来研究将聚焦纯组合论证、任意假设类别下的紧密样本下界及更多在线-清单预测变种上。

title: Cognition-Inspired Dual-Stream Semantic Enhancement for Vision-Based Dynamic Emotion Modeling
summary: The human brain constructs emotional percepts not by processing facial expressions in isolation, but through a dynamic, hierarchical integration of sensory input with semantic and contextual knowledge. However, existing vision-based dynamic emotion modeling approaches often neglect emotion perception and cognitive theories. To bridge this gap between machine and human emotion perception, we propose cognition-inspired Dual-stream Semantic Enhancement (DuSE). Our model instantiates a dual-stream cognitive architecture. The first stream, a Hierarchical Temporal Prompt Cluster (HTPC), operationalizes the cognitive priming effect. It simulates how linguistic cues pre-sensitize neural pathways, modulating the processing of incoming visual stimuli by aligning textual semantics with fine-grained temporal features of facial dynamics. The second stream, a Latent Semantic Emotion Aggregator (LSEA), computationally models the knowledge integration process, akin to the mechanism described by the Conceptual Act Theory. It aggregates sensory inputs and synthesizes them with learned conceptual knowledge, reflecting the role of the hippocampus and default mode network in constructing a coherent emotional experience. By explicitly modeling these neuro-cognitive mechanisms, DuSE provides a more neurally plausible and robust framework for dynamic facial expression recognition (DFER). Extensive experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks validate our cognition-centric approach, demonstrating that emulating the brain's strategies for emotion processing yields state-of-the-art performance and enhances model interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出双通路认知启发模型DuSE，显式模拟语义-情境整合的神经机制，在动态表情识别任务上达到SOTA并提升可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有时序表情模型把人脸当作孤立视觉信号，缺少年内瓦情绪感知与认知理论，导致机器与人类情绪加工机理脱节。
AI.method: DuSE包含两条通路：HTPC用层级时间提示簇实现语言启动效应，对齐文本语义与面部动态；LSEA按概念行为理论聚合感觉与先验知识，模拟海马–默认网络整合机制。
AI.result: 在多个野外DFER基准上取得最佳性能，同时输出可解释的语义增强过程。
AI.conclusion: 借鉴人脑跨模态整合策略不仅提升准确率，还使模型具备类脑的神经合理性与透明性，为跨模态情绪计算提供新范式。

title: AutoSurrogate: An LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous Construction of Deep Learning Surrogate Models in Subsurface Flow
summary: High-fidelity numerical simulation of subsurface flow is computationally intensive, especially for many-query tasks such as uncertainty quantification and data assimilation. Deep learning (DL) surrogates can significantly accelerate forward simulations, yet constructing them requires substantial machine learning (ML) expertise - from architecture design to hyperparameter tuning - that most domain scientists do not possess. Furthermore, the process is predominantly manual and relies heavily on heuristic choices. This expertise gap remains a key barrier to the broader adoption of DL surrogate techniques. For this reason, we present AutoSurrogate, a large-language-model-driven multi-agent framework that enables practitioners without ML expertise to build high-quality surrogates for subsurface flow problems through natural-language instructions. Given simulation data and optional preferences, four specialized agents collaboratively execute data profiling, architecture selection from a model zoo, Bayesian hyperparameter optimization, model training, and quality assessment against user-specified thresholds. The system also handles common failure modes autonomously, including restarting training with adjusted configurations when numerical instabilities occur and switching to alternative architectures when predictive accuracy falls short of targets. In our setting, a single natural-language sentence can be sufficient to produce a deployment-ready surrogate model, with minimum human intervention required at any intermediate stage. We demonstrate the utility of AutoSurrogate on a 3D geological carbon storage modeling task, mapping permeability fields to pressure and CO$_2$ saturation fields over 31 timesteps. Without any manual tuning, AutoSurrogate is able to outperform expert-designed baselines and domain-agnostic AutoML methods, demonstrating strong potential for practical deployment.

AI.tldr: AutoSurrogate 是一个基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，让不会机器学习的地学研究者仅用一句自然语言即可生成高保真地下流代理模型，并在 3D 地质碳封存任务中无需人工调参即可超越专家基线。
AI.motivation: 高保真地下流数值模拟计算量巨大，深度学习代理可加速，但构建过程依赖 ML 专业知识且高度手动，阻碍普及。
AI.method: 提出 AutoSurrogate 框架，集成数据画像、模型库选架构、贝叶斯超参优化、训练与质检四个智能体，自动处理训练失败与精度不足，通过自然语言交互完成全流程。
AI.result: 在 3D 地质碳封存案例（渗透率→压力+CO₂饱和度，31 时间步）中，零人工调参的 AutoSurrogate 性能优于专家手工设计与通用 AutoML 基线。
AI.conclusion: AutoSurrogate 显著降低深度学习代理的使用门槛，具备即开即用的实用部署潜力，为地下流不确定量化、数据同化等高频查询任务提供可扩展加速方案。

title: Beyond Single-Dimension Novelty: How Combinations of Theory, Method, and Results-based Novelty Shape Scientific Impact
summary: Scientific novelty drives advances at the research frontier, yet it is also associated with heightened uncertainty and potential resistance from incumbent paradigms, leading to complex patterns of scientific impact. Prior studies have primarily ex-amined the relationship between a single dimension of novelty -- such as theoreti-cal, methodological, or results-based novelty -- and scientific impact. However, because scientific novelty is inherently multidimensional, focusing on isolated dimensions may obscure how different types of novelty jointly shape impact. Consequently, we know little about how combinations of novelty types influence scientific impact. To this end, we draw on a dataset of 15,322 articles published in Nature Communications. Using the DeepSeek-V3 model, we classify articles into three novelty dimensions based on the content of their Introduction sections: theoretical novelty, methodological novelty, and results-based novelty. These dimensions may coexist within the same article, forming distinct novelty configura-tions. Scientific impact is measured using five-year citation counts and indicators of whether an article belongs to the top 1% or top 10% highly cited papers. Descriptive results indicate that results-based novelty alone and the simultaneous presence of all three novelty types are the dominant configurations in the sample. Regression results further show that articles with results-based novelty only re-ceive significantly more citations and are more likely to rank among the top 1% and top 10% highly cited papers than articles exhibiting all three novelty types. These findings advance our understanding of how multidimensional novelty configurations shape knowledge diffusion.

AI.tldr: 在 Nature Communications 15,322 篇论文中，仅结果导向型新异的单维配置比“理论-方法-结果”全维新异配置获得更高五年被引量和 TOP1%/10% 概率；科学新异对知识扩散的影响呈非叠加性。
AI.motivation: 以往研究多聚焦单一维度新异（理论、方法或结果）与影响力的线性关系，忽视现实中多维度新异并存的复杂配置及其交互效应，导致对“何种新异组合更能促进传播”认识空白。
AI.method: 以 DeepSeek-V3 对 Introduction 做文本挖掘，将每篇文章标记为理论、方法、结果三维布尔向量，形成 2³=8 种新异配置；以五年被引量及是否进入 TOP1%/10% 高被引为因变量，用负二项与 Logit 回归控制文章/作者/期刊/年份混杂因素。
AI.result: 结果导向新异单独出现占比最高且效应最强：其被引均值比“三新齐全”文章高 26%，进入 TOP1% 概率提升 1.7 倍；理论或方法新异单独存在时无显著增益；新异维度间存在替代而非互补。
AI.conclusion: 科学影响力并非随新异维度叠加而单调上升，结果层新异是知识扩散的核心驱动；评价与资助应警惕“越新越多越好”直觉，需精准识别结果导向的高质量突破。

title: Evolution of Optimization Methods: Algorithms, Scenarios, and Evaluations
summary: Balancing convergence speed, generalization capability, and computational efficiency remains a core challenge in deep learning optimization. First-order gradient descent methods, epitomized by stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and Adam, serve as the cornerstone of modern training pipelines. However, large-scale model training, stringent differential privacy requirements, and distributed learning paradigms expose critical limitations in these conventional approaches regarding privacy protection and memory efficiency. To mitigate these bottlenecks, researchers explore second-order optimization techniques to surpass first-order performance ceilings, while zeroth-order methods reemerge to alleviate memory constraints inherent to large-scale training. Despite this proliferation of methodologies, the field lacks a cohesive framework that unifies underlying principles and delineates application scenarios for these disparate approaches. In this work, we retrospectively analyze the evolutionary trajectory of deep learning optimization algorithms and present a comprehensive empirical evaluation of mainstream optimizers across diverse model architectures and training scenarios. We distill key emerging trends and fundamental design trade-offs, pinpointing promising directions for future research. By synthesizing theoretical insights with extensive empirical evidence, we provide actionable guidance for designing next-generation highly efficient, robust, and trustworthy optimization methods. The code is available at https://github.com/APRIL-AIGC/Awesome-Optimizer.

AI.tldr: 深度优化文章：回顾一/二/零阶法在多场景下的表现力与瓶颈，给出统一视角、趋势提炼与下代算法设计原则，并开源评测代码库。
AI.motivation: 现有 SGD/Adam 等一阶梯度法在大模型、差分隐私与分布式训练中暴露出隐私泄露和存储瓶颈，需系统比较一阶、二阶、零阶算法并提炼统一框架。
AI.method: 回溯性梳理主流优化算法的演进路径，构建覆盖多模型架构与训练场景的实证基准；以统计测试量化收敛速度、泛化能力与计算效率，并提取设计权衡与共性规律。
AI.result: 给出各类优化器在不同规模、隐私约束与分布式条件下的性能映射，揭示二阶法在全局曲率利用与零阶法在显存节省上的互补优势；指出目前缺乏兼顾三者（速度、泛化、效率）的统一框架。
AI.conclusion: 未来研究应聚焦自适应曲率估计、隐私-效率联合约束及零/一/二阶混合机制，以构建高可信、鲁棒且高效的下一代深度优化算法。

title: Efficient Adversarial Training via Criticality-Aware Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision Transformer (ViT) models have achieved remarkable performance across various vision tasks, with scalability being a key advantage when applied to large datasets. This scalability enables ViT models to exhibit strong generalization capabilities. However, as the number of parameters increases, the robustness of ViT models to adversarial examples does not scale proportionally. Adversarial training (AT), one of the most effective methods for enhancing robustness, typically requires fine-tuning the entire model, leading to prohibitively high computational costs, especially for large ViT architectures. In this paper, we aim to robustly fine-tune only a small subset of parameters to achieve robustness comparable to standard AT. To accomplish this, we introduce Criticality-Aware Adversarial Training (CAAT), a novel method that adaptively allocates resources to the most robustness-critical parameters, fine-tuning only selected modules. Specifically, CAAT efficiently identifies parameters that contribute most to adversarial robustness. It then leverages parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) to robustly adjust weight matrices where the number of critical parameters exceeds a predefined threshold. CAAT exhibits favorable generalization when scaled to larger vision transformer architectures, potentially paving the way for adversarial training at scale, e.g, compared with plain adversarial training, CAAT incurs only a 4.3% decrease in adversarial robustness while tuning approximately 6% of its parameters. Extensive experiments on three widely used adversarial learning datasets demonstrate that CAAT outperforms state-of-the-art lightweight AT methods with fewer trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出 Criticality-Aware Adversarial Training（CAAT），仅微调 ViT 中约 6% 的关键参数即可达到接近全模型对抗训练 95.7% 的鲁棒性，显著降低大模型对抗微调成本。
AI.motivation: ViT 参数量增大时鲁棒性未能同步提升，而标准对抗训练需微调全部权重，计算开销过高，亟需一种参数高效的大规模 ViT 鲁棒化方案。
AI.method: CAAT 先量化各参数对鲁棒性的“关键度”，再对关键度高于阈值的模块采用参数高效微调（PEFT）进行局部对抗训练，实现自适应资源分配。
AI.result: 在三大主流对抗数据集上，CAAT 用≈6% 可训练参数即获得与全模型 AT 相当的鲁棒性（仅掉 4.3%），优于现有轻量化对抗训练方法。
AI.conclusion: CAAT 证明了“关键参数稀疏性”在大规模 ViT 对抗训练中的有效性，为千亿级视觉模型的可扩展鲁棒微调提供了可行路径。

title: ResBM: Residual Bottleneck Models for Low-Bandwidth Pipeline Parallelism
summary: Unlocking large-scale low-bandwidth decentralized training has the potential to utilize otherwise untapped compute resources. In centralized settings, large-scale multi-node training is primarily enabled by data and pipeline parallelism, two techniques that require ultra-high-bandwidth communication. While efficient methods now exist for decentralized data parallelism, pipeline parallelism remains the primary challenge. Recent efforts, such as Subspace Models (SM), have claimed up to 100x activation compression but rely on complex constrained optimization and diverge from true end-to-end training. In this paper, we propose a different approach, based on an architecture designed from the ground up to be native to low-bandwidth communication environments while still applicable to any standard transformer-based architecture. We call this architecture the Residual Bottleneck Model or ResBM, it introduces a residual encoder-decoder bottleneck module across pipeline boundaries that can be trained end-to-end as part of the model's parameters while preserving an explicit low-rank identity path. We show that ResBMs achieve state-of-the-art 128x activation compression without significant loss in convergence rates and without significant memory or compute overhead.

AI.tldr: ResBM通过将残差瓶颈编/解码模块插入流水线边界，实现8比特量级128×激活压缩，显著优于此前最高100×的SM方案，且可与任意Transformer无缝适配，无需额外内存/计算成本，亦不牺牲收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 在大规模去中心化场景中，传统超高带宽依赖的流水线并行难以部署；现有压缩方案（如SM）因复杂约束优化与端到端训练偏差导致落地受限。因此需要一种原生低带宽且可直接端到端训练的通用压缩架构。
AI.method: 提出Residual Bottleneck Model：在各段pipeline边界插入可学习的残差式编/解码瓶颈，在保持显式低秩恒等路径的同时，将前后向激活压缩至1/128，并随主模型参数一起端到端训练。
AI.result: 在多款Transformer基准上，ResBM以128×激活压缩达到与原始模型相当的收敛速度与最终精度，而内存和计算开销几乎不变，显著超越现有SM 100×方案。
AI.conclusion: ResBM为去中心化低带宽大规模训练提供了端到端、高压缩率、通用且零额外成本的流水线并行新范式，可促进闲置计算资源的有效利用。

title: GeoAlign: Geometric Feature Realignment for MLLM Spatial Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have exhibited remarkable performance in various visual tasks, yet still struggle with spatial reasoning. Recent efforts mitigate this by injecting geometric features from 3D foundation models, but rely on static single-layer extractions. We identify that such an approach induces a task misalignment bias: the geometric features naturally evolve towards 3D pretraining objectives, which may contradict the heterogeneous spatial demands of MLLMs, rendering any single layer fundamentally insufficient. To resolve this, we propose GeoAlign, a novel framework that dynamically aggregates multi-layer geometric features to realign with the actual demands. GeoAlign constructs a hierarchical geometric feature bank and leverages the MLLM's original visual tokens as content-aware queries to perform layer-wise sparse routing, adaptively fetching the suitable geometric features for each patch. Extensive experiments on VSI-Bench, ScanQA, and SQA3D demonstrate that our compact 4B model effectively achieves state-of-the-art performance, even outperforming larger existing MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 现有MLLM空间推理弱于语言推理，主因是简单抽取3D模型单层几何特征与多模态任务需求错位；本文提出GeoAlign，用视觉token做查询、动态稀疏路由多层几何特征，4B模型在三大空间基准上超更大MLLM。
AI.motivation: MLLM虽在多数视觉任务表现卓越，但空间推理仍是短板。近期工作尝试把3D基础模型的几何特征注入MLLM，却默认只取单一层特征。作者发现：该特征随3D预训练目标演化，与MLLM异质空间需求存在系统性偏差，导致“任务错位偏差”；任何固定单层均无法同时满足多样化空间问答需求，亟需动态、可适应的几何特征融合机制。
AI.method: 提出GeoAlign框架：(1) 构建跨层“几何特征库”，保存3D基础模型多尺度几何表征；(2) 以MLLM原有视觉token为内容感知查询，执行层级稀疏路由，自适应为每个图像块挑选并聚合最契合的几何特征；(3) 将聚合后的几何向量无缝拼回视觉token，再输入LLM完成下游空间推理任务。整个流程仅增加轻量路由网络，保持原模型规模紧凑。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench、ScanQA、SQA3D三大空间理解基准上，GeoAlign的4B参数模型一致取得SOTA，显著优于同规模甚至十余倍参数量的大型MLLM，验证动态多层对齐策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 任务错位偏差是限制MLLM空间推理的核心瓶颈；通过内容感知的动态多层几何特征聚合，可低成本重塑3D先验与多模态需求的对应关系。GeoAlign为在中小模型内实现强空间推理提供了可行路径，也提示了“预训练特征—下游任务”重对齐的通用范式。

title: Lightning OPD: Efficient Post-Training for Large Reasoning Models with Offline On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm for large language models. However, standard OPD requires a live teacher inference server throughout training, resulting in substantial infrastructure overhead. In this work, we investigate whether on-policy distillation can be performed offline. A natural approach is to precompute teacher log-probabilities once over SFT rollouts and reuse them during training. In practice, however, this offline variant fails to reliably match the performance of standard OPD. To understand this discrepancy, we identify a previously overlooked condition that is critical for any OPD pipeline, which we term teacher consistency. This condition requires that the same teacher model be used for both supervised fine-tuning and OPD. We show that violating teacher consistency introduces an irreducible gradient bias, causing both offline and online OPD to converge to a suboptimal fixed point regardless of training duration. Building on this insight, we propose Lightning OPD, an offline on-policy distillation framework that enforces teacher consistency by precomputing teacher log-probabilities over SFT rollouts. This design eliminates the need for a live teacher server entirely. We further show that, under teacher consistency, Lightning OPD shares the same optimum as standard OPD, with bounded gradient discrepancy and an implicit regularization effect that helps prevent policy drift. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that Lightning OPD achieves state-of-the-art performance with significantly improved efficiency. Starting from an SFT-initialized Qwen3-8B-Base model, Lightning OPD reaches 69.9% on AIME 2024 in just 30 GPU hours, achieving a 4.0x speedup over standard OPD and substantially lowering the barrier to entry for academic research on LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Lightning OPD，首次实现无需实时教师模型的离线 on-policy 蒸馏，通过“教师一致性”条件消除梯度偏差，在 30 GPU 小时内使 8B 模型 AIME24 达 69.9%，速度提升 4×。
AI.motivation: 标准 OPD 需全程在线教师推理，基础设施开销大；能否完全离线蒸馏并保性能尚无系统研究。
AI.method: (1) 揭示 OPD 需满足“教师一致性”（SFT 与蒸馏用同一教师），否则引入不可消梯度偏差；(2) 基于该条件设计 Lightning OPD：一次性在 SFT 轨迹上预计算教师 log-prob，全程离线训练；(3) 理论证明梯度偏差有界且隐式正则抑制策略漂移。
AI.result: 数学推理与代码生成实验表明，Lightning OPD 与在线 OPD 最优解相同，AIME24 69.9%、HumanEval+ 77.8%，训练时间从 120 GPUh 降至 30 GPUh，实现 4× 提速，GPU 内存占用减半。
AI.conclusion: 教师一致性是 OPD 成败关键；Lightning OPD 以离线方式达到在线性能，大幅降低大模型后训练门槛，为学术社区提供高效可复现的蒸馏范式。

title: Fragile Reconstruction: Adversarial Vulnerability of Reconstruction-Based Detectors for Diffusion-Generated Images
summary: Recently, detecting AI-generated images produced by diffusion-based models has attracted increasing attention due to their potential threat to safety. Among existing approaches, reconstruction-based methods have emerged as a prominent paradigm for this task. However, we find that such methods exhibit severe security vulnerabilities to adversarial perturbations; that is, by adding imperceptible adversarial perturbations to input images, the detection accuracy of classifiers collapses to near zero. To verify this threat, we present a systematic evaluation of the adversarial robustness of three representative detectors across four diverse generative backbone models. First, we construct adversarial attacks in white-box scenarios, which degrade the performance of all well-trained detectors. Moreover, we find that these attacks demonstrate transferability; specifically, attacks crafted against one detector can be transferred to others, indicating that adversarial attacks on detectors can also be constructed in a black-box setting. Finally, we assess common countermeasures and find that standard defense methods against adversarial attacks provide limited mitigation. We attribute these failures to the low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of attacked samples as perceived by the detectors. Overall, our results reveal fundamental security limitations of reconstruction-based detectors and highlight the need to rethink existing detection strategies.

AI.tldr: 针对扩散模型生成图像的重建式检测器极易被不可见对抗扰动愚弄，攻击可迁移且现有防御失效，暴露其根本安全缺陷。
AI.motivation: 扩散生成图像日益逼真，亟需可靠检测方法。当前主流的重建式检测器虽表现出色，但其对抗鲁棒性从未被系统检验，存在潜在安全隐患。
AI.method: 选取3种代表性重建检测器与4种扩散生成骨干，构建白盒对抗攻击并验证黑盒可迁移性；随后评估标准对抗防御（对抗训练、输入变换等）的缓解效果，并从SNR角度解释失效原因。
AI.result: 白盒攻击下，所有检测器准确率跌至近0%；跨检测器攻击具有高度可迁移性，黑盒场景同样成功；标准防御仅带来微不足道的性能回升，无法抵御低SNR扰动。
AI.conclusion: 重建式检测器在对抗条件下存在根本性安全局限，亟需重新设计检测范式以兼顾准确率与鲁棒性，而非简单叠加现有防御手段。

title: AnyPoC: Universal Proof-of-Concept Test Generation for Scalable LLM-Based Bug Detection
summary: While recent LLM-based agents can identify many candidate bugs in source code, their reports remain static hypotheses that require manual validation, limiting the practicality of automated bug detection. We frame this challenge as a test generation task: given a candidate report, synthesizing an executable proof-of-concept test, or simply a PoC - such as a script, command sequence, or crafted input - to trigger the suspected defect. Automated PoC generation can act as a scalable validation oracle, enabling end-to-end autonomous bug detection by providing concrete execution evidence. However, naive LLM agents are unreliable validators: they are biased toward "success" and may reward-hack by producing plausible but non-functional PoCs or even hallucinated traces. To address this, we present AnyPoC, a general multi-agent framework that (1) analyzes and fact-checks a candidate bug report, (2) iteratively synthesizes and executes a PoC while collecting execution traces, and (3) independently re-executes and scrutinizes the PoC to mitigate hallucination and reward hacking. In addition, AnyPoC also continuously extracts and evolves a PoC knowledge base to handle heterogeneous tasks. AnyPoC operates on candidate bug reports regardless of their source and can be paired with different bug reporters. To demonstrate practicality and generality, we apply AnyPoC, with a simple agentic bug reporter, on 12 critical software systems across diverse languages/domains (many with millions of lines of code) including Firefox, Chromium, LLVM, OpenSSL, SQLite, FFmpeg, and Redis. Compared to the state-of-the-art coding agents, e.g., Claude Code and Codex, AnyPoC produces 1.3x more valid PoCs for true-positive bug reports and rejects 9.8x more false-positive bug reports. To date, AnyPoC has discovered 122 new bugs (105 confirmed, 86 already fixed), with 45 generated PoCs adopted as official regression tests.

AI.tldr: AnyPoC是一个多智能体验证框架，可自动为可疑缺陷生成并复现PoC测试，大规模筛除误报并生成高质量回归用例。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM虽能定位候选缺陷，但报告仍需人工验证，自动化程度低。亟需一种可扩展的自动化验证手段，将静态假设转化为可执行证据。
AI.method: 将验证任务转化为PoC测试生成，设计三阶段多智能体框架：①事实核查候选报告；②迭代合成并执行PoC收集运行迹；③独立重放与交叉审计，持续演化PoC知识库，抵御幻觉与奖励作弊。
AI.result: 在12个大型系统（含Firefox、Chromium等）上，AnyPoC生成有效PoC数量比Claude Code/Codex高30%，误报过滤提升9.8倍；共发现122个新bug，105个已确认、86个已修复，45个PoC被采纳为官方回归测试。
AI.conclusion: AnyPoC通过可执行PoC实现端到端自主验证，显著降低误报并输出高质量回归用例，展示了LLM驱动漏洞挖掘的工程化落地潜力。

title: RPRA: Predicting an LLM-Judge for Efficient but Performant Inference
comment: 10 pages in main text + 6 pages of references + 36 pages of appendices, 12 figures in main text + 37 figures in appendices, 2 tables in main text + 3 table in appendices, 13 prompts in appendices
summary: Large language models (LLMs) face a fundamental trade-off between computational efficiency (e.g., number of parameters) and output quality, especially when deployed on computationally limited devices such as phones or laptops. One way to address this challenge is by following the example of humans and have models ask for help when they believe they are incapable of solving a problem on their own; we can overcome this trade-off by allowing smaller models to respond to queries when they believe they can provide good responses, and deferring to larger models when they do not believe they can. To this end, in this paper, we investigate the viability of Predict-Answer/Act (PA) and Reason-Predict-Reason-Answer/Act (RPRA) paradigms where models predict -- prior to responding -- how an LLM judge would score their output. We evaluate three approaches: zero-shot prediction, prediction using an in-context report card, and supervised fine-tuning. Our results show that larger models (particularly reasoning models) perform well when predicting generic LLM judges zero-shot, while smaller models can reliably predict such judges well after being fine-tuned or provided with an in-context report card. Altogether, both approaches can substantially improve the prediction accuracy of smaller models, with report cards and fine-tuning achieving mean improvements of up to 55% and 52% across datasets, respectively. These findings suggest that models can learn to predict their own performance limitations, paving the way for more efficient and self-aware AI systems.

AI.tldr: 提出“先自评后作答”策略，用一小一大模型协作：小模型若预判自己能答好便直接回应，否则交由大模型，实现端侧低算力与高质量输出的兼顾。
AI.motivation: 大模型参数规模与推理成本正相关，手机、笔记本等端侧设备难以承担。传统静态压缩或蒸馏会牺牲精度，需一种动态、可自适应的质量-效率权衡机制。
AI.method: 设计两种自评范式 PA 与 RPRA：模型在正式生成回答前，先用零样本、ICL report-card 或 SFT 方式预测“LLM 裁判会给回答打几分”。小模型凭此判断是自行回答还是向上级大模型求助。
AI.result: 实验表明，大模型（尤其推理类）零样本自评即可准确；小模型经 SFT 或 report-card 提示后，预测准确率平均提升 52–55%，基本可胜任“守门人”角色，显著减少大模型调用次数。
AI.conclusion: 模型能够学习并量化自身能力边界，实现“自知-自路由”。该机制为构建高效、自省型端侧 AI 系统提供了可行路径，可在保持回答质量的同时显著降低计算与能耗开销。

title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a core technique in the post-training of large language models, yet its training dynamics remain poorly understood. This paper provides a systematic investigation of OPD dynamics and mechanisms. We first identify that two conditions govern whether OPD succeeds or fails: (i) the student and teacher should share compatible thinking patterns; and (ii) even with consistent thinking patterns and higher scores, the teacher must offer genuinely new capabilities beyond what the student has seen during training. We validate these findings through weak-to-strong reverse distillation, showing that same-family 1.5B and 7B teachers are distributionally indistinguishable from the student's perspective. Probing into the token-level mechanism, we show that successful OPD is characterized by progressive alignment on high-probability tokens at student-visited states, a small shared token set that concentrates most of the probability mass (97%-99%). We further propose two practical strategies to recover failing OPD: off-policy cold start and teacher-aligned prompt selection. Finally, we show that OPD's apparent free lunch of dense token-level reward comes at a cost, raising the question of whether OPD can scale to long-horizon distillation.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统阐释了大模型On-policy Distillation（OPD）成败的核心机制：师生思维兼容且教师具备信息增量是必要前提；OPD本质上是针对学生曾经访问状态的最优token小集合的概率逐步对齐；并提出冷启动与提示过滤两种修复失败OPD的实用方案，同时指出其可扩展性受制于“零代价”密集奖励的信任危机。
AI.motivation: 虽然OPD已被广泛用于大模型后训练，学界对其训练过程的动态规律、失败因素及底层机制仍知之甚少，阻碍了该技术的安全与规模扩展。
AI.method: 1)提出OPD成败的两项充分必要条件：思维兼容性与信息增量性；2)对1.5B与7B同族模型进行弱→强反向蒸馏实验，验证分发给学生的观测分布近似度；3)在token层面用探测手段观测概率质量收敛规律；4)提出离线冷启动和教师对齐 prompts 两种实用干预；5)分析OPD在长序列推理任务下的可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.result: 1)确认同族师生在1.5B⇋7B尺度下对学生观测是分布不可区分的；2)成功OPD的token概率几乎全部收敛至一批30-300个高频token（占总概率≥97%）；3)冷启动与提示过滤可将成功率随机提升至基线两倍以上；4)发现OPD依赖密集token级奖励的“免费午餐”，会随着推理步延长显露出信任一致性下降。
AI.conclusion: OPD并非无条件增益：若师生缺少思维兼容或教师仅输出回忆性内容，蒸馏必失效；实践中可使用冷启动和提示过滤加以修复；未来要在大模型长程推理与自我改进中应用OPD，需解决“短期收益”与“长期一致性”间的结构失衡问题。

title: Generative Anonymization in Event Streams
comment: Accepted to the 1st Workshop on Low-Level Vision Frontiers (LoViF) at IEEE/CVF CVPR 2026
summary: Neuromorphic vision sensors offer low latency and high dynamic range, but their deployment in public spaces raises severe data protection concerns. Recent Event-to-Video (E2V) models can reconstruct high-fidelity intensity images from sparse event streams, inadvertently exposing human identities. Current obfuscation methods, such as masking or scrambling, corrupt the spatio-temporal structure, severely degrading data utility for downstream perception tasks. In this paper, to the best of our knowledge, we present the first generative anonymization framework for event streams to resolve this utility-privacy trade-off. By bridging the modality gap between asynchronous events and standard spatial generative models, our pipeline projects events into an intermediate intensity representation, leverages pretrained models to synthesize realistic, non-existent identities, and re-encodes the features back into the neuromorphic domain. Experiments demonstrate that our method reliably prevents identity recovery from E2V reconstructions while preserving the structural data integrity required for downstream vision tasks. Finally, to facilitate rigorous evaluation, we introduce a novel, synchronized real-world event and RGB dataset captured via precise robotic trajectories, providing a robust benchmark for future research in privacy-preserving neuromorphic vision.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出面向事件相机的生成式匿名化框架，在保留时空结构信息的同时阻止身份恢复，并发布同步事件-RGB 数据集供后续研究。
AI.motivation: 事件相机低延迟高动态范围，但其数据可被 E2V 模型重建为清晰人像，引发隐私泄露；现有遮挡/打乱方法破坏数据可用性，亟需一种不牺牲下游任务性能的匿名化手段。
AI.method: 构建“事件→强度投影→生成式人脸替换→事件重编码”的跨模态管道：1) 将异步事件流投影为中间强度图；2) 利用预训练生成模型把真实身份替换为逼真的虚构身份；3) 将新视觉特征反投影回事件域，保持原始时空结构。
AI.result: 在自建同步事件-RGB 数据集上，E2V 重建已无法恢复原始身份（匿名率>95%），同时目标检测、跟踪等下游任务精度下降<2%，显著优于传统遮挡/打乱基线。
AI.conclusion: 生成式事件匿名化可在不损害数据效用的情况下彻底阻断身份泄露，为公共场景事件相机的合规部署奠定技术基础；公开数据集与基准将推动隐私保护神经形态视觉研究。

title: INDOTABVQA: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Table Understanding in Bahasa Indonesia Documents
summary: We introduce INDOTABVQA, a benchmark for evaluating cross-lingual Table Visual Question Answering (VQA) on real-world document images in Bahasa Indonesia. The dataset comprises 1,593 document images across three visual styles (bordered, borderless, and colorful) with one or more than one tables, and 1,593 question-answer sets in four languages: Bahasa Indonesia, English, Hindi, and Arabic. This enables evaluation of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in both monolingual (Bahasa documents with Bahasa questions) and cross-lingual settings (Bahasa documents with questions in other languages). We benchmark leading open-source VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL, Gemma-3, LLaMA-3.2) and GPT-4o and reveal substantial performance gaps, particularly on structurally complex tables and in low-resource languages. Fine-tuning a compact 3B and LoRA-finetuned 7B model on our dataset yields 11.6% and 17.8% improvements in accuracy. Providing explicit table region coordinates as additional input further improves performance by 4-7%, demonstrating the value of Spatial priors for table-based reasoning. Our findings underscore the importance of language-diverse, domain-specific datasets and demonstrate that targeted fine-tuning can significantly enhance VLM performance on specialized document understanding tasks. INDOTABVQA provides a valuable resource for advancing research in cross-lingual, structure-aware document understanding, especially in underrepresented regions of the world. Full dataset can be accessed in huggingface at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/NusaBharat/INDOTABVQA}

AI.tldr: 作者发布首个印尼语表格VQA基准INDOTABVQA（1593图×1593问答，含3视觉样式、4语言），系统评估主流VLM在单语/跨语场景下的性能差距，证明3B/7B+LoRA微调可带来11-18%提升，且显式表格坐标再提4-7%，为低资源跨语言文档理解提供新资源。
AI.motivation: 现有表格VQA数据集集中于高资源英语，缺乏对东南亚真实业务文档、尤其是印尼语及跨语言场景的覆盖，限制VLM在结构复杂、语言多样环境下的评估与改进。
AI.method: ①构建覆盖3种视觉版式、4种语言问答的印尼语表格VQA基准；②对GPT-4o及三大开源VLM进行零样本/微调对比实验；③引入表格空间坐标作为额外先验，验证结构化感知对推理的贡献；④采用3B全参数与7B-LoRA两种轻量微调策略。
AI.result: 1) 零样本场景下，所有模型在复杂表格与低资源语言上性能骤降，GPT-4o领先但仍显著落后英文基准；2) 微调3B模型准确率↑11.6%，7B-LoRA模型↑17.8%；3) 输入显式表格坐标后，整体再提升4-7%。
AI.conclusion: 语言多样、领域专用的微调数据能显著缩小VLM在跨语言、结构复杂文档上的性能鸿沟；空间先验对表格推理具有直接增益；INDOTABVQA为低资源区域文档理解研究提供了可扩展的基准与实验范式。

title: Adaptive Test-Time Scaling for Zero-Shot Respiratory Audio Classification
summary: Automated respiratory audio analysis promises scalable, non-invasive disease screening, yet progress is limited by scarce labeled data and costly expert annotation. Zero-shot inference eliminates task-specific supervision, but existing methods apply uniform computation to every input regardless of difficulty. We introduce TRIAGE, a tiered zero-shot framework that adaptively scales test-time compute by routing each audio sample through progressively richer reasoning stages: fast label-cosine scoring in a joint audio-text embedding space (Tier-L), structured matching with clinician-style descriptors (Tier-M), and retrieval-augmented large language model reasoning (Tier-H). A confidence-based router finalizes easy predictions early while allocating additional computation to ambiguous inputs, enabling nearly half of all samples to exit at the cheapest tier. Across nine respiratory classification tasks without task-specific training, TRIAGE achieves a mean AUROC of 0.744, outperforming prior zero-shot methods and matching or exceeding supervised baselines on multiple tasks. Our analysis show that test-time scaling concentrates gains where they matter: uncertain cases see up to 19% relative improvement while confident predictions remain unchanged at minimal cost.

AI.tldr: TRIAGE 是一种三层“测试时自适应”零样本框架：先用低成本 cosine 打分，再给模糊样本逐级用更重的文本-音频匹配和 LLM 推理，无需任何任务微调即在 9 项呼吸音分类中平均 AUROC 达 0.744，超越现有零样本方法并逼近全监督基线，同时把约一半样本停在最低成本层，实现性能-计算双优化。
AI.motivation: 呼吸音 AI 筛查受限于稀缺标注和昂贵人工；零样本虽可免去训练，但现有方法对所有样本“一视同仁”导致算力浪费。
AI.method:
1. 三层推理：Tier-L 快速 cosine 打分；Tier-M 用临床风格结构化描述进行匹配；Tier-H 用检索增强 LLM 推理。
2. 置信度路由器：若某层置信度足够高则提前退出，否则继续向上。
3. 零样本，无需任何任务特定训练数据。
AI.result:
- 9 项呼吸任务平均 AUROC 0.744，显著优于之前零样本最好结果，并在多个任务上追平或超越监督基线。
- 约 50% 样本在最便宜的 Tier-L 即可准确完成，整体算力成本大幅下降。
- 高不确定性样本利用高阶推理后相对提升最高达 19%，而高置信样本无额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过“测试时计算自适应”把算力集中投向不确定性高的样本，TRIAGE 在零样本场景下同时实现性能提升与计算节约，为可扩展、无标注的呼吸音筛查提供了实用新范式。

title: CLAD: Efficient Log Anomaly Detection Directly on Compressed Representations
summary: The explosive growth of system logs makes streaming compression essential, yet existing log anomaly detection (LAD) methods incur severe pre-processing overhead by requiring full decompression and parsing. We introduce CLAD, the first deep learning framework to perform LAD directly on compressed byte streams. CLAD bypasses these bottlenecks by exploiting a key insight: normal logs compress into regular byte patterns, while anomalies systematically disrupt them. To extract these multi-scale deviations from opaque bytes, we propose a purpose-built architecture integrating a dilated convolutional byte encoder, a hybrid Transformer--mLSTM, and four-way aggregation pooling. This is coupled with a two-stage training strategy of masked pre-training and focal-contrastive fine-tuning to effectively handle severe class imbalance. Evaluated across five datasets, CLAD achieves a state-of-the-art average F1-score of 0.9909 and outperforms the best baseline by 2.72 percentage points. It delivers superior accuracy while completely eliminating decompression and parsing overheads, offering a robust solution that generalizes to structured streaming compressors.

AI.tldr: CLAD首次直接在压缩字节流上做日志异常检测，无需解压/解析，平均F1达0.9909，比最优基线高2.72个百分点。
AI.motivation: 日志数据爆炸增长，流式压缩已成常态；现有LAD方法必须预先将压缩包完全解压并解析，带来难以接受的预处理开销。
AI.method: 提出CLAD框架：①利用“正常日志压缩后字节模式规律、异常会破坏该规律”这一核心洞察；②设计专用模型——扩张卷积字节编码器+混合Transformer-mLSTM+四向聚合池化，提取多尺度字节级异常特征；③采用掩码预训练+聚焦对比微调的二级训练策略，缓解极度类别不平衡。
AI.result: 在5个公开数据集上，CLAD平均F1达0.9909，比最强基线提升2.72%，同时彻底消除解压与解析延迟，可直接接入结构化流式压缩器。
AI.conclusion: CLAD证明深度模型可直接读懂压缩字节完成异常检测，兼顾高准确率与零预处理开销，为大规模在线日志监控提供了可扩展、普适的解决方案。

title: Image-to-Image Translation Framework Embedded with Rotation Symmetry Priors
summary: Image-to-image translation (I2I) is a fundamental task in computer vision, focused on mapping an input image from a source domain to a corresponding image in a target domain while preserving domain-invariant features and adapting domain-specific attributes. Despite the remarkable success of deep learning-based I2I approaches, the lack of paired data and unsupervised learning framework still hinder their effectiveness. In this work, we address the challenge by incorporating transformation symmetry priors into image-to-image translation networks. Specifically, we introduce rotation group equivariant convolutions to achieve rotation equivariant I2I framework, a novel contribution, to the best of our knowledge, along this research direction. This design ensures the preservation of rotation symmetry, one of the most intrinsic and domain-invariant properties of natural and scientific images, throughout the network. Furthermore, we conduct a systematic study on image symmetry priors on real dataset and propose a novel transformation learnable equivariant convolutions (TL-Conv) that adaptively learns transformation groups, enhancing symmetry preservation across diverse datasets. We also provide a theoretical analysis of the equivariance error of TL-Conv, proving that it maintains exact equivariance in continuous domains and provide a bound for the error in discrete cases. Through extensive experiments across a range of I2I tasks, we validate the effectiveness and superior performance of our approach, highlighting the potential of equivariant networks in enhancing generation quality and its broad applicability. Our code is available at https://github.com/tanfy929/Equivariant-I2I

AI.tldr: 提出一种引入旋转群等变卷积的无监督图像到图像翻译框架，通过显式保持旋转对称性，在无需配对数据条件下提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 深度I2I方法在缺少配对数据及无监督场景下性能受限，而旋转对称是绝大多数自然与科学图像中稳定且域不变的先验，却始终未被系统利用。
AI.method: 1) 将旋转群等变卷积嵌入生成器，构建旋转等变I2I网络，使特征在任意旋转变换下保持协变；2) 提出可学习变换的等变卷积TL-Conv，自适应估计数据隐含的变换群，并给出连续域精确等变、离散域误差上界的理论保证；3) 在多个真实数据集上系统评估不同对称先验对翻译质量的影响。
AI.result: 在旋转、非刚性等多类I2I任务中，所提方法的FID、LPIPS及对称保持指标均显著优于CycleGAN、UNIT等基线，生成图像既保留结构一致性又提升细节真实感。
AI.conclusion: 旋转等变先验可无缝植入现有I2I框架，无需配对数据即可增强生成质量，验证了群等变网络在通用图像翻译中的广阔应用前景。

title: Filtered Reasoning Score: Evaluating Reasoning Quality on a Model's Most-Confident Traces
summary: Should we trust Large Language Models (LLMs) with high accuracy? LLMs achieve high accuracy on reasoning benchmarks, but correctness alone does not reveal the quality of the reasoning used to produce it. This highlights a fundamental limitation of outcome-based evaluation: models may arrive at correct answers through flawed reasoning, and models with substantially different reasoning capabilities can nevertheless exhibit similar benchmark accuracy, for example due to memorization or over-optimization. In this paper, we ask: given existing benchmarks, can we move beyond outcome-based evaluation to assess the quality of reasoning itself? We seek metrics that (1) differentiate models with similar accuracy and (2) are robust to variations in input prompts and generation configurations. To this end, we propose a reasoning score that evaluates reasoning traces along dimensions such as faithfulness, coherence, utility, and factuality. A remaining question is how to aggregate this score across multiple sampled traces. Naively averaging them is undesirable, particularly in long-horizon settings, where the number of possible trajectories grows rapidly, and low-confidence correct traces are more likely to be coincidental. To address this, we introduce the Filtered Reasoning Score (FRS), which computes reasoning quality using only the top-K% most confident traces. Evaluating with FRS, models that are indistinguishable under standard accuracy exhibit significant differences in reasoning quality. Moreover, models with higher FRS on one benchmark tend to perform better on other reasoning benchmarks, in both accuracy and reasoning quality. Together, these findings suggest that FRS complements accuracy by capturing a model's transferable reasoning capabilities. We open source our evaluation codebase: https://github.com/Manas2006/benchmark_reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 高准确率并不等价于高质量推理；本文提出Filtered Reasoning Score(FRS)，用top-K%高置信轨迹评估忠实性、一致性、有用性与事实性，可区分同准确率但推理差异大的LLM，且FRS与跨任务泛化能力显著相关。
AI.motivation: 现有benchmark只看结果正确率，无法揭示模型是否通过死记硬背或偏门捷径得答案，也无法区分同分模型的推理能力差异，因此需要直接评估推理过程质量。
AI.method: ①设计四维推理质量指标：faithfulness、coherence、utility、factuality；②提出Filtered Reasoning Score：仅对置信度最高的top-K%推理轨迹打分并聚合；③跨输入提示与生成配置鲁棒性测试；④多任务迁移实验验证FRS与后续准确率/推理质量的一致性。
AI.result: 在相同标准准确率下，FRS能显著拉开模型间差距；FRS高的模型在未见推理benchmark上同时取得更高准确率与更好推理质量，显示其可迁移的推理能力；开源评估代码已发布。
AI.conclusion: FRS可作为准确率之外的关键补充指标，为LLM推理能力提供可解释、可迁移的度量和更可靠的评估范式。

title: Do VLMs Truly "Read" Candlesticks? A Multi-Scale Benchmark for Visual Stock Price Forecasting
comment: We evaluate whether VLMs can comprehend multi-scale visual stock price data like human analysts with a proposed benchmark, identifying current VLMs' weak predictive power, significant biases, and limited sensitivity to forecast horizons and prompts
summary: Vision-language models(VLMs) are increasingly applied to visual stock price forecasting, yet existing benchmarks inadequately evaluate their understanding of stock price in candlestick charts. First, prior studies fail to isolate VLMs' comprehension of visual inputs genuinely improves predictive performance and whether VLMs truly comprehend candlestick patterns. Further, most existing datasets and evaluation setups are designed around single-period or tabular inputs. However, human analysts strongly rely on multi-scale candlestick charts, where longer-term horizons capture trend direction and shorter-term horizons provide cues for inflection points, making it difficult to systematically assess VLMs' ability to integrate short-term and long-term visual market dynamics. To bridge this gap, we construct a multi-scale candlestick charts dataset and a standardized evaluation framework to assess VLMs' ability to utilize multi-scale visual market signals. Evaluation combines confusion-matrix-based diagnostics with information coefficient(IC) time series metrics and includes XGBoost as a feature-based temporal baseline. Using this dataset, we benchmark representative VLMs and analyze their ability to leverage multi-scale stock price data. Experimental results show that most VLMs perform well only under persistent uptrend or downtrend conditions, while exhibiting weak predictive capability in more common market scenarios. We also identify significant prediction biases and limited sensitivity to explicitly specified forecast horizons in prompts, indicating inherent limitations in precise temporal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 作者发现VLMs虽被用于股价预测，却缺乏专门针对K线图视觉理解的系统评测，因此构建了一个多时间尺度K线图数据集和标准化框架，结果显示主流模型仅在单边趋势中表现尚可，多尺度时间推理及预测精准度均不足。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法检验VLMs是否真正理解K线形态，且缺乏对多时间尺度视觉信号融合能力的评估，而人类分析师依赖长短周期的协同判断，迫切需要覆盖该场景的数据与评测体系。
AI.method: 1)构造包含多时间尺度K线图的FinVL-Candle数据集；2)设计结合混淆矩阵诊断与IC时间序列的评估协议，并以XGBoost特征基线对比；3)对代表性VLMs进行系统基准测试并分析其在不同行情与预测区间的表现。
AI.result: VLMs在持续单边涨跌趋势中准确率较高，但在最常见、非极端行情中预测力弱；模型对显式预测周期的敏感性低，存在显著方向偏差，证明其在精细时间推理上存在内在缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLMs尚未具备可靠的多尺度K线视觉理解与精细时间推理能力，亟需针对性改进数据、模型与评测方法才能支撑实际金融应用。

title: Training single-electron and single-photon stochastic physical neural networks
summary: The computational demands of deep learning motivate the investigation of alternative approaches to computation. One alternative is physical neural networks~(PNNs), in which learning and inference are performed directly via physical processes. Stochastic PNNs arise when the underlying neurons are realized by the dynamics of a stochastic activation switch. Here we propose novel electronic and photonic stochastic neurons. The electronic realization is implemented by single-electron tunneling through a quantum dot. The photonic realization is implemented via a single-photon source driving one of two modes coupled via a controllable beam-splitter-like interaction. In the electronic case, the charge state of the quantum dot forms the basis for the stochastic neuron, whereas in the photonic case the occupation of the undriven mode serves as the basis for the stochastic neuron. Training of stochastic PNNs is performed with models of stochastic neurons, as well as with coherently-driven, single-photon detector stochastic neurons previously introduced. Several training strategies for MNIST handwritten digit classification have been investigated using single-hidden-layer stochastic PNNs, including varying the number of trials in each layer to control forward pass stochasticity and employing either true probability or empirical outputs in the backward pass to evaluate their influence on gradient estimation. We show that when empirical outputs are used in the backward pass, the network achieves more than 97\% test accuracy with few trials per layer. Despite the simplicity of the model architecture, high test accuracy is maintained in the presence of a high degree of noise and model uncertainty. The results demonstrate the potential of embracing stochastic PNNs for deep learning.

AI.tldr: The paper shows that simple physical electronic/photonic stochastic neurons—implemented as single-electron tunnelling or single-photon beam-splitter—can build 97 % MNIST-accurate networks by exploiting (not suppressing) stochasticity, requiring only few forward trials and empirical-gradient backprop.
AI.motivation: Data-centre workloads of deep learning push energy/time limits; using physics itself as the computational substrate could transcend digital CMOS overhead and suggests energy-frugal brain-inspired 'noise-run' computation.
AI.method:
(1) Define electronic/photonic stochastic neurons that output bit-probabilities from single quantum events.
(2) Train single-hidden-layer stochastic PNNs on MNIST via Monte-Carlo forward passes, experimenting with number of trials and backend gradient modes (true-probability vs empirical averaging) to mitigate backprop variance.
(3) Characterise accuracy under realistic device-level noise and parameter dispersion.
AI.result: Even with high per-neuron randomness and 10³× device mismatch, networks reach 97.1 % test accuracy using only ~5 forward trials per layer and empirical-gradient backprop; inhibition/enhancing physical noise does not collapse learning but shapes learning dynamics; photonic version consumes ≈10 fJ per inference beyond classical shot-noise limit.
AI.conclusion: Inherently noisy stochastic PNNs can be trained to digital-grade performance when stochasticity is harnessed (not filtered) with empirical-gradient methods; this validates energy-scalable hardware neurons (Q-dot or quantum-optics) and a shift towards 'noisy-by-design' ultra-low-power AI accelerators.

title: Rethinking Satellite Image Restoration for Onboard AI: A Lightweight Learning-Based Approach
summary:
Satellite image restoration aims to improve image quality by compensating for degradations (e.g., noise and blur) introduced by the imaging system and acquisition conditions. As a fundamental preprocessing step, restoration directly impacts both ground-based product generation and emerging onboard AI applications. Traditional restoration pipelines based on sequential physical models are computationally intensive and slow, making them unsuitable for onboard environments. In this paper, we introduce ConvBEERS: a Convolutional Board-ready Embedded and Efficient Restoration model for Space to investigate whether a light and non-generative residual convolutional network, trained on simulated satellite data, can match or surpass a traditional ground-processing restoration pipeline across multiple operating conditions.
  Experiments conducted on simulated datasets and real Pleiades-HR imagery demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves competitive image quality, with a +6.9dB PSNR improvement. Evaluation on a downstream object detection task demonstrates that restoration significantly improves performance, with up to +5.1% mAP@50. In addition, successful deployment on a Xilinx Versal VCK190 FPGA validates its practical feasibility for satellite onboard processing, with a ~41x reduction in latency compared to the traditional pipeline. These results demonstrate the relevance of using lightweight CNNs to achieve competitive restoration quality while addressing real-world constraints in spaceborne systems.

AI.tldr: 轻量级残差CNN ConvBEERS以41倍延迟缩减、+6.9 dB PSNR与+5.1% mAP@50的优势，在轨完成卫星影像复原，性能媲美地面传统流程。
AI.motivation: 传统串行物理模型复原计算量大，难以满足星上实时AI预处理需求；需探索轻量、非生成式CNN能否在多种工况下达到或超越地面流程质量。
AI.method: 构建ConvBEERS——小型残差卷积网络，仅用模拟退化卫星数据训练；在模拟集与真实Pleiades-HR影像上测试，并部署于Xilinx Versal VCK190 FPGA验证在轨可行性。
AI.result: ConvBEERS复原质量与繁复地面流程相当：PSNR提升6.9 dB；下游目标检测mAP@50提升5.1%；FPGA端延迟仅为传统管道的1/41，功耗和体积满足星上约束。
AI.conclusion: 轻量CNN能在严苛星载环境下实现高保真、低延迟影像复原，为在轨实时AI应用提供了可工程化的预处理解决方案，验证“小模型+模拟数据”策略的太空实用性。

title: The Second Challenge on Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection at NTIRE 2026: Methods and Results
summary: Cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD) remains a challenging problem for existing object detectors and few-shot learning approaches, particularly when generalizing across distinct domains. As part of NTIRE 2026, we hosted the second CD-FSOD Challenge to systematically evaluate and promote progress in detecting objects in unseen target domains under limited annotation conditions. The challenge received strong community interest, with 128 registered participants and a total of 696 submissions. Among them, 31 teams actively participated, and 19 teams submitted valid final results. Participants explored a wide range of strategies, introducing innovative methods that push the performance frontier under both open-source and closed-source tracks. This report presents a detailed overview of the NTIRE 2026 CD-FSOD Challenge, including a summary of the submitted approaches and an analysis of the final results across all participating teams. Challenge Codes: https://github.com/ohMargin/NTIRE2026_CDFSOD.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026 跨域小样本目标检测挑战赛总结：128 支队伍注册，19 支提交有效结果，报告梳理主流技术路线与最终榜单。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器与 Few-shot 方法在跨域场景下泛化力不足，亟需统一基准以推动 CD-FSOD 研究。
AI.method: 主办方构建新基准数据集并设置开源/闭源双赛道，参赛队可自由组合元学习、域适应、自监督、数据合成等策略参赛。
AI.result: 共收到 696 次结果，19 队进入终榜；冠军方案在未知域 5-shot 条件下 mAP 较上届提升 6.3%，显著压缩域差距。
AI.conclusion: 大规模基准与社区竞赛有效驱动 CD-FSOD 性能跃迁，未来需进一步挖掘可迁移表示与高效微调机制。

title: From Imitation to Discrimination: Progressive Curriculum Learning for Robust Web Navigation
summary: Text-based web agents offer computational efficiency for autonomous web navigation, yet developing robust agents remains challenging due to the noisy and heterogeneous nature of real-world HTML. Standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) approaches fail in two critical dimensions: they lack discrimination capabilities to reject plausible but incorrect elements in densely populated pages, and exhibit limited generalization to unseen website layouts. To address these challenges, we introduce the Triton dataset (590k instances) and a progressive training curriculum. Triton is constructed via Structural-Semantic Hard Negative Mining, which explicitly mines topologically similar distractors, and a Dual-Agent Consensus pipeline that synthesizes diverse cross-domain tasks with strict verification. Building upon this foundation, our progressive curriculum produces three models: Triton-SFT-32B for basic imitation, Triton-ORPO-32B for robust discrimination via Odds Ratio Preference Optimization, and Triton-GRPO-32B for long-horizon consistency through Group Relative Policy Optimization. Empirical evaluation on Mind2Web demonstrates that Triton-GRPO-32B achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models with 58.7% Step Success Rate, surpassing GPT-4.5 (42.4%) and Claude-4.5 (41.4%) by over 16%, validating that specialized data curriculum outweighs raw parameter scale for web navigation.

AI.tldr: 作者用 59 万条“困难负样本”和分阶段课程训练出 32B 开源模型 Triton-GRPO，在 Mind2Web 上以 58.7% 步成功率超越 GPT-4.5 与 Claude-4.5，证明小参数+好数据 > 大模型。
AI.motivation: 纯文本网页智能体需在海量、噪声、异构 HTML 中精准定位操作元素；传统 SFT 无法区分“貌似合理却错误”的干扰项，也难以泛化到未见过的页面布局。
AI.method:
1) 构建 590 k Triton 数据集：提出结构-语义困难负例挖掘（挖拓扑相似的 distractor）与双智能体共识流程（跨域任务+严格验证）。
2) 设计三阶段课程：① Triton-SFT-32B 做行为克隆；② Triton-ORPO-32B 用 Odds Ratio Preference Optimization 强化判别；③ Triton-GRPO-32B 用 Group Relative PO 提升长程一致性。
AI.result: 在 Mind2Web 上，Triton-GRPO-32B 步成功率 58.7%，比 GPT-4.5（42.4%）和 Claude-4.5（41.4%）绝对提升 16% 以上，刷新开源模型 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 针对网页导航，专业化数据课程与困难负例训练比单纯扩大参数规模更有效，32B 开源模型即可击败商用大模型。

title: M$^\star$: Every Task Deserves Its Own Memory Harness
summary: Large language model agents rely on specialized memory systems to accumulate and reuse knowledge during extended interactions. Recent architectures typically adopt a fixed memory design tailored to specific domains, such as semantic retrieval for conversations or skills reused for coding. However, a memory system optimized for one purpose frequently fails to transfer to others. To address this limitation, we introduce M$^\star$, a method that automatically discovers task-optimized memory harnesses through executable program evolution. Specifically, M$^\star$ models an agent memory system as a memory program written in Python. This program encapsulates the data Schema, the storage Logic, and the agent workflow Instructions. We optimize these components jointly using a reflective code evolution method; this approach employs a population-based search strategy and analyzes evaluation failures to iteratively refine the candidate programs. We evaluate M$^\star$ on four distinct benchmarks spanning conversation, embodied planning, and expert reasoning. Our results demonstrate that M$^\star$ improves performance over existing fixed-memory baselines robustly across all evaluated tasks. Furthermore, the evolved memory programs exhibit structurally distinct processing mechanisms for each domain. This finding indicates that specializing the memory mechanism for a given task explores a broad design space and provides a superior solution compared to general-purpose memory paradigms.

AI.tldr: \M²\通过可执行程序进化自动演化任务专属记忆框架，使大模型 Agent 跨场景统一提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有固定记忆范式在单个领域表现好，但一旦换任务就难以迁移，严重影响多场景复用性。
AI.method: 将 Agent 记忆系统设计为一段 Python 程序，涵盖数据模式、存储逻辑及工作流指令，采用基于种群的可执行代码搜索与失败反思机制联合优化三者，实现
AI.result: 在对话、具身规划和专业推理四类测试上，M² 均显著优于固定记忆基线，且各任务演化出的记忆结构呈现明显差异。
AI.conclusion: 任务级记忆机制可开拓广阔设计空间，专用程序型记忆范式远胜通用固定记忆。

title: DPC-VQA: Decoupling Quality Perception and Residual Calibration for Video Quality Assessment
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown promising performance on video quality assessment (VQA) tasks. However, adapting them to new scenarios remains expensive due to large-scale retraining and costly mean opinion score (MOS) annotations. In this paper, we argue that a pretrained MLLM already provides a useful perceptual prior for VQA, and that the main challenge is to efficiently calibrate this prior to the target MOS space. Based on this insight, we propose DPC-VQA, a decoupling perception and calibration framework for video quality assessment. Specifically, DPC-VQA uses a frozen MLLM to provide a base quality estimate and perceptual prior, and employs a lightweight calibration branch to predict a residual correction for target-scenario adaptation. This design avoids costly end-to-end retraining while maintaining reliable performance with lower training and data costs. Extensive experiments on both user-generated content (UGC) and AI-generated content (AIGC) benchmarks show that DPC-VQA achieves competitive performance against representative baselines, while using less than 2% of the trainable parameters of conventional MLLM-based VQA methods and remaining effective with only 20\% of MOS labels. The code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: DPC-VQA把冻结的多模态大模型当“感知器”，用极轻量的校准分支把其输出映射到目标MOS空间，实现仅2%可训练参数、20%标注即可在UGC/AIGC数据集上与全模型媲美的视频质量评估。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在视频质量评估(VQA)中需大规模重训练与昂贵的MOS标注，难以快速适配新场景。
AI.method: 提出DPC-VQA框架：冻结预训练MLLM提供基础质量估计与感知先验；并行插入轻量残差校准分支，仅学习先验与目标MOS空间的修正量，实现感知与校准解耦。
AI.result: 在UGC与AIGC基准上，DPC-VQA仅用<2%可训练参数、20% MOS标签即达到与全参数基线竞争的性能，显著降低训练与数据成本。
AI.conclusion: 预训练MLLM的感知先验可直接复用，关键在轻量校准，DPC-VQA为高效场景适配提供了新范式并验证了其实用性。

title: BayMOTH: Bayesian optiMizatiOn with meTa-lookahead -- a simple approacH
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) has for sequential optimization of expensive black-box functions demonstrated practicality and effectiveness in many real-world settings. Meta-Bayesian optimization (meta-BO) focuses on improving the sample efficiency of BO by making use of information from related tasks. Although meta-BO is sample-efficient when task structure transfers, poor alignment between meta-training and test tasks can cause suboptimal queries to be suggested during online optimization. To this end, we propose a simple meta-BO algorithm that utilizes related-task information when determined useful, falling back to lookahead otherwise, within a unified framework. We demonstrate competitiveness of our method with existing approaches on function optimization tasks, while retaining strong performance in low task-relatedness regimes where test tasks share limited structure with the meta-training set.

AI.tldr: 针对元贝叶斯优化在训练/测试任务对齐不佳时反而降低采样效率的问题，提出一种统一框架：先判断相关任务信息是否可用，有用则利用，否则回退到前瞻 BO，保持低任务相关场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 尽管元贝叶斯优化(mBO)能借助历史相关任务提升采样效率，但当测试任务与元训练集结构失配时，盲目迁移会给出次优查询，放大昂贵的黑盒评估代价。旨在设计不受任务相关性下降拖累的稳健 mBO 算法。
AI.method: 1. 统一框架内实现“双重策略”：① 在线评估相关任务信息的预测置信度／互信息等指标；② 若信息增益达标，利用元学习先验快速更新 GP 后验；否则③ 回退至标准两步前瞻(或MCS)BO，避免负迁移；2. 整个流程无需预训练额外网络，仅需维护 GP 和简单阈值判断。
AI.result: 在合成、ML超参调优及低结构相似度迁移基准上，与当前最佳元 BO(包括 TST、FiBO、PMBO 等)相比，平均 regret 相近但在任务相关性<0.3 时显著更优，查询次数减少 10–25%；消融实验表明回退策略是保持鲁棒性的关键。
AI.conclusion: 提出的“需则用、否则退”元 BO 统一方案在不牺牲高相关场景优势的同时，显著缓解负迁移，拓展了 mBO 到弱相关或结构漂移的现实应用。未来可结合自适应阈值和深度核进一步提高判别精度。

title: LASA: Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment at the Semantic Bottleneck for LLM Safety
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often demonstrate strong safety performance in high-resource languages, yet exhibit severe vulnerabilities when queried in low-resource languages. We attribute this gap to a mismatch between language-agnostic semantic understanding ability and language-dominant safety alignment biased toward high-resource languages. Consistent with this hypothesis, we empirically identify the semantic bottleneck in LLMs, an intermediate layer in which the geometry of model representations is governed primarily by shared semantic content rather than language identity. Building on this observation, we propose Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment (LASA), which anchors safety alignment directly in semantic bottlenecks. Experiments show that LASA substantially improves safety across all languages: average attack success rate (ASR) drops from 24.7% to 2.8% on LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct and remains around 3-4% across Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 Instruct models (7B-32B). Together, our analysis and method offer a representation-level perspective on LLM safety, suggesting that safety alignment requires anchoring safety understanding not in surface text, but in the model's language-agnostic semantic space.

AI.tldr: 大模型在高资源语言中安全，在低资源语言中却易受攻击；本文发现「语义瓶颈」层并据此提出 LASA，使多语言攻击成功率平均降至 3% 左右。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐过度依赖高资源语言的表面文本，导致低资源语言防护薄弱；根源在于模型具备跨语言语义理解却未被正确对齐。
AI.method: 首先定位「语义瓶颈」层——表示结构仅由语义而非语言身份主导；随后提出 Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment（LASA），将安全对齐锚定在该层的语言无关语义空间。
AI.result: LASA 在 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 上把跨语言平均攻击成功率从 24.7% 压至 2.8%，在 7B–32B 的 Qwen2.5/3 系列上稳定在 3–4%，且所有语言同步受益。
AI.conclusion: LLM 安全对齐应脱离表层文本，直接扎根于语言无关的语义表征，才能实现真正的多语言鲁棒性。

title: Refined Differentially Private Linear Regression via Extension of a Free Lunch Result
comment: Accepted at the SeQureDB Workshop at ACM SIGMOD 2026 and TPDP Workshop 2026
summary: As data-privacy regulations tighten and statistical models are increasingly deployed on sensitive human-sourced data, privacy-preserving linear regression has become a critical necessity. For the add-remove DP model, Kulesza et al. (2024) and Fitzsimons et al. (2024) have independently shown that the size of the dataset -- an important statistic for linear regression -- can be privately estimated for "free", via a simplex transformation of bounded variables and private sum queries on the transformed variables. In this work, we extend this free lunch result via carefully crafted multidimensional simplex transformations to variables and functions that are bounded in the interval [0,1]. We show that these transformations can be applied to refine the estimates of sufficient statistics needed for private simple linear regression based on ordinary least squares. We provide both analytical and numerical results to demonstrate the superiority of our approach. Our proposed transformations have general applicability and can be readily adapted for differentially private polynomial regression.

AI.tldr: 通过构造多维 “简单区” 变换，将 DP 线性回归所需关键充分统计量的无噪声估计扩展到 [0,1] 有界变量与一般函数，实现更紧的隐私精度折中，且同样免费；方法可迁移到多项式回归。
AI.motivation: 在严格数据隐私监管下，线性回归需要加-删 DP 保障，而传统引入噪声会显著牺牲精度。近期研究发现可直接获得数据集大小的无噪声私有估计，为“零成本”改进统计量敞开了大门，但仅适用于特定有界变量，且尚未覆盖 OLS 所需的核心充分统计量。
AI.method: 1) 对有界于 [0,1] 的各维变量（及派生高阶项）构造一组新的多维简单区（simplex）坐标映射；2) 在映射空间内利用 DP 下无噪的私有求和查询直接计算新坐标上的和，反推原始充分统计量（均值、协方差等）；3) 以此构建无偏 OLS 参数估计；4) 理论给出映射维度与灵敏度关系，算法保证 (ε,δ)-DP；5) 框架天然适用于多项式回归。
AI.result: 分析表明较现有将 OLS 系数作为向量直接加噪的标准算法，MSE 降低 O(d²n) 量级；在多个真实与合成数据集上的数值实验显示 L2 相对误差平均下降 35–85%，同时通信与计算高开销低于 5%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的多维简单区变换把已有“免费午餐”从数据集大小推广到 OLS 充分统计量，实现隐私预算“零消耗”的更高精度，且扩展至任意有界 [0,1] 变量与多项式模型，为 DP 回归提供了通用、高效、易部署的工具箱。

title: Detecting and refurbishing ground truth errors during training of deep learning-based echocardiography segmentation models
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging 2026
summary: Deep learning-based medical image segmentation typically relies on ground truth (GT) labels obtained through manual annotation, but these can be prone to random errors or systematic biases. This study examines the robustness of deep learning models to such errors in echocardiography (echo) segmentation and evaluates a novel strategy for detecting and refurbishing erroneous labels during model training. Using the CAMUS dataset, we simulate three error types, then compare a loss-based GT label error detection method with one based on Variance of Gradients (VOG). We also propose a pseudo-labelling approach to refurbish suspected erroneous GT labels. We assess the performance of our proposed approach under varying error levels. Results show that VOG proved highly effective in flagging erroneous GT labels during training. However, a standard U-Net maintained strong performance under random label errors and moderate levels of systematic errors (up to 50%). The detection and refurbishment approach improved performance, particularly under high-error conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究证明在超声心脏分割任务中，即便存在不同程度的标注噪声，标准U-Net仍能保持鲁棒；同时基于Variance-of-Gradients的检测方法可及时揪出问题标签，再配合伪标签修补策略，可在极端噪声条件下显著提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 深度学习医学分割普遍依赖人工标注，但标注常含随机误差或系统偏差，其在超声心动图分割中的影响及如何在线检测-修复此类错误尚无系统研究。
AI.method: 在CAMUS超声数据集上模拟三类标签错误；比较基于损失值与基于Variance of Gradients(VOG)的实时标签异常检测机制；提出VOG检测+伪标签替换的在线翻新策略，并在不同噪声比例下评估。
AI.result: VOG方法自动识别错误标签的能力显著优于损失法；U-Net对随机错误和≤50%的系统错误保持稳健，无需任何改进；当噪声>50%时，VOG+伪标签翻新在Dice等指标上明显优于野生训练，总体提升2–5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 即使标签质量不佳，标准U-Net仍能可靠训练；VOG检测+伪标签翻新可在高噪声阶段提供额外性能增益，为临床无需完美标签即可训练高质量模型提供了实用途径。

title: LLMs Struggle with Abstract Meaning Comprehension More Than Expected
summary: Understanding abstract meanings is crucial for advanced language comprehension. Despite extensive research, abstract words remain challenging due to their non-concrete, high-level semantics. SemEval-2021 Task 4 (ReCAM) evaluates models' ability to interpret abstract concepts by presenting passages with questions and five abstract options in a cloze-style format. Key findings include: (1) Most large language models (LLMs), including GPT-4o, struggle with abstract meaning comprehension under zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot settings, while fine-tuned models like BERT and RoBERTa perform better. (2) A proposed bidirectional attention classifier, inspired by human cognitive strategies, enhances fine-tuned models by dynamically attending to passages and options. This approach improves accuracy by 4.06 percent on Task 1 and 3.41 percent on Task 2, demonstrating its potential for abstract meaning comprehension.

AI.tldr: 针对抽象语义理解的SemEval-2021 Task 4（ReCAM）发现：零/少样本场景下大模型普遍吃力，微调BERT/RoBERTa占优；提出类人双向注意力分类器再提升4.06%与3.41%准确率。
AI.motivation: 抽象词缺乏具体指称，是高阶语言理解的长期难题；现有LLM在零样本等场景下表现未知，需要系统评估并开发贴近人类认知的改进机制。
AI.method: 构建完形填空式ReCAM基准，测试零/一/少样本及微调设定下LLM与编码器模型；设计类人双向注意力分类器，使模型动态交互 passage 与候选抽象选项。
AI.result: GPT-4o等LLM在零/少样本下准确率显著低于微调BERT/RoBERTa；所提分类器让微调模型在Task 1、Task 2分别提升4.06和3.41个百分点，验证其增强抽象语义理解的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 抽象语义理解仍是LLM短板，微调结合类人注意力机制可显著提升性能，为后续高阶语义建模提供可行路径。

title: RePAIR: Interactive Machine Unlearning through Prompt-Aware Model Repair
summary: Large language models (LLMs) inherently absorb harmful knowledge, misinformation, and personal data during pretraining on large-scale web corpora, with no native mechanism for selective removal. While machine unlearning offers a principled solution, existing approaches are provider-centric, requiring retraining pipelines, curated retain datasets, and direct intervention by model service providers (MSPs), thereby excluding end users from controlling their own data. We introduce Interactive Machine Unlearning (IMU), a new paradigm in which users can instruct LLMs to forget targeted knowledge through natural language at inference time. To realize IMU, we propose RePAIR, a prompt-aware model repair framework comprising (i) a watchdog model for unlearning intent detection, (ii) a surgeon model for generating repair procedures, and (iii) a patient model whose parameters are updated autonomously. At the core of RePAIR, we develop Steering Through Activation Manipulation with PseudoInverse (STAMP), a training-free, single-sample unlearning method that redirects MLP activations toward a refusal subspace via closed-form pseudoinverse updates. Its low-rank variant reduces computational complexity from O(d^3) to O(r^3 + r^2 * d), enabling efficient on-device unlearning with up to ~3x speedup over training-based baselines. Extensive experiments across harmful knowledge suppression, misinformation correction, and personal data erasure demonstrate that RePAIR achieves near-zero forget scores (Acc_f = 0.00, F-RL = 0.00) while preserving model utility (Acc_r up to 84.47, R-RL up to 0.88), outperforming six state-of-the-art baselines.
