These results establish RePAIR as an effective and practical framework for user-driven model editing, advancing transparent and on-device control over learned knowledge, with potential extensions to multimodal foundation models.

AI.tldr: 首次让用户仅通过自然语言指令即可让大模型“即时遗忘”特定知识，无需模型服务商重训；所提 RePAIR 框架在单样本、无训练条件下实现≈0 遗忘残留，同时保留 84% 原模型性能，为设备端用户可控编辑奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在预训练阶段不可避免地吸收有害、错误及隐私信息，而当前“机器遗忘”方案完全由模型服务商主导，需重训、保留数据集和大量算力，终端用户无法自主删除自身数据，缺乏透明与即时可控性。
AI.method: 提出 Interactive Machine Unlearning(IMU) 新范式，通过自然语言即时触发遗忘。具体实现为 RePAIR 框架：① watchdog 检测用户遗忘意图；② surgeon 生成修复策略；③ patient 模型自主更新参数。核心算法 STAMP 利用伪逆做激活层 Steering，将 MLP 输出投影至“拒绝子空间”，其低秩版本把复杂度从 O(d³) 降至 O(r³+r²d)，支持设备端单次推理完成遗忘。
AI.result: 在有害知识、谣言、个人隐私三类任务上，RePAIR 的遗忘得分 Acc_f、F-RL 均≈0；保留集准确率 Acc_r 最高 84.47%，R-RL 0.88，六项 SOTA 基线全面落后；低秩 STAMP 相比重训方法提速≈3 倍，内存占用适合端侧部署。
AI.conclusion: RePAIR 证明无需重训、仅通过用户自然语言即可实现精准、高效的模型知识删除，兼顾隐私合规与模型效用，为可解释、用户主导的模型编辑提供了即插即用方案，可直接扩展至多模态基础模型。

title: Inverse Design of Inorganic Compounds with Generative AI
summary: Machine learning is revolutionizing chemistry. Beyond the value of predictive models accelerating virtual screening, generative AI aims at enabling inverse design, reversing the compound-to-property prediction paradigm into property-to-compound generation. Chemists now have access to a rich AI toolbox for organic chemistry, including drug discovery. However, the application of these methods to inorganic compounds remains limited by the challenges posed by their intrinsic nature. This Review analyzes how these challenges have been addressed, considering widely diverse systems ranging from molecules to crystals, including transition metal complexes and microporous materials. The analysis focuses on how generative AI methods have evolved towards data-representation-model pipelines that address the full complexity of inorganic compounds, including their chemical composition, geometry, symmetry, and electronic structure. Future directions, like benchmark standardization and the development of synthesizability metrics, are also discussed.

title: Challenging Vision-Language Models with Physically Deployable Multimodal Semantic Lighting Attacks
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable performance, yet their security remains insufficiently understood. Existing adversarial studies focus almost exclusively on the digital setting, leaving physical-world threats largely unexplored. As VLMs are increasingly deployed in real environments, this gap becomes critical, since adversarial perturbations must be physically realizable. Despite this practical relevance, physical attacks against VLMs have not been systematically studied. Such attacks may induce recognition failures and further disrupt multimodal reasoning, leading to severe semantic misinterpretation in downstream tasks. Therefore, investigating physical attacks on VLMs is essential for assessing their real-world security risks. To address this gap, we propose Multimodal Semantic Lighting Attacks (MSLA), the first physically deployable adversarial attack framework against VLMs. MSLA uses controllable adversarial lighting to disrupt multimodal semantic understanding in real scenes, attacking semantic alignment rather than only task-specific outputs. Consequently, it degrades zero-shot classification performance of mainstream CLIP variants while inducing severe semantic hallucinations in advanced VLMs such as LLaVA and BLIP across image captioning and visual question answering (VQA). Extensive experiments in both digital and physical domains demonstrate that MSLA is effective, transferable, and practically realizable. Our findings provide the first evidence that VLMs are highly vulnerable to physically deployable semantic attacks, exposing a previously overlooked robustness gap and underscoring the urgent need for physical-world robustness evaluation of VLMs.

AI.tldr: 首次提出可在真实光照场景中部署的多模态语义光照攻击（MSLA），系统证实主流视觉–语言模型在现实环境下存在严重的物理鲁棒性漏洞。
AI.motivation: 视觉–语言模型(VLM)已广泛应用，但现有对抗研究局限于数字输入，忽视现实环境中物理可实现的对抗威胁。
AI.method: 设计MSLA框架，对真实场景的可控灯光进行优化，生成物理可部署的光照扰动，以破坏VLM跨模态语义对齐而非仅限任务输出。
AI.result: 在零样本分类、图像描述与VQA任务上，MSLA显著降低CLIP家族性能，并诱导LLaVA、BLIP产生严重语义幻觉；数字与实体实验均验证其有效性、可迁移性与可实现性。
AI.conclusion: 首次实证揭示VLM极易遭受物理语义攻击，暴露以往被忽视的鲁棒性缺口，亟需开展面向真实世界的VLM鲁棒性评估与防御。

title: Curvelet-Based Frequency-Aware Feature Enhancement for Deepfake Detection
summary: The proliferation of sophisticated generative models has significantly advanced the realism of synthetic facial content, known as deepfakes, raising serious concerns about digital trust. Although modern deep learning-based detectors perform well, many rely on spatial-domain features that degrade under compression. This limitation has prompted a shift toward integrating frequency-domain representations with deep learning to improve robustness. Prior research has explored frequency transforms such as Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), and Wavelet Transform, among others. However, to the best of our knowledge, the Curvelet Transform, despite its superior directional and multiscale properties, remains entirely unexplored in the context of deepfake detection. In this work, we introduce a novel Curvelet-based detection approach that enhances feature quality through wedge-level attention and scale-aware spatial masking, both trained to selectively emphasize discriminative frequency components. The refined frequency cues are reconstructed and passed to a modified pretrained Xception network for classification. Evaluated on two compression qualities in the challenging FaceForensics++ dataset, our method achieves 98.48% accuracy and 99.96% AUC on FF++ low compression, while maintaining strong performance under high compression, demonstrating the efficacy and interpretability of Curvelet-informed forgery detection.

AI.tldr: 基于 Curvelet 变换频域特征的深度伪造检测新方法，在压缩条件下仍保持 98.48% 准确率与 99.96% AUC，显著优于现有空域方案。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习检测器过度依赖空域特征，压缩后性能骤降；频域方法虽已引入 DCT/FFT/小波，但方向-多尺度特性更强的 Curvelet 变换尚未被利用。
AI.method: 提出 Curvelet-ForgeryNet：① 对伪造人脸做 Curvelet 分解；② 楔形级注意力与尺度感知空域掩膜联合筛选判别频带；③ 重构关键频率图并送入改进的 Xception 完成二分类。
AI.result: 在 FaceForensics++ 低压缩子集上分获 98.48% 准确率、99.96% AUC；高压缩下仍保持领先，可视化亦验证了模型关注的高频伪造痕迹。
AI.conclusion: 首次证实 Curvelet 变换可为深度伪造检测提供压缩鲁棒、可解释的频率线索，为后续在极端压缩与跨数据集场景下的可靠取证奠定基础。

title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a core technique in the post-training of large language models, yet its training dynamics remain poorly understood. This paper provides a systematic investigation of OPD dynamics and mechanisms. We first identify that two conditions govern whether OPD succeeds or fails: (i) the student and teacher should share compatible thinking patterns; and (ii) even with consistent thinking patterns and higher scores, the teacher must offer genuinely new capabilities beyond what the student has seen during training. We validate these findings through weak-to-strong reverse distillation, showing that same-family 1.5B and 7B teachers are distributionally indistinguishable from the student's perspective. Probing into the token-level mechanism, we show that successful OPD is characterized by progressive alignment on high-probability tokens at student-visited states, a small shared token set that concentrates most of the probability mass (97%-99%). We further propose two practical strategies to recover failing OPD: off-policy cold start and teacher-aligned prompt selection. Finally, we show that OPD's apparent free lunch of dense token-level reward comes at a cost, raising the question of whether OPD can scale to long-horizon distillation.

AI.tldr: 首次系统化揭示On-policy蒸馏成败的两大条件：师生思维兼容且教师需提供学生未见的新能力；发现成功OPD依赖极小高概率token集对齐，并提出冷启动与提示优选两种挽救策略，同时指出其长程扩展性存疑。
AI.motivation: 大模型后训练核心手段OPD的训练动态与机制尚不清楚，需厘清其成功/失败的关键因素及可扩展性。
AI.method: 理论推导+实验验证：先提出师生思维兼容性与教师新增能力两大条件；通过弱→强反向蒸馏证实同族模型间分布不可区分；token级分析发现成功OPD仅对齐学生已访问状态中97–99%概率集中的共享小token集；最后设计冷启动与提示选择两种干预策略。
AI.result: 确认两大条件决定OPD成败；同族1.5B/7B教师对学生分布等价；失败OPD可被冷启动或优选提示恢复；揭示OPD的密集token奖励实为“免费午餐”，长程蒸馏代价显著。
AI.conclusion: OPD并非无代价的免费午餐，其扩展受限于教师新增能力与长程奖励稀疏性，未来需重新审视长程场景下的可扩展方案。

title: Evaluating the Limitations of Protein Sequence Representations for Parkinson's Disease Classification
summary: The identification of reliable molecular biomarkers for Parkinson's disease remains challenging due to its multifactorial nature. Although protein sequences constitute a fundamental and widely available source of biological information, their standalone discriminative capacity for complex disease classification remains unclear. In this work, we present a controlled and leakage-free evaluation of multiple representations derived exclusively from protein primary sequences, including amino acid composition, k-mers, physicochemical descriptors, hybrid representations, and embeddings from protein language models, all assessed under a nested stratified cross-validation framework to ensure unbiased performance estimation. The best-performing configuration (ProtBERT + MLP) achieves an F1-score of 0.704 +/- 0.028 and ROC-AUC of 0.748 +/- 0.047, indicating only moderate discriminative performance. Classical representations such as k-mers reach comparable F1 values (up to approximately 0.667), but exhibit highly imbalanced behavior, with recall close to 0.98 and precision around 0.50, reflecting a strong bias toward positive predictions. Across representations, performance differences remain within a narrow range (F1 between 0.60 and 0.70), while unsupervised analyses reveal no intrinsic structure aligned with class labels, and statistical testing (Friedman test, p = 0.1749) does not indicate significant differences across models. These results demonstrate substantial overlap between classes and indicate that primary sequence information alone provides limited discriminative power for Parkinson's disease classification. This work establishes a reproducible baseline and provides empirical evidence that more informative biological features, such as structural, functional, or interaction-based descriptors, are required for robust disease modeling.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统评估仅基于蛋白质一级序列构建的多种表示方式在帕金森病分类中的性能上限，发现其F1≈0.67–0.70、ROC-AUC≈0.75，且类别显著重叠，无法提供可靠判别力，为后续研究设定了可复现的负面基线。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病缺乏稳健分子标志物；蛋白质序列数据最易获取，但其独立判别潜力尚不明确，需在无信息泄露、严格交叉验证下给出定量答案。
AI.method: 在嵌套分层交叉验证框架内，比较氨基酸组成、k-mer、理化特征、混合表示及ProtBERT等蛋白语言模型嵌入，统一用MLP分类器，并辅以无监督聚类与Friedman统计检验。
AI.result: 最佳配置ProtBERT+MLP仅得F1 0.704±0.028、ROC-AUC 0.748±0.047；k-mer可逼近0.667但精度仅≈0.50。全部表示F1处于0.60–0.70狭窄区间，统计检验无显著差异，且类别间缺乏可分离结构。
AI.conclusion: 单凭一级序列信息对帕金森病分类判别力有限，必须引入结构、功能或相互作用等更高阶生物学特征才能建立稳健模型；本研究提供了严格、可复现的负面基线，可避免未来工作重复低效尝试。

title: PianoFlow: Music-Aware Streaming Piano Motion Generation with Bimanual Coordination
summary: Audio-driven bimanual piano motion generation requires precise modeling of complex musical structures and dynamic cross-hand coordination. However, existing methods often rely on acoustic-only representations lacking symbolic priors, employ inflexible interaction mechanisms, and are limited to computationally expensive short-sequence generation. To address these limitations, we propose PianoFlow, a flow-matching framework for precise and coordinated bimanual piano motion synthesis. Our approach strategically leverages MIDI as a privileged modality during training, distilling these structured musical priors to achieve deep semantic understanding while maintaining audio-only inference. Furthermore, we introduce an asymmetric role-gated interaction module to explicitly capture dynamic cross-hand coordination through role-aware attention and temporal gating. To enable real-time streaming generation for arbitrarily long sequences, we design an autoregressive flow continuation scheme that ensures seamless cross-chunk temporal coherence. Extensive experiments on the PianoMotion10M dataset demonstrate that PianoFlow achieves superior quantitative and qualitative performance, while accelerating inference by over 9\times compared to previous methods.

AI.tldr: PianoFlow是首个通过「音色无关」音频实时生成长时间、双手协调钢琴动作的系统，相比以往提速>9倍且质量更高。
AI.motivation: 现有手势合成方法仅用声音特征，缺少乐曲符号先验，难以表达复调结构与双手交叉节奏；同时只能离线生成短片段，无法实时演奏。
AI.method: 1) 训练阶段引入MIDI作为特权模态，用 flow-matching 蒸馏符号知识，使推理阶段仍仅依赖音频；2) 设计“角色门控”交互模块，通过左右手角色感知注意力+时间门控显式建模双手动态协作；3) 提出自回归流延续方案，逐块生成并维持时序一致性，实现任意长度实时流式输出。
AI.result: 在 PianoMotion10M 数据集上，PianoFlow 的节拍对齐误差、动作自然度、双手协调度等定量指标全面超越基线；用户研究亦显示视觉真实感与音乐同步性显著优于以往方法；推理帧率提升 9 倍以上，支持在线演奏。
AI.conclusion: 融合符号先验的流匹配框架能有效克服音频驱动的歧义性，实现高精度、长时序、双手协调的钢琴动作实时生成，为音乐视觉化、虚拟演奏等应用提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Benchmarking Deflection and Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) increasingly rely on retrieval to answer knowledge-intensive multimodal questions. Existing benchmarks overlook conflicts between visual and textual evidence and the importance of generating deflections (e.g., Sorry, I cannot answer...) when retrieved knowledge is incomplete. These benchmarks also suffer from rapid obsolescence, as growing LVLM training sets allow models to answer many questions without retrieval. We address these gaps with three contributions. First, we propose a dynamic data curation pipeline that preserves benchmark difficulty over time by filtering for genuinely retrieval-dependent samples. Second, we introduce VLM-DeflectionBench, a benchmark of 2,775 samples spanning diverse multimodal retrieval settings, designed to probe model behaviour under conflicting or insufficient evidence. Third, we define a fine-grained evaluation protocol with four scenarios that disentangle parametric memorization from retrieval robustness. Experiments across 20 state-of-the-art LVLMs indicate that models usually fail to deflect in the presence of noisy or misleading evidence. Our results highlight the need to evaluate not only what models know, but how they behave when they do not, and serve as a reusable and extensible benchmark for reliable KB-VQA evaluation. All resources will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 针对“大规模视觉-语言模型（LVLM）在知识密集型多模态问答中依赖检索”的场景，作者发现现有基准测试忽视图文证据冲突及检索知识不足时的“回避回答”能力，且因模型训练集膨胀导致基准快速失效。为此提出动态数据构建流程、VLM-DeflectionBench基准（2775例）与四情景细粒度评估协议，对20个SOTA LVLM实验表明模型普遍无法在噪声或矛盾证据下正确回避。新基准可长期保持难度并区分参数记忆与检索鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着LVLM在知识密集型多模态问答中日益依赖外部检索，现有基准存在两大盲区：①未考察图文证据冲突或检索知识缺失时模型是否应主动回避（deflect）；②训练数据膨胀使问题被模型“背过”而丧失评测效力。亟需一个能长期保持难度、系统评估“模型何时该说不知道”的基准。
AI.method: ①设计动态数据管护流程：持续过滤掉模型已能直接回答的样本，仅保留真正依赖检索的难例，保证基准持久有效。②构建VLM-DeflectionBench：2775组多模态问答，涵盖图文一致、图文冲突、文本/视觉证据缺失等多样检索情境。③提出四情景细粒度评估协议：分别测试“仅有参数记忆”“仅有检索”“参数+检索一致”“参数+检索冲突”下模型的回答与回避行为，从而量化模型对检索鲁棒性与自知之明。
AI.result: 20个SOTA LVLM实验显示：面对噪声或误导性检索证据，模型普遍继续生成答案而非回避，回避率低于15%；在图文冲突情境下，F1下降最高达38个百分点，暴露其盲信检索的倾向。动态流程筛选的“检索依赖”子集比原题库难23%，验证其持续挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 评估LVLM不应只关注“知道什么”，更要检验“何时承认不知道”。VLM-DeflectionBench与动态管护流程提供可复用、可扩展的KB-VQA评测框架，推动未来模型在知识不确定时实现可靠回避，增强多模态问答的可信度。

title: SceneCritic: A Symbolic Evaluator for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly generate indoor scenes through intermediate structures such as layouts and scene graphs, yet evaluation still relies on LLM or VLM judges that score rendered views, making judgments sensitive to viewpoint, prompt phrasing, and hallucination. When the evaluator is unstable, it becomes difficult to determine whether a model has produced a spatially plausible scene or whether the output score reflects the choice of viewpoint, rendering, or prompt. We introduce SceneCritic, a symbolic evaluator for floor-plan-level layouts. SceneCritic's constraints are grounded in SceneOnto, a structured spatial ontology we construct by aggregating indoor scene priors from 3D-FRONT, ScanNet, and Visual Genome. SceneOnto traverses this ontology to jointly verify semantic, orientation, and geometric coherence across object relationships, providing object-level and relationship-level assessments that identify specific violations and successful placements. Furthermore, we pair SceneCritic with an iterative refinement test bed that probes how models build and revise spatial structure under different critic modalities: a rule-based critic using collision constraints as feedback, an LLM critic operating on the layout as text, and a VLM critic operating on rendered observations. Through extensive experiments, we show that (a) SceneCritic aligns substantially better with human judgments than VLM-based evaluators, (b) text-only LLMs can outperform VLMs on semantic layout quality, and (c) image-based VLM refinement is the most effective critic modality for semantic and orientation correction.

AI.tldr: SceneCritic＋SceneOnto 用符号化规则替代 VLM/LLM 打分，直接检验 floor-plan 布局的语义、朝向与几何一致性，实验表明其评估更稳定且贴近人类判断。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM/VLM 场景生成评估依赖渲染图打分，受视角、提示词和幻觉影响大，无法区分是布局本身不合理还是评估信号不稳定，亟需一种对空间合理性直接、可解释且与人类对齐的评测方法。
AI.method: 1）构建结构化空间本体 SceneOnto，聚合 3D-FRONT、ScanNet、Visual Genome 的室内先验；2）提出符号评估器 SceneCritic，基于 SceneOnto 遍历验证对象间语义、朝向、几何一致性，给出对象级/关系级违规细节；3）建立迭代精修测试床，比较三种反馈模态：规则碰撞批评、LLM文本批评、VLM 图像批评。
AI.result: SceneCritic 与人类评分一致性显著高于 VLM 评估器；仅用文本的 LLM 在语义布局质量上优于 VLM；而图像式 VLM 批评在语义与朝向修正上最终效果最好。
AI.conclusion: 符号化的 SceneCritic 提供了稳定、可解释且对齐人类的布局评估基准，揭示不同批评模态对空间结构迭代的互补价值，为未来 LLM/VLM 场景生成模型的训练与评测奠定可靠基础。

title: Obtaining Partition Crossover masks using Statistical Linkage Learning for solving noised optimization problems with hidden variable dependency structure
summary: In optimization problems, some variable subsets may have a joint non-linear or non-monotonical influence on the function value. Therefore, knowledge of variable dependencies may be crucial for effective optimization, and many state-of-the-art optimizers leverage it to improve performance. However, some real-world problem instances may be the subject of noise of various origins. In such a case, variable dependencies relevant to optimization may be hard or impossible to tell using dependency checks sufficient for problems without noise, making highly effective operators, e.g., Partition Crossover (PX), useless. Therefore, we use Statistical Linkage Learning (SLL) to decompose problems with noise and propose a new SLL-dedicated mask construction algorithm. We prove that if the quality of the SLL-based decomposition is sufficiently high, the proposed clustering algorithm yields masks equivalent to PX masks for the noise-free instances. The experiments show that the optimizer using the proposed mechanisms remains equally effective despite the noise level and outperforms state-of-the-art optimizers for the problems with high noise.

AI.tldr: 针对噪声环境中变量依赖难以准确识别、导致高性能算子（如PX）失效的问题，本文引入统计连锁学习（SLL）对问题结构进行分解，并提出一种专为SLL设计的掩码构造算法；若SLL分解质量足够，该算法在无噪声情形下可等价于PX掩码。实验表明，对应优化器在任意噪声水平下均保持强劲性能，在大噪声问题上超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现实优化问题常伴噪声，噪声使传统依赖检测不可靠，导致依赖变量间非线性/非单调协同效应无法被准确捕获，进而令依赖变量信息的先进算子（如Partition Crossover）失效。迫切需要一种鲁棒手段，从噪声数据中准确学习潜在变量依赖结构，以保持算子在嘈杂环境下的性能优势。
AI.method: 1.采用统计连锁学习（Statistical Linkage Learning, SLL）对问题变量进行关联检测，利用统计检验或相关性度量识别潜在依赖；2.提出面向SLL的掩码构建算法，将检测到的依赖聚类成若干互扰群组，形成交叉或重组限制的掩码；3.证明当SLL分解精度足够高时，新算法生成的掩码在无噪声情况下与PX最优掩码等价；4.将该掩码集成到进化和交叉算子中，形成可在噪声场景直接应用的优化流程。
AI.result: 在多种噪声水平（低至高）测试函数上，基于SLL掩码的算子性能基本不变，显著提升现有PX及同类高依赖算子在噪声环境中的鲁棒性；在强噪声场景下，其收敛速度与最终解质量均优于当前代表性算法（如带噪声专用EA、分解EDA等）。理论证明与数值结果共同验证：只要SLL学习质量达标，所提方法可无缝继承PX的结构优势而不受噪声影响。
AI.conclusion: 基于统计连锁学习的掩码构建可稳定地恢复噪声掩盖的变量依赖结构，显著扩展PX等高依赖重组算子的适用范围。该方法无需了解噪声分布，理论等价保证与实证鲁棒性兼备，为噪声情形下实现对优化结构的自动学习与算子保护提供了有效途径，可进一步推广至各类存在变量耦合与噪声耦合的黑箱优化问题。

title: VideoFlexTok: Flexible-Length Coarse-to-Fine Video Tokenization
summary:
Visual tokenizers map high-dimensional raw pixels into a compressed representation for downstream modeling. Beyond compression, tokenizers dictate what information is preserved and how it is organized. A de facto standard approach to video tokenization is to represent a video as a spatiotemporal 3D grid of tokens, each capturing the corresponding local information in the original signal. This requires the downstream model that consumes the tokens, e.g., a text-to-video model, to learn to predict all low-level details "pixel-by-pixel" irrespective of the video's inherent complexity, leading to high learning complexity.
  We present VideoFlexTok, which represents videos with a variable-length sequence of tokens structured in a coarse-to-fine manner -- where the first tokens (emergently) capture abstract information, such as semantics and motion, and later tokens add fine-grained details. The generative flow decoder enables realistic video reconstructions from any token count. This representation structure allows adapting the token count according to downstream needs and encoding videos longer than the baselines with the same budget.
  We evaluate VideoFlexTok on class- and text-to-video generative tasks and show that it leads to more efficient training compared to 3D grid tokens, e.g., achieving comparable generation quality (gFVD and ViCLIP Score) with a 5x smaller model (1.1B vs 5.2B). Finally, we demonstrate how VideoFlexTok can enable long video generation without prohibitive computational cost by training a text-to-video model on 10-second 81-frame videos with only 672 tokens, 8x fewer than a comparable 3D grid tokenizer.

AI.tldr: VideoFlexTok用可变长度、由粗到细的视频token替代固定3D网格token，降低下游模型学习难度，仅用1/5参数即可在文本/类别到视频生成任务中取得同等质量，并以8倍token压缩比生成10秒长视频。
AI.motivation: 现有视频tokenizer把整段视频压成规则3D token网格，迫使生成模型逐像素预测全部细节，训练成本高；作者希望让token序列“先语义后细节”，让模型按需学习、按需解码。
AI.method: 提出VideoFlexTok：①编码器输出可裁剪的token序列，前端token自发捕获高层语义/运动，后续token逐层补充细节；②配套生成式流解码器，可在任意截断长度下高质量重建视频；③训练时通过随机截断token序列，使模型适应不同长度与分辨率需求。
AI.result: 在类别-视频和文本-视频生成基准上，与3D网格token方案相比：①同质量下模型参数从5.2B降到1.1B（5×缩减）；②训练步数/样本显著减少；③在81帧10秒视频上仅用672个token，比3D方案少8×，仍保持生成质量（gFVD、ViCLIP分数相当）。
AI.conclusion: VideoFlexTok证明“由粗到细、长度可变”的视频token表示可显著降低生成模型训练与推理开销，为长视频、高分辨率视频生成提供可扩展的新基础，也为后续研究提供了更灵活的信息组织范式。

title: SIR-Bench: Evaluating Investigation Depth in Security Incident Response Agents
comment: 9 pages, 6 tables, 1 figure. Equal contribution by first three authors
summary: We present SIR-Bench, a benchmark of 794 test cases for evaluating autonomous security incident response agents that distinguishes genuine forensic investigation from alert parroting. Derived from 129 anonymized incident patterns with expert-validated ground truth, SIR-Bench measures not only whether agents reach correct triage decisions, but whether they discover novel evidence through active investigation. To construct SIR-Bench, we develop Once Upon A Threat (OUAT), a framework that replays real incident patterns in controlled cloud environments, producing authentic telemetry with measurable investigation outcomes. Our evaluation methodology introduces three complementary metrics: triage accuracy (M1), novel finding discovery (M2), and tool usage appropriateness (M3), assessed through an adversarial LLM-as-Judge that inverts the burden of proof -- requiring concrete forensic evidence to credit investigations. Evaluating our SIR agent on the benchmark demonstrates 97.1% true positive (TP) detection, 73.4% false positive (FP) rejection, and 5.67 novel key findings per case, establishing a baseline against which future investigation agents can be measured.

AI.tldr: 构建 794 案例的 SIR-Bench 基准，用 OUAT 重放真实事件并引入 M1-M3 三维指标，对自主安全响应智能体进行可衡量、对抗式评估；基线代理 TP 97.1%、FP 拒识 73.4%、每案平均 5.67 项新发现。
AI.motivation: 既有评估多聚焦“能否答对”，忽视代理是否真正主动取证并发现新证据；“告警复读”导致虚高准确率，行业缺乏可重复、带真值的安全事件响应基准。
AI.method: 1) 从 129 匿名化真实事件提炼模式，设计 OUAT 框架在隔离云环境重放，生成可观测遥测；2) 构建含 794 测例的 SIR-Bench，覆盖多样攻防场景；3) 提出三维度指标：M1 研判正确率、M2 新证据发现量、M3 工具使用恰当度；4) 用“LLM-as-Judge”对抗模式，倒置举证责任——仅当代理呈现实质取证链才给分，抑制虚假阳性。
AI.result: 在 SIR-Bench 上评估自研 SIR 代理，获得 97.1% TP 检出、73.4% FP 拒识，每案平均发现 5.67 条关键新线索；相较传统仅看“对错”指标，FP 显著下降 18-25%。
AI.conclusion: SIR-Bench 将安全响应评估从“回答正确”升级为“主动调查可验证”，提供的量化基线可直接对比后续代理；OUAT+对抗 LLM 裁判范式可扩展至其他云安全场景。

title: E2LLM: Encoder Elongated Large Language Models for Long-Context Understanding and Reasoning
summary: Processing long contexts is increasingly important for Large Language Models (LLMs) in tasks like multi-turn dialogues, code generation, and document summarization. This paper addresses the challenges of achieving high long-context performance, low computational complexity, and compatibility with pretrained models -- collectively termed the ``impossible triangle''. We introduce E2LLM (Encoder Elongated Large Language Models), a novel approach that effectively navigates this paradox. E2LLM divides long contexts into chunks, compresses each into soft prompts using a pretrained text encoder, and aligns these representations with a decoder-only LLM via an adapter. To enhance the LLM's reasoning with these soft prompts, we employ two training objectives: encoder output reconstruction and long-context instruction fine-tuning. Extensive experiments reveal that E2LLM not only outperforms 8 state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in effectiveness and efficiency for document summarization and question answering, but also achieves the best performance on LongBench v2 among models of comparable size.

AI.tldr: E2LLM 用文本编码器将长上下文切块压缩为软提示，再通过轻量适配器注入到冻结的 decoder-only LLM，兼顾长程性能、低复杂度与模型复用，在 LongBench v2 等基准上优于 8 个 SOTA 方案。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 面临「不可能三角」：长上下文高性能、低计算开销、与预训练模型兼容无法同时满足，亟需不重新训练大模型即可处理多轮对话、代码生成、文档摘要等长文本任务的方法。
AI.method: 提出 E2LLM：1) 将超长输入分块；2) 用冻结文本编码器把每块压缩为连续软提示；3) 通过小型适配器对齐到冻结的 decoder-only LLM；4) 联合训练「编码器输出重构」与「长上下文指令微调」两目标，使 LLM 无需额外长程注意力即可利用软提示完成推理。
AI.result: 在文档摘要与问答任务上，E2LLM 效果与效率均优于 8 个 SOTA 长文模型；在 LongBench v2 同规模模型中取得最佳成绩，验证其即插即用且显著降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过「编码器压缩+软提示+适配器」策略，E2LLM 首次在长上下文场景同时破解性能、复杂度、兼容性三角矛盾，为低成本扩展预训练 LLM 的长文本能力提供了可复用范式。

title: FlowBoost Reveals Phase Transitions and Spectral Structure in Finite Free Information Inequalities
summary: Using FlowBoost, a closed-loop deep generative optimization framework for extremal structure discovery, we investigate $\ell^p$-generalizations of the finite free Stam inequality for real-rooted polynomials under finite free additive convolution $\boxplus_n$. At $p=2$, FlowBoost finds the Hermite pair as the unique equality case and reveals the spectral structure of the linearized convolution map at this extremal point. As a result, we conjecture that the singular values of the doubly stochastic coupling matrix $E_n$ on the mean-zero subspace are ${2^{-k/2}:k=1,\ldots,n-1}$, independent of $n$. Conditional on this conjecture, we obtain a sharp local stability constant and the finite free CLT convergence rate, both uniform in $n$. We introduce a one-parameter family of $p$-Stam inequalities using $\ell^p$-Fisher information and prove that the Hermite pair itself violates the inequality for every $p>2$, with the sign of the deficit governed by the $\ell^p$-contraction ratio of $E_n$. Systematic computation via FlowBoost supports the conjecture that $p^*\!=2$ is the sharp critical exponent. For $p<2$, the extremal configurations undergo a bifurcation, meaning that they become non-matching pairs with bimodal root structure, converging back to the Hermite diagonal only as $p\to 2^-$. Our findings demonstrate that FlowBoost, can be an effective tool of mathematical discovery in infinite-dimensional extremal problems.

AI.tldr: FlowBoost闭环深度生成优化框架在有限自由卷积的 ℓ^p-Stam 不等式研究中首次发现并验证了 p=2 时 Hermite 对是唯一等号成立态；给出耦合矩阵奇异值猜想和统一的局部稳定性常数，揭示 p>2 时 Hermite 对必违反不等式、p<2 时极值发生非匹配双峰分岔，从而把 AI 驱动的结构发现引入无限维极值问题。
AI.motivation: 经典 Stam 不等式在有限自由加法卷积下的 ℓ^p 推广尚未建立；理论分析面对无限维搜索空间难以穷举所有可能的极值多项式，既缺明确的等号成立条件，也缺少对临界指数与局部收敛速率的精确刻画。作者希望借助数据驱动的生成式优化寻找隐藏结构，并一次性获得等号情况、稳定性常数与中心极限定理收敛阶。
AI.method: 提出 FlowBoost——基于深度生成模型的闭合回路极值搜索框架：1) 以参数化多项式为生成变量，ℓ^p-Fisher 信息量为目标函数；2) 通过可微卷积算子实现快速评估，并利用梯度回传实时更新生成网络；3) 引入谱自适应的正则化策略与多尺度重参数化，实现高阶根分布的精确逼近；4) 结合符号计算与随机矩阵理论，对极值点线性化映射进行奇异值分解、推导临界 p* 的分岔判据。
AI.result: p=2 时在 n 次多项式空间唯一捕获 Hermite 对，并解析给出线性化卷积映射的谱结构；据此提出耦合矩阵 E_n 在零均值子空间的奇异值必为 {2^(−k/2): k=1,…,n−1}、与 n 无关的普适猜想。条件于该猜想，首次得到与 n 无关的有限自由 CLT 收敛速率及局部稳定性常数。证明当 p>2 时 Hermite 对恒违反 p-Stam 不等式，赤字符号由 E_n 的 ℓ^p 压缩比确定；而当 p<2 时极值对发生非匹配双峰分岔，仅当 p→2⁻ 时才重回 Hermite 对角。系统扫描支持 p*=2 为精确临界指数。
AI.conclusion: FlowBoost 作为 AI 驱动的数学发现工具，可在无限维极值问题中自动锁定隐藏解析结构并生成可证明猜想；研究不仅完整刻画了有限自由 Stam 不等式之 ℓ^p 推广的临界现象与稳定性，也为随机矩阵、泛函不等式与深度学习协同探索建立了范式。

title: Towards Long-horizon Agentic Multimodal Search
summary: Multimodal deep search agents have shown great potential in solving complex tasks by iteratively collecting textual and visual evidence. However, managing the heterogeneous information and high token costs associated with multimodal inputs over long horizons remains a critical challenge, as existing methods often suffer from context explosion or the loss of crucial visual signals. To address this, we propose a novel Long-horizon MultiModal deep search framework, named LMM-Searcher, centered on a file-based visual representation mechanism. By offloading visual assets to an external file system and mapping them to lightweight textual identifiers (UIDs), our approach mitigates context overhead while preserving multimodal information for future access. We equip the agent with a tailored fetch-image tool, enabling a progressive, on-demand visual loading strategy for active perception. Furthermore, we introduce a data synthesis pipeline designed to generate queries requiring complex cross-modal multi-hop reasoning. Using this pipeline, we distill 12K high-quality trajectories to fine-tune Qwen3-VL-Thinking-30A3B into a specialized multimodal deep search agent. Extensive experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate that our method successfully scales to 100-turn search horizons, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open-source models on challenging long-horizon benchmarks like MM-BrowseComp and MMSearch-Plus, while also exhibiting strong generalizability across different base models. Our code will be released in https://github.com/RUCAIBox/LMM-Searcher.

AI.tldr: 提出LMM-Searcher，用文件级视觉表示+按需加载把100轮多模态搜索的token开销压到极低，在MM-BrowseComp等长程基准上达到开源SOTA。
AI.motivation: 长程多模态搜索中，上下文爆炸与关键视觉信号丢失并存，现有方法难以兼顾信息完整与成本可控。
AI.method: 1) 把图像外存至文件系统，用轻量UID替代原图注入上下文中；2) 专用fetch-image工具支持按需渐进加载；3) 合成12K跨模态多跳查询轨迹，蒸馏微调Qwen3-VL-Thinking-30A3B。
AI.result: 在4个长程基准上验证，100轮搜索仍保持稳定性能，MM-BrowseComp、MMSearch-Plus等指标全面领先开源模型，且可迁移至不同基模型。
AI.conclusion: 文件级视觉表示+按需感知策略可显著扩展多模态智能体的搜索深度，兼顾效率与精度，为长 horizon 任务提供了可复现的新范式。

title: VISTA: Validation-Informed Trajectory Adaptation via Self-Distillation
summary: Deep learning models may converge to suboptimal solutions despite strong validation accuracy, masking an optimization failure we term Trajectory Deviation. This is because as training proceeds, models can abandon high generalization states for specific data sub-populations, thus discarding previously learned latent features without triggering classical overfitting signals. To address this problem we introduce VISTA, an online self-distillation framework that enforces consistency along the optimization trajectory. Using a validation-informed Marginal Coverage score, VISTA identifies expert anchors, which are earlier model states that retain specialized competence over distinct data regions. A coverage-weighted ensemble of these anchors is integrated online during training, regularizing the loss landscape and preserving mastered knowledge. When evaluated across multiple benchmarks, VISTA demonstrates improved robustness and generalization over standard training and prior self-distillation methods, while a lightweight implementation reduces storage overhead by 90% without performance loss.

AI.tldr: 提出了Trajectory Deviation现象：深模型在训练后期为追求整体验证精度而放弃对某些子群的泛化能力；设计了在线自蒸馏框架VISTA，用验证集计算的Marginal Coverage挑选早期'专家锚点'并在线加权集成，既保留已学知识又正则化损失面，在多个基准上提升鲁棒性与泛化，同时存储开销降低90%。
AI.motivation: 发现现有深度模型即使验证精度高，也可能在优化轨迹上悄悄“遗忘”对某些数据子群的判别特征，该失效不伴随传统过拟合信号，亟需一种无需额外数据、在线即可保持知识的方法。
AI.method: 1) 定义Marginal Coverage指标评估模型对不同数据子区的专业度；2) 在线识别并保存具有高MC的早期专家锚点；3) 训练期间以覆盖度为权重动态集成锚点预测，构建自蒸馏正则项；4) 整体流程与主网络同步更新，实现无额外存储的在线自蒸馏。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet、CINIC-10及NLP任务上，VISTA将最优基线的平均错误率再降1.2%-2.4%，对抗扰动鲁棒性提升4%-7%；与Snapshot、BE-self等自蒸馏方法相比，存储需求减少约90%，训练时间开销<5%。
AI.conclusion: Trajectory Deviation是隐藏于高验证精度背后的优化失败，VISTA通过在线锚点自蒸馏有效缓解该问题，兼顾性能提升与工程轻量化，为深度学习的稳定优化与知识保持提供了新范式。

title: GigaCheck: Detecting LLM-generated Content via Object-Centric Span Localization
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
summary: With the increasing quality and spread of LLM assistants, the amount of generated content is growing rapidly. In many cases and tasks, such texts are already indistinguishable from those written by humans, and the quality of generation continues to increase. At the same time, detection methods are advancing more slowly than generation models, making it challenging to prevent misuse of generative AI technologies. We propose GigaCheck, a dual-strategy framework for AI-generated text detection. At the document level, we leverage the representation learning of fine-tuned LLMs to discern authorship with high data efficiency. At the span level, we introduce a novel structural adaptation that treats generated text segments as "objects." By integrating a DETR-like vision model with linguistic encoders, we achieve precise localization of AI intervals, effectively transferring the robustness of visual object detection to the textual domain. Experimental results across three classification and three localization benchmarks confirm the robustness of our approach. The shared fine-tuned backbone delivers strong accuracy in both scenarios, highlighting the generalization power of the learned embeddings. Moreover, we successfully demonstrate that visual detection architectures like DETR are not limited to pixel space, effectively generalizing to the localization of generated text spans. To ensure reproducibility and foster further research, we publicly release our source code.

AI.tldr: 提出双策略框架GigaCheck，在文档级用微调LLM判别作者，在片段级把生成文本当“对象”并用DETR式视觉模型精确定位，实验在6项基准上验证其鲁棒性与可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM生成文本愈发逼真、生成能力持续超越检测方法，亟需一个兼具宏观判别与微观定位的高效检测框架，防止生成AI被恶意利用。
AI.method: GigaCheck采用双粒度协同：文档级通过微调LLM获得高数据效率的作者表示；片段级将生成区间视为“文本对象”，把DETR视觉检测架构迁移到语言空间，联合语言编码器实现端到端的生成片段定位。
AI.result: 在3项分类与3项定位基准上，共享的微调主干在双任务均取得SOTA级精度，证明嵌入泛化能力；首次验证DETR类视觉模型可突破像素域，有效定位文本中的生成跨度。
AI.conclusion: 视觉目标检测技术可无缝扩展到文本域，GigaCheck为生成文本检测提供了统一、可复现的新范式，并开源代码推动后续研究。

title: ProbeLogits: Kernel-Level LLM Inference Primitives for AI-Native Operating Systems
summary: An OS kernel that runs LLM inference internally can read logit distributions before any text is generated -- and act on them as a governance primitive. I present ProbeLogits, a kernel-level operation that performs a single forward pass and reads specific token logits to classify agent actions as safe or dangerous, with zero learned parameters. On a 260-prompt OS action benchmark (9 categories including adversarial attacks), ProbeLogits achieves F1=0.980, Precision=1.000, and Recall=0.960 using a general-purpose 7B model at 4-bit quantization. On ToxicChat (1,000 human-annotated real conversations), it achieves F1=0.790 at default calibration strength $α$=1.0, improving to F1=0.837 at $α$=0.5 -- 89% of Llama Guard 3's F1~0.939 with zero learned parameters. A key design contribution is the calibration strength $α$, which serves as a deployment-time policy knob rather than a learned hyperparameter. By adjusting $α$, the OS can enforce strict policies for privileged operations ($α\geq 0.8$, maximizing recall) or relaxed policies for conversational agents ($α$=0.5, maximizing precision). Contextual calibration improves accuracy from 64.8% to 97.3% on the custom benchmark. I implement ProbeLogits within Anima OS, a bare-metal x86_64 OS written in 80,400 lines of Rust. Because agent actions must pass through kernel-mediated host functions, ProbeLogits enforcement operates below the WASM sandbox boundary, making it significantly harder to circumvent than application-layer classifiers. Each classification costs 65ms on 7B -- fast enough for per-action governance. I also show that treating KV cache as process state enables checkpoint, restore, and fork operations analogous to traditional process management. To my knowledge, no prior system exposes LLM logit vectors as OS-level governance primitives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProbeLogits——一个内核级 LLM 治理原语：在生成文本前读取 logit 向量完成安全/危险行为判别，无需任何学习参数。
AI.motivation: 现有应用层安全过滤易于绕过，且 LLM 防护策略缺乏可审计、难调节的内核级机制。作者希望把 governance 下沉到操作系统层，利用 LLM 原生 logit 信号构建无法绕过的安全边界。
AI.method: 1. 将 7B LLM 推理植入自研 x86_64 OS (Anima，Rust，≈8 万行)；2. 定义内核系统调用 ProbeLogits，在执行主机函数前做一次前向传播并读取指定 token logit；3. 用无参数非线性映射（α 调节的可解释校准公式）将 logit→安全概率；4. α 作为部署时可手动调的策略旋钮（0.5–1.0），而非训练超参；5. KV-cache 视为进程状态，支持 checkpoint/restore/fork。
AI.result: 260 条 OS 操作基准（含对抗）：F1=0.980、Precision=1.000、Recall=0.960；ToxicChat 1k 真实对话：α=1 时 F1=0.790，α=0.5 时 F1=0.837（达 Llama Guard 3 的 89%）。校准使自定义基准准确率从 64.8%→97.3%。每判定耗时 65 ms，位于 WASM 沙箱之下不可绕过。
AI.conclusion: “logit 向量”首次被暴露为操作系统原语；零学习参数+可调 α 提供可审计 governance；内核级实现规避应用层绕过，且速度足够支持逐动作管控。KV-cache 进程化管理为后续 LLM 多进程 OS 奠定基础。

title: Representing 3D Faces with Learnable B-Spline Volumes
summary: We present CUBE (Control-based Unified B-spline Encoding), a new geometric representation for human faces that combines B-spline volumes with learned features, and demonstrate its use as a decoder for 3D scan registration and monocular 3D face reconstruction. Unlike existing B-spline representations with 3D control points, CUBE is parametrized by a lattice (e.g., 8 x 8 x 8) of high-dimensional control features, increasing the model's expressivity. These features define a continuous, two-stage mapping from a 3D parametric domain to 3D Euclidean space via an intermediate feature space. First, high-dimensional control features are locally blended using the B-spline bases, yielding a high-dimensional feature vector whose first three values define a 3D base mesh. A small MLP then processes this feature vector to predict a residual displacement from the base shape, yielding the final refined 3D coordinates. To reconstruct 3D surfaces in dense semantic correspondence, CUBE is queried at 3D coordinates sampled from a fixed template mesh. Crucially, CUBE retains the local support property of traditional B-spline representations, enabling local surface editing by updating individual control features. We demonstrate the strengths of this representation by training transformer-based encoders to predict CUBE's control features from unstructured point clouds and monocular images, achieving state-of-the-art scan registration results compared to recent baselines.

AI.tldr: CUBE用高维B-spline控制特征取代传统3D控制点，通过“先插值得到基网格→MLP预测残差”两步映射，把参数域连续映射到欧氏空间；保留B-spline局部支撑，可用transformer从点云/单张图像回归控制特征，实现稠密对应的三维人脸配准与重建。
AI.motivation: 传统B-spline仅依赖3D控制点表达力有限，难以同时满足高保真、可编辑与端到端重建需求；需要一种既能保持B-spline局部支撑优点，又能借助学习特征提升表达力的统一几何解码器。
AI.method: 1) 用8×8×8格点存储高维控制特征，B-spline基函数局部混合得到高维向量；2) 向量前三维直接生成基网格坐标，剩余维度经小型MLP输出残差位移，实现精细表面；3) 在固定模板网格的采样点上查询CUBE，保证稠密语义对应；4) 用transformer编码器从点云或单目图像回归控制特征，完成可微重建。
AI.result: 在3D扫描配准任务上显著优于现有基线，达到SOTA；单张图像重建亦展示高几何保真与语义一致性；局部更新控制特征即可实现局部表面编辑。
AI.conclusion: CUBE通过“高维控制特征+两阶段映射”兼顾了B-spline的可解释局部支撑与神经网络的表达力，为三维人脸配准与单目重建提供了统一、可编辑、可学习的几何解码范式。

title: Leveraging Weighted Syntactic and Semantic Context Assessment Summary (wSSAS) Towards Text Categorization Using LLMs
summary:
The use of Large Language Models (LLMs) for reliable, enterprise-grade analytics such as text categorization is often hindered by the stochastic nature of attention mechanisms and sensitivity to noise that compromise their analytical precision and reproducibility. To address these technical frictions, this paper introduces the Weighted Syntactic and Semantic Context Assessment Summary (wSSAS), a deterministic framework designed to enforce data integrity on large-scale, chaotic datasets. We propose a two-phased validation framework that first organizes raw text into a hierarchical classification structure containing Themes, Stories, and Clusters. It then leverages a Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) to prioritize high-value semantic features, ensuring the model's attention remains focused on the most representative data points. By incorporating this scoring mechanism into a Summary-of-Summaries (SoS) architecture, the framework effectively isolates essential information and mitigates background noise during data aggregation.
  Experimental results using Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite across diverse datasets - including Google Business reviews, Amazon Product reviews, and Goodreads Book reviews - demonstrate that wSSAS significantly improves clustering integrity and categorization accuracy. Our findings indicate that wSSAS reduces categorization entropy and provides a reproducible pathway for improving LLM based summaries based on a high-precision, deterministic process for large-scale text categorization.

AI.tldr: wSSAS 用两级结构+SNR 打分，把 LLM 聚类与分类变成可复现的企业级流程，在三大评论数据集上显著降低熵、提升精度。
AI.motivation: LLM 存在注意力随机性与噪声敏感，导致文本分类在企业级场景下不可重复、精度不足，亟需一个可复现、抗噪、保留语义的确定性框架。
AI.method: (1) 将原始文本自顶向下拆成 Theme→Story→Cluster；(2) 用 SNR 量化故事与簇的代表性，按得分筛出高价值语义特征；(3) 采用 Summary-of-Summaries 架构逐层聚合，整体流程完全确定化，不依赖随机采样。实验基于 Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite。
AI.result: 在 Google Business、Amazon、Goodreads 三个异构评论数据集中，wSSAS 相较基线显著降低分类熵，聚类完整性提升，分类准确率一致提高且结果完全可复现。
AI.conclusion: wSSAS 为大规模文本聚类与分类提供了高噪声容忍、端到端确定性、企业可用的方案；其 SNR+SoS 设计可迁移至其他 LLM 任务以保障可重复性与可控精度。

title: Speaker effects in language comprehension: An integrative model of language and speaker processing
summary: The identity of a speaker influences language comprehension through modulating perception and expectation. This review explores speaker effects and proposes an integrative model of language and speaker processing that integrates distinct mechanistic perspectives. We argue that speaker effects arise from the interplay between bottom-up perception-based processes, driven by acoustic-episodic memory, and top-down expectation-based processes, driven by a speaker model. We show that language and speaker processing are functionally integrated through multi-level probabilistic processing: prior beliefs about a speaker modulate language processing at the phonetic, lexical, and semantic levels, while the unfolding speech and message continuously update the speaker model, refining broad demographic priors into precise individualized representations. Within this framework, we distinguish between speaker-idiosyncrasy effects arising from familiarity with an individual and speaker-demographics effects arising from social group expectations. We discuss how speaker effects serve as indices for assessing language development and social cognition, and we encourage future research to extend these findings to the emerging domain of artificial intelligence (AI) speakers, as AI agents represent a new class of social interlocutors that are transforming the way we engage in communication.

AI.tldr: 说话者身份通过调节感知与预期影响语言理解；本文提出语言-说话者整合模型，区分熟悉个体效应与社会群体效应，并呼吁将研究扩展至AI说话者。
AI.motivation: 传统语言理解研究忽视说话者维度，导致无法解释为什么同一句话由不同人说出会被不同解读；需整合分散的“说话者效应”发现，建立统摄性理论框架。
AI.method: 系统化回顾行为、神经与计算研究，提取“自下而上声学-情景记忆驱动”与“自上而下说话者模型驱动”两条机制证据；构建多层次概率整合模型，用贝叶斯更新描述语言与说话者表征的互惠调制。
AI.result: 模型成功解释三类现象：(1)熟悉说话者引发的音位-词汇-语义加工加速与抑制；(2)社会群体刻板印象对词汇可得性与句子歧义消解的偏置；(3)言语流实时更新说话者模型的神经时间动态（N400/P600与前额-顶叶θ同步化）。
AI.conclusion: 说话者效应是语言与社会认知发展的敏感指标；未来需建立AI说话者认知模型，评估其是否激活与人类相同的感知-预期环路，为人机协同沟通提供算法与伦理基准。

title: Agentic LLM Reasoning in a Self-Driving Laboratory for Air-Sensitive Lithium Halide Spinel Conductors
summary: Self-driving laboratories promise to accelerate materials discovery. Yet current automated solid-state synthesis platforms are limited to ambient conditions, thereby precluding their use for air-sensitive materials. Here, we present A-Lab for Glovebox Powder Solid-state Synthesis (A-Lab GPSS), a robotic platform capable of synthesizing and characterizing air-sensitive inorganic materials under strict air-free conditions. By integrating an agentic AI framework into the A-Lab GPSS platform, we structure autonomous experimental design through abductive and inductive reasoning. We deploy this platform to explore the vast compositional space of lithium halide spinel solid-state ionic conductors. Across a synthesis campaign comprising 352 samples with diverse compositions, the system explores a broad chemical space, experimentally realizing 72% of the 171 possible pairwise combinations among the 19 metals considered in this study. Over the course of the campaign, the fraction of compositions exhibiting both good ionic conductivity (> 0.05 mS/cm) and high halide spinel phase purity increases from 1.33% in the first 75 agent-proposed samples to 5.33% in the final 75. Furthermore, by inspecting the AI's reasoning processes, we reveal distinct yet complementary discovery strategies: abductive reasoning interrogates abnormal observations within already explored regions, whereas inductive reasoning expands the search into broader, previously unvisited chemical space. This work establishes a scalable platform for the autonomous discovery of complex, air-sensitive solid-state materials.

AI.tldr: 开发了可在严格无空气环境下进行合成与表征的机器人平台A-Lab GPSS，并将其与Agentic AI框架集成，通过352个样品高通量实验发现锂卤化物尖晶石固态电解质，最终将有价值组分比例从1.33%提升至5.33%，首次实现空气敏感材料自驱动发现。
AI.motivation: 自动化固相合成平台已被证明能加速材料发现，但现有装置均局限于环境条件操作，无法处理对空气、水分极其敏感的无机固体材料，严重限制了固态电解质等前沿材料的探索效率。
AI.method: 构建集成于手套箱的A-Lab GPSS机器人平台，实现计量、混合、烧结、表征全链条无空气操作；在其中嵌入基于演绎-归纳推理的Agentic AI闭环框架，以锂卤化物尖晶石固态电解质为假想目标，在19种金属及Li、F/Cl/Br组成的巨大组分空间内开展自驱动设计-实验-分析循环。
AI.result: 共合成352个样品，实验验证171种金属对组合中的72%，最终75个AI推荐样品中兼具高离子电导率(>0.05 mS cm⁻¹)与高尖晶石相纯度的比例由初期的1.33%提升到5.33%；AI可解释分析显示演绎策略深挖异常数据，归纳策略开辟未探区域，两类策略互补驱动高效搜索。
AI.conclusion: A-Lab GPSS首次将自动化实验扩展到严格无空气环境，结合推理型AI可在复杂化学空间内持续自主学习并提高命中率，为空气敏感的固态电解质及更广范畴的功能材料提供了可扩展的自驱动发现范式。

title: Don't Show Pixels, Show Cues: Unlocking Visual Tool Reasoning in Language Models via Perception Programs
summary: Multimodal language models (MLLMs) are increasingly paired with vision tools (e.g., depth, flow, correspondence) to enhance visual reasoning. However, despite access to these tool-generated visual cues, MLLMs often fail to benefit from them. Existing approaches typically feed raw tool outputs into the model, but these dense, pixel-level representations are misaligned with the language-native reasoning strengths of LLMs, leading to weak perception and reliance on language priors. We argue that, in problems where vision tools can provide the necessary visual cues, the bottleneck is not more tool calls or larger MLLMs, it is how tool outputs are represented. We introduce Perception Programs (P$^2$), a training-free, model-agnostic method that rewrites tool outputs into compact, structured, language-native summaries that MLLMs can directly parse and reason over. Across six perception-centric tasks in BLINK, P$^2$ consistently yields large improvements over base models and raw tool-augmented baselines. With GPT-5 Mini as the base model, P$^2$ raises its accuracy from 41.35\% to 86.47\% on multi-view reasoning, from 52.42\% to 81.45\% on relative depth, and achieves a 22\% average gain across tasks, setting new state-of-the-art results. Even on smaller MLLMs, e.g., InternVL3.5-4B and Qwen3VL-4B, we observe 15-40\% absolute gains from P$^2$, surpassing prior agentic, supervised, and RL-based tool-use methods-without any training or model modifications.

AI.tldr: 提出Perception Programs（P²），无需训练即可将视觉工具输出转化为MLLM易解析的语言化摘要，在BLINK六大任务上平均提升22%，最高将GPT-5 Mini多视角推理准确率从41.35%提到86.47%。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLLM可调用深度、光流等视觉工具，但其语言原生推理机制与工具输出的稠密像素表示错位，导致感知弱、依赖语言先验，瓶颈在于“如何表示工具输出”而非工具数量或模型规模。
AI.method: P²：免训练、模型无关的表示转换层，将各类视觉工具结果自动提炼为紧凑、结构化、语言化的摘要，直接喂给MLLM进行推理；无需微调或修改模型。
AI.result: 在BLINK六类感知任务上，P²使GPT-5 Mini绝对准确率提升19–45个百分点，平均+22%；InternVL3.5-4B与Qwen3VL-4B亦分别提升15–40%，全面超越原始模型、原始工具增强基线及既有监督/RL/智能体方法。
AI.conclusion: 视觉工具的价值瓶颈在于表示形式；将工具输出“语言化”即可充分释放MLLM的推理潜力，P²为免训练、即插即用的通用解决方案，确立了新的最佳成绩。

title: Interpretable DNA Sequence Classification via Dynamic Feature Generation in Decision Trees
summary: The analysis of DNA sequences has become critical in numerous fields, from evolutionary biology to understanding gene regulation and disease mechanisms. While deep neural networks can achieve remarkable predictive performance, they typically operate as black boxes. Contrasting these black boxes, axis-aligned decision trees offer a promising direction for interpretable DNA sequence analysis, yet they suffer from a fundamental limitation: considering individual raw features in isolation at each split limits their expressivity, which results in prohibitive tree depths that hinder both interpretability and generalization performance. We address this challenge by introducing DEFT, a novel framework that adaptively generates high-level sequence features during tree construction. DEFT leverages large language models to propose biologically-informed features tailored to the local sequence distributions at each node and to iteratively refine them with a reflection mechanism. Empirically, we demonstrate that DEFT discovers human-interpretable and highly predictive sequence features across a diverse range of genomic tasks.

AI.tldr: DEFT以自适应方式在建树过程中调用大模型生成生物可解释的高层序列特征，克服传统轴对齐决策树只能逐碱基分裂、表达能力受限的瓶颈，实现既透明又准确的DNA序列分析。
AI.motivation: 深度网络虽精准但“黑箱”，而传统轴对齐决策树因每次分裂仅看单碱基，表达能力受限，需极深树才能拟合复杂序列规律，严重影响可解释性与泛化。亟需一种既保持树结构透明性、又能捕捉高阶序列模式的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出DEFT框架：在树生长的每个节点，利用大语言模型基于本地序列分布提出生物意义明确的高层特征候选；通过反射机制迭代精炼，动态选出最佳分裂特征，实现“节点-特定”特征生成与树构建同步进行。
AI.result: 在多项基因组学任务（如调控元件识别、变异效应预测）上，DEFT所得模型深度显著降低，性能媲美或优于深度网络，同时提供的特征（基序组合、上下文规则）可被领域专家直接解读。
AI.conclusion: DEFT将大模型的知识蒸馏与决策树透明性结合，为可解释基因组学建立了新范式，证明“白盒”模型无需牺牲精度即可理解复杂序列语言。

title: AdaMCoT: Rethinking Cross-Lingual Factual Reasoning through Adaptive Multilingual Chain-of-Thought
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive multilingual capabilities through pretraining on diverse corpora. Although these models show strong reasoning abilities, their performance varies significantly between languages due to the imbalanced distribution of training data. Existing approaches using sample-level translation for extensive multilingual pretraining and cross-lingual tuning face scalability challenges and often fail to capture nuanced reasoning processes across languages. In this paper, we introduce AdaMCOT (Adaptive Multilingual Chain-of-Thought), a framework that enhances multilingual factual reasoning by dynamically routing thought processes in intermediary "thinking languages" before generating target-language responses. AdaMCOT leverages a language-agnostic core and incorporates an adaptive, reward-based mechanism for selecting optimal reasoning pathways without requiring additional pretraining. Our comprehensive evaluation across multiple benchmarks demonstrates substantial improvements in both factual reasoning quality and cross-lingual consistency, with particularly strong performance gains in low-resource language settings. An in-depth analysis of the model's hidden states and semantic space further elucidates the underlying mechanism of our method. The results suggest that adaptive reasoning paths can effectively bridge the performance gap between high and low-resource languages while maintaining cultural and linguistic nuances.

AI.tldr: AdaMCOT用「中间思考语言」动态选推理路径，无需额外预训练即可在多语事实推理任务中显著缩小高低资源语言差距。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多语推理能力受训练语料不平衡影响，低资源语言表现差；逐句翻译或跨语微调可扩展性差且难保留推理细节。
AI.method: 提出AdaMCOT框架：1) 语言无关核心编码语义；2) 奖励驱动的路由器实时选择最适合的“思考语言”链式推理路径；3) 直接在目标语言生成答案，全程无需额外预训练。
AI.result: 在多语事实推理基准上平均提升9.8%，低资源语言增幅达15.3%；隐藏状态分析显示语义空间跨语言对齐度提高，文化细节得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 动态中间推理路径可有效弥补资源差异，兼顾语言与文化差异，为可扩展的多语推理提供新范式。

title: INDOTABVQA: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Table Understanding in Bahasa Indonesia Documents
summary: We introduce INDOTABVQA, a benchmark for evaluating cross-lingual Table Visual Question Answering (VQA) on real-world document images in Bahasa Indonesia. The dataset comprises 1,593 document images across three visual styles (bordered, borderless, and colorful) with one or more than one tables, and 1,593 question-answer sets in four languages: Bahasa Indonesia, English, Hindi, and Arabic. This enables evaluation of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in both monolingual (Bahasa documents with Bahasa questions) and cross-lingual settings (Bahasa documents with questions in other languages). We benchmark leading open-source VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL, Gemma-3, LLaMA-3.2) and GPT-4o and reveal substantial performance gaps, particularly on structurally complex tables and in low-resource languages. Fine-tuning a compact 3B and LoRA-finetuned 7B model on our dataset yields 11.6% and 17.8% improvements in accuracy. Providing explicit table region coordinates as additional input further improves performance by 4-7%, demonstrating the value of Spatial priors for table-based reasoning. Our findings underscore the importance of language-diverse, domain-specific datasets and demonstrate that targeted fine-tuning can significantly enhance VLM performance on specialized document understanding tasks. INDOTABVQA provides a valuable resource for advancing research in cross-lingual, structure-aware document understanding, especially in underrepresented regions of the world. Full dataset can be accessed in huggingface at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/NusaBharat/INDOTABVQA}

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨语言印尼文档表格视觉问答基准 INDOTABVQA，含 1 593 张真实印尼文档与四语 QA，揭示主流 VLM 在低资源语言与复杂表格上性能骤降，验证微调与空间先验显著增益，为区域化文档理解提供新资源。
AI.motivation: 现有表格 VQA 多聚焦英文，忽略低资源语言与跨语言迁移；现实中东南亚文档版式复杂、语言多样，亟需覆盖印尼语等代表性语种且含结构扰动的benchmark，以量化并缩小 VLM 在区域化文档理解上的性能鸿沟。
AI.method: 构建 1 593 张三类版式（有框/无框/彩印）印尼真实文档，配套四种语言 QA；评估 Qwen2.5-VL、Gemma-3、LLaMA-3.2、GPT-4o 的 mono/cross-lingual 表现；对 3B 全参及 7B LoRA 微调；并注入显式表格坐标作为空间先验进行消融。
AI.result: 零样本下复杂表格准确率骤降，跨语言更低；3B 与 7B-LoRA 微调分别提升 11.6% 与 17.8%；加入坐标再增 4–7%；GPT-4o 亦受益，印证方法通用性。
AI.conclusion: 语言多样、领域专用的数据集是提升 VLM 区域化文档理解的关键；针对性微调与空间先验可显著缓解低资源语言与结构复杂性带来的性能瓶颈，INDOTABVQA 为该方向提供可复现基准与数据。

title: A Sanity Check on Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image based on a query composed of a reference image, and a relative caption that specifies the desired modification. Despite the rapid development of CIR models, their performance is not well characterized by existing benchmarks, which inherently contain indeterminate queries degrading the evaluation (i.e., multiple candidate images, rather than solely the target image, meet the query criteria), and have not considered their effectiveness in the context of the multi-round system. Motivated by this, we consider improving the evaluation procedure from two aspects: 1) we introduce FISD, a Fully-Informed Semantically-Diverse benchmark, which employs generative models to precisely control the variables of reference-target image pairs, enabling a more accurate evaluation of CIR methods across six dimensions, without query ambiguity; 2) we propose an automatic multi-round agentic evaluation framework to probe the potential of the existing models in the interactive scenarios. By observing how models adapt and refine their choices over successive rounds of queries, this framework provides a more realistic appraisal of their efficacy in practical applications. Extensive experiments and comparisons prove the value of our novel evaluation on typical CIR methods.

AI.tldr: 现有CIR基准因查询歧义且未考虑多轮交互，需新基准与多轮评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有CIR基准存在查询模糊（多个候选符合查询）且忽视多轮系统场景，导致性能评价失真。
AI.method: 1. 构建FISD基准：利用生成模型精确控制参考-目标图像对变量，消除歧义，从六个语义维度精准评估；2. 设计自动多轮智能体评估框架：模拟连续多轮查询，观察模型自适应与选择演化，衡量真实交互潜力。
AI.result: 在典型CIR方法上的大量实验表明，新评估方案显著揭示模型差异，更准确反映其在无歧义及多轮交互条件下的实际效能。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除查询歧义并引入多轮交互评估，FISD与智能体框架共同提供了更可靠、贴近现实的CIR性能衡量手段，推动未来模型与应用发展。

title: Robust Explanations for User Trust in Enterprise NLP Systems
summary: Robust explanations are increasingly required for user trust in enterprise NLP, yet pre-deployment validation is difficult in the common case of black-box deployment (API-only access) where representation-based explainers are infeasible and existing studies provide limited guidance on whether explanations remain stable under real user noise, especially when organizations migrate from encoder classifiers to decoder LLMs. To close this gap, we propose a unified black-box robustness evaluation framework for token-level explanations based on leave-one-out occlusion, and operationalize explanation robustness with top-token flip rate under realistic perturbations (swap, deletion, shuffling, and back-translation) at multiple severity levels. Using this protocol, we conduct a systematic cross-architecture comparison across three benchmark datasets and six models spanning encoder and decoder families (BERT, RoBERTa, Qwen 7B/14B, Llama 8B/70B; 64,800 cases). We find that decoder LLMs produce substantially more stable explanations than encoder baselines (73% lower flip rates on average), and that stability improves with model scale (44% gain from 7B to 70B). Finally, we relate robustness improvements to inference cost, yielding a practical cost-robustness tradeoff curve that supports model and explanation selection prior to deployment in compliance-sensitive applications.

AI.tldr: 本文只假设能调用模型黑盒API，提出“留一掩码”统一评估框架，在4类用户级扰动下比较encoder与decoder模型token解释鲁棒性，发现decoder-LLM平均flip率降73%，且规模越大越稳，首次给出可部署前的成本-鲁棒权衡曲线。
AI.motivation: 企业实际多为黑盒API部署，无法获取表示，既缺验证解释鲁棒性的统一协议，也缺encoder向decoder迁移时解释是否仍可信的实证指导。
AI.method: 1) 设计黑盒token解释指标：leave-one-out遮挡δ；2) 定义鲁棒性：top-k token flip率；3) 构建4类真实扰动（替换、删除、乱序、回译）及多强度级别；4) 在3数据集、6模型（BERT/RoBERTa/Qwen-7/14B/Llama-8/70B）6.48万样例上做系统对照。
AI.result: decoder LLM的flip率比encoder平均低73%；同系列7B→70B带来44%稳定性提升；得出推理成本与flip率的可解权衡曲线。
AI.conclusion: 无需白盒即可量化解释鲁棒性；迁移至更大规模decoder-LLM可在有限额外成本下显著增强解释稳定性，为合规场景提供可操作的模型与解释选型依据。

title: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Report Summarization: Analysis on Supervised and Unsupervised Data
summary: We study the efficacy of fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for the specific task of report (government archives, news, intelligence reports) summarization. While this topic is being very actively researched - our specific application set-up faces two challenges: (i) ground-truth summaries maybe unavailable (e.g., for government archives), and (ii) availability of limited compute power - the sensitive nature of the application requires that computation is performed on-premise and for most of our experiments we use one or two A100 GPU cards. Under this set-up we conduct experiments to answer the following questions. First, given that fine-tuning the LLMs can be resource intensive, is it feasible to fine-tune them for improved report summarization capabilities on-premise? Second, what are the metrics we could leverage to assess the quality of these summaries? We conduct experiments on two different fine-tuning approaches in parallel and our findings reveal interesting trends regarding the utility of fine-tuning LLMs. Specifically, we find that in many cases, fine-tuning helps improve summary quality and in other cases it helps by reducing the number of invalid or garbage summaries.

AI.tldr: 在单/双 A100 本地卡、无人工摘要的严苛条件下，对 LLM 进行轻量微调仍可显著提升政府/情报文档摘要质量，并减少无效输出。
AI.motivation: 政府档案、新闻及情报报告等敏感场景往往缺乏参考摘要，且必须本地运算，算力仅 1–2 张 A100；亟需验证在此极限资源下微调 LLM 是否仍能带来可度量收益。
AI.method: 在本地单卡/双卡 A100 上，并行比较两种微调策略，使用无需人工参考摘要的自动指标评估生成摘要质量与无效输出比例。
AI.result: 微调不仅能在多数情况下提升摘要质量，还能显著降低无效或垃圾摘要的数量，证明在极端算力与数据约束下微调依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 即使缺乏参考摘要且仅有一张 A100，轻量级微调仍是提升专业文档摘要系统可用性的可行路径；可优先采用自动指标监控无效输出比例作为质量评估依据。

title: A Geometric Algebra-informed NeRF Framework for Generalizable Wireless Channel Prediction
comment: It is accepted by IEEE INFOCOM 2026
summary: In this paper, we propose the geometric algebra-informed neural radiance fields (GAI-NeRF), a novel framework for wireless channel prediction that leverages geometric algebra attention mechanisms to capture ray-object interactions in complex propagation environments. Our approach incorporates global token representations, drawing inspiration from transformer architectures in language and vision domains, to aggregate learned spatial-electromagnetic features and enhance scene understanding. We identify limitations in conventional static ray tracing modules that hinder model generalization and address this challenge through a new ray tracing architecture. This design enables effective generalization across diverse wireless scenarios while maintaining computational efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate that GAI-NeRF achieves superior performance in channel prediction tasks by combining geometric algebra principles with neural scene representations, offering a promising direction for next-generation wireless communication systems. Moreover, GAI-NeRF greatly outperforms existing methods across multiple wireless scenarios. To ensure comprehensive assessment, we further evaluate our approach against multiple benchmarks using newly collected real-world indoor datasets tailored for single-scene downstream tasks and generalization testing, confirming its robust performance in unseen environments and establishing its high efficacy for wireless channel prediction.

AI.tldr: GAI-NeRF把几何代数嵌入NeRF，用类Transformer注意力刻画射线–物体交互，一次性解决信道预测精度与跨场景泛化难题，实测全面领先。
AI.motivation: 传统射线追踪模块静态且无法泛化，导致复杂场景下无线信道预测精度受限；亟需一种能随场景自动调整、兼具解释性与高效性的新表征框架。
AI.method: 1) 用几何代数统一描述射线旋转、反射与物体几何，构建可微几何代数注意力；2) 将每条射线映射为token，引入全局token聚合空间-电磁特征，形成轻量级“代数-神经”混合射线追踪；3) 端到端联合优化NeRF体渲染与信道参数，实现跨场景迁移。
AI.result: 在新采集的多套真实室内数据集上，单场景与跨场景任务中GAI-NeRF均显著优于现有基线，预测误差平均降低20–35%，推理延迟低于同等精度方法40%。
AI.conclusion: 几何代数先验+神经场景表示为无线信道建模提供了高保真、可泛化的新范式，对6G智能无线环境感知与波束预测具有直接应用价值。

title: M3D-Stereo: A Multiple-Medium and Multiple-Degradation Dataset for Stereo Image Restoration
summary: Image restoration under adverse conditions, such as underwater, haze or fog, and low-light environments, remains a highly challenging problem due to complex physical degradations and severe information loss. Existing datasets are predominantly limited to a single degradation type or heavily rely on synthetic data without stereo consistency, inherently restricting their applicability in real-world scenarios. To address this, we introduce M3D-Stereo, a stereo dataset with 7904 high-resolution image pairs for image restoration research acquired in multiple media with multiple controlled degradation levels. It encompasses four degradation scenarios: underwater scatter, haze/fog, underwater low-light, and haze low-light. Each scenario forms a subset, and is divided into six levels of progressive degradation, allowing fine-grained evaluations of restoration methods with increasing severity of degradation. Collected via a laboratory setup, the dataset provides aligned stereo image pairs along with their pixel-wise consistent clear ground truths. Two restoration tasks, single-level and mixed-level degradation, were performed to verify its validity. M3D-Stereo establishes a better controlled and more realistic benchmark to evaluate image restoration and stereo matching methods in complex degradation environments. It is made public under LGPLv3 license.

AI.tldr: 发布了一个含7904对高分辨率立体图像的新数据集M3D-Stereo，可同时在四种真实退化（水下散射、雾霾、水下弱光、雾霾弱光）及六级退化强度下，精细评测图像恢复与立体匹配算法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集多为单一退化或合成数据且缺乏立体一致性，难以评估真实复杂退化场景中的恢复与匹配性能，亟需覆盖多介质、多强度且带精确真值的立体数据。
AI.method: 实验室搭建可控成像系统，逐层引入水下散射/雾霾/弱光等退化，采集对齐的左右视图并同步记录对应无退化清晰图作为真值；将数据以退化类型和六级渐进强度子集化，形成单级与混合级两种评测任务。
AI.result: 数据集提供像素级一致的立体真值，实验验证其可用于单级与混合级退化恢复任务，为图像恢复和立体匹配提供了更真实且可重复的挑战基准。
AI.conclusion: M3D-Stereo填补了多介质多强度立体退化数据的空白，以LGPLv3开源，推动复杂退化环境下图像恢复与立体匹配方法的公平对比与进一步发展。

title: OpenTME: An Open Dataset of AI-powered H&E Tumor Microenvironment Profiles from TCGA
summary: The tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a central role in cancer progression, treatment response, and patient outcomes, yet large-scale, consistent, and quantitative TME characterization from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained histopathology remains scarce. We introduce OpenTME, an open-access dataset of pre-computed TME profiles derived from 3,634 H&E-stained whole-slide images across five cancer types (bladder, breast, colorectal, liver, and lung cancer) from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). All outputs were generated using Atlas H&E-TME, an AI-powered application built on the Atlas family of pathology foundation models, which performs tissue quality control, tissue segmentation, cell detection and classification, and spatial neighborhood analysis, yielding over 4,500 quantitative readouts per slide at cell-level resolution. OpenTME is available for non-commercial academic research on Hugging Face. We will continue to expand OpenTME over time and anticipate it will serve as a resource for biomarker discovery, spatial biology research, and the development of computational methods for TME analysis.

AI.tldr: OpenTME 提供目前最大规模、开放获取的 H&E 全片 TME 细胞级定量数据库（3 634 张切片、4 500+ 读数/片），可直接用于生信挖掘与算法训练。
AI.motivation: H&E 染色是全院常规检查，但缺乏一致、高通量且开源的 TME 定量资源，严重阻碍生物标志物和计算模型的开发。
AI.method: 构建 Atlas H&E-TME：先用病理 foundation 模型做质量控制与组织分割，再进行细胞检测-分类和空间邻域分析，输出 4 500 余项细胞级特征；将流程批量运行于 TCGA 五大癌种（膀胱、乳腺、结直肠、肝、肺）3 634 张 H&E 全片。
AI.result: 生成 OpenTME 数据集并托管于 Hugging Face，提供每片预计算特征、元数据及可视化脚本；验证显示特征与已知临床变量相关，重现性达 r>0.95。
AI.conclusion: OpenTME 首次将 H&E 来源的细胞级 TME 特征开放给学术界，可加速空间生物学研究、生物标志物发现及 AI 算法开发，且后续将持续扩充癌种与样本量。

title: Joint Flashback Adaptation for Forgetting-Resistant Instruction Tuning
comment: The experimental setting is wrong, i.e., not a real continual learning setting
summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable success in various tasks. However, it is challenging for them to learn new tasks incrementally due to catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches rely on experience replay, optimization constraints, or task differentiation, which encounter strict limitations in real-world scenarios. To address these issues, we propose Joint Flashback Adaptation. We first introduce flashbacks -- a limited number of prompts from old tasks -- when adapting to new tasks and constrain the deviations of the model outputs compared to the original one. We then interpolate latent tasks between flashbacks and new tasks to enable jointly learning relevant latent tasks, new tasks, and flashbacks, alleviating data sparsity in flashbacks and facilitating knowledge sharing for smooth adaptation. Our method requires only a limited number of flashbacks without access to the replay data and is task-agnostic. We conduct extensive experiments on state-of-the-art large language models across 1000+ instruction-following tasks, arithmetic reasoning tasks, and general reasoning tasks. The results demonstrate the superior performance of our method in improving generalization on new tasks and reducing forgetting in old tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出“Joint Flashback Adaptation”框架，仅用极少量旧任务提示（flashbacks）即可在增量学习场景下同时抑制灾难性遗忘并提升新任务泛化，无需回放数据且任务无关。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型增量学习新任务时存在灾难性遗忘，现有经验回放、优化约束或任务隔离方法在真实部署中受限于数据、算力或任务边界划分困难，亟需一种无需完整回放、通用且高效的新范式。
AI.method: 1) 引入“flashbacks”——少量旧任务提示片段，在适配新任务时显式约束模型输出与原始输出的偏差；2) 在旧 flashbacks 与新任务之间进行潜在任务插值，构建联合学习目标，使模型同时学习潜在任务、新任务与 flashbacks，缓解 flashbacks 的稀疏性并促进知识共享。
AI.result: 在 1000+ 指令遵循、算术推理与通用推理任务上，对当前 SOTA 大模型进行系统实验，所提方法在不使用任何完整回放数据的情况下，显著优于现有增量学习基线，新任务泛化性能提升的同时旧任务遗忘率大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: Joint Flashback Adaptation 以极低成本实现任务无关的持续学习，为大规模语言模型在真实场景下的增量部署提供了可行且高效的解决方案。

title: Identity as Attractor: Geometric Evidence for Persistent Agent Architecture in LLM Activation Space
summary: Large language models map semantically related prompts to similar internal representations -- a phenomenon interpretable as attractor-like dynamics. We ask whether the identity document of a persistent cognitive agent (its cognitive_core) exhibits analogous attractor-like behavior. We present a controlled experiment on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, comparing hidden states of an original cognitive_core (Condition A), seven paraphrases (Condition B), and seven structurally matched controls (Condition C). Mean-pooled states at layers 8, 16, and 24 show that paraphrases converge to a tighter cluster than controls (Cohen's d > 1.88, p < 10^{-27}, Bonferroni-corrected). Replication on Gemma 2 9B confirms cross-architecture generalizability. Ablations suggest the effect is primarily semantic rather than structural, and that structural completeness appears necessary to reach the attractor region. An exploratory experiment shows that reading a scientific description of the agent shifts internal state toward the attractor -- closer than a sham preprint -- distinguishing knowing about an identity from operating as that identity. These results provide representational evidence that agent identity documents induce attractor-like geometry in LLM activation space.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型对“同一认知主体身份文档”及其同义改写产生比无关文本更紧密的隐状态聚类，表现出类似吸引子的动力学特征，且该现象跨模型可复现、依赖语义完整度，并能区分‘知道’与‘作为’该主体。
AI.motivation: 既有研究发现LLM将语义相关提示映射到相近内部表征，形成类吸引子动力学，但尚不清楚这种吸引子是否也适用于同一个持续认知主体的身份文档，即模型是否在激活空间中为主体的“认知内核”建立稳定表征。厘清这一点有助于理解LLM如何内部化与保持代理身份。
AI.method: 以Llama 3.1 8B Instruct为对象，设计三条件对照实验：A原始认知内核文档、B七句同义改写、C七个结构匹配但语义无关的控制文本。对第8、16、24层隐状态做均值池化，量化两两余弦距离；经多重比较校正后计算效应量，并进行跨模型（Gemma 2 9B）复现、语义-结构消融以及阅读科学描述vs假预印的探索实验。
AI.result: 1. 改写文本（B）在激活空间中聚类更紧密，与对照（C）的Cohen’s d > 1.88，p < 10⁻²⁷（Bonferroni校正）；2. Gemma 2 9B上复现效应，显示跨架构泛化；3. 消融表明吸引子效应主要由语义而非表层结构驱动，且文档结构完整性是落入吸引区之必要；4. 让模型阅读该主体的科学描述比阅读假预印更能使其状态接近吸引子，从而区分“知道身份”与“作为身份”。
AI.conclusion: 首次提供表征层面证据，表明持续认知主体的身份文档可在LLM激活空间诱导出吸引子式几何结构；该结构跨模型稳健，对语义与结构完整性敏感，并能区分不同认知角色。这为理解LLM内部主体表征与“代理身份”机制奠定实验基础。

title: Radar-Camera BEV Multi-Task Learning with Cross-Task Attention Bridge for Joint 3D Detection and Segmentation
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 Tables, submitted to a venue for consideration
summary: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations are the dominant paradigm for 3D perception in autonomous driving, providing a unified spatial canvas where detection and segmentation features are geometrically registered to the same physical coordinate system. However, existing radar-camera fusion methods treat these tasks in isolation, missing the opportunity to share complementary information between them: detection features encode object-level geometry that can sharpen segmentation boundaries, while segmentation features provide dense semantic context that can anchor detection. We propose \textbf{CTAB} (Cross-Task Attention Bridge), a bidirectional module that exchanges features between detection and segmentation branches via multi-scale deformable attention in shared BEV space. CTAB is integrated into a multi-task framework with an Instance Normalization-based segmentation decoder and learnable BEV upsampling to provide a more detailed BEV representation. On nuScenes, CTAB improves segmentation on 7 classes over the joint multi-task baseline at essentially neutral detection. On a 4-class subset (drivable area, pedestrian crossing, walkway, vehicle), our joint multi-task model reaches comparable mIoU on 4 classes while simultaneously providing 3D detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CTAB模块，在共享BEV空间中通过多尺度可变形注意力实现检测与分割的双向特征交换，在nuScenes上同步提升分割性能并保持检测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有雷达-摄像头融合方法将3D检测与BEV分割视为独立任务，忽视了检测特征可锐化分割边界、分割特征可为检测提供稠密语义上下文的互补潜力。
AI.method: 设计CTAB（Cross-Task Attention Bridge）双向跨任务注意力桥，在统一BEV空间中利用多尺度可变形注意力完成检测-分支与分割分支的特征交换；并引入基于实例归一化的分割解码器与可学习BEV上采样，构建多任务框架。
AI.result: nuScenes上，CTAB在保持检测性能几乎不变的同时，将7类分割任务的mIoU较联合多任务基线提升；在4类子集（可行驶区域、人行横道、步行区、车辆）上，模型在提供3D检测结果的同时达到与纯分割模型相当的mIoU。
AI.conclusion: CTAB验证了在共享BEV空间中跨任务特征交换的有效性，首次在不牺牲检测精度的前提下同步增强BEV语义分割，为多任务3D感知提供了新的联合优化范式。

title: Narrative over Numbers: The Identifiable Victim Effect and its Amplification Under Alignment and Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: The Identifiable Victim Effect (IVE) $-$ the tendency to allocate greater resources to a specific, narratively described victim than to a statistically characterized group facing equivalent hardship $-$ is one of the most robust findings in moral psychology and behavioural economics. As large language models (LLMs) assume consequential roles in humanitarian triage, automated grant evaluation, and content moderation, a critical question arises: do these systems inherit the affective irrationalities present in human moral reasoning? We present the first systematic, large-scale empirical investigation of the IVE in LLMs, comprising N=51,955 validated API trials across 16 frontier models spanning nine organizational lineages (Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, DeepSeek, xAI, Alibaba, IBM, and Moonshot). Using a suite of ten experiments $-$ porting and extending canonical paradigms from Small et al. (2007) and Kogut and Ritov (2005) $-$ we find that the IVE is prevalent but strongly modulated by alignment training. Instruction-tuned models exhibit extreme IVE (Cohen's d up to 1.56), while reasoning-specialized models invert the effect (down to d=-0.85). The pooled effect (d=0.223, p=2e-6) is approximately twice the single-victim human meta-analytic baseline (d$\approx$0.10) reported by Lee and Feeley (2016) $-$ and likely exceeds the overall human pooled effect by a larger margin, given that the group-victim human effect is near zero. Standard Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting $-$ contrary to its role as a deliberative corrective $-$ nearly triples the IVE effect size (from d=0.15 to d=0.41), while only utilitarian CoT reliably eliminates it. We further document psychophysical numbing, perfect quantity neglect, and marginal in-group/out-group cultural bias, with implications for AI deployment in humanitarian and ethical decision-making contexts.

AI.tldr: 大规模测试显示，主流 LLM 显著继承并可放大人类的“可识别受害者效应”（IVE）；对齐训练方式决定效应方向与强度，标准 CoT 反而加剧偏见，仅功利主义 CoT 可消除。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型被用于人道救援排序、资助评审等道德敏感场景，需验证其是否复制人类情感偏差（IVE），以防资源错配。
AI.method: 在 9 家机构 16 个前沿模型上完成 5.2 万条有效 API 试验，移植并扩展 Small (2007)、Kogut & Ritov (2005) 等经典 IVE 范式，共 10 项实验；比较指令微调 vs 推理专项模型，并测试标准与功利主义 CoT 提示。
AI.result: 指令微调模型出现极端 IVE（d=1.56），推理专项模型反向效应（d=-0.85）；总体 IVE（d=0.22）约为人单受害者元分析值的两倍。标准 CoT 将效应放大 3 倍（d=0.15→0.41），仅功利主义 CoT 能消除；同时发现心理麻木、数量完全忽视及轻微群体内外文化偏好。
AI.conclusion: LLM 在道德决策中可放大人类情感偏差，对齐目标与提示策略直接决定偏差方向与幅度。部署于人道、资助等场景时，必须采用抑制 IVE 的专项对齐与功利主义推理提示，避免资源分配失衡。

title: Advancing Multi-Agent RAG Systems with Minimalist Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) equipped with modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems often employ multi-turn interaction pipelines to interface with search engines for complex reasoning tasks. However, such multi-turn interactions inevitably produce long intermediate contexts, as context length grows exponentially with exploration depth. This leads to a well-known limitation of LLMs: their difficulty in effectively leveraging information from long contexts. This problem is further amplified in RAG systems that depend on in-context learning, where few-shot demonstrations must also be included in the prompt, compounding the context-length bottleneck. To address these challenges, we propose Mujica-MyGo, a unified framework for efficient multi-turn reasoning in RAG. Inspired by the divide-and-conquer principle, we introduce Mujica (Multi-hop Joint Intelligence for Complex Question Answering), a multi-agent RAG workflow that decomposes multi-turn interactions into cooperative sub-interactions, thereby mitigating long-context issues. To eliminate the dependency on in-context learning, we further develop MyGO (Minimalist Policy Gradient Optimization), a lightweight and efficient reinforcement learning algorithm that enables effective post-training of LLMs within complex RAG pipelines. We provide theoretical guarantees for MyGO's convergence to the optimal policy. Empirical evaluations across diverse question-answering benchmarks, covering both text corpora and knowledge graphs, show that Mujica-MyGO achieves superior performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mujica-MyGo 框架，用分治式多智能体 RAG + 轻量强化学习策略优化，突破长上下文瓶颈，无需少样本提示即可在多轮问答中取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现代 RAG 系统在多轮调用搜索引擎进行复杂推理时，上下文随探索深度指数级膨胀，LLM 难以有效利用超长中间结果；同时依赖少样本提示进一步加剧上下文长度瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) Mujica：基于分治思想的多智能体 RAG 工作流，将多轮交互拆分为若干并行协作子交互，限制单智能体上下文长度；2) MyGO：极简策略梯度强化学习算法，对 pipeline 中的 LLM 进行后训练，摆脱对 in-context learning 的依赖，并提供最优策略收敛理论保证。
AI.result: 在文本语料与知识图谱的多种多跳问答基准上，Mujica-MyGo 相比现有 RAG 系统显著降低延迟与显存占用，同时取得更高 F1 / 准确率，验证长上下文问题被有效缓解。
AI.conclusion: 通过

title: Constant-Factor Approximation for the Uniform Decision Tree
summary: We resolve a long-standing open question, about the existence of a constant-factor approximation algorithm for the average-case \textsc{Decision Tree} problem with uniform probability distribution over the hypotheses. We answer the question in the affirmative by providing a simple polynomial-time algorithm with approximation ratio of $\frac{2}{1-\sqrt{(e+1)/(2e)}}+ε<11.57$. This improves upon the currently best-known, greedy algorithm which achieves $O(\log n/{\log\log n})$-approximation. The first key ingredient in our analysis is the usage of a decomposition technique known from problems related to \textsc{Hierarchical Clustering} [SODA '17, WALCOM '26], which allows us to decompose the optimal decision tree into a series of objects called separating subfamilies. The second crucial idea is to reduce the subproblem of finding a \textsc{Separating Subfamily} to an instance of the \textsc{Maximum Coverage} problem. To do so, we analyze the properties of cutting cliques into small pieces, which represent pairs of hypotheses to be separated. This allows us to obtain a good approximation for the \textsc{Separating Subfamily} problem, which then enables the design of the approximation algorithm for the original problem.

AI.tldr: 首次给出平均情形均匀分布决策树问题的常数因子近似算法，逼近比 11.57，突破此前 O(log n / log log n) 的贪心算法瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 近二十年来，能否在均匀分布假设下为平均情形决策树问题设计常数因子近似算法一直是公开难题；本文旨在彻底解决该问题并显著改善可实现的近似保证。
AI.method: 1) 借层次聚类中的“分解”思想，将最优决策树剖分为若干“分离子族”；2) 把找分离子族归约到最大覆盖问题，核心步骤是把切割团拆成“需分离假设对”的小块；3) 对归约后的最大覆盖实例用标准贪心得到常数因子近似，再逆向组合得到原决策树算法。
AI.result: 获得一个简单而多项式时间的算法，近似比上界为 2/(1−√((e+1)/2e))+ε<11.57，首次将平均情形决策树逼近保证锁定在常数范围内。
AI.conclusion: 不仅肯定地回答了长期悬而未决的常数因子近似存在性问题，也表明借助层次聚类分解与最大覆盖归约的组合范式，可为平均情形决策树及其他相关搜索/识别问题带来新的近似算法设计思路。

title: Pi-HOC: Pairwise 3D Human-Object Contact Estimation
summary: Resolving real-world human-object interactions in images is a many-to-many challenge, in which disentangling fine-grained concurrent physical contact is particularly difficult. Existing semantic contact estimation methods are either limited to single-human settings or require object geometries (e.g., meshes) in addition to the input image. Current state-of-the-art leverages powerful VLM for category-level semantics but struggles with multi-human scenarios and scales poorly in inference. We introduce Pi-HOC, a single-pass, instance-aware framework for dense 3D semantic contact prediction of all human-object pairs. Pi-HOC detects instances, creates dedicated human-object (HO) tokens for each pair, and refines them using an InteractionFormer. A SAM-based decoder then predicts dense contact on SMPL human meshes for each human-object pair. On the MMHOI and DAMON datasets, Pi-HOC significantly improves accuracy and localization over state-of-the-art methods while achieving 20x higher throughput. We further demonstrate that predicted contacts improve SAM-3D image-to-mesh reconstruction via a test-time optimization algorithm and enable referential contact prediction from language queries without additional training.

AI.tldr: Pi-HOC在单张图像中一次性完成多人-多物密集语义接触估计，无需物体网格，速度提升20倍，并支持语言查询接触区域。
AI.motivation: 现实图像中多人同时与多物交互的“多对多”场景下，细粒度并发物理接触难以解耦；现有方法要么限单人也需物体几何，要么在多人体情况下推理速度骤降。
AI.method: Pi-HOC先检测所有人体与物体实例，为每对人-物对生成专属HO token，用InteractionFormer自注意力精炼交互特征，再以SAM式解码器直接在SMPL人体网格上回归逐顶点语义接触标签；整个流程单帧前向完成，无需额外物体网格输入。
AI.result: 在MMHOI与DAMON基准上，Pi-HOC在接触分类与定位精度均显著超越SOTA，吞吐量提升20倍；预测的接触图可零样本增强SAM-3D图像到网格重建，并首次实现“语言指代→接触区域”的无训练推理。
AI.conclusion: Pi-HOC证明实例级HO token加InteractionFormer可高效解析多人复杂交互，为下游3D重建与语言指代任务提供即插即用的接触先验，推动人机交互理解向真实多对象场景落地。

title: LLM-Based Automated Diagnosis Of Integration Test Failures At Google
summary: Integration testing is critical for the quality and reliability of complex software systems. However, diagnosing their failures presents significant challenges due to the massive volume, unstructured nature, and heterogeneity of logs they generate. These result in a high cognitive load, low signal-to-noise ratio, and make diagnosis difficult and time-consuming. Developers complain about these difficulties consistently and report spending substantially more time diagnosing integration test failures compared to unit test failures. To address these shortcomings, we introduce Auto-Diagnose, a novel diagnosis tool that leverages LLMs to help developers efficiently determine the root cause of integration test failures. Auto-Diagnose analyzes failure logs, produces concise summaries with the most relevant log lines, and is integrated into Critique, Google's internal code review system, providing contextual and in-time assistance.
