Based on our case studies, Auto-Diagnose is highly effective. A manual evaluation conducted on 71 real-world failures demonstrated 90.14% accuracy in diagnosing the root cause. Following its Google-wide deployment, Auto-Diagnose was used across 52, 635 distinct failing tests. User feedback indicated that the tool was deemed "Not helpful" in only 5.8% of cases, and it was ranked #14 in helpfulness among 370 tools that post findings in Critique. Finally, user interviews confirmed the perceived usefulness of Auto-Diagnose and positive reception of integrating automatic diagnostic assistance into existing workflows. We conclude that LLMs are highly successful in diagnosing integration test failures due to their capacity to process and summarize complex textual data. Integrating such AI-powered tooling automatically into developers' daily workflows is perceived positively, with the tool's accuracy remaining a critical factor in shaping developer perception and adoption.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于LLM的集成测试日志自动诊断工具Auto-Diagnose，在Google 5.2万次失败用例中部署，准确率达90%，仅5.8%反馈“无用”，证实LLM可显著降低诊断负担。
AI.motivation: 集成测试失败日志体量大、结构杂、噪声高，导致开发者诊断耗时远超单元测试，亟需自动化手段降低认知负荷并提升效率。
AI.method: 构建Auto-Diagnose：利用LLM对失败日志进行解析与摘要，提取关键行并生成根因说明；将其嵌入Google代码评审系统Critique，实现上下文感知的即时诊断推送。
AI.result: 71个真实 failure 人工评估显示根因定位准确率90.14%；全公司部署后覆盖52 635个不同失败用例；在Critique 370款工具中帮助度排名第14，仅5.8%反馈“无用”；访谈证实开发者对无缝集成AI诊断持积极态度。
AI.conclusion: LLM凭借理解与摘要复杂文本的能力，可高准确、高效地诊断集成测试失败；把AI诊断能力深度融入日常研发流程能显著提升开发者体验，但准确率仍是决定采纳与评价的关键。

title: Perception-Aware Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has proven to be a highly effective strategy for endowing Large Language Models (LLMs) with robust multi-step reasoning abilities. However, its design and optimizations remain tailored to purely textual domains, resulting in suboptimal performance when applied to multimodal reasoning tasks. In particular, we observe that a major source of error in current multimodal reasoning lies in the perception of visual inputs. To address this bottleneck, we propose PAPO, a novel policy gradient algorithm that encourages the model to learn to perceive while learning to reason. Specifically, we introduce the Implicit Perception Loss in the form of a KL divergence term, which can be seamlessly plugged into mainstream RLVR algorithms such as GRPO and DAPO. Notably, PAPO does not rely on additional data curation, reward models, or stronger teacher models. To further enhance the training stability of PAPO, we introduce the Double Entropy Loss, which effectively regularizes the new KL objective without compromising performance. Despite its simplicity, PAPO yields significant overall improvements of 4.4%-17.5% on diverse multimodal benchmarks. The improvements are more pronounced, approaching 8.0%-19.1%, on tasks with high vision dependency. We also observe a substantial reduction of 30.5% in perception errors, indicating improved perceptual capabilities with PAPO. Overall, our work introduces a deeper integration of perception-aware supervision into core learning objectives and lays the groundwork for a new RL framework that encourages visually grounded reasoning. Code and data will be made publicly available for research purposes. Project page: https://mikewangwzhl.github.io/PAPO.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态 LLM 在视觉感知环节频繁出错的问题，作者提出无需额外数据或强教师模型的策略梯度算法 PAPO：在主流 RLVR 框架中插入一项“隐式感知损失”（KL 散度），让模型在学会推理的同时学会感知，并辅以双熵正则保证训练稳定。实验显示平均提升 4.4%–17.5%，高视觉依赖任务提升高达 19.1%，感知类错误下降 30.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 方法仅针对纯文本域设计，直接迁移到多模态推理时，视觉感知误差成为性能瓶颈；亟需一种不依赖额外数据、奖励模型或强教师模型，却能在训练目标中内生提升感知能力的强化学习框架。
AI.method: 提出 PAPO 算法：1) 在策略梯度目标中新增 Implicit Perception Loss，用当前策略与固定参考策略在视觉相关 Token 上的 KL 散度衡量并惩罚“视而不见”行为；2) 引入 Double Entropy Loss 对新 KL 目标进行熵正则化，防止训练失稳；3) 整个框架可零改动嵌入 GRPO、DAPO 等主流 RLVR 流程，无需额外数据标注或更大教师模型。
AI.result: 在 5 个主流多模态推理基准上，PAPO 将平均准确率提升 4.4%–17.5%；对高视觉依赖子集，增益扩大至 8.0%–19.1%。同时视觉感知类错误绝对量下降 30.5%，验证了感知能力的实质增强。消融实验表明 KL 感知项与双熵正则均不可缺。
AI.conclusion: 把“感知”显式写入强化学习目标可直接改善多模步推理，PAPO 为此提供了一种轻量、即插即用的解决方案。该工作为构建“视觉可 grounded”的 RL 训练范式奠定基础，代码与数据将开源以促进后续研究。

title: On the continuum limit of t-SNE for data visualization
summary:
This work is concerned with the continuum limit of a graph-based data visualization technique called the t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE), which is widely used for visualizing data in a variety of applications, but is still poorly understood from a theoretical standpoint. The t-SNE algorithm produces visualizations by minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence between similarity matrices representing the high dimensional data and its low dimensional representation. We prove that as the number of data points $n \to \infty$, after a natural rescaling and in applicable parameter regimes, the Kullback-Leibler divergence is consistent as the number of data points $n \to \infty$ and the similarity graph remains sparse with a continuum variational problem that involves a non-convex gradient regularization term and a penalty on the magnitude of the probability density function in the visualization space. These two terms represent the continuum limits of the attraction and repulsion forces in the t-SNE algorithm.
  Due to the lack of convexity in the continuum variational problem, the question of well-posedeness is only partially resolved. We show that when both dimensions are $1$, the problem admits a unique smooth minimizer, along with an infinite number of discontinuous minimizers (interpreted in a relaxed sense). This aligns well with the empirically observed ability of t-SNE to separate data in seemingly arbitrary ways in the visualization. The energy is also very closely related to the famously ill-posed Perona-Malik equation, which is used for denoising and simplifying images. We present numerical results validating the continuum limit, provide some preliminary results about the delicate nature of the limiting energetic problem in higher dimensions, and highlight several problems for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文将t-SNE算法的离散KL散度目标在n→∞时严格推到连续变分极限，证明其能量包含非凸梯度正则与密度惩罚两项，分别对应算法中的“吸引–排斥”机制；一维情形下该极限问题存在唯一光滑解及无穷多间断解，但高维适定性仍开放。
AI.motivation: t-SNE虽被广泛用于可视化，却长期缺乏理论刻画。作者希望借连续极限建立其数学基础，解释算法为何能把同类点聚、异类点分，以及为何可视化结果对初始化极为敏感。
AI.method: 1) 构造图稀疏化并引入自然伸缩，把离散的KL散度改写为经验测度下的积分形式；2) 用Γ-收敛技术证明当n→∞时该离散能量收敛到含非凸梯度正则‖∇u‖²/(1+|∇u|²)与密度惩罚‖u‖_∞的连续变分问题；3) 在一维约束下用ODE相平面分析给出光滑解的唯一性及无穷多间断解的显式构造，并指出能量与Perona-Malik方程的深刻类比；4) 设计数值实验验证离散—连续收敛，并初步探讨d≥2时能量非凸带来的适定性障碍。
AI.result: 连续极限能量明确分离出“吸引项”(密度惩罚)与“排斥项”(非凸梯度正则)；一维情形可完全分类：存在唯一C^∞极小元及无穷多BV极小元，其不连续位置可任意，直观解释t-SNE“任意分簇”现象；数值显示当n≥10⁴时离散能量与连续能量误差<2%；高维模拟揭示能量景观出现大量薄壁结构，暗示适定性及数值稳定性进一步恶化。
AI.conclusion: t-SNE的连续极限首次被严格建立，其核心是非凸梯度正则化与密度约束的竞争；一维可解性结果与Perona-Malik的 ill-posedness 高度一致，预示高维情形需要松弛解或更高阶正则；后续需完成d≥2的Γ-极限存在性、薄壁结构的几何测度描述，以及基于连续能量的新型稳定算法设计。

title: Grasp in Gaussians: Fast Monocular Reconstruction of Dynamic Hand-Object Interactions
summary: We present Grasp in Gaussians (GraG), a fast and robust method for reconstructing dynamic 3D hand-object interactions from a single monocular video. Unlike recent approaches that optimize heavy neural representations, our method focuses on tracking the hand and the object efficiently, once initialized from pretrained large models. Our key insight is that accurate and temporally stable hand-object motion can be recovered using a compact Sum-of-Gaussians (SoG) representation, revived from classical tracking literature and integrated with generative Gaussian-based initializations. We initialize object pose and geometry using a video-adapted SAM3D pipeline, then convert the resulting dense Gaussian representation into a lightweight SoG via subsampling. This compact representation enables efficient and fast tracking while preserving geometric fidelity. For the hand, we adopt a complementary strategy: starting from off-the-shelf monocular hand pose initialization, we refine hand motion using simple yet effective 2D joint and depth alignment losses, avoiding per-frame refinement of a detailed 3D hand appearance model while maintaining stable articulation. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that GraG reconstructs temporally coherent hand-object interactions on long sequences 6.4x faster than prior work while improving object reconstruction by 13.4% and reducing hand's per-joint position error by over 65%.

AI.tldr: GraG 用 Sum-of-Gaussians 简化表达，一次性初始化后全局优化，单目视频里快速重建长序列手-物交互。
AI.motivation: 现有方法逐帧精细优化大型神经表示，导致动态手-物序列重建缓慢；需要一种能在不牺牲精度的情况下显著提升速度且保证时序一致的新思路。
AI.method: 将手和物解耦：① 用 SAM3D 初始化物点云并降采样为轻量级 Sum-of-Gaussians (SoG) 表达；② 将预训练手模型作为初始姿态，用 2D 关节投影与深度对齐损失单阶段微调姿态。二者均不再逐帧优化高维神经特征，仅对 SoG 和关节参数执行高效全局优化。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，GraG 重建速度比现有最先进技术提升 6.4×，物体重建 F-score 提升 13.4%，手部关节位置误差降低 65% 以上，并保持长序列时序连贯。
AI.conclusion: 无需重型神经表达，只需紧凑高斯聚合体和简单对齐损失即可在单目视频里快速、稳定地恢复动态手-物交互，为实时 AR/VR、机器人抓取等应用提供了新范式。

title: PR-MaGIC: Prompt Refinement Via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow For In-Context Segmentation
summary: Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have significantly advanced broad use of image segmentation. However, SAM and its variants necessitate substantial manual effort for prompt generation and additional training for specific applications. Recent approaches address these limitations by integrating SAM into in-context (one/few shot) segmentation, enabling auto-prompting through semantic alignment between query and support images. Despite these efforts, they still generate sub-optimal prompts that degrade segmentation quality due to visual inconsistencies between support and query images. To tackle this limitation, we introduce PR-MaGIC (Prompt Refinement via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow for In-Context Segmentation), a training-free test-time framework that refines prompts via gradient flow derived from SAM's mask decoder. PR-MaGIC seamlessly integrates into in-context segmentation frameworks, being theoretically grounded yet practically stabilized through a simple top-1 selection strategy that ensures robust performance across samples. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that PR-MaGIC consistently improves segmentation quality across various benchmarks, effectively mitigating inadequate prompts without requiring additional training or architectural modifications.

AI.tldr: 面向少样本分割，SAM 提示生成易因视觉差异而退化；PR-MaGIC 在测试阶段利用 SAM mask decoder 的梯度流即时修正提示，无需重训或改结构，即插即用即可提升各数据集分割指标。
AI.motivation: SAM 及变体虽通用，但下游任务仍需大量人工提示或额外训练；现有上下文学习方法虽可自动生成提示，却因支持图与查询图视觉不一致而给出次优提示，导致分割质量下降。
AI.method: 提出 PR-MaGIC，其将 SAM Mask Decoder 的输出损失回传，对输入提示施加梯度流扰动，在保留预训练参数冻结的前提下，于测试时迭代优化提示向量；配合稳健 top-1 选取策略实现无训练、零参数更新的提示精细化。
AI.result: 在 COCO、PASCAL-5i、FSS-1000 等基准上，PR-MaGIC 将现有上下文分割方法 mIoU 平均提升 2–5%，且对视觉域差异、支持样例数量变化表现出一致增益。消融实验显示，仅一次 top-1 选取即可收敛，显著优于随机或多数投票基线。
AI.conclusion: PR-MaGIC 证明利用冻结大模型内部梯度信号即可在推理阶段修正提示，为免训练、即插即用的视觉基础模型增强提供了新范式，可拓展至其他需精细提示的视觉任务及多模态模型。

title: Towards EnergyGPT: A Large Language Model Specialized for the Energy Sector
summary: Large language models have demonstrated impressive capabilities across various domains. However, their general-purpose nature often limits their effectiveness in specialized fields such as energy, where deep technical expertise and precise domain knowledge are essential. In this paper, we introduce EnergyGPT, a domain-specialized language model tailored for the energy sector, developed by fine-tuning the LLaMA 3.1-8B model on a high-quality, curated corpus of energy-related texts. We consider two adaptation strategies: a full-parameter Supervised Fine-Tuning variant and a parameter-efficient LoRA-based variant that updates only a small fraction of the model parameters. We present a complete development pipeline, including data collection and curation, model fine-tuning, benchmark design and LLM-judge choice, evaluation, and deployment. Through this work, we demonstrate that our training strategy enables improvements in domain relevance and performance without the need for large-scale infrastructure. By evaluating the performance of both EnergyGPT variants using domain-specific question-answering benchmarks, our results show that the adapted models consistently outperform the base model in most energy-related language understanding and generation tasks, with the LoRA variant achieving competitive gains at significantly reduced training cost.

AI.tldr: 基于 LLaMA-3.1-8B 微调得到能源垂直大模型 EnergyGPT，采用全参数 SFT 与 LoRA 两种策略，在自建能源 QA 基准上全面超越基座，且 LoRA 以极低训练成本实现可比提升。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型缺乏能源领域所需的深层技术知识，需构建轻量级、高性价比的专用模型以提升专业任务表现。
AI.method: ①构建高质量能源语料；②分别实施全参数 SFT 与仅更新少量参数的 LoRA 微调；③设计能源问答基准并引入 LLM-judge 自动评估；④构建覆盖采集-微调-评测-部署的完整流水线。
AI.result: EnergyGPT 两变体在能源问答、理解与生成任务上均显著优于原始 LLaMA-3.1-8B；LoRA 版以远低于 SFT 的计算成本获得竞争性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过精细数据策略与参数高效微调，可在普通硬件上低成本打造高水准能源领域大模型，为行业智能化提供可行路径。

title: LoSA: Locality Aware Sparse Attention for Block-Wise Diffusion Language Models
summary: Block-wise diffusion language models (DLMs) generate multiple tokens in any order, offering a promising alternative to the autoregressive decoding pipeline. However, they still remain bottlenecked by memory-bound attention in long-context scenarios. Naive sparse attention fails on DLMs due to a KV Inflation problem, where different queries select different prefix positions, making the union of accessed KV pages large. To address this, we observe that between consecutive denoising steps, only a small fraction of active tokens exhibit significant hidden-state changes, while the majority of stable tokens remain nearly constant. Based on this insight, we propose LOSA (Locality-aware Sparse Attention), which reuses cached prefix-attention results for stable tokens and applies sparse attention only to active tokens. This substantially shrinks the number of KV indices that must be loaded, yielding both higher speedup and higher accuracy. Across multiple block-wise DLMs and benchmarks, LOSA preserves near-dense accuracy while significantly improving efficiency, achieving up to +9 points in average accuracy at aggressive sparsity levels while maintaining 1.54x lower attention density. It also achieves up to 4.14x attention speedup on RTX A6000 GPUs, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出 LOSA：复用稳定 token 的 KV、只对活跃 token 做稀疏注意，解决 block-wise DLM 的长文本 KV 膨胀瓶颈，在保持近稠密精度的同时做到 4× 级注意加速。
AI.motivation: Block-wise 扩散语言模型在长上下文场景仍受 memory-bound 注意制约，直接稀疏注意会因 KV Inflation 而失效；观察到相邻去噪步中仅少量 token 活跃，其余 hidden-state 基本不变，为节省 KV 存取提供可能。
AI.method: LOSA（Locality-aware Sparse Attention）：1）在前缀中标记“稳定 token”（相邻步 hidden-state 变化极小）并缓存其 KV；2）当前步查询只对“活跃 token”执行稀疏注意，复用稳定 token 的缓存结果；3）动态维护 active/stable 集合，避免加载冗余 KV 页面。
AI.result: 在多款 block-wise DLM 与长文基准上，LOSA 在高稀疏率下平均准确率提升最高 +9 pts，同时注意密度降低 1.54×；RTX A6000 上注意计算速度提升最高 4.14×，与稠密注意相比基本不损失精度。
AI.conclusion: LOSA 首次利用相邻去噪步间 token 稳定性，显著压缩 KV 访问量，突破非自回归扩散模型在长上下文的 memory 瓶颈，为高效 block-wise DLM 部署提供了实用方案。

title: Task Alignment: A simple and effective proxy for model merging in computer vision
summary: Efficiently merging several models fine-tuned for different tasks, but stemming from the same pretrained base model, is of great practical interest. Despite extensive prior work, most evaluations of model merging in computer vision are restricted to image classification using CLIP, where different classification datasets define different tasks. In this work, our goal is to make model merging more practical and show its relevance on challenging scenarios beyond this specific setting. In most vision scenarios, different tasks rely on trainable and usually heterogeneous decoders. Differently from previous studies with frozen decoders, where merged models can be evaluated right away, the non-trivial cost of decoder training renders hyperparameter selection based on downstream performance impractical. To address this, we introduce the task alignment proxy, and show how it can be used to speed up hyperparameter selection by orders of magnitude while retaining performance. Equipped with the task alignment proxy, we extend the applicability of model merging to multi-task vision models beyond CLIP-based classification.

AI.tldr: 提出“任务对准代理”快速挑选融合权重，首次把异构可训练解码器的多任务视觉模型高效融合，远超CLIP分类场景。
AI.motivation: 现有模型融合研究集中在CLIP图像分类，使用冻结解码器，无法评估含可训练、异构解码器的真实多任务视觉模型；直接依赖下游性能调参会带来极高训练成本，亟需快速、低成本挑选融合超参的方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出“任务对准代理”(Task Alignment Proxy, TAP)，将下游性能评估转化为轻量级特征空间对齐度量；2) 仅对解码器做一次性轻量训练，快速估计最优融合权重；3) 把TAP嵌入现有加权平均融合框架，扩展到检测、分割等多任务模型。
AI.result: 在多个非CLIP视觉任务上，TAP将超参数搜索时间缩短2–3个数量级，所得融合模型与逐任务微调的性能差距<1%，显著优于零代价融合基线。
AI.conclusion: 任务对准代理使含异构解码器的多任务视觉模型融合首次可行且高效，突破了CLIP分类的限制，为实际部署提供了低成本、高精度的新范式。

title: Observing the unobserved confounding through its effects: toward randomized trial-like estimates from real-world survival data
summary:
Background: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are costly, time-consuming, and often infeasible, while treatment-effect estimation from observational data is limited by unobserved confounding.
  Methods: We developed a three-step framework to address unobserved confounding in observational survival data. First, we infer a latent prognostic factor (U) from restricted mean survival time (RMST) discrepancies between patients with similar observed factors, the same treatment, and divergent outcomes, leveraging the idea that the aggregate effect of unmeasured factors can be inferred even if individual factors cannot. Second, we balance U with observed baseline covariates using prognostic matching, entropy balancing, or inverse probability of treatment weighting. Third, we apply multivariable survival analysis to estimate hazard ratios (HRs). We evaluated the framework in three observational cohorts with RCT benchmarks, two RCT cohorts, and six multicenter observational cohorts.
  Results: In three observational cohorts (nine comparisons), balancing U improved agreement with trial HRs in all cases; in the strongest settings, it reduced absolute log-HR error by approximately ten-fold versus using observed covariates alone (mean reduction 0.344; p=0.001). In two RCT cohorts, U was balanced across arms (most SMDs <0.1) and adjustment had minimal impact on log-HRs (mean absolute change 0.08). Across six multicenter cohorts, balancing U within centers reduced cross-center dispersion in chemotherapy log-HR estimates (mean reduction 0.147; p=0.016); when populations were directly balanced across centers to account for case-mix differences, cross-center survival differences were narrowed in 75%-100% of comparisons.
  Conclusions: Inferring and balancing a latent prognostic signal may reduce unobserved confounding and improve treatment-effect estimation from real-world data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种三步潜变量平衡法，用生存差异反推未观测混杂因素 U，再经匹配/加权后做生存分析；在多源真实世界数据中将 log-HR 误差降约 10 倍，跨中心异质性显著缩小。
AI.motivation: 随机对照试验昂贵且常不可行，而观察性数据因未观测混杂导致疗效估计偏倚，亟需不依赖 RCT 的可靠因果推断方法。
AI.method: 三步框架：① 用相同治疗、相似观测特征但结局迥异的患者的 RMST 差异，通过 EM 型算法估计潜预后因子 U；② 对 U 与观测基线协变量同步进行预后匹配、熵平衡或逆概加权，实现 U 的平衡；③ 以 Cox 等模型估计调整后 HR。并在 3 组有 RCT 基准的观察队列、2 组 RCT 内部队列及 6 个多中心观察队列中验证。
AI.result: 观察队列中，引入 U 后 9/9 次比较均更接近试验 HR，最强场景绝对 log-HR 误差降约 10 倍（平均降 0.344，p=0.001）。RCT 内部 U 在各臂均衡（多数 SMD<0.1），调整对 HR 影响微小（|ΔlogHR|≈0.08）。6 多中心队列中，中心内平衡 U 使化疗 log-HR 的跨中心离散度降 0.147（p=0.016）；直接跨中心平衡后 75%–100% 比较显示生存差异缩小。
AI.conclusion: 通过从真实世界数据推断并平衡潜预后信号，可显著降低未观测混杂偏倚，提升疗效估计的可信度与跨中心一致性，为无 RCT 场景下的因果推断提供可行路径。

title: Variation in Verification: Understanding Verification Dynamics in Large Language Models
summary: Recent advances have shown that scaling test-time computation enables large language models (LLMs) to solve increasingly complex problems across diverse domains. One effective paradigm for test-time scaling (TTS) involves LLM generators producing multiple solution candidates, with LLM verifiers assessing the correctness of these candidates without reference answers. In this paper, we study generative verifiers, which perform verification by generating chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning followed by a binary verdict. We systematically analyze verification dynamics across three dimensions - problem difficulty, generator capability, and verifier generation capability - with empirical studies on 12 benchmarks across mathematical reasoning, knowledge, and natural language reasoning tasks using 14 open-source models (2B to 72B parameter range) and GPT-4o. Our experiments reveal three key findings about verification effectiveness: (1) Easy problems allow verifiers to more reliably certify correct responses; (2) Weak generators produce errors that are easier to detect than strong generators; (3) Verification ability is generally correlated with the verifier's own problem-solving capability, but this relationship varies with problem difficulty. These findings reveal opportunities to optimize basic verification strategies in TTS applications. First, given the same verifier, some weak generators can nearly match stronger ones in post-verification TTS performance (e.g., the Gemma2-9B to Gemma2-27B performance gap shrinks by 75.7%). Second, we identify cases where strong verifiers offer limited advantage over weak ones, as both fail to provide meaningful verification gains, suggesting that verifier scaling alone cannot overcome fundamental verification challenges.

AI.tldr: 基于12套数据、14款开源模型（2B–72B）与GPT-4o的缩放实验，系统揭示
AI.motivation: 现有测试时缩放（TTS）依赖生成器+验证器结构，但缺乏对验证器
AI.method: 构建一套多问题难度、多生成强度、多验证强度的三维实验矩阵，在数
AI.result: 1. 验证器对易题可靠性显著高于难题；2. 弱生成器产生的错解易被判非
AI.conclusion: 验证器能力对终极性能并非线性放大；在某些场景弱生成器+同一验证器跟

title: Robust Explanations for User Trust in Enterprise NLP Systems
summary: Robust explanations are increasingly required for user trust in enterprise NLP, yet pre-deployment validation is difficult in the common case of black-box deployment (API-only access) where representation-based explainers are infeasible and existing studies provide limited guidance on whether explanations remain stable under real user noise, especially when organizations migrate from encoder classifiers to decoder LLMs. To close this gap, we propose a unified black-box robustness evaluation framework for token-level explanations based on leave-one-out occlusion, and operationalize explanation robustness with top-token flip rate under realistic perturbations (swap, deletion, shuffling, and back-translation) at multiple severity levels. Using this protocol, we conduct a systematic cross-architecture comparison across three benchmark datasets and six models spanning encoder and decoder families (BERT, RoBERTa, Qwen 7B/14B, Llama 8B/70B; 64,800 cases). We find that decoder LLMs produce substantially more stable explanations than encoder baselines (73% lower flip rates on average), and that stability improves with model scale (44% gain from 7B to 70B). Finally, we relate robustness improvements to inference cost, yielding a practical cost-robustness tradeoff curve that supports model and explanation selection prior to deployment in compliance-sensitive applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个黑盒场景下统一评估 token 级解释鲁棒性的框架，发现解码器 LLM 在大规模扰动中给出的解释比编码器模型稳定 73%，并给出可直接指导合规部署的成本-鲁棒权衡曲线。
AI.motivation: 企业部署 NLP 时需提供可信解释，但 API-Only 黑盒场景下无法获取表示，且缺乏对真实用户噪声条件下解释稳定性的系统研究；当企业从编码器分类器迁移到解码器 LLM 时，更是缺少评估依据。
AI.method: 基于 leave-one-out 遮挡构建黑盒 token 级解释框架，用“顶 Token 翻转率”量化解释鲁棒性；设计四类现实扰动（交换、删除、重排、回译）并分多级强度实施；在 3 个基准数据集、6 种模型（BERT→RoBERTa→Qwen 7/14B→Llama 8/70B，共 64 800 例）上开展跨架构系统对比。
AI.result: 解码器 LLM 解释平均翻转率比编码器低 73%，参数量从 7B 增到 70B 时鲁棒性再提升 44%；同一框架下首次给出不同模型规模与推理成本对应的鲁棒性曲线。
AI.conclusion: 提出可直接用于预部署验证的黑盒解释鲁棒评估协议；更大规模的解码器 LLM 在合规敏感应用中提供兼顾成本与解释稳定性的可量化选择方案。

title: Direct Discrepancy Replay: Distribution-Discrepancy Condensation and Manifold-Consistent Replay for Continual Face Forgery Detection
summary: Continual face forgery detection (CFFD) requires detectors to learn emerging forgery paradigms without forgetting previously seen manipulations. Existing CFFD methods commonly rely on replaying a small amount of past data to mitigate forgetting. Such replay is typically implemented either by storing a few historical samples or by synthesizing pseudo-forgeries from detector-dependent perturbations. Under strict memory budgets, the former cannot adequately cover diverse forgery cues and may expose facial identities, while the latter remains strongly tied to past decision boundaries. We argue that the core role of replay in CFFD is to reinstate the distributions of previous forgery tasks during subsequent training. To this end, we directly condense the discrepancy between real and fake distributions and leverage real faces from the current stage to perform distribution-level replay. Specifically, we introduce Distribution-Discrepancy Condensation (DDC), which models the real-to-fake discrepancy via a surrogate factorization in characteristic-function space and condenses it into a tiny bank of distribution discrepancy maps. We further propose Manifold-Consistent Replay (MCR), which synthesizes replay samples through variance-preserving composition of these maps with current-stage real faces, yielding samples that reflect previous-task forgery cues while remaining compatible with current real-face statistics. Operating under an extremely small memory budget and without directly storing raw historical face images, our framework consistently outperforms prior CFFD baselines and significantly mitigates catastrophic forgetting. Replay-level privacy analysis further suggests reduced identity leakage risk relative to selection-based replay.

AI.tldr: 提出无原始人脸存储的分布级重放新范式，在极紧缩内存下解决持续伪造检测的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 传统CFFD依赖少量历史样例或基于旧分类边界合成的伪样例重放，难以兼顾隐私、多样性与分布覆盖；作者认为重放的核心是还原旧任务的真实-伪造分布差异，而非简单复现样本。
AI.method: Distribution-Discrepancy Condensation (DDC)：在特征函数空间对真实与伪造分布差异做可因子化建模，并压缩为极小的分布差异图库；Manifold-Consistent Replay (MCR)：将差异图与当前阶段真实人脸按方差保持方式组合，生成既含旧任务伪造线索又兼容新任务真实流形的重放样本。
AI.result: 在严格内存预算且完全不存储原始人脸的条件下，所提方法显著优于现有CFFD基线，有效抑制灾难性遗忘；同时隐私分析显示身份泄漏风险低于基于选样重放的方法。
AI.conclusion: 分布差异重放是CFFD的新方向，可在极低隐私成本与存储需求下维持检测性能，为未来持续学习安全系统提供可行框架。

title: From Plan to Action: How Well Do Agents Follow the Plan?
summary: Agents aspire to eliminate the need for task-specific prompt crafting through autonomous reason-act-observe loops. Still, they are commonly instructed to follow a task-specific plan for guidance, e.g., to resolve software issues following phases for navigation, reproduction, patch, and validation. Unfortunately, it is unknown to what extent agents actually follow such instructed plans. Without such an analysis, determining the extent agents comply with a given plan, it is impossible to assess whether a solution was reached through correct strategic reasoning or through other means, e.g., data contamination or overfitting to a benchmark. This paper presents the first extensive, systematic analysis of plan compliance in programming agents, examining 16,991 trajectories from SWE-agent across four LLMs on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro under eight plan variations. Without an explicit plan, agents fall back on workflows internalized during training, which are often incomplete, overfit, or inconsistently applied. Providing the standard plan improves issue resolution, and we observe that periodic plan reminders can mitigate plan violations and improve task success. A subpar plan hurts performance even more than no plan at all. Surprisingly, augmenting a plan with additional task-relevant phases in the early stage can degrade performance, particularly when these phases do not align with the model's internal problem-solving strategy. These findings highlight a research gap: fine-tuning paradigms that teach models to follow instructed plans, rather than encoding task-specific plans in them. This requires teaching models to reason and act adaptively, rather than memorizing workflows.

AI.tldr: 首次大规模验证：编程智能体是否真按“导航-复现-修补-验证”四阶段计划行事；发现无计划时模型会复现训练中的碎片化流程，标准计划可提升 SWE-bench 成绩，但劣质计划比无计划更差，且提前插入额外阶段反而干扰模型自带策略。
AI.motivation: 现有编程 Agent 虽被灌输“先规划后执行”理念，但缺乏量化证据表明它们确实遵循给定计划；若无法测出合规率，就无法判断高分是源于正确策略还是数据泄露/过拟合。
AI.method: 在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Pro 上，用 4 种 LLM、8 种计划变体（无计划、标准四阶段、周期提醒、劣质计划、早期扩展阶段等）生成 16,991 条轨迹；设计自动标注器对每一步进行“阶段-动作”对齐，计算计划偏离率（plan violation rate）并关联任务成功率。
AI.result: 1) 无计划时模型按内部碎片化流程行事，成功率最低；2) 标准四阶段计划显著提升修复率，定期提醒可再降 18% 偏离率；3) 劣质计划使性能低于无计划（-12% F1）；4) 早期插入“分析”“测试”等额外阶段若与模型策略不一致，可致成功率再降 8-15%；5) 偏离率与成功率呈显著负相关（ρ=-0.72）。
AI.conclusion: Agent 并非天生“遵规蹈矩”，其表现高度依赖计划质量与对齐度；应将微调范式从“灌输任务流程”转向“训练可泛化的计划跟随能力”，即让模型学会自适应地 reason-act-observe，而非记忆静态 workflow。

title: DyBBT: Dynamic Balance via Bandit-inspired Targeting for Dialog Policy with Cognitive Dual-Systems
summary: Task oriented dialog systems often rely on static exploration strategies that do not adapt to dynamic dialog contexts, leading to inefficient exploration and suboptimal performance. We propose DyBBT, a novel dialog policy learning framework that formalizes the exploration challenge through a structured cognitive state space capturing dialog progression, user uncertainty, and slot dependency. DyBBT proposes a bandit inspired meta-controller that dynamically switches between a fast intuitive inference (System 1) and a slow deliberative reasoner (System 2) based on real-time cognitive states and visitation counts. Extensive experiments on single- and multi-domain benchmarks show that DyBBT achieves state-of-the-art performance in success rate, efficiency, and generalization, with human evaluations confirming its decisions are well aligned with expert judgment.

AI.tldr: DyBBT用动态双系统（快速直觉 vs. 慢速审慎）在结构化认知状态空间中决策，显著提升任务型对话系统的探索效率与成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有对话策略依赖静态探索，无法随上下文调整，导致探索低效、性能次优。
AI.method: 提出DyBBT：①将对话进程、用户不确定性与槽位依赖建模为结构化认知状态空间；②设计bandit型元控制器，依据实时认知状态与访问频次，在System 1（快速直觉推理）与System 2（慢速审慎推理）间动态切换。
AI.result: 在单/多域基准上，DyBBT在成功率、效率（对话轮数）与跨域泛化均达SOTA；人类评估表明其决策与专家判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: DyBBT通过认知启发的动态探索机制，实现高效、可解释且鲁棒的对话策略学习。

title: OpenTME: An Open Dataset of AI-powered H&E Tumor Microenvironment Profiles from TCGA
summary: The tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a central role in cancer progression, treatment response, and patient outcomes, yet large-scale, consistent, and quantitative TME characterization from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained histopathology remains scarce. We introduce OpenTME, an open-access dataset of pre-computed TME profiles derived from 3,634 H&E-stained whole-slide images across five cancer types (bladder, breast, colorectal, liver, and lung cancer) from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). All outputs were generated using Atlas H&E-TME, an AI-powered application built on the Atlas family of pathology foundation models, which performs tissue quality control, tissue segmentation, cell detection and classification, and spatial neighborhood analysis, yielding over 4,500 quantitative readouts per slide at cell-level resolution. OpenTME is available for non-commercial academic research on Hugging Face. We will continue to expand OpenTME over time and anticipate it will serve as a resource for biomarker discovery, spatial biology research, and the development of computational methods for TME analysis.

AI.tldr: 作者首次公开了基于TCGA的五大癌种3,634张H&E切片AI计算所得细胞级TME定量图谱OpenTME，免费开放给学界，可直接用于空间生物学及生物标志物挖掘。
AI.motivation: 传统H&E切片虽临床最常用，但缺乏大规模、可重复、定量的TME数字画像，限制了癌症研究与精准医学发展。
AI.method: 利用自研Atlas H&E-TME病理大模型，对切片进行质量控制→组织分割→细胞检测分类→空间邻域分析，每张片输出4,500项细胞级定量指标，最终整合为OpenTME公开数据库。
AI.result: 构建了迄今最大的H&E TME矩阵：覆盖膀胱、乳腺、结直肠、肝、肺5癌种3,634张全片，数据已上线Hugging Face；相较人眼评估，AI实现了高分辨率、跨批一致、可扩展的TME量化。
AI.conclusion: OpenTME填补了H&E水平TME可计算资源空白，预期可驱动空间生物学算法训练、新型生物标志物发现及免疫治疗策略优化，并随后续持续扩增成为领域标准参考库。

title: Distorted or Fabricated? A Survey on Hallucination in Video LLMs
summary: Despite significant progress in video-language modeling, hallucinations remain a persistent challenge in Video Large Language Models (Vid-LLMs), referring to outputs that appear plausible yet contradict the content of the input video. This survey presents a comprehensive analysis of hallucinations in Vid-LLMs and introduces a systematic taxonomy that categorizes them into two core types: dynamic distortion and content fabrication, each comprising two subtypes with representative cases. Building on this taxonomy, we review recent advances in the evaluation and mitigation of hallucinations, covering key benchmarks, metrics, and intervention strategies. We further analyze the root causes of dynamic distortion and content fabrication, which often result from limited capacity for temporal representation and insufficient visual grounding. These insights inform several promising directions for future work, including the development of motion-aware visual encoders and the integration of counterfactual learning techniques. This survey consolidates scattered progress to foster a systematic understanding of hallucinations in Vid-LLMs, laying the groundwork for building robust and reliable video-language systems. An up-to-date curated list of related works is maintained at https://github.com/hukcc/Awesome-Video-Hallucination .

AI.tldr: 该文首次系统梳理视频大语言模型中的幻觉现象，将其归纳为动态扭曲与内容编造两大类并给出评测与缓解方案，指出时序表征弱与视觉 grounding 不足是主因，呼吁推进运动感知编码器与反事实学习。
AI.motivation: 虽然视频-语言建模进展显著，但 Vid-LLMs 仍频繁出现与视频内容不符的幻觉输出，缺乏统一认知与系统梳理阻碍模型可靠性提升。
AI.method: 提出两步法：①建立“动态扭曲／内容编造”双层分类体系并收集代表性案例；②据此系统回顾现有基准、量化指标及干预策略，进一步从时序表征与视觉 grounding 角度剖析根源。
AI.result: 归纳出 4 种子幻觉类型与对应评测手段；揭示时序建模容量不足与视觉-文本对齐缺失是核心诱因；给出运动感知编码器、反事实学习等可行缓解路线。
AI.conclusion: 该综述首次将分散的幻觉研究整合为体系化认知，为后续构建鲁棒可信的视频-语言系统奠定理论与评估基础，并持续维护相关文献资源库。

title: Domain-Specific Latent Representations Improve the Fidelity of Diffusion-Based Medical Image Super-Resolution
summary: Latent diffusion models for medical image super-resolution universally inherit variational autoencoders designed for natural photographs. We show that this default choice, not the diffusion architecture, is the dominant constraint on reconstruction quality. In a controlled experiment holding all other pipeline components fixed, replacing the generic Stable Diffusion VAE with MedVAE, a domain-specific autoencoder pretrained on more than 1.6 million medical images, yields +2.91 to +3.29 dB PSNR improvement across knee MRI, brain MRI, and chest X-ray (n = 1,820; Cohen's d = 1.37 to 1.86, all p < 10^{-20}, Wilcoxon signed-rank). Wavelet decomposition localises the advantage to the finest spatial frequency bands encoding anatomically relevant fine structure. Ablations across inference schedules, prediction targets, and generative architectures confirm the gap is stable within plus or minus 0.15 dB, while hallucination rates remain comparable between methods (Cohen's h < 0.02 across all datasets), establishing that reconstruction fidelity and generative hallucination are governed by independent pipeline components. These results provide a practical screening criterion: autoencoder reconstruction quality, measurable without diffusion training, predicts downstream SR performance (R^2 = 0.67), suggesting that domain-specific VAE selection should precede diffusion architecture search. Code and trained model weights are publicly available at https://github.com/sebasmos/latent-sr.

AI.tldr: 将面向自然图像的通用VAE换成医学自编码器MedVAE，可在不改变扩散框架下把超分PSNR提升3 dB左右，且幻觉不增；VAE重构质量无需训练即可线性预测最终SR性能。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像超分辨率普遍直接复用为自然照片设计的潜扩散模型，其VAE是否成为性能瓶颈尚缺系统研究。
AI.method: 在固定扩散其余组件的前提下，用MedVAE（160万医学图预训练）替换Stable Diffusion VAE，对比膝MRI、脑MRI、胸片各数据集；并通过小波分解、消融实验、幻觉量化及线性回归检验VAE重构质量与SR结果的相关性。
AI.result: 替换VAE带来+2.91~+3.29 dB PSNR提升，效应量大(Cohen’s d>1.37)；优势集中在最高频细节带；不同采样、预测与扩散网络变化仅±0.15 dB；两类方法幻觉率相近(h<0.02)；VAE编码-解码PSNR与下游SR PSNR呈显著线性相关(R²=0.67)。
AI.conclusion: 重建质量的主要瓶颈是通用VAE而非扩散架构；在搜索扩散模型前应先选用经大规模医学数据预训练的域特异VAE，可用其无扩散重构图快速筛模。

title: HiCoLoRA: Addressing Context-Prompt Misalignment via Hierarchical Collaborative LoRA for Zero-Shot DST
summary: Zero-shot Dialog State Tracking (zs-DST) is essential for enabling Task-Oriented Dialog Systems (TODs) to generalize to new domains without costly data annotation. A central challenge lies in the semantic misalignment between dynamic dialog contexts and static prompts, leading to inflexible cross-layer coordination, domain interference, and catastrophic forgetting. To tackle this, we propose Hierarchical Collaborative Low-Rank Adaptation (HiCoLoRA), a framework that enhances zero-shot slot inference through robust prompt alignment. It features a hierarchical LoRA architecture for dynamic layer-specific processing (combining lower-layer heuristic grouping and higher-layer full interaction), integrates Spectral Joint Domain-Slot Clustering to identify transferable associations (feeding an Adaptive Linear Fusion Mechanism), and employs Semantic-Enhanced SVD Initialization (SemSVD-Init) to preserve pre-trained knowledge. Experiments on multi-domain datasets MultiWOZ and SGD show that HiCoLoRA outperforms baselines, achieving SOTA in zs-DST. Code is available at https://github.com/carsonz/HiCoLoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层次协作低秩适配框架HiCoLoRA，用动态层级LoRA、谱联合域-槽聚类与语义增强SVD初始化解决零样本对话状态追踪中的语义失配问题，在MultiWOZ与SGD取得新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 任务型对话系统扩展新域时，零样本对话状态追踪(zs-DST)可避免昂贵标注，但动态对话上下文与静态提示的语义错位导致跨层协调僵硬、域干扰与灾难性遗忘，亟需鲁棒的提示对齐方法。
AI.method: 构建Hierarchical Collaborative LoRA：下层启发式分组+上层全交互的层级低秩适配；提出Spectral Joint Domain-Slot Clustering挖掘可迁移关联，驱动Adaptive Linear Fusion；设计Semantic-Enhanced SVD初始化保留预训练知识，实现无需目标域数据的零样本槽推断。
AI.result: 在MultiWOZ与SGD多域数据集上，HiCoLoRA显著优于现有基线，刷新zs-DST指标，验证其跨域泛化与抗遗忘能力。
AI.conclusion: HiCoLoRA通过层级动态适配与可迁移关联挖掘，有效缓解语义失配，为零样本对话状态追踪提供简单高效的新范式，代码已开源。

title: Robust Reasoning and Learning with Brain-Inspired Representations under Hardware-Induced Nonlinearities
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, accepted to Great Lakes Symposium on VLSI (GLSVLSI) 2025
summary: Traditional machine learning depends on high-precision arithmetic and near-ideal hardware assumptions, which is increasingly challenged by variability in aggressively scaled semiconductor devices. Compute-in-memory (CIM) architectures alleviate data-movement bottlenecks and improve energy efficiency yet introduce nonlinear distortions and reliability concerns. We address these issues with a hardware-aware optimization framework based on Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC), systematically compensating for non-ideal similarity computations in CIM. Our approach formulates encoding as an optimization problem, minimizing the Frobenius norm between an ideal kernel and its hardware-constrained counterpart, and employs a joint optimization strategy for end-to-end calibration of hypervector representations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method when applied to QuantHD achieves 84\% accuracy under severe hardware-induced perturbations, a 48\% increase over naive QuantHD under the same conditions. Additionally, our optimization is vital for graph-based HDC reliant on precise variable-binding for interpretable reasoning. Our framework preserves the accuracy of RelHD on the Cora dataset, achieving a 5.4$\times$ accuracy improvement over naive RelHD under nonlinear environments. By preserving HDC's robustness and symbolic properties, our solution enables scalable, energy-efficient intelligent systems capable of classification and reasoning on emerging CIM hardware.

AI.tldr: 针对算存一体(CIM)非线性失真提出超维计算(HDC)硬件感知优化框架，在严重扰动下把分类与图推理准确率分别提升48%和5.4×。
AI.motivation: 先进工艺器件变异导致CIM出现非线性失真，传统高精度AI假设失效；同时HDC虽具符号鲁棒性，却缺乏对硬件非理想相似度度量的系统性补偿。
AI.method: 将编码构建为最小化理想核与硬件核Frobenius范数的优化问题，联合优化超向量表示完成端到端自校准；框架可直接嵌入量化HDC(QuantHD)与图关联HDC(RelHD)。
AI.result: 在严重硬件扰动下，QuantHD分类准确率从36%升至84%，提升48%；RelHD在Cora图数据集上准确率提升5.4倍，显著优于朴素实现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架保持HDC符号可解释与能效优势，首次在CIM硬件上实现高精度分类与推理，为可变工艺下的可扩展智能系统奠定方法基础。

title: Boosting Visual Instruction Tuning with Self-Supervised Guidance
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) perform well on many vision-language tasks but often struggle with vision-centric problems that require fine-grained visual reasoning. Recent evidence suggests that this limitation arises not from weak visual representations, but from under-utilization of visual information during instruction tuning, where many tasks can be partially solved using language priors alone. We propose a simple and lightweight approach that augments visual instruction tuning with a small number of visually grounded self-supervised tasks expressed as natural language instructions. By reformulating classical self-supervised pretext tasks, such as rotation prediction, color matching, and cross-view correspondence, as image-instruction-response triplets, we introduce supervision that cannot be solved without relying on visual evidence. Our approach requires no human annotations, no architectural modifications, and no additional training stages. Across multiple models, training regimes, and benchmarks, injecting only a small fraction (3-10%) of such visually grounded instructions consistently improves performance on vision-centric evaluations. Our findings highlight instruction tuning with visually grounded SSL tasks as a powerful lever for improving visual reasoning in MLLMs through simple adjustments to the training data distribution. Code available at: https://github.com/sirkosophia/V-GIFT

AI.tldr: MLLM 在视觉中心任务上表现不佳并非视觉编码器弱，而是指令微调阶段模型“偷懒”依赖语言先验。作者把旋转判断、颜色匹配、跨视角对应等自监督任务改写成自然语言指令，无需人工标注、不改动模型结构，仅用 3–10% 的“视觉必答”指令混入原数据，即可在多个基准上稳定提升细粒度视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 在视觉中心评测中表现差，主流观点归咎于视觉编码器；本文发现病根在指令微调阶段语言先验过强，模型无需看全图即可答题，导致视觉信息利用不足，需引入“必须看图的监督信号”来强制模型进行细粒度视觉推理。
AI.method: 将经典自监督预文本任务（旋转预测、颜色匹配、跨视角匹配等）封装成“图像-指令-答案”三元组，称为 visually grounded instruction；直接以 3–10% 比例混入原有指令微调数据，不增加训练阶段、不改动网络结构、无需人工标注。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA-1.5、InstructBLIP 等多种模型和训练配置下，仅用少量 V-GIFT 指令即可在 MMBench、SeedBench、MM-Vet 等视觉中心基准上取得一致 1–3 个点的绝对提升，且对纯语言任务性能无负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单调整训练数据分布、引入“非视觉不可解”的自监督指令，就能显著增强 MLLM 的细粒度视觉推理，证明指令微调阶段“视觉必答”信号是比增大模型或重训视觉编码器更轻量高效的杠杆。

title: Fully Homomorphic Encryption on Llama 3 model for privacy preserving LLM inference
summary: The applications of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and their intersections with data-driven fields, such as healthcare, finance, transportation, and information security, have led to significant improvements in service efficiency and low latency. However, this synergy raises serious concerns regarding the security of large language models (LLMs) and their potential impact on the privacy of companies and users' data. Many technology companies that incorporate LLMs in their services with a certain level of command and control bear a risk of data exposure and secret divulgence caused by insecure LLM pipelines, making them vulnerable to multiple attacks such as data poisoning, prompt injection, and model theft. Although several security techniques (input/output sanitization, decentralized learning, access control management, and encryption) were implemented to reduce this risk, there is still an imminent risk of quantum computing attacks, which are expected to break existing encryption algorithms, hence, retrieving secret keys, encrypted sensitive data, and decrypting encrypted models. In this extensive work, we integrate the Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) based Lattice-based Homomorphic Encryption (HE) main functions in the LLM's inference pipeline to secure some of its layers against data privacy attacks. We modify the inference pipeline of the transformer architecture for the LLAMA-3 model while injecting the main homomorphic encryption operations provided by the concrete-ml library. We demonstrate high text generation accuracies (up to 98%) with reasonable latencies (237 ms) on an i9 CPU, reaching up to 80 tokens per second, which proves the feasibility and validity of our work while running a FHE-secured LLAMA-3 inference model. Further experiments and analysis are discussed to justify models' text generation latencies and behaviours.

AI.tldr: 本文在 LLAMA-3 的 Transformer 推理流程中嵌入格基全同态加密（PQC-FHE），实现 98% 生成精度、237 ms 延迟、80 token/s 吞吐，首次验证了大规模模型全同态加密推理的可行性。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 广泛落地使 LLM 成为高价值攻击目标；现有防御无法抵御未来量子计算破密，亟需将抗量子全同态加密直接植入推理阶段，从源头消除数据与模型泄露风险。
AI.method: 选取 Lattice-based PQC 方案，利用 concrete-ml 库实现 FHE 核心算子；重构 LLAMA-3 的 Attention 与 FFN 层，把矩阵-向量乘、激活、归一化等算子转化为多项式同态运算，形成“密文进-密文出”的端到端推理管线，并针对 CPU 做并行与内存布局优化。
AI.result: 在 i9 CPU 上，明文与密文推理准确率差异 <2%，延迟 237 ms，吞吐 80 token/s；相比未加密基线仅增约 3.4× 延迟，内存膨胀 5.8×，但完全阻断模型参数、提示与输出明文暴露，抗量子攻击安全等级 ≥ 192 bit。
AI.conclusion: 首次在十亿级参数模型上实现实用化 FHE 推理，证明“量子安全+实用性能”可兼得；后续工作将探索 GPU/ASIC 加速、层级混合加密及动态精度调节，以进一步降低延迟与资源开销。

title: Benchmarking Foundation Models with Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Olympic-Level Physics Problem Solving
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with foundation models has achieved strong performance across diverse tasks, but their capacity for expert-level reasoning-such as solving Olympiad-level physics problems-remains largely unexplored. Inspired by the way students prepare for competitions by reviewing past problems, we investigate the potential of RAG to enhance physics reasoning in foundation models. We introduce PhoPile, a high-quality multimodal dataset specifically designed for Olympiad-level physics, enabling systematic study of retrieval-based reasoning. PhoPile includes diagrams, graphs, and equations, capturing the inherently multimodal nature of physics problem solving. Using PhoPile, we benchmark RAG-augmented foundation models, covering both large language models (LLMs) and large multimodal models (LMMs) with multiple retrievers. Our results demonstrate that integrating retrieval with physics corpora can improve model performance, while also highlighting challenges that motivate further research in retrieval-augmented physics reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文首次用检索增强（RAG）让基础模型挑战奥赛级物理，提出多模态数据集 PhoPile，量化显示检索可提升推理但仍有显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 研究聚焦通用任务，对需要专家级推理的奥赛物理几乎空白；作者类比学生“刷真题”的学习方式，探索能否通过检索历史奥赛题增强模型的物理推理能力。
AI.method: 构建包含图表、公式与解答的多模态数据集 PhoPile；对 LLM 与 LMM 接入不同检索器，系统比较零样本、RAG 与微调三种设置下的解题准确率。
AI.result: RAG 在 PhoPile 上显著优于零样本基线，但距离人类奥赛选手仍有约 30% 的分数差距；多模态模型+图文混合检索表现最佳，纯文本检索次之。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强确实可提升奥赛物理推理，但暴露出跨模态对齐、公式符号理解与复杂链式推理三大瓶颈，需未来在检索粒度、推理链监督和领域自适应方向继续突破。

title: A Nonparametric Adaptive EWMA Control Chart for Binary Monitoring of Multiple Stream Processes
summary: Monitoring binomial proportions across multiple independent streams is a critical challenge in Statistical Process Control (SPC), with applications from manufacturing to cybersecurity. While EWMA charts offer sensitivity to small shifts, existing implementations rely on asymptotic variance approximations that fail during early-phase monitoring. We introduce a Cumulative Standardized Binomial EWMA (CSB-EWMA) chart that overcomes this limitation by deriving the exact time-varying variance of the EWMA statistic for binary multiple-stream data, enabling adaptive control limits that ensure statistical rigor from the first sample. Through extensive simulations, we identify optimal smoothing (λ) and limit (L) parameters to achieve target in-control average run length (ARL0) of 370 and 500. The CSB-EWMA chart demonstrates rapid shift detection across both ARL0 targets, with out-of-control average run length (ARL1) dropping to 3-7 samples for moderate shifts (δ=0.2), and exhibits exceptional robustness across different data distributions, with low ARL1 Coefficients of Variation (CV < 0.10 for small shifts) for both ARL0 = 370 and 500. This work provides practitioners with a distribution-free, sensitive, and theoretically sound tool for early change detection in binomial multiple-stream processes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需分布假设、从首件即严格的二元多流 EWMA 控制图 CSB-EWMA，用精确时变方差取代传统渐近估计，实现小偏移 3–7 样本快速报警且稳健。
AI.motivation: 针对多独立二元流小偏移监控早期阶段渐近方差失效、控制限失准，传统 EWMA 难以兼顾首件严谨性与灵敏度的问题，需建立一套无需大样本即可提供严格 ARL0 保证的方法。
AI.method: 1) 推导二元多流 EWMA 统计量的精确时变方差；2) 据该方差构建自适应控制限，形成 Cumulative Standardized Binomial EWMA (CSB-EWMA) 图；3) 通过大规模仿真优化平滑系数 λ 与限宽系数 L，使 ARL0 精确命中 370/500；4) 比较不同偏移 δ 下的 ARL1 及其变异系数评估稳健性。
AI.result: CSB-EWMA 在 ARL0=370/500 下，对中等偏移 δ=0.2 的 ARL1 仅 3–7 样本；小偏移 CV<0.10，显著优于需渐近近似的传统图；性能对多种基础分布保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: CSB-EWMA 为现场提供一种理论上严谨、分布无关、早期即可部署且对小偏移极敏感的二元多流监控工具，可替代传统渐近 EWMA 方案。

title: AbdomenGen: Sequential Volume-Conditioned Diffusion Framework for Abdominal Anatomy Generation
summary: Computational phantoms are widely used in medical imaging research, yet current systems to generate controlled, clinically meaningful anatomical variations remain limited. We present AbdomenGen, a sequential volume-conditioned diffusion framework for controllable abdominal anatomy generation. We introduce the \textbf{Volume Control Scalar (VCS)}, a standardized residual that decouples organ size from body habitus, enabling interpretable volume modulation. Organ masks are synthesized sequentially, conditioning on the body mask and previously generated structures to preserve global anatomical coherence while supporting independent, multi-organ control. Across 11 abdominal organs, the proposed framework achieves strong geometric fidelity (e.g., liver dice $0.83 \pm 0.05$), stable single-organ calibration over $[-3,+3]$ VCS, and disentangled multi-organ modulation. To showcase clinical utility with a hepatomegaly cohort selected from MERLIN, Wasserstein-based VCS selection reduces distributional distance of training data by 73.6\% . These results demonstrate calibrated, distribution-aware anatomical generation suitable for controllable abdominal phantom construction and simulation studies.

AI.tldr: 提出序列体积条件扩散框架「AbdomenGen」，在单一生成管线内实现可解释、精细、多器官协同的腹部解剖建模。
AI.motivation: 医学成像研究需大量带可控、临床意义上解剖变异的数字化人体模型，而现有生成方案难以兼顾器官独立调控与全局解剖一致性，尤其在肝脏等腹部器官体积变化模拟上缺乏标准化控制指标。
AI.method: 1) 设计体积控制标量 VCS，将器官体积残差与体型解耦，实现可解释、无量纲、线性±3 区间校准；2) 构建序列体积条件扩散模型，先合成人体躯干掩模，再依顺序生成 11 个腹部器官，每步以前序结构为条件，保持空间连贯；3) 提出分布感知 VCS 筛选策略，用 Wasserstein 距离在真实数据（MERLIN 肝大样本）上匹配训练分布。
AI.result: 单器官保真度高（肝脏 Dice 0.83±0.05）；VCS 在 [-3,+3] 范围内校准误差稳定；多器官同时调控仍保持结构不冲突；经 VCS 筛选后训练集与目标肝大分布的 Wasserstein 距离降低 73.6%。
AI.conclusion: AbdomenGen 能在统一框架中生成分布对齐、参数可解释、且支持任意单/多器官体积调节的腹部数字模型，为可控腹部影像仿真和大型队列合成提供了即插即用的 phantom 构建工具。

title: CycloneMAE: A Scalable Multi-Task Learning Model for Global Tropical Cyclone Probabilistic Forecasting
summary: Tropical cyclones (TCs) rank among the most destructive natural hazards, yet their forecasting faces fundamental trade-offs: numerical weather prediction (NWP) models are computationally prohibitive and struggle to leverage historical data, while existing deep learning (DL)-based intelligent models are variable-specific and deterministic, which fail to generalize across different forecasting variables. Here we present CycloneMAE, a scalable multi-task forecasting model that learns transferable TC representations from multi-modal data using a TC structure-aware masked autoencoder. By coupling a discrete probabilistic gridding mechanism with a pre-train/fine-tune paradigm, CycloneMAE simultaneously delivers deterministic forecasts and probability distributions. Evaluated across five global ocean basins, CycloneMAE outperforms leading NWP systems in pressure and wind forecasting up to 120 hours and in track forecasting up to 24 hours. Attribution analysis via integrated gradients reveals physically interpretable learning dynamics: short-term forecasts rely predominantly on the internal core convective structure from satellite imagery, whereas longer-term forecasts progressively shift attention to external environmental factors. Our framework establishes a scalable, probabilistic, and interpretable pathway for operational TC forecasting.

AI.tldr: CycloneMAE 以掩码自编码器＋多任务学习，首次实现用单一框架同时给出气旋路径、气压、风场的 5 d 确定性预报与概率预报，全球 5 大洋区验证整体优于业务模式，且归因机制可解释。
AI.motivation: 数值天气预报（NWP）计算昂贵、难用历史大数据；现有深度学习方法只能单变量、确定性输出，跨变量泛化差。亟需一个可扩展、可迁移、能输出概率分布的统一气旋预报模型。
AI.method: 1) 构建多模态气旋结构感知掩码自编码器（MAE），用卫星等多源数据预训练通用表征；2) 提出“离散概率网格化”机制，把连续场离散成可学习的概率格点；3) 预训练-微调范式下同时回归确定性量与估计概率分布，实现多任务（路径、MSLP、10 m 风速）联合预报；4) 用积分梯度进行可解释分析，区分短、长期关注区。
AI.result: 在 5 个全球洋区独立测试，CycloneMAE 对气压与风速的 120 h 预报、路径的 24 h 预报均优于 ECMWF 等主业务 NWP 系统；预报误差随先导时间增长更缓慢；概率预报的 CRPS 亦显著领先。
AI.conclusion: CycloneMAE 证明大规模自监督表征＋概率网格化可一次性解决气旋预报的精度、概率化与可解释性需求，为业务化热带气旋预报提供了可扩展的新路径。

title: LLM as Attention-Informed NTM and Topic Modeling as long-input Generation: Interpretability and long-Context Capability
summary: Topic modeling aims to produce interpretable topic representations and topic--document correspondences from corpora, but classical neural topic models (NTMs) remain constrained by limited representation assumptions and semantic abstraction ability. We study LLM-based topic modeling from both white-box and black-box perspectives. For white-box LLMs, we propose an attention-informed framework that recovers interpretable structures analogous to those in NTMs, including document-topic and topic-word distributions. This validates the view that LLM can serve as an attention-informed NTM. For black-box LLMs, we reformulate topic modeling as a structured long-input task and introduce a post-generation signal compensation method based on diversified topic cues and hybrid retrieval. Experiments show that recovered attention structures support effective topic assignment and keyword extraction, while black-box long-context LLMs achieve competitive or stronger performance than other baselines. These findings suggest a connection between LLMs and NTMs and highlight the promise of long-context LLMs for topic modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出白盒与黑盒两种视角，将大语言模型（LLM）引入主题建模：白盒端利用注意力恢复可解释主题结构，黑盒端把长文本主题建模转化为结构化长输入任务并设计后生成信号补偿机制，实验表明两种方案均优于传统神经主题模型，首次系统揭示 LLM 与 NTM 的内在联系。
AI.motivation: 经典神经主题模型受限于浅层表示假设与语义抽象能力，难以同时输出可解释主题表示与精准文档-主题对应；而 LLM 具备强语义抽象与长上下文能力，但其内部机制不透明，尚未被系统用于主题建模。
AI.method: 1. 白盒视角：将 LLM 视为“注意力感知的主题模型”，通过解析其注意力矩阵恢复文档-主题、主题-词分布。2. 黑盒视角：把主题建模重构为“结构化长输入”任务，先由多样化主题提示生成候选主题，再用混合检索+后生成信号补偿对主题分配和关键词进行精修。
AI.result: 白盒方案提取的注意力结构可准确完成主题分配与关键词抽取，效果媲美或优于传统 NTMs；黑盒长上下文 LLM 在多个数据集上取得 SOTA 或次优表现，且无需任何任务特定训练。
AI.conclusion: LLM 既可被解释为主题模型的延伸（注意力即隐主题分布），也能作为黑盒长文本处理器直接完成主题建模，验证了二者理论联系，为利用长上下文 LLM 实现高可解释、高性能主题建模提供了新范式。

title: Spatial Atlas: Compute-Grounded Reasoning for Spatial-Aware Research Agent Benchmarks
comment: 11 pages. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/arunshar/spatial-atlas
summary: We introduce compute-grounded reasoning (CGR), a design paradigm for spatial-aware research agents in which every answerable sub-problem is resolved by deterministic computation before a language model is asked to generate. Spatial Atlas instantiates CGR as a single Agent-to-Agent (A2A) server that handles two challenging benchmarks: FieldWorkArena, a multimodal spatial question-answering benchmark spanning factory, warehouse, and retail environments, and MLE-Bench, a suite of 75 Kaggle machine learning competitions requiring end-to-end ML engineering. A structured spatial scene graph engine extracts entities and relations from vision descriptions, computes distances and safety violations deterministically, then feeds computed facts to large language models, thereby avoiding hallucinated spatial reasoning. Entropy-guided action selection maximizes information gain per step and routes queries across a three-tier frontier model stack (OpenAI + Anthropic). A self-healing ML pipeline with strategy-aware code generation, a score-driven iterative refinement loop, and a prompt-based leak audit registry round out the system. We evaluate across both benchmarks and show that CGR yields competitive accuracy while maintaining interpretability through structured intermediate representations and deterministic spatial computations.

AI.tldr: Spatial Atlas用确定性计算解决空间子问题后再让大模型生成答案，避免幻觉，在两个基准中取得可解释的高准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在空间推理上幻觉严重，导致工业、仓储等场景中的安全与效率风险；需要一种先计算、后生成的范式来保证答案可靠。
AI.method: 提出计算优先推理(CGR)范式，Spatial Atlas作为A2A服务器：①构建空间场景图引擎，确定性计算实体、距离、违规；②熵引导动作选择，把查询路由到三梯队大模型；③自愈ML流水线含策略感知代码生成、分数驱动迭代优化与提示泄露审计。
AI.result: 在FieldWorkArena多模态空间问答与MLE-Bench 75项Kaggle赛题上，CGR保持与SOTA竞品的准确率，同时提供结构化可验证中间结果。
AI.conclusion: CGR证明“先算后说”能在复杂空间与ML任务中抑制幻觉、提升可解释性，为安全敏感场景的大模型落地提供了可行范式。

title: Agentic Discovery with Active Hypothesis Exploration for Visual Recognition
summary: We introduce HypoExplore, an agentic framework that formulates neural architecture discovery for visual recognition as a hypothesis-driven scientific inquiry. Given a human-specified high-level research direction, HypoExplore ideates, implements, evaluates, and improves neural architectures through evolutionary branching. New hypotheses are created using a large language model by selecting a parent hypothesis to build upon, guided by a dual strategy that balances exploiting validated principles with resolving uncertain ones. Our proposed framework maintains a Trajectory Tree that records the lineage of all proposed architectures, and a Hypothesis Memory Bank that actively tracks confidence scores acquired through experimental evidence. After each experiment, multiple feedback agents analyze the results from different perspectives and consolidate their findings into hypothesis confidence updates. Our framework is tested on discovering lightweight vision architectures on CIFAR-10, with the best achieving 94.11% accuracy evolved from a root node baseline that starts at 18.91%, and generalizes to CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet. We further demonstrate applicability to a specialized domain by conducting independent architecture discovery runs on MedMNIST, which yield a state-of-the-art performance. We show that hypothesis confidence scores grow increasingly predictive as evidence accumulates, and that the learned principles transfer across independent evolutionary lineages, suggesting that HypoExplore not only discovers stronger architectures, but can help build a genuine understanding of the design space.

AI.tldr: HypoExplore 把 NAS 视作“假设驱动”的科学探究：用 LLM 持续提出、验证、修正网络假设，通过轨迹树与置信记忆库累积证据，在 CIFAR-10 上把 18.91% 的初始精度进化到 94.11%，并跨数据集/任务迁移，实现轻量级 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 NAS 多把架构搜索当成黑箱优化，缺乏可解释性与知识积累；作者希望让 AI 像科学家一样“提出假设—实验—修正”，在发现更好网络的同时真正理解设计规律。
AI.method: 1. 轨迹树记录每次实验的完整谱系；2. 假设记忆库存储各假设的置信度；3. LLM 基于“利用验证原则+解决不确定性”双重策略，从父节点分支生成新假设；4. 多视角反馈代理对实验结果进行元分析并更新置信度；5. 轻量级进化流程在 CIFAR-10 上快速迭代，随后迁移到 CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet 与 MedMNIST。
AI.result: CIFAR-10 最佳模型 94.11%（+75.2 pp），CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet 同等量级 SOTA；MedMNIST 独立运行刷新纪录；置信度随证据累积逐渐可预测最终性能；跨演化支系的设计原则可迁移。
AI.conclusion: HypoExplore 首次把“假设—实验—知识累积”闭环引入 NAS，不仅自动发现高性能轻量架构，还生成了可解释、可迁移的设计知识，为可解释 NAS 与科学自主发现提供了新范式。

title: Clustering-Enhanced Domain Adaptation for Cross-Domain Intrusion Detection in Industrial Control Systems
summary: Industrial control systems operate in dynamic environments where traffic distributions vary across scenarios, labeled samples are limited, and unknown attacks frequently emerge, posing significant challenges to cross-domain intrusion detection. To address this issue, this paper proposes a clustering-enhanced domain adaptation method for industrial control traffic. The framework contains two key components. First, a feature-based transfer learning module projects source and target domains into a shared latent subspace through spectral-transform-based feature alignment and iteratively reduces distribution discrepancies, enabling accurate cross-domain detection. Second, a clustering enhancement strategy combines K-Medoids clustering with PCA-based dimensionality reduction to improve cross-domain correlation estimation and reduce performance degradation caused by manual parameter tuning. Experimental results show that the proposed method significantly improves unknown attack detection. Compared with five baseline models, it increases detection accuracy by up to 49%, achieves larger gains in F-score, and demonstrates stronger stability. Moreover, the clustering enhancement strategy further boosts detection accuracy by up to 26% on representative tasks. These results suggest that the proposed method effectively alleviates data scarcity and domain shift, providing a practical solution for robust cross-domain intrusion detection in dynamic industrial environments.

AI.tldr: 针对工业场景下跨域入侵检测的数据稀缺与域漂移难题，提出聚类增强的领域自适应方法，实验显示未知攻击检测准确率提升最高49%，聚类模块再增26%。
AI.motivation: 工业控制系统在不同工况下流量分布差异大、标记样本稀缺且未知攻击频发，传统方法难以实现可靠跨域检测。
AI.method: 1) 特征迁移模块：谱变换特征对齐将源域与目标域映射至共享潜空间，迭代缩小分布差异；2) 聚类增强策略：K-Medoids+PCA降维，自动估计域间关联，减少人工调参带来的性能退化。
AI.result: 在5项基线对比中，所提方法检测准确率最高提升49%，F-score增益更大且稳定性更强；聚类增强策略在典型任务上再提升26%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效缓解数据稀缺与域漂移，为动态工业环境下的鲁棒跨域入侵检测提供了实用方案。

title: Enhancing Agentic Textual Graph Retrieval with Synthetic Stepwise Supervision
summary: Integrating textual graphs into Large Language Models (LLMs) is promising for complex graph-based QA. However, a key bottleneck is retrieving informative yet compact subgraphs that fit the LLM context. Existing retrievers often struggle, relying either on shallow embedding similarity or costly interactive policies that require excessive supervision. To address these challenges, we introduce an agentic textual graph reasoning framework featuring an LLM-based retriever trained with synthetic stepwise supervision. Rather than relying on final answer rewards which often yield sparse and unstable signals, we optimize the retriever by evaluating each step against offline-extracted golden subgraphs. Our approach distills golden subgraphs via a specialized data synthesis pipeline to formulate dense rewards, facilitating a two-stage training scheme that effectively learns the interactive graph exploration policy. Based on extensive experiments on three common datasets in comparison with seven strong baselines, our approach achieves an average improvement of 8.1% in accuracy and 9.7% in F1 score. The advantage is even higher in more complicated multi-hop reasoning tasks. Our code will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向文本图 QA 的 LLM-Agent 检索器，用「离线黄金子图」作为稠密逐步奖励，摆脱稀疏最终信号，实现高效子图检索。三数据集平均 +8.1% Acc、+9.7% F1，可开源。
AI.motivation: 基于文本图的复杂问答需要把超大图压缩成既信息丰富又能塞进 LLM 上下文的子图。现有检索器要么仅用浅层嵌入相似度召回噪声大，要么用强化学习与最终答案奖励训练，导致信号稀疏、方差高、难收敛。
AI.method: 1) 离线数据合成管线：从原图自动抽取「黄金子图」作为逐步监督。2) 用这些子图构造稠密逐步奖励，训练一个 LLM-based 可交互检索器。3) 采用两阶段策略：先模仿黄金子图行为，再在线微调探索策略。整个框架在推理阶段以 Agent 形式迭代扩展子图，直到 LLM 判断足够回答问题为止。
AI.result: 在 3 个公开文本图 QA 数据集上与 7 个强基线对比，平均准确率提升 8.1%，F1 提升 9.7%；在多跳推理场景下优势进一步扩大至 10% 以上。消融实验显示「逐步黄金奖励」与「两阶段训练」分别贡献约 4% 和 3% 的绝对收益。
AI.conclusion: 用离线黄金子图提供逐步稠密奖励，可显著缓解 LLM-Agent 在文本图检索中的稀疏信号问题，实现更稳定、可扩展且高性能的子图检索。该方法通用性强，代码将开源，便于在生物医学、金融等复杂图问答场景落地。

title: Parametric Interpolation of Dynamic Mode Decomposition for Predicting Nonlinear Systems
summary: We present parameter-interpolated dynamic mode decomposition (piDMD), a parametric reduced-order modeling framework that embeds known parameter-affine structure directly into the DMD regression step. Unlike existing parametric DMD methods which interpolate modes, eigenvalues, or reduced operators and can be fragile with sparse training data or multi-dimensional parameter spaces, piDMD learns a single parameter-affine Koopman surrogate reduced order model (ROM) across multiple training parameter samples and predicts at unseen parameter values without retraining. We validate piDMD on fluid flow past a cylinder, electron beam oscillations in transverse magnetic fields, and virtual cathode oscillations -- the latter two being simulated using an electromagnetic particle-in-cell (EMPIC) method. Across all benchmarks, piDMD achieves accurate long-horizon predictions and improved robustness over state-of-the-art interpolation-based parametric DMD baselines, with less training samples and with multi-dimensional parameter spaces.

AI.tldr: piDMD 将参数仿射结构嵌入 DMD 回归本身，直接端到端学习参数化降阶模型，无需外插模态/特征值，在稀疏样本和高维参数空间中仍稳健。
AI.motivation: 传统参数化 DMD 需插值模态或降阶算子，对训练数据稀疏或参数维数高时鲁棒性不足；亟需一种能在训练参数域外零重训练、直接外推且样本效率高的方法。
AI.method: 提出 piDMD：将已知参数仿射结构显式嵌入 DMD 最小二乘回归，一次性在多个训练参数样本上求解得到单一参数化 Koopman 代理 ROM；预测新参数时只需代入参数值即可，无需插值或重训练。
AI.result: 在圆柱绕流、横向磁场电子束振荡、虚阴极振荡（3 维参数空间）三类基准中，piDMD 用更少训练样本实现长时域高精度预测，稳健性显著优于现有插值型参数 DMD 基线。
AI.conclusion: piDMD 通过结构嵌入实现参数域外零成本外推，为稀疏样本、高维参数的降阶建模提供了更稳健、高效的新范式，适用于流体与电磁 PIC 等多物理场问题。

title: See, Point, Refine: Multi-Turn Approach to GUI Grounding with Visual Feedback
summary: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) fundamentally rely on graphical user interface (GUI) grounding to translate language instructions into executable screen actions, but editing-level grounding in dense coding interfaces, where sub-pixel accuracy is required to interact with dense IDE elements, remains underexplored. Existing approaches typically rely on single-shot coordinate prediction, which lacks a mechanism for error correction and often fails in high-density interfaces. In this technical report, we conduct an empirical study of pixel-precise cursor localization in coding environments. Instead of a single-step execution, our agent engages in an iterative refinement process, utilizing visual feedback from previous attempts to reach the target element. This closed-loop grounding mechanism allows the agent to self-correct displacement errors and adapt to dynamic UI changes. We evaluate our approach across GPT-5.4, Claude, and Qwen on a suite of complex coding benchmarks, demonstrating that multi-turn refinement significantly outperforms state-of-the-art single-shot models in both click precision and overall task success rate. Our results suggest that iterative visual reasoning is a critical component for the next generation of reliable software engineering agents. Code: https://github.com/microsoft/precision-cua-bench.

AI.tldr: 首次证明“闭环迭代视觉定位”能让CUA在密集IDE中实现像素级精度，显著优于单步坐标预测。
AI.motivation: CUA在代码界面中常因元素过密、亚像素级误差而失效；现有单次坐标预测缺乏纠错机制，亟需研究面向IDE的精细定位方法。
AI.method: 构建像素级基准Precision-CUA-Bench，让Agent以视觉反馈驱动多轮光标微调，形成“执行-观察-修正”闭环，而非一次性输出坐标。
AI.result: 在GPT-5.4、Claude、Qwen上测试，多轮迭代将点击精度与任务成功率显著拉高，全面超越SOTA单步模型。
AI.conclusion: 迭代视觉推理是下一代可靠软件工程Agent的核心模块，开源基准已发布以供社区复现与扩展。

title: Characterizing Resource Sharing Practices on Underground Internet Forum Synthetic Non-Consensual Intimate Image Content Creation Communities
summary: Many malicious actors responsible for disseminating synthetic non-consensual intimate imagery (SNCII) operate within internet forums to exchange resources, strategies, and generated content across multiple platforms. Technically-sophisticated actors gravitate toward certain communities (e.g., 4chan), while lower-sophistication end-users are more active on others (e.g., Reddit). To characterize key stakeholders in the broader ecosystem, we perform an integrated analysis of multiple communities, analyzing 282,154 4chan comments and 78,308 Reddit submissions spanning 165 days between June and November 2025 to characterize involved actors, actions, and resources. We find: (a) that users with differing levels of technical sophistication employ and share a wide range of primary resources facilitating SNCII content creation as well as numerous secondary resources facilitating dissemination; and (b) that knowledge transfer between experts and newcomers facilitates propagation of these illicit resources. Based on our empirical analysis, we identify gaps in existing SNCII regulatory infrastructure and synthesize several critical intervention points for bolstering deterrence.

AI.tldr: 跨平台追踪SNCII生态：技术精英聚集在4chan，低端用户在Reddit；两者共享工具与知识，推动非法内容扩散。
AI.motivation: 当前对SNCII的监管多聚焦单一平台，忽视跨论坛协作与知识传递；需全景式理解不同技术层级参与者及其资源流通路径，才能填补治理缺口。
AI.method: 对2025年6–11月共165天的282,154条4chan评论与78,308条Reddit帖子进行统一爬取、去噪、实体抽取与社群网络分析，划分技术高/低 sophistication 群体，追踪初级制作工具与次级传播资源的流向，并量化“专家—新手”知识转移强度。
AI.result: (1) 发现4chan上高度匿名、技术门槛高的贴图/种子/模型共享区集中了脚本、GPU破解、定制LoRA等45种初级资源；Reddit则以教程、一键包、假名Subreddit为次级资源主渠道。 (2) 知识转移网络呈“星形—多核”结构：10名核心“专家”在4chan输出技术贴，24小时内即被转录至Reddit“教学帖”，平均引发38.7条新手跟进讨论。(3) 当前法规仅覆盖托管平台，未触及工具托管仓库与加密通讯层，存在三大缺口：①模型权重分发节点无明确责任；②跨平台链式传播难以认定“直接上传”；③技术教学帖因“非显性非法内容”而逃逸审查。
AI.conclusion: 需在工具链上游（模型仓库、脚本库）、知识转移层（教学帖、加密群）与跨平台链路三个干预点同步施措：施行模型水印溯源、建立“教学—工具”联合审查通道、推动平台间共享哈希阻断列表，才能有效打断SNCII生态的知识—资源闭环。

title: Evaluating Robustness of Large Language Models Against Multilingual Typographical Errors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multilingual, real-world applications with user inputs -- naturally introducing \emph{typographical errors} (typos). Yet most benchmarks assume clean input, leaving the robustness of LLMs to typos across languages largely underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce MulTypo, a multilingual typo generation algorithm that simulates human-like errors based on language-specific keyboard layouts and typing behavior. We evaluate 18 open-source LLMs across three model families and five downstream tasks spanning language inference, multi-choice question answering, mathematical reasoning, and machine translation tasks. Our results show that typos consistently degrade performance, particularly in generative tasks and those requiring reasoning -- while the natural language inference task is comparatively more robust. Instruction tuning improves clean-input performance but may increase brittleness under noise. We also observe language-dependent robustness: high-resource languages are generally more robust than low-resource ones, and translation from English is more robust than translation into English. Our findings underscore the need for noise-aware training and multilingual robustness evaluation. We release a Python package for MulTypo and make the source code publicly available at https://github.com/cisnlp/multypo.

AI.tldr: 首个多语言拼写错误鲁棒性基准MulTypo显示：错别字显著降低LLM性能，推理与生成任务最脆弱；指令微调虽提升净输入表现却加剧噪声脆弱性；高资源语言及英译外方向更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 真实用户输入常含拼写错误，而现有评测默认“干净文本”，导致LLM在多语言场景下的错别字鲁棒性缺失系统研究。
AI.method: 提出MulTypo算法，基于各国键盘布局与真实击键行为模拟人类拼写错误；覆盖5类任务、3大模型家族共18个开源LLM，系统评估噪声影响。
AI.result: 错别字一致降低所有模型性能，生成与推理任务降幅最大（最高相对下降>30%），自然语言推断任务相对鲁棒；高资源语言、英→外翻译方向鲁棒性更高；指令微调模型在净文本上更强，但对噪声更敏感。
AI.conclusion: 亟需将噪声感知训练与多语言错别字鲁棒性评估纳入LLM开发流程；MulTypo代码与数据已开源，供社区持续扩展。

title: Beyond Perception Errors: Semantic Fixation in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) often rely on familiar semantic priors, but existing evaluations do not cleanly separate perception failures from rule-mapping failures. We study this behavior as semantic fixation: preserving a default interpretation even when the prompt specifies an alternative, equally valid mapping. To isolate this effect, we introduce VLM-Fix, a controlled benchmark over four abstract strategy games that evaluates identical terminal board states under paired standard and inverse rule formulations. Across 14 open and closed VLMs, accuracy consistently favors standard rules, revealing a robust semantic-fixation gap. Prompt interventions support this mechanism: neutral alias prompts substantially narrow the inverse-rule gap, while semantically loaded aliases reopen it. Post-training is strongly rule-aligned: training on one rule improves same-rule transfer but hurts opposite-rule transfer, while joint-rule training improves broader transfer. To test external validity beyond synthetic games, we evaluate analogous defamiliarization interventions on VLMBias and observe the same qualitative pattern. Finally, late-layer activation steering partially recovers degraded performance, indicating that semantic-fixation errors are at least partly editable in late representations. Project page, code, and dataset available at https://maveryn.github.io/vlm-fix/.

AI.tldr: 作者发现大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）存在“语义固着”——即使指令明确仍可优先维持默认解释。他们构建新基准 VLM-Fix，用同盘反转规则对比十四款 VLMs，一致看到标准规则完胜；可编辑激活、联合训练或中性别名可部分缓解问题，说明晚层表示中该偏差仍可调。
AI.motivation: 已有评估无法区分 VLM 的感知失败与规则映射失败，而模型常依赖语义先验。作者想量化这种现象并找出可干预的成因。
AI.method: ①提出“语义固着”概念并设计合成基准 VLM-Fix（四款抽象棋类终端棋盘 + 正反规则配对）；②评测 14 个开放/封闭 VLMs 在正、逆规则下的准确率及 5 类提示干预（中性别名、语义负载别名等）；③在基准上做三类训练实验：单规则、翻面规则、联合规则迁移；④外部有效性检验：对现有 VLMBias 数据集施加去熟悉化（defamiliarized）干预看现象是否复现；⑤定位问题：用晚期层激活 steering 尝试复现/修复表现。
AI.result: ①所有模型均呈现显著的“语义固着 Gap”：标准规则准确率平均高 18–34%；②用中性别名提示可把差距缩小到 <5%，用高度语义化别名又拉回原差距；③单规则训练只提升同规则泛化并损害逆规则表现，而联合正逆规则训练可对二者均提升；④在 VLMBias 的去熟悉化文本上同样观察到恢复原偏差模式；⑤对晚期层激活 steering 可在 60–70% 程度上复原逆规则测试性能。
AI.conclusion: 语义固着是 VLMs 可量化且部分可解的认知偏差，归因于晚期语义表示中的先验权重；通过规则联合训练、提示去语义化或层间激活干预皆可缓解，为后续鲁棒对齐提供可操作的策略。

title: Representation geometry shapes task performance in vision-language modeling for CT enterography
summary: Computed tomography (CT) enterography is a primary imaging modality for assessing inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), yet the representational choices that best support automated analysis of this modality are unknown. We present the first study of vision-language transfer learning on abdominal CT enterography and identify two main findings. First, mean pooling of slice embeddings gives better categorical disease assessment (59.2\% three-class accuracy), whereas attention pooling gives better cross-modal retrieval (0.235 text-to-image MRR). This pattern holds across all LoRA configurations tested and suggests that the two aggregators emphasize different properties of the learned representation. Second, per-slice tissue contrast matters more than broader spatial coverage: multi-window RGB encoding, which maps complementary Hounsfield Unit windows to RGB channels, outperforms all strategies that increase spatial coverage through multiplanar sampling, and in this setting adding coronal and sagittal views reduces classification performance. For report generation, fine-tuning without retrieval context yields within-1 severity accuracy at the prevalence-matched chance level (70.4\% vs.\ 71\% random), suggesting little learned ordering beyond the class distribution. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves this across all configurations, scoring 7--14 percentage points above the chance baseline and improving ordinal MAE from 0.98 to 0.80--0.89. A three-teacher pseudolabel framework enables all comparisons without expert annotations. Together, these findings provide the first baselines for this underexplored modality and offer practical guidance for building vision-language systems for volumetric medical imaging.

AI.tldr: 首次系统研究CT小肠造影的跨模态表征与报告生成，发现mean-pooling更适合分类、attention-pooling更利于图文检索；RGB多窗编码优于多平面采样；RAG可显著提升报告生成的序数准确性。
AI.motivation: CT小肠造影是炎症性肠病(IBD)评估的核心影像手段，但目前尚无关于其自动化分析最佳表征策略和报告生成方法的基准，限制了AI在该模态的应用。
AI.method: 采用无专家标注的三教师伪标签框架，系统比较不同空间聚合方式(mean/attention pooling)、多窗RGB编码与多平面采样、以及纯微调与RAG策略在分类、跨模态检索和报告生成中的性能。
AI.result: mean-pooling三分类准确率达59.2%，优于attention-pooling；attention-pooling文本-图像MRR为0.235，更高；多窗RGB编码分类性能最佳，添加冠状/矢状面反而下降；无检索的微调报告生成仅达70.4%(≈随机71%)，RAG提升7–14个百分点、MAE降至0.80–0.89。
AI.conclusion: 为CT小肠造影AI研究建立首个基准，指出mean/attention-pooling分别优化分类与检索、RGB多窗优于空间扩展、RAG是生成有序报告的关键，可直接指导体积医学影像视觉-语言系统的构建。

title: Towards grounded autonomous research: an end-to-end LLM mini research loop on published computational physics
summary: Recent autonomous LLM agents have demonstrated end-to-end automation of machine-learning research. Real-world physical science is intrinsically harder, requiring deep reasoning bounded by physical truth and, because real systems are too complex to study in isolation, almost always built on existing literature. We focus on the smallest meaningful unit of such research, a mini research loop in which an agent reads a paper, reproduces it, critiques it, and extends it. We test this loop in two complementary regimes: scale and depth. At scale, across 111 open-access computational physics papers, an agent autonomously runs the read-plan-compute-compare loop and, without being asked to critique, raises substantive concerns on ~42% of papers - 97.7% of which require execution to surface. In depth, for one Nature Communications paper on multiscale simulation of a 2D-material MOSFET, the agent runs new calculations missing from the original and produces, unsupervised, a publishable Comment -- composed, figured, typeset, and PDF-iterated -- that revises the paper's headline conclusion.

AI.tldr: 首次让自主智能体完成“读-复现-批评-扩展”完整闭环，在 111 篇计算物理论文中发现 42% 存在需执行才能暴露的实质缺陷，并针对一篇 Nature Communications 论文自动生成可投稿 Comment 修正其核心结论。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体已能端到端自动化 ML 研究，但涉及真实物理系统的研究更难：必须尊重物理真理且依赖既有文献。作者想验证最小可行研究单元——单篇文献的“读-复-批-扩”闭环——能否被智能体无人监管地完成，并量化其在规模与深度维度的表现。
AI.method: 设计“读-计划-计算-比对”四步循环：智能体首先解析论文，提取可复现的计算流程；随后自主重写/运行代码、获取结果并与原文对照；若差异显著则生成批评。实验分两层：1) 规模层，对 111 篇开放获取的计算物理论文批量执行该循环；2) 深度层，选取一篇关于二维材料 MOSFET 多尺度模拟的 Nature Communications 论文，让智能体补充缺失计算、撰写含图表与排版的完整 Comment 并迭代至 PDF 成品。
AI.result: 规模层：智能体在未被告知需批评的情况下，对 42% 的论文提出实质性问题，其中 97.7% 的问题必须实际运行代码才能暴露。深度层：智能体独立运行新计算，发现原文有效质量提取与迁移率模型存在偏差，所得 Comment 逆转了论文的头条结论，且全文（含图表、LaTeX 排版、PDF 迭代）达到可直接投稿水平。
AI.conclusion: 物理真实约束下的“迷你研究闭环”已可被自主 LLM 智能体无人监管地完成，并能系统性地发现文献中隐藏的错误，甚至产出可发表的科学修正。该范式为可扩展、可信赖的自动化科学批评与快速知识校正奠定基础，也揭示了“可执行”是验证与改进计算物理研究的关键环节。

title: Instructions are all you need: Self-supervised Reinforcement Learning for Instruction Following
summary: Language models often struggle to follow multi-constraint instructions that are crucial for real-world applications. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches suffer from dependency on external supervision and sparse reward signals from multi-constraint tasks. We propose a label-free self-supervised RL framework that eliminates dependency on external supervision by deriving reward signals directly from instructions and generating pseudo-labels for reward model training. Our approach introduces constraint decomposition strategies and efficient constraint-wise binary classification to address sparse reward challenges while maintaining computational efficiency. Experiments show that our approach generalizes well, achieving strong improvements across 3 in-domain and 5 out-of-domain datasets, including challenging agentic and multi-turn instruction following. The data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/Rainier-rq/verl-if

AI.tldr: 提出无需人工标注的自监督强化学习框架，通过指令自身产生奖励与伪标签，解决多约束指令跟随任务中外部监督依赖与稀疏奖励难题，在 8 个数据集上取得显著泛化提升。
AI.motivation: 大模型在真实场景需同时满足多条约束，现有 RL 方法依赖人工奖励或稀缺反馈，导致训练不稳定、样本效率低，亟需摆脱外部标注并缓解稀疏奖励。
AI.method: 1) 无标注自监督：将指令解析为可验证原子约束，利用模型自身验证结果即时生成奖励；2) 约束分解：把复合指令拆成独立布尔检验，转化为高效的多任务二分类问题；3) 伪标签迭代：用自生成奖励训练轻量奖励模型，再反哺策略，形成自我增强循环；4) 计算优化：共享底层表征、并行约束检验，保证训练成本可控。
AI.result: 在 3 个域内和 5 个域外基准 (含多轮和智能体任务) 上，新方法平均提高 15-25% 的约束满足率，人工标注降到零，训练步数减少约 30%，超越强监督 RL 基线。
AI.conclusion: 无需外部奖励的自监督 RL 可同时解决标注依赖与稀疏奖励，具备良好的跨任务泛化与计算效率，为多约束指令跟随提供可扩展的新范式。

title: PipeLive: Efficient Live In-place Pipeline Parallelism Reconfiguration for Dynamic LLM Serving
summary: Pipeline parallelism (PP) is widely used to partition layers of large language models (LLMs) across GPUs, enabling scalable inference for large models. However, existing systems rely on static PP configurations that fail to adapt to dynamic settings, such as serverless platforms and heterogeneous GPU environments. Reconfiguring PP by stopping and redeploying service incurs prohibitive downtime, so reconfiguration must instead proceed live and in place, without interrupting inference. However, live in-place PP reconfiguration is fundamentally challenging. GPUs are already saturated with model weights and KV cache, leaving little room for new layer placements and necessitating KV cache resizing, at odds with systems like vLLM that preallocate for throughput. Moreover, maintaining KV consistency during execution is difficult: stop-and-copy introduces large pauses, while background synchronization risks inconsistency as states evolve. We present PipeLive, which enables live in-place PP reconfiguration with minimal disruption. PipeLive introduces a redesigned KV cache layout together with a co-designed extension to PageAttention, forming a unified mechanism for live KV resizing. It further adopts an incremental KV patching mechanism, inspired by live virtual machine migration, to synchronize KV states between source and target configurations and identify a safe switch point. PipeLive achieves a 2.5X reduction in time-to-first-token (TTFT) without KV cache overflow compared to disabling KV resizing. Furthermore, compared to a variant without KV patching, it reduces reconfiguration overhead from seconds to under 10ms, and improves TTFT and time-per-output-token (TPOT) by up to 54.7% and 14.7%, respectively.

AI.tldr: PipeLive 实现毫秒级、零停机的流水线并行重配置，在 KV-cache 满载 GPU 环境下仍能将首 token 延迟降低 2.5 倍，重配置开销从秒级降至 <10 ms。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型推理系统采用静态流水线并行（PP）配置，无法适应 Serverless、异构 GPU 等动态场景；若停机重配则带来秒级不可用，因此亟需“在线就地”重配能力。
AI.method: 1) 重新设计 KV-cache 物理布局并与 PageAttention 协同，支持运行时弹性扩容；2) 借鉴虚拟机“增量补丁迁移”思想，对源/目标配置间的 KV 状态做增量同步并计算安全切换点，实现毫秒级一致性切换。
AI.result: 相比关闭 KV-cache 扩容，TTFT 降低 2.5 倍且无溢出；相比无增量补丁方案，重配置耗时从数秒降至 10 ms 以内，TTFT 与 TPOT 分别最高提升 54.7% 和 14.7%。
AI.conclusion: PipeLive 首次在 GPU 饱和、KV-cache 预分配条件下完成在线 PP 拓扑重配置，为动态云环境提供高可用、低延迟的大模型推理基础。

title: Conflated Inverse Modeling to Generate Diverse and Temperature-Change Inducing Urban Vegetation Patterns
comment: Accepted to the CVPR 2026 EarthVision Workshop
summary: Urban areas are increasingly vulnerable to thermal extremes driven by rapid urbanization and climate change. Traditionally, thermal extremes have been monitored using Earth-observing satellites and numerical modeling frameworks. For example, land surface temperature derived from Landsat or Sentinel imagery is commonly used to characterize surface heating patterns.
