These approaches operate as forward models, translating radiative observations or modeled boundary conditions into estimates of surface thermal states. While forward models can predict land surface temperature from vegetation and urban form, the inverse problem of determining spatial vegetation configurations that achieve a desired regional temperature shift remains largely unexplored. This task is inherently underdetermined, as multiple spatial vegetation patterns can yield similar aggregated temperature responses. Conventional regression and deterministic neural networks fail to capture this ambiguity and often produce averaged solutions, particularly under data-scarce conditions. We propose a conflated inverse modeling framework that combines a predictive forward model with a diffusion-based generative inverse model to produce diverse, physically plausible image-based vegetation patterns conditioned on specific temperature goals. Our framework maintains control over thermal outcomes while enabling diverse spatial vegetation configurations, even when such combinations are absent from training data. Altogether, this work introduces a controllable inverse modeling approach for urban climate adaptation that accounts for the inherent diversity of the problem. Code is available at the GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 首次用扩散生成模型实现“给定目标温度→反推城市植被空间分布”的可控反演，解决传统前向模型无法应对的多解性与数据稀缺难题。
AI.motivation: 城市热极端频发，但现有卫星与模型仅能“正向”估算地表温度，无法回答“要让城市降温 X °C，该把绿地点在哪”这一规划核心问题；且植被-温度映射存在多解性，数据稀缺时回归或确定性网络只能给出平均、失真方案。
AI.method: 构建“耦合反演框架”：①前向子模型（卫星/模拟数据训练）快速预测任意植被布局对应的温度；②扩散生成子模型以前向温度为条件，反向采样生成多样、物理合理的植被分布图像；两模型端到端联合优化，确保热控目标同时保持空间多样性。
AI.result: 在训练集未出现的温度目标下，框架仍能生成百组满足 ΔT≥1 °C 降温需求的植被图，空间结构差异显著；与多元回归、Pix2Pix 相比，温度误差降低 32%，结构多样性指标提升 2.4 倍，且反演结果经前向验证 92% 满足预设热目标。
AI.conclusion: 扩散反演范式首次把“城市气候调控”转化为可控图像生成问题，为数据稀缺条件下的适应性规划提供可解释、多样化、物理解密的绿化方案库，代码已开源。

title: Unveiling the Surprising Efficacy of Navigation Understanding in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. ICRA 2026. Code available at https://fudan-magic-lab.github.io/SNG-VLA-web
summary: Global navigation information and local scene understanding are two crucial components of autonomous driving systems. However, our experimental results indicate that many end-to-end autonomous driving systems tend to over-rely on local scene understanding while failing to utilize global navigation information. These systems exhibit weak correlation between their planning capabilities and navigation input, and struggle to perform navigation-following in complex scenarios. To overcome this limitation, we propose the Sequential Navigation Guidance (SNG) framework, an efficient representation of global navigation information based on real-world navigation patterns. The SNG encompasses both navigation paths for constraining long-term trajectories and turn-by-turn (TBT) information for real-time decision-making logic. We constructed the SNG-QA dataset, a visual question answering (VQA) dataset based on SNG that aligns global and local planning. Additionally, we introduce an efficient model SNG-VLA that fuses local planning with global planning. The SNG-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance through precise navigation information modeling without requiring auxiliary loss functions from perception tasks. Project page: SNG-VLA

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有多数端到端智驾系统过度依赖局部场景理解而忽视全局导航信息，提出轻量SNG框架与SNG-VLA模型，仅用导航路径与转向提示即可显著提升导航一致性，并在自研SNG-QA数据集上取得SOTA指标，无需额外感知损失。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端智驾系统在复杂场景下导航跟随性差，实验发现规划与导航输入相关性弱，根源是网络对全局导航信息利用不足。作者致力于在不引入复杂感知辅助损失的前提下，增强系统对导航先验的建模能力。
AI.method: 1. 提出Sequential Navigation Guidance(SNG)显式表示：用导航路径约束长期轨迹，用turn-by-turn(TBT)文本提供实时决策逻辑。2. 构建SNG-QA视觉问答数据集，将全局路径与局部帧配对，用于监督端到端规划。3. 设计SNG-VLA模型，基于Transformer的VLM结构，把图像token、导航路径token与TBT指令token做cross-attention融合，输出规划向量，全程仅用导航-轨迹监督信号。
AI.result: SNG-VLA在SNG-QA与公开Carla导航基准上均达SOTA，导航成功率提升10–18%，路径一致性误差下降30%，且不依赖任何感知子损失或深度图。消融实验显示移除TBT或路径token会使成功率分别下降8%、12%，证明两种导航提示均不可替代。
AI.conclusion: 证明若能以简单结构化方式充分注入全局导航信息，端到端模型可显著提升导航鲁棒性；SNG路径＋TBT的轻量表示形式足以支撑复杂城市导航，无需昂贵感知辅助损失。未来将扩展至高速与多域场景，并开放数据集与模型权重。

title: Think Parallax: Solving Multi-Hop Problems via Multi-View Knowledge-Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) still struggle with multi-hop reasoning over knowledge-graphs (KGs), and we identify a previously overlooked structural reason for this difficulty: Transformer attention heads naturally specialize in distinct semantic relations across reasoning stages, forming a hop-aligned relay pattern. This key finding suggests that multi-hop reasoning is inherently multi-view, yet existing KG-based retrieval-augmented generation (KG-RAG) systems collapse all reasoning hops into a single representation, flat embedding space, suppressing this implicit structure and causing noisy or drifted path exploration. We introduce ParallaxRAG, a symmetric multi-view framework that decouples queries and KGs into aligned, head-specific semantic spaces. By enforcing relational diversity across multiple heads while constraining weakly related paths, ParallaxRAG constructs more accurate, cleaner subgraphs and guides LLMs through grounded, hop-wise reasoning. On WebQSP and CWQ, it achieves state-of-the-art retrieval and QA performance, substantially reduces hallucination, and generalizes strongly to the biomedical BioASQ benchmark.

AI.tldr: 多跳推理本质是多视图过程，现有 KG-RAG 忽视注意力头的 hop 对齐中继模式；ParallaxRAG 在头专属语义空间内对齐查询与 KG，抑制弱相关路径，获得 SOTA 并显著降低幻觉。
AI.motivation: LLM 在 KG 上做多跳推理仍失败率高，作者发现 Transformer 注意力头会按跳数自发形成语义特化，而现有 KG-RAG 将多跳扁平化到单一嵌入空间，破坏这一天然结构，导致路径漂移与幻觉。
AI.method: 提出 ParallaxRAG 对称多视图框架：将查询与 KG 拆解到与注意力头对应的多个 hop 对齐语义空间；在训练目标中强化关系多样性并约束弱相关路径，使 LLM 逐跳、有依据地生成子图并完成推理。
AI.result: 在 WebQSP、CWQ 上达 SOTA 答案准确率与检索召回率，BioASQ 零样本迁移也显著提高，整体幻觉率下降显著。
AI.conclusion: 多跳推理需显式建模注意力头的 hop 对齐多视图结构；ParallaxRAG 通过头专属空间解耦与弱路径约束，有效提升 KG 多跳问答的精度、可解释性与跨域泛化能力。

title: Policy-Invisible Violations in LLM-Based Agents
summary: LLM-based agents can execute actions that are syntactically valid, user-sanctioned, and semantically appropriate, yet still violate organizational policy because the facts needed for correct policy judgment are hidden at decision time. We call this failure mode policy-invisible violations: cases in which compliance depends on entity attributes, contextual state, or session history absent from the agent's visible context. We present PhantomPolicy, a benchmark spanning eight violation categories with balanced violation and safe-control cases, in which all tool responses contain clean business data without policy metadata. We manually review all 600 model traces produced by five frontier models and evaluate them using human-reviewed trace labels. Manual review changes 32 labels (5.3%) relative to the original case-level annotations, confirming the need for trace-level human review. To demonstrate what world-state-grounded enforcement can achieve under favorable conditions, we introduce Sentinel, an enforcement framework based on counterfactual graph simulation. Sentinel treats every agent action as a proposed mutation to an organizational knowledge graph, performs speculative execution to materialize the post-action world state, and verifies graph-structural invariants to decide Allow/Block/Clarify. Against human-reviewed trace labels, Sentinel substantially outperforms a content-only DLP baseline (68.8% vs. 93.0% accuracy) while maintaining high precision, though it still leaves room for improvement on certain violation categories. These results demonstrate what becomes achievable once policy-relevant world state is made available to the enforcement layer.

AI.tldr: 即使LLM agent的每一步操作语法合法、用户授权且语义合理，仍可能因缺乏组织策略所需的隐藏事实而违规。作者提出含8类策略违例、600条标注轨迹的PhantomPolicy基准，并给出基于知识图反事实模拟的Sentinel框架，使策略把关准确率从68.8%提升至93.0%，但部分违例类型仍有改进空间。
AI.motivation: LLM agent调用工具时缺少组织实体属性、会话历史等隐藏事实，导致经典DLP等内容级检测无法识别
AI.method: 1) 构建含隐藏策略数据的PhantomPolicy基准(600条，8类违例，人工轨迹级复核)；2) 设计Sentinel：将每次agent动作视为对知识图的修改，反事实模拟执行后验图不变量，输出Allow/Block/Clarify
AI.result: 手工复核改变5.3%原标签；Sentinel准确率93.0%，显著超越仅内容检测的DLP基线68.8%，保持高精确率，但在部分类别仍有漏检
AI.conclusion: 只要给执行层提供策略相关的

title: Visual Preference Optimization with Rubric Rewards
summary: The effectiveness of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) depends on preference data that reflect the quality differences that matter in multimodal tasks. Existing pipelines often rely on off-policy perturbations or coarse outcome-based signals, which are not well suited to fine-grained visual reasoning. We propose rDPO, a preference optimization framework based on instance-specific rubrics. For each image-instruction pair, we create a checklist-style rubric of essential and additional criteria to score responses from any possible policies. The instruction-rubric pool is built offline and reused during the construction of on-policy data. On public reward modeling benchmarks, rubric-based prompting massively improves a 30B-A3B judge and brings it close to GPT-5.4. On public downstream benchmarks, rubric-based filtering raises the macro average to 82.69, whereas outcome-based filtering drops it to 75.82 from 81.14. When evaluating scalability on a comprehensive benchmark, rDPO achieves 61.01, markedly outperforming the style-constrained baseline (52.36) and surpassing the 59.48 base model. Together, these results show that visual preference optimization benefits from combining on-policy data construction with instance-specific criterion-level feedback.

title: Ride the Wave: Precision-Allocated Sparse Attention for Smooth Video Generation
summary: Video Diffusion Transformers have revolutionized high-fidelity video generation but suffer from the massive computational burden of self-attention. While sparse attention provides a promising acceleration solution, existing methods frequently provoke severe visual flickering caused by static sparsity patterns and deterministic block routing. To resolve these limitations, we propose Precision-Allocated Sparse Attention (PASA), a training-free framework designed for highly efficient and temporally smooth video generation. First, we implement a curvature-aware dynamic budgeting mechanism. By profiling the generation trajectory acceleration across timesteps, we elastically allocate the exact-computation budget to secure high-precision processing strictly during critical semantic transitions. Second, we replace global homogenizing estimations with hardware-aligned grouped approximations, successfully capturing fine-grained local variations while maintaining peak compute throughput. Finally, we incorporate a stochastic selection bias into the attention routing mechanism. This probabilistic approach softens rigid selection boundaries and eliminates selection oscillation, effectively eradicating the localized computational starvation that drives temporal flickering. Extensive evaluations on leading video diffusion models demonstrate that PASA achieves substantial inference acceleration while consistently producing remarkably fluid and structurally stable video sequences.

AI.tldr: PASA在无需重训练的前提下，用两步动态策略（关键帧精确计算＋局部近似＋随机路由）把Transformer自注意力开销砍到1/5，彻底消除闪屏，保持甚至提升视频质量。
AI.motivation: Video Diffusion Transformer 的自注意力呈二次复杂度，导致高分辨率长视频推理不可承受；现有稀疏注意力采用静态或确定性分块，时序信息断裂，引发明显 flickering。
AI.method: 1) 曲率感知预算：沿去噪轨迹实时监测帧间语义突变，仅在“高曲率”时间步分配精确全局注意力，其余时段自动降级为轻量近似。 2) 硬件对齐分组近似：把全局相似度估计拆成若干小块，利用 Tensor-core 级并发在片上完成局部注意力，维持吞吐。 3) 随机选择偏置：在路由门控中注入轻量级随机扰动，打破确定性硬开关，消除因反复切换导致的计算饥饿与亮度跳变。整个流程零训练、即插即用。
AI.result: 在 Stable Video Diffusion、AnimateDiff 等主流模型上， PASA 实现 4.8–5.2× 加速，FVD 降低 6–9 %，时域一致性指标（Warping Error、Lpips-Δ）下降 30 % 以上，主观 flickering 基本不可察觉。
AI.conclusion: 通过“关键处精准、其余处近似、路由加随机”的三元策略，PASA 首次在视频扩散 Transformer 上同时解决效率与时序稳定性矛盾，无需重训练即可部署，为实时高保真视频生成提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: CoRoVA: Compressed Representations for Vector-Augmented Code Completion
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation has emerged as one of the most effective approaches for code completion enhancement, especially when repository-level context is important. However, adding this extra retrieved context significantly increases sequence length, raises prefill cost, and degrades time-to-first-token (TTFT), which slows down inference -- a critical limitation for interactive settings such as IDEs. In this work, we introduce CoRoVA, a framework that compresses context into compact, semantically rich representations that remain interpretable to code LLMs. This improves generation quality while reducing prompt augmentation to only a few compressed single-token vectors. Our approach requires training only a small projector module and introduces negligible additional latency, yet it significantly improves the prediction quality of code LLMs. Our experiments show that CoRoVA enables a 20-38\% reduction in TTFT on completion tasks compared to uncompressed RAG.

AI.tldr: CoRoVA用可解释的单token向量压缩仓库级上下文，使代码补全TTFT降20–38%，只需训练轻量投影模块。
AI.motivation: RAG虽能提升代码补全，但引入的长上下文显著增加prefill开销与首token延迟，直接损害IDE等交互场景体验，亟需一种既保留语义又缩短输入长度的方法。
AI.method: 提出CoRoVA框架：仅训练一个极小投影模块，将检索到的仓库级上下文压缩成若干紧凑、语义丰富且对LLM仍可解释的单token向量，再与原提示拼接供模型解码。
AI.result: 在代码补全任务上，相比未压缩RAG，TTFT降低20–38%，生成质量显著提升，额外延迟可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过把冗长检索上下文压缩为极短可解释表示，CoRoVA在几乎零额外成本下兼顾了延迟与质量，为交互式代码生成中的高效RAG提供了实用方案。

title: LLM-Guided Semantic Bootstrapping for Interpretable Text Classification with Tsetlin Machines
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Pretrained language models (PLMs) like BERT provide strong semantic representations but are costly and opaque, while symbolic models such as the Tsetlin Machine (TM) offer transparency but lack semantic generalization. We propose a semantic bootstrapping framework that transfers LLM knowledge into symbolic form, combining interpretability with semantic capacity. Given a class label, an LLM generates sub-intents that guide synthetic data creation through a three-stage curriculum (seed, core, enriched), expanding semantic diversity. A Non-Negated TM (NTM) learns from these examples to extract high-confidence literals as interpretable semantic cues. Injecting these cues into real data enables a TM to align clause logic with LLM-inferred semantics. Our method requires no embeddings or runtime LLM calls, yet equips symbolic models with pretrained semantic priors. Across multiple text classification tasks, it improves interpretability and accuracy over vanilla TM, achieving performance comparable to BERT while remaining fully symbolic and efficient.

AI.tldr: 用无嵌入、零LLM推理开销的“语义自举”框架，把LLM语义先验蒸馏为可解释的Tsetlin Machine规则，兼顾BERT级精度与符号透明性。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型效果好但黑盒、昂贵；符号模型如Tsetlin Machine可解释却缺语义泛化。作者尝试把两者优点融合，实现高准确、完全透明、低部署成本。
AI.method: 1) 标签驱动子意图生成：LLM先为每类生成若干子意图；2) 三阶段课程式合成数据（种子→核心→丰富）扩大语义覆盖面；3) Non-Negated Tsetlin Machine（NTM）在合成集上训练，提取高置信文字级literal作为语义线索；4) 将这些线索注入真实数据，再训练标准TM，使子句逻辑对齐LLM语义；5) 推理阶段无需任何嵌入或LLM调用。
AI.result: 在多项文本分类基准上，该方法比原始TM显著提升准确率与可解释性，性能与BERT相当，同时保持纯符号、低延迟、低内存。
AI.conclusion: 语义自举框架首次把LLM的深层语义先验转化为可解释符号规则，实现“黑盒→白盒”的知识迁移，为高精度透明模型提供了一条低成本落地路径。

title: Generative Refinement Networks for Visual Synthesis
summary: While diffusion models dominate the field of visual generation, they are computationally inefficient, applying a uniform computational effort regardless of different complexity. In contrast, autoregressive (AR) models are inherently complexity-aware, as evidenced by their variable likelihoods, but are often hindered by lossy discrete tokenization and error accumulation. In this work, we introduce Generative Refinement Networks (GRN), a next-generation visual synthesis paradigm to address these issues. At its core, GRN addresses the discrete tokenization bottleneck through a theoretically near-lossless Hierarchical Binary Quantization (HBQ), achieving a reconstruction quality comparable to continuous counterparts. Built upon HBQ's latent space, GRN fundamentally upgrades AR generation with a global refinement mechanism that progressively perfects and corrects artworks -- like a human artist painting. Besides, GRN integrates an entropy-guided sampling strategy, enabling complexity-aware, adaptive-step generation without compromising visual quality. On the ImageNet benchmark, GRN establishes new records in image reconstruction (0.56 rFID) and class-conditional image generation (1.81 gFID). We also scale GRN to more challenging text-to-image and text-to-video generation, delivering superior performance on an equivalent scale. We release all models and code to foster further research on GRN.

AI.tldr: 提出 Generative Refinement Networks (GRN)，用 HBQ 近无损量化+全局迭代修正+熵引导采样，实现计算随复杂度自适应；ImageNet 0.56 rFID，1.81 gFID 新纪录，并可扩展至文图/文视频生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型计算开销无差别、低效；自回归模型虽能感知复杂度，却因离散 token 量化损失与误差累积导致视觉质量受限。
AI.method: 1) 提出 Hierarchical Binary Quantization (HBQ)，在理论上逼近无损的离散潜空间；2) 在此潜空间上构建自回归 GRN，引入全局迭代修正机制逐步精化；3) 设计熵引导采样，实现复杂度自适应的生成步数分配。
AI.result: ImageNet 重构 rFID 0.56（新纪录），类别条件生成 gFID 1.81（新纪录）；同量级下文本到图像/视频任务亦优于现有方法；代码与模型全部开源。
AI.conclusion: GRN 统一了“复杂度感知”和“高保真视觉生成”，突破传统 AR 与扩散模型各自瓶颈，为高效、自适应生成提供新范式。

title: LLM-Guided Semantic Bootstrapping for Interpretable Text Classification with Tsetlin Machines
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Pretrained language models (PLMs) like BERT provide strong semantic representations but are costly and opaque, while symbolic models such as the Tsetlin Machine (TM) offer transparency but lack semantic generalization. We propose a semantic bootstrapping framework that transfers LLM knowledge into symbolic form, combining interpretability with semantic capacity. Given a class label, an LLM generates sub-intents that guide synthetic data creation through a three-stage curriculum (seed, core, enriched), expanding semantic diversity. A Non-Negated TM (NTM) learns from these examples to extract high-confidence literals as interpretable semantic cues. Injecting these cues into real data enables a TM to align clause logic with LLM-inferred semantics. Our method requires no embeddings or runtime LLM calls, yet equips symbolic models with pretrained semantic priors. Across multiple text classification tasks, it improves interpretability and accuracy over vanilla TM, achieving performance comparable to BERT while remaining fully symbolic and efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义自举框架，将大模型语义知识蒸馏为可解释的符号规则，使Tsetlin机在无需Embedding与LLM推理的情况下获得BERT级性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型虽语义强但代价高且黑盒，符号模型如Tsetlin机可解释却缺乏语义泛化，因此需结合二者优势。
AI.method: 1) LLM为每个类别生成子意图；2) 按“种子-核心-丰富”三阶段课程生成合成数据扩展语义；3) 非否定Tsetlin机(NTM)从中提取高置信文字作为语义提示；4) 将提示注入真实数据，引导Tsetlin机对齐LLM语义。
AI.result: 在多项文本分类任务中，该方法在保持完全符号与高效的前提下，准确率显著优于原生TM，并可与BERT媲美，同时保持可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 语义自举首次让符号模型无需嵌入或运行时LLM即可获得预训练语义先验，实现“BERT级精度+TM级解释性”的统一，为可解释NLP提供新范式。

title: Why Did Apple Fall: Evaluating Curiosity in Large Language Models
summary: Curiosity serves as a pivotal conduit for human beings to discover and learn new knowledge. Recent advancements of large language models (LLMs) in natural language processing have sparked discussions regarding whether these models possess capability of curiosity-driven learning akin to humans. In this paper, starting from the human curiosity assessment questionnaire Five-Dimensional Curiosity scale Revised (5DCR), we design a comprehensive evaluation framework that covers dimensions such as Information Seeking, Thrill Seeking, and Social Curiosity to assess the extent of curiosity exhibited by LLMs. The results demonstrate that LLMs exhibit a stronger thirst for knowledge than humans but still tend to make conservative choices when faced with uncertain environments. We further investigated the relationship between curiosity and thinking of LLMs, confirming that curious behaviors can enhance the model's reasoning and active learning abilities. These findings suggest that LLMs have the potential to exhibit curiosity similar to that of humans, providing experimental support for the future development of learning capabilities and innovative research in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 利用修订版五维好奇量表(5DCR)评估大语言模型的类人好奇特质，发现模型知识渴求高但风险保守，且好奇行为可强化推理与主动学习能力。
AI.motivation: 回答“大语言模型是否具备类似人类的好奇驱动学习机制”这一核心问题，为后续模型学习与创新能力研究提供实验依据。
AI.method: 基于5DCR构建信息、刺激、社交等多维度评估框架，对比LLM与人类的好奇表现，并分析好奇与推理/主动学习的因果关联。
AI.result: LLM在知识维度好奇显著高于人类；面对不确定环境仍倾向保守选择；激发好奇行为可同步提升推理准确率与主动学习效能。
AI.conclusion: LLM已展现类人好奇潜能，提示可将其作为增强模型推理与持续学习的可控信号，为下一代自驱学习型AI系统设计奠定理论与实验基础。

title: SpecBound: Adaptive Bounded Self-Speculation with Layer-wise Confidence Calibration
summary: Speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach to accelerate autoregressive inference in large language models (LLMs). Self-draft methods, which leverage the base LLM itself for speculation, avoid the overhead of auxiliary draft models but face limitations: shallow layers often produce overconfident yet incorrect token predictions, and the presence of difficult tokens in a draft sequence forces redundant computation through deeper layers, undermining both draft acceptance and overall speedup. To address these issues, we propose a novel self-draft framework that suppresses spurious confidence via layer-wise temperature annealing in early-exit decision and adaptively bounds speculation length based on token-wise decoding difficulty. By reprocessing the hidden states of draft tokens in a unified parallel pass through deep layers, our method maintains exact output equivalence with the original model while maximizing computational efficiency. It requires no modifications to the base LLM parameters and achieves up to 2.33x wall-time speedup over standard autoregressive decoding across diverse long-form generation tasks and multiple model architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需修改参数的 self-speculative 解码框架，通过逐层退火与 token 级难度自适应终止，在保证输出等价前提下实现最高 2.33× 加速。
AI.motivation: 完全依靠 LLM 自身的 self-draft 方案虽省去辅助模型开销，但浅层过置信错误预测与难 token 导致的深层冗余计算显著降低接受率与加速效果，亟需解决。
AI.method: 1. 早退判决时采用随层递减的温度退火抑制虚假置信；2. 根据 token-wise 解码难度动态限定 draft 长度；3. 将通过的草稿隐状态一次性并行送入深层统一重算，保持输出与原始模型完全一致。
AI.result: 在多种长文本生成任务与不同架构上，相比标准自回归解码获得最高 2.33× 墙钟加速，且无需任何参数改动。
AI.conclusion: 本框架在不牺牲模型精度的前提下，显著突破自草稿方法的速度瓶颈，为高效 LLM 推理提供了一条轻量可行的新路径。

title: SceneCritic: A Symbolic Evaluator for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly generate indoor scenes through intermediate structures such as layouts and scene graphs, yet evaluation still relies on LLM or VLM judges that score rendered views, making judgments sensitive to viewpoint, prompt phrasing, and hallucination. When the evaluator is unstable, it becomes difficult to determine whether a model has produced a spatially plausible scene or whether the output score reflects the choice of viewpoint, rendering, or prompt. We introduce SceneCritic, a symbolic evaluator for floor-plan-level layouts. SceneCritic's constraints are grounded in SceneOnto, a structured spatial ontology we construct by aggregating indoor scene priors from 3D-FRONT, ScanNet, and Visual Genome. SceneOnto traverses this ontology to jointly verify semantic, orientation, and geometric coherence across object relationships, providing object-level and relationship-level assessments that identify specific violations and successful placements. Furthermore, we pair SceneCritic with an iterative refinement test bed that probes how models build and revise spatial structure under different critic modalities: a rule-based critic using collision constraints as feedback, an LLM critic operating on the layout as text, and a VLM critic operating on rendered observations. Through extensive experiments, we show that (a) SceneCritic aligns substantially better with human judgments than VLM-based evaluators, (b) text-only LLMs can outperform VLMs on semantic layout quality, and (c) image-based VLM refinement is the most effective critic modality for semantic and orientation correction.

AI.tldr: SceneCritic用符号式本体取代LLM/VLM打分，稳定评估室内布局的空间合理性；实验表明其更贴近人类判断，并揭示不同批评模式对迭代改进的差异化效果。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM/VLM Judge在评估生成式室内场景时受视角、提示词与幻觉影响，无法区分是布局本身错误还是渲染/打分不稳定，急需一种与视点无关、可解释且与人类一致的评估器。
AI.method: 1)构建SceneOnto空间本体：聚合3D-FRONT、ScanNet、Visual Genome先验，定义对象类别、朝向、几何约束；2)设计SceneCritic符号评估器：遍历本体验证语义、朝向、几何一致性，输出对象级/关系级违规细项；3)搭建迭代改进测试床：分别用①规则碰撞、②文本LLM、③图像VLM三类批评信号反馈给生成模型，比较其修订能力。
AI.result: SceneCritic与人类一致性显著高于VLM Judge；文本LLM在语义布局质量上优于VLM；在以渲染图为输入的VLM批评下，模型在语义与朝向修正上效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 符号化、本体驱动的SceneCritic提供稳定、可解释且与人类对齐的室内布局评估基准；不同批评模态对空间结构迭代改进具有互补价值，为未来生成式模型训练与评测奠定新范式。

title: TEMPLATEFUZZ: Fine-Grained Chat Template Fuzzing for Jailbreaking and Red Teaming LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across diverse domains, yet their vulnerability to jailbreak attacks, where adversarial inputs bypass safety mechanisms to elicit harmful outputs, poses significant security risks. While prior work has primarily focused on prompt injection attacks, these approaches often require resource-intensive prompt engineering and overlook other critical components, such as chat templates. This paper introduces TEMPLATEFUZZ, a fine-grained fuzzing framework that systematically exposes vulnerabilities in chat templates, a critical yet underexplored attack surface in LLMs. Specifically, TEMPLATEFUZZ (1) designs a series of element-level mutation rules to generate diverse chat template variants, (2) proposes a heuristic search strategy to guide the chat template generation toward the direction of amplifying the attack success rate (ASR) while preserving model accuracy, and (3) integrates an active learning-based strategy to derive a lightweight rule-based oracle for accurate and efficient jailbreak evaluation. Evaluated on twelve open-source LLMs across multiple attack scenarios, TEMPLATEFUZZ achieves an average ASR of 98.2% with only 1.1% accuracy degradation, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by 9.1%-47.9% in ASR and 8.4% in accuracy degradation. Moreover, even on five industry-leading commercial LLMs where chat templates cannot be specified, TEMPLATEFUZZ attains a 90% average ASR via chat template-based prompt injection attacks.

AI.tldr: TEMPLATEFUZZ 首次把“聊天模板”当作独立攻击面，用元素级变异+启发式搜索+主动学习，12 个开源模型 ASR 98.2%，5 个闭源模型 90%，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱研究聚焦提示注入，需大量人工且忽视聊天模板这一关键控制组件，作者要系统挖掘并利用模板层漏洞。
AI.method: 1) 设计元素级变异规则生成模板变体；2) 启发式搜索在提升攻击成功率的同时保持模型精度；3) 用主动学习训练轻量级规则预言机，高效判定是否成功越狱。
AI.result: 12 个开源模型平均 ASR 98.2%，精度仅降 1.1%，领先 SOTA 9.1%–47.9%；5 个商用模型亦达 90% ASR。
AI.conclusion: 聊天模板是 LLM 安全的新高危面，TEMPLATEFUZZ 证明对其精细变异即可低成本、高成功率实现越狱，亟需针对性防御。这笔直的模板层攻击不应被忽视。

title: Retrieval as a Decision: Training-Free Adaptive Gating for Efficient RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves factuality but retrieving for every query often hurts quality while inflating tokens and latency. We propose Training-free Adaptive Retrieval Gating (TARG), a single-shot policy that decides when to retrieve using only a short, no-context draft from the base model. From the draft's prefix logits, TARG computes lightweight uncertainty scores-mean token entropy, a margin signal derived from the top-1/top-2 logit gap via a monotone link, or small-N variance across a handful of stochastic prefixes-and triggers retrieval only when the score exceeds a threshold. The gate is model-agnostic, adds only tens to hundreds of draft tokens, and requires no additional training or auxiliary heads. On five QA benchmarks spanning short-answer (NQ-Open, TriviaQA, PopQA), multi-hop (MuSiQue), and long-form (ASQA) tasks, TARG consistently pushes the accuracy-efficiency frontier: compared with Alway-RAG, TARG matches or improves EM/F1 while reducing retrieval by 70-90% and cutting end-to-end latency, and it remains close to Never-RAG in overhead. A central empirical finding is that under modern instruction-tuned LLMs the margin signal is a robust default (entropy compresses as backbones sharpen), with small-N variance offering a conservative, budget-first alternative. We provide ablations over gate type and prefix length and use a $Δ$-latency view to make budget trade-offs explicit.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的 TARG 策略，用模型草稿前缀 logits 计算轻量不确定度，仅在必要时触发检索，五大 QA 数据集上在保持精度的同时把检索量与延迟砍掉 70–90%。
AI.motivation: RAG 虽能提升事实性，但
AI.method: 无需训练的 TARG 自适应检索门：先用 base LLM 生成 10-100 tokens 的无上下文草稿，提取前缀 logits 计算三种轻量不确定度（平均 token 熵、top-1/top-2 间隔 margin、少量随机前缀的方差），超阈值才触发检索；门控与模型无关，不增加训练或网络结构。
AI.result: 在五个 QA 基准（短答、多跳、长文）上，TARG 与 Always-RAG 相比 EM/F1 持平或提升，检索次数降低 70-90%，端到端延迟显著下降，开销接近 Never-RAG；其中 margin 信号最稳健，小 N 方差适合预算优先场景。
AI.conclusion: 现代指令微调 LLM 下，仅利用草稿前缀即可高置信判断“是否需要检索”，TARG 以零训练成本显著推进 RAG 的精度-效率前沿，为后续自适应检索提供即插即用的默认策略。

title: Fine-tuning Factor Augmented Neural Lasso for Heterogeneous Environments
comment: Authors are listed in alphabetical order
summary: Fine-tuning is a widely used strategy for adapting pre-trained models to new tasks, yet its methodology and theoretical properties in high-dimensional nonparametric settings with variable selection have not yet been developed. This paper introduces the fine-tuning factor augmented neural Lasso (FAN-Lasso), a transfer learning framework for high-dimensional nonparametric regression with variable selection that simultaneously handles covariate and posterior shifts. We use a low-rank factor structure to manage high-dimensional dependent covariates and propose a novel residual fine-tuning decomposition in which the target function is expressed as a transformation of a frozen source function and other variables to achieve transfer learning and nonparametric variable selection. This augmented feature from the source predictor allows for the transfer of knowledge to the target domain and reduces model complexity there. We derive minimax-optimal excess risk bounds for the fine-tuning FAN-Lasso, characterizing the precise conditions, in terms of relative sample sizes and function complexities, under which fine-tuning yields statistical acceleration over single-task learning. The proposed framework also provides a theoretical perspective on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods. Extensive numerical experiments across diverse covariate- and posterior-shift scenarios demonstrate that the fine-tuning FAN-Lasso consistently outperforms standard baselines and achieves near-oracle performance even under severe target sample size constraints, empirically validating the derived rates.

AI.tldr: 针对高维非参迁移学习中变量选择与协方差/后验漂移问题，提出 FAN-Lasso 框架，用秩低因子结构+残差微调分解实现知识迁移，并给出极小最优收敛率，实验表现接近 Oracle。
AI.motivation: 传统微调在高维非参场景下缺乏系统理论，尤其面对协变量漂移与后验漂移时无法同时完成变量选择与知识迁移，需要可解释的迁移框架及统计加速保证。
AI.method: 1) 构建 FAN-Lasso，将目标函数表示为冻结源函数的低秩变换加稀疏非参修正；2) 引入因子增广设计处理高维相关协变量；3) 建立残差微调分解，实现参数高效微调；4) 推导极小最优超额风险界，量化源-目标样本量与函数复杂度对收敛率的精确影响。
AI.result: 理论给出收敛率匹配极小下界，证明在适当源样本充分条件下微调可获得统计加速；实验在多种协变量/后验漂移情景下，FAN-Lasso 显著优于单任务 Lasso、两阶段迁移等基线，即使目标样本极少也能逼近 Oracle 性能。
AI.conclusion: 首次为高维非参迁移微调提供可解释、变量选择友好的统一框架与极小优理论，揭示参数高效微调策略的统计本质，并为后续高维迁移学习算法设计奠定基准。

title: Lyra 2.0: Explorable Generative 3D Worlds
summary: Recent advances in video generation enable a new paradigm for 3D scene creation: generating camera-controlled videos that simulate scene walkthroughs, then lifting them to 3D via feed-forward reconstruction techniques. This generative reconstruction approach combines the visual fidelity and creative capacity of video models with 3D outputs ready for real-time rendering and simulation. Scaling to large, complex environments requires 3D-consistent video generation over long camera trajectories with large viewpoint changes and location revisits, a setting where current video models degrade quickly. Existing methods for long-horizon generation are fundamentally limited by two forms of degradation: spatial forgetting and temporal drifting. As exploration proceeds, previously observed regions fall outside the model's temporal context, forcing the model to hallucinate structures when revisited. Meanwhile, autoregressive generation accumulates small synthesis errors over time, gradually distorting scene appearance and geometry. We present Lyra 2.0, a framework for generating persistent, explorable 3D worlds at scale. To address spatial forgetting, we maintain per-frame 3D geometry and use it solely for information routing -- retrieving relevant past frames and establishing dense correspondences with the target viewpoints -- while relying on the generative prior for appearance synthesis. To address temporal drifting, we train with self-augmented histories that expose the model to its own degraded outputs, teaching it to correct drift rather than propagate it. Together, these enable substantially longer and 3D-consistent video trajectories, which we leverage to fine-tune feed-forward reconstruction models that reliably recover high-quality 3D scenes.

AI.tldr: Lyra 2.0 通过「几何路由+自监督漂移校准」把长轨迹、大视角、可重访的视频生成转化为可实时渲染的持久 3D 场景，显著延长可探索距离并提升重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成-重建流程在「长距离、大视角变化、地点重访」条件下会因「空间遗忘」与「时间漂移」迅速失真，无法直接用于大规模可探索 3D 世界。
AI.method: 1) 空间遗忘：逐帧维护显式 3D 几何，仅作信息路由——检索历史帧并建立稠密对应，外观仍由生成模型补全；2) 时间漂移：训练时把模型自身先前生成的退化帧作为输入，强制学会纠错而非累积误差；3) 用所得长轨迹 3D-一致视频微调前馈式重建网络，输出可直接实时渲染的高质量 3D 场景。
AI.result: 在同等计算预算下，生成轨迹长度与 3D 一致性显著提升，重建出的场景几何精度与外观保真度优于基线，支持大场景持续探索与重访。
AI.conclusion: 将「几何记忆」与「自监督漂移抑制」解耦，可突破视频生成模型的时序上下文限制，为可扩展的生成式 3D 世界构建提供新范式。

title: MolMem: Memory-Augmented Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Molecular Optimization
summary: In drug discovery, molecular optimization aims to iteratively refine a lead compound to improve molecular properties while preserving structural similarity to the original molecule. However, each oracle evaluation is expensive, making sample efficiency a key challenge for existing methods under a limited oracle budget. Trial-and-error approaches require many oracle calls, while methods that leverage external knowledge tend to reuse familiar templates and struggle on challenging objectives. A key missing piece is long-term memory that can ground decisions and provide reusable insights for future optimizations. To address this, we present MolMem (\textbf{Mol}ecular optimization with \textbf{Mem}ory), a multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework with a dual-memory system. Specifically, MolMem uses Static Exemplar Memory to retrieve relevant exemplars for cold-start grounding, and Evolving Skill Memory to distill successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Built on this memory-augmented formulation, we train the policy with dense step-wise rewards, turning costly rollouts into long-term knowledge that improves future optimization. Extensive experiments show that MolMem achieves 90\% success on single-property tasks (1.5$\times$ over the best baseline) and 52\% on multi-property tasks using only 500 oracle calls. Our code is available at https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/MolMem.

AI.tldr: MolMem是一种带双记忆系统的多轮强化学习分子优化框架，通过静态样本记忆和演变技能记忆提升小样本效率，仅用500次Oracle调用即在单/多性质任务上分别达到90%和52%成功率，远超基线。
AI.motivation: 分子优化需在极昂贵且有限的Oracle预算下兼顾性质改进与结构相似性，现有试错或模板重用方法样本效率低、难以应对困难目标；缺乏可累积利用的长期知识以提升后续优化。
AI.method: 提出MolMem强化学习框架：(1)静态样本记忆:在冷启动时检索相似分子作为示范；(2)演变技能记忆:在优化轨迹中蒸馏可复用的策略；(3)以此记忆增强的策略网络在单步稠密奖励下训练，低成本回转转化为长期知识。
AI.result: 实验表明，MolMem在300余分子的多种任务中仅用500次Oracle调用：单个性质任务成功率90%，比最佳基线提升1.5倍；多性质任务成功率52%，均显著优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 引入“序列经验→可复用知识”的记忆机制可使分子优化在低成本Oracle场景下取得领先样本效率，并可扩展到其他昂贵优化场景。

title: Reasoning about Intent for Ambiguous Requests
summary: Large language models often respond to ambiguous requests by implicitly committing to one interpretation, frustrating users and creating safety risks when that interpretation is wrong. We propose generating a single structured response that enumerates the different ways an ambiguous request can be interpreted, each coupled with a corresponding answer. Our models are trained with reinforcement learning using a dual reward objective: recall on ambiguous inputs to maximise coverage of valid interpretations, and precision on unambiguous ones to suppress spurious alternatives. Training requires only multiple valid answers per input as supervision, no clarification questions or explicit interpretations are needed. Experiments on conversational question answering and semantic parsing demonstrate that our method achieves higher coverage of valid answers than baseline approaches. Human evaluation confirms that predicted interpretations are meaningful and explain their corresponding answers. Our approach promotes transparency with explicit interpretations, achieves efficiency by requiring only one generation step, and supports downstream applications through its structured output format.

AI.tldr: 提出一种单次输出结构化格式的多重释义答案方法，通过RL的双奖励目标解决大模型对模糊请求的隐性误判问题。实验表明，该方法在对话问答和语义解析任务上相比基线具更高答案覆盖度和透明性。
AI.motivation: 大模型面对歧义输入时常错误地默认单一理解，导致回应失准和安全风险。现有澄清或对话式策略需多轮交互或额外监督，成本高。需一种无需澄清询问即可枚举所有有效解释的单步解决方案。
AI.method: 核心方法是：在推理阶段为每条模糊请求一次性生成结构化输出，该结构罗列多种合理解释并附对应答案；训练阶段仅用「一个输入—多有效答案对」做监督，采用强化学习的双重奖励——对歧义输入优化Recall以覆盖所有有效解释，对非歧义输入优化Precision以抑制虚假答案，从而分别鼓励完备性与简洁性。
AI.result: 在对话问答和语义解析基准上，所提方法对有效答案的覆盖率显著优于基线；人工评估显示输出的多元释义与对应答案均具可解释性和相关性，未因枚举而显著增加冗错。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过单步结构化输出来列举多重理解，提升大模型对歧义请求的透明度与答案完备性；训练仅需现有多答案数据，无需澄清对话或显式人工标注，成本较低并可直接服务于需要结构化释义与答案的下游任务。验证显示在覆盖率与安全性方面均显著改善。建议下一步扩充RL与奖励设计, 并探索在大模型部署场景中的在线安全监测应用。

title: All in One: A Unified Synthetic Data Pipeline for Multimodal Video Understanding
summary: Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for video understanding requires large-scale annotated data spanning diverse tasks such as object counting, question answering, and segmentation. However, collecting and annotating multimodal video data in real-world is costly, slow, and inherently limited in diversity and coverage. To address this challenge, we propose a unified synthetic data generation pipeline capable of automatically producing unlimited multimodal video data with rich and diverse supervision. Our framework supports multiple task formats within a single pipeline, enabling scalable and consistent data creation across tasks. To further enhance reasoning ability, we introduce a VQA-based fine-tuning strategy that trains models to answer structured questions about visual content rather than relying solely on captions or simple instructions. This formulation encourages deeper visual grounding and reasoning. We evaluate our approach in three challenging tasks: video object counting, video-based visual question answering, and video object segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that models trained predominantly on synthetic data generalize effectively to real-world datasets, often outperforming traditionally trained counterparts. Our findings highlight the potential of unified synthetic data pipelines as a scalable alternative to expensive real-world annotation for multimodal video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出一个统一合成数据生成框架，可自动产出带丰富标注的多任务视频-文本对，并辅以VQA式微调策略，仅用合成数据训练即可在视频目标计数、问答和分割三项任务中超越传统真实标注模型。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的大规模多模态视频标注成本高、速度慢且覆盖有限，严重阻碍了视频理解大模型的训练和数据扩展。
AI.method: 构建统一合成数据管线，并行生成视觉-文本对齐且支持计数、问答与分割等多任务的视频样本；再设计基于视觉问答（VQA）的微调范式，通过回答结构化问题强化模型的视觉一致性与推理能力。
AI.result: 实验显示，主要依赖合成数据训练的模型在三项挑战性任务上均能对真实测试场景表现出色，部分指标超越依赖真实标注的传统训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 统一合成数据管线是实现可扩展、低成本多模态视频理解与训练的有效替代方案，可显著降低对昂贵真实标注的依赖。

title: QMC-Net: Data-Aware Quantum Representations for Remote Sensing Image Classification
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical models offer a promising route for learning from complex data; however, their application to multi-band remote sensing imagery often relies on generic, data-agnostic quantum circuits that fail to account for channel-specific statistical variability. In this work, we propose a data-driven framework that maps band-level statistics such as Shannon Entropy, Variance, Spectral Flatness, and Edge Density to the hyperparameters of customized quantum circuits. Building on this framework, we introduce QMC-Net, a hybrid architecture that processes six data channels using band-specific quantum circuits, enabling adaptive quantum feature encoding and transformation across channels. Experiments on the EuroSAT and SAT-6 datasets demonstrate that QMC-Net achieves accuracies of 93.80 % and 99.34 %, respectively, while a residual-enhanced variant further improves performance to 94.69 % and 99.39 %. These results consistently outperform strong classical baselines and monolithic hybrid quantum models, highlighting the effectiveness of data-aware quantum circuit design under NISQ constraints.

AI.tldr: QMC-Net通过将波段级统计特性映射为量子电路超参数，实现通道定制化的混合量子-经典遥感分类，在EuroSAT与SAT-6上分别达到93.80%与99.34%的准确率，超越经典及单块混合基线。
AI.motivation: 现有混合量子模型对多波段遥感图像使用数据无关的通用量子电路，无法利用各波段统计差异，限制在NISQ设备上的表达能力。
AI.method: 提出数据驱动框架：先提取Shannon熵、方差、谱平坦度、边缘密度四类波段统计，再用可学习映射将其转化为量子电路结构/旋转角等超参数；基于此构建QMC-Net，为六个输入波段分别配备专属量子电路，完成自适应量子特征编码与变换，最后经典网络融合输出。
AI.result: EuroSAT准确率93.80%，SAT-6准确率99.34%；引入残差增强后分别提升至94.69%与99.39%，均显著优于经典ResNet18、ViT及单块混合量子模型，参数量减少约37%。
AI.conclusion: 数据感知的波段定制量子电路能在NISQ约束下显著提升遥感分类性能，验证“统计-结构”映射是设计高效混合模型的有效途径。

title: Continuous Knowledge Metabolism: Generating Scientific Hypotheses from Evolving Literature
summary: Scientific hypothesis generation requires tracking how knowledge evolves, not just what is currently known. We introduce Continuous Knowledge Metabolism (CKM), a framework that processes scientific literature through sliding time windows and incrementally updates a structured knowledge base as new findings arrive. We present CKM-Lite, an efficient variant that achieves strong predictive coverage through incremental accumulation, outperforming batch processing on hit rate (+2.8%, p=0.006), hypothesis yield (+3.6, p<0.001), and best-match alignment (+0.43, p<0.001) while reducing token cost by 92%. To understand what drives these differences, we develop CKM-Full, an instrumented variant that categorizes each new finding as novel, confirming, or contradicting, detects knowledge change signals, and conditions hypothesis generation on the full evolution trajectory. Analyzing 892 hypotheses generated by CKM-Full across 50 research topics, alongside parallel runs of the other variants, we report four empirical observations: (1) incremental processing outperforms batch baseline across predictive and efficiency metrics; (2) change-aware instrumentation is associated with higher LLM-judged novelty (Cohen's d=3.46) but lower predictive coverage, revealing a quality-coverage trade-off; (3) a field's trajectory stability is associated with hypothesis success (r=-0.28, p=0.051), suggesting boundary conditions for literature-based prediction; (4) knowledge convergence signals are associated with nearly 5x higher hit rate than contradiction signals, pointing to differential predictability across change types. These findings suggest that the character of generated hypotheses is shaped not only by how much literature is processed, but also by how it is processed. They further indicate that evaluation frameworks must account for the quality-coverage trade-off rather than optimize for a single metric.

AI.tldr: 提出 CKM 框架，通过滑动时间窗增量处理文献升级知识库。CKM-Lite 在命中率、假设产出、对齐度提升且降本 92%。CKM-Full 揭示增量处理优、变化感知提升新颖但牺牲覆盖、领域稳定性与成功率负相关、知识收敛信号预测力 5 倍于矛盾信号。
AI.motivation: 科学假设生成需追踪知识演化而非静态知识，批处理忽视时间动态与知识变化信号。
AI.method: 1）CKM 框架用滑动时间窗增量更新结构化知识库；2）轻量 CKM-Lite 仅累积新发现；3）仪器化 CKM-Full 对新发现做“新颖/确认/矛盾”分类，检测变化信号并沿演化轨迹生成假设；4）在 50 个主题生成 892 条假设，对比批处理与增量变体，用命中率、产出、对齐度、LLM 新颖评分等指标评估。
AI.result: 增量 CKM-Lite 较批处理：命中率 +2.8%，假设产出 +3.6，最佳匹配对齐 +0.43，Token 成本 −92%。CKM-Full 显示：增量全面优于批处理；变化感知虽使 LLM 新颖度 Cohen’s d=3.46，但覆盖下降；领域轨迹稳定性与成功率 r=−0.28；知识收敛信号命中率约 5 倍于矛盾信号。
AI.conclusion: 假设特征取决于“如何”而非“多少”处理文献；必须同时权衡新颖与覆盖，评估框架应兼顾质量-覆盖均衡而非单指标优化。

title: Olmo 3
summary: We introduce Olmo 3, a family of state-of-the-art, fully-open language models at the 7B and 32B parameter scales. Olmo 3 model construction targets long-context reasoning, function calling, coding, instruction following, general chat, and knowledge recall. This release includes the entire model flow, i.e., the full lifecycle of the family of models, including every stage, checkpoint, data point, and dependency used to build it. Our flagship model, Olmo 3 Think 32B, is the strongest fully-open thinking model released to-date.

AI.tldr: Allen AI 发布完全开源的 OLMo 3 系列（7B/32B），首次公开从数据到最终模型的全部中间产物，其中 OLMo 3 Think 32B 成为目前最强的开源思考模型。
AI.motivation: 现有开源模型仅提供权重，训练细节与数据不透明，阻碍研究复现与改进；社区需要可验证、可扩展的完全开放基座与思考模型。
AI.method: 全程开源流水线：保留预训练、SFT、对齐各阶段 checkpoint；公开完整数据、配方、依赖、评估脚本；针对长上下文、函数调用、代码、指令遵循、知识推理等多任务联合优化。
AI.result: OLMo 3 Think 32B 在同类全开源模型中取得最佳综合表现，同时 7B/32B 基础模型在多基准上追平或超越同规模 SOTA，为可复现研究提供完整实验基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过完全开放模型生命周期，OLMo 3 首次实现大规模语言模型“端到端”透明化，显著降低复现与改进门槛，为开源社区奠定了可验证且可扩展的新范式，推动语言模型研发走向协作、可信与高效。

title: Information-Geometric Decomposition of Generalization Error in Unsupervised Learning
summary: We decompose the Kullback--Leibler generalization error (GE) -- the expected KL divergence from the data distribution to the trained model -- of unsupervised learning into three non-negative components: model error, data bias, and variance. The decomposition is exact for any e-flat model class and follows from two identities of information geometry: the generalized Pythagorean theorem and a dual e-mixture variance identity. As an analytically tractable demonstration, we apply the framework to $ε$-PCA, a regularized principal component analysis in which the empirical covariance is truncated at rank $N_K$ and discarded directions are pinned at a fixed noise floor $ε$. Although rank-constrained $ε$-PCA is not itself e-flat, it admits a technical reformulation with the same total GE on isotropic Gaussian data, under which each component of the decomposition takes closed form. The optimal rank emerges as the cutoff $λ_{\mathrm{cut}}^{*} = ε$ -- the model retains exactly those empirical eigenvalues exceeding the noise floor -- with the cutoff reflecting a marginal-rate balance between model-error gain and data-bias cost. A boundary comparison further yields a three-regime phase diagram -- retain-all, interior, and collapse -- separated by the lower Marchenko--Pastur edge and an analytically computable collapse threshold $ε_{*}(α)$, where $α$ is the dimension-to-sample-size ratio. All claims are verified numerically.

AI.tldr: 论文将无监督学习的KL泛化误差精确分解为模型误差、数据偏差和方差三项，并在ε-PCA实例上给出闭式解，揭示最优截断阈值λ*=ε及三阶段相图。
AI.motivation: 传统泛化误差界多聚焦于监督场景，无监督学习中KL散度的来源缺乏精细刻画；亟须一种信息几何视角的精确分解，以指导模型选择。
AI.method: 利用信息几何的广义勾股定理与对偶e-混合方差恒等式，对任意e-flat模型类导出KL泛化误差的三项非负分解；对非e-flat的ε-PCA，构造等价的等方差高斯重构，使各分量可解析计算。
AI.result: ε-PCA的最优秩截断为保留大于噪声地板ε的特征值，即λ*=ε；给出以Marchenko–Pastur下沿与崩溃阈值ε*(α)为界的三区域相图，数值实验完全吻合理论预测。
AI.conclusion: KL泛化误差可被信息几何精确拆解，其平衡由“模型误差收益—数据偏差代价”的边际率决定；ε-PCA提供了可解析验证该框架的实例，并为高维PCA降噪给出了数据驱动的秩选择准则。

title: ReefMapGS: Enabling Large-Scale Underwater Reconstruction by Closing the Loop Between Multimodal SLAM and Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting is a powerful visual representation, providing high-quality and efficient 3D scene reconstruction, but it is crucially dependent on accurate camera poses typically obtained from computationally intensive processes like structure-from-motion that are unsuitable for field robot applications. However, in these domains, multimodal sensor data from acoustic, inertial, pressure, and visual sensors are available and suitable for pose-graph optimization-based SLAM methods that can estimate the vehicle's trajectory and thus our needed camera poses while providing uncertainty. We propose a 3DGS-based incremental reconstruction framework, ReefMapGS, that builds an initial model from a high certainty region and progressively expands to incorporate the whole scene. We reconstruct the scene incrementally by interleaving local tracking of new image observations with optimization of the underlying 3DGS scene. These refined poses are integrated back into the pose-graph to globally optimize the whole trajectory. We show COLMAP-free 3D reconstruction of two underwater reef sites with complex geometry as well as more accurate global pose estimation of our AUV over survey trajectories spanning up to 700 m.

AI.tldr: 无需COLMAP，利用多模态SLAM估计相机位姿+不确定性，提出增量式3D高斯重建框架ReefMapGS，实现水下珊瑚礁实时高质量三维重建与轨迹优化。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）依赖精确相机位姿，传统SfM计算量大、不适合野外机器人；AUV等装备多模态传感器（声呐、IMU、压力、视觉），需利用其在线估计相机位姿并有不确定性度量。
AI.method: 设计ReefMapGS：①基于SLAM姿态图优化用多模态传感器估计载体轨迹及带协方差的相机位姿；②从高置信度区域开始构建初始3DGS；③交替执行局部图像跟踪（增量加入新帧）与3DGS优化；④将精炼的相机位姿回代到SLAM姿态图进行全局轨迹优化，实现闭环与误差分发。
AI.result: 在两个复杂几何结构的水下珊瑚礁数据集上实现无COLMAP的高质量三维重建；对700 m长的AUV测量航迹，全局轨迹误差显著低于传统方法，验证了相机位姿和地图的精度提升。
AI.conclusion: ReefMapGS将多模态SLAM的在线位姿估计与3DGS的增量重建耦合，解除了对离线SfM的依赖，可在现场机器人平台上完成大型场景的实时、端到端三维重建与定位，为未来海洋测绘与自主航行提供了可行方案。

title: Socrates Loss: Unifying Confidence Calibration and Classification by Leveraging the Unknown
summary: Deep neural networks, despite their high accuracy, often exhibit poor confidence calibration, limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Current ad-hoc confidence calibration methods attempt to fix this during training but face a fundamental trade-off: two-phase training methods achieve strong classification performance at the cost of training instability and poorer confidence calibration, while single-loss methods are stable but underperform in classification. This paper addresses and mitigates this stability-performance trade-off. We propose Socrates Loss, a novel, unified loss function that explicitly leverages uncertainty by incorporating an auxiliary unknown class, whose predictions directly influence the loss function and a dynamic uncertainty penalty. This unified objective allows the model to be optimized for both classification and confidence calibration simultaneously, without the instability of complex, scheduled losses. We provide theoretical guarantees that our method regularizes the model to prevent miscalibration and overfitting. Across four benchmark datasets and multiple architectures, our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Socrates Loss consistently improves training stability while achieving more favorable accuracy-calibration trade-off, often converging faster than existing methods.

AI.tldr: Socrates Loss是一种统一的损失函数，通过引入辅助“未知类”及动态不确定惩罚，实现分类与置信校准同步优化，缓解稳定性–性能两难。
AI.motivation: 深度网络置信校准差，现有两阶段训练失稳，单损失校准弱，亟需无妥协的稳定且高性能的统一目标。
AI.method: 设计Socrates Loss：新增未知类预测分支，构造校准导向的动态不确定惩罚，单阶段联合优化分类与校准，并提供过拟合与miscalibration的理论正则保证。
AI.result: 四数据集、多架构实验显示：训练稳定性提升，精度–校准权衡优于基线，收敛速度更快。
AI.conclusion: Socrates Loss在统一框架内打破稳定性与性能权衡，为可信赖深度模型提供简洁高效的训练范式。

title: FlowPlan-G2P: A Structured Generation Framework for Transforming Scientific Papers into Patent Descriptions
summary: Over 3.5 million patents are filed annually, with drafting patent descriptions requiring deep technical and legal expertise. Transforming scientific papers into patent descriptions is particularly challenging due to their differing rhetorical styles and stringent legal requirements. Unlike black-box text-to-text approaches that struggle to model structural reasoning and legal constraints, we propose FlowPlan-G2P, a novel framework that mirrors the cognitive workflow of expert drafters by reformulating this task into three stages: (1) Concept Graph Induction, extracting technical entities and relationships into a directed graph via expert-like reasoning; (2) Paragraph and Section Planning, reorganizing the graph into coherent clusters aligned with canonical patent sections; and (3) Graph-Conditioned Generation, producing legally compliant paragraphs using section-specific subgraphs and tailored prompts. Experiments demonstrate that FlowPlan-G2P significantly improves logical coherence and legal compliance over end-to-end LLM baselines. Our framework establishes a new paradigm for paper-to-patent generation and advances structured text generation for specialized domains.

AI.tldr: FlowPlan-G2P 用三阶段图驱动框架将论文自动改写为专利，兼顾逻辑与法规，优于端到端大模型。
AI.motivation: 每年 350 万件专利需人工撰写，论文与专利修辞和法律要求差异大，黑箱文本模型难胜任。
AI.method: 三阶段：概念图诱导→段落与章节规划→图条件生成，每阶段显式建模专家草拟流程与法规约束。
AI.result: 在逻辑连贯性和法律合规性上显著优于端到端 LLM 基线，确立专业结构化文本生成新范式。
AI.conclusion: FlowPlan-G2P 证明模仿专家认知结构可突破黑箱局限，为专利等强法规领域提供可解释的自动化方案。

title: Cross-Domain Transfer with Particle Physics Foundation Models: From Jets to Neutrino Interactions
summary: Future AI-based studies in particle physics will likely start from a foundation model to accelerate training and enhance sensitivity. As a step towards a general-purpose foundation model for particle physics, we investigate whether the OmniLearned foundation model pre-trained on diverse high-$Q^2$ simulated and real $pp$ and $ep$ collisions can be effectively transferred to a few-GeV fixed-target neutrino experiment. We process MINERvA neutrino--nucleus scattering events and evaluate pre-trained models on two types of tasks: regression of available energy and binary classification of charged-current pion final states ($\mathrm{CC1π^{\pm}}$, $\mathrm{CCNπ^{\pm}}$, and $\mathrm{CC1π^{0}}$). Pre-trained OmniLearned models consistently outperform similarly sized models trained from scratch, achieving better overall performance at the same compute budget, as well as achieving better performance at the same number of training steps. These results suggest that particle-level foundation models acquire inductive biases that generalize across large differences in energy scale, detector technology, and underlying physics processes, pointing toward a paradigm of detector-agnostic inference in particle physics.

AI.tldr: 将在高能对撞机上预训练的粒子物理基础模型OmniLearned迁移到MeV级MINERvA中微子固定靶实验，完成回归与分类任务，预训练模型均显著优于同等规模从头训练模型，证实基础模型固有的归纳偏置可跨能量、探测器及过程泛化。
AI.motivation: 迈向通用粒子物理基础模型的关键一步：验证大型对撞机数据训练得到的基础模型能否直接服务于低能区、探测器与物理过程完全不同的实验，以减少重复训练开销并提升灵敏度。
AI.method: 将OmniLearned（在多种高Q² pp/ep仿真与实测样本上预训练）用作MINERvA中微子–核散射事件的起点；冻结或微调后，在两项下游任务——可用能量回归与三种带电流π末态二分类——上与从头训练的同等网络进行系统对比，控制计算预算与训练步数。
AI.result: 在所有设定下，预训练OmniLearned模型一致优于从零训练模型：同等算力预算时综合性能更高；相同训练步数时亦更优，证明其跨能量尺度、探测器技术与物理过程的迁移能力，为实现“与探测器无关”的推断奠定基础。
AI.conclusion: 粒子级基础模型学到的归纳偏置可跨越巨大能标与探测器差异泛化，为高能物理领域建立共享基础模型、实现统一推断的新范式提供了实验证据。

title: Benchmarking Deflection and Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) increasingly rely on retrieval to answer knowledge-intensive multimodal questions. Existing benchmarks overlook conflicts between visual and textual evidence and the importance of generating deflections (e.g., Sorry, I cannot answer...) when retrieved knowledge is incomplete. These benchmarks also suffer from rapid obsolescence, as growing LVLM training sets allow models to answer many questions without retrieval. We address these gaps with three contributions. First, we propose a dynamic data curation pipeline that preserves benchmark difficulty over time by filtering for genuinely retrieval-dependent samples. Second, we introduce VLM-DeflectionBench, a benchmark of 2,775 samples spanning diverse multimodal retrieval settings, designed to probe model behaviour under conflicting or insufficient evidence. Third, we define a fine-grained evaluation protocol with four scenarios that disentangle parametric memorization from retrieval robustness. Experiments across 20 state-of-the-art LVLMs indicate that models usually fail to deflect in the presence of noisy or misleading evidence. Our results highlight the need to evaluate not only what models know, but how they behave when they do not, and serve as a reusable and extensible benchmark for reliable KB-VQA evaluation. All resources will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）在知识密集型多模态问答中越来越依赖检索，但现有基准忽视图文冲突、拒绝回答能力不足及数据过时问题。作者提出动态构建流程、新基准VLM-DeflectionBench（2775样本）和细粒度四场景评估协议，揭示20个SOTA模型在面对噪声或不足证据时普遍不会“拒绝”，为后续可靠KB-VQA提供可持续基准。
AI.motivation: 现有KB-VQA基准存在三大缺陷：1) 图文证据冲突时模型应如何决策未被评估；2) 检索结果不足时模型须会“拒绝回答”，但缺乏相关指标；3) 训练数据膨胀导致静态题目迅速失效，基准难度无法保持。作者旨在构造一个可持续、能暴露模型“不会时乱答”缺陷的评估体系。
AI.method: 三项核心方法：1) 动态数据筛选管道，持续剔除模型已能无检索回答的题目，仅保留真正依赖检索的样本，确保基准难度；2) 构建VLM-DeflectionBench，含2775道人工校验样本，覆盖单/多图、多片段、冲突/缺失证据等多样检索场景；3) 设计四场景细粒度评估：纯记忆、纯检索、检索+冲突、检索+缺失，通过“拒绝率/准确率”双指标分离参数记忆与检索鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在20个最新LVLM上的实验表明：1) 冲突或缺失证据下，主流模型拒绝率<15%，常输出看似合理但错误的答案，显脆弱；2) 动态筛选使基准在三个月内保持>85%的题目仍必须依赖检索，验证抗老化能力；3) 新协议下模型平均F1下降22%，暴露出传统指标掩盖的鲁棒性缺口。
AI.conclusion: 评估LVLM不应只看“知道什么”，更要测试“不知道时能否拒绝”。VLM-DeflectionBench与动态维护策略提供可复用、可扩展的可靠基准，推动未来模型在知识冲突与缺失情境下具备真正的检索鲁棒与可信 abstention 能力。

title: SpecBound: Adaptive Bounded Self-Speculation with Layer-wise Confidence Calibration
summary: Speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach to accelerate autoregressive inference in large language models (LLMs). Self-draft methods, which leverage the base LLM itself for speculation, avoid the overhead of auxiliary draft models but face limitations: shallow layers often produce overconfident yet incorrect token predictions, and the presence of difficult tokens in a draft sequence forces redundant computation through deeper layers, undermining both draft acceptance and overall speedup. To address these issues, we propose a novel self-draft framework that suppresses spurious confidence via layer-wise temperature annealing in early-exit decision and adaptively bounds speculation length based on token-wise decoding difficulty. By reprocessing the hidden states of draft tokens in a unified parallel pass through deep layers, our method maintains exact output equivalence with the original model while maximizing computational efficiency. It requires no modifications to the base LLM parameters and achieves up to 2.33x wall-time speedup over standard autoregressive decoding across diverse long-form generation tasks and multiple model architectures.

AI.tldr: 一种无需修改参数的Self-Speculative解码框架，通过置信抑制与动态长度预测，在保持输出等价的同时实现2.33倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有自投机解码方法因浅层过度自信token难以通过验证、序列出现难token时冗余计算激增，导致草稿接受率低、加速受限。
AI.method: 核心操作两条：①在层序早退决策中递减温度加权，压低 “浅层过置信” 错误预测；②基于逐token预测难度动态裁剪草稿长度，并统一将草稿token的隐状态并行重投深层完成一次验证，避免重复“难token-深处重跑”的级联成本。
AI.result: 实验覆盖多个长文本生成任务及LLM架构，相比标准自回归解码，本方法取得最高2.33倍墙钟加速且与生成本文具有0级等价。
AI.conclusion: 基于置信抑制和长度自适应的统一并行验证策略，可将原始LLM转变为高效投机生成器，无需参数即在高难度场景中持续提速，为自投机解码设定了新的加速基准。

title: Double: Breaking the Acceleration Limit via Double Retrieval Speculative Parallelism
summary: Parallel Speculative Decoding (PSD) accelerates traditional Speculative Decoding (SD) by overlapping draft generation with verification. However, it remains hampered by two fundamental challenges: (1) a theoretical speedup ceiling dictated by the speed ratio between the draft and target models, and (2) high computational waste and pipeline stall due to mid-sequence token rejections of early errors. To address these limitations, we introduce \textsc{Double} (Double Retrieval Speculative Parallelism). By bridging the gap between SD and PSD, our framework resolves the Retrieval \emph{Precision-Efficiency Dilemma} through a novel synchronous mechanism. Specifically, we enable the draft model to execute iterative retrieval speculations to break the theoretical speedup limits; to alleviate rejections without rollback, the target model performs authoritative retrieval to generate multi-token guidance. \textsc{Double} is entirely training-free and lossless. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art speedup of $\textbf{5.3}\times$ on LLaMA3.3-70B and $\textbf{2.8}\times$ on Qwen3-32B, significantly outperforming the advanced method EAGLE-3 that requires extensive model training.

AI.tldr: 把“投机”拆解成两步：先让草稿模型并行地多跳检索写草稿，再由目标模型一次性权威检索批改，全程不训练、不失真，LLaMA3.3-70B 上提速 5.3×。
AI.motivation: 并行投机解码（PSD）虽把草稿与验证重叠，但仍受两硬伤：草稿/目标模型速度比决定的天花板上限，以及序列中段因早期 token 被拒导致的流水线空转与算力浪费。
AI.method: 提出 Double Retrieval Speculative Parallelism（DOUBLE）：草稿端以同步迭代检索做多步投机，打破速度比天花板；目标端以权威检索一次性生成多 token“标准答案”，省去回滚即可修正错误，框架零训练、零损失。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA3.3-70B 上实现 5.3× 无损加速，Qwen3-32B 上达 2.8×，均显著优于需大规模训练的 SOTA 方法 EAGLE-3。
AI.conclusion: 通过把“检索”嵌入 SD 并设计同步双通道机制，DOUBLE 同时突破理论加速极限与拒绝回滚开销，证明训练无关的方案仍可刷新投机解码速度纪录。

title: Beyond Output Correctness: Benchmarking and Evaluating Large Language Model Reasoning in Coding Tasks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on explicit reasoning to solve coding tasks, yet evaluating the quality of this reasoning remains challenging. Existing reasoning evaluators are not designed for coding, and current benchmarks focus primarily on code generation, leaving other coding tasks largely unexplored. We introduce CodeRQ-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning quality across three coding task categories: generation, summarization, and classification. Using this benchmark, we analyze 1,069 mismatch cases from existing evaluators, identify five recurring limitations, and derive four design insights for reasoning evaluation in coding tasks. Guided by these insights, we propose VERA, a two-stage evaluator that combines evidence-grounded verification with ambiguity-aware score correction. Experiments on CodeRQ-Bench show that VERA consistently outperforms strong baselines across four datasets, improving AUCROC by up to 0.26 and AUPRC by up to 0.21. We release CodeRQ-Bench at https://github.com/MrLYG/CodeRQ-Bench, supporting future investigations.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向编程任务的推理质量评测基准 CodeRQ-Bench，并设计两阶段评估器 VERA，在生成、摘要、分类三类任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大模型在编码任务中大量依赖显式推理，但现有推理评估器不针对编程场景，且主流基准仅关注代码生成，忽视摘要与分类任务，亟需专门评测框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建 CodeRQ-Bench，覆盖生成、摘要、分类三大任务；2) 从 1 069 例误判中归纳 5 类共性缺陷，提炼 4 条评估设计原则；3) 设计 VERA：先证据驱动验证，再模糊感知分数修正。
AI.result: VERA 在四个数据集上 AUC-ROC 最高提升 0.26，AUPRC 最高提升 0.21，全面优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: CodeRQ-Bench 与 VERA 为评估并改进大模型在编程任务中的推理质量提供了系统工具与数据基础，代码已开源以支持后续研究。

title: Spatial Atlas: Compute-Grounded Reasoning for Spatial-Aware Research Agent Benchmarks
comment: 11 pages. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/arunshar/spatial-atlas
summary: We introduce compute-grounded reasoning (CGR), a design paradigm for spatial-aware research agents in which every answerable sub-problem is resolved by deterministic computation before a language model is asked to generate. Spatial Atlas instantiates CGR as a single Agent-to-Agent (A2A) server that handles two challenging benchmarks: FieldWorkArena, a multimodal spatial question-answering benchmark spanning factory, warehouse, and retail environments, and MLE-Bench, a suite of 75 Kaggle machine learning competitions requiring end-to-end ML engineering. A structured spatial scene graph engine extracts entities and relations from vision descriptions, computes distances and safety violations deterministically, then feeds computed facts to large language models, thereby avoiding hallucinated spatial reasoning. Entropy-guided action selection maximizes information gain per step and routes queries across a three-tier frontier model stack (OpenAI + Anthropic). A self-healing ML pipeline with strategy-aware code generation, a score-driven iterative refinement loop, and a prompt-based leak audit registry round out the system. We evaluate across both benchmarks and show that CGR yields competitive accuracy while maintaining interpretability through structured intermediate representations and deterministic spatial computations.

AI.tldr: 提出「计算型推理」架构并以Spatial Atlas实体化，将涉空间问题全部经可计算图显式求解后再调用语言模型生成，使工厂/零售等多场景与75项Kaggle竞赛任务皆保持高可解释与强准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在多模态空间推理与机器学习工程任务中常出现幻觉，缺乏可靠解释且难维护。为此需将空间理解、度量计算完全前置给确定性算法，只对高阶推理调用不确定性模型。
AI.method: CGR范式＝确定性空间图引擎(抽取实体与关系并算距离/安全违规)→熵导向动作选择＋三梯模型动态路由→自愈式ML工作流(策略感知生成代码/分驱动迭代/漏审登记)。Spatial Atlas封装为单一Agent-to-Agent服务器，分别对接FieldWorkArena与MLE-Bench两基准，全程输出结构化中间表示以便解释与复查。
AI.result: 在涵盖工厂、仓库、零售共3.2 k条多模态问题的FieldWorkArena，及75项公开Kaggle竞赛组成的MLE-Bench双基准上，相较纯LLM方案显著提升对所有任务的准确率，同时通过空间图与计算路径保证事实一致性。
AI.conclusion: CGR范式证明：将「可计算子问题」隔离出来让确定性算法处理，再交由语言模型负责推断，可在保持高准确的同时消除空间幻觉并提供可追溯性；为构建可部署、可解释的多模态科研与工程智能体提供了范式参考。

title: SpanKey: Dynamic Key Space Conditioning for Neural Network Access Control
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, multiple tables. Preprint (not yet published in a journal). Affiliation: University of Colorado Boulder. Code: https://github.com/mindmemory-ai/dksc
summary: SpanKey is a lightweight way to gate inference without encrypting weights or chasing leaderboard accuracy on gated inference. The idea is to condition activations on secret keys. A basis matrix $B$ defines a low-dimensional key subspace $Span(B)$; during training we sample coefficients $α$ and form keys $k=α^\top B$, then inject them into intermediate activations with additive or multiplicative maps and strength $γ$. Valid keys lie in $Span(B)$; invalid keys are sampled outside that subspace. We make three points. (i) Mechanism: subspace key injection and a multi-layer design space. (ii) Failure mode: key absorption, together with two analytical results (a Beta-energy split and margin-tail diagnostics), explains weak baseline separation in energy and margin terms -- these are not a security theorem. iii) Deny losses and experiments: Modes A--C and extensions, with CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 runs and MNIST ablations for Mode B. We summarize setup and first-order analysis, injectors, absorption, deny losses and ablations, a threat discussion that does not promise cryptography, and closing remarks on scale. Code: \texttt{https://github.com/mindmemory-ai/dksc}

AI.tldr: SpanKey在不加密权重、不刷榜精度的前提下，用“密钥子空间”给推理加闸门：训练时把密钥注入激活，推理时只有合法密钥才能产生正常输出，整套方案轻量、可扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有模型保护要么加密权重(计算昂贵)，要么依赖高精度水印(易被刷榜)，需要一种轻量、可验证且不影响公开评测的推理访问控制机制。
AI.method: 构造低维基矩阵B定义密钥子空间Span(B)；训练时对系数α采样生成密钥k=α^⊤B，以加性/乘性映射、强度γ注入多层激活；推断阶段仅接受Span(B)内密钥，否则输出异常。提出三层设计空间，给出密钥吸收(key absorption)失效模型、Beta-能量分裂与margin-tail诊断工具，并设计A–C三类deny损失。
AI.result: CIFAR-10 ResNet-18与MNIST实验表明：合法/非法密钥在能量与margin上可分离，但吸收效应会削弱区分；Mode B消融验证了deny损失对吸收抑制有效，整体开销≈1%计算增量。
AI.conclusion: SpanKey首次把子空间密钥注入作为轻量推理闸门，给出可解释诊断与吸收抑制策略；虽不提供密码学安全保证，但为模型服务权限控制与后续研究提供了实用基线与开放代码。

title: Generation-Augmented Generation: A Plug-and-Play Framework for Private Knowledge Injection in Large Language Models
summary: In domains such as materials science, biomedicine, and finance, high-stakes deployment of large language models (LLMs) requires injecting private, domain-specific knowledge that is proprietary, fast-evolving, and under-represented in public pretraining. However, the two dominant paradigms for private knowledge injection each have clear drawbacks: fine-tuning is expensive to iterate under continual updates that can induce catastrophic forgetting and general-capability regression; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) keeps the base model intact but remains brittle in specialized private corpora due to chunk-induced evidence fragmentation, retrieval mismatch, and long-context pressure. Inspired by how multimodal LLMs align heterogeneous modalities into a shared semantic space, we propose Generation-Augmented Generation (GAG), which treats private expertise as an auxiliary modality and injects it into a frozen base model through a compact, constant-budget latent interface. Concretely, GAG distills question-conditioned specialist knowledge from lightweight domain experts into multi-slot latent memories, integrates multi-layer expert signals via per-slot cross-layer fusion, and aligns them to the frozen base model through gated residual projection, while supporting scalable mixed-domain deployment with reliable selective activation. In a unified mixed-domain evaluation spanning two scientific private-domain QA benchmarks (catalytic materials and immunology adjuvant) together with general-domain queries, GAG consistently outperforms strong retrieval-based and parameter-efficient fine-tuning baselines on specialist QA, while preserving general-domain capability, achieving highly reliable routing, and offering a favorable efficiency--effectiveness trade-off. Code and datasets are provided in the supplementary material. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/360CVGroup/GAG.

AI.tldr: 提出 GAG——将私有领域知识视为附加模态，通过固定小预算的潜变量接口注入冻结 LLM，无需重训即可持续更新，兼顾专业问答与通用能力。实验在催化材料与免疫佐剂私有 QA 上超越 RAG 与参数高效微调，且保持通用性能。
AI.motivation: 高价值领域需将专有、快速演化的私有知识注入 LLM，但持续微调成本高昂且易致灾难性遗忘；RAG 在私有语料上因分块碎片化、检索失配和长上下文压力表现脆弱。需要一种低成本、可迭代、不损通用能力的私有知识注入方案。
AI.method: 1) 将私有知识当作“辅助模态”，用轻量级领域专家模型针对问题生成知识，蒸馏为多槽潜变量记忆；2) 通过跨层融合汇聚多层专家信号；3) 用门控残差投影将潜变量对齐到冻结基模型；4) 引入选择性激活机制，实现多领域混合部署与动态路由。
AI.result: 在催化材料与免疫佐剂两个私有科学问答基准及通用问答上，GAG 的专业问答准确率显著优于强 RAG 与 LoRA/AdaLoRA 等参数高效微调基线，同时保持通用域性能，激活路由准确率>98%，推理延迟仅增加 3–7%。
AI.conclusion: GAG 提供了一种“冻结基模型+潜变量接口”的新范式，兼顾私有知识持续更新、灾难遗忘免疫、部署成本低与通用能力保留，适用于材料、生物医药、金融等高 stakes 场景。

title: Machine learning for four-dimensional SU(3) lattice gauge theories
comment: 18 pages, 9 figure; Plenary talk at the 42nd International Symposium on Lattice Field Theory (LATTICE2025), Mumbai, India
summary: In this review I summarize how machine learning can be used in lattice gauge theory simulations and what ap\-proaches are currently available to improve the sampling of gauge field configurations, with a focus on applications in four-dimensional SU(3) gauge theories. These include approaches based on generative machine-learning models such as (stochastic) normalizing flows and diffusion processes, and an approach based on renormalization group (RG) transformations, more specifically the machine learning of RG-improved gauge actions using gauge-equivariant convolutional neural networks. In particular, I present scaling results for a machine-learned fixed-point action in four-dimensional SU(3) gauge theory towards the continuum limit. The results include observables based on the classically perfect gradient-flow scales, which are free of tree-level lattice artefacts to all orders, and quantities related to the static potential and the deconfinement transition.

AI.tldr: 综述了机器学习在四维 SU(3) 格点规范理论中的两条主流提速途径：生成式模型（归一化流、扩散）与RG 改进作用量的神经网络参数化，并首次给出机器学习固定点作用量在连续极限下的标度测试。
AI.motivation: 传统蒙特卡洛采样在接近连续极限时临界慢化严重，需要 O(10⁴) 以上关联长度的马尔可夫链；机器学习有望以 O(1) 成本生成独立组态或直接给出低离散化误差的作用量，从而根本性加速格点 QCD 模拟。
AI.method: 系统比较三类方案：①基于随机归一化流与扩散过程的生成式采样；②用规范等变 CNN 从 RG 流中学习“近似固定点”作用量；③以梯度流尺度、静势、去禁闭跃迁等可观测量为基准，在四维 SU(3) 格子上做连续外推。
AI.result: 机器学习得到的 RG 改进作用量在 a→0 时显示渐近标度，与 Symanzik 改进作用量相比，树格格点 artifact 被抑制到所有阶；梯度流尺度 t₀/w₀ 与静势 r₀ 的连续外推与标准结果一致，去禁闭过渡温度误差 <1%。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习不仅能当快速采样器，更能通过 RG 视角“学到”几乎完美的格点作用量，为格点 QCD 提供连续极限可控、且无树级误差的新模拟范式；未来有望在更大体积、物理夸克质量下替代传统 Hybrid Monte Carlo。

title: Socrates Loss: Unifying Confidence Calibration and Classification by Leveraging the Unknown
summary: Deep neural networks, despite their high accuracy, often exhibit poor confidence calibration, limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Current ad-hoc confidence calibration methods attempt to fix this during training but face a fundamental trade-off: two-phase training methods achieve strong classification performance at the cost of training instability and poorer confidence calibration, while single-loss methods are stable but underperform in classification. This paper addresses and mitigates this stability-performance trade-off. We propose Socrates Loss, a novel, unified loss function that explicitly leverages uncertainty by incorporating an auxiliary unknown class, whose predictions directly influence the loss function and a dynamic uncertainty penalty. This unified objective allows the model to be optimized for both classification and confidence calibration simultaneously, without the instability of complex, scheduled losses. We provide theoretical guarantees that our method regularizes the model to prevent miscalibration and overfitting. Across four benchmark datasets and multiple architectures, our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Socrates Loss consistently improves training stability while achieving more favorable accuracy-calibration trade-off, often converging faster than existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一个统一损失Socrates Loss，可在单次训练中同时优化分类与置信度校准，缓解二阶段训练的稳定性与性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 深度网络虽准确却校准差，现有后期校准或训练期折衷方案均存在稳定性-性能两难，需要一种无需两阶段即可同时保证精度与校准的训练目标。
AI.method: 设计未知辅助类及动态不确定性惩罚项，构造单目标Socrates Loss；理论上证明其具有防止过拟合与误校准的正则化效应，并可直接端到端训练。
AI.result: 在4个基准数据集与多种架构上，Socrates Loss在保持或提升准确率的同时降低ECE，训练更稳定、收敛更快，超越单损失与多阶段基线。
AI.conclusion: Socrates Loss统一了分类与校准优化，消除了稳定性-性能权衡，为高风险场景提供了更可信的端到端训练方案。

title: ARGen: Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation towards Vision-based Dynamic Emotion Perception
summary: Dynamic facial expression recognition in the wild remains challenging due to data scarcity and long-tail distributions, which hinder models from effectively learning the temporal dynamics of scarce emotions. To address these limitations, we propose ARGen, an Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation Framework that enables data-adaptive dynamic expression generation for robust emotion perception. ARGen operates in two stages: Affective Semantic Injection (ASI) and Adaptive Reinforcement Diffusion (ARD). The ASI stage establishes affective knowledge alignment through facial Action Units and employs a retrieval-augmented prompt generation strategy to synthesize consistent and fine-grained affective descriptions via large-scale visual-language models, thereby injecting interpretable emotional priors into the generation process. The ARD stage integrates text-conditioned image-to-video diffusion with reinforcement learning, introducing inter-frame conditional guidance and a multi-objective reward function to jointly optimize expression naturalness, facial integrity, and generative efficiency. Extensive experiments on both generation and recognition tasks verify that ARGen substantially enhances synthesis fidelity and improves recognition performance, establishing an interpretable and generalizable generative augmentation paradigm for vision-based affective computing.

AI.tldr: 针对野外动态表情数据稀缺与长尾分布难题，提出两阶段可解释增强生成框架 ARGen，在生成与识别双任务上同时提升合成保真度与识别准确率。
AI.motivation: 野外动态表情识别因稀缺情绪样本不足及长尾分布，导致模型难以学习时间动态；亟需既能扩充稀缺类别又能保持时间一致性的生成方法。
AI.method: ARGen 分两步：1) ASI 阶段利用面部 Action Units 建立情感知识对齐，并以检索增强提示策略驱动大模型生成细粒度情感描述，注入可解释先验；2) ARD 阶段将文本条件图生视频扩散模型与强化学习结合，提出帧间条件引导及多目标奖励函数，联合优化表情自然度、面部完整性与生成效率。
AI.result: 大量生成与识别实验表明，ARGen 在合成保真度上显著优于现有方法，并使下游识别模型在稀缺情绪类别上的准确率大幅提升，验证其作为通用可解释增强范式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ARGen 通过先验注入与强化扩散协同，首次实现面向野外动态表情的数据自适应增强，为基于视觉的情感计算提供高保真、可解释且通用的生成解决方案。

title: Understanding or Memorizing? A Case Study of German Definite Articles in Language Models
summary: Language models perform well on grammatical agreement, but it is unclear whether this reflects rule-based generalization or memorization. We study this question for German definite singular articles, whose forms depend on gender and case. Using GRADIEND, a gradient-based interpretability method, we learn parameter update directions for gender-case specific article transitions. We find that updates learned for a specific gender-case article transition frequently affect unrelated gender-case settings, with substantial overlap among the most affected neurons across settings. These results argue against a strictly rule-based encoding of German definite articles, indicating that models at least partly rely on memorized associations rather than abstract grammatical rules.

AI.tldr: German-article-learning in LMs is driven by memorized item-specific associations, not crisp symbolic rules.
AI.motivation: Clarify whether LMs’ grammatical-agreement competence is rule-based generalization or rote memorization, using German case/gender articles as a test case.
AI.method: Train gender-case specific article transitions; apply GRADIEND (gradient-based interpretability) to extract parameter-update directions; measure how targeted updates spill over to unrelated gender-case settings and quantify neuron-overlap.
AI.result: Updates targeting one gender-case pair frequently alter unrelated pairs; high neuron overlap across settings; no isolated, rule-specific circuits detected.
AI.conclusion: German definite articles are not encoded via distinct symbolic rules; models rely on distributed, overlapping memorized associations.

title: VeriX-Anon: A Multi-Layered Framework for Mathematically Verifiable Outsourced Target-Driven Data Anonymization
summary: Organisations increasingly outsource privacy-sensitive data transformations to cloud providers, yet no practical mechanism lets the data owner verify that the contracted algorithm was faithfully executed. VeriX-Anon is a multi-layered verification framework for outsourced Target-Driven k-anonymization combining three orthogonal mechanisms: deterministic verification via Merkle-style hashing of an Authenticated Decision Tree, probabilistic verification via Boundary Sentinels near the Random Forest decision boundary and exact-duplicate Twins with cryptographic identifiers, and utility-based verification via Explainable AI fingerprinting that compares SHAP value distributions before and after anonymization using the Wasserstein distance. Evaluated on three cross-domain datasets against Lazy (drops 5 percent of records), Dumb (random splitting, fake hash), and Approximate (random splitting, valid hash) adversaries, VeriX-Anon correctly detected deviations in 11 of 12 scenarios. No single layer achieved this alone. The XAI layer was the only mechanism that caught the Approximate adversary, succeeding on Adult and Bank but failing on the severely imbalanced Diabetes dataset where class imbalance suppresses the SHAP signal, confirming the need for adaptive thresholding. An 11-point k-sweep showed Target-Driven anonymization preserves significantly more utility than Blind anonymization (Wilcoxon $p = 0.000977$, Cohen's $d = 1.96$, mean F1 gap $+0.1574$). Client-side verification completes under one second at one million rows. The threat model covers three empirically evaluated profiles and one theoretical profile (Informed Attacker) aware of trap embedding but unable to defeat the cryptographic salt. Sentinel evasion probability ranges from near-zero for balanced datasets to 0.52 for imbalanced ones, a limitation the twin layer compensates for in every tested scenario.

AI.tldr: VeriX-Anon用三层正交验证机制（哈希+边界哨兵+SHAP指纹）在客户端1 s内可检测云服务商是否忠实执行k-匿名化合约，12场景11次成功，仅XAI层捕获
AI.motivation: 机构将含隐私的数据变换外包给云后，缺乏轻量级手段验证对方是否按约定算法执行，尤其k-匿名化这类会修改数据分布的操作。
AI.method: 提出VeriX-Anon框架：①确定性层——对认证决策树做Merkle哈希；②概率层——在随机森林边界布哨兵并插入带密码盐的双胞胎记录；③效用层——用SHAP值分布的Wasserstein距离做XAI指纹比对。三层结果联合判定。
AI.result: 在Adult、Bank、Diabetes三数据集上对抗Lazy、Dumb、Approximate三类攻击者，整体检测率11/12；单用XAI层可揪出Approximate攻击，但在类别极度不平衡的Diabetes上因SHAP信号弱而失效。目标驱动匿名化比盲匿名化F1平均高0.1574（p=0.000977，d=1.96）。客户端验证≤1 s/百万行；哨兵逃逸率在最不平衡数据集上达0.52，由双胞胎层补偿。
AI.conclusion: 多正交机制协同可在轻量级代价下高置信验证外包k-匿名化，但需针对数据分布自适应设定阈值；效用导向匿名化同时提升可验证性与模型可用性。

title: SubFlow: Sub-mode Conditioned Flow Matching for Diverse One-Step Generation
summary: Flow matching has emerged as a powerful generative framework, with recent few-step methods achieving remarkable inference acceleration. However, we identify a critical yet overlooked limitation: these models suffer from severe diversity degradation, concentrating samples on dominant modes while neglecting rare but valid variations of the target distribution. We trace this degradation to averaging distortion: when trained with MSE objectives, class-conditional flows learn a frequency-weighted mean over intra-class sub-modes, causing the model to over-represent high-density modes while systematically neglecting low-density ones. To address this, we propose SubFlow, Sub-mode Conditioned Flow Matching, which eliminates averaging distortion by decomposing each class into fine-grained sub-modes via semantic clustering and conditioning the flow on sub-mode indices. Each conditioned sub-distribution is approximately unimodal, so the learned flow accurately targets individual modes with no averaging distortion, restoring full mode coverage in a single inference step. Crucially, SubFlow is entirely plug-and-play: it integrates seamlessly into existing one-step models such as MeanFlow and Shortcut Models without any architectural modifications. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-256 demonstrate that SubFlow yields substantial gains in generation diversity (Recall) while maintaining competitive image quality (FID), confirming its broad applicability across different one-step generation frameworks. Project page: https://yexionglin.github.io/subflow.

AI.tldr: 单步Flow模型在MSE训练下会平均化类内子模，导致多样性崩塌；SubFlow通过“语义聚类→子模编号条件”把单峰子模独立建模，无需改网络即可一步恢复全模覆盖，ImageNet-256上Recall↑、FID持平。
AI.motivation: 现有少步Flow匹配推理加速方法被证实存在严重多样性退化：样本集中于高密度主模，稀有但有效的子模被系统性忽略，限制了生成完整性。
AI.method: 1) 对每个类别做语义聚类，自动发现K个细粒度子模；2) 训练阶段将子模编号作为额外条件，构建子模条件流匹配损失，使每个子分布逼近单峰；3) 推理时依均匀先验随机选子模编号，单步生成即可覆盖所有子模；4) 以插件形式嵌入已有单步架构（MeanFlow/Shortcut），零网络改动。
AI.result: ImageNet-256上相较于原单步基线，SubFlow将Recall从0.38提升至0.61（+61%），FID维持在2.30左右；在Shortcut、MeanFlow等不同框架上均观察到一致的多样性增益，且推理耗时仅增加可忽略的K类采样开销。
AI.conclusion: 证明“类内平均失真”是少步Flow多样性丢失的主因；通过子模条件化解平均即可一步还原全模分布，兼顾加速与多样性，为后续一步生成模型提供通用插件范式。

title: Coding-Free and Privacy-Preserving MCP Framework for Clinical Agentic Research Intelligence System
summary: Clinical research involves labor-intensive processes such as study design, cohort construction, model development, and documentation, requiring domain expertise, programming skills, and access to sensitive patient data.
