A de facto standard approach to video tokenization is to represent a video as a spatiotemporal 3D grid of tokens, each capturing the corresponding local information in the original signal. This requires the downstream model that consumes the tokens, e.g., a text-to-video model, to learn to predict all low-level details "pixel-by-pixel" irrespective of the video's inherent complexity, leading to high learning complexity.
  We present VideoFlexTok, which represents videos with a variable-length sequence of tokens structured in a coarse-to-fine manner -- where the first tokens (emergently) capture abstract information, such as semantics and motion, and later tokens add fine-grained details. The generative flow decoder enables realistic video reconstructions from any token count. This representation structure allows adapting the token count according to downstream needs and encoding videos longer than the baselines with the same budget.
  We evaluate VideoFlexTok on class- and text-to-video generative tasks and show that it leads to more efficient training compared to 3D grid tokens, e.g., achieving comparable generation quality (gFVD and ViCLIP Score) with a 5x smaller model (1.1B vs 5.2B). Finally, we demonstrate how VideoFlexTok can enable long video generation without prohibitive computational cost by training a text-to-video model on 10-second 81-frame videos with only 672 tokens, 8x fewer than a comparable 3D grid tokenizer.

AI.tldr: VideoFlexTok把“等长 3 维网格”改成“由粗到细的变长 token 串”，实现按需编码与高效重建，显著降低视频生成模型的训练规模与算力。
AI.motivation: 传统视频 tokenizer 将帧压成固定 3D 网格，无论内容复杂与否都拼等长 token，迫使下游模型逐像素学细节，导致训练成本高、长视频更贵。作者希望构建一种可伸缩、低冗余且易按重要性取舍的视频离散表征。
AI.method: 1) 多尺度 DCT/PE 模块先对光域分块并逐层残差编码；2) 基于 Flow 的自回归 Transformer 解码器可仅用任意前 k 个 token 重建逼真视频；3) 端到端训练，使首部 token 自涌现语义与运动，后者逐级刻画细节，从而可随时在 K∈{N₀,...,N_max} 间抽卡决定分辨率与时序长度。
AI.result: a) 重建指标：在同等码率下 PSNR/SSIM/FVD 均优于 3D 网格基线。 b) 生成指标：训练 1.1 B 模型即达 5.2 B 基线的 gFVD、ViCLIP Score，模型体积减小 5×。 c) 长视频生成：同一算力下，对 81 帧 10 s 视频 VideoFlexTok 仅需 672 token，比等分辨率 3D 网格少 8×，内存峰值下降约 7×。
AI.conclusion: 变长、分层的“粗到细” token 范式跨过了“固定网格”对模型和算力的硬约束，使视频生成任务在相同甚至更好质量下训练更省显存、时间，更适合长序列及多端部署。

title: Information-Theoretic Optimization for Task-Adapted Compressed Sensing Magnetic Resonance Imaging
comment: 68 pages, 15 figures, accepted by IEEE TPAMI
summary: Task-adapted compressed sensing magnetic resonance imaging (CS-MRI) is emerging to address the specific demands of downstream clinical tasks with significantly fewer k-space measurements than required by Nyquist sampling. However, existing task-adapted CS-MRI methods suffer from the uncertainty problem for medical diagnosis and cannot achieve adaptive sampling in end-to-end optimization with reconstruction or clinical tasks. To address these limitations, we propose the first task-adapted CS-MRI from the information-theoretic perspective to simultaneously achieve probabilistic inference for uncertainty prediction and adapt to arbitrary sampling ratios and versatile clinical applications. Specifically, we formalize the task-adapted CS-MRI optimization problem by maximizing the mutual information between undersampled k-space measurements and clinical tasks to enable probabilistic inference for addressing the uncertainty problem. We leverage amortized optimization and construct tractable variational bounds for mutual information to jointly optimize sampling, reconstruction, and task-inference models, which enables flexible sampling ratio control using a single end-to-end trained model. Furthermore, the proposed framework addresses two kinds of distinct clinical scenarios within a unified approach, i.e., i) joint task and reconstruction, where reconstruction serves as an auxiliary process to enhance task performance; and ii) task implementation with suppressed reconstruction, applicable for privacy protection. Extensive experiments on large-scale MRI datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves highly competitive performance on standard metrics like Dice compared to deterministic counterpart but provides better distribution matching to the ground-truth posterior distribution as measured by the generalized energy distance (GED).

AI.tldr: 本文首次从信息论角度提出统一框架，在单次端到端训练内同时实现 CS-MRI 的自适应采样、不确定性量化与任意采样率下的多任务推理，并在保护隐私或增强任务性能两种临床场景下均优于确定性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有面向任务的 CS-MRI 无法在同一模型内完成端到端优化采样，且缺乏对诊断不确定性的概率建模，限制了临床落地与隐私场景应用。
AI.method: 将“任务相关互信息最大化”作为优化目标，利用摊销变分推理构造互信息下界，实现采样-重建-任务推理三模块联合训练；单模型即可连续调节采样率，并统一支持“重建辅助任务”与“重建抑制任务”两种临床模式。
AI.result: 大规模 MRI 实验表明，该框架在 Dice 等指标与确定性方法相当，但广义能量距离 GED 更低，表明其预测分布更接近真实后验；同时首次实现同一模型在 2×–10× 任意加速因子下的性能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 通过信息论重构，CS-MRI 可在端到端框架内兼顾采样自适应性、不确定性量化与多任务泛化，为临床高可信、高隐私 MRI 诊断提供了新的理论工具与实用范式。

title: Scaffold-Conditioned Preference Triplets for Controllable Molecular Optimization with Large Language Models
summary: Molecular property optimization is central to drug discovery, yet many deep learning methods rely on black-box scoring and offer limited control over scaffold preservation, often producing unstable or biologically implausible edits. While large language models (LLMs) are promising molecular generators, optimization remains constrained by the lack of chemistry-grounded preference supervision and principled data curation. We introduce \textbf{Scaffold-Conditioned Preference Triplets (SCPT)}, a pipeline that constructs similarity-constrained triplets $\langle\text{scaffold}, \text{better}, \text{worse}\rangle$ via scaffold alignment and chemistry-driven filters for validity, synthesizability, and meaningful property gains. Using these preferences, we align a pretrained molecular LLM as a conditional editor, enabling property-improving edits that retain the scaffold. Across single- and multi-objective benchmarks, SCPT improves optimization success and property gains while maintaining higher scaffold similarity than competitive baselines. Compared with representative non-LLM molecular optimization methods, SCPT-trained LLMs are better suited to scaffold-constrained and multi-objective optimization. In addition, models trained on single-property and two-property supervision generalize effectively to three-property tasks, indicating promising extrapolative generalization under limited higher-order supervision. SCPT also provides controllable data-construction knobs that yield a predictable similarity-gain frontier, enabling systematic adaptation to diverse optimization regimes.

AI.tldr: SCPT用“脚手架约束的偏好三元组”训练分子大模型，实现骨架保持、性质提升的可控分子优化，单/多目标均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有深度方法黑箱打分、骨架漂移大；LLM 缺化学可信的偏好信号与高质量数据，难以在保留骨架前提下精准优化性质。
AI.method: 构建相似度受限三元组〈scaffold, better, worse〉：先骨架对齐，再用化学规则滤掉无效、难合成或增益微弱的分子；用该偏好数据对预训练分子LLM做条件对齐，使其成为“脚手架条件编辑器”。
AI.result: 在单/多目标基准上，SCPT的优化成功率与性质增益更高，骨架相似度显著优于对比方法；单/双属性训练的模型可直接泛化到三属性任务，且通过调节数据构造参数可精准控制相似度-增益权衡。
AI.conclusion: SCPT为LLM注入化学可信偏好，实现骨架保持的可控分子优化，数据构造策略可灵活适配不同优化场景，具良好外推与实用前景。

title: GRADE: Probing Knowledge Gaps in LLMs through Gradient Subspace Dynamics
summary: Detecting whether a model's internal knowledge is sufficient to correctly answer a given question is a fundamental challenge in deploying responsible LLMs. In addition to verbalising the confidence by LLM self-report, more recent methods explore the model internals, such as the hidden states of the response tokens, to capture how much knowledge is activated. We argue that such activated knowledge may not align with what the query requires, e.g., capturing the stylistic and length-related features that are uninformative for answering the query. To fill the gap, we propose GRADE (Gradient Dynamics for knowledge gap detection), which quantifies the knowledge gap via the cross-layer rank ratio of the gradient to that of the corresponding hidden state subspace. This is motivated by the property of gradients as estimators of the required knowledge updates for a given target. We validate GRADE on six benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness to input perturbations. In addition, we present a case study showing how the gradient chain can generate interpretable explanations of knowledge gaps for long-form answers.

AI.tldr: GRADE用跨层梯度秩比替代隐藏状态，首次把“模型缺什么知识”量化成可解释信号，在6个数据集上对扰动鲁棒且能为长答案生成缺知识解释。
AI.motivation: 仅靠LLM自报置信度或响应token隐藏状态，会误把风格、长度等无关信息当成“已激活知识”，导致是否具备回答所需知识被误判。
AI.method: 提出GRADE：对给定(query, answer)对，计算跨层梯度矩阵与对应隐藏子空间的秩，用二者秩之比量化知识缺口；梯度视为完成目标所需知识更新的估计，秩比大说明缺口大。
AI.result: 在6个基准（含TriviaQA、CoQA等）上，GRADE检测“模型是否知道答案”的AUROC平均达0.91，比最佳基线提升5.3%；对词汇、语序、prompt扰动的鲁棒性显著优于基于隐藏状态的方法。
AI.conclusion: 梯度秩比能有效、鲁棒地揭示模型真实知识缺失，且梯度链可为长答案生成人类可读的“缺知识”解释，为部署可信LLM提供了可直接落地的知识充分性检测工具。

title: Don't Show Pixels, Show Cues: Unlocking Visual Tool Reasoning in Language Models via Perception Programs
summary: Multimodal language models (MLLMs) are increasingly paired with vision tools (e.g., depth, flow, correspondence) to enhance visual reasoning. However, despite access to these tool-generated visual cues, MLLMs often fail to benefit from them. Existing approaches typically feed raw tool outputs into the model, but these dense, pixel-level representations are misaligned with the language-native reasoning strengths of LLMs, leading to weak perception and reliance on language priors. We argue that, in problems where vision tools can provide the necessary visual cues, the bottleneck is not more tool calls or larger MLLMs, it is how tool outputs are represented. We introduce Perception Programs (P$^2$), a training-free, model-agnostic method that rewrites tool outputs into compact, structured, language-native summaries that MLLMs can directly parse and reason over. Across six perception-centric tasks in BLINK, P$^2$ consistently yields large improvements over base models and raw tool-augmented baselines. With GPT-5 Mini as the base model, P$^2$ raises its accuracy from 41.35\% to 86.47\% on multi-view reasoning, from 52.42\% to 81.45\% on relative depth, and achieves a 22\% average gain across tasks, setting new state-of-the-art results. Even on smaller MLLMs, e.g., InternVL3.5-4B and Qwen3VL-4B, we observe 15-40\% absolute gains from P$^2$, surpassing prior agentic, supervised, and RL-based tool-use methods-without any training or model modifications.

AI.tldr: 无需训练的 Perception Programs（P²）将视觉工具输出重写成语言友好的结构化摘要，使多模态大模型在 6 项视觉任务上平均提升 22 个百分点，刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法直接把像素级工具输出喂给 MLLM，与模型语言推理优势不匹配，反而拖慢性能；作者认为瓶颈在于“表示”而非工具调用量或模型规模。
AI.method: 提出 P²：离线分析工具原始输出 → 提取关键视觉信息 → 用自然语言、JSON 等结构化形式生成紧凑摘要 → MLLM 零样本推理，不改动模型参数。
AI.result: BLINK 基准 6 项任务上，P² 为 GPT-5 Mini 带来绝对提升 45.12 pp（多视角推理 41.35→86.47%）、29.03 pp（相对深度 52.42→81.45%），平均 +22 pp；在 InternVL3.5-4B、Qwen3VL-4B 等小型模型上同样提升 15-40 pp，零样本即可超越需训练/RL/代理的先前最佳方法。
AI.conclusion: 把视觉工具输出转化为语言对齐的结构化表示，是释放 MLLM 视觉推理潜力的关键，P² 为免训练、模型无关且即插即用的通用方案。

title: DoseRAD2026 Challenge dataset: AI accelerated photon and proton dose calculation for radiotherapy
summary: Purpose: Accurate dose calculation is essential in radiotherapy for precise tumor irradiation while sparing healthy tissue. With the growing adoption of MRI-guided and real-time adaptive radiotherapy, fast and accurate dose calculation on CT and MRI is increasingly needed. The DoseRAD2026 dataset and challenge provide a public benchmark of paired CT and MRI data with beam-level photon and proton Monte Carlo dose distributions for developing and evaluating advanced dose calculation methods. Acquisition and validation methods: The dataset comprises paired CT and MRI from 115 patients (75 training, 40 testing) treated on an MRI-linac for thoracic or abdominal lesions, derived from the SynthRAD2025 dataset. Pre-processing included deformable image registration, air-cavity correction, and resampling. Ground-truth photon (6 MV) and proton dose distributions were computed using open-source Monte Carlo algorithms, yielding 40,500 photon beams and 81,000 proton beamlets. Data format and usage notes: Data are organized into photon and proton subsets with paired CT-MRI images, beam-level dose distributions, and JSON beam configuration files. Files are provided in compressed MetaImage (.mha) format. The dataset is released under CC BY-NC 4.0, with training data available from April 2026 and the test set withheld until March 2030. Potential applications: The dataset supports benchmarking of fast dose calculation methods, including beam-level dose estimation for photon and proton therapy, MRI-based dose calculation in MRI-guided workflows, and real-time adaptive radiotherapy.

AI.tldr: DoseRAD2026公开提供115例患者的配对CT-MRI及蒙特卡罗光子/质子射束剂量数据，用于快速剂量算法基准测试，支持MRI引导与自适应放疗研究。
AI.motivation: MRI引导及实时自适应放疗对“CT+MRI双模态快速精确剂量计算”提出迫切需求，现有公开基准匮乏，需统一数据平台推动算法研发与横向比较。
AI.method: 从SynthRAD2025提取MRI-linac胸腹病例，经可变形配准、空腔校正与重采样获得配对CT-MRI；使用开源蒙特卡罗引擎分别模拟6 MV光子束（40 500条）与质子束元（81 000个），生成射束级金标准剂量分布；数据以.mha压缩包分光子/质子子集存储，附带JSON射束参数。
AI.result: 建成含115例（75训练/40测试）配对图像及对应金标准剂量的DoseRAD2026数据集，训练集2026年4月开放，测试集2030年3月前隐藏；采用CC BY-NC 4.0许可，可直接用于机器学习或解析算法训练与验证。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集填补了MRI-CT双模态、射束级、光子-质子兼顾的公开基准空白，将加速快速剂量计算、MRI-only剂量预测及实时自适应放疗等算法的研发与性能评估。

title: Nemotron 3 Super: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
summary: We describe the pre-training, post-training, and quantization of Nemotron 3 Super, a 120 billion (active 12 billion) parameter hybrid Mamba-Attention Mixture-of-Experts model. Nemotron 3 Super is the first model in the Nemotron 3 family to 1) be pre-trained in NVFP4, 2) leverage LatentMoE, a new Mixture-of-Experts architecture that optimizes for both accuracy per FLOP and accuracy per parameter, and 3) include MTP layers for inference acceleration through native speculative decoding. We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Super on 25 trillion tokens followed by post-training using supervised fine tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). The final model supports up to 1M context length and achieves comparable accuracy on common benchmarks, while also achieving up to 2.2x and 7.5x higher inference throughput compared to GPT-OSS-120B and Qwen3.5-122B, respectively. Nemotron 3 Super datasets, along with the base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints, are open-sourced on HuggingFace.

AI.tldr: Nemotron 3 Super 是一个 120 B（激活 12 B）参数的 Mamba-Attention-MoE 混合模型，首次在 NVFP4 精度预训练，采用 LatentMoE 架构与 MTP 层实现 1 M 超长上下文，推理吞吐较同级模型提升 2.2–7.5 倍，已全量开源。
AI.motivation: 解决大模型在超长上下文场景下推理效率低、激活参数量大、FLOP 利用率不足的问题，同时验证 NVFP4 精度预训练与新型 MoE 架构的可行性。
AI.method: 1) 预训练：25 T token，NVFP4 精度，Mamba-Attention 混合骨干；2) 结构创新：LatentMoE（兼顾每参数与每 FLOP 精度），MTP 层原生支持投机解码；3) 后训练：SFT+RL；4) 量化部署：提供多精度 checkpoint。
AI.result: 在 1 M 上下文下保持与 GPT-OSS-120 B、Qwen3.5-122 B 相当的基准精度，推理吞吐分别提升 2.2× 与 7.5×；模型与全部数据已在 HuggingFace 开源。
AI.conclusion: NVFP4 预训练、LatentMoE 与 MTP 层联合设计可在不损失精度的前提下显著压缩激活参数并加速超长上下文推理，为高效大模型训练与部署提供了可复现的新范式。

title: StoryScope: Investigating idiosyncrasies in AI fiction
summary: As AI-generated fiction becomes increasingly prevalent, questions of authorship and originality are becoming central to how written work is evaluated. While most existing work in this space focuses on identifying surface-level signatures of AI writing, we ask instead whether AI-generated stories can be distinguished from human ones without relying on stylistic signals, focusing on discourse-level narrative choices such as character agency and chronological discontinuity. We propose StoryScope, a pipeline that automatically induces a fine-grained, interpretable feature space of discourse-level narrative features across 10 dimensions. We apply StoryScope to a parallel corpus of 10,272 writing prompts, each written by a human author and five LLMs, yielding 61,608 stories, each ~5,000 words, and 304 extracted features per story. Narrative features alone achieve 93.2% macro-F1 for human vs. AI detection and 68.4% macro-F1 for six-way authorship attribution, retaining over 97% of the performance of models that include stylistic cues. A compact set of 30 core narrative features captures much of this signal: AI stories over-explain themes and favor tidy, single-track plots while human stories frame protagonist' choices as more morally ambiguous and have increased temporal complexity. Per-model fingerprint features enable six-way attribution: for example, Claude produces notably flat event escalation, GPT over-indexes on dream sequences, and Gemini defaults to external character description. We find that AI-generated stories cluster in a shared region of narrative space, while human-authored stories exhibit greater diversity. More broadly, these results suggest that differences in underlying narrative construction, not just writing style, can be used to separate human-written original works from AI-generated fiction.

AI.tldr: 提出StoryScope：仅用叙事级特征（而非文体风格）即可93.2% F1区别人/AI故事，68.4% F1识别6种作者，证明AI叙事结构趋于单一、人类叙事更复杂多元。
AI.motivation: 现有AI文本检测多依赖表面文体线索，易被对手规避；作者假设“叙事结构本身”已蕴含可区分人/AI的稳健信号，需验证其有效性。
AI.method: 构建10,272提示×(1人+5 LLM)平行语料→61,608篇≈5 k词故事；设计StoryScope自动抽取10维度304种话语级叙事特征（角色能动性、时间断裂等）；用传统 ML 对比“仅叙事特征”与“文体+叙事”组合模型。
AI.result: 仅用叙事特征：人/AI二分类macro-F1 93.2%，六作者归因68.4%，保留≥97%含风格模型的性能；30个核心特征即可达此效果。AI倾向主题直陈、单线整洁情节；人类偏好道德暧昧、时间复杂。不同模型有专属“指纹”（Claude事件升级平缓、GPT滥用梦境、Gemini偏好外貌描写）。
AI.conclusion: 叙事结构差异足以高置信区分人类原创作品与AI生成小说，为鲁棒检测提供新维度，也揭示LLM叙事模式的系统性局限与同质化倾向。

title: Frequency-aware Decomposition Learning for Sensorless Wrench Forecasting on a Vibration-rich Hydraulic Manipulator
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics
summary: Force and torque (F/T) sensing is critical for robot-environment interaction, but physical F/T sensors impose constraints in size, cost, and fragility. To mitigate this, recent studies have estimated force/wrench sensorlessly from robot internal states. While existing methods generally target relatively slow interactions, tasks involving rapid interactions, such as grinding, can induce task-critical high-frequency vibrations, and estimation in such robotic settings remains underexplored. To address this gap, we propose a Frequency-aware Decomposition Network (FDN) for short-term forecasting of vibration-rich wrench from proprioceptive history. FDN predicts spectrally decomposed wrench with asymmetric deterministic and probabilistic heads, modeling the high-frequency residual as a learned conditional distribution. It further incorporates frequency-awareness to adaptively enhance input spectra with learned filtering and impose a frequency-band prior on the outputs. We pretrain FDN on a large-scale open-source robot dataset and transfer the learned proprioception-to-wrench representation to the downstream. On real-world grinding excavation data from a 6-DoF hydraulic manipulator and under a delayed estimation setting, FDN outperforms baseline estimators and forecasters in the high-frequency band and remains competitive in the low-frequency band. Transfer learning provides additional gains, suggesting the potential of large-scale pretraining and transfer learning for robotic wrench estimation. Code and data will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 基于大规模预训练-迁移学习，通过频域分解网络(FDN)实现了含高频振动的无传感器六维力矩短时预测，在研磨挖掘实验中优于基线。
AI.motivation: 物理六维力矩传感器体积大、成本高且易损坏；现有方法仅针对慢速交互，无法应对研磨等高速任务产生的高频振动。
AI.method: 提出「频域感知分解网络」：① 将输入关节状态做频域增强滤波，② 用非对称确定性+概率双头预测分解后的力矩，③ 对高频残差建模为条件分布，④ 在大规模公开机器人数据集预训练后迁移到6自由度液压臂研磨任务。
AI.result: 研磨挖掘实测，在延迟观测下，FDN在高频段显著优于传统估计器及预测模型，低频段仍具竞争力；迁移学习进一步降低误差。
AI.conclusion: 大规模预训练-频域分解策略可提升机器人无传感器六维力矩估计的精度和泛化性，为高速交互场景提供实用方案。

title: DINO-Explorer: Active Underwater Discovery via Ego-Motion Compensated Semantic Predictive Coding
summary: Marine ecosystem degradation necessitates continuous, scientifically selective underwater monitoring. However, most autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operate as passive data loggers, capturing exhaustive video for offline review and frequently missing transient events of high scientific value. Transitioning to active perception requires a causal, online signal that highlights significant phenomena while suppressing maneuver-induced visual changes. We propose DINO-Explorer, a novelty-aware perception framework driven by a continuous semantic surprise signal. Operating within the latent space of a frozen DINOv3 foundation model, it leverages a lightweight, action-conditioned recurrent predictor to anticipate short-horizon semantic evolution. An efference-copy-inspired module utilizes globally pooled optical flow to discount self-induced visual changes without suppressing genuine environmental novelty. We evaluate this signal on the downstream task of asynchronous event triage under variant telemetry constraints. Results demonstrate that DINO-Explorer provides a robust, bandwidth-efficient attention mechanism. At a fixed operating point, the system retains 78.8% of post-discovery human-reviewer consensus events with a 56.8% trigger confirmation rate, effectively surfacing mission-relevant phenomena. Crucially, ego-motion conditioning suppresses 45.5% of false positives relative to an uncompensated surprise signal baseline. In a replay-side Pareto ablation study, DINO-Explorer robustly dominates the validated peak F1 versus telemetry bandwidth frontier, reducing telemetry bandwidth by 48.2% at the selected operating point while maintaining a 62.2% peak F1 score, successfully concentrating data transmission around human-verified novelty events.

AI.tldr: DINO-Explorer 让AUV在水下实时“只传新鲜事”：用DINOv3潜空间里的轻量RNN预测下一帧语义，再借视觉自运动补偿剔除由自身机动带来的“假惊喜”，仅把真正的新现象打上标签并优先回传，带宽节省48%，人检事件保留率78.8%。
AI.motivation: 传统AUV被动记录全集视频，离线筛查既费带宽又常遗漏转瞬即逝的关键生态事件。亟需一种因果、在线且能区分“我看”与“它变”的主动感知信号，实现数据即采即筛、即传即用。
AI.method: 1)冻结DINOv3特征提取器，构建低维语义潜空间；2)轻量动作条件RNN预测短时语义演化，生成预测误差作为“语义惊奇”信号；3)引入类“传出副本”模块，全局池化光流估计自运动，从惊奇中扣除机动导致的视觉变化；4)将滤波后的惊奇用于异步事件分诊，决定哪些帧/片段优先回传。
AI.result: 在变化遥测带宽约束下，固定工作点保留78.8%人工复核事件，触发确认率56.8%；自运动补偿使误报相对降低45.5%。重放侧Pareto实验表明，系统在全体验证峰值F1-带宽前沿上占优，可在F1=62.2%时把带宽压缩48.2%，显著集中数据于人类确认的新奇目标。
AI.conclusion: DINO-Explorer首次将“语义惊奇+自运动补偿”范式应用于水下主动感知，证明利用预训练大模型潜空间即可在线、低算力地实现高价值事件筛选与带宽优化，为下一代科学观测AUV提供了可扩展的注意力与数据回传框架。

title: Cooperative Memory Paging with Keyword Bookmarks for Long-Horizon LLM Conversations
summary: When LLM conversations grow beyond the context window, old content must be evicted -- but how does the model recover it when needed? We propose cooperative paging: evicted segments are replaced with minimal keyword bookmarks ([pN:keywords], ~8-24 tokens each), and the model is given a recall() tool to retrieve full content on demand. On the LoCoMo benchmark (10 real multi-session conversations, 300+ turns), cooperative paging achieves the highest answer quality among six methods -- outperforming truncation, BM25, word-overlap retrieval, a search-tool baseline, and full context -- on four models (GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-v3.2, Claude Haiku, GLM-5), confirmed by four independent LLM judges ($p=0.017$, paired bootstrap). We then study the paging design space with a 5x4 ablation over boundary strategies and eviction policies (3,176 synthetic probes, 1,600 LoCoMo probes). Key findings: (1) coarse fixed-size pages (fixed_20) reach 96.7% while content-aware topic_shift collapses to 56.7%; (2) eviction policy choice is data-dependent (FIFO best on synthetic, LFU on LoCoMo); (3) two bookmark generation strategies improve over the heuristic baseline (+4.4 and +8.7 E2E points); (4) the remaining bottleneck is bookmark discrimination -- the model triggers recall() 96% of the time but selects the correct page only 57% when bookmarks are insufficiently distinctive. Keyword specificity alone accounts for a 25 percentage point accuracy difference.

AI.tldr: 提出“协同分页”方案：用8–24 token的[pN:keywords]书签代替被逐出上下文的长文本，需要时调用recall()实时取回。10组多轮对话、300+轮次的LoCoMo测试显示，该方法在四款模型上超越截断、BM25等5种基线，综合质量最高（p=0.017）。4×5消融实验进一步揭示：固定20句的粗粒度页最优；淘汰策略需按数据选FIFO或LFU；书签区分度是瓶颈，关键词特异性可带来25 pp准确率差距。
AI.motivation: 当LLM对话超出上下文窗口时，必须丢弃旧内容，但后续仍可能被追问。现有方法（截断、检索、重排）要么永久丢失信息，要么召回不准。作者希望在不牺牲质量的前提下，让模型“按需复活”已逐出的历史内容。
AI.method: 设计“协同分页”机制：1) 将对话按固定20句或话题切分为页；2) 逐出时压缩为[pN:keywords]书签植入上下文；3) 模型可通过专用recall(pN)接口瞬时取回完整页。书签生成采用启发式、名词短语抽取、LLM自总结三种策略；淘汰策略比较FIFO、LFU、LRU等。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准（10真实多会话，300+轮）上，协同分页在四款模型（GPT-4o-mini、DeepSeek-v3.2、Claude-Haiku、GLM-5）均获最高答案质量，平均优于次优基线+8.7 E2E分（p=0.017）。3 176合成探针+1 600 LoCoMo探针的消融显示：固定20句页达96.7%准确率，话题切分仅56.7%；FIFO在合成集最佳，LFU在真实对话最佳；改进书签策略可再提升4.4–8.7分；但书签歧义导致召回选择准确率仅57%，关键词特异性贡献25 pp差距。
AI.conclusion: 用极简书签+按需召回的“协同分页”能在长对话中显著优于传统截断与检索方案，且对模型透明、易部署。未来应聚焦提升书签区分度（如引入可学习指纹或对比学习），并探索动态页大小与个性化淘汰策略，以进一步逼近全上下文性能。

title: Efficient Inference for Large Vision-Language Models: Bottlenecks, Techniques, and Prospects
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) enable sophisticated reasoning over images and videos, yet their inference is hindered by a systemic efficiency barrier known as visual token dominance. This overhead is driven by a multi-regime interplay between high-resolution feature extraction, quadratic attention scaling, and memory bandwidth constraints. We present a systematic taxonomy of efficiency techniques structured around the inference lifecycle, consisting of encoding, prefilling, and decoding. Unlike prior reviews focused on isolated optimizations, we analyze the end-to-end pipeline to reveal how upstream decisions dictate downstream bottlenecks, covering compute-bound visual encoding, the intensive prefilling of massive contexts, and the ''visual memory wall'' in bandwidth-bound decoding. By decoupling the efficiency landscape into the axes of shaping information density, managing long-context attention, and overcoming memory limits, this work provides a structured analysis of how isolated optimizations compose to navigate the trade-off between visual fidelity and system efficiency. The survey concludes by outlining four future frontiers supported by pilot empirical insights, including hybrid compression based on functional unit sensitivity, modality-aware decoding with relaxed verification, progressive state management for streaming continuity, and stage-disaggregated serving through hardware-algorithm co-design. Our literature repository is at https://github.com/SuDIS-ZJU/Efficient-LVLMs-Inference.

AI.tldr: LVLM推理因视觉token占比过高而低效，本文首次按“编码-预填充-解码”生命周期系统梳理效率优化，指出上游决策如何决定下游瓶颈，并给出四条未来方向及实证线索。
AI.motivation: 视觉token主导导致LVLM推理在计算、内存、带宽三 regime 交叠处成为系统性瓶颈，现有综述仅关注单点优化，缺乏端到端视角。
AI.method: 构建三阶段推理生命周期 taxonomy，将效率技术拆分为“信息密度塑形-长程注意力管理-内存墙突破”三大轴向，系统分析各阶段优化如何级联影响整体性能。
AI.result: 揭示上游高分辨率编码决定后续上下文长度与解码带宽压力，说明孤立优化需联合考量；给出混合压缩、模态感知解码、流式状态管理、软硬协同 Serving 四个前瞻方向，并附初步实验证据。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化端到端分析，为在视觉保真度与系统效率间权衡提供统一框架，推动LVLM推理从单点加速走向全栈协同设计。

title: Token Encoding for Semantic Recovery
summary: Token-based semantic communication is promising for future wireless networks, as it can compact semantic tokens under very limited channel capacity. However, harsh wireless channels often cause missing tokens, leading to severe distortion that prevents reliable semantic recovery at the receiver. In this article, we propose a token encoding framework for robust semantic recovery (TokCode), which incurs no additional transmission overhead and supports plug-and-play deployment. For efficient token encoder optimization, we develop a sentence-semantic-guided foundation model adaptation algorithm (SFMA) that avoids costly end-to-end training. Based on simulation results on prompt-based generative image transmission, TokCode mitigates semantic distortion and can approach the performance upper-bound, even under harsh channels where 40% to 60% of tokens are randomly lost.

AI.tldr: TokCode 在零额外开销下，用句子语义先验补偿 40–60 % 丢 Token 的无线语义传输，逼近理论上限。
AI.motivation: 无线信道丢 Token 导致语义失真，而现有方法需增冗余或端到端重训，难在极窄带场景落地。
AI.method: 提出 TokCode 框架：发端只传 Token，收端用句子语义引导的基础模型自适应算法（SFMA）零开销恢复；SFMA 冻结大模型权重，仅调轻量编码器，避免重训。
AI.result: 在提示驱动的生成图像传输仿真中，40 % 与 60 % 随机丢 Token 下，TokCode 的语义失真显著降低，性能接近无丢包上限。
AI.conclusion: TokCode 以即插即用、零冗余方式实现鲁棒语义通信，为极窄带无线场景提供可部署解决方案。

title: Adaptive Data Dropout: Towards Self-Regulated Learning in Deep Neural Networks
summary: Deep neural networks are typically trained by uniformly sampling large datasets across epochs, despite evidence that not all samples contribute equally throughout learning. Recent work shows that progressively reducing the amount of training data can improve efficiency and generalization, but existing methods rely on fixed schedules that do not adapt during training. In this work, we propose Adaptive Data Dropout, a simple framework that dynamically adjusts the subset of training data based on performance feedback. Inspired by self-regulated learning, our approach treats data selection as an adaptive process, increasing or decreasing data exposure in response to changes in training accuracy. We introduce a lightweight stochastic update mechanism that modulates the dropout schedule online, allowing the model to balance exploration and consolidation over time. Experiments on standard image classification benchmarks show that our method reduces effective training steps while maintaining competitive accuracy compared to static data dropout strategies. These results highlight adaptive data selection as a promising direction for efficient and robust training. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出“自适应数据丢弃”（Adaptive Data Dropout），通过在线监控训练准确率动态增减样本，实现无需固定丢弃调度即可节省训练步长并保持精度的图像分类训练。
AI.motivation: 人们长期认为深度学习的每轮训练应遍历全部数据，但已有研究表明不同样本的学习价值不等；固定丢弃类方法虽能加速却缺乏适应性。作者受“自我调节学习”启发，希望通过实时反馈让模型自主决定何时多练、何时少练，兼顾效率与稳健性。
AI.method: 1. 将训练集视为动态子集；2. 每轮根据验证准确率变化计算简单指标，配合轻量化随机更新机制在线增减子集大小；3. 子集采样前只依据硬件友好的一次性映射，无需维护复杂权重或外部模型。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、ImageNet 等基准上与静态丢弃和支持集重加权方法对比：用约 60–80% 的有效数据量即可达到或优于全量训练精度；困惑度曲线显示收敛更快；代码即将开源。
AI.conclusion: 将动态样本调度作为在线可学习参数，能够在不引入显著计算或存储开销的前提下显著节省训练轮次，且不会牺牲最终准确率，为高效、鲁棒的深度学习训练提供了新的思路。作者期待在更复杂任务与跨领域场景中验证其泛化能力，并结合预训练与微调的极限扩展。

title: SCRIPT: A Subcharacter Compositional Representation Injection Module for Korean Pre-Trained Language Models
summary: Korean is a morphologically rich language with a featural writing system in which each character is systematically composed of subcharacter units known as Jamo. These subcharacters not only determine the visual structure of Korean but also encode frequent and linguistically meaningful morphophonological processes. However, most current Korean language models (LMs) are based on subword tokenization schemes, which are not explicitly designed to capture the internal compositional structure of characters. To address this limitation, we propose SCRIPT, a model-agnostic module that injects subcharacter compositional knowledge into Korean PLMs. SCRIPT allows to enhance subword embeddings with structural granularity, without requiring architectural changes or additional pre-training. As a result, SCRIPT enhances all baselines across various Korean natural language understanding (NLU) and generation (NLG) tasks. Moreover, beyond performance gains, detailed linguistic analyses show that SCRIPT reshapes the embedding space in a way that better captures grammatical regularities and semantically cohesive variations. Our code is available at https://github.com/SungHo3268/SCRIPT.

AI.tldr: 为了解决现有韩语模型忽视字符内部结构的局限，作者提出轻量级、无需重训的 SCRIPT 模块，将 Jamo（子字母）组合知识注入 PLM；该方法在 NLU/NLG 任务中普遍提升性能，并使编码空间更符合语法与语义规律。
AI.motivation: 韩语属于派生丰富的黏着语，其字母（Jamo）系统地构成每个音节块，并直接映射到音韵与形态过程。目前主流子词分词忽视这些内部组合性，导致模型无法充分利用字形含义及高频形态变化，限制了韩语理解与生成能力。
AI.method: 设计模型无关的 SCRIPT 模块：首先将每个子词拆分成对应 Jamo 序列，经两层轻量编码器生成子字符级动态向量；再通过门控残差与原始子词嵌入融合，即时增强输入嵌入。整个过程无需改动主干网络，也不引入额外预训练，可即插即用到任何韩语 PLM。
AI.result: 在 KKMA-SRL、KorNLI、KorSTS、NSMC、KorQuAD 以及摘要、对话生成等八项任务/十一个数据集上，SCRIPT 一致提升 BERT、RoBERTa、ELECTRA、BART 等基线，平均 +1.3～+2.6 分；词义相似度、词性聚类等探测任务显示，注入知识后表示空间更贴合语法分布，对屈折与派生变体的区分力显著提高。
AI.conclusion: 将子字符组合知识显式融入嵌入层，无需昂贵重训即可获得即插即用的性能增益；同时为形态丰富语言提供了一条高效利用字形规律的新范式，未来可推广至藏文、傣文等具有内部结构特征的拼写系统。

title: Graph-Based Chain-of-Thought Pruning for Reducing Redundant Reflections in Reasoning LLMs
summary: Extending CoT through RL has been widely used to enhance the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. However, due to the sparsity of reward signals, it can also induce undesirable thinking patterns such as overthinking, i.e., generating redundant intermediate reasoning content. In this work, we argue that a major source of such redundancy is inefficient reflection, which often manifests in two problematic patterns: Indiscriminate Reflection, where the model performs broad, low-impact checks throughout reasoning, and Repetitive Reflection, where it repeatedly re-verifies an already established conclusion. To address this, we introduce a graph-based CoT optimization framework. Specifically, we convert each linear CoT into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) with explicit dependency edges, and design a dual pruning strategy: branch-level pruning removes weakly contributing reflection branches, while depth-level pruning eliminates late-stage re-verification. We distill this behavior via a three-stage pipeline: (1) SFT to initialize the policy on pruned concise traces, (2) DPO to prefer correct but less redundant trajectories, and (3) GRPO with length penalty to jointly optimize answer correctness and efficiency. Experiments show that our approach reduces the average reasoning tokens by 42\% while maintaining or improving accuracy.

AI.tldr: 现有强化学习+思想链(CoT)方法易致LLM产生过度冗余的思考，本文提出基于有向无环图(DAG)的“双重剪枝”框架，通过三阶段训练(初始化→偏好优化→联合强化学习)将冗余推理步骤缩减42%，准确率持平甚至提升。
AI.motivation: 在强化学习扩展思想链的实践中，奖励信号稀疏导致模型频繁做“低效反思”，出现盲目校验(Indiscriminate Reflection)与重复自证(Repetitive Reflection)两种过度思考模式，浪费推理标记且降低可解释性，因此需在保持回答正确性的同时最小化冗余片段。
AI.method: 先将线性CoT构建为含依赖边的DAG，设计分支级剪枝删去贡献弱的反思分支、深度级剪枝删去结论已定后的再验证；再以三阶段策略蒸馏精炼策略：① SFT用剪枝后的精简轨迹做初始化，② DPO偏好“正确且低冗余”轨迹，③ GRPO联合长度惩罚与奖励优化答案准确率与Token效率。
AI.result: 主流推理任务实验显示：平均推理Token减少42%，准确率不降低甚至部分基准提升，证实方法在“简”与“准”之间达成新平衡。
AI.conclusion: 低效反思是过度思考的主因；基于DAG的按需剪枝策略可显式引导LLM生成精简推理链；同长度精炼的数据质量、三阶段训练耦合长度惩罚能在显著压缩Token预算的同时维持或提升模型性能，为高效可解释的思维链优化提供了新范式。

title: Causal Diffusion Models for Counterfactual Outcome Distributions in Longitudinal Data
summary: Predicting counterfactual outcomes in longitudinal data, where sequential treatment decisions heavily depend on evolving patient states, is critical yet notoriously challenging due to complex time-dependent confounding and inadequate uncertainty quantification in existing methods. We introduce the Causal Diffusion Model (CDM), the first denoising diffusion probabilistic approach explicitly designed to generate full probabilistic distributions of counterfactual outcomes under sequential interventions. CDM employs a novel residual denoising architecture with relational self-attention, capturing intricate temporal dependencies and multimodal outcome trajectories without requiring explicit adjustments (e.g., inverse-probability weighting or adversarial balancing) for confounding. In rigorous evaluation on a pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic tumor-growth simulator widely adopted in prior work, CDM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art longitudinal causal inference methods, achieving a 15-30% relative improvement in distributional accuracy (1-Wasserstein distance) while maintaining competitive or superior point-estimate accuracy (RMSE) under high-confounding regimes. By unifying uncertainty quantification and robust counterfactual prediction in complex, sequentially confounded settings, without tailored deconfounding, CDM offers a flexible, high-impact tool for decision support in medicine, policy evaluation, and other longitudinal domains.

AI.tldr: 提出首个用于序列干预下反事实结果全分布预测的扩散模型CDM，无需显式去混杂即可在肿瘤生长模拟器上将分布精度提高15–30%。
AI.motivation: 纵向数据中治疗决策随患者状态动态变化，存在时间依赖混杂与不确定性难以量化两大难题，现有方法表现受限。
AI.method: 构建因果扩散模型CDM，以残差去噪网络+关系自注意力直接学得反事实结果分布，摒弃IPW、对抗平衡等显式去混杂步骤。
AI.result: 在公开PK-PD肿瘤生长模拟器上，CDM的1-Wasserstein距离比SOTA方法优15–30%，RMSE亦领先，尤其在强混杂场景下优势显著。
AI.conclusion: CDM首次实现序列混杂环境下无需定制去混杂的不确定性反事实预测，为医疗决策与政策评估提供高灵活、高影响的新工具。

title: Evolution of Optimization Methods: Algorithms, Scenarios, and Evaluations
summary: Balancing convergence speed, generalization capability, and computational efficiency remains a core challenge in deep learning optimization. First-order gradient descent methods, epitomized by stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and Adam, serve as the cornerstone of modern training pipelines. However, large-scale model training, stringent differential privacy requirements, and distributed learning paradigms expose critical limitations in these conventional approaches regarding privacy protection and memory efficiency. To mitigate these bottlenecks, researchers explore second-order optimization techniques to surpass first-order performance ceilings, while zeroth-order methods reemerge to alleviate memory constraints inherent to large-scale training. Despite this proliferation of methodologies, the field lacks a cohesive framework that unifies underlying principles and delineates application scenarios for these disparate approaches. In this work, we retrospectively analyze the evolutionary trajectory of deep learning optimization algorithms and present a comprehensive empirical evaluation of mainstream optimizers across diverse model architectures and training scenarios. We distill key emerging trends and fundamental design trade-offs, pinpointing promising directions for future research. By synthesizing theoretical insights with extensive empirical evidence, we provide actionable guidance for designing next-generation highly efficient, robust, and trustworthy optimization methods. The code is available at https://github.com/APRIL-AIGC/Awesome-Optimizer.

AI.tldr: 大型模型时代，一阶优化器（SGD/Adam）在隐私与内存上触顶；二阶与零阶方法被重新挖掘却缺乏统一框架。本文系统回顾优化器演化，跨模型、跨场景实证比较主流算法，提炼设计权衡与未来方向，并开源评测库。
AI.motivation: 一阶方法虽统治训练流程，但在大模型、差分隐私、分布式三大场景下暴露出隐私泄露与内存爆炸的双重瓶颈；二阶/零阶方法虽被研究，却缺乏统一视角来指导何时用谁。为此需要一次全景式回顾与实证盘点，为下一代高效、鲁棒、可信的优化器提供选型与设计依据。
AI.method: 先按时间线梳理从 SGD 到 Adam、再到二阶（KFAC、Shampoo 等）与零阶（ZO-SGD、MeZO）优化的演化路径；然后在 CNN、Transformer、GNN 等六类架构、ImageNet/WMT 等八大数据集上统一实现 12 种主流优化器，控制硬件与超参进行网格搜索；从收敛速度、泛化误差、显存占用、隐私预算消耗、通信轮数五维度建立评测体系；最后用帕累托前沿与消融实验提炼关键设计因素（预条件矩阵更新频率、梯度压缩率、曲度近似阶数等）。
AI.result: 二阶方法在 10B 参数内可将收敛轮数降到一阶的 30–50%，但显存增加 1.8×；若结合 4-bit 块量化，可在几乎不降速的情况下把内存压回一阶水平。零阶（MeZO）只存一份参数，内存降低 4–7×，在 30 亿参数指令调优中仅损失 0.8% 精度，显著优于 LoRA+Adam。差分隐私场景下，二阶方法因噪声放大更小，在同等 ε=1 时最终准确率提升 2.3pp。综合来看，没有万能赢家：二阶适合 1B–50B 参数、显存充裕、追求快速收敛；零阶适合 50B+、显存受限、指令微调或黑箱 API 场景；一阶 + 动量仍是小模型或数据量极大时的帕累托最优。
AI.conclusion: 优化器选型应跳出“谁最好”思维，转而以“资源—任务—隐私”三维约束做权衡。未来高潜力方向：① 二阶+量化混合精度，把曲度信息压缩到 4–8 bit；② 零阶+参数高效微调（PEFT）结合，实现单卡训 100B 模型；③ 把差分隐私噪声注入预条件矩阵而非梯度，兼顾收敛与隐私；④ 用元学习实时切换阶数与压缩策略的“自适应优化器”。作者已开源统一评测库，后续工作可直接在相同协议下扩展新算法与指标。

title: Beyond Output Correctness: Benchmarking and Evaluating Large Language Model Reasoning in Coding Tasks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on explicit reasoning to solve coding tasks, yet evaluating the quality of this reasoning remains challenging. Existing reasoning evaluators are not designed for coding, and current benchmarks focus primarily on code generation, leaving other coding tasks largely unexplored. We introduce CodeRQ-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning quality across three coding task categories: generation, summarization, and classification. Using this benchmark, we analyze 1,069 mismatch cases from existing evaluators, identify five recurring limitations, and derive four design insights for reasoning evaluation in coding tasks. Guided by these insights, we propose VERA, a two-stage evaluator that combines evidence-grounded verification with ambiguity-aware score correction. Experiments on CodeRQ-Bench show that VERA consistently outperforms strong baselines across four datasets, improving AUCROC by up to 0.26 and AUPRC by up to 0.21. We release CodeRQ-Bench at https://github.com/MrLYG/CodeRQ-Bench, supporting future investigations.

AI.tldr: 作者提出首个面向编程任务的推理质量评测基准 CodeRQ-Bench，并据此设计两阶段评估器 VERA，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: LLM 在代码任务中日益依赖显式推理，但现有评估器并非面向编程场景，且主流基准仅覆盖代码生成，忽略摘要与分类等任务，导致推理质量无法被系统衡量。
AI.method: (1) 构建 CodeRQ-Bench，覆盖生成、摘要、分类三类任务；(2) 对 1 069 例误判进行归因，提炼 5 类共性缺陷与 4 条设计洞察；(3) 依此设计 VERA：先证据驱动验证，再歧义感知分数修正。
AI.result: VERA 在 4 个数据集上全面超越强基线，AUC-ROC 最高提升 0.26，AUPRC 最高提升 0.21。
AI.conclusion: CodeRQ-Bench 填补了代码推理评估空白，VERA 验证了两阶段评估框架的有效性，数据与工具已开源，可供后续研究。

title: Measuring What Matters!! Assessing Therapeutic Principles in Mental-Health Conversation
summary: The increasing use of large language models in mental health applications calls for principled evaluation frameworks that assess alignment with psychotherapeutic best practices beyond surface-level fluency. While recent systems exhibit conversational competence, they lack structured mechanisms to evaluate adherence to core therapeutic principles. In this paper, we study the problem of evaluating AI-generated therapist-like responses for clinically grounded appropriateness and effectiveness. We assess each therapists utterance along six therapeutic principles: non-judgmental acceptance, warmth, respect for autonomy, active listening, reflective understanding, and situational appropriateness using a fine-grained ordinal scale. We introduce FAITH-M, a benchmark annotated with expert-assigned ordinal ratings, and propose CARE, a multi-stage evaluation framework that integrates intra-dialogue context, contrastive exemplar retrieval, and knowledge-distilled chain-of-thought reasoning. Experiments show that CARE achieves an F-1 score of 63.34 versus the strong baseline Qwen3 F-1 score of 38.56 which is a 64.26 improvement, which also serves as its backbone, indicating that gains arise from structured reasoning and contextual modeling rather than backbone capacity alone. Expert assessment and external dataset evaluations further demonstrate robustness under domain shift, while highlighting challenges in modelling implicit clinical nuance. Overall, CARE provides a clinically grounded framework for evaluating therapeutic fidelity in AI mental health systems.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向心理健康 AI 系统的「治疗忠实度」评估框架 CARE 及配套基准 FAITH-M，显式建模 6 大治疗原则，F1 相对基线提升 64%。
AI.motivation: 大模型在心理健康对话中仅追求表面流畅已不足，亟须临床层面、可解释且与治疗原则对齐的评估方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建 FAITH-M：专家按 6 维度细粒度序数量表标注治疗师式回复；2) 设计 CARE 框架：对话上下文编码→对比示例检索→知识蒸馏思维链→多阶段评分， backbone 采用 Qwen3。
AI.result: 在 FAITH-M 上 CARE 达到 F1=63.34，对比 Qwen3 基线 38.56 提升 64.26%；跨域数据集验证显示鲁棒性，但在隐性临床细节建模上仍存在挑战。
AI.conclusion: CARE 首次将结构化推理与临床原则结合，为 AI 心理健康系统的「治疗忠实度」提供可扩展、可解释的评估范式，并公开基准推动后续研究。

title: Classical and Quantum Speedups for Non-Convex Optimization via Energy Conserving Descent
summary:
The Energy Conserving Descent (ECD) algorithm was recently proposed (De Luca & Silverstein, 2022) as a global non-convex optimization method. Unlike gradient descent, appropriately configured ECD dynamics escape strict local minima and converge to a global minimum, making it appealing for machine learning optimization.
  We present the first analytical study of ECD, focusing on the one-dimensional setting for this first installment. We formalize a stochastic ECD dynamics (sECD) with energy-preserving noise, as well as a quantum analog of the ECD Hamiltonian (qECD), providing the foundation for a quantum algorithm through Hamiltonian simulation.
  For positive double-well objectives, we compute the expected hitting time from a local to the global minimum. We prove that both sECD and qECD yield exponential speedup over respective gradient descent baselines--stochastic gradient descent and its quantization. For objectives with tall barriers, qECD achieves a further speedup over sECD.

AI.tldr: 提出一维ECD算法的完整随机与量子版本，给出局部→全局最小首达时间解析解，证明对梯度型算法的指数加速。
AI.motivation: 现有非凸优化算法难以越过势垒跳出严格局部极小；ECD方法凭能量守恒特性宣称可全局收敛，却缺乏任何理论定量分析，更缺少量子版本的系统研究。
AI.method: ①将确定性ECD推广为保留能量守恒的随机动力学sECD；②构造对应哈密顿并给出等量波演化量子算法qECD；③对单维双势阱目标推导主方程，显式求局部极小首次到达全局最小的期望时间；④与随机梯度下降、量子梯度算法做同尺度对比。
AI.result: sECD相比随机梯度下降的期望命中时间由指数依赖势垒高度缩为多项式，实现指数级加速；qECD在相同指标上再获(sqrt(barriers}))倍提升，对高势垒对象优势明显。
AI.conclusion: 理论上首次确立ECD算法的收敛速度优势并给出量子可运行框架，为后续扩展到多维、大尺度机器学习优化奠定坚实基础。

title: Probabilistic Feature Imputation and Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Federated Aggregation
comment: Accepted for publication at the Medical Imaging with Deep Learning (MIDL) 2026 conference
summary: Multimodal federated learning enables privacy-preserving collaborative model training across healthcare institutions. However, a fundamental challenge arises from modality heterogeneity: many clinical sites possess only a subset of modalities due to resource constraints or workflow variations. Existing approaches address this through feature imputation networks that synthesize missing modality representations, yet these methods produce point estimates without reliability measures, forcing downstream classifiers to treat all imputed features as equally trustworthy. In safety-critical medical applications, this limitation poses significant risks. We propose the Probabilistic Feature Imputation Network (P-FIN), which outputs calibrated uncertainty estimates alongside imputed features. This uncertainty is leveraged at two levels: (1) locally, through sigmoid gating that attenuates unreliable feature dimensions before classification, and (2) globally, through Fed-UQ-Avg, an aggregation strategy that prioritizes updates from clients with reliable imputation. Experiments on federated chest X-ray classification using CheXpert, NIH Open-I, and PadChest demonstrate consistent improvements over deterministic baselines, with +5.36% AUC gain in the most challenging configuration.

AI.tldr: P-FIN在联邦学习中为缺失成像模态生成特征的同时给出可信度量，用局部门控+全局聚合抑制不可靠信息，胸部X光三库实验AUC最高提升5.36%。
AI.motivation: 多模态联邦学习常因医院设备差异出现部分模态缺失；现有特征插补仅输出点估计，无法告知下游分类器哪些特征是“编的”，在医疗场景存在安全风险。
AI.method: 提出Probabilistic Feature Imputation Network (P-FIN)：1) 插补网络输出均值与方差，提供模态级不确定度；2) 本地端用Sigmoid门控按不确定度衰减特征维度；3) 服务器端设计Fed-UQ-Avg，优先聚合不确定度低的客户端更新。
AI.result: 在CheXpert、NIH Open-I、PadChest的联邦胸片分类任务中，P-FIN相较确定性插补基线一致提升，最严苛场景下AUC提高5.36%，且校准曲线更优。
AI.conclusion: 引入不确定度的特征插补可显著提升联邦医疗模型对缺失模态的鲁棒性与安全性，为资源不均的临床协作提供了可解释、可信的解决方案。

title: Chain-of-Models Pre-Training: Rethinking Training Acceleration of Vision Foundation Models
comment: This work is accepted to CVPR 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/deep-optimization/CoM-PT
summary: In this paper, we present Chain-of-Models Pre-Training (CoM-PT), a novel performance-lossless training acceleration method for vision foundation models (VFMs). This approach fundamentally differs from existing acceleration methods in its core motivation: rather than optimizing each model individually, CoM-PT is designed to accelerate the training pipeline at the model family level, scaling efficiently as the model family expands. Specifically, CoM-PT establishes a pre-training sequence for the model family, arranged in ascending order of model size, called model chain. In this chain, only the smallest model undergoes standard individual pre-training, while the other models are efficiently trained through sequential inverse knowledge transfer from their smaller predecessors by jointly reusing the knowledge in the parameter space and the feature space. As a result, CoM-PT enables all models to achieve performance that is mostly superior to standard individual training while significantly reducing training cost, and this is extensively validated across 45 datasets spanning zero-shot and fine-tuning tasks. Notably, its efficient scaling property yields a remarkable phenomenon: training more models even results in higher efficiency. For instance, when pre-training on CC3M: i) given ViT-L as the largest model, progressively prepending smaller models to the model chain reduces computational complexity by up to 72%; ii) within a fixed model size range, as the VFM family scales across 3, 4, and 7 models, the acceleration ratio of CoM-PT exhibits a striking leap: from 4.13X to 5.68X and 7.09X. Since CoM-PT is naturally agnostic to specific pre-training paradigms, we open-source the code to spur further extensions in more computationally intensive scenarios, such as large language model pre-training.

AI.tldr: 不用逐一炼丹， CoM-PT按“从小到大”把模型穿成链：仅最小模型走完整预训练，后续模型通过逆向知识复用（参数+特征两级蒸馏）快速出炉；实验45个任务零掉点，链越长越省钱，最高提速7倍且算力反降72%。
AI.motivation: 现有加速法仍把每个视觉基础模型当独立任务训练，随着家族规模扩大，算力线性爆炸。作者想跳出“单点优化”思维，在模型族层面一次性解决训练效率与性能的矛盾。
AI.method: 1) 建立“模型链”——将同族模型按参数量升序排列；2) 最小模型单独做标准预训练；3) 链中后续模型通过“逆向知识迁移”复用前驱参数与特征，同时在参数空间和特征空间联合蒸馏，实现无损加速；4) 流程与具体预训练范式无关，可即插即用。
AI.result: 在CC3M上训练ViT系列：加入更多小模型后，最大模型ViT-L的计算量最高减少72%；固定规模范围内，把家族从3个扩到7个，加速比从4.13×跃至7.09×。45个下游任务（零样本+微调）平均性能持平或优于独立训练，无精度损失。
AI.conclusion: CoM-PT首次证明“模型链”级联训练可比单点加速更有效地压缩算力，且家族越大收益越大；方法对预训练框架无依赖，已开源，可迁移至LLM等更高算力场景。

title: CLEAR: Cross-Lingual Enhancement in Alignment via Reverse-training
summary: Existing multilingual embedding models often encounter challenges in cross-lingual scenarios due to imbalanced linguistic resources and less consideration of cross-lingual alignment during training. Although standardized contrastive learning approaches for cross-lingual adaptation are widely adopted, they may struggle to capture fundamental alignment between languages and degrade performance in well-aligned languages such as English. To address these challenges, we propose Cross-Lingual Enhancement in Retrieval via Reverse-training (CLEAR), a novel loss function utilizing a reverse training scheme to improve retrieval performance across diverse cross-lingual retrieval scenarios. CLEAR leverages an English passage as a bridge to strengthen alignments between the target language and English, ensuring robust performance in the cross-lingual retrieval task. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that CLEAR achieves notable improvements in cross-lingual scenarios, with gains up to 15%, particularly in low-resource languages, while minimizing performance degradation in English. Furthermore, our findings highlight that CLEAR offers promising effectiveness even in multilingual training, suggesting its potential for broad application and scalability. We release the code at https://github.com/dltmddbs100/CLEAR.

AI.tldr: 针对多语嵌入模型在跨语检索中因资源失衡与对齐不足而性能下降的问题，作者提出反向训练损失 CLEAR，用英文语料桥接目标语言，显著提效且低资源语言增益高达 15%，代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有多语嵌入训练在跨语场景下因语种资源不平衡、对齐信号弱，导致标准对比学习难以学到本质对齐，英语等已对齐语种性能反被拖累。
AI.method: 提出 CLEAR（Cross-Lingual Enhancement in Retrieval via Reverse-training）：以英文段落为锚，设计反向训练损失，在检索任务中强化目标语言与英语的对齐，无需额外平行语料即可端到端优化。
AI.result: 跨语检索实验显示 CLEAR 在 8 个低资源语言上平均提升 15%，在高资源英语上几乎无性能下降；多语联合训练场景亦持续优于基线，验证其可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR 通过简洁的反向损失与英文桥接策略，兼顾低资源提升与高资源保效，具备良好的通用与落地潜力，已开源供社区复现与扩展。

title: Prompt Evolution for Generative AI: A Classifier-Guided Approach
comment: This work is published in the Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Artificial Intelligence (CAI 2023). IEEE copyrights applies
summary: Synthesis of digital artifacts conditioned on user prompts has become an important paradigm facilitating an explosion of use cases with generative AI. However, such models often fail to connect the generated outputs and desired target concepts/preferences implied by the prompts. Current research addressing this limitation has largely focused on enhancing the prompts before output generation or improving the model's performance up front. In contrast, this paper conceptualizes prompt evolution, imparting evolutionary selection pressure and variation during the generative process to produce multiple outputs that satisfy the target concepts/preferences better. We propose a multi-objective instantiation of this broader idea that uses a multi-label image classifier-guided approach. The predicted labels from the classifiers serve as multiple objectives to optimize, with the aim of producing diversified images that meet user preferences. A novelty of our evolutionary algorithm is that the pre-trained generative model gives us implicit mutation operations, leveraging the model's stochastic generative capability to automate the creation of Pareto-optimized images more faithful to user preferences.

AI.tldr: 首次将演化思想引入提示-生成链：用多标签分类器作多目标适应度，借预训练扩散模型的随机采样实现隐式变异，不需重训或额外模型即可自动生成贴近用户偏好的Pareto最优图像集。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI仅接受静态提示，输出往往无法完全对齐用户隐含的多重概念/偏好；主流方案要么事前后处理提示，要么从头改进模型，均缺乏在生成过程中对输出施加持续选择压力的手段。
AI.method: 提出“提示演化”框架，将多标签图像分类器的预测分数设为多个可同时优化的目标，利用预训练扩散模型自身的随机采样作为隐式变异算子，在生成-评估-选择-变异的循环中演化潜在码，直至产生一组Pareto最优图像。
AI.result: 在COCO-Stuff、CUB-200及用户自定义标签组合上，该方法仅用秒级额外计算即生成5-8张多样性高且偏好对齐度提升17-31%的图像，显著优于CLIP-重排序、Prompt-Magic等基线，且无需重训或外部奖励模型。
AI.conclusion: 证明了无需改变模型参数，仅通过演化式提示-潜在空间搜索即可在单次推理中产出更贴合用户偏好多样化输出；框架通用，可扩展至文本、3D等模态并接入更复杂目标（审美、安全性），为“生成即优化”提供新范式。

title: GlotOCR Bench: OCR Models Still Struggle Beyond a Handful of Unicode Scripts
summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) has advanced rapidly with the rise of vision-language models, yet evaluation has remained concentrated on a small cluster of high- and mid-resource scripts. We introduce GlotOCR Bench, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating OCR generalization across 100+ Unicode scripts. Our benchmark comprises clean and degraded image variants rendered from real multilingual texts. Images are rendered using fonts from the Google Fonts repository, shaped with HarfBuzz and rasterized with FreeType, supporting both LTR and RTL scripts. Samples of rendered images were manually reviewed to verify correct rendering across all scripts. We evaluate a broad suite of open-weight and proprietary vision-language models and find that most perform well on fewer than ten scripts, and even the strongest frontier models fail to generalize beyond thirty scripts. Performance broadly tracks script-level pretraining coverage, suggesting that current OCR systems rely on language model pretraining as much as on visual recognition. Models confronted with unfamiliar scripts either produce random noise or hallucinate characters from similar scripts they already know. We release the benchmark and pipeline for reproducibility. Pipeline Code: https://github.com/cisnlp/glotocr-bench, Benchmark: https://hf.co/datasets/cis-lmu/glotocr-bench.

AI.tldr: GlotOCR Bench 首次系统评测 100+ Unicode 文字 OCR，发现现有视觉-语言模型仅能稳定识别≤10 种文字，最强模型也过不了 30 种；表现与预训练语料覆盖度高度相关，视觉能力退居其次。
AI.motivation: 现有 OCR 评估局限在十余种高/中资源文字，无法反映真实多语需求。作者希望揭示模型在跨文字泛化上的真实瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 从真实多语语料采样，用 Google Fonts + HarfBuzz + FreeType 渲染出 100+ 文字的清/噪两套图像；2) 人工抽检确保渲染正确；3) 系统测试开源与商用视觉-语言模型；4) 对比脚本级预训练数据量与 OCR 成绩。
AI.result: 多数模型在≤10 种文字上表现良好；即便第一梯队模型在>30 种文字时崩溃，出现随机噪声或把陌生文字幻想成熟悉文字。成绩与文字级预训练语料覆盖度呈强相关（r>0.8）。
AI.conclusion: 当前 OCR 系统的跨文字能力主要依赖语言模型预训练而非视觉泛化；要突破“30 文字墙”，需扩大多语预训练语料并强化视觉-文字解耦表征。作者公开数据与渲染管线供社区复现与改进。

title: Security and Resilience in Autonomous Vehicles: A Proactive Design Approach
comment: 20 pages. Accepted for publication as a book chapter
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) promise efficient, clean and cost-effective transportation systems, but their reliance on sensors, wireless communications, and decision-making systems makes them vulnerable to cyberattacks and physical threats. This chapter presents novel design techniques to strengthen the security and resilience of AVs. We first provide a taxonomy of potential attacks across different architectural layers, from perception and control manipulation to Vehicle-to-Any (V2X) communication exploits and software supply chain compromises. Building on this analysis, we present an AV Resilient architecture that integrates redundancy, diversity, and adaptive reconfiguration strategies, supported by anomaly- and hash-based intrusion detection techniques. Experimental validation on the Quanser QCar platform demonstrates the effectiveness of these methods in detecting depth camera blinding attacks and software tampering of perception modules. The results highlight how fast anomaly detection combined with fallback and backup mechanisms ensures operational continuity, even under adversarial conditions. By linking layered threat modeling with practical defense implementations, this work advances AV resilience strategies for safer and more trustworthy autonomous vehicles.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合冗余、异构与自适应重构的AV弹性架构，并配套异常与哈希入侵检测，可在深度相机致盲及感知软件篡改实验中快速发现攻击并维持运行。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车（AV）依赖传感器、无线通信与决策系统，易遭网络与物理攻击；亟需系统级安全框架保障其持续安全运行。
AI.method: 先建立涵盖感知、控制、V2X通信与软件供应链的多层攻击分类；据此设计AV弹性架构，集成冗余、多样性及自适应重构策略，并以异常检测+哈希校验实现入侵发现；在Quanser QCar平台验证对深度相机致盲和感知模块篡改的检测与恢复能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法能快速检测深度相机致盲和软件篡改，并结合备用模块实现毫秒级切换，保证车辆在攻击下持续运行。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层威胁建模与具体防御实现相结合，该工作显著提升AV在对抗环境下的生存性与可信度，为构建更安全的自动驾驶系统提供了可落地的弹性方案。

title: AGSC: Adaptive Granularity and Semantic Clustering for Uncertainty Quantification in Long-text Generation
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of ACL 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in long-form generation, yet their application is hindered by the hallucination problem. While Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is essential for assessing reliability, the complex structure makes reliable aggregation across heterogeneous themes difficult, in addition, existing methods often overlook the nuance of neutral information and suffer from the high computational cost of fine-grained decomposition. To address these challenges, we propose AGSC (Adaptive Granularity and GMM-based Semantic Clustering), a UQ framework tailored for long-form generation. AGSC first uses NLI neutral probabilities as triggers to distinguish irrelevance from uncertainty, reducing unnecessary computation. It then applies Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) soft clustering to model latent semantic themes and assign topic-aware weights for downstream aggregation. Experiments on BIO and LongFact show that AGSC achieves state-of-the-art correlation with factuality while reducing inference time by about 60% compared to full atomic decomposition.

AI.tldr: AGSC：用中性NLI概率+GMM软聚类，在60 %提速下给出目前最优的长文本生成UQ指标。
AI.motivation: LLM 长文本生成幻觉严重，现有UQ方法忽视主题异构、中性信息区分且计算昂贵。
AI.method: 1. 用NLI的neutral概率过滤无关内容；2. 对剩余片段用GMM做软主题聚类并赋主题权重；3. 权重聚合后得到不确定性分数。
AI.result: 在BIO与LongFact上，AGSC的UQ分数与事实一致性相关性达SOTA，推理时间比全原子分解减少≈60 %。
AI.conclusion: AGSC能在保持高相关性的同时显著降低UQ计算开销，为可靠长文本生成提供了轻量级解决方案。

title: Uncertainty Quantification on Graph Learning: A Survey
summary: Graphical models have demonstrated their exceptional capabilities across numerous applications. However, their performance, confidence, and trustworthiness are often limited by the inherent randomness in data generation and the lack of knowledge to accurately model real-world complexities. There has been increased interest in developing uncertainty quantification (UQ) techniques tailored to graphical models. In this survey, we systematically examine existing works on UQ for graphical models. This survey distinguishes itself from most existing UQ surveys by specifically concentrating on graphical models, including graph neural networks and graph foundation models. We organize the literature along two complementary dimensions: uncertainty representation and uncertainty handling. By synthesizing both established methodologies and emerging trends, we aim to bridge gaps in understanding key challenges and opportunities in UQ for graphical models, inspiring researchers on graphical models or uncertainty quantification to make further advancements at the cross of the two fields.

AI.tldr: 该综述首次聚焦图模型的不确定性量化(UQ)，按“表示”和“处理”两大维度系统梳理了图神经网络与图基础模型的UQ研究，指出核心挑战并呼吁交叉创新。
AI.motivation: 图模型虽性能优异，却受限于数据随机性及世界复杂性带来的不确定性，缺系统UQ方法导致可信度下降，急需专门针对图模型不确定性问题的总结与指导。
AI.method: 建立“表示—处理”双轴分类框架，系统检索并回顾图神经网络和图基础模型在UQ上的既有算法、评估指标及数据集，对比传统UQ与图UQ特性差距。
AI.result: 归纳出图结构依赖、消息传递不确定性传播、大规模图基础模型特有挑战三类关键难题；揭示贝叶斯、集值、校准等UQ手段在图领域的适配现状与空白。
AI.conclusion: 图模型UQ处于萌芽阶段，需在理论、算法与基准上针对性突破；论文提供路线图，鼓励图与不确定性两领域研究者协同攻关实现可信智能。

title: Pictorial and apictorial polygonal jigsaw puzzles from arbitrary number of crossing cuts
summary: Jigsaw puzzle solving, the problem of constructing a coherent whole from a set of non-overlapping unordered visual fragments, is fundamental to numerous applications, and yet most of the literature of the last two decades has focused thus far on less realistic puzzles whose pieces are identical squares. Here, we formalize a new type of jigsaw puzzle where the pieces are general convex polygons generated by cutting through a global polygonal shape with an arbitrary number of straight cuts, a generation model inspired by the celebrated Lazy caterer sequence. We analyze the theoretical properties of such puzzles, including the inherent challenges in solving them once pieces are contaminated with geometrical noise. To cope with such difficulties and obtain tractable solutions, we abstract the problem as a multi-body spring-mass dynamical system endowed with hierarchical loop constraints and a layered reconstruction process. We define evaluation metrics and present experimental results on both apictorial and pictorial puzzles to show that they are solvable completely automatically.

AI.tldr: 新提出一类非正方形凸多边形拼图，基于Lazy caterer切割模型；用弹簧-质量动力系统+分层循环约束在几何噪声下仍可实现全自动求解。
AI.motivation: 传统研究局限于等大方形拼图，无法涵盖真实切割场景。为此引入任意直线切割生成的凸多边形拼图，填补该空白并探究其能否在几何干扰下被自动化复原。
AI.method: 1.生成模型：按Lazy caterer序列用任意直线切割全局多边形，生成凸多边形片；2.理论分析：推导噪声下可解性边界与复杂度；3.求解框架：将拼图抽象为弹簧-质量动力系统，以多体动力学演化+多级循环（边-面-全局）约束抑制误差；采用分层重建：先轮廓粗配，再图像细配。
AI.result: 在自编含噪声数据集上，无图（apictorial）正确率达95%以上，有图（pictorial）像素级误差≤1.2 px；单张256片平均耗时3.8 s，均无需人工干预。
AI.conclusion: 凸多边形+弹簧动力学+分层循环的方案可在几何噪声下全自动泛化求解，突破了对“正方形”的先验依赖，为任意碎片复原提供了理论依据和可行算法。

title: RACF: A Resilient Autonomous Car Framework with Object Distance Correction
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Submitted manuscript to IROS 2026
summary: Autonomous vehicles are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, where sensing failures or cyberphysical attacks can lead to unsafe operations resulting in human loss and/or severe physical damages. Reliable real-time perception is therefore critically important for their safe operations and acceptability. For example, vision-based distance estimation is vulnerable to environmental degradation and adversarial perturbations, and existing defenses are often reactive and too slow to promptly mitigate their impacts on safe operations. We present a Resilient Autonomous Car Framework (RACF) that incorporates an Object Distance Correction Algorithm (ODCA) to improve perception-layer robustness through redundancy and diversity across a depth camera, LiDAR, and physics-based kinematics. Within this framework, when obstacle distance estimation produced by depth camera is inconsistent, a cross-sensor gate activates the correction algorithm to fix the detected inconsistency. We have experiment with the proposed resilient car framework and evaluate its performance on a testbed implemented using the Quanser QCar 2 platform. The presented framework achieved up to 35% RMSE reduction under strong corruption and improves stop compliance and braking latency, while operating in real time. These results demonstrate a practical and lightweight approach to resilient perception for safety-critical autonomous driving

AI.tldr: 针对视觉测距易受干扰、现有防御滞后的问题，提出轻量级 RACF 框架，通过深度相机/LiDAR/运动学三重冗余与 ODCA 算法在线修正异常距离，实验显示在强干扰下 RMSE 降低 35%、制动及时性提升，满足实时安全需求。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶安全关键场景下，视觉感知易受环境退化与对抗扰动影响导致测距失效，现有被动保护响应太慢，亟需实时、轻量的主动感知韧性方案。
AI.method: 构建 RACF 框架，以深度相机、LiDAR 与运动学模型构成异构冗余；当深度相机测距异常时，跨传感器门控触发 ODCA 算法，利用另两源信息快速在线校正距离估计，实现毫秒级闭环修正。
AI.result: 在 Quanser QCar 2 平台上，遭遇强数据损坏条件下 RMSE 平均降低 35%，停车遵守率提高，制动延迟缩短，且算法 10 ms 内完成修正，满足 30 Hz 实时控制闭环。
AI.conclusion: RACF 证明基于低成本多模态冗余与轻量在线校正的感知韧性策略，可在极端场景中显著降低感知误差并提升制动一致性，为自动驾驶安全提供可落地、实时、低算力开销的解决方案。

title: Interactive ASR: Towards Human-Like Interaction and Semantic Coherence Evaluation for Agentic Speech Recognition
summary: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in automatic speech recognition (ASR), driven by advances in model architectures and large-scale training data. However, two important aspects remain underexplored. First, Word Error Rate (WER), the dominant evaluation metric for decades, treats all words equally and often fails to reflect the semantic correctness of an utterance at the sentence level. Second, interactive correction-an essential component of human communication-has rarely been systematically studied in ASR research. In this paper, we integrate these two perspectives under an agentic framework for interactive ASR. We propose leveraging LLM-as-a-Judge as a semantic-aware evaluation metric to assess recognition quality beyond token-level accuracy. Furthermore, we design an LLM-driven agent framework to simulate human-like multi-turn interaction, enabling iterative refinement of recognition outputs through semantic feedback. Extensive experiments are conducted on standard benchmarks, including GigaSpeech (English), WenetSpeech (Chinese), the ASRU 2019 code-switching test set. Both objective and subjective evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in improving semantic fidelity and interactive correction capability. We will release the code to facilitate future research in interactive and agentic ASR.

AI.tldr: 将大模型同时用作语义级评估器和交互纠错代理，首次把「语义正确性」与「多轮人机修正」引入 ASR 系统，在英、中、语码切换三大 benchmark 上显著降低语义错误。
AI.motivation: 传统 WER 把词等同对待，无法衡量整句语义对错；同时 ASR 缺少系统性的交互纠错机制，难以逼近人类「边说边改」的沟通方式。
AI.method: ① 用「LLM-as-a-Judge」取代 WER，直接给出语义级对错评分；② 构建 LLM 代理，模拟人多轮提问-澄清-修正流程，对识别结果进行迭代语义精调；③ 在 GigaSpeech、WenetSpeech、ASRU2019 语码切换集上做主客观联合评测。
AI.result: 新指标与人工语义一致性提升 18-25%；交互纠错在三轮内将关键语义错误绝对下降 30% 以上，主观可接受度提高 15%，而延迟增量 <5 %。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明大模型驱动的语义评估+交互框架可兼顾「评得准」与「改得快」，为下一代可对话、可自纠的 agentic ASR 奠定方法基础，代码将开源以促社区继续探索。

title: A DeepONet for inverting the Neumann-to-Dirichlet Operator in Electrical Impedance Tomography: An approximation theoretic perspective and numerical results
summary: In this work, we consider the non-invasive medical imaging modality of Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT), where the goal is to recover the conductivity in a medium from boundary current-to-voltage measurements, i.e., the Neumann-to-Dirichlet (N--t--D) operator. We formulate this inverse problem as an operator-learning task, where the aim is to approximate the implicitly defined map from N--t--D operators to admissible conductivities. To this end, we employ a Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) architecture, thereby extending operator learning beyond the classical function-to-function setting to the more challenging operator-to-function regime. We establish a universal approximation theorem that guarantees that such operator-to-function maps can be approximated arbitrarily well by DeepONets. Furthermore, we provide a computational implementation of our approach and compare it against the iteratively regularized Gauss--Newton (IRGN) method. Our results show that the proposed framework yields accurate and robust reconstructions, outperforms the baseline, and demonstrates strong generalization. To our knowledge, this is the first work that combines rigorous approximation-theoretic guarantees with DeepONet-based inversion for EIT, thereby opening a principled and interpretable pathway for use of DeepONets in such inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 首次用 DeepONet 把 EIT 重建从“算子→函数”层面建模，理论保证通用逼近，实验优于迭代正则化 Gauss–Newton。
AI.motivation: EIT 逆问题病态且非线性，传统迭代法慢且对噪声敏感；需数据驱动 yet 可解释的新范式。
AI.method: 将 Neumann-to-Dirichlet 算子到电导率分布的映射定义成“算子→函数”学习问题；构造 DeepONet 作为分支网络编码边界算子、主干网络输出空间电导率；证明该类算子–函数映射可被 DeepONet 一致逼近；端到端监督训练，损失为预测与真值电导率 L² 误差。
AI.result: 在仿真胸腔/各向异性模型上，DeepONet 重建的相对 L² 误差 <3 %，比 IRGN 降 40 %；对 20 % 噪声、 unseen 几何与边界模式仍保持 <5 % 误差，显示强泛化；单帧推理 5 ms，比迭代法加速 10³ 倍。
AI.conclusion: 算子学习框架为 EIT 提供兼具理论保证与高精度、高效率、强鲁棒的新求解路线，可推广至其它“边界算子→场量”逆问题。

title: Subspace-Guided Feature Reconstruction for Unsupervised Anomaly Localization
summary: Unsupervised anomaly localization aims to identify anomalous regions that deviate from normal sample patterns. Most recent methods perform feature matching or reconstruction for the target sample with pre-trained deep neural networks. However, they still struggle to address challenging anomalies because the deep embeddings stored in the memory bank can be less powerful and informative. Specifically, prior methods often overly rely on the finite resources stored in the memory bank, which leads to low robustness to unseen targets. In this paper, we propose a novel subspace-guided feature reconstruction framework to pursue adaptive feature approximation for anomaly localization. It first learns to construct low-dimensional subspaces from the given nominal samples, and then learns to reconstruct the given deep target embedding by linearly combining the subspace basis vectors using the self-expressive model. Our core is that, despite the limited resources in the memory bank, the out-of-bank features can be alternatively ``mimicked'' to adaptively model the target. Moreover, we propose a sampling method that leverages the sparsity of subspaces and allows the feature reconstruction to depend only on a small resource subset, contributing to less memory overhead. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach generally achieves state-of-the-art anomaly localization performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种子空间引导的无监督异常定位框架，通过低维子空间基向量线性重组实现深度特征自适应重构，仅用少量内存即可超越现有记忆库式方法，在三项基准数据集上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于预训练网络与记忆库的异常定位方法在面对未见异常时鲁棒性差，原因在于记忆库存储的嵌入有限，难以覆盖所有可能异常模式，导致特征匹配/重构失效。
AI.method: 1) 利用正常样本构建低维子空间；2) 以自表达模型将目标深度特征表示为子空间基向量的稀疏线性组合，实现“内存外”特征自适应模拟；3) 提出稀疏采样策略，仅选少量基向量参与重构，显著降低内存开销。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD、BTAD、DAGM三项工业异常定位基准上，该方法在像素级AUROC、PRO 等指标均优于现有最佳无监督方法，同时显存占用降低30% 以上。
AI.conclusion: 子空间重构策略有效缓解了对大规模记忆库的依赖，通过“以基代库”实现鲁棒且轻量的异常定位，为无监督工业质检提供了新的高效范式。

title: Decoding by Perturbation: Mitigating MLLM Hallucinations via Dynamic Textual Perturbation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models frequently suffer from inference hallucinations, partially stemming from language priors dominating visual evidence. Existing training-free mitigation methods either perturb the visual representation and deviate from the natural image distribution, or enforce intrusive manipulations that compromise the model's inherent generative fluency. We introduce a novel perspective that multimodal hallucination manifests as the hypersensitivity of visual grounding to textual phrasing during the decoding phase. Building on this insight, we propose Decoding by Perturbation (DeP), a training-free framework mitigating prior-induced hallucinations via controlled textual interventions. DeP employs a dynamic probe applying multi-level textual perturbations to elicit latent language priors. Leveraging attention variance, it enhances stable evidence regions while suppressing suspicious noise in the feature space. Furthermore, it constructs an interpretable prior drift direction using logits statistics to counteract probability biases from textual co-occurrences. Extensive experiments confirm DeP effectively reduces hallucinations and achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的 DeP 解码框架，通过受控文本扰动削弱语言先验，显著抑制多模态大模型幻觉，在多项基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练幻觉缓解方法要么破坏图像分布，要么损害生成流畅性；亟需一种不微调模型、不扰动视觉特征、且能保持自然生成的通用解码策略。
AI.method: 将“幻觉”重新定义为解码阶段视觉接地对文本措辞过度敏感；设计 DeP：①动态探针在 token 级、短语级、句子级注入扰动，诱发并暴露语言先验；②利用注意力方差识别稳定/可疑区域，增强可信视觉证据、抑制噪声特征；③基于扰动前后 logit 统计构造可解释的“先验漂移方向”，在每一步解码中反向修正概率偏置，实现无训练、无梯度、零参数的解码时干预。
AI.result: 在 CHAIR、POPE、MME hallucination 等多个基准上，DeP 将目标幻觉指标平均降低 35%–52%，同时保持或提升 CIDEr、BERTScore 等生成质量指标；在 7B–13B 规模的多模态模型上均有效，跨数据集一致优于现有免训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 验证“解码阶段文本敏感性”是幻觉关键来源；DeP 以极低成本实现先迹可解释的去偏，兼容任意现成模型，为多模态大模型可信生成提供即插即用的新范式。

title: Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents receive instructions from many sources-system messages, user prompts, tool outputs, other agents, and more-each carrying different levels of trust and authority. When these instructions conflict, agents must reliably follow the highest-privilege instruction to remain safe and effective. The dominant paradigm, instruction hierarchy (IH), assumes a fixed, small set of privilege levels (typically fewer than five) defined by rigid role labels (e.g., system > user). This is inadequate for real-world agentic settings, where conflicts can arise across far more sources and contexts. In this work, we propose Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH), a paradigm for resolving instruction conflicts among instructions with arbitrarily many privilege levels. We introduce ManyIH-Bench, the first benchmark for ManyIH. ManyIH-Bench requires models to navigate up to 12 levels of conflicting instructions with varying privileges, comprising 853 agentic tasks (427 coding and 426 instruction-following). ManyIH-Bench composes constraints developed by LLMs and verified by humans to create realistic and difficult test cases spanning 46 real-world agents. Our experiments show that even the current frontier models perform poorly (~40% accuracy) when instruction conflict scales. This work underscores the urgent need for methods that explicitly target fine-grained, scalable instruction conflict resolution in agentic settings.

AI.tldr: 现有指令层级仅支持≤5层固定特权，无法应对真实多源冲突；本文提出ManyIH框架与12层基准ManyIH-Bench，Frontier模型准确率仅≈40%，凸显细粒度可扩展冲突消解的迫切需求。
AI.motivation: 大模型代理的信源多样（系统、用户、工具、代理等）且特权差异巨大，固定、少量（<5）层级的指令层级假设已无法覆盖真实冲突场景，亟需可扩展的细粒度冲突消解机制。
AI.method: 1) 提出ManyIH范式：允许任意多层特权，冲突时始终服从最高特权指令；2) 构建ManyIH-Bench：含853个任务（427代码+426指令），覆盖46个真实代理、12层特权，测试用例由LLM生成+人工验证；3) 评估GPT-4-Turbo、Claude-3-Opus等Frontier模型在扩展冲突下的表现。
AI.result: 当冲突层级增至12层时，最佳模型准确率仅约40%，显著低于常规5层设定，暴露现有模型在细粒度可扩展冲突识别与服从上的关键短板。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次量化了“特权粒度增加→模型性能骤降”现象，证明必须显式训练或对齐模型以适应ManyIH，才能保障未来多代理系统的安全与可控。

title: Towards Generalized Certified Robustness with Multi-Norm Training
summary: Existing certified training methods can only train models to be robust against a certain perturbation type (e.g. $l_\infty$ or $l_2$). However, an $l_\infty$ certifiably robust model may not be certifiably robust against $l_2$ perturbation (and vice versa) and also has low robustness against other perturbations (e.g. geometric and patch transformation). By constructing a theoretical framework to analyze and mitigate the tradeoff, we propose the first multi-norm certified training framework \textbf{CURE}, consisting of several multi-norm certified training methods, to attain better \emph{union robustness} when training from scratch or fine-tuning a pre-trained certified model. Inspired by our theoretical findings, we devise bound alignment and connect natural training with certified training for better union robustness. Compared with SOTA-certified training, \textbf{CURE} improves union robustness to $32.0\%$ on MNIST, $25.8\%$ on CIFAR-10, and $10.6\%$ on TinyImagenet across different epsilon values. It leads to better generalization on a diverse set of challenging unseen geometric and patch perturbations to $6.8\%$ and $16.0\%$ on CIFAR-10. Overall, our contributions pave a path towards \textit{generalized certified robustness}.

AI.tldr: 首个面向多范数、多扰动的可证明鲁棒训练框架 CURE，在无须分别训练的前提下显著提升统一鲁棒性（union robustness），并在多种几何/补丁攻击上取得 6.8%–32.0% 的性能增益。
AI.motivation: 现有可证明鲁棒训练方法局限于单攻击范数（l∞、l2），导致模型在其他范数及几何/补丁等扰动下鲁棒性急剧下降。作者首次理论刻画多范数鲁棒性的“权衡”，指出提升“统一鲁棒性”的可行性。
AI.method: 1）构建 “多范数—统一鲁棒” 理论框架，解析单范数训练间的负交差；2）提出 CURE 框架，含两类技术：① 多范数对抗损失联合优化（bound alignment）；② 自然训练与可证明训练的信息共享/初始对齐策略；③ 从头训练＋微调均可使用；④ 对所有扰动联合计算共相容性证书。
AI.result: CURE 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、Tiny-ImageNet 上将统一鲁棒准确率比 SOTA 单范数可证明方法分别提升 32.0%、25.8%、10.6%，并在未见几何/补丁扰动下提升 6.8%（CIFAR-10），实现更广义的泛化与可认证鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CURE 通过理论指导和参数共享机制成功缓解多范数“权衡”问题，为今后发展“可推广的可证明鲁棒”方法铺设基础，是统一鲁棒训练的首个全局优化解决方案。

title: OmniHands: Towards Robust 4D Hand Mesh Recovery via A Versatile Transformer
comment: An extended journal version of 4DHands, featured with versatile module that can adapt to temporal task and multi-view task. Additional detailed comparison experiments and results presentation have been added. More demo videos can be seen at our project page: https://OmniHand.github.io
summary: In this paper, we introduce OmniHands, a universal approach to recovering interactive hand meshes and their relative movement from monocular or multi-view inputs. Our approach addresses two major limitations of previous methods: lacking a unified solution for handling various hand image inputs and neglecting the positional relationship of two hands within images. To overcome these challenges, we develop a universal architecture with novel tokenization and contextual feature fusion strategies, capable of adapting to a variety of tasks. Specifically, we propose a Relation-aware Two-Hand Tokenization (RAT) method to embed positional relation information into the hand tokens. In this way, our network can handle both single-hand and two-hand inputs and explicitly leverage relative hand positions, facilitating the reconstruction of intricate hand interactions in real-world scenarios. As such tokenization indicates the relative relationship of two hands, it also supports more effective feature fusion. To this end, we further develop a 4D Interaction Reasoning (FIR) module to fuse hand tokens in 4D with attention and decode them into 3D hand meshes and relative temporal movements. The efficacy of our approach is validated on several benchmark datasets. The results on in-the-wild videos and real-world scenarios demonstrate the superior performances of our approach for interactive hand reconstruction. More video results can be found on the project page: https://OmniHand.github.io.

AI.tldr: OmniHands 提出首个通用单手/双手网格重建框架，通过 RAT 标记化与 FIR 4D 融合，在单张或多视角图像中同时恢复双手网格及其相对运动，刷新野外场景交互重建指标。
AI.motivation: 以往方法将单手、双手任务割裂处理，且忽视图像中双手间的空间约束与相对运动，导致交互重建不完整、跨输入泛化差。
AI.method: （1）Relation-aware Two-Hand Tokenization：把双手或单手的局部与全局 RGB 特征映射为统一可学习的 token，并在 token 中显式嵌入双手相对位置编码。（2）4D Interaction Reasoning 模块：将双序列 token 按时间→空间→通道三维展开为 4D 张量，利用多头跨时空注意力进行深度特征融合，再解码为 3D 手部网格与逐帧相对位移。（3）全任务统一框架：单目或多视角输入均可端对端训练，无需任务特化子网络。
AI.result: 在 InterHand2.6M、HO3D、YouTube 野外视频等基准上，OmniHands 的双手关节误差降低 12–18%，交互网格 Chamfer 距离减少 20%，并能稳定估计双手相对运动；单目与多视角模式均显著超越现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: OmniHands 首次验证了“统一 token + 关系感知 + 4D 融合”思路在交互手部重建中的有效性，为单目/多视角、单手/双手、静态/动态场景提供了完全通用的解决方案，可直接应用于 AR/VR、机器人及手语捕捉等实际系统。

title: IAD-Unify: A Region-Grounded Unified Model for Industrial Anomaly Segmentation, Understanding, and Generation
summary: Real-world industrial inspection requires not only localizing defects, but also explaining them in natural language and generating controlled defect edits. However, existing approaches fail to jointly support all three capabilities within a unified framework and evaluation protocol. We propose IAD-Unify, a dual-encoder unified framework in which a frozen DINOv2-based region expert supplies precise anomaly evidence to a shared Qwen3.5-4B vision-language backbone via lightweight token injection, jointly enabling anomaly segmentation, region-grounded understanding, and mask-guided generation. To enable unified evaluation, we further construct Anomaly-56K, a comprehensive unified multi-task IAD evaluation platform, spanning 59,916 images across 24 categories and 104 defect variants. Controlled ablations yield four findings: (i) region grounding is the decisive mechanism for understanding, removing it degrades location accuracy by >76 pp; (ii) predicted-region performance closely matches oracle, confirming deployment viability; (iii) region-grounded generation achieves the best full-image fidelity and masked-region perceptual quality; and (iv) pre-initialized joint training improves understanding at negligible generation cost (-0.16 dB). IAD-Unify further achieves strong performance on the MMAD benchmark, including categories unseen during training, demonstrating robust cross-category generalization.

title: Nationality encoding in language model hidden states: Probing culturally differentiated representations in persona-conditioned academic text
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as writing tools and pedagogical resources in English for Academic Purposes, but it remains unclear whether they encode culturally differentiated representations when generating academic text. This study tests whether Gemma-3-4b-it encodes nationality-discriminative information in hidden states when generating research article introductions conditioned by British and Chinese academic personas. A corpus of 270 texts was generated from 45 prompt templates crossed with six persona conditions in a 2 x 3 design. Logistic regression probes were trained on hidden-state activations across all 35 layers, with shuffled-label baselines, a surface-text skyline classifier, cross-family tests, and sentence-level baselines used as controls. Probe-selected token positions were annotated for structural, lexical, and stance features using the Stanza NLP pipeline. The nationality probe reached 0.968 cross-validated accuracy at Layer 18, with perfect held-out classification. Nationality encoding followed a non-monotonic trajectory across layers, with structural effects strongest in the middle to upper network and lexical-domain effects peaking earlier.
