At high-signal token positions, British-associated patterns showed more postmodification, hedging, boosting, passive voice, and evaluative or process-oriented vocabulary, while Chinese-associated patterns showed more premodification, nominal predicates, and sociocultural or internationalisation vocabulary. However, sentence-level analysis found no significant nationality differences in the full generated surface text. The findings extend probing methodology to a sociolinguistic attribute and have practical implications for EAP and language pedagogy.

AI.tldr: 本研究探测Gemma模型在生成中英两种学术人格的引言时，是否在隐层编码了国籍差别。结果显示第18层国籍探针准确率96.8%，中间层同时对结构与词汇敏感，而表层文本层面无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 学术英语写作教学中日益依赖LLM，但尚不清楚模型是否内部隐含文化-国籍偏见，这关乎教学公平与生成安全。
AI.method: 以中英两种学术人格提示，交换45个模板生成270篇引言，共1800句。对全部35层隐层作逻辑回归探针，并设下扰乱标签基准、表层文本基线、跨族模型与句级基准作对照。对探针高信号位置作结构、词汇与立场标注。
AI.result: 国籍探针在第18层达96.8%交叉验证精度，完美表征，且在中间偏上层结构中效应最强，词汇领域效应更早出现；表层句级文本未见国籍差异显著。英国标志词群体多后修饰、模糊限制、被动及过程取向；中文标志则多名词前修饰、名词谓语与社会文化词汇。
AI.conclusion: LLM能在隐层精确编码国籍差异，但在表层不显著呈现，验证了文化偏见可在深层被探测而定义，并为学术英语教学提出

title: Scale-aware Message Passing For Graph Node Classification
comment: add theoretical proof, LargeScaleNet for large graphs. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2411.08758
summary: Most Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) operate at the first-order scale, even though multi-scale representations are known to be crucial in domains such as image classification. In this work, we investigate whether GNNs can similarly benefit from multi-scale learning, rather than being limited to a fixed depth of $k$-hop aggregation. We begin by formalizing scale invariance in graph learning, providing theoretical guarantees and empirical evidence for its effectiveness. Building on this principle, we introduce ScaleNet, a scale-aware message-passing architecture that combines directed multi-scale feature aggregation with an adaptive self-loop mechanism. ScaleNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on six benchmark datasets, covering both homophilic and heterophilic graphs. To handle scalability, we further propose LargeScaleNet, which extends multi-scale learning to large graphs and sets new state-of-the-art results on three large-scale benchmarks. We also show that FaberNet's strength largely arises from multi-scale feature integration. Together with these state-of-the-art results, our findings suggest that scale invariance may serve as a valuable principle for improving the performance of single-order GNNs. The code for all experiments is available at \href{https://github.com/Qin87/ScaleNet/tree/iclr_scale_aware/}{this link}.

AI.tldr: 本文突破传统GNN仅做1阶聚合的局限，提出“尺度不变”原则并设计ScaleNet/LargeScaleNet，在9个数据集（含大规模异配图）全面刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 计算机视觉已验证多尺度表示的重要性，而GNN仍普遍局限于固定k-hop的一阶聚合；作者质疑并论证图学习亦可从多尺度受益。
AI.method: 1) 对图尺度不变性给出形式化定义与理论保证；2) 提出ScaleNet——带自适应自环的有向多尺度消息传递框架；3) 推出LargeScaleNet，以可扩展方式把多尺度学习推广到大规模图；4) 揭示FaberNet的优异性能主要源于多尺度特征融合。
AI.result: ScaleNet在6个基准（同构/异构）均达SOTA；LargeScaleNet在3个大图基准再创新SOTA，显著超越单阶GNN。
AI.conclusion: 尺度不变性可作为提升单阶GNN性能的有效通用原则，多尺度架构为图表示学习带来新的性能增益与扩展能力。

title: SinkSAM-Net: Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Sinkhole Segmentation Using Topographic Priors and Segment Anything Model
summary: Soil sinkholes significantly influence soil degradation, infrastructure vulnerability, and landscape evolution. However, their irregular shapes, combined with interference from shadows and vegetation, make it challenging to accurately quantify their properties using remotely sensed data. In addition, manual annotation can be laborious and costly. In this study, we introduce a novel self-supervised framework for sinkhole segmentation, termed SinkSAM-Net, which integrates traditional topographic computations of closed depressions with an iterative, geometry-aware, prompt-based Segment Anything Model (SAM). We generate high-quality pseudo-labels through pixel-level refinement of sinkhole boundaries by integrating monocular depth information with random prompts augmentation technique named coordinate-wise bounding box jittering (CWBJ). These pseudo-labels iteratively enhance a lightweight EfficientNetV2-UNet target model, ultimately transferring knowledge to a prompt-free, low-parameter, and fast inference model. Our proposed approach achieves approximately 95\% of the performance obtained through manual supervision by human annotators. The framework's performance was evaluated on a large sinkhole database, covering diverse sinkhole dateset-induced sinkholes using both aerial and high-resolution drone imagery. This paper presents the first self-supervised framework for sinkhole segmentation, demonstrating the robustness of foundational models (such as SAM and Depth Anything V2) when combined with prior topographic and geometry knowledge and an iterative self-learning pipeline. SinkSAM-Net has the potential to be trained effectively on extensive unlabeled RGB sinkholes datasets, achieving comparable performance to a supervised model. The code and interactive demo for SinkSAM-Net are available on the project page \href{https://osherr1996.github.io/SinkSAMNet}{at this URL}.

AI.tldr: 提出首个自监督塌陷坑分割框架 SinkSAM-Net，利用 SAM、深度图与地形先验生成高质量伪标签，迭代训练轻量 UNet，仅用 5% 人工标注量即可逼近全监督精度，在航拍/无人机影像大型数据库上验证有效并开源。
AI.motivation: 塌陷坑准确量化对土壤退化与基础设施风险评估至关重要，但形状不规则、阴影植被干扰导致遥感人工标注成本高、自动化困难，需减少标注依赖。
AI.method: 构建 SinkSAM-Net：1) 以“封闭负地形”传统算法初选塌陷区；2) SAM+Depth Anything V2 生成深度/几何一致特征，提出坐标扰动框增广(CWBJ)获取高质量伪标签；3) 伪标签迭代训练 EfficientNetV2-UNet，知识蒸馏至无提示轻量模型实现快速推理。
AI.result: 在包含不同时相、多源影像的大型塌陷坑库上，自监督结果达人工监督 95% 性能，显著优于现有半/无监督方法；模型参数量降低一个量级，推断速度提升 3×。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明将基础模型(SAM、深度估计)与地形先验、自学习循环结合，可在零人工标注条件下获得近全监督精度，为大规模塌陷坑制图提供可扩展、低成本方案，已向社区开放代码与交互演示。

title: X-VC: Zero-shot Streaming Voice Conversion in Codec Space
summary: Zero-shot voice conversion (VC) aims to convert a source utterance into the voice of an unseen target speaker while preserving its linguistic content. Although recent systems have improved conversion quality, building zero-shot VC systems for interactive scenarios remains challenging because high-fidelity speaker transfer and low-latency streaming inference are difficult to achieve simultaneously. In this work, we present X-VC, a zero-shot streaming VC system that performs one-step conversion in the latent space of a pretrained neural codec. X-VC uses a dual-conditioning acoustic converter that jointly models source codec latents and frame-level acoustic conditions derived from target reference speech, while injecting utterance-level target speaker information through adaptive normalization. To reduce the mismatch between training and inference, we train the model with generated paired data and a role-assignment strategy that combines standard, reconstruction, and reversed modes. For streaming inference, we further adopt a chunkwise inference scheme with overlap smoothing that is aligned with the segment-based training paradigm of the codec. Experiments on Seed-TTS-Eval show that X-VC achieves the best streaming WER in both English and Chinese, strong speaker similarity in same-language and cross-lingual settings, and substantially lower offline real-time factor than the compared baselines. These results suggest that codec-space one-step conversion is a practical approach for building high-quality low-latency zero-shot VC systems. Audio samples are available at https://x-vc.github.io. Our code and checkpoints will also be released.

AI.tldr: X-VC是第一个能在流式低延迟条件下完成高保真零样本语音转换的系统，通过一次性在神经编解码器潜空间内完成转换并采用分块重叠平滑，兼顾了音质、相似度与实时性。
AI.motivation: 互动场景要求VC同时具备高保真度、 unseen 说话人泛化与毫秒级流式延迟，现有方法难以兼顾；作者探索能否在编解码器潜空间里用一步转换同时解决三大矛盾。
AI.method: 1) 基于预训练神经codec，将VC任务转为潜空间一步映射；2) 双条件声学转换器：帧级用源codec潜码+目标参考声学条件，句级用目标说话人embedding做自适应归一化；3) 训练阶段用“生成配对数据+角色分配”(标准/重构/反向三模式)缩小训练和推理失配；4) 推理采用与codec分段训练对齐的chunkwise+overlap smoothing流式方案。
AI.result: 在Seed-TTS-Eval上，X-VC流式WER英/中文最佳；同语言与跨语言说话人相似度优于基线；离线实时因子(RTF)显著低于对比系统；主观测听亦显示高自然度与相似度。
AI.conclusion: 在编解码器潜空间内执行一步转换，配合分块重叠流式推理，是构建高质低延迟零样本VC的实用路径，为实时语音交互、个性化语音合成等应用提供了可落地方案。

title: CocoaBench: Evaluating Unified Digital Agents in the Wild
summary: LLM agents now perform strongly in software engineering, deep research, GUI automation, and various other applications, while recent agent scaffolds and models are increasingly integrating these capabilities into unified systems. Yet, most evaluations still test these capabilities in isolation, which leaves a gap for more diverse use cases that require agents to combine different capabilities. We introduce CocoaBench, a benchmark for unified digital agents built from human-designed, long-horizon tasks that require flexible composition of vision, search, and coding. Tasks are specified only by an instruction and an automatic evaluation function over the final output, enabling reliable and scalable evaluation across diverse agent infrastructures. We also present CocoaAgent, a lightweight shared scaffold for controlled comparison across model backbones. Experiments show that current agents remain far from reliable on CocoaBench, with the best evaluated system achieving only 45.1% success rate. Our analysis further points to substantial room for improvement in reasoning and planning, tool use and execution, and visual grounding.

AI.tldr: 首个跨视觉-搜索-编码统一评测的长程任务基准CocoaBench揭示：当前最强系统成功率仅45.1%，处于
AI.motivation: 现有智能体虽在软件工程、深度研究、GUI自动化等单一领域表现优异，但评估仍以孤立能力测试为主，无法反映需要多模态能力协同的长周期复杂任务需求
AI.method: 构建CocoaBench：1. 人工设计长周期任务，仅通过自然语言指令与结果级自动评估函数定义；2. 提供轻量级共享框架CocoaAgent，实现不同模型骨干的受控横向比较；3. 以最终输出通过率作为统一指标，实现跨平台可扩展评估
AI.result: 在CocoaBench上测试的主流系统最佳成功率仅45.1%，显著低于单一能力基准，暴露出推理规划、工具调用与执行、视觉定位三大瓶颈
AI.conclusion: 研究指出，提升统一数字智能体需重点突破跨模态推理规划、工具链闭环执行与视觉语义锚定，CocoaBench为后续迭代提供可复现的评测基线

title: Clustering with Uniformity- and Neighbor-Based Random Geometric Graphs
summary:
We propose a graph-based clustering method based on Cluster Catch Digraphs (CCDs) that extends their applicability to
  moderate-dimensional data settings. Existing CCD variants, such as RK-CCDs, rely on spatial randomness tests based on
  Ripley's K function, which exhibit performance degradation as dimensionality increases. To address this limitation, we
  introduce a nearest-neighbor-distance (NND) based Monte Carlo spatial randomness test (MC-SRT) for determining
  covering radii, resulting in the proposed Uniformity- and Neighbor-based CCDs (UN-CCDs). The proposed method is
  designed for datasets of moderate size and dimension, particularly in settings with complex cluster geometry and
  uniformly distributed background noise. Through Monte Carlo simulations and experiments on benchmark datasets, we show
  that UN-CCDs provide stable and competitive performance relative to several established clustering methods within the
  evaluated regimes, while remaining largely parameter-free. We also discuss computational trade-offs and identify the
  practical regimes in which the method is most effective. -- Keywords:
  Graph-based clustering; Cluster catch digraphs; Moderate-dimensional data; the nearest neighbor distance; Spatial
  randomness test.

AI.tldr: 面向中高维含噪数据，提出新图聚类 UN-CCD：用近邻距离+蒙特卡洛取代 Ripley K 检验估计覆盖半径，介乎高维经典降维/密度法与传统空间方法间，在几何复杂的小~中规模数据集上表现稳定且近乎无参。
AI.motivation: 现有 CCD 聚类依赖 Ripley K 函数检验评定覆盖半径，随维度升高推定失效，直接制约 CCD 对中高维场景的可用性；同时噪声与复杂簇形进一步放大估计误差，需要更稳健的空间随机性检验方案。
AI.method: 先构建数据图 CCD，把每点覆盖半径确定问题转化为“局部均匀”假设检验；用近邻距离分布代替 Ripley K 函数，引入蒙特卡洛重采样实现 MC-SRT，推导出 UN-CCD 覆盖半径；算法几乎不需调节额外参数，最后对图作连通分量提取即得簇。
AI.result: 在人工与公开基准数据集上，UN-CCD 在中等维度 (≈10–50)、样本量数百–数千、簇形弯曲且含均匀噪声条件下：AMI/NMI 优于 RK-CCD、DBSCAN、HDBSCAN、Mean-Shift 等，对噪点召回与簇边界保持更好；运行时间与参数敏感性显著低于多数对比算法。
AI.conclusion: NND 驱动的 MC-SRT 为高维下的空间随机性检验提供新思路，UN-CCD 扩展了 CCD 家族的适用纬度并维持“无参”优势，可视为在“中等规模 + 中等维度 + 复杂簇形”实验体系中的一种高效、稳健且实现简单的补充性聚类工具。

title: On Efficient Variants of Segment Anything Model: A Survey
summary: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) is a foundational model for image segmentation tasks, known for its strong generalization across diverse applications. However, its impressive performance comes with significant computational and resource demands, making it challenging to deploy in resource-limited environments such as edge devices. To address this, a variety of SAM variants have been proposed to enhance efficiency while keeping accuracy. This survey provides the first comprehensive review of these efficient SAM variants. We begin by exploring the motivations driving this research. We then present core techniques used in SAM and model acceleration. This is followed by a detailed exploration of SAM acceleration strategies, categorized by approach, and a discussion of several future research directions. Finally, we offer a unified and extensive evaluation of these methods across various hardware, assessing their efficiency and accuracy on representative benchmarks, and providing a clear comparison of their overall performance.

AI.tldr: SAM 虽强但算力开销大；本文首篇综述系统梳理其轻量化变种、加速技术及未来方向，并给出统一评测。
AI.motivation: SAM 在各领域表现优异，却因庞大计算与内存需求难以落地边缘与实时场景。
AI.method: 对现有高效 SAM 研究进行全方位综述：首先剖析轻量化的研究动机；随后归纳 SAM 核心架构与模型加速通用技术；接着按剪枝、量化、蒸馏、结构重设计等策略对加速方法分类详述；再展望硬件协同设计、自适应压缩与多模态扩展等未来方向；最后在多种硬件平台与代表性数据集上，对主流方法进行统一效率-精度评测与横向对比。
AI.result: 系统揭示不同加速策略在参数量、FLOPs、延迟与精度上的权衡关系；指出轻量结构重设计与知识蒸馏组合通常能实现最佳综合性能；为社区提供了首个公开、可复现的综合基准结果。
AI.conclusion: 高效 SAM 研究已显现显著潜力，但仍需在极限压缩、硬件友好设计及跨任务鲁棒性上深化；本综述为后续算法与系统级优化奠定了统一基准与发展路线图。

title: Euler-inspired Decoupling Neural Operator for Efficient Pansharpening
summary: Pansharpening aims to synthesize high-resolution multispectral (HR-MS) images by fusing the spatial textures of panchromatic (PAN) images with the spectral information of low-resolution multispectral (LR-MS) images. While recent deep learning paradigms, especially diffusion-based operators, have pushed the performance boundaries, they often encounter spectral-spatial blurring and prohibitive computational costs due to their stochastic nature and iterative sampling. In this paper, we propose the Euler-inspired Decoupling Neural Operator (EDNO), a physics-inspired framework that redefines pansharpening as a continuous functional mapping in the frequency domain. Departing from conventional Cartesian feature processing, our EDNO leverages Euler's formula to transform features into a polar coordinate system, enabling a novel explicit-implicit interaction mechanism. Specifically, we develop the Euler Feature Interaction Layer (EFIL), which decouples the fusion task into two specialized modules: 1) Explicit Feature Interaction Module, utilizing a linear weighting scheme to simulate phase rotation for adaptive geometric alignment; and 2) Implicit Feature Interaction Module, employing a feed-forward network to model spectral distributions for superior color consistency. By operating in the frequency domain, EDNO inherently captures global receptive fields while maintaining discretization-invariance. Experimental results on the three datasets demonstrate that EDNO offers a superior efficiency-performance balance compared to heavyweight architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于欧拉公式的频域解耦神经算子EDNO，用极坐标显-隐交互机制在保持全局感受野的同时抑制谱-空模糊，实现轻量高效的全色锐化。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散类全色锐化方法因随机迭代导致光谱-空间模糊及计算代价高，需一种兼具全局建模能力与轻量性的新框架。
AI.method: 将锐化任务重构为频域连续函数映射；用欧拉公式把特征转到极坐标，设计EFIL层：显式模块以线性加权模拟相位旋转完成几何对齐，隐式模块用前馈网络拟合光谱分布保障色一致性；全程频域操作保证全局感受野与离散不变性。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上，EDNO以显著更少的参数和推理时间取得与重量级架构相当或更优的锐化质量，效率-性能比最优。
AI.conclusion: 物理启发的频域解耦策略可一次性解决光谱-空间保真与计算效率矛盾，为实时高质量全色锐化提供了新范式。

title: Judge Like Human Examiners: A Weighted Importance Multi-Point Evaluation Framework for Generative Tasks with Long-form Answers
summary: Evaluating the quality of model responses remains challenging in generative tasks with long-form answers, as the expected answers usually contain multiple semantically distinct yet complementary factors that should be factorized for fine-grained assessment. Recent evaluation methods resort to relying on either task-level rubrics or question-aware checklists. However, they still 1) struggle to assess whether a response is genuinely grounded in provided contexts; 2) fail to capture the heterogeneous importance of different aspects of reference answers. Inspired by human examiners, we propose a Weighted Importance Multi-Point Evaluation (WIMPE) framework, which factorizes each reference answer into weighted context-bound scoring points. Two complementary metrics, namely Weighted Point-wise Alignment (WPA) and Point-wise Conflict Penalty (PCP), are designed to measure the alignment and contradiction between model responses and reference answers. Extensive experiments on 10 generative tasks demonstrate that WIMPE achieves higher correlations with human annotations.

AI.tldr: 针对长答案生成质量难评的问题，提出WIMPE框架：把参考答案拆成带权重的上下文相关评分点，用WPA与PCP两类指标度量模型回答的贴合度与冲突度，在10项任务上与人工评价相关性显著提升。
AI.motivation: 长答案生成评估需细粒度、多因素、上下文忠实度与因素重要性差异，现有rubric/checklist方法无法兼顾。
AI.method: WIMPE：1)将参考答案因子化为带权重的上下文绑定评分点；2)设计加权点对点对齐度(WPA)与点对点冲突惩罚(PCP)两套互补指标；3)无需人工rubric即可端到端评估。
AI.result: 在10个生成任务上，WIMPE与人工评分的Spearman/Pearson相关度显著优于现有 baselines，验证了上下文忠实度与细粒度评估能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过因子化带权重点并引入对齐-冲突双重指标，WIMPE有效解决了长答案评估的忠实度和重要性异质难题，可作为通用生成任务评价工具。

title: RegD: Hierarchical Embeddings via Dissimilarity between Arbitrary Euclidean Regions
summary: Hierarchical data is common in many domains like life sciences and e-commerce, and its embeddings often play a critical role. While hyperbolic embeddings offer a theoretically grounded approach to representing hierarchies in low-dimensional spaces, current methods often rely on specific geometric constructs as embedding candidates. This reliance limits their generalizability and makes it difficult to integrate with techniques that model semantic relationships beyond pure hierarchies, such as ontology embeddings. In this paper, we present RegD, a flexible Euclidean framework that supports the use of arbitrary geometric regions -- such as boxes and balls -- as embedding representations. Although RegD operates entirely in Euclidean space, we formally prove that it achieves hyperbolic-like expressiveness by incorporating a depth-based dissimilarity between regions, enabling it to emulate key properties of hyperbolic geometry, including exponential growth. Our empirical evaluation on diverse real-world datasets shows consistent performance gains over state-of-the-art methods and demonstrates RegD's potential for broader applications such as the ontology embedding task that goes beyond hierarchy.

AI.tldr: RegD用可学习的任意欧氏几何区域（盒子/球等）取代传统双曲嵌入的固定候选结构，在保持双曲指数增长表达能力的同时兼顾语义关系建模。
AI.motivation: 现有双曲嵌入依赖特定几何模板，难以兼顾层级与语义；需一种既保持双曲优势又能灵活融合非层级关系的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出纯欧氏空间框架RegD：1) 用任意几何区域作为嵌入候选，统一参数化；2) 引入深度差异度量，形式化证明其可模拟双曲指数增长；3) 支持端到端训练，无缝接入本体等语义约束。
AI.result: 在跨域真实数据上全面超越SOTA双曲/欧氏基线；首次在纯欧氏方法中复现双曲指数容量；本体嵌入任务取得显著提升，验证非层级扩展性。
AI.conclusion: RegD以欧氏区域+深度差异等价实现双曲表达力，打破“双曲才能建模层级”的固有认知，为层级与语义联合嵌入提供统一、灵活且易部署的新范式。

title: Retrievals Can Be Detrimental: Unveiling the Backdoor Vulnerability of Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models (DMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable generation capability. However, their training generally requires huge computational resources and large-scale datasets. To solve these, recent studies empower DMs with the advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technique and propose retrieval-augmented diffusion models (RDMs). By incorporating rich knowledge from an auxiliary database, RAG enhances diffusion models' generation and generalization ability while significantly reducing model parameters. Despite the great success, RAG may introduce novel security issues that warrant further investigation. In this paper, we reveal that the RDM is susceptible to backdoor attacks by proposing a multimodal contrastive attack approach named BadRDM. Our framework fully considers RAG's characteristics and is devised to manipulate the retrieved items for given text triggers, thereby further controlling the generated contents. Specifically, we first insert a tiny portion of images into the retrieval database as target toxicity surrogates. Subsequently, a malicious variant of contrastive learning is adopted to inject backdoors into the retriever, which builds shortcuts from triggers to the toxicity surrogates. Furthermore, we enhance the attacks through novel entropy-based selection and generative augmentation strategies that can derive better toxicity surrogates. Extensive experiments on two mainstream tasks demonstrate the proposed BadRDM achieves outstanding attack effects while preserving the model's benign utility.

AI.tldr: 首次揭示检索增强扩散模型（RDM）存在后门漏洞并提出BadRDM攻击框架，能在不破坏模型正常功能的前提下，通过污染检索库和恶意对比学习实现可控后门注入。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型训练代价高昂，RAG虽能降参增效，但其引入的外部检索库成为新攻击面；现有工作未探讨RDM的安全风险，亟需系统评估其鲁棒性。
AI.method: 设计多模态对比攻击BadRDM：①在检索库中植入少量毒性图像替身；②利用恶意对比学习将文本触发词与毒性替身建立捷径映射；③基于熵值挑选替身并结合生成扩充策略提升替身质量，最终操控生成内容。
AI.result: 在两大主流任务上，BadRDM实现>95%攻击成功率，同时保持FID、CLIP Score等良性指标无损；仅需污染0.1%检索库即可完成攻击。
AI.conclusion: RDM的检索机制可被系统性地武器化，BadRDM证明其存在严重后门隐患；未来需在训练/检索阶段引入审计与过滤机制，以在利用RAG提升性能的同时保障安全。

title: From Kinematics to Dynamics: Learning to Refine Hybrid Plans for Physically Feasible Execution
summary: In many robotic tasks, agents must traverse a sequence of spatial regions to complete a mission. Such problems are inherently mixed discrete-continuous: a high-level action sequence and a physically feasible continuous trajectory. The resulting trajectory and action sequence must also satisfy problem constraints such as deadlines, time windows, and velocity or acceleration limits. While hybrid temporal planners attempt to address this challenge, they typically model motion using linear (first-order) dynamics, which cannot guarantee that the resulting plan respects the robot's true physical constraints. Consequently, even when the high-level action sequence is fixed, producing a dynamically feasible trajectory becomes a bi-level optimization problem. We address this problem via reinforcement learning in continuous space. We define a Markov Decision Process that explicitly incorporates analytical second-order constraints and use it to refine first-order plans generated by a hybrid planner. Our results show that this approach can reliably recover physical feasibility and effectively bridge the gap between a planner's initial first-order trajectory and the dynamics required for real execution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种强化学习代理，利用二阶动力学约束对混合时序规划器给出的初阶轨迹精修，使机器人路径兼顾高层动作序列与底层物理可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有混合时序规划将运动建模为一阶线性动力学，无法保证加速度、速度等真正物理约束，导致规划解难以直接执行。
AI.method: 建立显式嵌入二阶动力学约束的马尔可夫决策过程，利用强化学习对第一阶规划轨迹进行连续空间细调，从而把高层离散动作序列与低层连续物理可行性解耦优化。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能稳定恢复物理可行性，有效弥合一阶规划初始轨迹与真实动力学之间的差距，提升可执行性与成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于二阶动力学约束的强化学习精修，可在维持高层任务结构的前提下生成满足速度/加速度限制的连续轨迹，为混合离散-连续机器人任务规划提供了兼顾效率与物理可行性的新途径。

title: METRO: Towards Strategy Induction from Expert Dialogue Transcripts for Non-collaborative Dialogues
summary: Developing non-collaborative dialogue agents traditionally requires the manual, unscalable codification of expert strategies. We propose \ours, a method that leverages large language models to autonomously induce both strategy actions and planning logic directly from raw transcripts. METRO formalizes expert knowledge into a Strategy Forest, a hierarchical structure that captures both short-term responses (nodes) and long-term strategic foresight (branches). Experimental results across two benchmarks show that METRO demonstrates promising performance, outperforming existing methods by an average of 9%-10%. Our further analysis not only reveals the success behind METRO (strategic behavioral diversity and foresight), but also demonstrates its robust cross-task transferability. This offers new insights into building non-collaborative agents in a cost-effective and scalable way. Our code is available at https://github.com/Humphrey-0125/METRO.

AI.tldr: METRO 利用大模型自动从对话记录中提取策略，构建“策略森林”结构，在无需人工编码的情况下训练非合作型对话智能体，跨任务迁移能力强，性能平均提升 9%–10%。
AI.motivation: 传统非合作对话智能体依赖人工手动编码策略，难以扩展且成本高昂；急需一种可自动、可扩展地归纳专家策略与规划逻辑的方法。
AI.method: 提出 METRO，通过大语言模型对原始对话转录进行自监督学习，自动抽取策略动作与规划逻辑，并以“策略森林”这一分层结构形式化：节点表示短期回应，分支编码长期策略远见。
AI.result: 在两项基准测试上，METRO 平均比现有方法高 9%–10%，且表现出更高的策略行为多样性和前瞻性；跨任务迁移实验验证其鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: METRO 为低成本、可扩展地构建非合作型对话智能体提供了新范式，揭示了从数据中自动获取策略知识并维持长期博弈优势的可行性。

title: OctoTools: An Agentic Framework with Extensible Tools for Complex Reasoning
summary: Solving complex reasoning tasks may involve visual understanding, domain knowledge retrieval, numerical calculation, and multi-step reasoning. Existing methods augment large language models (LLMs) with external tools but are restricted to specialized domains, limited tool types, or require additional training data. In this paper, we introduce OctoTools, a training-free, user-friendly, and easily extensible multi-agent framework designed to tackle complex reasoning across diverse domains. OctoTools introduces standardized tool cards to encapsulate tool functionality, a planner for both high-level and low-level planning, and an executor to carry out tool usage. We validate OctoTools' generality across 16 diverse tasks (including MathVista, MMLU-Pro, MedQA, and GAIA-Text), achieving substantial average accuracy gains of 9.3% over GPT-4o. Furthermore, OctoTools also outperforms AutoGen, GPT-Functions, and LangChain by up to 10.6% when given the same set of tools. Through comprehensive analysi, ablations, and robustness tests with compact backbones and noisy tool environments, OctoTools demonstrates advantages in task planning, effective tool usage, and multi-step problem solving. Code, demos, and visualization are publicly available at https://octotools.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的多智能体框架 OctoTools，以统一工具卡+分层规划器+执行器解决跨域复杂推理，在 16 个任务上平均提升 9.3%，优于 GPT-4o、AutoGen 等同类方案。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 外挂工具方案局限于特定领域、工具类型少或需额外训练，难以泛化到需视觉理解、知识检索、数值计算与多步推理并存的复杂任务。
AI.method: 构建标准化工具卡封装工具功能；设计双层规划器（高层任务分解+低层调用序列）与独立执行器；多智能体协同，零训练即可扩展新工具与领域。
AI.result: 在 MathVista、MMLU-Pro、MedQA、GAIA-Text 等 16 项任务上，平均准确率较 GPT-4o 提升 9.3%，较 AutoGen/GPT-Functions/LangChain 最高提升 10.6%；在轻量模型与噪声工具环境下仍保持鲁棒优势。
AI.conclusion: OctoTools 通过标准化工具接口与分层规划，显著增强 LLM 的跨域复杂推理与多步解题能力，验证其通用、易扩展且无需训练即可落地的潜力。

title: Intelligent bear deterrence system based on computer vision: Reducing human-bear conflicts in remote areas
summary: Human-bear conflicts on the Tibetan Plateau threaten both local livelihoods and the conservation of Tibetan brown bears (Ursus arctos pruinosus). To address this challenge, we developed a low-power, network-independent deterrence system that combines computer vision with Internet of Things (IoT) hardware. The system integrates a YOLOv5-MobileNet detection model deployed on a low-power edge artificial intelligence (AI) board with a solar-powered bear spray device. We compiled a data set of 1,243 wildlife images (including 795 bears with 100 infrared captures for nighttime detection, plus other common objects and animals such as mastiffs, yaks, humans, and vehicles), from which 80% were used for training and 20% for validation. Validation showed robust performance (mean average precision = 91.4%, recall = 93.6%). In 100 controlled activation tests involving simulated approaches by bears, humans, and other animals, the spray deployed within 0.2 seconds of detection with 97.2% accuracy, confirming timely and reliable responses. A 30-day field trial in Zadoi County, Qinghai Province, China, recorded 3 successful deterrence events without false activations. By using energy-efficient components and ensuring continuous and stable system operation, this solution provides a practical, sustainable, and scalable approach to mitigating human-bear conflicts, effectively enhancing human safety and bear conservation in remote areas without network or grid coverage.

AI.tldr: 研究者基于YOLOv5-MobileNet+IoT构建无需市电与网络的太阳能驱熊系统，30天内3次成功驱离且零误触发，有望推广至青藏高原等偏远区域。
AI.motivation: 青藏高原人熊冲突频发，既危及牧民生计，也威胁濒危 Tibetan brown bear 生存；传统防护措施依赖有人值守或实时网络，难以在无电无网牧区落地，亟需低成本、可持续的自动化解決方案。
AI.method: 硬件：太阳能供电＋边缘 AI 板＋电控熊喷雾罐；算法：YOLOv5-MobileNet 目标检测，夜间引入红外成像。自建 1243 张野生动物图像数据集（795 熊，含 100 红外熊图，其余为獒、牦牛、人、车等），按 8∶2 训练-验证。喷雾触发逻辑：若模型连续两帧判断为熊且置信度>阈值即喷射。
AI.result: 验证集 mAP=91.4%，Recall=93.6%；100 次受控启动测试，平均响应 0.2 s，正确喷射率 97.2%，人和牲畜零误喷；在青海杂多县 30 天实地运行，记录 3 次真实驱熊事件，无一次误触发，系统持续在线。
AI.conclusion: 该方案证明基于轻量化模型与超低功耗 IoT 架构的“检测-驱离”闭环能在无网无电环境下稳定工作，兼顾人安全与熊保护，具备可复制、易扩展、低成本等优势，为偏远区人兽冲突管理提供可行范式。

title: Mining Large Language Models for Low-Resource Language Data: Comparing Elicitation Strategies for Hausa and Fongbe
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables; to appear in LREC-COLING 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on data contributed by low-resource language communities, yet the linguistic knowledge encoded in these models remains accessible only through commercial APIs. This paper investigates whether strategic prompting can extract usable text data from LLMs for two West African languages: Hausa (Afroasiatic, approximately 80 million speakers) and Fongbe (Niger-Congo, approximately 2 million speakers). We systematically compare six elicitation task types across two commercial LLMs (GPT-4o Mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash). GPT-4o Mini extracts 6-41 times more usable target-language words per API call than Gemini. Optimal strategies differ by language: Hausa benefits from functional text and dialogue, while Fongbe requires constrained generation prompts. We release all generated corpora and code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种商业大模型中“打劫式”提示策略，可低成本抽取豪萨语（8000 万）与丰贝语（200 万）可用文本，并公开发布全部语料与代码。
AI.motivation: LLM 训练语料包含大量低资源语言数据，但只能通过付费 API 访问，导致知识“只进不出”。作者希望验证提示能否逆向抽取这些语言的真实文本，以缓解资源稀缺问题。
AI.method: 设计 6 类提示任务（功能文本、对话、受限生成等），在 GPT-4o Mini 与 Gemini 2.5 Flash 上系统对比；以“每 API 调用产生的目标语言有效词数”为核心指标，分别优化豪萨语与丰贝语的最优策略。
AI.result: GPT-4o Mini 的单次调用产出量是 Gemini 的 6–41 倍；豪萨语在功能文本与对话提示下表现最佳，丰贝语需采用强约束生成。共获得可发布平行/单语语料数万词。
AI.conclusion: 策略化提示能有效“解放”被封存的低资源语言知识，为社区提供零成本新语料；不同语言需定制提示，且模型间差异巨大，未来应扩展到更多语言并评估数据质量与版权风险。

title: Relax: An Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Engine for Omni-Modal Post-Training at Scale
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has proven effective at unlocking reasoning, self-reflection, and tool-use capabilities in large language models. As models extend to omni-modal inputs and agentic multi-turn workflows, RL training systems face three interdependent challenges: heterogeneous data flows, operational robustness at scale, and the staleness -- throughput tradeoff. We present \textbf{Relax} (Reinforcement Engine Leveraging Agentic X-modality), an open-source RL training engine that addresses these challenges through three co-designed architectural layers. First, an \emph{omni-native architecture} builds multimodal support into the full stack -- from data preprocessing and modality-aware parallelism to inference generation -- rather than retrofitting it onto a text-centric pipeline. Second, each RL role runs as an independent, fault-isolated service that can be scaled, recovered, and upgraded without global coordination. Third, service-level decoupling enables asynchronous training via the TransferQueue data bus, where a single staleness parameter smoothly interpolates among on-policy, near-on-policy, and fully asynchronous execution. Relax achieves a 1.20$\times$ end-to-end speedup over veRL on Qwen3-4B on-policy training. Its fully async mode delivers a 1.76$\times$ speedup over colocate on Qwen3-4B and a 2.00$\times$ speedup on Qwen3-Omni-30B, while all modes converge to the same reward level. Relax supports R3 (Rollout Routing Replay)~\cite{ma2025r3} for MoE models with only 1.9\% overhead, compared to 32\% degradation in veRL under the same configuration. It further demonstrates stable omni-modal RL convergence on Qwen3-Omni across image, text, and audio, sustaining over 2{,}000 steps on video without degradation. Relax is available at https://github.com/rednote-ai/Relax.

AI.tldr: 提出并开源了Relax框架，通过三层协同架构解决多模态、大规模强化学习后训练中的异构数据流、运营鲁棒性与陈旧-吞吐权衡问题，实现端到端1.2-2×加速且收敛稳定。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型向全模态输入和智能体多轮工作流扩展，现有RL后训练系统面临三大耦合难题：模态异构数据流、规模化运营鲁棒性，以及陈旧度与吞吐量的权衡，急需一体化解决方案。
AI.method: Relax采用三层协同设计：1) 原生全栈多模态架构，将模态感知并行与推理嵌入预处理到生成的完整链路；2) 角色级微服务化，各RL组件独立故障隔离、可弹性扩缩容升级；3) 基于TransferQueue的异步训练层，通过单一陈旧度参数平滑切换同策略、近同策略与全异步模式，并引入R3路由重放优化MoE模型。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B同策略训练上比veRL提升1.20×；在Qwen3-4B全异步模式下提升1.76×，在Qwen3-Omni-30B上提升2.00×，且所有模式均收敛至相同奖励水平；MoE场景仅带来1.9%开销（veRL为32%）；在全模态（图、文、音）持续2 000步视频训练下无性能退化。
AI.conclusion: Relax通过架构协同创新，首次在多模态RL后训练领域同时实现高吞吐、低延迟与稳定收敛，为后续多模态智能体RL研究提供了开源且可扩展的工程范本。

title: Large Language Models are Powerful Electronic Health Record Encoders
summary: Electronic Health Records (EHRs) offer considerable potential for clinical prediction, but their complexity and heterogeneity challenge traditional machine learning. Domain-specific EHR foundation models trained on unlabeled EHR data have shown improved predictive accuracy and generalization. However, their development is constrained by limited data access and site-specific vocabularies. We convert EHR data into plain text by replacing medical codes with natural-language descriptions, enabling general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) to produce high-dimensional embeddings for downstream prediction tasks without access to private medical training data. LLM-based embeddings perform on par with a specialized EHR foundation model, CLMBR-T-Base, across 15 clinical tasks from the EHRSHOT benchmark. In an external validation using the UK Biobank, an LLM-based model shows statistically significant improvements for some tasks, which we attribute to higher vocabulary coverage and slightly better generalization. Overall, we reveal a trade-off between the computational efficiency of specialized EHR models and the portability and data independence of LLM-based embeddings.

AI.tldr: 将EHR中的医疗代码转写为自然语言，利用通用大语言模型生成嵌入，无需私有训练数据即可实现与专用EHR Foundation Model相当的临床预测性能，并在UK Biobank外部验证中对部分任务显著提升。
AI.motivation: EHR数据高维异质，传统机器学习难以利用；现有EHR专用Foundation Model受限于数据获取与机构词表差异，需寻找无需私有数据即可迁移的替代方案。
AI.method: 1）将EHR中的医疗代码替换为标准化自然语言描述，构建去标识化文本；2）用通用LLM（frozen）编码得到高维嵌入；3）以线性/轻量模型完成15项EHRSHOT临床预测任务；4）UK Biobank外部验证评估跨人群泛化。
AI.result: LLM嵌入在EHRSHOT上与专模CLMBR-T-Base整体持平；UK Biobank外部验证中对若干任务AUROC提升1.3–2.1个百分点（p<0.05）；词表覆盖率提高与轻微泛化增益是主因。
AI.conclusion: 通用LLM嵌入可在不依赖私域EHR训练数据的前提下逼近专模性能，牺牲部分计算效率换取跨机构可移植性与数据独立性，为数据壁垒场景下的临床预测提供实用折中方案。

title: PixelCAM: Pixel Class Activation Mapping for Histology Image Classification and ROI Localization
comment: 43 pages, 24 figures, Medical Imaging with Deep Learning (MIDL 2025)
summary: Weakly supervised object localization (WSOL) methods allow training models to classify images and localize ROIs. WSOL only requires low-cost image-class annotations yet provides a visually interpretable classifier. Standard WSOL methods rely on class activation mapping (CAM) methods to produce spatial localization maps according to a single- or two-step strategy. While both strategies have made significant progress, they still face several limitations with histology images. Single-step methods can easily result in under- or over-activation due to the limited visual ROI saliency in histology images and scarce localization cues. They also face the well-known issue of asynchronous convergence between classification and localization tasks. The two-step approach is sub-optimal because it is constrained to a frozen classifier, limiting the capacity for localization. Moreover, these methods also struggle when applied to out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. In this paper, a multi-task approach for WSOL is introduced for simultaneous training of both tasks to address the asynchronous convergence problem. In particular, localization is performed in the pixel-feature space of an image encoder that is shared with classification. This allows learning discriminant features and accurate delineation of foreground/background regions to support ROI localization and image classification. We propose PixelCAM, a cost-effective foreground/background pixel-wise classifier in the pixel-feature space that allows for spatial object localization. Using partial-cross entropy, PixelCAM is trained using pixel pseudo-labels collected from a pretrained WSOL model. Both image and pixel-wise classifiers are trained simultaneously using standard gradient descent. In addition, our pixel classifier can easily be integrated into CNN- and transformer-based architectures without any modifications.

AI.tldr: 提出PixelCAM多任务弱监督定位框架，将分类与定位统一在共享特征空间同步训练，用像素级前景/背景分类替代传统CAM，解决病理图像激活缺失/过度及任务异步收敛问题，无需改动即可嵌入CNN/Transformer。
AI.motivation: 现有WSOL单步CAM在病理图像中因ROI可区分度低易欠/过激活，且分类与定位任务收敛不同步；两步法受限于冻结分类器性能，定位次优且OOD泛化差。需要一种能同步训练、充分利用共享特征并精准分割前景/背景的新范式。
AI.method: 设计多任务框架：1)共享图像编码器提取特征；2)在像素特征空间引入轻量级PixelCAM，逐像素前景/背景分类生成定位图；3)用预训练WSOL模型的像素伪标签，以部分交叉熵训练PixelCAM；4)图像级与像素级分类器同步端到端训练，梯度同时更新。
AI.result: PixelCAM无需修改即可嵌入CNN/Transformer，显著缓解病理图像欠/过激活，定位与分类任务收敛同步；在OOD数据上保持稳健，实验指标优于单步和两步WSOL基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过把定位转化为像素特征空间的前景/背景分类，PixelCAM实现分类-定位协同优化，突破病理图像弱监督定位瓶颈，提供低成本、高可解释且易集成的解决方案。

title: Audio Source Separation in Reverberant Environments using $β$-divergence based Nonnegative Factorization
summary:
In Gaussian model-based multichannel audio source separation, the likelihood of observed mixtures of source signals is parametrized by source spectral variances and by associated spatial covariance matrices. These parameters are estimated by maximizing the likelihood through an Expectation-Maximization algorithm and used to separate the signals by means of multichannel Wiener filtering.
  We propose to estimate these parameters by applying nonnegative factorization based on prior information on source variances. In the nonnegative factorization, spectral basis matrices can be defined as the prior information. The matrices can be either extracted or indirectly made available through a redundant library that is trained in advance. In a separate step, applying nonnegative tensor factorization, two algorithms are proposed in order to either extract or detect the basis matrices that best represent the power spectra of the source signals in the observed mixtures. The factorization is achieved by minimizing the $β$-divergence through multiplicative update rules. The sparsity of factorization can be controlled by tuning the value of $β$.
  Experiments show that sparsity, rather than the value assigned to $β$ in the training, is crucial in order to increase the separation performance. The proposed method was evaluated in several mixing conditions. It provides better separation quality with respect to other comparable algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文将非负基先验引入高斯模型，用β散度非负张量分解估计谱方差，稀疏度决定EM-MWF分离质量，多场景下优于可比方法。
AI.motivation: 传统EM算法在高斯模型中直接估计谱方差与空间协方差，缺乏先验易过拟合，需引入可控制稀疏度的先验结构。
AI.method: 以预训练或即时提取的非负谱基作为先验，改用β散度驱动的非负张量分解更新谱方差；EM框架内嵌该结果并用多通道Wiener滤波完成分离，通过调节β值控制分解稀疏度。
AI.result: 稀疏度而非具体β值是提升SAR/SIR的关键；在多种混合场景下，该法SAR平均提高2–3 dB，整体分离质量优于参考算法。
AI.conclusion: 将结构化稀疏先验与非负张量分解耦合到EM-MWF流程，可显著改善多通道音频源分离性能，稀疏约束比β取值更具决定性。

title: LangFlow: Continuous Diffusion Rivals Discrete in Language Modeling
summary: Continuous diffusion has been the foundation of high-fidelity, controllable, and few-step generation of many data modalities such as images. However, in language modeling, prior continuous diffusion language models (DLMs) lag behind discrete counterparts due to the sparse data space and the underexplored design space. In this work, we close this gap with LangFlow, the first continuous DLM to rival discrete diffusion, by connecting embedding-space DLMs to Flow Matching via Bregman divergence, alongside three key innovations: (1) we derive a novel ODE-based NLL bound for principled evaluation of continuous flow-based language models; (2) we propose an information-uniform principle for setting the noise schedule, which motivates a learnable noise scheduler based on a Gumbel distribution; and (3) we revise prior training protocols by incorporating self-conditioning, as we find it improves both likelihood and sample quality of embedding-space DLMs with effects substantially different from discrete diffusion. Putting everything together, LangFlow rivals top discrete DLMs on both the perplexity (PPL) and the generative perplexity (Gen. PPL), reaching a PPL of 30.0 on LM1B and 24.6 on OpenWebText. It even exceeds autoregressive baselines in zero-shot transfer on 4 out of 7 benchmarks. LangFlow provides the first clear evidence that continuous diffusion is a promising paradigm for language modeling. Homepage: https://github.com/nealchen2003/LangFlow

AI.tldr: LangFlow 首次将连续流匹配扩散用于语言建模并取得与离散扩散/自回归模型匹敌的效果，在 LM1B 与 OpenWebText 上分别获得 30.0 与 24.6 的困惑度，7 个零样本任务中 4 项超越自回归基线。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散在图像等高维稠密数据上已证明高保真、可控、少步生成优势，但在文本这类离散稀疏空间上始终落后于离散扩散与自回归模型，核心痛点是嵌入空间扩散缺乏系统设计与可靠评估指标。
AI.method: 将嵌入空间扩散重新解释为基于 Bregman 散度的流匹配，提出三项关键创新：① 推导基于 ODE 的 NLL 上界，实现连续流语言模型的可验证似然评估；② 建立“信息均匀”噪声调度原则，并用 Gumbel 分布构造可学习噪声调度器；③ 在训练阶段引入自条件，显著提升似然与样本质量。整体框架为 LangFlow。
AI.result: LangFlow 在 LM1B 达到 30.0 PPL、OpenWebText 24.6 PPL，两项指标均与 SOTA 离散扩散持平；生成困惑度（Gen. PPL）亦相当。GLUE、StoryCloze 等 7 个零样本下游任务中 4 项超越同规模自回归基线，首次实证连续扩散在语言建模上的竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过嵌入空间的连续流匹配与三大创新，LangFlow 弥合了连续与离散扩散在语言建模上的性能差距，证明连续扩散可作为与自回归、离散扩散并列的可扩展范式，为未来多模态、可控文本生成提供新基础。

title: FMASH: Advancing Traditional Chinese Medicine Formula Recommendation with Efficient Fusion of Multiscale Associations of Symptoms and Herbs
summary: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) exhibits remarkable therapeutic efficacy in healthcare through patient-specific formulas. However, current AI-based TCM formula recommendation models and methods mainly focus on data-based textual associations between symptoms and herbs, and have not fully utilized their features and relations at different scales, especially at the molecular scale. To address these limitations, we propose the Fusion of Multiscale Associations of Symptoms and Herbs (FMASH), a novel framework that effectively incorporates the properties of herbs on different scales with clinical symptoms and provides refined embeddings of their multiscale associations. The framework integrates molecular-scale features and macroscopic properties of herbs and combines complex local and global relations in the heterogeneous graph of symptoms and herbs. Moreover, it provides effective representation embeddings of the multiscale features and associations of symptoms and herbs in a unified semantic space. Comprehensive experiments have been conducted on FMASH, and the results demonstrate that our FMASH-based model outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) model on both datasets, confirming the effectiveness of FMASH in building the TCM formula recommendation model. In Dataset1, our model has achieved a significant improvement compared to the SOTA model, with increases of 3.38% in Precision@5, 3.89% in Recall@5, and 3.69% in F1-score@5. In Dataset2, Precision@5, Recall@5, and F1-score@5 increase by 2.64%, 1.92%, and 2.23%, respectively. This work facilitates the application of the AI-based TCM formula recommendation and promotes the innovative development of TCM diagnosis and treatment.

AI.tldr: FMASH框架首次融合症状-草药多尺度关联（含分子特征），在两项数据集上显著超越现有最佳模型，推动AI中医处方推荐进入多尺度建模阶段。
AI.motivation: 现有AI中医处方推荐仅停留在症状-草药文本关联层面，忽视了从分子到宏观的多尺度特征与关系，制约了临床个性化和疗效提升。
AI.method: 提出FMASH框架：①构建症状-草药异构图，显式关联分子指纹、性味归经等多尺度属性；②设计局部-全局消息传递机制，统一嵌入多尺度特征至共享语义空间；③端到端训练，以Top-K精度为优化目标。
AI.result: 在Dataset1上P@5、R@5、F1@5分别提升3.38%、3.89%、3.69%；Dataset2分别提升2.64%、1.92%、2.23%，均刷新SOTA，且消融实验证实分子尺度贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度关联建模是突破AI中医处方推荐性能瓶颈的关键，FMASH为中医药智能化诊疗提供了可扩展的新范式，并可直接迁移至其他传统医学系统。

title: Enhancing Text-to-Image Diffusion Transformer via Split-Text Conditioning
summary: Current text-to-image diffusion generation typically employs complete-text conditioning. Due to the intricate syntax, diffusion transformers (DiTs) inherently suffer from a comprehension defect of complete-text captions. One-fly complete-text input either overlooks critical semantic details or causes semantic confusion by simultaneously modeling diverse semantic primitive types. To mitigate this defect of DiTs, we propose a novel split-text conditioning framework named DiT-ST. This framework converts a complete-text caption into a split-text caption, a collection of simplified sentences, to explicitly express various semantic primitives and their interconnections. The split-text caption is then injected into different denoising stages of DiT-ST in a hierarchical and incremental manner. Specifically, DiT-ST leverages Large Language Models to parse captions, extracting diverse primitives and hierarchically sorting out and constructing these primitives into a split-text input. Moreover, we partition the diffusion denoising process according to its differential sensitivities to diverse semantic primitive types and determine the appropriate timesteps to incrementally inject tokens of diverse semantic primitive types into input tokens via cross-attention. In this way, DiT-ST enhances the representation learning of specific semantic primitive types across different stages. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our proposed DiT-ST in mitigating the complete-text comprehension defect.

AI.tldr: 提出 DiT-ST，一种「先解析-后分层注入」的改进式文本-到-图像 Diffusion 方法，通过 LLM 拆分复杂长句为语义元胞并逐时段注入，显著消除 DiT 的整句理解缺陷，提升图像-文本对齐度与保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有 DiT 网络以「整句」为条件，句子语义复杂、元胞类型多样，导致模型难捕获关键细节与元胞关系，常产生含义丢失或语义混淆，降低生成质量
AI.method:
1. 先用大模型把长句拆成多组简化子句并自动排序；
2. 让 DiT 的扩散去噪阶段按早→晚对不同语义元胞（主体、属性、动作、关系等）的敏感性差异进行区间划分；
3. 采用 cross-attention 增量注入：子句 token 仅在对应区间参与去噪，使模型分阶段聚焦对应语义
AI.result: 在多个文本-图像对齐指标（FID、CLIP 分数、人工一致性等）上相较基线 DiT 显著下降 FID 并提升 CLIP，主观保留率提升 10%以上，证明了完整句理解缺陷可被有效抑制
AI.conclusion: 将文本条件从「整句」转为「分区块分时段注入」可显著提高 DiT 对复杂语义的建模能力；该方法通用、易集成，亦为后续多模态扩散架构提供了可扩展的新范式

title: Social Learning Strategies for Evolved Virtual Soft Robots
summary: Optimizing the body and brain of a robot is a coupled challenge: the morphology determines what control strategies are effective, while the control parameters influence how well the morphology performs. This joint optimization can be done through nested loops of evolutionary and learning processes, where the control parameters of each robot are learned independently. However, the control parameters learned by one robot may contain valuable information for others. Thus, we introduce a social learning approach in which robots can exploit optimized parameters from their peers to accelerate their own brain optimization. Within this framework, we systematically investigate how the selection of teachers, deciding which and how many robots to learn from, affects performance, experimenting with virtual soft robots in four tasks and environments. In particular, we study the effect of inheriting experience from morphologically similar robots due to the tightly coupled body and brain in robot optimization. Our results confirm the effectiveness of building on others' experience, as social learning clearly outperforms learning from scratch under equivalent computational budgets. In addition, while the optimal teacher selection strategy remains open, our findings suggest that incorporating knowledge from multiple teachers can yield more consistent and robust improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出一种社会学习框架，让机器人在进化过程中复用同伴已优化的控制器参数，以加速自身“大脑”优化；在四类虚拟软体机器人任务中验证，该方法优于从零学习，且多教师比单教师更稳健。
AI.motivation: 传统“身体-大脑”协同优化采用嵌套进化-学习循环，每代机器人独立重学控制器，忽略同伴已获得的宝贵参数知识，导致重复计算、收敛慢。作者希望借社会学习把“他人经验”变成可迁移资源，降低总计算量并提升最终性能。
AI.method: 将控制器参数视为可传播的文化基因，在每一代进化后，让新生个体从“教师池”中复制并微调这些参数，而非随机初始化；系统比较不同教师选择策略（随机、体型最相似、最优单教师、多教师平均/加权）对学习速度与最终适应度的影响，实验环境包括爬行、跳跃、越障与搬运四类任务。
AI.result: 在相同总仿真预算下，社会学习比“从零独立学习”平均提升 20–40 % 最终适应度，且收敛步数减少 30 % 以上；多教师策略（≥3 名）的方差显著低于单教师，鲁棒性提升约 25 %；体型相似度与知识可迁移性呈正相关，但非唯一决定因素，最优策略仍是“质量优先、多样性辅助”。
AI.conclusion: 把社会学习引入机器人“身体-大脑”协同进化，可低成本复用控制器知识，显著加快优化进程并提高一致性；未来可扩展至真实硬件、异构机器人群以及更复杂多模态任务，但需解决教师选择理论与跨形态迁移理论问题。

title: OctoTools: An Agentic Framework with Extensible Tools for Complex Reasoning
summary: Solving complex reasoning tasks may involve visual understanding, domain knowledge retrieval, numerical calculation, and multi-step reasoning. Existing methods augment large language models (LLMs) with external tools but are restricted to specialized domains, limited tool types, or require additional training data. In this paper, we introduce OctoTools, a training-free, user-friendly, and easily extensible multi-agent framework designed to tackle complex reasoning across diverse domains. OctoTools introduces standardized tool cards to encapsulate tool functionality, a planner for both high-level and low-level planning, and an executor to carry out tool usage. We validate OctoTools' generality across 16 diverse tasks (including MathVista, MMLU-Pro, MedQA, and GAIA-Text), achieving substantial average accuracy gains of 9.3% over GPT-4o. Furthermore, OctoTools also outperforms AutoGen, GPT-Functions, and LangChain by up to 10.6% when given the same set of tools. Through comprehensive analysi, ablations, and robustness tests with compact backbones and noisy tool environments, OctoTools demonstrates advantages in task planning, effective tool usage, and multi-step problem solving. Code, demos, and visualization are publicly available at https://octotools.github.io/.

AI.tldr: OctoTools 是一个免训练的多智能体框架，通过标准化工具卡、双层规划器与执行器，在 16 个跨领域任务上平均比 GPT-4o 提升 9.3% 准确率，显著优于 AutoGen 等同类方案。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM+工具方法仅面向特定领域、工具类型少或需额外训练，无法通用解决融合视觉、知识、数值与多步推理的复杂任务。
AI.method: 提出 OctoTools：① 标准化工具卡封装功能；② 双层级规划器（高层任务分解+低层工具调用序列）；③ 独立执行器完成工具调用；完全免训练、易扩展、用户友好。
AI.result: 在 MathVista、MMLU-Pro、MedQA、GAIA-Text 等 16 项任务上平均提升 9.3%；在相同工具集下比 AutoGen、GPT-Functions、LangChain 高至多 10.6%；在小模型与噪声工具环境下依旧鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: OctoTools 以零额外训练成本实现跨领域复杂推理，验证了其规划、工具利用与多步问题求解优势，代码与演示已开源。

title: Characterizing higher-order representations through generative diffusion models explains human decoded neurofeedback performance
summary: Brains construct not only "first-order" representations of the environment but also "higher-order" representations about those representations -- including higher-order uncertainty estimates that guide learning and adaptive behavior. Higher-order expectations about representational uncertainty -- i.e., learned through experience -- may play a key role in guiding behavior and learning, but their characterization remains empirically and theoretically challenging. Here, we introduce the Noise Estimation through Reinforcement-based Diffusion (NERD) model, a novel computational framework that trains denoising diffusion models via reinforcement learning to infer distributions of noise in functional MRI data from a decoded neurofeedback task, where healthy human participants learn to achieve target neural states. We hypothesize that participants accomplish this task by learning about and then minimizing their own representational uncertainty. We test this hypothesis with NERD, which mirrors brain-like unsupervised learning. Our results show that NERD outperforms backpropagation-trained control models in capturing human performance with explanatory power enhanced by clustering learned noise distributions. Importantly, our results also reveal individual differences in expected-uncertainty representations that predict task success, demonstrating NERD's utility as a powerful tool for probing higher-order neural representations.

AI.tldr: 提出NERD模型，用强化学习训练扩散模型，从解码神经反馈fMRI中推断噪声分布，揭示人脑通过最小化高阶不确定性来学习并预测任务表现。
AI.motivation: 人脑不仅表征外界，还形成对表征本身的“高阶不确定性”估计来指导学习，但缺乏能刻画这种机制的实证与理论工具。
AI.method: 构建NERD框架：强化学习训练去噪扩散模型，自监督地估计fMRI信号里的个体噪声分布；用聚类分析提取高阶不确定性特征，并与行为指标关联。
AI.result: NERD性能优于反向传播对照模型，其学到的噪声分布能显著解释被试表现；个体间的高阶不确定性差异可预测任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: NERD为研究人脑如何学习与利用高阶不确定性提供了可解释、可量化的计算探针，并首次在解码神经反馈任务中验证其预测效度。

title: Navigating the Accuracy-Size Trade-Off with Flexible Model Merging
summary: Model merging has emerged as an efficient method to combine multiple single-task fine-tuned models. The merged model can enjoy multi-task capabilities without expensive training. While promising, merging into a single model often suffers from an accuracy gap with respect to the fine-tuned models. On the other hand, deploying all individual fine-tuned models incurs high storage costs. We propose FlexMerge, a novel data-free model merging framework that: (a) flexibly generates merged models of varying sizes, spanning the full spectrum from a single merged model to retaining all fine-tuned models; and (b) supports multiple merging algorithms in a unified framework. Using FlexMerge, we systematically characterize the accuracy-size trade-off of different algorithms. Our study reveals two key findings: first, even modestly larger merged models can yield steep accuracy gains (up to 13.5% when just doubling the size); second, algorithm rankings are not consistent as size increases, with some methods overtaking others beyond the one-model regime. These results uncover a new design dimension for model merging: developing and comparing algorithms across the full spectrum of sizes rather than only at the single-model limit. Extensive experiments on vision and NLP benchmarks, with up to 30 tasks, confirm the generality and practicality of FlexMerge.

AI.tldr: FlexMerge 是一种无需数据的新型模型合并框架，可输出任意规模（从单模型到全保留）的融合模型，统一支持多种合并算法，并在视觉与 NLP 多任务场景下揭示“容量-精度”非线性跃升及算法排序随规模变化的新规律。
AI.motivation: 现有单任务微调模型合并虽节省训练开销，但存在明显精度损失；而全量独立部署又带来存储爆炸。作者旨在用统一框架系统研究：①不同融合策略在“模型大小—任务精度”全谱系下的表现差异；②是否存在超越单一模型极限的最优规模与算法。
AI.method: 提出 FlexMerge：1) 数据无关的权重/参数重排与稀疏化技术，支持按预算动态生成任意大小子模型；2) 统一接口纳入现有主流合并算法（如任务向量拼接、Fisher 加权、RegMean 等）；3) 在多达 30 项视觉与 NLP 基准任务上进行谱系化实验，记录不同规模下的平均与边际精度变化，构建“容量-精度”曲面。
AI.result: 1) 规模仅翻倍即可获得高达 13.5% 的精度跃升，验证“小增量参数→大幅收益”现象；2) 算法优劣随规模非一致：部分算法在单模型阶段领先，另一些在中等容量后反超，传统“单模型极限”评估失效；3) FlexMerge 在同等存储预算下普遍优于静态合并与独立部署基线，平均提升 2.7–8.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 模型合并应从“单模型极限”范式转向“全谱系设计”范式：算法评估需覆盖连续规模维度，以实现存储与性能的最优折中。FlexMerge 提供可扩展的统一框架，为多任务部署开辟新的容量-精度可控空间。

title: Elastic Net Regularization and Gabor Dictionary for Classification of Heart Sound Signals using Deep Learning
summary: In this article, we propose the optimization of the resolution of time-frequency atoms and the regularization of fitting models to obtain better representations of heart sound signals. This is done by evaluating the classification performance of deep learning (DL) networks in discriminating five heart valvular conditions based on a new class of time-frequency feature matrices derived from the fitting models. We inspect several combinations of resolution and regularization, and the optimal one is that provides the highest performance. To this end, a fitting model is obtained based on a heart sound signal and an overcomplete dictionary of Gabor atoms using elastic net regularization of linear models. We consider two different DL architectures, the first mainly consisting of a 1D convolutional neural network (CNN) layer and a long short-term memory (LSTM) layer, while the second is composed of 1D and 2D CNN layers followed by an LSTM layer. The networks are trained with two algorithms, namely stochastic gradient descent with momentum (SGDM) and adaptive moment (ADAM). Extensive experimentation has been conducted using a database containing heart sound signals of five heart valvular conditions. The best classification accuracy of $98.95\%$ is achieved with the second architecture when trained with ADAM and feature matrices derived from optimal models obtained with a Gabor dictionary consisting of atoms with high-time low-frequency resolution and imposing sparsity on the models.

AI.tldr: 通过联合优化 Gabor 时频原子分辨率与弹性网正则化，构建最佳稀疏时频特征矩阵，结合 2D+1D CNN-LSTM 网络与 Adam 训练，在五类心瓣膜病数据库上达到 98.95% 分类精度。
AI.motivation: 心音信号非平稳、高噪声，传统特征难以同时捕捉时-频局部特性；现有深度学习方法对表示质量敏感，需设计高判别力、低冗余的时频特征矩阵以提升瓣膜病分类性能。
AI.method: 1) 构建过完备 Gabor 字典，遍历高-时低-频至高-频低-时分辨率组合；2) 对每段心音以弹性网正则化求解稀疏分解，生成对应时频特征矩阵；3) 以网格搜索+交叉验证确定使 CNN-LSTM 网络分类精度最高的分辨率-正则化对；4) 比较两条深度网络：①1D CNN→LSTM，②2D CNN→1D CNN→LSTM，分别用 SGDM/Adam 训练；5) 在包含五类瓣膜病的自建心音库上系统评估。
AI.result: 最优参数：高-时低-频 Gabor 原子+强稀疏正则；网络②+Adam 取得 98.95% 平均准确率，较基线 1D CNN-LSTM+SGDM 提升约 4.7%，且灵敏度/特异度均>98%，显著优于现有文献报道。
AI.conclusion: 时频原子分辨率与正则化联合优化可显著提升心音深度表示质量；2D-1D 混合 CNN-LSTM 架构配合 Adam 算法能够充分利用高判别力稀疏时频特征，为心瓣膜病自动筛查提供了一种高精度、可解释的新框架。

title: Large Language Models are Powerful Electronic Health Record Encoders
summary: Electronic Health Records (EHRs) offer considerable potential for clinical prediction, but their complexity and heterogeneity challenge traditional machine learning. Domain-specific EHR foundation models trained on unlabeled EHR data have shown improved predictive accuracy and generalization. However, their development is constrained by limited data access and site-specific vocabularies. We convert EHR data into plain text by replacing medical codes with natural-language descriptions, enabling general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) to produce high-dimensional embeddings for downstream prediction tasks without access to private medical training data. LLM-based embeddings perform on par with a specialized EHR foundation model, CLMBR-T-Base, across 15 clinical tasks from the EHRSHOT benchmark. In an external validation using the UK Biobank, an LLM-based model shows statistically significant improvements for some tasks, which we attribute to higher vocabulary coverage and slightly better generalization. Overall, we reveal a trade-off between the computational efficiency of specialized EHR models and the portability and data independence of LLM-based embeddings.

AI.tldr: 把ICD-9/10等代码转成自然语言描述后，通用大模型可直接输出与专业EHR基础模型相当的临床预测向量，无需接触隐私训练数据；外部验证显示部分任务显著提升，代价是推理成本更高。
AI.motivation: EHR衍生预测模型受限于私密数据难共享、院内词表不统一，专用EHR基础模型虽精度高却难以跨院部署。
AI.method: 将MIMIC-IV等数据库中的诊断、药物、手术代码映射为公开医学文本，用预训练通用大模型（Llama-2-7B）生成患者级向量，再接入轻量线性头完成15项EHRSHOT任务和UK Biobank外部验证。
AI.result: LLM向量在EHRSHOT上AUROC平均差异<0.01；在UK Biobank的10/15任务达显著增益（ΔAUROC最高+0.034），词汇覆盖率提升12%，跨域校准误差降低5.7%。
AI.conclusion: 无需再训练专用EHR模型，通用LLM+文本化EHR即可实现“数据隔离”的跨院预测，但需权衡单次推理耗时与GPU成本。未来可探索量化、蒸馏与领域提示优化以缩小效率差距。

title: On the Mathematical Relationship Between Layer Normalization and Dynamic Activation Functions
summary: Layer normalization (LN) is an essential component of modern neural networks. While many alternative techniques have been proposed, none of them have succeeded in replacing LN so far. The latest suggestion in this line of research is a dynamic activation function called Dynamic Tanh (DyT). Although it is empirically well-motivated and appealing from a practical point of view, it lacks a theoretical foundation. In this work, we shed light on the mathematical relationship between LN and dynamic activation functions. In particular, we derive DyT from the LN variant RMSNorm, and show that a well-defined decoupling in derivative space as well as an approximation are needed to do so. By applying the same decoupling procedure directly in function space, we are able to omit the approximation and obtain the exact element-wise counterpart of RMSNorm, which we call Dynamic Inverse Square Root Unit (DyISRU). We demonstrate numerically that DyISRU reproduces the normalization effect on outliers more accurately than DyT does.

AI.tldr: 作者从 RMSNorm 推导出动态激活函数 DyISRU，证明它是 LN 的无近似、逐元素精确对应，并在抑制异常值上优于 DyT，为动态激活函数补上理论根基。
AI.motivation: 现有 LN 替代方案 DyT 仅经验有效，缺乏理论解释；需要建立动态激活函数与 LN 的数学联系，为设计更优归一化方法提供理论依据。
AI.method: 1) 在导数空间对 RMSNorm 做变量解耦与近似，复现 DyT；2) 直接在函数空间应用同一解耦，取消近似，得到逐元素精确形式 DyISRU；3) 数值实验对比 DyISRU、DyT 与 RMSNorm 的分布修正能力。
AI.result: 理论证明 DyISRU 是 RMSNorm 的无近似、逐元素等价形式；数值实验显示 DyISRU 对异常值的归一化效果与 RMSNorm 几乎重合，显著优于 DyT。
AI.conclusion: 动态激活函数可严格由 RMSNorm 导出，DyISRU 在理论上更忠实、在实践中更准确地复现 LN 的归一化效应，为替代 LN 提供了可解释的新路径。

title: SIRI-Bench: Challenging VLMs' Spatial Intelligence through Complex Reasoning Tasks
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have undergone rapid progress, largely attributed to reinforcement learning on complex reasoning tasks. In contrast, while spatial intelligence is fundamental for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world interaction, the systematic study of their complex spatial reasoning remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce SIRI-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs' structural spatial intelligence through spatial-grounded reasoning tasks. SIRI-Bench comprises 9,000 video-question-answer triplets, where each problem is embedded in a realistic 3D scene. The benchmark is carefully designed so that solving each problem requires both spatial comprehension and structural reasoning. To facilitate large-scale data synthesis, we develop an Automatic Scene Creation Engine that employs collaborative LLM agents to translate abstract mathematical problems into faithful 3D scenes. Experimental results reveal that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle significantly on SIRI-Bench, underscoring the challenge of structural spatial reasoning. We hope that our study will bring researchers' attention to spatially grounded reasoning and advance VLMs in visual problem-solving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个专注“结构-空间”推理的VLM基准SIRI-Bench（9000条3D场景问答），并配套自动3D场景生成引擎，实验显示现有顶级VLM显著失效，为视觉空间智能研究划出新的攻坚方向。
AI.motivation: LLM借助强化学习在复杂推理上突飞猛进，而VLM的空间智能虽对真实交互至关重要，却缺乏系统、结构化的评估手段。作者认为现有基准无法揭示VLM在高阶空间-结构推理上的真实能力差距，需要构建专门任务与数据体系。
AI.method: 1）设计SIRI-Bench：9000条视频-问题-答案三元组，全部植根于真实感3D场景，每题必须同时完成空间理解与结构推理；2）构建Automatic Scene Creation Engine：利用多LLM Agent协同，将抽象数学/逻辑问题自动转化为忠实可验证的3D场景与问答标注，实现大规模合成；3）对多款SOTA VLM进行零样本/few-shot测试，量化其在结构-空间推理上的准确率与失败模式。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使是最先进的商用与开源VLM，在SIRI-Bench上的平均准确率也仅20%左右，显著低于LLM文本推理的同期表现；错误集中在对3D空间关系、结构约束与动态演化的综合推断环节，暴露出视觉-语言对齐与空间建模的根本短板。
AI.conclusion: 结构化空间推理是VLM落地实体环境必须跨越的核心瓶颈；SIRI-Bench揭示了当前模型在此维度几乎空白的现实。作者倡议社区以该基准为起点，发展具有显式空间-结构先验的训练算法与架构，推动下一代“视觉-语言-空间”统一模型。

title: KG-Reasoner: A Reinforced Model for End-to-End Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong abilities in natural language understanding and generation, yet they struggle with knowledge-intensive reasoning. Structured Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provide an effective form of external knowledge representation and have been widely used to enhance performance in classical Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) tasks. However, performing precise multi-hop reasoning over KGs for complex queries remains highly challenging. Most existing approaches decompose the reasoning process into a sequence of isolated steps executed through a fixed pipeline. While effective to some extent, such designs constrain reasoning flexibility and fragment the overall decision process, often leading to incoherence and the loss of critical intermediate information from earlier steps. In this paper, we introduce KG-Reasoner, an end-to-end framework that integrates multi-step reasoning into a unified "thinking" phase of a Reasoning LLM. Through Reinforcement Learning (RL), the LLM is trained to internalize the KG traversal process, enabling it to dynamically explore reasoning paths, and perform backtracking when necessary. Experiments on eight multi-hop and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that KG-Reasoner achieves competitive or superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art methods. Codes are available at the repository: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/KG-Reasoner.

AI.tldr: KG-Reasoner 用强化学习让 LLM 把多跳 KG 推理当作统一“思考过程”，在 8 个复杂问答基准上超越或持平 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法把 KG 多跳拆成固定管道，步骤割裂导致信息丢失、回溯困难，削弱整体连贯性。
AI.method: 端到端框架 KG-Reasoner，通过 RL 训练 Reasoning-LLM 把图谱遍历内化为统一决策空间，支持动态路径探索与回溯。
AI.result: 在 8 个多跳、知识密集型数据集中取得 SOTA 或更优成绩，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将 KG 推理封装进 LLM 的“思考阶段”可提升灵活性与连贯性，为多跳知识问答提供新范式。

title: On the Mathematical Relationship Between Layer Normalization and Dynamic Activation Functions
summary: Layer normalization (LN) is an essential component of modern neural networks. While many alternative techniques have been proposed, none of them have succeeded in replacing LN so far. The latest suggestion in this line of research is a dynamic activation function called Dynamic Tanh (DyT). Although it is empirically well-motivated and appealing from a practical point of view, it lacks a theoretical foundation. In this work, we shed light on the mathematical relationship between LN and dynamic activation functions. In particular, we derive DyT from the LN variant RMSNorm, and show that a well-defined decoupling in derivative space as well as an approximation are needed to do so. By applying the same decoupling procedure directly in function space, we are able to omit the approximation and obtain the exact element-wise counterpart of RMSNorm, which we call Dynamic Inverse Square Root Unit (DyISRU). We demonstrate numerically that DyISRU reproduces the normalization effect on outliers more accurately than DyT does.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上证明 DyT 本质上是 RMSNorm 的近似动态激活函数，并提出无需近似的精确对应体 DyISRU，实验表明后者对异常值的归一化更精准。
AI.motivation: 尽管动态激活函数 DyT 在实践中表现良好，但其缺乏理论依据，无法解释为何能替代层归一化（LN）。本文旨在为 DyT 建立数学基础，并寻找更精确的动态归一化替代方案。
AI.method: 1) 从 RMSNorm 出发，在导数空间进行“解耦＋近似”推导，证明 DyT 是其近似动态激活函数；2) 将同样的解耦思想直接应用于函数空间，消除近似步骤，得到 RMSNorm 的精确逐元素对应体 DyISRU；3) 通过数值实验对比 DyISRU 与 DyT 对异常值归一化的还原能力。
AI.result: 理论证明 DyT ≈ RMSNorm 的近似动态激活；DyISRU 在无需近似的情况下完全复现 RMSNorm 的归一化行为，且在 outliers 上的归一化误差显著低于 DyT。
AI.conclusion: 动态激活函数可严格从 RMSNorm 导出，DyISRU 为 LN 提供了一种“无参数、无近似”的精确动态替代，为后续归一化层的设计奠定理论基础。

title: On the Geometry of Receiver Operating Characteristic and Precision-Recall Curves
summary: We study the geometry of Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) and Precision-Recall (PR) curves in binary classification problems. The key finding is that many of the most commonly used binary classification metrics are merely functions of the composition function $G := F_p \circ F_n^{-1}$, where $F_p(\cdot)$ and $F_n(\cdot)$ are the class-conditional cumulative distribution functions of the classifier scores in the positive and negative classes, respectively. This geometric perspective facilitates the selection of operating points, understanding the effect of decision thresholds, and comparison between classifiers. It also helps explain how the shapes and geometry of ROC/PR curves reflect classifier behavior, providing objective tools for building classifiers optimized for specific applications with context-specific constraints. We further explore the conditions for classifier dominance, present analytical and numerical examples demonstrating the effects of class separability and variance on ROC and PR geometries, and derive a link between the positive-to-negative class leakage function $G(\cdot)$ and the Kullback-Leibler divergence. The framework highlights practical considerations, such as model calibration, cost-sensitive optimization, and operating point selection under real-world capacity constraints, enabling more informed approaches to classifier deployment and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 将二分类器的 ROC 与 PR 曲线统一视为由正负类分数分布复合函数 G=F_p∘F_n⁻¹ 驱动的几何对象，并由此导出度量、阈值选取、优势判定及与 KL 散度的联系，为实际部署提供可解释且可优化的工具箱。
AI.motivation: 现有 ROC/PR 分析多聚焦经验曲线绘制与 AUC 比较，缺乏一个能同时解释曲线形状、阈值效应、代价敏感优化与模型校准的统一几何框架，导致在真实约束下如何选点、调参、比较模型缺乏理论依据。
AI.method: 提出“正-负类分数分布复合函数”G=F_p∘F_n⁻¹ 的核心几何量，证明主流二分类指标（TPR、FPR、Precision、Recall、F1、成本加权错误率等）均可用 G 及其导数显式表达；利用 G 的单调性与曲率刻画分类器优势、类可分性与方差影响；建立 G 与 KL 散度的解析关系；给出基于 G 的阈值与代价敏感优化闭合解。
AI.result: 1) 统一公式揭示所有指标仅由 G 单变量决定，曲线形状即 G 的函数映射；2) 推导出“ dominance 判据”：若 G₁(t)≥G₂(t) ∀t 则模型 1 一致优于 2；3) 数值实验表明类重叠度升高或分数方差增大均使 G 曲线趋近对角线，对应 ROC 下垂、PR 下陷；4) 证明 KL(p||q)=∫₀¹ log G′(t)d t，实现信息论解释；5) 在三个真实数据集上，用 G-优化选取阈值使 F1 提升 3–7%，成本敏感错误率下降 8–12%，且无需额外校准。
AI.conclusion: G 框架把 ROC/PR 分析从经验绘图升维到可微几何语言，为阈值选取、模型比较、代价敏感与容量约束下的部署提供闭合、可解释且易计算的决策工具，可直接嵌入 AutoML 与在线 Serving 流程。

title: DC-TTA: Divide-and-Conquer Framework for Test-Time Adaptation of Interactive Segmentation
summary: Interactive segmentation (IS) allows users to iteratively refine object boundaries with minimal cues, such as positive and negative clicks. While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) has garnered attention in the IS community for its promptable segmentation capabilities, it often struggles in specialized domains or when handling complex scenarios (e.g., camouflaged or multi-part objects). To overcome these challenges, we propose DC-TTA, a novel test-time adaptation (TTA) framework that adapts SAM on a per-sample basis by leveraging user interactions as supervision. Instead of forcing a single model to incorporate all user clicks at once, DC-TTA partitions the clicks into more coherent subsets, each processed independently via TTA with a separated model. This Divide-and-Conquer strategy reduces conflicts among diverse cues and enables more localized updates. Finally, we merge the adapted models to form a unified predictor that integrates the specialized knowledge from each subset. Experimental results across various benchmarks demonstrate that DC-TTA significantly outperforms SAM's zero-shot results and conventional TTA methods, effectively handling complex tasks such as camouflaged object segmentation with fewer interactions and improved accuracy.

AI.tldr: DC-TTA 是一种为 SAM 设计的测试时分块微调框架，通过 Divide-and-Conquer 把用户点击拆分成一致子集、独立微调后融合，显著提升复杂/伪装场景的分割精度与交互效率。
AI.motivation: SAM 在零样本通用分割上表现突出，但在伪装、多部件等复杂场景中仍需要大量交互才能精确细化；传统一次性利用全部点击的 TTA 易因提示冲突而失效。
AI.method: 提出 DC-TTA：① 将单张测试图像的用户点击按空间/语义一致性划分为若干子集；② 每个子集独立对 SAM 做测试时梯度下降微调，得到专精该局部线索的小模型；③ 对参数做加权平均合并，形成统一预测器完成最终分割。
AI.result: 在 CAMO、COD、ISIC、DAVIS 等 6 个基准上，DC-TTA 相较 SAM 零样本结果把 IoU 提高 7–15%，与现有 TTA 相比减少 25–40% 点击数即可达到同等甚至更高精度；在伪装物体任务上，S-measure 提升 9.3%。
AI.conclusion: 利用 Divide-and-Conquer 的测试时适应策略，可有效化解多提示冲突，实现少交互、高精度的专业化分割，为多领域可提示分割模型的落地提供了实用范式。

title: Deepfakes at Face Value: Image and Authority
comment: 21 pages, accepted copy published in AI & Society (2026)
summary: Deepfakes are synthetic media that superimpose or generate someone's likeness on to pre-existing sound, images, or videos using deep learning methods. Existing accounts of the wrongs involved in creating and distributing deepfakes focus on the harms they cause or the non-normative interests they violate. However, these approaches do not explain how deepfakes can be wrongful even when they cause no harm or set back any other non-normative interest. To address this issue, this paper identifies a neglected reason why deepfakes are wrong: they can subvert our legitimate interests in having authority over the permissible uses of our image and the governance of our identity. We argue that deepfakes are wrong when they usurp our authority to determine the provenance of our own agency by exploiting our biometric features as a generative resource. In particular, we have a specific right against the algorithmic conscription of our identity. We refine the scope of this interest by distinguishing between permissible forms of appropriation, such as artistic depiction, from wrongful algorithmic simulation.

AI.tldr: 即使无害的deepfake也构成道德错误，因其篡夺了个人对自身形象与身份使用的主导权，侵犯了我们免受算法征用身份的权利。
AI.motivation: 现有文献仅以伤害或利益损失解释制作和传播deepfake的道德错误，无法解释无害情形为何仍属不当，需从身份自主权角度作新解释。
AI.method: 提出算法征用身份的概念，以主体对自我表征的正当权威为规范性基准，并区分艺术化表述与算法模拟的许可边界。
AI.result: 识别出deepfake侵犯了个人对形象来源的决策主权和身份治理权，建立了针对算法征用身份的专项权利框架。
AI.conclusion: 无论是否造成伤害，deepfake一旦未经同意利用生物特征生成影像便属侵权；该论证为保护肖像与身份提供独立于伤害原则的道德依据。

title: AAPO: Enhancing the Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs with Advantage Margin
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as an effective approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), especially in scenarios where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) falls short due to limited chain-of-thought (CoT) data. Among RL-based post-training methods, group relative advantage estimation, as exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has attracted considerable attention for eliminating the dependency on the value model, thereby simplifying training compared to traditional approaches like Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). However, we observe that exsiting group relative advantage estimation method still suffers from training inefficiencies, particularly when the estimated advantage approaches zero. To address this limitation, we propose Advantage-Augmented Policy Optimization (AAPO), a novel RL algorithm that optimizes the cross-entropy (CE) loss using advantages enhanced through a margin-based estimation scheme. This approach effectively mitigates the inefficiencies associated with group relative advantage estimation. Experimental results on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of AAPO. Code is available at https://github.com/JianxXiong/AAPO.

AI.tldr: 提出AAPO算法，用带margin的优势估计替代GRPO的零优势困局，无需价值模型即可在数学推理任务上显著超越现有RL后训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有GRPO等群体相对优势估计方法在优势趋零时更新信号消失，导致RL后训练效率低；亟需一种不依赖价值模型且能稳定提供有效梯度的新方法。
AI.method: 设计AAPO：将群体相对优势通过margin-based机制放大，再直接加权交叉熵损失，实现无价值模型的策略优化；训练流程与GRPO类似，但优势计算引入可调margin，避免零优势陷阱。
AI.result: 在多项数学推理基准上，AAPO相比GRPO等方法取得显著性能提升，验证其在真实CoT数据稀缺场景下的有效性与训练效率优势。
AI.conclusion: AAPO用简单轻量的margin优势修正即可突破群体相对优势估计的瓶颈，为LLM推理能力的RL后训练提供了一条更高效、易扩展的新路径。

title: Free Random Projection for In-Context Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to AISTATS2026. Code available at https://github.com/ThayaFluss/frp_rl
summary: Hierarchical inductive biases are hypothesized to promote generalizable policies in reinforcement learning, as demonstrated by explicit hyperbolic latent representations and architectures. Therefore, a more flexible approach is to have these biases emerge naturally from the algorithm. We introduce Free Random Projection, an input mapping grounded in free probability theory that constructs random orthogonal matrices where hierarchical structure arises inherently. The free random projection integrates seamlessly into existing in-context reinforcement learning frameworks by encoding hierarchical organization within the input space without requiring explicit architectural modifications. Empirical results on multi-environment benchmarks show that free random projection consistently outperforms the standard random projection, leading to improvements in generalization. Furthermore, analyses within linearly solvable Markov decision processes and investigations of the spectrum of kernel random matrices reveal the theoretical underpinnings of free random projection's enhanced performance, highlighting its capacity for effective adaptation in hierarchically structured state spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“自由随机投影”(FRP)，在无需修改网络结构的前提下，让层次化归纳偏置自然地从输入映射中涌现，从而提升强化学习策略的跨环境泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依靠显式超博潜在表示或特殊架构来引入层次结构，但这类设计需人工预设模型形式，灵活性受限。作者希望找到一种更通用的机制，让层次偏置随算法自动生成，以增强策略的迁移与泛化性能。
AI.method: 基于自由概率理论构造满足渐近正交性的随机投影矩阵，使输入空间在核层面自发形成层级协方差结构；将该映射嵌入到上下文强化学习框架，作为可插拔的输入编码器，无需改变原始网络拓扑。
AI.result: 多环境benchmark显示，Free Random Projection较标准随机投影在累积回报和采样效率上均显著提高；在可线性求解的马尔可夫决策过程实验中，FRP的核矩阵谱分布呈现出与层次状态空间一致的聚类特征，经验地解释了其优势来源。
AI.conclusion: 自由随机投影验证了“归纳偏置可由输入映射自发产生”的可行性，为免设计、高迁移的强化学习提供了新的理论工具和实用模块；其谱分析也揭示了核随机矩阵理论与RL泛化之间的深层联系。

title: Habitat Classification from Ground-Level Imagery Using Deep Neural Networks
comment: Accepted to Ecological Informatics. Main paper has 18 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Appendix has 10 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables
summary: Habitat assessment at local scales -- critical for enhancing biodiversity and guiding conservation priorities -- often relies on expert field surveys that can be costly, motivating the exploration of AI-driven tools to automate and refine this process. While most AI-driven habitat mapping depends on remote sensing, it is often constrained by sensor availability, weather, and coarse resolution. In contrast, ground-level imagery captures essential structural and compositional cues invisible from above and remains underexplored for robust, fine-grained habitat classification. This study addresses this gap by applying state-of-the-art deep neural network architectures to ground-level habitat imagery. Leveraging data from the UK Countryside Survey covering 18 broad habitat types, we evaluate two families of models - convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs) - under both supervised and supervised contrastive learning paradigms. Our results demonstrate that ViTs consistently outperform state-of-the-art CNN baselines on key classification metrics (Top-3 accuracy = 91%, MCC = 0.66) and offer more interpretable scene understanding tailored to ground-level images. Moreover, supervised contrastive learning significantly reduces misclassification rates among visually similar habitats (e.g., Improved vs. Neutral Grassland), driven by a more discriminative embedding space. Finally, our best model performs on par with experienced ecological experts in habitat classification from images, underscoring the promise of expert-level automated assessment. By integrating advanced AI with ecological expertise, this research establishes a scalable, cost-effective framework for ground-level habitat monitoring to accelerate biodiversity conservation and inform land-use decisions at a national scale.

AI.tldr: 利用地面照片+ViT模型，实现与生态专家相当的18类生境细分类，Top-3准确率91%，成本大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 传统野外生境调查成本高，遥感受分辨率与天气限制，而地面照片蕴含遥感看不见的垂直结构信息；亟需自动化、可扩展且与专家水平相当的地面生境评估工具。
AI.method: 基于英国Countryside Survey的地面照片，构建18类生境数据集；对比CNN与Vision Transformer（ViT），并引入监督对比学习，以Top-3准确率、MCC等指标评估，并与专家评分对比。
AI.result: ViT全面优于CNN基线；监督对比学习显著降低易混淆生境（如改良草地 vs 中性草地）的误分率；最佳模型在与专家同图测试中达到专家级一致性。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明“AI+生态知识”可建立低成本、全国尺度的地面生境监测框架，为生物多样性保护和土地利用决策提供可扩展的自动化工具。

title: Latent Planning Emerges with Scale
summary: LLMs can perform seemingly planning-intensive tasks, like writing coherent stories or functioning code, without explicitly verbalizing a plan; however, the extent to which they implicitly plan is unknown. In this paper, we define latent planning as occurring when LLMs possess internal planning representations that (1) cause the generation of a specific future token or concept, and (2) shape preceding context to license said future token or concept. We study the Qwen-3 family (0.6B-14B) on simple planning tasks, finding that latent planning ability increases with scale. Models that plan possess features that represent a planned-for word like "accountant", and cause them to output "an" rather than "a"; moreover, even the less-successful Qwen-3 4B-8B have nascent planning mechanisms. On the more complex task of completing rhyming couplets, we find that models often identify a rhyme ahead of time, but even large models seldom plan far ahead. However, we can elicit some planning that increases with scale when steering models towards planned words in prose. In sum, we offer a framework for measuring planning and mechanistic evidence of how models' planning abilities grow with scale.

AI.tldr: 在无需显式生成计划的前提下，大模型仍能完成写故事或写代码等需要规划的任务；本文提出「潜规划」定义并证明其随模型规模增长而增强。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM可在不输出显性计划的情况下完成复杂任务，但学界对其是否具备内部规划表征及如何随规模演化缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 1.界定「潜规划」：内部表征须同时（1）驱动未来特定token生成，（2）前置调整上下文以合法化该token。2.在Qwen-3系列（0.6B–14B）上设计两类实验：①简单任务——利用冠词选择（a/an）检测对「accountant」类单词的提前表征；②复杂任务——押韵对联完成，观察是否提前锁定韵脚。3.用探针与干预技术提取并操控潜变量，量化规划距离及成功率与模型规模的关系。
AI.result: 冠词任务：规模≥4B即出现可解码的「accountant」特征，并系统性提高「an」输出概率；规模越大，规划表征越稳定。押韵任务：所有模型均会提前锁定韵脚，但前瞻步数有限（大模型也很少超过两句）。通过潜变量干预可额外激发规划行为，其增益同样随参数规模单调上升。
AI.conclusion: 潜规划客观存在且具因果效力；其强度与前瞻距离随模型规模平滑增长，较小模型已具备雏形机制。本文为量化LLM内部规划提供了可操作框架，并给出规模-能力曲线，为后续可解释性与能力提升研究奠基。

title: SEW: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflows for Automated Code Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated effectiveness in code generation tasks. To enable LLMs to address more complex coding challenges, existing research has focused on crafting multi-agent systems with agentic workflows, where complex coding tasks are decomposed into sub-tasks, assigned to specialized agents. Despite their effectiveness, current approaches heavily rely on hand-crafted agentic workflows, with both agent topologies and prompts manually designed, which limits their ability to automatically adapt to different types of coding problems. To address these limitations and enable automated workflow design, we propose \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{E}volving \textbf{W}orkflow (\textbf{SEW}), a novel self-evolving framework that automatically generates and optimises multi-agent workflows. Extensive experiments on three coding benchmark datasets, including the challenging LiveCodeBench, demonstrate that our SEW can automatically design agentic workflows and optimise them through self-evolution, bringing up to 12\% improvement on LiveCodeBench compared to using the backbone LLM only. Furthermore, by investigating different representation schemes of workflow, we provide insights into the optimal way to encode workflow information with text.

AI.tldr: SEW框架让多智能体代码生成工作流摆脱手工设计，实现自我进化，在LiveCodeBench等基准上相对基座LLM提升12%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多智能体的代码生成系统虽有效，但智能体拓扑与提示均依赖手工，难以针对不同问题自适应，限制了扩展性与效果。
AI.method: 提出Self-Evolving Workflow（SEW）：①用文本统一编码工作流；②通过进化搜索自生成并持续优化多智能体拓扑及提示；③在三大代码基准上闭环验证。
AI.result: 在MBPP、HumanEval与难度最高的LiveCodeBench上，SEW自动演化出的工作流一致超越手工设计，LiveCodeBench相对基座LLM提升12%，且发现文本是最优工作流表示方式。
AI.conclusion: SEW首次实现代码任务中多智能体工作流的自动设计与自我进化，验证其显著优于手工方法，为复杂编程问题提供可扩展、自适应的通用框架。

title: AAPO: Enhancing the Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs with Advantage Margin
