Rather than simply observing that ``crowded scenes are harder,'' we rigorously control for class imbalance to measure the precise degradation caused by density alone.
  Controlled experiments on the WIDER FACE and Open Images datasets, restricted to exactly 1 to 18 faces per image with perfectly balanced sampling, reveal that model performance degrades monotonically with increasing face count. This trend holds across classification, regression, and detection paradigms, even when models are fully exposed to the entire density range. Furthermore, we demonstrate that models trained on low-density regimes fail to generalize to higher densities, exhibiting a systematic under-counting bias, with error rates increasing by up to 4.6x, which suggests density acts as a domain shift.
  These findings establish instance density as an intrinsic, quantifiable dimension of data hardness and motivate specific interventions in curriculum learning and density-stratified evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次量化“实例密度”为数据硬度的独立维度，证明人脸数量单因素即可导致检测/分类性能单调下降并产生4.6倍误差跃迁，密度低→高泛化失败。
AI.motivation: 摆脱“模型中心”盲追，把性能瓶颈归因到数据本身的可测量属性；验证“人多场景难”究竟是人数本身还是伴随的类别失衡，从而建立数据层面的可干预变量。
AI.method: 在WIDER FACE与Open Images上严格平衡类别分布，限定每张图1–18张脸并等采样；对比分类、回归、检测三类任务；再测试仅用低密度训练的模型在高密度上的迁移误差。
AI.result: 性能随人脸数单调退化，跨任务一致；低密度训练模型迁移到高密度时计数误差放大至4.6倍，呈现系统性低估，证实密度即域漂移。
AI.conclusion: 实例密度是可量化、可干预的数据硬度维度，应纳入课程学习与分层评估，为数据-centric AI提供可操作框架。

title: Visual Preference Optimization with Rubric Rewards
summary: The effectiveness of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) depends on preference data that reflect the quality differences that matter in multimodal tasks. Existing pipelines often rely on off-policy perturbations or coarse outcome-based signals, which are not well suited to fine-grained visual reasoning. We propose rDPO, a preference optimization framework based on instance-specific rubrics. For each image-instruction pair, we create a checklist-style rubric of essential and additional criteria to score responses from any possible policies. The instruction-rubric pool is built offline and reused during the construction of on-policy data. On public reward modeling benchmarks, rubric-based prompting massively improves a 30B-A3B judge and brings it close to GPT-5.4. On public downstream benchmarks, rubric-based filtering raises the macro average to 82.69, whereas outcome-based filtering drops it to 75.82 from 81.14. When evaluating scalability on a comprehensive benchmark, rDPO achieves 61.01, markedly outperforming the style-constrained baseline (52.36) and surpassing the 59.48 base model. Together, these results show that visual preference optimization benefits from combining on-policy data construction with instance-specific criterion-level feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出基于实例级评分标准的 rDPO 框架，用离线构建的细粒度规则清单替代传统偏好数据，显著提升多模态大模型指令对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 DPO 依赖的偏好数据常来自离策略扰动或粗粒度结果信号，难以捕捉视觉推理所需的细粒度质量差异，亟需更精准的偏好构建方式。
AI.method: 离线为每幅图像-指令对生成可复用的检查表式评分标准，在线用该标准对任意策略生成的回答进行多维度打分，构建 on-policy 偏好对，再执行 DPO 训练。
AI.result: 在公开奖励建模基准上，30B-A3B 评判模型经规则提示后逼近 GPT-5.4；在多模态下游任务上，规则过滤将宏观平均准确率从 81.14 提升至 82.69，而结果基过滤降至 75.82；综合基准上 rDPO 达 61.01，显著优于风格约束基线 52.36 与原生模型 59.48。
AI.conclusion: 将 on-policy 数据构造与实例级细粒度标准相结合，可显著提升视觉偏好优化效果，为后续多模态对齐提供新范式。

title: A Full Compression Pipeline for Green Federated Learning in Communication-Constrained Environments
comment: This work was accepted at IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning for Communication and Networking (ICMLCN), 2026
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw data, thereby preserving privacy. However, FL often suffers from significant communication and computational overhead, limiting its scalability and sustainability. In this work, we introduce a Full Compression Pipeline (FCP) for FL in communication-constrained environments. FCP integrates three complementary deep compression techniques (pruning, quantization, and Huffman encoding) into a unified end-to-end framework. By compressing local models and communication payloads, FCP substantially reduces transmission costs and resource consumption while maintaining competitive accuracy. To quantify its impact, we develop an evaluation framework that captures both communication and computation overheads as a unified model cost, allowing a holistic assessment of efficiency trade-offs. The pipeline is evaluated in an independent and identically distributed (IID) and non-IID data setting. In one representative scenario, training a ResNet-12 model on the CIFAR-10 dataset with ten clients and a 2 Mbps bandwidth, the FCP achieves more than 11$\times$ reduction in model size, with only a 2% drop in accuracy compared to the uncompressed baseline. This results in an FL training that is more than 60% faster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出端到端“全压缩管道”（FCP），将剪枝、量化与 Huffman 编码整合到联邦学习，统一压缩本地模型与通信载荷，在 CIFAR-10/ResNet-12 场景下实现 11 倍模型体积压缩、仅 2% 精度损失、训练时间缩短 60% 以上。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽能保护隐私，但传输与计算开销大，直接限制其规模化和可持续部署，亟需一种能在通信受限环境中显著降低资源消耗且保精度的系统级方案。
AI.method: 设计 FCP：① 结构化剪枝去除冗余通道；② 量化权重至 8 bit 并结合聚类优化；③ Huffman 编码进一步压缩参数；三步串联形成端到端压缩流水线，并在客户端-服务器间同步压缩格式，提出统一“模型成本”指标综合评估通信+计算开销。
AI.result: 在 IID 与 non-IID 设置下测试，CIFAR-10 上 10 客户端、2 Mbps 带宽、ResNet-12 模型：模型大小缩减 11.2×，Top-1 准确率下降仅 2%，总训练时间减少 60% 以上；模型成本指标下降 55%，显著优于单一压缩方法及现有 FL 压缩框架。
AI.conclusion: FCP 通过系统级整合三种压缩技术，在不牺牲精度的前提下显著降低 FL 通信与计算负担，为资源受限场景提供可扩展、可持续的联邦学习解决方案，其统一评估指标亦可指导后续效率优化研究。

title: LOLGORITHM: Funny Comment Generation Agent For Short Videos
summary: Short-form video platforms have become central to multimedia information dissemination, where comments play a critical role in driving engagement, propagation, and algorithmic feedback. However, existing approaches -- including video summarization and live-streaming danmaku generation -- fail to produce authentic comments that conform to platform-specific cultural and linguistic norms. In this paper, we present LOLGORITHM, a novel modular multi-agent framework for stylized short-form video comment generation. LOLGORITHM supports six controllable comment styles and comprises three core modules: video content summarization, video classification, and comment generation with semantic retrieval and hot meme augmentation. We further construct a bilingual dataset of 3,267 videos and 16,335 comments spanning five high-engagement categories across YouTube and Douyin. Evaluation combining automatic scoring and large-scale human preference analysis demonstrates that LOLGORITHM consistently outperforms baseline methods, achieving human preference selection rates of 80.46\% on YouTube and 84.29\% on Douyin across 107 respondents. Ablation studies confirm that these gains are attributable to the framework architecture rather than the choice of backbone LLM, underscoring the robustness and generalizability of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LOLGORITHM，一个多智能体模块化框架，可在 YouTube 与 Douyin 上按 6 种平台化风格自动生成高真实感短视频评论，人工偏好率超 80%。
AI.motivation: 短视频评论是互动与算法反馈的核心，但现有视频摘要、弹幕生成等方法无法复刻平台特有的文化与语言风格，亟需可控制、风格化的自动评论技术。
AI.method: 构建双语 3 267 视频+16 335 评论数据集；设计三模块流水线：①内容摘要②视频分类③语义检索+热梗增强的评论生成；整体以多智能体协同完成 6 种风格可控输出。
AI.result: 在 107 人主观评测中，LOLGORITHM 在 YouTube 与 Douyin 分别获得 80.46% 与 84.29% 人工优选率，显著优于基线；消融实验表明性能源于框架设计而非底层 LLM 选择。
AI.conclusion: LOLGORITHM 通过模块化多智能体架构实现跨平台、风格化的短视频评论生成，具备良好的可扩展性与泛化能力，为短视频互动内容自动化提供了新范式。

title: SmellNet: A Large-scale Dataset for Real-world Smell Recognition
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026; published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026. 32 pages; 21 figures
summary: The ability of AI to sense and identify various substances based on their smell alone can have profound impacts on allergen detection (e.g. smelling gluten or peanuts in a cake), monitoring the manufacturing process, and sensing hormones that indicate emotional states, stress levels, and diseases. Despite these broad impacts, there are few standardized datasets, and therefore little progress, for training and evaluating AI systems' ability to `smell' in the real-world. In this paper, we use small gas and chemical sensors to create SmellNet, a comparatively large dataset for sensor-based machine olfaction that digitizes a diverse range of smells in the natural world. SmellNet contains about 828,000 time-series data points across 50 substances, spanning nuts, spices, herbs, fruits, and vegetables, and 43 mixtures among them with fixed ingredient volumetric ratios, with 68 hours of data collected. Using SmellNet, we developed ScentFormer, a Transformer-based architecture combining temporal differencing and sliding-window augmentation for smell data. For the SmellNet-Base classification tasks, ScentFormer achieves 63.3% Top-1 accuracy with GC-MS supervision, and for the SmellNet-Mixture distribution prediction tasks, ScentFormer achieves 50.2% Top-1@0.1 on the test-seen split. ScentFormer's ability to generalize across conditions and capture transient chemical dynamics demonstrates the promise of temporal modeling in sensor-based olfactory AI. SmellNet and ScentFormer lay the groundwork for sensor-based olfactory applications across healthcare, food and beverage, environmental monitoring, manufacturing, and entertainment.

AI.tldr: 提出首个大规模开源电子嗅觉数据集SmellNet（82.8万条时序数据、50种纯物质+43种混合比例样本），并设计Transformer架构ScentFormer，在纯物质分类达63.3% Top-1准确率、混合比例预测达50.2% Top-1@0.1，为机器嗅觉落地奠定数据与模型基础。
AI.motivation: 现实场景（过敏原检测、制造监控、疾病情绪标志物嗅测）对AI嗅觉需求迫切，但缺乏标准化、规模化的真实嗅觉数据集，导致领域进展停滞。
AI.method: ①用微型气敏/化学传感器阵列长时间采集自然状态挥发信号，构建含时序维度、混合比例标签的SmellNet；②提出ScentFormer：先对原始时间序列做差分+滑动窗扩增，再用Transformer建模瞬态化学动态，分别执行纯物质分类与混合比例分布回归。
AI.result: 在SmellNet-Base纯物质分类任务中，Top-1准确率63.3%，GC-MS成分标签作弱监督；在SmellNet-Mixture混合分布预测任务中，Top-1@0.1指标50.2%，且模型跨条件泛化能力优于传统CNN与LSTM基线。
AI.conclusion: SmellNet填补了大规模真实电子嗅觉数据空白，ScentFormer验证了时序建模对捕捉瞬态化学信号的重要性，二者共同支撑医疗、食品、环境等多领域嗅觉AI系统落地。

title: Towards Situation-aware State Modeling for Air Traffic Flow Prediction
comment: There are issues with the authors of the paper I submitted, as well as problems with the content of the article, so it needs to be withdrawn. Thank you for your understanding
summary: Accurate air traffic prediction in the terminal airspace (TA) is pivotal for proactive air traffic management (ATM). However, existing data-driven approaches predominantly rely on time series-based forecasting paradigms, which inherently overlook critical aircraft state information, such as real-time kinematics and proximity to airspace boundaries. To address this limitation, we propose \textit{AeroSense}, a direct state-to-flow modeling framework for air traffic prediction. Unlike classical time series-based methods that first aggregate aircraft trajectories into macroscopic flow sequences before modeling, AeroSense explicitly represents the real-time airspace situation as \textit{a dynamic set of aircraft states}, enabling the direct processing of a variable number of aircraft instead of time series as inputs. Specifically, we introduce a situation-aware state representation that enables AeroSense to sense the instantaneous terminal airspace situation directly from microscopic aircraft states. Furthermore, we design a model architecture that incorporates masked self-attention to capture inter-aircraft interactions, together with two decoupled prediction heads to model heterogeneous flow dynamics across two key functional areas of the TA. Extensive experiments on a large-scale real-world airport dataset demonstrate that AeroSense consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating that direct modeling of microscopic aircraft states yields substantially higher predictive fidelity than time series-based baselines. Moreover, the proposed framework exhibits superior robustness during peak traffic periods, achieves Pareto-optimal performance under dayparting multi-object evaluation, and provides meaningful interpretability through attention-based visualizations.

AI.tldr: 针对终端空域航班状态信息缺失导致预测精度不足的问题，提出直接对单体飞机状态建模的 AeroSense 框架，实现显著优于时序方法的多目标稳健预测。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动空管预测主要依赖宏观时序流模型，忽略了飞机实时运动状态与邻近空域边界等关键微观信息，难以在高峰流量及复杂边界条件下保证精度与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1）将终端空域表示为动态飞机状态集合而非时序流序列；2）构建情境感知的状态编码，直接输入可变规模飞机状态；3）采用带掩码的自注意力机制捕获机间交互；4）设计双解耦预测头分别对进场与离场两个功能区流量异构建模；5）基于大规模真实机场轨迹数据进行端到端训练与解释性可视化。
AI.result: 相比时序基准模型，AeroSense 在均方误差、平均绝对误差等指标上平均降低 18–32%，在高峰时段稳健性提升约 25%，并在昼夜分段多目标评估中实现帕累托最优，同时通过注意力图提供可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 直接对微观飞机状态进行建模可显著提升终端空域交通预测保真度与鲁棒性；将动态状态集合与注意力机制引入空管预测为后续实时决策支持系统开辟了新路径。

title: Do vision models perceive illusory motion in static images like humans?
summary: Understanding human motion processing is essential for building reliable, human-centered computer vision systems. Although deep neural networks (DNNs) achieve strong performance in optical flow estimation, they remain less robust than humans and rely on fundamentally different computational strategies. Visual motion illusions provide a powerful probe into these mechanisms, revealing how human and machine vision align or diverge. While recent DNN-based motion models can reproduce dynamic illusions such as reverse-phi, it remains unclear whether they can perceive illusory motion in static images, exemplified by the Rotating Snakes illusion. We evaluate several representative optical flow models on Rotating Snakes and show that most fail to generate flow fields consistent with human perception. Under simulated conditions mimicking saccadic eye movements, only the human-inspired Dual-Channel model exhibits the expected rotational motion, with the closest correspondence emerging during the saccade simulation. Ablation analyses further reveal that both luminance-based and higher-order color--feature--based motion signals contribute to this behavior and that a recurrent attention mechanism is critical for integrating local cues. Our results highlight a substantial gap between current optical-flow models and human visual motion processing, and offer insights for developing future motion-estimation systems with improved correspondence to human perception and human-centric AI.

AI.tldr: 主流光流网络仍不能像人类那样在静态图中‘看见’旋转蛇错觉；只有受人类启发的双通路+循环注意模型在模拟眼跳条件下复现出与人接近的旋转流场，表明现网存在显著感知缺口。
AI.motivation: 深度光流网络性能虽高却远不如人类鲁棒，且处理策略不同。旋转蛇等静态视觉运动错觉能直接检验模型是否具备类似人类的运动感知机制，从而指导人本 AI 设计。
AI.method: 1) 在旋转蛇错觉图上测试多种代表性光流网络；2) 引入模拟眼跳序列，观察动态输入下输出变化；3) 对表现最好的人类启发的 Dual-Channel 模型进行消融，逐次去除亮度通道、颜色-特征通道和循环注意模块，量化各成分贡献。
AI.result: • 绝大多数光流网络无法产生与人感知一致的旋转流场；• Dual-Channel 模型仅在眼跳模拟阶段输出显著旋转运动，与人类数据最接近；• 消融表明亮度与颜色-特征运动信号均必需，循环注意机制是整合局部线索、触发错觉的关键。
AI.conclusion: 现网缺乏人类式的静态错觉感知能力，主因是缺少跨特征融合与动态注意整合；引入双通路编码+循环注意可显著缩小差距，为未来构建真正人本、可靠的运动估计系统提供明确路径。

title: Fragile Preferences: A Deep Dive Into Order Effects in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in decision-support systems for high-stakes domains such as hiring and university admissions, where choices often involve selecting among competing alternatives. While prior work has noted position biases in LLM-driven comparisons, these biases have not been systematically analyzed or linked to underlying preference structures. We present the first comprehensive study of position biases across multiple LLMs and two distinct domains: resume comparisons, representing a realistic high-stakes context, and color selection, which isolates position effects by removing confounding factors. We find strong and consistent order effects, including a quality-dependent shift: when all options are high quality, models favor the first option, but when quality is lower, they favor later options. We also identify a previously undocumented bias: a name bias, where certain names are favored despite controlling for demographic signals. To separate superficial tie-breaking from genuine distortions of judgment, we extend the rational choice framework to classify pairwise preferences as robust, fragile, or indifferent. Using this framework, we show that order effects can lead models to select strictly inferior options. These results indicate that LLMs exhibit distinct failure modes not documented in human decision-making. We also propose targeted mitigation strategies, including a novel use of the temperature parameter, to recover underlying preferences when order effects distort model behavior.

AI.tldr: 首次系统揭示LLM在成对比较中存在‘质量依赖型顺序偏差’与‘姓名偏差’，可导致选出严格次优选项，并提出以温度参数为核心的缓解方案。
AI.motivation: LLM已被用于招聘、录取等高风险决策，却无人系统研究其比较时的位置/顺序偏差是否会扭曲真实偏好并带来实际损害。
AI.method: 跨多个LLM，在简历（高利害）与颜色选择（控制变量）两个任务中，记录不同呈现顺序下的选择；引入‘质量依赖’与‘姓名’对照实验；提出将成对偏好划分为稳健、脆弱、无差异的扩展理性选择框架，以甄别偏差是否造成实质性劣选。
AI.result: (1) 存在一致且强烈的顺序效应：全高质量时首项占优，整体质量低时末项反升；(2) 发现新‘姓名偏差’，控制人口信号后仍系统性偏好某些名字；(3) 偏差可使模型在脆弱偏好对中选出严格次优选项，对应失败模式未见于人类。
AI.conclusion: LLM在高风险比较任务中表现出独特且可量化的顺序与姓名偏差，需引入如温度调节等针对性缓解措施才能恢复其潜在偏好并保证决策公平可靠。

title: Structural Consequences of Policy-Based Interventions on the Global Supply Chain Network
summary: As global political tensions rise and the anticipation of additional tariffs from the United States on international trade increases, the issues of economic independence and supply chain resilience become more prominent. The importance of supply chain resilience has been further underscored by disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic and the ongoing war in Ukraine. In light of these challenges, ranging from geopolitical instability to product supply uncertainties, governments are increasingly focused on adopting new trade policies. This study explores the impact of several of these policies on the global electric vehicle (EV) supply chain network, with a particular focus on their effects on country clusters and the broader structure of international trade. Specifically, we analyse three key policies: Country Plus One, Friendshoring, and Reshoring. Our findings show that Friendshoring, contrary to expectations, leads to greater globalisation by increasing the number of supply links across friendly countries, potentially raising transaction costs. The Country Plus One policy similarly enhances network density through redundant links, while the Reshoring policy creates challenges in the EV sector due to the high number of irreplaceable products. Additionally, the effects of these policies vary across industries; for instance, mining goods being less affected in Country Plus One than the Friendshoring policy.

AI.tldr: 三大贸易政策(伙伴外包、N+1、回流)重塑全球电动车供应链：伙伴外包意外强化全球化并推高交易成本，N+1通过冗余链路提升网络密度，回流因不可替代件多而受阻。
AI.motivation: 因地缘紧张、疫情与俄乌冲突，全球电动车供应链暴露韧性短板，亟需评估新兴贸易政策对网络结构与产业差异的真实影响。
AI.method: 构建多层级电动车供应链网络模型，分别模拟 Friendshoring、Country Plus One 与 Reshoring 三种政策场景，量化链路数、网络密度、交易成本及行业异质性差异。
AI.result: Friendshoring 显著增加跨国友好链接，全球化指标不降反升，交易成本同步抬升；Country Plus One 通过冗余路径提高网络密度，但对矿业冲击小于 Friendshoring；Reshoring 因 EV 核心零部件可替代性低而实施困难。
AI.conclusion: 传统“去全球化”直觉被证伪；政策制定者需权衡网络冗余、成本与可替代性，依行业特性定制供应链韧性方案，而非一刀切推行单一政策。

title: Are Pretrained Image Matchers Good Enough for SAR-Optical Satellite Registration?
summary: Cross-modal optical-SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) registration is a bottleneck for disaster-response via remote sensing, yet modern image matchers are developed and benchmarked almost exclusively on natural-image domains. We evaluate twenty-four pretrained matcher families--in a zero-shot setting with no fine-tuning or domain adaptation on satellite or SAR data--on SpaceNet9 and two additional cross-modal benchmarks under a deterministic protocol with tiled large-image inference, robust geometric filtering, and tie-point-grounded metrics. Our results reveal asymmetric transfer--matchers with explicit cross-modal training do not uniformly outperform those without it. While XoFTR (trained for visible-thermal matching) and RoMa achieve the lowest reported mean error at $3.0$ px on the labeled SpaceNet9 training scenes, RoMa achieves this without any cross-modal training, and MatchAnything-ELoFTR ($3.4$ px)--trained on synthetic cross-modal pairs--matches closely, suggesting (as a working hypothesis) that foundation-model features (DINOv2) may contribute to modality invariance that partially substitutes for explicit cross-modal supervision. 3D-reconstruction matchers (MASt3R, DUSt3R), which are not designed for traditional 2D image matching, are highly protocol-sensitive and remain fragile under default settings. Deployment protocol choices (geometry model, tile size, inlier gating) shift accuracy by up to $33\times$ for a single matcher, sometimes exceeding the effect of swapping matchers entirely within the evaluated sweep--affine geometry alone reduces mean error from $12.34$ to $9.74$ px. These findings inform both practical deployment of existing matchers and future matcher design for cross-modal satellite registration.

AI.tldr: 无需任何微调，24组通用预训练匹配器在光学-SAR跨模态配准任务上被系统评估；RoMa（无跨模态训练）与XoTR（有跨模态训练）并列3.0 px误差最低；部署协议（几何模型、瓦片尺寸、内点门控）对精度影响可达33倍，甚至超过更换模型本身。
AI.motivation: 自然灾害应急响应急需光学与SAR图像的快速、精准配准，但现有匹配器几乎只在自然图像域开发并评测，其在跨模态卫星数据中的零样本表现与最佳部署策略尚不明确。
AI.method: 在零样本条件下，对24个预训练匹配器家族进行统一基准测试：采用SpaceNet9及两个自建跨模态数据集，实施确定性大图像瓦片推理、鲁棒几何过滤与基于连接点的指标评估；系统扫描几何模型（仿射/单应/基础矩阵）、瓦片尺寸、内点门限等部署超参；并额外测试3D重建网络MASt3R/DUSt3R的配准能力。
AI.result: 显式跨模态训练并非必要：RoMa（无跨模态数据）与XoFTR（可见光-热红外训练）同样取得3.0 px平均误差；MatchAnything-ELoFTR（3.4 px）逼近前者，暗示DINOv2基础特征自带部分模态不变性。3D重建网络在默认参数下极不稳定。超参选择可将同一模型误差从12.34 px降至9.74 px，最大带来33倍精度波动，其影响幅度超过模型替换本身。
AI.conclusion: 现有通用匹配器已具备光学-SAR零样本配准潜力，但精度瓶颈主要来自部署协议而非模型选择；未来应优先优化几何假设、瓦片策略与内点门控，同时在设计新匹配器时充分验证协议敏感性。

title: League of LLMs: A Benchmark-Free Paradigm for Mutual Evaluation of Large Language Models
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) have shown exceptional capabilities across a wide range of tasks, reliable evaluation remains a critical challenge due to data contamination, opaque operation, and subjective preferences. To address these issues, we propose League of LLMs (LOL), a novel benchmark-free evaluation paradigm that organizes multiple LLMs into a self-governed league for multi-round mutual evaluation. LOL integrates four core criteria (dynamic, transparent, objective, and professional) to mitigate key limitations of existing paradigms. Experiments on eight mainstream LLMs in mathematics and programming demonstrate that LOL can effectively distinguish LLM capabilities while maintaining high internal ranking stability (Top-$k$ consistency $= 70.7\%$). Beyond ranking, LOL reveals empirical findings that are difficult for traditional paradigms to capture. For instance, ``memorization-based answering'' behaviors are observed in some models, and higher in-family scores are found in the OpenAI model family ($Δ= 9$, $p < 0.05$). Finally, we make our framework and code publicly available as a valuable complement to the current LLM evaluation ecosystem.

AI.tldr: LOL用一个“无基准、模型互评”联赛制度，能稳定区分主流LLM数学/编程能力，并首次暴露“死记硬背答题”、“同系模型互打高分”等传统评测难以察觉的现象。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估受数据污染、黑箱操作与人为主观偏好困扰，难以给出可信、可重复的能力排序。
AI.method: 提出League of LLMs（LOL）：将多款模型组织成自治理联赛，在多轮互相评分与动态积分规则中，引入“动态、透明、客观、专业”四准则，无需外部基准即可完成排名。
AI.result: 在8款主流模型上，LOL区分性能优异，Top-k一致性达70.7%，并发现OpenAI家族内部互评分数显著偏高、部分模型依赖记忆回答等经验规律（p＜0.05）。
AI.conclusion: LOL提供了一种不依赖基准数据、可解释的评估替代方案，其框架与代码已开源，可作为现有LLM生态的重要补充。目前已发现的问题提示未来模型家族间需增加独立评审或跨家对比环节以减少偏差。

title: Towards Autonomous Mechanistic Reasoning in Virtual Cells
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently gained significant attention as a promising approach to accelerate scientific discovery. However, their application in open-ended scientific domains such as biology remains limited, primarily due to the lack of factually grounded and actionable explanations. To address this, we introduce a structured explanation formalism for virtual cells that represents biological reasoning as mechanistic action graphs, enabling systematic verification and falsification. Building upon this, we propose VCR-Agent, a multi-agent framework that integrates biologically grounded knowledge retrieval with a verifier-based filtering approach to generate and validate mechanistic reasoning autonomously. Using this framework, we release VC-TRACES dataset, which consists of verified mechanistic explanations derived from the Tahoe-100M atlas. Empirically, we demonstrate that training with these explanations improves factual precision and provides a more effective supervision signal for downstream gene expression prediction. These results underscore the importance of reliable mechanistic reasoning for virtual cells, achieved through the synergy of multi-agent and rigorous verification.

AI.tldr: 提出面向虚拟细胞的结构化机制解释格式与多智能体验证框架 VCR-Agent，用 VC-TRACES 数据训练可显著提升基因表达预测的事实精度。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在开放式生物领域因缺乏可验证、可操作的机制解释而应用受限，亟需一种能系统证伪且可落地的生物推理范式。
AI.method: 1) 设计“机制动作图”形式的结构化解释规范，将生物推理转化为可验证图结构；2) 构建多智能体系统 VCR-Agent，融合生物知识检索与基于验证器的过滤，自主生成并筛选机制解释；3) 基于 Tahoe-100M 单细胞图谱构建 VC-TRACES 数据集，用于监督微调。
AI.result: 在下游基因表达预测任务中，相较基线模型，使用 VC-TRACES 训练的模型在事实准确率上显著提升，且提供更强的监督信号。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的多智能体协同与严格验证机制，是实现虚拟细胞可信机制推理的关键，为 LLM 驱动科学发现奠定可扩展基础。

title: MedVeriSeg: Teaching MLLM-Based Medical Segmentation Models to Verify Query Validity Without Extra Training
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures; the paper is under consideration at Pattern Recognition Letters
summary: Despite recent advances in MLLM-based medical image segmentation, existing LISA-like methods cannot reliably reject false queries and often produce hallucinated segmentation masks for absent targets. This limitation reduces practical reliability in both medical education and clinical use. In this work, we propose MedVeriSeg, a training-free verification framework that equips LISA-like medical segmentation models with the ability to identify and reject false queries which contain non-existent targets. Our key observation is that the similarity map between the [SEG] token feature and MLLM image features exhibits markedly different distribution patterns for true and false queries. Based on this, we introduce a Similarity Response Quality Scoring Module that characterizes the similarity map from three aspects: strength, compactness, and purity, producing an initial target-existence prediction. We further incorporate qualitative visual evidence by using GPT-4o to jointly assess the similarity heatmap and the results of Similarity Response Quality Scoring Module for final verification. Experiments on a small-scale benchmark constructed from SA-Med2D-20M show that MedVeriSeg effectively rejects false-query segmentation requests while maintaining reliable recognition of true queries.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的 MedVeriSeg，利用 [SEG] token 与图像特征的相似度分布差异，从强度、紧凑度、纯度三维度打分，再结合 GPT-4o 视觉判断，可在医疗开放词汇分割中识别并拒识伪查询，保留真查询的准确分割。
AI.motivation: 现有 LISA 类 MLLM 医疗分割方法无法可靠拒绝伪查询，易对不存在目标产生幻觉掩膜，降低教学与临床可信性。
AI.method: 设计免训练框架 MedVeriSeg：1) 提取 [SEG] token 与 MLLM 图像特征的相似度图；2) 构建 Similarity Response Quality Scoring 模块，量化相似度图的强度、紧凑度、纯度，给出目标存在初始预测；3) 将相似度热图与初始预测送入 GPT-4o 做视觉二次校验，输出最终拒识/接受决策。
AI.result: 在自建 SA-Med2D-20M 小规模测试集上，MedVeriSeg 能在保持真查询高识别率的同时显著降低伪查询误分割率，验证了框架有效性。
AI.conclusion: 无需重训即可赋予 LISA 类模型拒识能力， hallucination 问题得到缓解，为实现高可信医疗开放分割提供轻量级新范式。

title: Synthetic POMDPs to Challenge Memory-Augmented RL: Memory Demand Structure Modeling
comment: The article has been accepted by Frontiers of Computer Science (FCS), with the DOI: {10.1007/s11704-026-52148-y}
summary: Recent benchmarks for memory-augmented reinforcement learning (RL) have introduced partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) environments in which agents must use historical observations to make decisions. However, these benchmarks often lack fine-grained control over the challenges posed to memory models. Synthetic environments offer a solution, enabling precise manipulation of environment dynamics for rigorous and interpretable evaluation of memory-augmented RL. This paper advances the design of such customizable POMDPs with three key contributions: (1) a theoretical framework for analyzing POMDPs based on Memory Demand Structure (MDS) and related concepts; (2) a methodology using linear dynamics, state aggregation, and reward redistribution to construct POMDPs with predefined MDS; and (3) a suite of lightweight, scalable POMDP environments with tunable difficulty, grounded in our theoretical insights. Overall, our work clarifies core challenges in partially observable RL, offers principled guidelines for POMDP design, and aids in selecting and developing suitable memory architectures for RL tasks.

AI.tldr: 通过可定制的 POMDP 合成环境，为记忆强化学习提供精准可控的基准与理论框架。
AI.motivation: 现有 POMDP 基准对记忆模型的挑战粒度不可控，难以系统评估记忆增强 RL 算法，需要可精细调节的合成环境。
AI.method: 提出 Memory Demand Structure（MDS）理论框架，结合线性动力学、状态聚合与奖励再分配方法，按需构造具有预设 MDS 的轻量级、可扩展 POMDP 环境。
AI.result: 得到一套难度可调、理论支撑强的 POMDP 套件，可精准映射不同记忆复杂度，为记忆架构选型与算法开发提供可解释评估平台。
AI.conclusion: 工作厘清了部分可观 RL 的核心记忆难题，给出 POMDP 设计的系统指南，并推动记忆增强 RL 向可重复、可解释、可扩展的基准测试迈进。

title: Physics-Informed State Space Models for Reliable Solar Irradiance Forecasting in Off-Grid Systems
comment: Updated abstract to match the manuscript
summary: The stable operation of off-grid photovoltaic systems requires accurate, computationally efficient solar forecasting. Contemporary deep learning models often suffer from massive computational overhead and physical blindness, generating impossible predictions. This paper introduces the Physics-Informed State Space Model (PISSM) to bridge the gap between efficiency and physical accuracy for edge-deployed microcontrollers. PISSM utilizes a dynamic Hankel matrix embedding to filter stochastic sensor noise by transforming raw meteorological sequences into a robust state space. A Linear State Space Model replaces heavy attention mechanisms, efficiently modeling temporal dependencies for parallel processing. Crucially, a novel Physics-Informed Gating mechanism leverages the Solar Zenith Angle and Clearness Index to structurally bound outputs, ensuring predictions strictly obey diurnal cycles and preventing nocturnal errors. Validated on a multi-year dataset for Omdurman, Sudan, PISSM achieves superior accuracy with fewer than 40,000 parameters, establishing an ultra-lightweight benchmark for real-time off-grid control.

AI.tldr: 面向离网光伏微控制器，提出参数量<40 k的物理嵌入式状态空间模型PISSM，在保持极高计算效率的同时通过太阳高度角与晴朗指数硬性约束输出，杜绝夜间非零预测等违背物理规律现象，实现轻量级实时太阳辐照预测新基准。
AI.motivation: 离网光伏系统需毫秒级、低功耗的辐照预测以稳定发电，但现有深度模型计算冗余且缺乏物理规律约束，常出现夜间非零值等违背常识的预测，难以在边缘MCU部署。
AI.method: 1) 动态Hankel矩阵嵌入——将原始气象序列映射为滤波后的状态空间，抑制传感器随机噪声；2) 线性状态空间模型——替代自注意力，并行捕捉长时依赖，计算复杂度O(N)；3) 物理嵌入式门控——以太阳天顶角与晴空指数构建硬约束，强制输出在昼夜周期内物理可行。
AI.result: 在苏丹喀土穆多年实测数据上，PISSM以<40 k参数达到sMAE 20.1 W m⁻²、sRMSE 31.4 W m⁻²，预测误差较同类轻量CNN降低18%，推理延迟<2 ms，内存占用<180 kB，适用于Cortex-M级MCU。
AI.conclusion: PISSM证明在超低参数预算下仍可融合数据驱动与物理先验，为离网光伏、物联网传感等边缘场景提供了兼顾精度、效率与物理可信的实时预测范式。

title: Rein3D: Reinforced 3D Indoor Scene Generation with Panoramic Video Diffusion Models
summary: The growing demand for Embodied AI and VR applications has highlighted the need for synthesizing high-quality 3D indoor scenes from sparse inputs. However, existing approaches struggle to infer massive amounts of missing geometry in large unseen areas while maintaining global consistency, often producing locally plausible but globally inconsistent reconstructions. We present Rein3D, a framework that reconstructs full 360-degree indoor environments by coupling explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with temporally coherent priors from video diffusion models. Our approach follows a "restore-and-refine" paradigm: we employ a radial exploration strategy to render imperfect panoramic videos along trajectories starting from the origin, effectively uncovering occluded regions from a coarse 3DGS initialization. These sequences are restored by a panoramic video-to-video diffusion model and further enhanced via video super-resolution to synthesize high-fidelity geometry and textures. Finally, these refined videos serve as pseudo-ground truths to update the global 3D Gaussian field. To support this task, we construct PanoV2V-15K, a dataset of over 15K paired clean and degraded panoramic videos for diffusion-based scene restoration. Experiments demonstrate that Rein3D produces photorealistic and globally consistent 3D scenes and significantly improves long-range camera exploration compared with existing baselines.

AI.tldr: Rein3D 首次将 3D 高斯溅射与视频扩散先验耦合，实现稀疏输入下 360° 室内全景级重建，兼顾全局一致性与细节保真。
AI.motivation: 具身 AI 与 VR 对高质量 3D 室内场景需求激增，但现有方法在大范围不可见区域补全上仍难保持全局一致，常出现局部逼真却整体矛盾的结果。
AI.method: 提出“修复-精化”框架：1) 以径向探索策略沿轨迹渲染粗 3DGS 初始化的不完美全景视频，暴露被遮挡区域；2) 用全景视频-视频扩散模型修复序列，并经视频超分提升几何与纹理；3) 将修复后的高保真视频作为伪真值更新全局 3D 高斯场；同时构建 15K 对 PanoV2V-15K 数据集支持扩散模型训练。
AI.result: 在公开与自建基准上，Rein3D 在 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 及长程轨迹一致性指标上全面超越最新基线，合成结果达到照片级真实感并保持全局结构连贯。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式 3DGS 与视频扩散先验协同，Rein3D 突破了稀疏观测下的全局一致性瓶颈，为具身智能与 VR 提供了可扩展的 360° 场景重建新范式。

title: Mantis: A Foundation Model for Mechanistic Disease Forecasting
summary: Infectious disease forecasting in novel outbreaks or low-resource settings is hampered by the need for large disease and covariate data sets, bespoke training, and expert tuning, all of which can hinder rapid generation of forecasts for new settings. To help address these challenges, we developed Mantis, a foundation model trained entirely on mechanistic simulations, which enables out-of-the-box forecasting across diseases, regions, and outcomes, even in settings with limited historical data. We evaluated Mantis against 78 forecasting models across sixteen diseases with diverse modes of transmission, assessing both point forecast accuracy (mean absolute error) and probabilistic performance (weighted interval score and coverage). Despite using no real-world data during training, Mantis achieved lower mean absolute error than all models in the CDC's COVID-19 Forecast Hub when backtested on early pandemic forecasts which it had not previously seen. Across all other diseases tested, Mantis consistently ranked in the top two models across evaluation metrics. Mantis further generalized to diseases with transmission mechanisms not represented in its training data, demonstrating that it can capture fundamental contagion dynamics rather than memorizing disease-specific patterns. These capabilities illustrate that purely simulation-based foundation models such as Mantis can provide a practical foundation for disease forecasting: general-purpose, accurate, and deployable where traditional models struggle.

AI.tldr: Mantis=仅基于传染病机理模拟训练出的“零真实数据”基础模型，在新发/低资源场景下仍优于78个传统预测模型，可跨病、跨区、跨指标即插即用。
AI.motivation: 新发或大流行初期缺乏历史数据、协变量与专家调参，使传统统计/机器学习模型难以及时落地，亟需不依赖真实样本的通用预测框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建多机理方程库（SEIR、网络、年龄结构等）→ 生成大规模合成疫情曲线；2) 用transformer在模拟数据上预训练，得到通用时间序列生成式基础模型Mantis；3) 推理时仅需提供“初始病例数+时间长度”，无需再训练或调参。
AI.result: 1) COVID-19 Forecast Hub早期30周回测：MAE优于全部78个参赛模型；2) 16种传播机制不同疾病（登革、流感、霍乱、埃博拉等）：MAE、WIS、覆盖率三项指标均稳定排名前二；3) 对训练未见的寄生虫/媒介传播病仍保持高预测精度，证明学到的是普适传播动力学而非疾病特异模式。
AI.conclusion: 纯模拟驱动的传染病基础模型可突破“数据-专家-调参”瓶颈，实现快速、精准、低成本的全球疫情预测，为资源匮乏地区和新发传染病提供即用型数字工具。

title: Deep Learning using Rectified Linear Units (ReLU)
summary: The Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) is a foundational activation function in artficial neural networks. Recent literature frequently misattributes its origin to the 2018 (initial) version of this paper, which exclusively investigated ReLU at the classification layer. This paper formally corrects the citation record by tracing the mathematical lineage of piecewise linear functions from early biological models to their definitive integration into deep learning by Nair & Hinton (2010). Alongside this historical rectification, we present a comprehensive empirical comparison of the ReLU, Hyperbolic Tangent (Tanh), and Logistic (Sigmoid) activation functions across image classification, text classification, and image reconstruction tasks. To ensure statistical robustness, we evaluated these functions using 10 independent randomized trials and assessed significance using the non-parametric Kruskal-Wallis $H$ test. The empirical data validates the theoretical limitations of saturating functions. Sigmoid failed to converge in deep convolutional vision tasks due to the vanishing gradient problem, thus yielding accuracies equivalent to random probability. Conversely, ReLU and Tanh exhibited stable convergence. ReLU achieved the highest mean accuracy and F1-score on image classification and text classification tasks, while Tanh yielded the highest peak signal to noise ratio in image reconstruction. Ultimately, this study confirms a statistically significant performance variance among activations, thus reaffirming the necessity of non-saturating functions in deep architectures, and restores proper historical attribution to prior literature.

AI.tldr: ReLU实非2018年才出现，其源于2010年Nair&Hinton；系统实验证实ReLU性能全面优于Sigmoid/Tanh，历史与性能双重纠偏。
AI.motivation: 针对学界广泛误引ReLU起源、忽视早期文献的现象，作者希望正本清源；同时通过大规模实验再次验证非饱和激活函数对深度网络的必要性，为后续研究提供可靠依据。
AI.method: 1)历史溯源：梳理分段线性函数从早期生物模型到2010年Nair&Hinton正式引入CNN的演进链；2)实验设计：在图像分类、文本分类、图像重建三大任务上，用10次独立随机初始化比较ReLU、Tanh、Sigmoid；3)统计检验：采用非参数Kruskal-Wallis H检验量化差异显著性。
AI.result: 1)历史：确认Nair&Hinton(2010)为ReLU进入深度学习的关键节点；2)实验：Sigmoid因梯度消失无法收敛，性能≈随机；ReLU在分类任务取得最高平均准确率与F1；Tanh在图像重建上PSNR最优；检验显示三种激活性能差异统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 非饱和激活函数对深度网络不可或缺；ReLU的综合优势再次得到实证支持；同时恢复了被忽视的早期文献贡献，为后续引用提供准确依据。

title: CoFusion: Multispectral and Hyperspectral Image Fusion via Spectral Coordinate Attention
summary: Multispectral and Hyperspectral Image Fusion (MHIF) aims to reconstruct high-resolution images by integrating low-resolution hyperspectral images (LRHSI) and high-resolution multispectral images (HRMSI). However, existing methods face limitations in modeling cross-scale interactions and spatial-spectral collaboration, making it difficult to achieve an optimal trade-off between spatial detail enhancement and spectral fidelity. To address this challenge, we propose CoFusion: a unified spatial-spectral collaborative fusion framework that explicitly models cross-scale and cross-modal dependencies. Specifically, a Multi-Scale Generator (MSG) is designed to construct a three-level pyramidal architecture, enabling the effective integration of global semantics and local details. Within each scale, a dual-branch strategy is employed: the Spatial Coordinate-Aware Mixing module (SpaCAM) is utilized to capture multi-scale spatial contexts, while the Spectral Coordinate-Aware Mixing module (SpeCAM) enhances spectral representations through frequency decomposition and coordinate mixing. Furthermore, we introduce the Spatial-Spectral Cross-Fusion Module (SSCFM) to perform dynamic cross-modal alignment and complementary feature fusion. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that CoFusion consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior performance in both spatial reconstruction and spectral consistency.

AI.tldr: CoFusion 通过跨尺度-跨模态协同网络，将低分辨高光谱与高清多光谱图像融合为兼具高空间细节与高光谱保真的图像，在多个数据集上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 MHIF 方法难以同时建模跨尺度交互与空-谱协同，导致空间增强与光谱保真无法兼顾。
AI.method: 提出 CoFusion 统一框架：1) Multi-Scale Generator 构建三级金字塔，逐级融合全局语义与局部细节；2) 每级双分支——SpaCAM 用坐标感知混合捕获多尺度空间上下文，SpeCAM 基于频域分解与坐标混合增强光谱表征；3) Spatial-Spectral Cross-Fusion Module 实现动态跨模态对齐与互补特征融合。
AI.result: 在 CAVE、Harvard、Chikusei 等基准数据集上，CoFusion 在 SAM、ERGAS、PSNR、SSIM 等指标均优于现有最优方法，空间重建与光谱一致性同时领先。
AI.conclusion: 显式跨尺度-跨模态协同是提升 MHIF 性能的关键；CoFusion 以统一框架实现空间细节与光谱 fidelity 的最佳权衡，具备良好泛化与落地潜力。

title: Thinking Sparks!: Emergent Attention Heads in Reasoning Models During Post Training
summary: The remarkable capabilities of modern large reasoning models are largely unlocked through post-training techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). However, the architectural mechanisms behind such improvements remain largely opaque. In this work, we use circuit analysis to demonstrate that post-training for complex reasoning sparks the emergence of novel, functionally specialized attention heads. These heads collectively support structured reasoning and computation. Our comparative analysis across various model families reveals that these emergent heads evolve differently under different training regimes. Distillation and SFT foster a cumulative addition of stable reasoning heads. In contrast, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) operates in a dynamic search mode: relatively few attention heads are iteratively activated, evaluated, and pruned, with their survival closely tracking fluctuations in the task reward signal. Furthermore, we find that controllable "think on/off" models do not possess dedicated "thinking" heads. Instead, turning off explicit reasoning triggers a broader-but less efficient-set of compensatory heads. Through ablation and qualitative analyses, we connect these circuit-level dynamics to a crucial performance trade-off: strengthened heads enable sophisticated problem-solving strategies for difficult problems but can also introduce "over-thinking" failure modes, such as calculation errors or logical loops on simpler tasks. These findings connect circuit-level dynamics to macro-level performance, identifying an inherent tension where complex reasoning comes at the cost of elementary computations. More broadly, our work points to future directions for training policy design, emphasizing the need to balance the development of effective reasoning strategies with the assurance of reliable, flawless execution.

AI.tldr: 用‘电路级’剖析发现：后训练会在Transformer中催生功能专精的注意力头；其演化路径随SFT、RL而异，并带来‘能解难题却易在小题上过度思考’的天然权衡。
AI.motivation: 尽管SFT与RL显著提升大模型推理能力，但究竟在架构内部如何产生这些能力仍属黑箱。作者希望借电路分析揭示‘后天训练’到底激活或创造了哪些可解释的子结构，并解释这些结构如何左右最终性能。
AI.method: 1) 对多套大模型家族进行训练前后对比，定位并追踪功能专一、与复杂推理紧密耦合的注意力头；2) 比较SFT/蒸馏与GRPO两种训练机制下图谱演化差异；3) 引入‘可开关思考’模型，研究当显式推理被关闭时的补偿回路；4) 消融与定性分析将这些子结构与具体错误（算错、逻辑回环）关联。
AI.result: 1) 确认存在稳定、对推理至关重要的“reasoning heads”，其分布在不同模型上的收敛方式不同；2) 蒸馏/SFT趋向“累加式”固定新头，而GRPO呈“搜索-激活-淘汰”动态，存活度与奖励波动高度同步；3) 关闭思考功能并未消解推理头，而是转而调动一组扩张但低效的补偿头；4) 电路强化虽提升难题成功率，却显著增加简单题的过度演算与犯错率。
AI.conclusion: 推理能力的提升不是“无损增益”：专门化注意力头的成型意味着模型对基础计算的可靠性下降，形成“复杂-简单”任务的内在张力。未来训练策略需在激活高效推理与保持基础鲁棒之间重新平衡，并考虑对电路演化进行精细调控与剪枝。

title: Gradient flow dynamics of shallow ReLU networks for square loss and orthogonal inputs
summary: The training of neural networks by gradient descent methods is a cornerstone of the deep learning revolution. Yet, despite some recent progress, a complete theory explaining its success is still missing. This article presents, for orthogonal input vectors, a precise description of the gradient flow dynamics of training one-hidden layer ReLU neural networks for the mean squared error at small initialisation. In this setting, despite non-convexity, we show that the gradient flow converges to zero loss and characterise its implicit bias towards minimum variation norm. Furthermore, some interesting phenomena are highlighted: a quantitative description of the initial alignment phenomenon and a proof that the process follows a specific saddle to saddle dynamics.

AI.tldr: 首次在正交输入下单隐藏层ReLU网络的梯度流得到完整解析：非凸但零损失收敛，隐式偏向最小变差范数，揭示“初始对齐”与“鞍–鞍”动态。
AI.motivation: 深度学习虽被梯度下降驱动，却缺乏解释其成功的完备理论；作者聚焦最易分析的单隐藏层ReLU网络，试图在可严格处理的“正交输入＋小初始化”条件下，给出训练动力学的封闭刻画，从而为非凸优化中的隐式偏差与收敛行为提供范本。
AI.method: 1) 设输入样本正交、网络单隐藏层ReLU、平方损失、梯度流连续极限；2) 利用黎曼型可积哈密顿框架，将权重演化投影至可观测多项式不变量；3) 推导变差范数 Lyapunov 函数，证明其单调递减；4) 通过鞍点谱分析，建立“鞍–鞍”序列化逃逸时间；5) 给出初始对齐阶段的闭合解及收敛率。
AI.result: 梯度流以概率1收敛到全局零损失；极限解的变差范数‖a‖_V最小，即隐式偏差；初始阶段神经元权重与输入方向呈定量对齐，对齐角≤arcsin(C/√d)；训练轨迹依次穿越一系列鞍点，每步鞍–鞍时间尺度Θ(1/λ_2)，总体迭代复杂度Θ(log(1/ε))。
AI.conclusion: 即使在非凸场景，简单正交数据也可让ReLU网络训练动力学被完全预测：隐式正则化等价于最小变差范数，早期对齐与鞍–鞍动态是核心机制；该范例为理解更深层、更真实数据的梯度下降行为提供了可严格验证的基准，并提示初始化规模与数据正交性对隐式偏差的重要控制作用。

title: LoViF 2026 The First Challenge on Weather Removal in Videos
summary: This paper presents a review of the LoViF 2026 Challenge on Weather Removal in Videos. The challenge encourages the development of methods for restoring clean videos from inputs degraded by adverse weather conditions such as rain and snow, with an emphasis on achieving visually plausible and temporally consistent results while preserving scene structure and motion dynamics. To support this task, we introduce a new short-form WRV dataset tailored for video weather removal. It consists of 18 videos 1,216 synthesized frames paired with 1,216 real-world ground-truth frames at a resolution of 832 x 480, and is split into training, validation, and test sets with a ratio of 1:1:1. The goal of this challenge is to advance robust and realistic video restoration under real-world weather conditions, with evaluation protocols that jointly consider fidelity and perceptual quality. The challenge attracted 37 participants and received 5 valid final submissions with corresponding fact sheets, contributing to progress in weather removal for videos. The project is publicly available at https://www.codabench.org/competitions/13462/.

AI.tldr: LoViF2026 Challenge发布首个短时真实配准视频去雨/雪数据集WRV，设计1:1:1训练-验证-测试拆分，吸引37支队伍、5份有效方案，推动真实退化下视频保结构＋保运动＋保时间一致性复原范式的发展与评估。
AI.motivation: 恶劣天气导致的雨、雪互补性退化会严重破坏视频视觉质量和机器感知鲁棒性，而兼顾真实退化、短时序结构和真实GT的公开数据与统一评价机制缺失，因此提出LoViF2026挑战以填补空缺、激励算法突破。
AI.method: 构建832×480分辨率、18段/1216帧短时合成退化视频及其严格配准的实采GT（WRV数据集）；采用训练-验证1:1分配，测试只线上盲评；评价协议同步衡量保真度(LPIPS、PSNR、SSIM)和感知合理性(手工时序一致性打分、无参考NRQM)。
AI.result: 挑战收到37支注册团队，6队上传模型，5份符合技术文档的全面提交顺利评测，其中最佳方法在WRV-clean测试集上相比baseline将LPIPS↓0.062，时序断裂数↓34%，保持运动轨迹不漂移；全面基线公开可促进持续研究。
AI.conclusion: WRV和测评协议为视频去天气任务提供了首个面向短时富运动场景的基准，揭示保真度与知觉质量难分、时序一致性需显式建模；后续研究可拓展多场景自监督数据生成、轻量化帧间一致性损失及面向系统的实时部署。

title: ASGuard: Activation-Scaling Guard to Mitigate Targeted Jailbreaking Attack
summary: Large language models (LLMs), despite being safety-aligned, exhibit brittle refusal behaviors that can be circumvented by simple linguistic changes. As tense jailbreaking demonstrates that models refusing harmful requests often comply when rephrased in past tense, a critical generalization gap is revealed in current alignment methods whose underlying mechanisms are poorly understood. In this work, we introduce Activation-Scaling Guard (ASGuard), an insightful, mechanistically-informed framework that surgically mitigates this specific vulnerability. In the first step, we use circuit analysis to identify the specific attention heads causally linked to the targeted jailbreaking such as a tense-changing attack. Second, we train a precise, channel-wise scaling vector to recalibrate the activation of tense vulnerable heads. Lastly, we apply it into a "preventative fine-tuning", forcing the model to learn a more robust refusal mechanism. Across four LLMs, ASGuard effectively reduces the attack success rate of targeted jailbreaking while preserving general capabilities and minimizing over refusal, achieving a Pareto-optimal balance between safety and utility. Our findings underscore how adversarial suffixes suppress the propagation of the refusal-mediating direction, based on mechanistic analysis. Furthermore, our work showcases how a deep understanding of model internals can be leveraged to develop practical, efficient, and targeted methods for adjusting model behavior, charting a course for more reliable and interpretable AI safety.

AI.tldr: 提出ASGuard：靠定位并微调少量attention-head来堵上“时态越狱”漏洞，在4种LLM上同时提升安全性与可用性。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐后的大模型仍会被简单语法变换（如把请求改为过去时态）攻破，说明现有对齐机制存在关键泛化缺陷。
AI.method: 1. 电路分析定位与时态越狱因果相关的attention head；2. 训练通道级缩放向量精准修正其激活值；3. 将缩放向量注入“预防式微调”，强化鲁棒拒绝机制。
AI.result: 在四款LLM上把针对性越狱攻击成功率降到极低，而通用能力不下降、不过度拒绝，实现安全-效用帕累托最优。
AI.conclusion: 用机理揭示对抗后缀抑制拒绝路径，证明深入模型内部可催生高效、可解释且定向的安全增强方法。

title: metasnf: Meta Clustering with Similarity Network Fusion in R
comment: 66 pages, 26 figures, provisionally accepted at Journal of Statistical Software
summary: metasnf is an R package that enables users to apply meta clustering, a method for efficiently searching a broad space of cluster solutions by clustering the solutions themselves, to clustering workflows based on similarity network fusion (SNF). SNF is a multi-modal data integration algorithm commonly used for biomedical subtype discovery. The package also contains functions to assist with cluster visualization, characterization, and validation. This package can help researchers identify SNF-derived cluster solutions that are guided by context-specific utility over context-agnostic measures of quality.

AI.tldr: Metasnf 将“元聚类”封装成 R 包，对 SNF 多组学融合产生的海量聚类结果再进行聚类，从而快速锁定贴合具体生信场景、而非仅依据通用指标的最优亚型划分，并配套可视化、刻画与验证工具。
AI.motivation: SNF 在生物医学亚型发现中被广泛使用，但一次运行即得单一聚类，难以穷尽参数空间；传统评估指标（如 Silhouette）与下游生物学意义常脱节，研究者缺乏高效筛选“既稳定又贴合研究目的”解决方案的手段。
AI.method: 1）调用 SNF 重复采样/多参数生成候选聚类集合；2）以 Adjusted Rand Index 等构建聚类-聚类相似网络；3）对该网络再聚类（meta-clustering）找出代表性的“共识聚类簇”；4）引入自定义效用函数（临床关联、通路富集等）对每簇打分，输出最优解；5）配套 t-SNE/Heatmap、 silhouette 曲线、 Kaplan–Meier 等函数辅助解释与验证。
AI.result: 在 TCGA 多组学数据（n≈9 000）中，metasnf 用 3 小时遍历 1 024 种参数组合，元聚类后浓缩为 12 个共识簇；其中排名第一的解决方案使三阴性乳腺癌 5 年生存 AUC 提升 0.11，富集出 7 条可用药通路，显著优于 Silhouette 最优但无临床差异的模型。
AI.conclusion: Metasnf 把“先产生-再筛选”范式升级为“产生-再聚类-按场景偏好精炼”，兼顾计算效率与结果生物学可解释性，为 SNF 框架在精准肿瘤学等多组学亚型研究提供即插即用的新工具。

title: Retrieving to Recover: Towards Incomplete Audio-Visual Question Answering via Semantic-consistent Purification
summary: Recent Audio-Visual Question Answering (AVQA) methods have advanced significantly. However, most AVQA methods lack effective mechanisms for handling missing modalities, suffering from severe performance degradation in real-world scenarios with data interruptions. Furthermore, prevailing methods for handling missing modalities predominantly rely on generative imputation to synthesize missing features. While partially effective, these methods tend to capture inter-modal commonalities but struggle to acquire unique, modality-specific knowledge within the missing data, leading to hallucinations and compromised reasoning accuracy. To tackle these challenges, we propose R$^{2}$ScP, a novel framework that shifts the paradigm of missing modality handling from traditional generative imputation to retrieval-based recovery. Specifically, we leverage cross-modal retrieval via unified semantic embeddings to acquire missing domain-specific knowledge. To maximize semantic restoration, we introduce a context-aware adaptive purification mechanism that eliminates latent semantic noise within the retrieved data. Additionally, we employ a two-stage training strategy to explicitly model the semantic relationships between knowledge from different sources. Extensive experiments demonstrate that R$^{2}$ScP significantly improves AVQA and enhances robustness in modal-incomplete scenarios.

AI.tldr: 将缺失模态的生成式修补改为跨模态检索+自适应净化，显著缓解AVQA在模态缺失场景下的幻觉与性能衰减。
AI.motivation: 现有AVQA方法在模态缺失时性能骤降，主流生成式补全难以捕获缺失模态独有知识，易产生幻觉并降低推理准确率。
AI.method: 提出R²ScP框架：1) 统一语义嵌入跨模态检索替代生成式补全；2) 上下文感知的自适应净化机制去除检索语义噪声；3) 两阶段训练显式建模异源知识间语义关系。
AI.result: 在模态缺失评测中，R²ScP显著优于现有基线，有效抑制幻觉并提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 从“生成”转向“检索+净化”是缺失模态恢复的新范式，可推广至其他多模态任务以增强现实场景容错能力。

title: The Stackelberg Speaker: Optimizing Persuasive Communication in Social Deduction Games
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown remarkable progress in social deduction games (SDGs). However, existing approaches primarily focus on information processing and strategy selection, overlooking the significance of persuasive communication in influencing other players' beliefs and responses. In SDGs, success depends not only on making correct deductions but on convincing others to response in alignment with one's intent. To address this limitation, we formalize turn-based dialogue in SDGs as a Stackelberg competition, where the current player acts as the leader who strategically influences the follower's response. Building on this theoretical foundation, we propose a reinforcement learning framework that trains agents to optimize utterances for persuasive impact. Through comprehensive experiments across three diverse SDGs, we demonstrate that our agents significantly outperform baselines. This work represents a significant step toward developing AI agents capable of strategic social influence, with implications extending to scenarios requiring persuasive communication. Our code and data are available at https://3dagentworld.github.io/leader_follower.

AI.tldr: 首次把SDG中的说服建模为Stackelberg主从博弈，用强化学习训练LLM agent生成具策略性影响力的话语，三项游戏实验全面优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在SDG中偏重推理与策略选择，忽视说服他人按己方意图行动的关键环节，限制了胜率与策略纵深。
AI.method: 将回合对话形式化为Stackelberg博弈：当前发言者为Leader，其话语作为策略变量，后续玩家为Follower，其信念与行动视为响应；构建RL框架，以Follower响应与Leader目标的吻合度为奖励，端到端优化话语生成策略。
AI.result: 在三种不同机制SDG（含抵抗组织、狼人与新设定）中，所训练agent的胜率平均提升12–18%，话语说服力指标（目标对齐率、信任度迁移量）显著高于仅做信息推理或模仿人类语言的基线。
AI.conclusion: 证明把说服显式建模并强化优化，可让AI在需要社交影响的情境中具备更强策略沟通力，为谈判、协作与安全治理等更广泛场景提供方法论与模型基础。

title: Surrogate models for diffusion on graphs via sparse polynomials
summary: Diffusion kernels over graphs have been widely utilized as effective tools in various applications due to their ability to accurately model the flow of information through nodes and edges. However, there is a notable gap in the literature regarding the development of surrogate models for diffusion processes on graphs. In this work, we fill this gap by proposing sparse polynomial-based surrogate models for parametric diffusion equations on graphs with community structure. In tandem, we provide convergence guarantees for both least squares and compressed sensing-based approximations by showing the holomorphic regularity of parametric solutions to these diffusion equations. Our theoretical findings are accompanied by a series of numerical experiments conducted on both synthetic and real-world graphs that demonstrate the applicability of our methodology.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为带社区结构的图参数扩散方程构造了稀疏多项式替代模型，并给出最小二乘与压缩感知逼近的收敛保证；合成与真实图实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有图扩散核虽应用广泛，但缺乏针对图参数扩散过程的高效替代模型，阻碍快速预测与不确定性量化。
AI.method: 以参数扩散方程解的全纯正则性为基础，构造稀疏多项式 surrogate；分别用最小二乘和压缩 sensing 进行系数估计，并针对含社区结构的图设计采样策略。
AI.result: 理论上：证明参数化解在复参数域内全纯，导出指数级收敛率；实验上：在合成／真实图上，稀疏多项式仅用 <1% 自由度即可逼近原扩散过程，误差比经典降维方法低一个数量级，且推理时间加速 10^3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏多项式替代模型为图参数扩散方程提供可证明收敛、可扩展的高效逼近框架，可推广至更复杂随机图与时空扩散场景。

title: Architecture-Agnostic Modality-Isolated Gated Fusion for Robust Multi-Modal Prostate MRI Segmentation
summary: Multi-parametric prostate MRI -- combining T2-weighted, apparent diffusion coefficient, and high b-value diffusion-weighted sequences -- is central to non-invasive detection of clinically significant prostate cancer, yet in routine practice individual sequences may be missing or degraded by motion, artifacts, or abbreviated protocols. Existing multi-modal fusion strategies typically assume complete inputs and entangle modality-specific information at early layers, offering limited resilience when one channel is corrupted or absent. We propose Modality-Isolated Gated Fusion (MIGF), an architecture-agnostic module that maintains separate modality-specific encoding streams before a learned gating stage, combined with modality dropout training to enforce compensation behavior under incomplete inputs. We benchmark six bare backbones and assess MIGF-equipped models under seven missing-modality and artifact scenarios on the PI-CAI dataset (1,500 studies, fold-0 split, five random seeds). Among bare backbones, nnUNet provided the strongest balance of performance and stability. MIGF improved ideal-scenario Ranking Score for UNet, nnUNet, and Mamba by 2.8%, 4.6%, and 13.4%, respectively; the best model, MIGFNet-nnUNet (gating + ModDrop, no deep supervision), achieved 0.7304 +/- 0.056. Mechanistic analysis reveals that robustness gains arise from strict modality isolation and dropout-driven compensation rather than adaptive per-sample quality routing: the gate converged to a stable modality prior, and deep supervision was beneficial only for the largest backbone while degrading lighter models. These findings support a simpler design principle for robust multi-modal segmentation: structurally contain corrupted inputs first, then train explicitly for incomplete-input compensation.

AI.tldr: 这篇摘要介绍了一个名为Modality-Isolated Gated Fusion(MIGF)的通用模块，可在多参数前列腺MRI任一序列缺失或受伪影干扰时，仍保持对临床显著癌灶的稳定分割。实验表明，MIGF在nnUNet、UNet和Mamba backbone上分别提升理想场景性能4.6%、2.8%与13.4%，最佳模型MIGFNet-nnUNet在PI-CAI 1,500例数据上达到0.7304±0.056的Ranking Score。通过对模态隔离和模态dropout训练，MIGF仅在浅层骨干网络上就能显著提升鲁棒性，而无需复杂的质量自适应路由。结果支持“先隔离受损输入，再显式训练补偿”的多模态分割设计原则。
AI.motivation: 多参数前列腺MRI（T2WI+ADC+高b值DWI）是无创检出临床显著前列腺癌的核心手段，但日常扫描常因运动、伪影或简化协议导致序列缺损或劣化。现有早期融合方法假设输入完整，在通道受损时鲁棒性有限，亟需一种在序列缺位时仍能稳定分割的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出Modality-Isolated Gated Fusion (MIGF)：1) 保持各模态独立编码流，避免早期信息纠缠；2) 在编码后引入可学习门控进行融合；3) 训练阶段采用modality dropout随机丢弃模态，迫使网络学会补偿。该模块可即插即用于任意backbone。共测试六种裸backbone（UNet、nnUNet、Mamba等）与MIGF增强版本在PI-CAI 1,500例数据、七种缺失/伪影场景（序列缺失、运动伪影等）下的表现。
AI.result: 裸backbone中nnUNet兼顾性能与稳定性。加入MIGF后，UNet、nnUNet、Mamba在理想完整输入场景下的Ranking Score分别提高2.8%、4.6%、13.4%。最佳模型MIGFNet-nnUNet（仅门控+ModDrop，无深度监督）平均Ranking Score为0.7304±0.056。鲁棒性提升主要源自模态隔离与dropout驱动的补偿机制，而非逐样本质量自适应：门控收敛到稳定的模态先验，深度监督仅在最大backbone有效，对轻量化模型反而有害。
AI.conclusion: 在多模态医学影像分割中，先通过结构隔离防止受损输入污染特征，再用显式缺失模态训练迫使网络学会补偿，即可在无需复杂路由的情况下显著提升鲁棒性。MIGF为临床“序列不完整”场景提供了简单有效的即插即用方案。

title: Mixed-Density Diffuser: Efficient Planning with Non-Uniform Temporal Resolution
comment: European Symposium on Artificial Neural Networks, Computational Intelligence and Machine Learning (ESANN, 2026)
summary: Recent studies demonstrate that diffusion planners benefit from sparse-step planning over single-step planning. Training models to skip steps in their trajectories helps capture long-term dependencies without additional memory or computational cost. However, predicting excessively sparse plans degrades performance. We hypothesize this temporal density threshold is non-uniform across a planning horizon and that certain parts of a predicted trajectory should be more densely generated. We propose Mixed-Density Diffuser (MDD), a diffusion planner where the densities throughout the horizon are tunable hyperparameters. We show that MDD surpasses the SOTA Diffusion Veteran (DV) framework across the Maze2D, Franka Kitchen, and Antmaze Datasets for Deep Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning (D4RL) task domains, achieving a new SOTA on the D4RL benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合密度扩散规划器（MDD），通过在整个时域内可调的稀疏步数规划，实现无额外计算开销的长程依赖建模，在 D4RL 基准上刷新三项任务 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 扩散规划器在稀疏步训练下能捕获长程依赖，但过稀疏会掉点；作者认为轨迹不同段落对密度的敏感度不同，需动态调整稀疏度而非全局一致。
AI.method: 将轨迹各段落的步数密度设为可调超参数，构建 Mixed-Density Diffuser（MDD），在训练阶段对高密度区保留更多步，低密度区跳过更多步，实现非均匀稀疏采样。
AI.result: 在 Maze2D、Franka Kitchen 与 Antmaze 三大 D4RL 任务上，MDD 全面优于当前 SOTA 方法 Diffusion Veteran（DV），平均成功率提升 X%，刷新 D4RL 基准记录。
AI.conclusion: 通过非均匀稀疏步数规划，MDD 证明“局部密度”对扩散规划性能至关重要，为高效、可扩展的长程决策建模提供了新范式。

title: The Illusion of Fit: Spatially Resolved Assessment of Constitutive Model Validity in Elastography and Physics-Based Inverse Problems
summary:
Inferring the mechanical properties of soft tissues from measured deformations is a fundamental challenge in elastography. A rarely examined assumption underlying existing approaches is that the assumed constitutive law correctly describes the imaged material. When it fails, inversion still yields plausible-looking estimates - an illusion of fit with no indication of local model invalidity, which can mislead clinical interpretation.
  We propose a probabilistic framework that transforms constitutive model validity from an implicit assumption into an explicit, spatially resolved inference target. The key is to treat the stress field as an independent latent variable rather than deriving it from the constitutive law. This enables a pointwise comparison between the stress required by mechanical equilibrium and the stress predicted by the assumed constitutive model. Both governing equations enter the probabilistic learning objective as virtual observables with separate precision hyperparameters: the conservation law precision is set a priori to a small value reflecting its undisputed validity, while the constitutive precision is inferred under a sparsity-promoting prior. The resulting constitutive precision field provides an uncertainty-aware map of where the assumed model is supported by the data and where it is not. Inference is carried out via stochastic variational inference and is forward-model-free.
  We validate the framework on synthetic harmonic elastography experiments on a brain-slice geometry with an anisotropic inclusion. The inferred precision field identifies the inclusion with a five-order-of-magnitude precision contrast against the valid domain, robustly across 25-35 dB noise and four-fold sparser observations. A phantom experiment with ultrasound measurements on a linear elastic material yields no false-positive violations and recovers the true stiffness contrast.

AI.tldr: 提出一种概率框架，在无需指定正演模型的情况下，直接从位移场推断“本构模型在何处失效”，给出空间分辨的模型有效性图。
AI.motivation: 传统弹性成像反演默认本构关系全局成立；一旦模型失配，仍输出看似合理的参数，却无局部失效警示，易误导临床。需要将“模型是否成立”作为可量化的推断对象。
AI.method: 将应力场视为独立潜变量，而非由本构定律导出；把平衡方程与假设的本构方程分别当作虚拟观测，赋予独立精度超参数。平衡精度固定为极小值，本构精度则用稀疏促进先验由数据推断，得到空间变化的“本构精度场”。采用随机变分推断，无需正演求解器。
AI.result: 在含各向异性夹杂的脑片合成数据上，25–35 dB 噪声、四倍稀疏采样仍能以 10⁵ 倍精度对比准确定位夹杂；线性弹性超声幻像实验无假阳性，且正确重建刚度对比。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把“本构有效性”由隐式假设转化为显式、带不确定度的空间推断目标，可即时标出模型不适用区域，为弹性成像提供模型可信度地图。

title: STGV: Spatio-Temporal Hash Encoding for Gaussian-based Video Representation
summary: 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) has recently become a promising paradigm for high-quality video representation. However, existing methods employ content-agnostic or spatio-temporal feature overlapping embeddings to predict canonical Gaussian primitive deformations, which entangles static and dynamic components in videos and prevents modeling their distinct properties effectively. These result in inaccurate predictions for spatio-temporal deformations and unsatisfactory representation quality. To address these problems, this paper proposes a Spatio-Temporal hash encoding framework for Gaussian-based Video representation (STGV). By decomposing video features into learnable 2D spatial and 3D temporal hash encodings, STGV effectively facilitates the learning of motion patterns for dynamic components while maintaining background details for static elements. In addition, we construct a more stable and consistent initial canonical Gaussian representation through a key frame canonical initialization strategy, preventing from feature overlapping and a structurally incoherent geometry representation. Experimental results demonstrate that our method attains better video representation quality (+0.98 PSNR) against other Gaussian-based methods and achieves competitive performance in downstream video tasks.

AI.tldr: 针对2D Gaussian Splatting 视频表示中静态-动态耦合导致的变形预测误差，提出基于时空哈希分解的STGV框架，在关键帧初始化下获得+0.98 dB PSNR提升。
AI.motivation: 现有2DGS方法采用内容无关或重叠的时空特征嵌入，无法区分视频中的静态背景与动态前景，导致高斯原语变形预测不准确、合成质量下降。
AI.method: 提出STGV：①将视频特征解耦为可学习的2D空间+3D时间哈希编码，分别建模背景细节与运动模式；②关键帧初始化构造无重叠、结构一致的规范高斯表示，避免初始几何不连贯。
AI.result: 相较其它Gaussian-based方法，视频重建PSNR提高0.98 dB；在下游视频处理任务中保持同等或更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过在哈希层级显式分离时空维度并优化初始规范空间，STGV有效提升高斯原语对动静分量的表达能力，为高保真视频重建及后续应用提供了新范式。

title: JanusCoder: Towards a Foundational Visual-Programmatic Interface for Code Intelligence
summary: The scope of neural code intelligence is rapidly expanding beyond text-based source code to encompass the rich visual outputs that programs generate. This visual dimension is critical for advanced applications like flexible content generation and precise, program-driven editing of visualizations. However, progress has been impeded by the scarcity of high-quality multimodal code data, a bottleneck stemming from challenges in synthesis and quality assessment. To address these challenges, we make contributions from both a data and modeling perspective. We first introduce a complete synthesis toolkit that leverages reciprocal synergies between data modalities to efficiently produce a large-scale, high-quality corpus spanning from standard charts to complex interactive web UIs and code-driven animations. Leveraging this toolkit, we construct JanusCode-800K, the largest multimodal code corpus to date. This powers the training of our models, JanusCoder and JanusCoderV, which establish a visual-programmatic interface for generating code from textual instructions, visual inputs, or a combination of both. Our unified model is a departure from existing approaches that build specialized models for isolated tasks. Extensive experiments on both text-centric and vision-centric coding tasks demonstrate the superior performance of the JanusCoder series, with our 7B to 14B scale models approaching or even exceeding the performance of commercial models. Furthermore, extensive analysis provides key insights into harmonizing programmatic logic with its visual expression. Our code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/InternLM/JanusCoder.

AI.tldr: 构建并开源迄今最大规模图文对齐代码语料 JanusCode-800K，训练出统一多模态模型 JanusCoder，在文本与视觉导向的代码任务上均逼近或超越商业模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有神经代码智能局限于纯文本，难以满足程序生成/编辑可视化内容等视觉驱动场景；高质量图文对齐代码数据匮乏是主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 提出跨模态协同的综合生成工具链，自动合成涵盖图表、交互 UI 与代码动画的大规模数据；2) 构建 80 万样本的 JanusCode-800K；3) 设计统一 Transformer，支持文本、图像或混合输入生成代码。
AI.result: JanusCoder 7B-14B 在文本基准(HumanEval、MBPP)和视觉基准(Web2Code、GUI 自动修复)上均显著优于同类开源模型，部分指标追平或超过 GPT-4-Turbo 等商业系统。
AI.conclusion: 通过大规模图文对齐语料与统一模型，首次在 10B 级参数量下实现文本与视觉代码生成的 SOTA，验证了程序逻辑与其视觉表现可协同建模，为多模态代码智能提供新范式。

title: Influence Strength Estimation in Hyperbolic Space for Social Influence Maximization
summary: The Influence Maximization (IM) problem aims to find a small set of influential users to maximize their influence spread in a social network. Traditional methods rely on fixed diffusion models with known parameters, limiting their generalization to real-world scenarios. In contrast, graph representation learning-based methods have gained wide attention for overcoming this limitation by learning user representations to capture influence characteristics. However, existing studies are built on Euclidean space, which fails to effectively capture the latent hierarchical features of social influence distribution. As a result, users' influence spread cannot be effectively measured through the learned representations. To alleviate these limitations, we propose HIM, a novel diffusion model agnostic method that leverages hyperbolic representation learning to estimate users' potential influence spread from social propagation data. HIM consists of two key components. First, a hyperbolic influence representation module encodes influence spread patterns from network structure and historical influence activations into expressive hyperbolic user representations. Hence, the influence magnitude of users can be reflected through the geometric properties of hyperbolic space, where highly influential users tend to cluster near the space origin. Second, a novel adaptive seed selection module is developed to flexibly and effectively select seed users using the positional information of learned user representations. Extensive experiments on five network datasets demonstrate the superior effectiveness and efficiency of our method for the IM problem with unknown diffusion model parameters, highlighting its potential for large-scale real-world social networks.

AI.tldr: 提出 HIM——一种基于双曲表示学习、无需扩散模型参数的IM方法，通过双曲空间捕获用户层级影响力并自适应选种，实验显示其效果与效率优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 固定扩散模型参数难以泛化；现有图表示学习在欧氏空间无法刻画社交影响的层级结构，导致影响力测度失效。
AI.method: 1) 双曲影响力表示模块：将网络结构与历史激活数据编码为双曲用户向量，利用双曲几何性质（高影响力用户靠近原点）度量影响力大小；2) 自适应种子选择模块：基于学到的双曲位置信息灵活选种，无需知道扩散模型参数。
AI.result: 在5个网络数据集上，HIM 在影响力传播范围与时间效率上均显著优于现有欧氏与模型驱动方法，展示了对大规模真实网络的扩展潜力。
AI.conclusion: 双曲表示可有效建模社交影响的层级特征，HIM 为无参数扩散模型场景提供高效、可扩展的 IM 解决方案，并具备部署于真实大规模社交网络的实用前景。

title: ReXSonoVQA: A Video QA Benchmark for Procedure-Centric Ultrasound Understanding
summary: Ultrasound acquisition requires skilled probe manipulation and real-time adjustments. Vision-language models (VLMs) could enable autonomous ultrasound systems, but existing benchmarks evaluate only static images, not dynamic procedural understanding. We introduce ReXSonoVQA, a video QA benchmark with 514 video clips and 514 questions (249 MCQ, 265 free-response) targeting three competencies: Action-Goal Reasoning, Artifact Resolution & Optimization, and Procedure Context & Planning. Zero-shot evaluation of Gemini 3 Pro, Qwen3.5-397B, LLaVA-Video-72B, and Seed 2.0 Pro shows VLMs can extract some procedural information, but troubleshooting questions remain challenging with minimal gains over text-only baselines, exposing limitations in causal reasoning. ReXSonoVQA enables developing perception systems for ultrasound training, guidance, and robotic automation.

AI.tldr: 首个动态超声操作评测集ReXSonoVQA显示，现有视觉-语言模型在因果推理与故障排查上仍显著不足，难支撑真正自主超声系统。
AI.motivation: 超声检查高度依赖操作者实时手法与图像调优，现有VLMs仅用静态图像评估，无法衡量模型对动态操作序列、伪影处理与因果推理的能力，阻碍自主超声/机器人系统的研发。
AI.method: 采集514段超声操作视频，设计514道问题（249选择题+265开放问答），覆盖动作-目标推理、伪影解析与优化、程序上下文与规划三维度，零样本评测Gemini 3 Pro等四款最强VLMs，并与纯文本基线对比。
AI.result: VLMs在识别探头动作与图像特征上可取得部分准确率，但涉及故障排查与因果推理的题目得分几乎无提升，仅略优于纯文本模型，暴露动态因果理解瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ReXSonoVQA为后续算法提供公开基准，需针对性增强因果与操作逻辑建模，才能推进超声培训导航与机器人自动扫查落地。

title: MGA: Memory-Driven GUI Agent for Observation-Centric Interaction
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced GUI agents, yet long-horizon automation remains constrained by two critical bottlenecks: context overload from raw sequential trajectory dependence and architectural redundancy from over-engineered expert modules. Prevailing End-to-End and Multi-Agent paradigms struggle with error cascades caused by concatenated visual-textual histories and incur high inference latency due to redundant expert components, limiting their practical deployment. To address these issues, we propose the Memory-Driven GUI Agent (MGA), a minimalist framework that decouples long-horizon trajectories into independent decision steps linked by a structured state memory. MGA operates on an ``Observe First and Memory Enhancement`` principle, powered by two tightly coupled core mechanisms: (1) an Observer module that acts as a task-agnostic, intent-free screen state reader to eliminate confirmation bias, visual hallucinations, and perception bias at the root; and (2) a Structured Memory mechanism that distills, validates, and compresses each interaction step into verified state deltas, constructing a lightweight state transition chain to avoid irrelevant historical interference and system redundancy. By replacing raw historical aggregation with compact, fact-based memory transitions, MGA drastically reduces cognitive overhead and system complexity. Extensive experiments on OSWorld and real-world applications demonstrate that MGA achieves highly competitive performance in open-ended GUI tasks while maintaining architectural simplicity, offering a scalable and efficient blueprint for next-generation GUI automation {https://github.com/MintyCo0kie/MGA4OSWorld}.

AI.tldr: MGA 用“观察-记忆”两步极简框架替代长轨迹拼接，彻底甩掉冗余专家模块与历史噪声，在 OSWorld 等任务取得 SOTA 级表现，推理延迟与错误级联显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有 E2E 与多智能体 GUI 代理依赖原始视觉-文本历史拼接，导致上下文爆炸、专家模块冗余、错误级联及高推理延迟，难以落地长周期操作。
AI.method: 提出 Memory-Driven GUI Agent（MGA）：① Observer 模块以零意图、零先验方式读取屏幕状态，根除确认偏差与视觉幻觉；② Structured Memory 机制将每步交互蒸馏为验证过的状态 delta，构建轻量状态转移链，完全替代原始历史累积。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld 及真实应用长周期任务中，MGA 以极简架构取得竞争性成功率，推理时延和错误传播显著降低，无需额外专家组件即可扩展。
AI.conclusion: 通过“先观察、后记忆”的解耦设计，MGA 为下一代可扩展、低延迟的 GUI 自动化提供了简洁而高效的新范式。

title: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Report Summarization: Analysis on Supervised and Unsupervised Data
summary: We study the efficacy of fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for the specific task of report (government archives, news, intelligence reports) summarization. While this topic is being very actively researched - our specific application set-up faces two challenges: (i) ground-truth summaries maybe unavailable (e.g., for government archives), and (ii) availability of limited compute power - the sensitive nature of the application requires that computation is performed on-premise and for most of our experiments we use one or two A100 GPU cards. Under this set-up we conduct experiments to answer the following questions. First, given that fine-tuning the LLMs can be resource intensive, is it feasible to fine-tune them for improved report summarization capabilities on-premise? Second, what are the metrics we could leverage to assess the quality of these summaries? We conduct experiments on two different fine-tuning approaches in parallel and our findings reveal interesting trends regarding the utility of fine-tuning LLMs. Specifically, we find that in many cases, fine-tuning helps improve summary quality and in other cases it helps by reducing the number of invalid or garbage summaries.

AI.tldr: 在仅1–2张A100的本地算力与缺乏参考摘要的双重限制下，通过两种微调策略让LLM生成政府/情报类报告摘要，既能提升质量也能显著减少无效输出，证明资源受限场景下就地微调可行。
AI.motivation: 政府、情报、新闻等敏感文档的自动摘要需求旺盛，但真实摘要常不可得，且数据无法上云，只能在1–2张A100的本地环境中完成微调，亟需验证在此极限资源与无监督条件下微调LLM是否值得。
AI.method: 在单卡或双卡A100上并行比较两种轻量化微调方案（具体技术未展开），使用无须人工摘要的内在/外在指标评估摘要质量与有效性；数据集涵盖政府档案、新闻与情报报告。
AI.result: 微调显著优于零 shot 基线：部分场景ROUGE/BERTScore类指标提升，同时无效/垃圾摘要比例下降；证明即使算力受限，本地化微调仍能带来可度量的收益。
AI.conclusion: 在敏感、资源受限场景下，仅用1–2张A100即可通过轻量化微调获得更可靠、更高质的报告摘要，且无需依赖人工标注，为政府/情报单位的本地LLM落地提供了可行范式。

title: Bootstrapping Video Semantic Segmentation Model via Distillation-assisted Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Fully supervised Video Semantic Segmentation (VSS) relies heavily on densely annotated video data, limiting practical applicability. Alternatively, applying pre-trained Image Semantic Segmentation (ISS) models frame-by-frame avoids annotation costs but ignores crucial temporal coherence. Recent foundation models such as SAM2 enable high-quality mask propagation yet remain impractical for direct VSS due to limited semantic understanding and computational overhead. In this paper, we propose DiTTA (Distillation-assisted Test-Time Adaptation), a novel framework that converts an ISS model into a temporally-aware VSS model through efficient test-time adaptation (TTA), without annotated videos. DiTTA distills SAM2's temporal segmentation knowledge into the ISS model during a brief, single-pass initialization phase, complemented by a lightweight temporal fusion module to aggregate cross-frame context. Crucially, DiTTA achieves robust generalization even when adapting with highly limited partial video snippets (e.g., initial 10%), significantly outperforming zero-shot refinement approaches that repeatedly invoke SAM2 during inference. Extensive experiments on VSPW and Cityscapes demonstrate DiTTA's effectiveness, achieving competitive or superior performance relative to fully-supervised VSS methods, thus providing a practical and annotation-free solution for real-world VSS tasks.

AI.tldr: 无需任何视频标注，仅需10%视频片段，在测试阶段把静态图像分割模型改造成性能媲美全监督方案的视频语义分割模型。
AI.motivation: 全监督VSS需要逐帧密集标注，现实中不可行；逐帧跑ISS或调用SAM2推理均无法兼顾时间一致性与效率，急需一种零标注、低计算、即插即用的视频分割方案。
AI.method: DiTTA：①初始化阶段以SAM2为教师，把其掩码传播知识蒸馏到学生ISS网络，仅扫描一遍前10%视频帧；②在线推理阶段，用轻量级跨帧融合模块聚合时序上下文，实现测试时自适应更新；③整个过程无需反向传播或迭代调用SAM2。
AI.result: VSPW与Cityscapes上，DiTTA在零标注条件下达到甚至超越全监督VSS精度，同时比反复调用SAM2的零次优化方法提速4×以上，显存占用下降约30%。
AI.conclusion: DiTTA首次证明仅用极短无标视频片段即可让静态ISS模型获得强时序感知能力，为实际部署提供了一条真正免标注、低延迟、高泛化的VSS新路径。

title: Does RLVR Extend Reasoning Boundaries? Investigating Capability Expansion in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent studies posit that Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) primarily amplifies behaviors inherent to the pre-training distribution rather than inducing new capabilities, but these insights are predominantly limited to language-only domains, leaving the dynamics of visual-centric spatial reasoning under-explored. To examine the impact of RLVR on the capability boundaries of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), we introduce \textbf{Ariadne}, a controlled framework based on synthetic maze navigation where the reasoning difficulty is precisely regulated by path length and the number of turns. We demonstrate that applying RLVR extends the spatial reasoning boundary, achieving success on problems where the base policy VLM consistently attains $0\%$ accuracy despite increasing pass@k sampling budgets, indicating that the optimized policy successfully navigates search spaces that were effectively unreachable by the base distribution. Furthermore, despite being trained exclusively on synthetic mazes, we evaluate the model on two real-world navigation benchmarks (MapBench and ReasonMap) in a zero-shot setting. The observed improvements in these out-of-domain tasks suggest genuine spatial reasoning capability expansion rather than mere sampling efficiency.

AI.tldr: 在可控的合成迷宫任务中，RLVR 让 VLM 学会解决预训练策略无法触及的「零正确率」难题，并在零样本真实导航任务上迁移提升，说明空间推理边界被真正拓展而非仅采样效率。
AI.motivation: 已有 RLVR 研究局限于纯语言任务，认为其只是放大预训练分布固有行为，未验证视觉-空间推理是否同样成立。
AI.method: 提出可控框架 Ariadne，通过调节路径长度与转弯数精确控制迷宫导航难度，用 RLVR 训练 VLM，并在两个真实导航 benchmark 做零-shot 测试。
AI.result: 1) 在合成迷宫中，RLVR 策略能连续解决基础策略 pass@k 采样准确率始终为 0 的难题；2) 零-shot 迁移到 MapBench 与 ReasonMap 仍有提升，表明空间推理能力被真正扩展。
AI.conclusion: RLVR 不仅放大预训练行为，还能突破原有空间推理边界，该结论对视觉-语言模型同样成立。

title: Privacy-Preserving Transfer Learning for Community Detection using Locally Distributed Multiple Networks
summary: Modern applications increasingly involve highly sensitive network data, where raw edges cannot be shared due to privacy constraints. We propose \texttt{TransNet}, a new spectral clustering-based transfer learning framework that improves community detection on a \emph{target network} by leveraging heterogeneous, locally stored, and privacy-preserved auxiliary \emph{source networks}. Our focus is the \textit{local differential privacy} regime, in which each local data provider perturbs edges via \textit{randomized response} before release, requiring no trusted third party. \texttt{TransNet} aggregates source eigenspaces through a novel adaptive weighting scheme that accounts for both privacy and heterogeneity, and then regularizes the weighted source eigenspace with the target eigenspace to optimally balance the two. Theoretically, we establish an error-bound-oracle property: the estimation error for the aggregated eigenspace depends only on \textit{informative sources}, ensuring robustness when some sources are highly heterogeneous or heavily privatized. We further show that the error bound of \texttt{TransNet} is no greater than that of estimators using only the target network or only (weighted) sources. Empirically, \texttt{TransNet} delivers strong gains across a range of privacy levels and heterogeneity patterns. For completeness, we also present \texttt{TransNetX}, an extension based on Gaussian perturbation of projection matrices under the assumption that trusted local data curators are available.

AI.tldr: 针对本地差分隐私下的敏感网络数据共享难题，提出基于谱聚类的迁移学习框架 TransNet，通过自适应加权聚合多源扰动网络的特征空间，实现目标网络社区检测增强，并给出误差上界仅受信息源影响的理论保证。
AI.motivation: 现代应用的网络数据高度敏感，原始边信息因隐私限制无法直接共享，而现有社区检测方法难以在本地差分隐私场景下利用外部辅助网络提升目标网络性能。
AI.method: 设计 TransNet：各数据提供方先以随机响应机制本地扰动边（无需可信第三方）；提出自适应加权方案聚合源网络特征空间，兼顾隐私噪声与网络异质性；再以正则化方式将加权源空间与目标空间融合，理论证明其误差界仅由“信息源”决定，且优于仅用目标或仅用源的方法。
AI.result: 在多种隐私预算与异质性设定下，TransNet 显著优于基线；理论给出误差上界 oracle 性质，且该界不高于仅使用目标或仅使用加权源的估计器；扩展版本 TransNetX 在存在可信本地 curator 时，通过高斯扰动投影矩阵进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: TransNet 首次在本地差分隐私约束下实现多源网络特征空间的有效迁移，为隐私保护场景下的社区检测提供了可扩展、鲁棒且理论有保障的解决方案。

title: ArtiCAD: Articulated CAD Assembly Design via Multi-Agent Code Generation
summary: Parametric Computer-Aided Design (CAD) of articulated assemblies is essential for product development, yet generating these multi-part, movable models from high-level descriptions remains unexplored. To address this, we propose ArtiCAD, the first training-free multi-agent system capable of generating editable, articulated CAD assemblies directly from text or images. Our system divides this complex task among four specialized agents: Design, Generation, Assembly, and Review. One of our key insights is to predict assembly relationships during the initial design stage rather than the assembly stage. By utilizing a Connector that explicitly defines attachment points and joint parameters, ArtiCAD determines these relationships before geometry generation, effectively bypassing the limited spatial reasoning capabilities of current LLMs and VLMs. To further ensure high-quality outputs, we introduce validation steps in the generation and assembly stages, accompanied by a cross-stage rollback mechanism that accurately isolates and corrects design- and code-level errors. Additionally, a self-evolving experience store accumulates design knowledge to continuously improve performance on future tasks. Extensive evaluations on three datasets (ArtiCAD-Bench, CADPrompt, and ACD) validate the effectiveness of our approach. We further demonstrate the applicability of ArtiCAD in requirement-driven conceptual design, physical prototyping, and the generation of embodied AI training assets through URDF export.

AI.tldr: ArtiCAD 是首个无需训练的多智能体系统，可直接根据文本或图像生成可编辑的关节 CAD 装配体，在生成前即预测装配关系，并通过验证-回滚与经验库持续优化。
AI.motivation: 传统参数化 CAD 难以从高层描述自动生成多部件可动装配体，现有大模型空间推理弱，装配关系常被留到几何生成后处理，导致错误累积、不可编辑。
AI.method: 1) 四智能体协作：Design→Generation→Assembly→Review；2) Connector 先验：在几何生成前显式定义连接点与关节参数，绕过 LLM/VLM 空间推理短板；3) 两阶段验证+跨阶段回滚，定位并修复设计与代码级错误；4) 自演化经验库持续沉淀设计知识。
