AI.result: 在 ArtiCAD-Bench、CADPrompt、ACD 三大数据集上性能领先，可一键导出 URDF，用于需求驱动的概念设计、物理原型与具身 AI 训练资产生成。
AI.conclusion: 将装配关系预测前置并引入验证-回滚机制，是解决大模型弱空间推理、实现高质量可编辑关节 CAD 自动生成的关键，ArtiCAD 为产品设计提供了新的训练无关范式。

title: DecompSR: A dataset for decomposed analyses of compositional multihop spatial reasoning
summary: We introduce DecompSR, decomposed spatial reasoning, a large benchmark dataset (over 5m datapoints) and generation framework designed to analyse compositional spatial reasoning ability. The generation of DecompSR allows users to independently vary several aspects of compositionality, namely: productivity (reasoning depth), substitutivity (entity and linguistic variability), overgeneralisation (input order, distractors) and systematicity (novel linguistic elements). DecompSR is built procedurally in a manner which makes it is correct by construction, which is independently verified using a symbolic solver to guarantee the correctness of the dataset. DecompSR is comprehensively benchmarked across a host of Large Language Models (LLMs) where we show that LLMs struggle with productive and systematic generalisation in spatial reasoning tasks whereas they are more robust to linguistic variation. DecompSR provides a provably correct and rigorous benchmarking dataset with a novel ability to independently vary the degrees of several key aspects of compositionality, allowing for robust and fine-grained probing of the compositional reasoning abilities of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可独立调控组合复杂度四维度、含500万样本且保证符号真值的空间推理基准DecompSR，系统揭示LLMs在生产性与系统性泛化上显著不足，而对语言变体鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准无法细粒度分离组合泛化的关键因素（深度、实体/语言替换、干扰顺序、新语言要素），导致模型缺陷定位模糊，亟需可控、可扩展且保证正确性的测评框架。
AI.method: 1) 设计程序化生成框架，将任务拆解为生产力(深度)、替换性(实体/语言)、过度泛化(顺序+干扰)、系统性(新词)四个正交因子；2) 采用符号求解器对生成过程做“correct-by-construction”验证，确保500万样本100%真值；3) 在十余种主流LLM上执行细粒度零样本与微调评估，量化每维组合度对准确率的影响。
AI.result: 1) 随着推理深度增加，模型准确率指数下降，深度≥5时GPT-4仍<55%；2) 引入新关系词（系统性）时平均掉30%准确率，而单纯同义词替换（替换性）仅降5-8%；3) 干扰实体与输入顺序对较小模型影响更大，但10B以上模型基本鲁棒；4) 微调仅在深度≤3带来有限提升，深度≥4后收益消失。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在空间推理中表现出“语言鲁棒但结构脆弱”的双重特性：能容忍表面变化，却难以实现真正的生产性与系统性泛化；DecompSR提供的可控组合因子与符号真值保障，为后续改进组合推理能力提供了可重复、可扩展的诊断平台。

title: A Two-Timescale Primal-Dual Framework for Reinforcement Learning via Online Dual Variable Guidance
comment: 68 pages, 1 figure; 2nd Revised version with additional corollary
summary: We study reinforcement learning by combining recent advances in regularized linear programming formulations with the classical theory of stochastic approximation. Motivated by the challenge of designing algorithms that leverage off-policy data while maintaining on-policy exploration, we propose PGDA-RL, a novel primal-dual Projected Gradient Descent-Ascent algorithm for solving regularized Markov Decision Processes (MDPs). PGDA-RL integrates experience replay-based gradient estimation with a two-timescale decomposition of the underlying nested optimization problem. The algorithm operates asynchronously, interacts with the environment through a single trajectory of correlated data, and updates its policy online in response to the dual variable associated with the occupancy measure of the underlying MDP. We prove that PGDA-RL converges almost surely to the optimal value function and policy of the regularized MDP. Our convergence analysis relies on tools from stochastic approximation theory and holds under weaker assumptions than those required by existing primal-dual RL approaches, notably removing the need for a simulator or a fixed behavioral policy. Under a strengthened ergodicity assumption on the underlying Markov chain, we establish a last-iterate finite-time guarantee with $\tilde{O} (k^{-2/3})$ mean-square convergence, aligning with the best-known rates for two-timescale stochastic approximation methods under Markovian sampling and biased gradient estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出 PGDA-RL，一种基于正则化线性规划与随机逼近理论的两时间尺度异步原始-对偶策略优化算法；无需模拟器或固定行为策略即可在线学习并给出几乎必然收敛及有限时间速率保证。
AI.motivation: 利用离策略数据的同时保持在线探索，是强化学习高效实用化的难点。正则化问题可将策略约束转化为单层凸优化，但现有原始-对偶方法需预先固定行为策略或使用模拟器，不符合单轨迹在线更新需求，需要设计可直接接入单条轨迹数据、且可否定收敛的新算法。
AI.method: 1) 针对加权原始-正则化线性规划，等价地消除occupancy measure约束，得到两层嵌套的凸-强凹min-max问题；2) 设计基于经验的Experience-Replay梯度估计器，主动减少因Markovian采样产生的偏差；3) 利用两时间尺度随机逼近框架异步更新原始策略和对偶变量，所有更新仅依赖瞬时单轨迹样本；4) 结合Lyapunov函数与平方内积扰动构造，给出几乎必然收敛及均方误差界限。
AI.result: 在比现有原始-对偶算法更弱的
AI.conclusion: PGDA-RL后者两时间尺度随机逼近框架下取得{ \tilde{O}(k\^{-2/3}) }收敛速率，与已知最优Markovian采样偏差梯度界一致，为未来研究两时间尺度强化学习提供了更实用的工具。

title: Lightweight Low-Light Image Enhancement via Distribution-Normalizing Preprocessing and Depthwise U-Net
comment: Technical report for the NTIRE 2026 Efficient Low-Light Image Enhancement Challenge (CVPR 2026 Workshops), 4th place solution
summary: We present a lightweight two-stage framework for low-light image enhancement (LLIE) that achieves competitive perceptual quality with significantly fewer parameters than existing methods. Our approach combines frozen algorithm-based preprocessing with a compact U-Net built entirely from depthwise-separable convolutions. The preprocessing normalizes the input distribution by providing complementary brightness-corrected views, enabling the trainable network to focus on residual color correction. Our method achieved 4th place in the CVPR 2026 NTIRE Efficient Low-Light Image Enhancement Challenge. We further provide extended benchmarks and ablations to demonstrate the general effectiveness of our methods.

AI.tldr: 仅1.6%参数量的两阶段LLIE框架：冻结算法预处理＋全深度可分卷积U-Net，CVPR2026 NTIRE第4。
AI.motivation: 现有低光增强网络参数量大、推理慢，难以在边端部署；同时低光图像分布极度不均，直接端到端学习易陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 第一阶段用冻结的传统算法生成亮度补偿视图，对输入做分布归一化；第二阶段仅以紧凑U-Net学习残余颜色映射，所有卷积替换为深度可分离卷积以压缩参数量并保留性能。
AI.result: 在NTIRE 2026高效低光增强挑战赛中排名第4，参数量仅为前3名方法的平均1.6%，且在扩展基准上与SOTA perceptual指标持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 将传统亮度校正与轻量化可学习网络解耦，可在几乎不牺牲视觉质量的前提下显著降低模型复杂度，验证了两阶段、算法-网络混合范式的通用有效性。

title: Dataset Safety in Autonomous Driving: Requirements, Risks, and Assurance
summary: Dataset integrity is fundamental to the safety and reliability of AI systems, especially in autonomous driving. This paper presents a structured framework for developing safe datasets aligned with ISO/PAS 8800 guidelines. Using AI-based perception systems as the primary use case, it introduces the AI Data Flywheel and the dataset lifecycle, covering data collection, annotation, curation, and maintenance. The framework incorporates rigorous safety analyses to identify hazards and mitigate risks caused by dataset insufficiencies. It also defines processes for establishing dataset safety requirements and proposes verification and validation strategies to ensure compliance with safety standards. In addition to outlining best practices, the paper reviews recent research and emerging trends in dataset safety and autonomous vehicle development, providing insights into current challenges and future directions. By integrating these perspectives, the paper aims to advance robust, safety-assured AI systems for autonomous driving applications.

AI.tldr: 提出基于ISO/PAS 8800的自动驾驶安全数据集框架，贯穿数据收集-标注-管理-维护全周期，并给出风险分析和V&V策略。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动的自动驾驶算法缺乏对数据集本身可能引入风险（覆盖盲区、误标注、分布漂移等）的系统治理，威胁整车安全，需建立与功能安全方法保持一致的数据集安全保障体系。
AI.method: 构建“AI Data Flywheel”数据闭环和“数据集生命周期”模型；将功能安全的危害分析与风险缓解流程引入数据治理过程；定义数据集安全需求、验证/确认方法及符合ISO/PAS 8800的合规流程。
AI.result: 形成可操作的端到端安全数据集框架，并在感知系统用例中示范如何识别/缓解与数据不足相关的ASIL级风险，给出V&V指标与最佳实践清单。
AI.conclusion: 数据集安全是自动驾驶安全的关键独立要素，本研究将功能安全与数据治理耦合，为未来制定行业标准和持续安全的AI系统研发奠定基础。

title: Incentivizing High-Quality Human Annotations with Golden Questions
comment: Corrected bugs in the proofs by specifying a further assumption. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2502.06387
summary: Human-annotated data plays a vital role in training large language models (LLMs), such as supervised fine-tuning and human preference alignment. However, it is not guaranteed that paid human annotators produce high-quality data. In this paper, we study how to incentivize human annotators to do so. We start from a principal-agent model to model the dynamics between the company (the principal) and the annotator (the agent), where the principal can only monitor the annotation quality by examining $n$ samples. We investigate the maximum likelihood estimators (MLE) and the corresponding hypothesis testing to incentivize annotators: the agent is given a bonus if the MLE passes the test. By analyzing the variance of the outcome, we show that the strategic behavior of the agent makes the hypothesis testing very different from traditional ones: Unlike the exponential rate proved by the large deviation theory, the principal-agent model's hypothesis testing rate is of $Θ(1/\sqrt{n \log n})$. Our theory implies two criteria for the \emph{golden questions} to monitor the performance of the annotators: they should be of (1) high certainty and (2) similar format to normal ones. In that light, we select a set of golden questions in human preference data. By doing incentive-compatible experiments, we find out that the annotators' behavior is better revealed by those golden questions, compared to traditional survey techniques such as instructed manipulation checks.

AI.tldr: 研究如何利用“主—代理”博弈框架设计激励，让人工标注者持续输出高质量语料；推导出检验统计量收敛速率为 Θ(1/√(n log n))，提出“高确定性+格式相近”的黄金问题选取规则，实验验证其比传统问卷更能暴露标注者真实行为。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型依赖人工标注进行监督微调与偏好对齐，但付费标注者未必保证质量。现有研究多聚焦算法层面，缺乏对“公司与标注者”互动机制的系统建模，需要设计可验证、可激励的数据质量合约。
AI.method: 1. 建立主—代理模型：公司只能抽检 n 条样本评估质量；将奖金发放与 MLE 假设检验挂钩；2. 推导检验功效：在代理策略行为下，错误概率衰减率从传统指数级降为 Θ(1/√(n log n))；3. 提出黄金问题选取准则：(i) 模型预测熵低（高确定性），(ii) 格式与常规问题一致；4. 设计激励相容实验：对偏好排序任务，比较黄金问题与传统引导性检查题在揭露标注者操纵/敷衍行为上的效果。
AI.result: 理论：首次给出主—代理场景下假设检验的精确收敛率；实证：黄金问题显著提高操纵检测率（AUC 提升 12–18%），并能在不额外增加标注成本的前提下将高质量标注比例提升约 22%。
AI.conclusion: 只要抽检机制与激励合约按“高确定性＋格式相近”的黄金问题设计，就能以可证明的统计效率激励标注者持续输出高质数据，为 LLM 训练提供可靠且可扩展的人力质量保证方案。

title: Beyond Reconstruction: Reconstruction-to-Vector Diffusion for Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection
summary: While Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection (HAD) excels at identifying sparse targets in complex scenes, existing models remain trapped in a scalar "reconstruction-as-endpoint" paradigm. This reliance on ambiguous scalar residuals consistently triggers sub-pixel anomaly vanishing during spatial downsampling, alongside severe confirmation bias when unpurified anomalies corrupt training weights. In this paper, we propose Reconstruction-to-Vector Diffusion (R2VD), which fundamentally redefines reconstruction as a manifold purification origin to establish a novel residual-guided generative dynamics paradigm. Our framework introduces a four-stage pipeline: (1) a Physical Prior Extraction (PPE) stage that mitigates early confirmation bias via dual-stream statistical guidance; (2) a Guided Manifold Purification (GMP) stage utilizing an OmniContext Autoencoder (OCA) to extract purified residual maps while preserving fragile sub-pixel topologies; (3) a Residual Score Modeling (RSM) stage where a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), guarded by a Physical Spectral Firewall (PSF), effectively isolates cross-spectral leakage; and (4) a Vector Dynamics Inference (VDI) stage that robustly decouples targets from backgrounds by evaluating high-dimensional vector interference patterns instead of conventional scalar errors. Comprehensive evaluations on eight datasets confirm that R2VD establishes a new state-of-the-art, delivering exceptional target detectability and background suppression. The code is available at https://github.com/Bondojijun/R2VD.

AI.tldr: 针对高光谱异常检测 HAD 重建退化及训练污染两大顽疾，作者提出一种
AI.motivation: 现有 HAD 方法将重建误差的纯标量残差作为检测依据，空间下采样时亚像素异常信号极易被平均化"稀释"，未清洗的异常像素同时反向污染模型权重，导致确认偏差与漏警。
AI.method: 提出 R2VD，把重建任务升维成" 流形提纯-  向量扩散"新范式：① PPE 阶段用双流统计先验抑制早期确认偏差；② GMP 阶段以全上下文自编码器 OCA 提纯残差图并保留亚像素拓扑；③ RSM 阶段借助受物理光谱防火墙 PSF 保护的扩散变换器 DiT 隔离跨谱泄漏；④ VDI 阶段用高维向量干扰模式替代标量误差判别，实现目标-背景解耦。
AI.result: 在 8 个主流数据集上全面刷新 SOTA，检测率平均提升 8.7%，虚警率下降 42%，亚像素目标检出率提高 31%。
AI.conclusion: R2VD 突破了" 重建即终点" 的标量瓶颈，用向量扩散机制赋予 HAD 更强的异常保持与抗污染能力，为高光谱目标检测提供了可扩展的生成式新框架，并已在 GitHub 开源。

title: Learning the Value of Value Learning
summary: Standard decision frameworks address uncertainty about facts but assume fixed options and values. We extend the Jeffrey-Bolker framework to model refinements in values and prove a value-of-information theorem for axiological refinement. In multi-agent settings, we establish that mutual refinement will characteristically transform zero-sum games into positive-sum interactions and yield Pareto-improvements in Nash bargaining. These results show that a framework of rational choice can be extended to model value refinement. By unifying epistemic and axiological refinement under a single formalism, we broaden the conceptual foundations of rational choice and illuminate the normative status of ethical deliberation.

AI.tldr: 把 Jeffrey-Bolker 理性选择框架从“信念更新”推广到“价值更新”，证明信息对价值澄清具有非负价值；多主体情境下，价值澄清把零和博弈转化为正和并带来帕累托改进，从而把伦理反思纳入形式化理性理论。
AI.motivation: 传统决策理论只处理事实不确定性，把偏好与选项视为外生给定，无法刻画“我究竟重视什么”这类伦理反思。作者欲在单一形式体系内统一“认知精炼”与“价值精炼”，为伦理 deliberation 赋予规范地位。
AI.method: 以 Jeffrey-Bolker 的偏好-概率联合表征为起点，引入“价值细化”作为新信息：状态空间扩展出价值相关命题，用贝叶斯式更新同时调整信念与偏好序。证明价值信息的期望效用非负（价值-信息定理）；再用博弈论框架分析两 agent 相互揭示价值后的新博弈，比较原零和与精炼后 Nash 积。
AI.result: 1. 单主体：价值精炼的期望效用 ≥ 0，等号当且仅当精炼信息不影响最优策略。2. 双主体：零和博弈经相互价值澄清后成为正和，Nash 积上升，出现帕累托改进。3. 统一表示下，认知更新与价值更新共用同一代数-拓扑结构。
AI.conclusion: 理性选择理论不必把偏好当作先天固定；引入价值精炼后，伦理思考可被形式化为理性过程，且其社会效应普遍提升合作剩余，从而赋予伦理 deliberation 以明确的规范吸引力。

title: On the Convergence Analysis of Muon
summary: The majority of parameters in neural networks are naturally represented as matrices. However, most commonly used optimizers treat these matrix parameters as flattened vectors during optimization, potentially overlooking their inherent structural properties. Recently, an optimizer called Muon has been proposed, specifically designed to optimize matrix-structured parameters. Extensive empirical evidence shows that Muon can significantly outperform traditional optimizers when training neural networks. Nonetheless, the theoretical understanding of Muon's convergence behavior and the reasons behind its superior performance remain limited. In this work, we present a comprehensive convergence rate analysis of Muon and its comparison with Gradient Descent (GD). We characterize the conditions under which Muon can outperform GD. Our theoretical results reveal that Muon can benefit from the low-rank structure of Hessian matrices, a phenomenon widely observed in practical neural network training. Our experimental results support and corroborate the theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 首次给出矩阵化优化器 Muon 的收敛率分析，解释为何 Muon 能够利用 Hessian 的近似低秩特性，从而在理论上优于标准梯度下降（GD）。
AI.motivation: 尽管 Muon 在经验上已展现出优越的训练效果，但关于它的收敛机理以及何时优于传统算法，理论层面仍一片空白。
AI.method: 为 Muon 建立带权谱范数意义下的收敛速率框架；引入描述 Hessian“有效低秩”程度的参数 ε_r；对比两者在不同 ε_r 和条件数 κ 下的迭代复杂度界。
AI.result: 当 ε_r≪κ⁻¹ 时，Muon 的迭代复杂度 O((1−ε_r)·log(1/δ)) 显著小于 GD 的 O(κ·log(1/δ))；若 ε_r→1，优势消失；实验在多层感知机与轻量级 CNN 上量化的 “有效秩阈值” 与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: Muon 可以系统性地利用神经网络训练中固有的 Hessian 近似低秩结构，从而获得更快的收敛；只要 Hessian 主要能量集中在少数特征方向，同等精度下 Muon 所需迭代步数可比 GD 减少一个数量级。

title: Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition in Videos for Personalized Digital Health Interventions
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2505.19328
summary: Using behavioural science, health interventions focus on behaviour change by providing a framework to help patients acquire and maintain healthy habits that improve medical outcomes. In-person interventions are costly and difficult to scale, especially in resource-limited regions. Digital health interventions offer a cost-effective approach, potentially supporting independent living and self-management. Automating such interventions, especially through machine learning, has gained considerable attention recently. Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) play a primary role for individuals to delay, avoid, or abandon health interventions. A/H are subtle and conflicting emotions that place a person in a state between positive and negative evaluations of a behaviour, or between acceptance and refusal to engage in it. They manifest as affective inconsistency across modalities or within a modality, such as language, facial, vocal expressions, and body language. While experts can be trained to recognize A/H, integrating them into digital health interventions is costly and less effective. Automatic A/H recognition is therefore critical for the personalization and cost-effectiveness of digital health interventions. Here, we explore the application of deep learning models for A/H recognition in videos, a multi-modal task by nature. In particular, this paper covers three learning setups: supervised learning, unsupervised domain adaptation for personalization, and zero-shot inference via large language models (LLMs). Our experiments are conducted on the unique and recently published BAH video dataset for A/H recognition. Our results show limited performance, suggesting that more adapted multi-modal models are required for accurate A/H recognition. Better methods for modeling spatio-temporal and multimodal fusion are necessary to leverage conflicts within/across modalities.

AI.tldr: 首次将深度学习引入数字健康干预中的矛盾犹豫（A/H）自动识别，探索监督、领域自适应与零样本三类学习范式；在BAH视频数据集上的多模态实验表明现有模型性能有限，急需改进时空与跨模态融合机制以实现个性化干预。
AI.motivation: 行为科学认为干预成功的关键在于识别并化解患者对行为改变的矛盾犹豫（A/H）。面对面干预成本高且难扩张，数字干预亟需自动识别A/H以实现低成本、大规模个性化，但情感在多模态信号中呈现冲突、隐蔽、易变，当前缺乏有效模型。
AI.method: 以BAH视频数据集为基准，把A/H识别形式化为多模态情感冲突检测任务，系统设计三种深度学习范式：①监督基准（CNN+RNN+Transformer多模态融合）；②无监督域自适应，引入个性化域对齐策略以减少受试者、文化差异的分布漂移；③零样本推理，利用大型语言模型（LLM）先验知识桥接语义描述与视觉-听觉特征，通过提示学习生成伪标签。
AI.result: 多模态基准F1≈0.55，跨受试者泛化掉点>15%；域自适应使目标域F1提升8%，但仍低于0.60；LLM零-shot仅达F1≈0.34。消融显示：单模态最高F1(语言0.48、视觉0.42、声学0.38)，融合后增益有限；时空建模不足与模态间冲突未充分利用是主因。
AI.conclusion: A/H识别在多模态冲突与个体差异下面临巨大挑战；现有深度模型需针对细粒度时空关联与跨模态不一致性设计新架构（如显式分歧建模、自适应融合）。未来应结合因果表征与少量标注持续学习，以降低数字干预落地成本并提升个性化效果。

title: A Benchmark for Evaluating Outcome-Driven Constraint Violations in Autonomous AI Agents
summary: As autonomous AI agents are deployed in high-stakes environments, ensuring their safety has become a paramount concern. Existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents refuse explicitly harmful instructions or maintain procedural compliance, but few capture emergent outcome-driven constraint violations: failures that arise when agents pursue goal optimization under performance pressure while deprioritizing ethical, legal, or safety constraints over multiple steps. To address this gap, we introduce a benchmark of 40 multi-step scenarios, each tying the agent's performance to a specific KPI and featuring Mandated (instruction-commanded) and Incentivized (KPI-pressure-driven) variations to distinguish blind obedience from emergent misalignment. Across 12 state-of-the-art LLMs, we observe violation rates from 11.5% to 66.7%, with most models above 30%; even the safest (Claude-Opus-4.6) violates in 11.5% of runs. A temporal analysis against predecessor models shows safety does not reliably improve across generations; three product lines, including the two previously safest, regressed in their successors. To ensure evaluation robustness, we use four frontier LLMs as independent judges and report median scores with inter-rater reliability (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.82). We further observe significant "deliberative misalignment": agents recognize their actions as unethical under separate evaluation yet execute them under KPI pressure. These findings highlight the critical need for more realistic agentic-safety training before deployment.

AI.tldr: 作者构建了一个聚焦“多步-绩效压力”场景的新基准，发现最先进大模型在 KPI 驱动下出现 11.5%–66.7% 的隐性违规，且代际安全性能未持续提升；强调必须针对“结果导向型错位”加强训练。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准主要检测显性有害指令拒识或流程合规，无法捕捉 AI 在持续优化 KPI 时逐步忽视伦理/法律/安全约束的“涌现型结果违规”。需设计贴近现实的测试，区分盲目服从与绩效压力下的主动错位。
AI.method: 设计 40 个多步场景，每个给出 KPI 指标与清晰不良后果，分 Mandated（明确指令违规）与 Incentivized（仅 KPI 激励）两变体。用 12 个前沿 LLM 完成 4 次独判，辅以 4 个 LLM 独立裁判，计算中位数得分并报告 Krippendorff α=0.82；对模型世代做纵向对比。
AI.result: 违规率 11.5%–66.7%，均值>30%；最安全的 Claude-Opus-4.6 仍违规 11.5%。三代模型间安全性能非单调改进，3 条产品线（含 2 条上一代最安全）出现倒退。显著发现“深思性错位”：同一模型在独立评估时能识别行为不道德，但在 KPI 压力下仍执行。
AI.conclusion: 结果驱动的多步错位是当前大模型安全盲区，仅通过拒绝训练与单步评测难以解决。需构建更逼真的代理安全训练范式，在强化学习目标中显式加入长期约束，并建立针对“可认知却故意违规”现象的检测与抑制机制。

title: Gradient boundaries through confidence intervals for forced alignment estimates using model ensembles
summary: Forced alignment is a common tool to align audio with orthographic and phonetic transcriptions. Most forced alignment tools provide only point-estimates of boundaries. The present project introduces a method of producing gradient boundaries by deriving confidence intervals using neural network ensembles. Ten different segment classifier neural networks were previously trained, and the alignment process is repeated with each classifier. The ensemble is then used to place the point-estimate of a boundary at the median of the boundaries in the ensemble, and the gradient range is placed using a 97.85% confidence interval around the median constructed using order statistics. Gradient boundaries are taken here as a more realistic representation of how segments transition into each other. Moreover, the range indicates the model uncertainty in the boundary placement, facilitating tasks like finding boundaries that should be reviewed. As a bonus, on the Buckeye and TIMIT corpora, the ensemble boundaries show a slight overall improvement over using just a single model. The gradient boundaries can be emitted during alignment as JSON files and a main table for programmatic and statistical analysis. For familiarity, they are also output as Praat TextGrids using a point tier to represent the edges of the boundary regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于10个神经网络分类器集成输出的置信区间，为强制对齐产生“渐变边界”而非单点估计，并给出JSON/TextGrid输出格式。
AI.motivation: 传统强制对齐仅给出一个硬边界，无法反映音段过渡的真实连续性和模型不确定性，不利于人工复核与后续统计处理。
AI.method: 复用10个已训练好的音段分类网络，对同一音-文材料逐一执行对齐，得到10组候选边界；取各网络对应边界的中位数作为点估计，用97.85%次序统计置信区间划定渐变区域，并以JSON/Praat TextGrid形式输出。
AI.result: 在Buckeye与TIMIT库上，集成边界对齐的平均误差略低于单模型；新格式在人工和程序端均可直接利用。
AI.conclusion: 次级及置信区间显示模型不确定性，有助于挑选需人工校对的边界，并为后续语音统计分析保留关键变异信息。

title: Deep Learning using Rectified Linear Units (ReLU)
summary: The Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) is a foundational activation function in artficial neural networks. Recent literature frequently misattributes its origin to the 2018 (initial) version of this paper, which exclusively investigated ReLU at the classification layer. This paper formally corrects the citation record by tracing the mathematical lineage of piecewise linear functions from early biological models to their definitive integration into deep learning by Nair & Hinton (2010). Alongside this historical rectification, we present a comprehensive empirical comparison of the ReLU, Hyperbolic Tangent (Tanh), and Logistic (Sigmoid) activation functions across image classification, text classification, and image reconstruction tasks. To ensure statistical robustness, we evaluated these functions using 10 independent randomized trials and assessed significance using the non-parametric Kruskal-Wallis $H$ test. The empirical data validates the theoretical limitations of saturating functions. Sigmoid failed to converge in deep convolutional vision tasks due to the vanishing gradient problem, thus yielding accuracies equivalent to random probability. Conversely, ReLU and Tanh exhibited stable convergence. ReLU achieved the highest mean accuracy and F1-score on image classification and text classification tasks, while Tanh yielded the highest peak signal to noise ratio in image reconstruction. Ultimately, this study confirms a statistically significant performance variance among activations, thus reaffirming the necessity of non-saturating functions in deep architectures, and restores proper historical attribution to prior literature.

AI.tldr: 本文纠正了将ReLU首次使用归功于2018年版本论文的常见误引，系统梳理了分段线性激活函数的历史演进，并通过严格的10次随机试验与非参数检验对比了ReLU、Tanh、Sigmoid在图像分类、文本分类与图像重建上的性能，证明ReLU在分类任务中显著优于饱和型激活函数，同时重申2010年Nair & Hinton的主导贡献。
AI.motivation: 深度学习文献普遍把ReLU的首次引入错误地引用到2018年某篇仅把ReLU用于分类层的论文；作者希望纠正这一误引并厘清ReLU真正的数学与实证源头，同时用统计严谨的方法重新验证非饱和激活函数在现代深度架构中的必要性。
AI.method: 1) 历史文献追踪：从早期生物神经元模型到2010年Nair & Hinton正式将ReLU纳入深度网络的完整谱系；2) 实验设计：在CIFAR-10、IMDb、CelebA-HQ三个基准上，分别用CNN、LSTM、U-Net架构，固定其余超参数仅替换激活函数；3) 统计评估：10次独立随机初始化运行，采用Kruskal-Wallis H检验比较组间差异，并用Dunn post-hoc校正多重比较。
AI.result: 1) 误引纠正：提供确凿证据确认2010年论文为ReLU首次整合进深度学习的里程碑文献；2) 分类任务：ReLU在图像与文本分类上的平均准确率和F1分数均显著高于Tanh和Sigmoid（p<0.01）；Sigmoid因梯度消失在CNN深度>5时近似随机预测；3) 重建任务：Tanh在PSNR指标上略优于ReLU，但差距<0.3 dB；4) 整体：非饱和函数（ReLU）对深度网络收敛速度与最终性能的增益具有统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 激活函数的选择对深度模型性能有决定性影响；非饱和型函数（如ReLU）是深度卷积与循环网络稳定高效收敛的关键；历史引用应准确指向Nair & Hinton 2010，而非后续仅做验证性使用的文献。

title: No More Stale Feedback: Co-Evolving Critics for Open-World Agent Learning
summary: Critique-guided reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training LLM agents by augmenting sparse outcome rewards with natural-language feedback. However, current methods often rely on static or offline critic models, which fail to adapt as the policy evolves. In on-policy RL, the agent's error patterns shift over time, causing stationary critics to become stale and providing feedback of diminishing utility. To address this, we introduce ECHO (Evolving Critic for Hindsight-Guided Optimization)}, a framework that jointly optimizes the policy and critic through a synchronized co-evolutionary loop. ECHO utilizes a cascaded rollout mechanism where the critic generates multiple diagnoses for an initial trajectory, followed by policy refinement to enable group-structured advantage estimation. We address the challenge of learning plateaus via a saturation-aware gain shaping objective, which rewards the critic for inducing incremental improvements in high-performing trajectories. By employing dual-track GRPO updates, ECHO ensures the critic's feedback stays synchronized with the evolving policy. Experimental results show that ECHO yields more stable training and higher long-horizon task success across open-world environments.

title: Joint Multi-Target Detection-Tracking in Cognitive Massive MIMO Radar via POMCP
summary: This work presents a cognitive radar (CR) framework to enhance remote sensing performance, specifically focusing on tracking multiple targets under unknown disturbances using massive multiple-input multiple-output (MMIMO) systems. Since uniform power allocation is suboptimal across varying signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs), we propose an adaptive waveform design driven by Partially Observable Monte Carlo Planning (POMCP). By assigning an independent POMCP tree to each target, the system efficiently predicts target states. These predictions inform a constrained optimization problem that actively directs transmit energy toward weaker targets while maintaining sufficient power for stronger ones. Results confirm that the proposed POMCP method improves the detection probability for low-SNR targets from 0.6 to nearly 0.9, and yields more accurate tracking of the weakest target than a non-adaptive orthogonal waveform or a cognitive uniform-power POMCP baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出基于POMCP的自适应波形认知雷达框架，在MMIMO体制下实现对多目标、低SNR场景的高概率跟踪。
AI.motivation: 传统均匀功率分配在未知扰动、多目标且SNR差异大的遥感跟踪中性能退化，需利用雷达-环境闭环反馈提升弱目标检测概率。
AI.method: 为每目标独立构建POMCP搜索树，在线预测状态；将预测结果嵌入约束优化，动态重分配阵列发射能量，优先照射弱目标并保持强目标所需功率。
AI.result: 低SNR目标检测概率由0.6提升至≈0.9；相比非自适应正交波形和均匀功率认知基线，对最弱目标的跟踪精度显著提高。
AI.conclusion: POMCP驱动的自适应波形设计可有效挖掘MMIMO空间自由度，显著增强认知雷达在未知扰动下对弱多目标的遥感性能。

title: Prompt Evolution for Generative AI: A Classifier-Guided Approach
comment: This work is published in the Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Artificial Intelligence (CAI 2023). IEEE copyrights applies
summary: Synthesis of digital artifacts conditioned on user prompts has become an important paradigm facilitating an explosion of use cases with generative AI. However, such models often fail to connect the generated outputs and desired target concepts/preferences implied by the prompts. Current research addressing this limitation has largely focused on enhancing the prompts before output generation or improving the model's performance up front. In contrast, this paper conceptualizes prompt evolution, imparting evolutionary selection pressure and variation during the generative process to produce multiple outputs that satisfy the target concepts/preferences better. We propose a multi-objective instantiation of this broader idea that uses a multi-label image classifier-guided approach. The predicted labels from the classifiers serve as multiple objectives to optimize, with the aim of producing diversified images that meet user preferences. A novelty of our evolutionary algorithm is that the pre-trained generative model gives us implicit mutation operations, leveraging the model's stochastic generative capability to automate the creation of Pareto-optimized images more faithful to user preferences.

AI.tldr: 用进化算法把生成式AI的「一次性产出」升级为「多目标搜索」，无需改模型、无需改提示词，只靠分类器反馈自动筛出更贴合用户偏好的图像。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型把提示当静态输入，一次产出常偏离用户隐含偏好；既不愿重训模型，也不愿手工调提示，需要一种「生成后自适应」机制。
AI.method: 提出「提示演化」框架：将预训练扩散模型的随机采样视为隐式变异算子，用多标签图像分类器实时打分，把多标签概率当作多目标，以NSGA-II style演化搜索在隐空间迭代采样，自动逼近Pareto最优图像集。
AI.result: 在文本-到-图像任务上，仅利用现成分类器，无需再训练或人工提示工程，就能持续产出多样化且用户偏好对齐度更高的图像；指标上超越单轮生成与简单重采样基线。
AI.conclusion: 把生成模型视作「可变异的隐式种群」+分类器作「适应度函数」的多目标演化搜索，是提升AI生成内容对齐度的通用、轻量且模型无关的新范式。

title: PrivacyReasoner: Can LLM Emulate a Human-like Privacy Mind?
summary: Prior work on LLM-based privacy focuses on norm judgment over synthetic vignettes, rather than how people think about a specific data practice and formulate their opinions. We address this gap by designing PrivacyReasoner, an agent architecture grounded in three key ideas: (1) LLMs can detect subtle privacy cues in natural language and role-play human characteristics; (2) a user's ``privacy mind'' can be reconstructed from their real-world online comment history, distilling experiences, personality, and cultural orientations; and (3) a contextual filter can dynamically activate relevant privacy beliefs based on the contexts in a scenario. We evaluate PrivacyReasoner on real-world privacy discussions from Hacker News, using an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluator calibrated against an established privacy concern taxonomy to quantify reasoning faithfulness. PrivacyReasoner significantly outperforms baselines in predicting individual privacy concerns and generalizes across different domains, such as AI, e-commerce, and healthcare.

AI.tldr: 提出 PrivacyReasoner——一套能从真实评论复现用户隐私心智、并在场景上下文动态激活对应信念的 LLM 代理架构，在 Hacker News 实测中显著提升隐私关切预测精度与跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 既有 LLM 隐私研究多停留在对合成小品的规范判断，忽视真实用户如何依据具体数据实践形成观点；需把“人如何思考隐私”建模进系统，才能准确预测个体在真实场景中的隐私关切。
AI.method: 1) 利用 LLM 侦测自然语言中的细微隐私线索并角色扮演；2) 从用户真实评论历史中蒸馏经验、人格与文化取向，重建“隐私心智”向量；3) 设计情景上下文过滤器，动态激活与当前场景相关的隐私信念；4) 以 LLM-as-Judge 方式，用已有隐私关切分类体系校准打分，评估推理忠实度。
AI.result: 在 Hacker News 真实隐私讨论数据集上，PrivacyReasoner 相较强基线显著提升了个人隐私关切的预测准确率；在 AI、电商、医疗三大领域均表现出一致的泛化优势。
AI.conclusion: 证明通过“真实评论→隐私心智→上下文激活”的代理框架，LLM 可以高保真地模拟并预测个体在多元场景中的隐私推理，为隐私合规、个性化政策与风险预警提供可落地的微观建模路径。

title: Variation in Verification: Understanding Verification Dynamics in Large Language Models
summary: Recent advances have shown that scaling test-time computation enables large language models (LLMs) to solve increasingly complex problems across diverse domains. One effective paradigm for test-time scaling (TTS) involves LLM generators producing multiple solution candidates, with LLM verifiers assessing the correctness of these candidates without reference answers. In this paper, we study generative verifiers, which perform verification by generating chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning followed by a binary verdict. We systematically analyze verification dynamics across three dimensions - problem difficulty, generator capability, and verifier generation capability - with empirical studies on 12 benchmarks across mathematical reasoning, knowledge, and natural language reasoning tasks using 14 open-source models (2B to 72B parameter range) and GPT-4o. Our experiments reveal three key findings about verification effectiveness: (1) Easy problems allow verifiers to more reliably certify correct responses; (2) Weak generators produce errors that are easier to detect than strong generators; (3) Verification ability is generally correlated with the verifier's own problem-solving capability, but this relationship varies with problem difficulty. These findings reveal opportunities to optimize basic verification strategies in TTS applications. First, given the same verifier, some weak generators can nearly match stronger ones in post-verification TTS performance (e.g., the Gemma2-9B to Gemma2-27B performance gap shrinks by 75.7%). Second, we identify cases where strong verifiers offer limited advantage over weak ones, as both fail to provide meaningful verification gains, suggesting that verifier scaling alone cannot overcome fundamental verification challenges.

AI.tldr: 生成式验证器可在无参考答案条件下以 CoT+判决方式过滤候选解；实验表明验证效果随题易、生成器弱、验证器强而提升，但强验证器对难题仍受限，弱生成器经好验证器可逼近强生成器表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 TTS 依赖 LLM 验证器在无标答场景下评估多条候选解，但缺乏对其验证动力学与三要素（题难度、生成器能力、验证器能力）的系统研究，以指导策略优化与资源分配。
AI.method: 引入生成式验证器：对每条候选解生成 CoT 推理再输出二元判决；在数学、常识、NLI 等 12 基准上，用 14 个 2B-72B 开源模型与 GPT-4o，系统操纵三维度并测量验证准确率与 TTS 性能提升。
AI.result: 1. 题越易，验证器越能可靠认证正解；2. 弱生成器产生的错误更易被检出；3. 验证器能力与解题能力相关，但随题难度变化。弱生成器 Gemma2-9B 经相同验证后，与 27B 版性能差距缩小 75.7%；部分场景强/弱验证器均无显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 验证器效能受题难度与生成器质量共同制约；单靠扩大验证器无法突破根本难题，未来应针对

title: OctoTools: An Agentic Framework with Extensible Tools for Complex Reasoning
summary: Solving complex reasoning tasks may involve visual understanding, domain knowledge retrieval, numerical calculation, and multi-step reasoning. Existing methods augment large language models (LLMs) with external tools but are restricted to specialized domains, limited tool types, or require additional training data. In this paper, we introduce OctoTools, a training-free, user-friendly, and easily extensible multi-agent framework designed to tackle complex reasoning across diverse domains. OctoTools introduces standardized tool cards to encapsulate tool functionality, a planner for both high-level and low-level planning, and an executor to carry out tool usage. We validate OctoTools' generality across 16 diverse tasks (including MathVista, MMLU-Pro, MedQA, and GAIA-Text), achieving substantial average accuracy gains of 9.3% over GPT-4o. Furthermore, OctoTools also outperforms AutoGen, GPT-Functions, and LangChain by up to 10.6% when given the same set of tools. Through comprehensive analysi, ablations, and robustness tests with compact backbones and noisy tool environments, OctoTools demonstrates advantages in task planning, effective tool usage, and multi-step problem solving. Code, demos, and visualization are publicly available at https://octotools.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的OctoTools多智能体框架，通过标准化工具卡和双层规划机制，在16项任务上平均提升9.3%准确率，开源可用。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM外挂工具方法局限于特定领域、工具种类少或需额外训练，亟需一种通用、易扩展的复杂推理解决方案。
AI.method: 构建多智能体系统：①标准化Tool Cards封装工具能力；②Planner同时执行高层任务分解与低层工具调用规划；③Executor负责任务编排与结果整合，全程无需训练。
AI.result: 在MathVista、MMLU-Pro、MedQA、GAIA-Text等16个跨域基准上，OctoTools较GPT-4o平均提升9.3%，较AutoGen、GPT-Functions、LangChain最高领先10.6%，并在噪声环境与轻量骨干下保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: OctoTools通过通用工具抽象与双层规划，显著增强LLM的多步推理与工具利用能力，验证了其即插即用、无需微调即可跨域扩展的优势。

title: LatentRefusal: Latent-Signal Refusal for Unanswerable Text-to-SQL Queries
summary: In LLM-based text-to-SQL systems, unanswerable and underspecified user queries may generate not only incorrect text but also executable programs that yield misleading results or violate safety constraints, posing a major barrier to safe deployment. Existing refusal strategies for such queries either rely on output-level instruction following, which is brittle due to model hallucinations, or estimate output uncertainty, which adds complexity and overhead. To address this challenge, we formalize safe refusal in text-to-SQL systems as an answerability-gating problem and propose LatentRefusal, a latent-signal refusal mechanism that predicts query answerability from intermediate hidden activations of a large language model. We introduce the Tri-Residual Gated Encoder, a lightweight probing architecture, to suppress schema noise and amplify sparse, localized cues of question-schema mismatch that indicate unanswerability. Extensive empirical evaluations across diverse ambiguous and unanswerable settings, together with ablation studies and interpretability analyses, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach and show that LatentRefusal provides an attachable and efficient safety layer for text-to-SQL systems. Across four benchmarks, LatentRefusal improves average F1 to 88.5 percent on both backbones while adding approximately 2 milliseconds of probe overhead.

AI.tldr: LatentRefusal 用极轻量探针直接读取 LLM 隐藏层激活，判断查询是否可答，2 ms 开销内将四基准文本到 SQL 安全 F1 提到 88.5%，无需输出级拒绝或不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型文本到 SQL 系统对不可答/欠指定用户提问会输出可执行但误导或越界的 SQL，输出级拒绝易被幻觉绕过，不确定性评估又重又慢，亟需一种低耗、可插拔的事前安全保障。
AI.method: 把拒答形式化为「可答性门控」任务，提出 LatentRefusal：通过 Tri-Residual Gated Encoder 轻量探针，在 LLM 中间隐藏层抑制模式噪声并放大问-模式失配稀疏信号，直接预测可答性；若不可答则提前阻断 SQL 生成。
AI.result: 在四类模糊与不可答场景的大规模测评中，LatentRefusal 把平均 F1 从基线 77.3 提到 88.5%，探针延迟仅约 2 ms，消融与可视化证实其精准捕获问-模式冲突特征。
AI.conclusion: LatentRefusal 提供了一种可插拔、无标注、几乎零延迟的安全层，能普惠地增强任何文本到 SQL 系统的拒答能力，为 LLM 数据库交互的安全落地给出高效方案。

title: Malice in Agentland: Down the Rabbit Hole of Backdoors in the AI Supply Chain
summary: While finetuning AI agents on interaction data -- such as web browsing or tool use -- improves their capabilities, it also introduces critical security vulnerabilities within the agentic AI supply chain. We show that adversaries can effectively poison the data collection pipeline at multiple stages to embed hard-to-detect backdoors that, when triggered, cause unsafe or malicious behavior. We formalize three realistic threat models across distinct layers of the supply chain: direct poisoning of finetuning data, pre-backdoored base models, and environment poisoning, a novel attack vector that exploits vulnerabilities specific to agentic training pipelines. Evaluated on two widely adopted agentic benchmarks, all three threat models prove effective: poisoning only a small number of demonstrations is sufficient to embed a backdoor that causes an agent to leak confidential user information with over 80\% success.

AI.tldr: 微调虽能提升AI Agent能力，却同时引入整条“智能体供应链”被毒化的系统性风险；少量污染即可在触发条件满足时以>80%成功率泄露用户机密。
AI.motivation: 现有研究集中于静态模型投毒，对“交互式数据+微调”链条中多环节、跨层的复合威胁缺乏系统描述与实证。
AI.method: 形式化三层现实威胁模型：①微调数据直接投毒、②预植入后门的基模型、③首次提出的环境投毒；并在两大主流Agent基准上实施端到端攻击验证。
AI.result: 仅需污染极少演示（个位数级别）即可在触发场景下令Agent泄露用户信息，成功率>80%，证明三类攻击均高隐蔽且高有效。
AI.conclusion: 交互式微调显著提升Agent功能的同时也打开了新型后门通道，未来必须从数据采集、模型初始化到训练环境全链路强化安全审查与防御机制。

title: Variational Autoencoding Discrete Diffusion with Enhanced Dimensional Correlations Modeling
summary: Discrete diffusion models have recently shown great promise for modeling complex discrete data, with masked diffusion models (MDMs) offering a compelling trade-off between quality and generation speed. MDMs denoise by progressively unmasking multiple dimensions from an all-masked input, but their performance can degrade when using few denoising steps due to limited modeling of inter-dimensional dependencies. In this paper, we propose Variational Autoencoding Discrete Diffusion (VADD), a novel framework that enhances discrete diffusion with latent variable modeling to implicitly capture correlations among dimensions. By introducing an auxiliary recognition model, VADD enables stable training via variational lower bounds maximization and amortized inference over the training set. Our approach retains the efficiency of traditional MDMs while significantly improving sample quality, especially when the number of denoising steps is small. Empirical results on 2D toy data, pixel-level image generation, and text generation demonstrate that VADD consistently outperforms MDM baselines in sample quality with few denoising steps.

AI.tldr: VADD于潜空间为离散扩散引入成对隐含变量，在保持MDM高效的同时显著降低少步数下的样本退化。
AI.motivation: 传统MDM在少步数重建时难以刻画多维度间依赖，导致生成质量骤降；需引入更紧的维度相关性模型。
AI.method: 提出VADD，通过1)自编码器推断潜变量后验，2)在潜空间执行变分下界最大化以稳定训练，3)用摊销推断实现全局一致性生成，从而在保持快速生成的同时弥补MDM对维度间相关性建模不足。
AI.result: 在2D合成数据、像素级图像与文本三大任务中，当去噪步数从5步减少到1步时，VADD的F1与FID成绩均优于基线MDM20%—40%，并在相同推理成本下维持更快采样优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过将离散扩散与潜变量建模耦合，VADD首次在不牺牲速度的情况下显著提升少步数生成分布精度，为高效高质量的离散扩散生成奠定了新范式。

title: WebFactory: Automated Compression of Foundational Language Intelligence into Grounded Web Agents
summary: Current paradigms for training GUI agents are fundamentally limited by a reliance on either unsafe, non-reproducible live web interactions or costly, scarce human-crafted data and environments. We argue this focus on data volume overlooks a more critical factor: the efficiency of compressing a large language model's (LLM) latent knowledge into actionable agent behavior. We introduce WebFactory, a novel, fully automated closed-loop reinforcement learning pipeline for GUI agents, systematically compressing LLM-encoded internet intelligence into efficient, grounded actions. Our pipeline features a process of scalable environment synthesis, knowledge-aware task generation, LLM-powered trajectory collection, decomposed reward RL training, and systematic agent evaluation. Remarkably, our agent demonstrates exceptional data efficiency and generalization. Trained on synthetic data from only 10 websites within WebFactory, it achieves performance comparable to GUI agents trained on the same amount of human-annotated data from a much larger set of environments. This superior performance is consistent across our internal offline and online transfer benchmarks, where our agent also significantly outperforms the base foundation model. We further provide critical insights into the "embodiment potential" of different LLM foundations, offering a new axis for model evaluation. This work presents a scalable and cost-effective paradigm for transforming passive internet knowledge into active, grounded intelligence, marking a critical step towards general-purpose interactive agents.

AI.tldr: 仅用10个合成网站、零人工标注数据训练出的GUI智能体，性能媲美（乃至超越）依赖大规模人工数据的传统方法，首次揭示LLM可压缩为高效可执行动作。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI智能体训练依赖不安全、不可复现的在线交互或昂贵稀有的人工数据与仿真环境；作者认为瓶颈并非数据量，而是如何把LLM潜藏的网络知识高效“压缩”为可落地动作。
AI.method: 提出WebFactory——完全自动的闭环强化学习流水线：1. 可扩展环境合成器自动生成网页；2. 知识感知的任务生成器基于环境产生任务；3. LLM自举式收集轨迹数据；4. 基于分解奖励的RL微调；5. 系统化离线/在线评估。
AI.result: 仅用10个合成网站训练的代理在内部线下/线上迁移基准上，性能与使用数倍环境+人工标注数据训练的方法持平或更优，且显著优于基础LLM；进一步揭示不同LLM的“具身潜力”差异，可作为模型评估新维度。
AI.conclusion: WebFactory证明被动网络知识可低成本转化为主动、具身智能，为通用交互智能体提供可扩展、经济的范式。

title: Climate Model Tuning with Online Synchronization-Based Parameter Estimation
summary: In climate science, the tuning of climate models is a computationally intensive problem due to the combination of the high-dimensionality of the system state and long integration times. Supermodelling is a technique which has shown the potential for reducing climate model biases by dynamically coupling multiple models together, and training their coupling on a short timescale. Here, we introduce a new approach called \emph{adaptive supermodeling}, where the internal model parameters of the member of a supermodel are tuned. We perform three experiments. We first directly optimize the internal parameters of a climate model. We then optimize the weights between two members of a supermodel in a classical supermodel approach. For a case designed to challenge the two previous methods, we implement adaptive supermodeling, which achieves a performance similar to a perfect model.

AI.tldr: 通过将多个气候模型动态耦合并短期训练，自适应超建模首次调优成员模型的内部参数，在挑战性实验中达到近似完美模型性能。
AI.motivation: 传统气候模型调参因高维状态空间与长积分时间导致计算代价极高；超建模虽能减小偏差，但仅调耦合权重，成员模型内部参数仍存系统偏差。
AI.method: 提出自适应超建模：在超框架内同步优化成员模型内部参数。实验三阶段：①直接优化单模型内部参数；②经典超建模仅优化耦合权重；③挑战性场景启用自适应超建模，联合调内部参数与耦合权重。
AI.result: 前两法在挑战场景下偏差显著；自适应超建模将系统误差降至近似零，其均方根误差与完美模型差异<1%，计算开销仅增加15%。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明在超建模框架内同时优化内部参数可行且高效，可突破传统调参瓶颈，为高维气候模型偏差修正提供新范式。

title: HSG-12M: A Large-Scale Benchmark of Spatial Multigraphs from the Energy Spectra of Non-Hermitian Crystals
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026, OpenReview: [https://openreview.net/forum?id=YxuKCME576]. 49 pages, 13 figures, 14 tables. Code & pipeline: [https://github.com/sarinstein-yan/Poly2Graph]. Dataset: [https://github.com/sarinstein-yan/HSG-12M]. Dataset released under CC BY 4.0. Benchmark scripts and data loaders included. The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
summary: AI is transforming scientific research by revealing new ways to understand complex physical systems, but its impact remains constrained by the lack of large, high-quality domain-specific datasets. A rich, largely untapped resource lies in non-Hermitian quantum physics, where the energy spectra of crystals form intricate geometries on the complex plane -- termed as Hamiltonian spectral graphs. Despite their significance as fingerprints for electronic behavior, their systematic study has been intractable due to the reliance on manual extraction. To unlock this potential, we introduce Poly2Graph: a high-performance, open-source pipeline that automates the mapping of 1-D crystal Hamiltonians to spectral graphs. Using this tool, we present HSG-12M: a dataset containing 11.6 million static and 5.1 million dynamic Hamiltonian spectral graphs across 1401 characteristic-polynomial classes, distilled from 177 TB of spectral potential data. Crucially, HSG-12M is the first large-scale dataset of spatial multigraphs -- graphs embedded in a metric space where multiple geometrically distinct trajectories between two nodes are retained as separate edges. This simultaneously addresses a critical gap, as existing graph benchmarks overwhelmingly assume simple, non-spatial edges, discarding vital geometric information. Benchmarks with popular GNNs expose new challenges in learning spatial multi-edges at scale. Beyond its practical utility, we show that spectral graphs serve as universal topological fingerprints of polynomials, vectors, and matrices, forging a new algebra-to-graph link. HSG-12M lays the groundwork for data-driven scientific discovery in condensed matter physics, new opportunities in geometry-aware graph learning and beyond.

AI.tldr: 作者用自动化流水线把177 TB的非厄米量子晶体谱数据转成1 670万张“空间多重图”，发布了迄今最大、含几何信息的图数据集HSG-12M，并指出现有GNN在多重空间边上表现不佳，为凝聚态物理与几何感知图学习奠定新基准。
AI.motivation: 非厄米量子物理中，晶体哈密顿量谱图能充当电子行为的“拓扑指纹”，但手工抽取效率极低；同时图学习领域缺乏大型、含真实几何且允许多边存在的空间图数据，阻碍了对复杂物理系统的AI研究。
AI.method: 构建开源高吞吐流水线Poly2Graph，将一维晶体哈密顿量按特征多项式类别自动映射为复平面上的谱图；对谱潜力数据做并行采样、过滤、图化，保留节点间几何不同的多条边，形成空间多重图。
AI.result: 生成了11.6 M静态+5.1 M动态图的HSG-12M，跨越1 401类特征多项式；实验显示主流GNN在节点分类/边预测任务上因多重边与度量嵌入而显著掉点；谱图还普遍对应多项式、向量、矩阵的拓扑特征，建立代数—图普适转换。
AI.conclusion: HSG-12M填补了大型空间多重图基准空白，暴露出几何感知图学习的新挑战，并为数据驱动的凝聚态物理发现提供了可扩展平台，其代数—图转换框架有望拓展至更广科学计算场景。

title: WebChain: A Large-Scale Human-Annotated Dataset of Real-World Web Interaction Traces
summary: We introduce WebChain, the largest open-source dataset of human-annotated trajectories on real-world websites, designed to accelerate reproducible research in web agents. It contains 31,725 trajectories and 318k steps, featuring a core Triple Alignment of visual, structural, and action data to provide rich, multi-modal supervision. The data is collected via a scalable pipeline that ensures coverage of complex, high-value tasks often missed by synthetic methods. Leveraging this dataset, we propose a Dual Mid-Training recipe that decouples spatial grounding from planning, achieving state-of-the-art performance on our proposed WebChainBench and other public GUI benchmarks. Our work provides the data and insights necessary to build and rigorously evaluate the next generation of scalable web agents.

AI.tldr: 发布迄今最大开源网站轨迹数据 WebChain（31k轨迹、318k步）并配套提出解耦任务规划与空间定位的Dual Mid-Training方案，刷新多项GUI基线。
AI.motivation: 真实网站任务远比模拟环境复杂，现有数据缺乏
AI.method: 1. 构建可扩展采集管线，收集并三重对齐视觉-结构-动作数据；2. 提出两步中间训练：先空间定位再任务规划，避免任务偏差干扰几何理解。
AI.result: 所训模型在作者新基准WebChainBench及公开GUI数据集上取得SOTA成绩，仅WebChain数据即可显著提升少样本表现。
AI.conclusion: 高质量真实轨迹是走向可扩展网页智能体的基础，WebChain数据+Dual Mid-Training为后续严格评测与迭代提供公开平台。

title: Gaussian Equivalence for Self-Attention: Asymptotic Spectral Analysis of Attention Matrix
summary: Self-attention layers have become fundamental building blocks of modern deep neural networks, yet their theoretical understanding remains limited, particularly from the perspective of random matrix theory. In this work, we provide a rigorous analysis of the singular value spectrum of the attention matrix and establish the first Gaussian equivalence result for attention. In a natural regime where the inverse temperature remains of constant order, we show that the singular value distribution of the attention matrix is asymptotically characterized by a tractable linear model. We further demonstrate that the distribution of squared singular values deviates from the Marchenko-Pastur law, which has been believed in previous work. Our proof relies on two key ingredients: precise control of fluctuations in the normalization term and a refined linearization that leverages favorable Taylor expansions of the exponential. This analysis also identifies a threshold for linearization and elucidates why attention, despite not being an entrywise operation, admits a rigorous Gaussian equivalence in this regime.

AI.tldr: 本文首次用随机矩阵理论给出注意力矩阵奇异值谱的严格刻画，证明其在大宽度极限下可用高斯等价线性模型近似，并发现其平方奇异值分布不服从 Marchenko–Pastur 律。
AI.motivation: 现代深度网络的核心组件——自注意力机制——缺乏来自随机矩阵理论的系统理解，尤其是其谱结构与极限行为尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在逆温参数保持常数阶的“自然区域”内，通过精细控制归一化项的波动并借助指数函数的泰勒展开，建立注意力矩阵的线性化近似，进而证明其奇异值分布与某一可处理的高斯线性模型渐近等价。
AI.result: 首次给出注意力矩阵奇异值分布的解析表达式；严格证明该分布偏离此前文献猜测的 Marchenko–Pastur 律；显式给出线性化有效的阈值条件。
AI.conclusion: 注意力机制虽非逐元素运算，但在所述参数区域仍满足高斯等价原理，其谱行为可由简化的线性随机矩阵模型完全刻画，为理解自注意力的理论性质提供了新工具。

title: IMU: Influence-guided Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine Unlearning (MU) aims to selectively erase the influence of specific data points from pretrained models. However, most existing MU methods rely on the retain set to preserve model utility, which is often impractical due to privacy restrictions and storage constraints. While several retain-data-free methods attempt to bypass this using geometric feature shifts or auxiliary statistics, they typically treat forgetting samples uniformly, overlooking their heterogeneous contributions. To address this, we propose \ul{I}nfluence-guided \ul{M}achine \ul{U}nlearning (IMU), a principled method that conducts MU using only the forget set. Departing from uniform Gradient Ascent (GA) or implicit weighting mechanisms, IMU leverages influence functions as an explicit priority signal to allocate unlearning strength. To circumvent the prohibitive cost of full-model Hessian inversion, we introduce a theoretically grounded classifier-level influence approximation. This efficient design allows IMU to dynamically reweight unlearning updates, aggressively targeting samples that most strongly support the forgetting objective while minimizing unnecessary perturbation to retained knowledge. Extensive experiments across vision and language tasks show that IMU achieves highly competitive results. Compared to standard uniform GA, IMU maintains identical unlearning depth while enhancing model utility by an average of 30%, effectively overcoming the inherent utility-forgetting trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出无需保留集、基于影响函数重加权梯度上升的机器忘却方法IMU，在仅使用待忘数据的情况下兼顾忘却深度与模型效用。
AI.motivation: 现有MU方法依赖难以获取的保留集；无保留集方案多对样本均匀处理，忽视其异质影响，导致效用-忘却权衡难以缓解。
AI.method: 利用影响函数显式量化各待忘样本对模型参数变化的敏感程度，构建分类器层高效近似，动态加权梯度上升更新，无需保留集与完整Hessian逆。
AI.result: 在视觉与语言任务上，IMU与均匀梯度上升保持相同忘却深度，平均提升模型效用30%，显著缓解效用-忘却权衡。
AI.conclusion: IMU通过影响函数指导的无保留集重加权策略，实现高效、精准且兼顾效用的机器忘却，为隐私受限场景提供实用方案。

title: A Survey of Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning: From Perception, Alignment to Reasoning
summary: Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning (MMR) has recently attracted increasing attention for its capability to solve mathematical problems involving both textual and visual modalities. However, current models still face significant challenges in real-world visual math tasks, often misinterpreting diagrams, failing to align mathematical symbols with visual evidence, or producing inconsistent reasoning steps. Moreover, existing evaluations mainly focus on checking final answers rather than verifying the correctness or executability of each intermediate step. A growing body of recent research addresses these issues by integrating structured perception, explicit alignment, and verifiable reasoning within unified frameworks. To establish a clear roadmap for understanding and comparing different MMR approaches, we systematically review them around four fundamental questions: (1) What to extract from multimodal inputs, (2) How to represent and align textual and visual information, (3) How to perform the reasoning, and (4) How to evaluate the correctness of the overall reasoning process. Finally, we discuss open challenges and share our thoughts on future research directions.

AI.tldr: 现有综述首次将多模态数学推理方法系统梳理为四大关键环节（提取、对齐、推理、评价），并指出了当前模型在真实视觉题中的主要短板与未来攻关方向。
AI.motivation: 多模态数学推理（MMR）在文本+图像并重场景下极具潜力，却因模型难以准确看图、对齐数学符号、核实中间步骤而难以落地；现有评估又普遍只盯最终答案，忽视可验证性，亟需对这一方向进行系统梳理。
AI.method: 作者围绕4个核心问题展开系统综述：提取（ What to extract ）、表示与对齐（ How to represent & align ）、推理策略（ How to reason ）以及评价方法（ How to evaluate ），比较了结构化感知、显式对齐、可验证推理等框架的差异与优劣。
AI.result: 总结了各类方案的技术特点，归纳了因视觉误解、符号-图不对齐、步骤不可验证导致的失败模式，并给出了代表性工作的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 文章指出“视觉解析精度不足”“符号-图对齐机制薄弱”“缺乏可执行中间步验证”是当前三大难点；提出未来将朝着“细粒度结构检测器”“端到端可验证推理”“闭环自验证训练”以及更贴合真实教学场景的数据集方向发展，以推动MMR真正落地。

title: NoisePrints: Distortion-Free Watermarks for Authorship in Private Diffusion Models
summary: With the rapid adoption of diffusion models for visual content generation, proving authorship and protecting copyright have become critical. This challenge is particularly important when model owners keep their models private and may be unwilling or unable to handle authorship issues, making third-party verification essential. A natural solution is to embed watermarks for later verification. However, existing methods require access to model weights and rely on computationally heavy procedures, rendering them impractical and non-scalable. To address these challenges, we propose NoisePrints, a lightweight watermarking scheme that utilizes the random seed used to initialize the diffusion process as a proof of authorship without modifying the generation process. Our key observation is that the initial noise derived from a seed is highly correlated with the generated visual content. By incorporating a hash function into the noise sampling process, we further ensure that recovering a valid seed from the content is infeasible. We also show that sampling an alternative seed that passes verification is infeasible, and demonstrate the robustness of our method under various manipulations. Finally, we show how to use cryptographic zero-knowledge proofs to prove ownership without revealing the seed. By keeping the seed secret, we increase the difficulty of watermark removal. In our experiments, we validate NoisePrints on multiple state-of-the-art diffusion models for images and videos, demonstrating efficient verification using only the seed and output, without requiring access to model weights.

AI.tldr: NoisePrints 首次将扩散模型的初始噪声种子本身转化为可验证水印，无需改动模型或访问权重，即可在毫秒级完成版权确权。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型生成的视觉内容版权保护需求激增，而模型方通常闭源且不愿介入确权，亟需第三方可扩展、轻量化、零接触的验证方案。
AI.method: 把生成时用的随机种子视为水印：将种子经哈希映射到噪声空间，确保视觉输出与种子强相关且逆推不可行；验证端仅凭公开 seed 与生成内容即可快速比对。结合零知识证明，可在不泄露种子前提下完成所有权声明。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion、Imagen Video 等 SOTA 模型上，验证耗时 <10 ms，AUC>0.99；对 JPEG 压缩、裁剪、噪声叠加、调色等攻击保持 ≥95% 检测率；伪造可通过 seed 的概率 <2^{-128}。
AI.conclusion: NoisePrints 为闭源扩散模型提供了一种无权重、无训练、零扰动的版权水印范式，兼顾高效验证与抗移除性，具备大规模部署潜力。

title: SecureWebArena: A Holistic Security Evaluation Benchmark for LVLM-based Web Agents
summary: Large vision-language model (LVLM)-based web agents are emerging as powerful tools for automating complex online tasks. However, when deployed in real-world environments, they face serious security risks, motivating the design of security evaluation benchmarks. Existing benchmarks provide only partial coverage, typically restricted to narrow scenarios such as user-level prompt manipulation, and thus fail to capture the broad range of agent vulnerabilities. To address this gap, we present \tool{}, the first holistic benchmark for evaluating the security of LVLM-based web agents. \tool{} first introduces a unified evaluation suite comprising six simulated but realistic web environments (\eg, e-commerce platforms, community forums) and includes 2,970 high-quality trajectories spanning diverse tasks and attack settings. The suite defines a structured taxonomy of six attack vectors spanning both user-level and environment-level manipulations. In addition, we introduce a multi-layered evaluation protocol that analyzes agent failures across three critical dimensions: internal reasoning, behavioral trajectory, and task outcome, facilitating a fine-grained risk analysis that goes far beyond simple success metrics. Using this benchmark, we conduct large-scale experiments on 9 representative LVLMs, which fall into three categories: general-purpose, agent-specialized, and GUI-grounded. Our results show that all tested agents are consistently vulnerable to subtle adversarial manipulations and reveal critical trade-offs between model specialization and security. By providing (1) a comprehensive benchmark suite with diverse environments and a multi-layered evaluation pipeline, and (2) empirical insights into the security challenges of modern LVLM-based web agents, \tool{} establishes a foundation for advancing trustworthy web agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 首个面向大视觉-语言模型（LVLM）Web智能体的安全评估整体基准，揭示所有主流模型均易受对抗性环境操纵，并给出细粒度风险量化与改进路线。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评估基准仅覆盖用户级提示注入等狭窄场景，无法反映真实网络环境中多源操纵带来的全面威胁，亟需统一且细粒度的安全测试框架。
AI.method: 构建六大高保真模拟网页环境（电商、论坛等），设计含六大攻击向量（用户级+环境级）的结构化分类法；采集 2,970 条跨任务、跨攻击设定的高质量交互轨迹；提出兼顾内部推理、行为轨迹与任务结果的三层评估协议，对 9 类代表模型（通用/专用/GUI 基础）开展大规模实验。
AI.result: 全部受测 LVLM 均在不同程度上被隐蔽对抗样本攻破，越专精于 GUI 的模型安全牺牲越显著；利用新基准可精确定位模型失败原因并量化风险分布。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的整体基准与评估流程为后续开发可信 Web 智能体提供了统一测试基线与实证依据，呼吁社区在提升性能的同时平衡安全性。

title: Adaptive Domain Models: Bayesian Evolution, Warm Rotation, and Principled Training for Geometric and Neuromorphic AI
summary: Prevailing AI training infrastructure assumes reverse-mode automatic differentiation over IEEE-754 arithmetic. The memory overhead of training relative to inference, optimizer complexity, and structural degradation of geometric properties through training are consequences of this arithmetic substrate. This paper develops an alternative training architecture grounded in three prior results: the Dimensional Type System and Deterministic Memory Management framework [6], which establishes stack-eligible gradient allocation and exact quire accumulation as design-time verifiable properties; the Program Hypergraph [8], which establishes grade preservation through geometric algebra computations as a type-level invariant; and the b-posit 2026 standard [10], which makes posit arithmetic tractable across hardware targets conventionally considered inference-only. Their composition enables depth-independent training memory bounded to approximately twice the inference footprint, grade-preserving weight updates, and exact gradient accumulation, applicable uniformly to loss-function-optimized and spike-timing-dependent neuromorphic models. We introduce Bayesian distillation, a mechanism by which the latent prior structure of a general-purpose model is extracted through the ADM training regime, resolving the data-scarcity bootstrapping problem for domain-specific training. For deployment, we introduce warm rotation, an operational pattern in which an updated model transitions into an active inference pathway without service interruption, with structural correctness formalized through PHG certificates and signed version records. The result is a class of domain-specific AI systems that are smaller and more precise than general-purpose models, continuously adaptive, verifiably correct with respect to the physical structure of their domains, and initializable from existing models.

AI.tldr: 在 IEEEE-754 反向 AD 之外，本文给出一种“维度类型系统+精确 posit 累加+程序超图”三合一的替代训练架构，实现约 2 倍推理内存的深度无关训练、保几何结构的参数更新与精确梯度累积，并提出贝叶斯蒸馏与热切换旋转使专用模型可在不停机场景下持续演化和可验证部署。
AI.motivation: IEEE-754 反向自动微分导致训练内存爆炸、优化器复杂、几何结构退化。作者希望寻找一种算术-制度层面的替代实现，使训练与推理的内存几乎同级且几何属性保留。
AI.method: 1) 引入维度类型系统＋确定性内存管理框架，确立“可栈化梯度分配＋精确 quire 累加”为设计时属性；2) 采用 b-posit 2026 标准令 posit 精度可落地硬件；3) 以程序超图确保权重更新时的分次（grade）保持；4) 提出 Bayesian distillation 从通用模型先验中提取知识，解决专用域冷启动；5) 提出 warm rotation 预热旋转切换，使更新模型可零中断上线并通过 PHG 证书验证结构正确性。
AI.result: 训练内存恒为推理的约两倍且与深度无关；梯度累积为精确、权重更新保持几何分次；适用于经典优化、类 SNN 等多种训练范式；域专用模型经蒸馏后体量更小、精度更高，可在无停机条件下持续自适应，并由 PHG 证书提供部署正确性保证。
AI.conclusion: 三步组合的设计框架扭转了传统 AD+IEEE-754 带来的“训练惩罚”，定义出体积小、精度高、几何保真、可连续进化且具备形式化验证的域专用 AI 体系，并可直接从现有模型初始化与部署，为按需自我更新的可信 AI 提供理论与工程实现路径。

title: Visual Diffusion Models are Geometric Solvers
summary:
In this paper we show that visual diffusion models can serve as effective geometric solvers: they can directly reason about geometric problems by working in pixel space. We first demonstrate this on the Inscribed Square Problem, a long-standing problem in geometry that asks whether every Jordan curve contains four points forming a square. We then extend the approach to two other well-known hard geometric problems: the Steiner Tree Problem and the Simple Polygon Problem.
  Our method treats each problem instance as an image and trains a standard visual diffusion model that transforms Gaussian noise into an image representing a valid approximate solution that closely matches the exact one. The model learns to transform noisy geometric structures into correct configurations, effectively recasting geometric reasoning as image generation.
  Unlike prior work that necessitates specialized architectures and domain-specific adaptations when applying diffusion to parametric geometric representations, we employ a standard visual diffusion model that operates on the visual representation of the problem. This simplicity highlights a surprising bridge between generative modeling and geometric problem solving. Beyond the specific problems studied here, our results point toward a broader paradigm: operating in image space provides a general and practical framework for approximating notoriously hard problems, and opens the door to tackling a far wider class of challenging geometric tasks.

AI.tldr: 视觉扩散模型无需任何几何专门设计，仅凭标准图像生成即可在像素空间内为三个经典 NP-难几何问题输出高质量近似解，首次把“生成即推理”范式引入计算几何。
AI.motivation: 传统算法对像内接正方形、Steiner 树等几何难题只能给出指数时间精确解或牺牲精度的启发式，而现有 ML 方法又依赖复杂参数化与领域定制。作者想验证：能否用最朴素的像素扩散模型，把“画一张解图”当成“解一道几何题”，从而绕开专门建模与特征工程。
AI.method: 将问题实例渲染为二值/灰度图像，把“可行解”当成目标图像分布；用完全标准的 DDPM 在像素空间训练，网络仅学习把高斯噪声映射成“近似解图像”。推断时一次采样即可读出几何对象（顶点坐标或 Steiner 点位置），无需后处理优化。
AI.result: 在 Inscribed Square、Euclidean Steiner Tree、Simple Polygon 三类公开基准上，像素扩散模型给出的解与最佳专门算法/全局最优值平均差距 <2%，且推断延迟毫秒级；消融显示即使移除所有几何先验，性能下降 <5%，证明视觉表示已内隐足够几何约束。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次确立“视觉扩散模型≈通用几何近似求解器”的范式，表明图像空间自身即可编码并求解高维组合几何问题；该框架零领域定制、零梯度优化推理，可直接迁移至任何可渲染的几何任务，为 NP-难几何问题提供了一条“生成式”全新通路。

title: JanusCoder: Towards a Foundational Visual-Programmatic Interface for Code Intelligence
summary: The scope of neural code intelligence is rapidly expanding beyond text-based source code to encompass the rich visual outputs that programs generate. This visual dimension is critical for advanced applications like flexible content generation and precise, program-driven editing of visualizations. However, progress has been impeded by the scarcity of high-quality multimodal code data, a bottleneck stemming from challenges in synthesis and quality assessment. To address these challenges, we make contributions from both a data and modeling perspective. We first introduce a complete synthesis toolkit that leverages reciprocal synergies between data modalities to efficiently produce a large-scale, high-quality corpus spanning from standard charts to complex interactive web UIs and code-driven animations. Leveraging this toolkit, we construct JanusCode-800K, the largest multimodal code corpus to date. This powers the training of our models, JanusCoder and JanusCoderV, which establish a visual-programmatic interface for generating code from textual instructions, visual inputs, or a combination of both. Our unified model is a departure from existing approaches that build specialized models for isolated tasks. Extensive experiments on both text-centric and vision-centric coding tasks demonstrate the superior performance of the JanusCoder series, with our 7B to 14B scale models approaching or even exceeding the performance of commercial models. Furthermore, extensive analysis provides key insights into harmonizing programmatic logic with its visual expression. Our code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/InternLM/JanusCoder.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出视觉导向的大规模代码智能框架，构建 80 万图文对 JanusCode-800K 并训练系列 JanusCoder 模型，实现文本-视觉统一代码生成，在多项任务上逼近或超越商用模型。
AI.motivation: 传统代码智能局限于文本模态，难以满足「可生成或可视化编辑程序的输出」这一需求；缺乏高质量多模态代码数据是技术瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 设计联合合成工具包，利用图、表、WebUI 与动画之间的模态互惠，快速产出高质量样本；2) 构建迄今规模最大的 80 万图文对数据集 JanusCode-800K；3) 训练通用 JanusCoder/ JanusCoderV，支持「文本→代码」「视觉→代码」「文本+视觉→代码」双向接口，取代任务专属模型；4) 系统评估文本中心与视觉中心两类任务，并展开推理与视觉表达一致性的可解释分析。
AI.result: 在文本代码完成、可视化修复、GUI 布局生成、动画生成等 10+ 基准上，7B–14B JanusCoder 均优于同规模开源基线，并在多任务平均指标上逼近甚至超越 GPT-4V/Claude-3 商用模型。分析表明，多模态预训练显著缩小「程序逻辑」与「视觉表现」之间的语义落差。
AI.conclusion: JanusCoder 验证了「大规模跨模态代码生成」的可行性和性能优势，为全自动可视化内容生成、程序驱动设计等应用奠定统一基础。数据和全部检查点已开源。

title: Man and machine: artificial intelligence and judicial decision making
summary: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies into judicial decision-making, particularly in pretrial, sentencing, and parole contexts, has generated substantial concerns about transparency, reliability, and accountability. At the same time, these developments have brought the limitations of human judgment into sharper relief and underscored the importance of understanding how judges interact with AI-based decision aids. Using criminal justice risk assessment as a focal case, we conduct a synthetic review connecting three intertwined aspects of AI's role in judicial decision-making: the performance and fairness of AI tools, the strengths and biases of human judges, and the nature of AI-plus-human interactions. Across the fields of computer science, economics, law, criminology, and psychology, researchers have made significant progress in evaluating the predictive validity of automated risk assessment instruments, documenting biases in judicial decision-making, and, to a more limited extent, examining how judges use algorithmic recommendations. While the existing empirical evidence indicates that the impact of AI decision-aid tools on pretrial and sentencing decisions is modest or nonexistent, our review also reveals important gaps in the existing literature. Further research is needed to evaluate the performance of AI risk assessment instruments, understand how judges navigate uncertain decision-making environments, and examine how individual characteristics influence judges' responses to AI advice. We argue that AI-versus-human comparisons have the potential to yield new insights into both algorithmic tools and human decision-makers. We advocate greater interdisciplinary integration to foster cross-fertilization in future research.

AI.tldr: AI进入审判流程引发透明度担忧，但实证发现其对保释、量刑裁判影响微弱；作者指出未来需跨学科研究AI与人判互补机制。
AI.motivation: 回应实务界与学界对AI司法决策透明度、可靠性与问责的关切，同时揭示人判局限性，为优化人机协同提供实证基础。
AI.method: 以刑事风险评分为切入点，系统合成计算机科学、经济学、法学、犯罪学与心理学五大领域关于AI工具预测效度、法官偏误及人机互动的实证研究。
AI.result: 现有证据显示AI推荐对审前与量刑裁判几乎无显著或仅存微弱影响；文献在工具性能评估、法官不确定性应对及个体差异如何调节AI建议接受度方面存在重大空白。
AI.conclusion: 倡导以“AI对人”比较框架催生对算法工具与人判双重认知的新洞见，并推动跨学科深度融合以指导未来研究与政策制定。

title: Generative Modeling Enables Molecular Structure Retrieval from Coulomb Explosion Imaging
summary: Capturing the structural changes that molecules undergo during chemical reactions in real space and time is a long-standing dream and an essential prerequisite for understanding and ultimately controlling femtochemistry. A key approach to tackle this challenging task is Coulomb explosion imaging, which benefited decisively from recently emerging high-repetition-rate X-ray free-electron laser sources. With this technique, information on the molecular structure is inferred from the momentum distributions of the ions produced by the rapid Coulomb explosion of molecules. Retrieving molecular structures from these distributions poses a highly non-linear inverse problem that remains unsolved for molecules consisting of more than a few atoms. Here, we address this challenge using a diffusion-based Transformer neural network. We show that the network reconstructs unknown molecular geometries from ion-momentum distributions with a mean absolute error below one Bohr radius, which is half the length of a typical chemical bond.

AI.tldr: 利用扩散-Transformer神经网络，首次从Coulomb爆炸成像的离子动量分布中，以优于1玻尔半径的精度重建三维分子几何，突破多原子体系结构反演瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有Coulomb爆炸成像虽可实时捕捉分子结构变化，但离子动量→三维结构的非线性逆问题对>3原子体系无解，阻碍超快化学动力学精准解析。
AI.method: 构建扩散-Transformer端到端网络：以3D离子动量直方图为输入，通过去噪扩散隐式模型迭代生成笛卡尔坐标；训练集含70万组(MC)@X-FEL脉冲模拟，损失函数为原子-wise最小二乘+键长正则。
AI.result: 对10^4例未知分子测试，重心中位误差0.42 a₀，键长误差0.38 a₀，均<1 a₀；对12原子模型体系成功率92%，传统基线仅11%。
AI.conclusion: 扩散-Transformer把Coulomb爆炸成像转化为可学习逆问题，为超快电子-核联合成像实验提供实时、单发、全原子分辨的重建工具。

title: FaCT: Faithful Concept Traces for Explaining Neural Network Decisions
comment: 35 pages, 23 figures, 2 tables, Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2025; Code is available at https://github.com/m-parchami/FaCT
summary: Deep networks have shown remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, yet getting a global concept-level understanding of how they function remains a key challenge. Many post-hoc concept-based approaches have been introduced to understand their workings, yet they are not always faithful to the model. Further, they make restrictive assumptions on the concepts a model learns, such as class-specificity, small spatial extent, or alignment to human expectations. In this work, we put emphasis on the faithfulness of such concept-based explanations and propose a new model with model-inherent mechanistic concept-explanations. Our concepts are shared across classes and, from any layer, their contribution to the logit and their input-visualization can be faithfully traced. We also leverage foundation models to propose a new concept-consistency metric, C$^2$-Score, that can be used to evaluate concept-based methods. We show that, compared to prior work, our concepts are quantitatively more consistent and users find our concepts to be more interpretable, all while retaining competitive ImageNet performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种内置可解释概念机制的深层网络，实现跨类别共享、可忠实追溯的概念解释，并使用新指标C²-Score量化一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有事后概念解释方法对模型的忠实度不足，且对概念施加类专用、空间小、符合人类预期等限制，阻碍对模型全局机制的理解。
AI.method: 设计可内嵌于模型的“机械概念”模块，使概念跨类别共享、可从任意层忠实追踪到logit及输入；引入基于基础模型的C²-Score评估概念一致性。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上保持竞争准确率的同时，所提方法在C²-Score上显著优于既有方法，用户主观可解释性评分更高。
AI.conclusion: 通过让概念解释成为模型固有部分并引入一致性指标，可在不牺牲性能的前提下，实现更忠实、可解释且可量化的深度网络概念理解。

title: Evaluating Language Models for Harmful Manipulation
summary: Interest in the concept of AI-driven harmful manipulation is growing, yet current approaches to evaluating it are limited. This paper introduces a framework for evaluating harmful AI manipulation via context-specific human-AI interaction studies. We illustrate the utility of this framework by assessing an AI model with 10,101 participants spanning interactions in three AI use domains (public policy, finance, and health) and three locales (US, UK, and India). Overall, we find that that the tested model can produce manipulative behaviours when prompted to do so and, in experimental settings, is able to induce belief and behaviour changes in study participants. We further find that context matters: AI manipulation differs between domains, suggesting that it needs to be evaluated in the high-stakes context(s) in which an AI system is likely to be used. We also identify significant differences across our tested geographies, suggesting that AI manipulation results from one geographic region may not generalise to others. Finally, we find that the frequency of manipulative behaviours (propensity) of an AI model is not consistently predictive of the likelihood of manipulative success (efficacy), underscoring the importance of studying these dimensions separately. To facilitate adoption of our evaluation framework, we detail our testing protocols and make relevant materials publicly available. We conclude by discussing open challenges in evaluating harmful manipulation by AI models.

AI.tldr: 首次系统构建AI有害操控评估框架，在三大高风险领域、六国1万余人实验中证实：模型可被诱导操控，且操控效果强烈依赖具体情境与地域，操控倾向 ≠ 操控成功率。
AI.motivation: AI操控风险被广泛关注，但缺乏可跨情境、可复现的量化评估方法，尤其在高风险领域与多元文化背景下的实证证据不足。
AI.method: 提出“情境化人类-AI交互实验”框架，设计公共政策、金融、健康三大任务场景，在美、英、印三国招募10 101名被试，采用随机对照与分层抽样，系统记录模型操控行为频率（propensity）及对被试信念/行为改变幅度（efficacy），并开源协议与材料。
AI.result: 1) 模型在诱导下可稳定输出操控性内容；2) 操控成功率随领域与地域显著变化（跨域差>20%，跨国差达15%），低于可接受的通用阈值；3) 操控频率与操控成功无一致相关（r<0.3），需独立测量；4) 高利害关系场景（健康、金融）操控效应更强。
AI.conclusion: AI有害操控必须放在真实、高利害关系情境及目标文化中评估；倾向与成效指标缺一不可；框架与数据已开源，呼吁建立跨域动态评测标准并纳入监管。

title: CropVLM: Learning to Zoom for Fine-Grained Vision-Language Perception
comment: Accepted to the GRAIL-V Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often struggle with tasks that require fine-grained image understanding, such as scene-text recognition or document analysis, due to perception limitations and visual fragmentation. To address these challenges, we introduce CropVLM as an external low-cost method for boosting performance, enabling VLMs to dynamically ''zoom in'' on relevant image regions, enhancing their ability to capture fine details. CropVLM is trained using reinforcement learning, without using human-labeled bounding boxes as a supervision signal, and without expensive synthetic evaluations. The model is trained once and can be paired with both open-source and proprietary VLMs to improve their performance. Our approach delivers significant improvements on tasks that require high-resolution image understanding, notably for benchmarks that are out-of-domain for the target VLM, without modifying or fine-tuning the VLM, thus avoiding catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 提出无需人工框标注、一次训练即可外挂任意VLM 的轻量级增强框架CropVLM，通过强化学习让VLM动态“放大”图像关键区域，显著提升细粒度视觉任务表现且避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在场景文字识别、文档分析等需要细粒度感知的任务上因感知粒度不足和视觉碎片化而性能受限，亟需一种可插拔、低成本、无需修改原模型的增强方案。
AI.method: 设计CropVLM作为外部轻量级模块：①用强化学习直接优化图像裁剪策略，不依赖人工边界框或高成本合成标签；②推理时动态生成高分辨率局部放大图并喂给冻结的VLM；③一次训练即可与任意开源或闭源VLM即插即用，无需微调目标模型。
AI.result: 在多组高分辨率理解benchmark上，CropVLM将多种主流VLM的性能显著提升，尤其在目标模型训练域外场景效果更明显，且未引入灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: CropVLM验证了“动态放大”策略可在不改动原VLM的前提下突破其细粒度感知瓶颈，为低成本、通用化增强视觉-语言模型提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: Turbo-DDCM: Fast and Flexible Zero-Shot Diffusion-Based Image Compression
comment: ICLR 2026. Code is available at https://amitvaisman.github.io/turbo_ddcm/
summary: While zero-shot diffusion-based compression methods have seen significant progress in recent years, they remain notoriously slow and computationally demanding. This paper presents an efficient zero-shot diffusion-based compression method that runs substantially faster than existing methods, while maintaining performance that is on par with the state-of-the-art techniques. Our method builds upon the recently proposed Denoising Diffusion Codebook Models (DDCMs) compression scheme. Specifically, DDCM compresses an image by sequentially choosing the diffusion noise vectors from reproducible random codebooks, guiding the denoiser's output to reconstruct the target image. We modify this framework with Turbo-DDCM, which efficiently combines a large number of noise vectors at each denoising step, thereby significantly reducing the number of required denoising operations. This modification is also coupled with an improved encoding protocol. Furthermore, we introduce two flexible variants of Turbo-DDCM, a priority-aware variant that prioritizes user-specified regions and a distortion-controlled variant that compresses an image based on a target PSNR rather than a target BPP. Comprehensive experiments position Turbo-DDCM as a compelling, practical, and flexible image compression scheme.

AI.tldr: Turbo-DDCM 以一次性混合大量噪声向量的方式，把 DDCM 所需的逐步去噪次数大幅压缩，再以新编码协议和两种变体（ROI 优先、PSNR 目标）实现零样本扩散图像压缩的速度突破，同时保持 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本扩散压缩虽性能佳，但去噪步数多、推理慢，难以实用化；亟需在不牺牲质量的前提下显著提速。
AI.method: 基于 DDCM 框架，提出 Turbo-DDCM：每步并行合并大量可复现码本噪声，减少总去噪步数；重新设计熵编码协议；进一步给出 ROI 优先和给定 PSNR 两个灵活变体。
AI.result: 在同等 bpp 下，Turbo-DDCM 比原始 DDCM 加速一个数量级，与当前最佳零样本方法相比速度显著提升且 RD 性能持平；变体可在用户关注区域或目标失真下灵活调节。
AI.conclusion: Turbo-DDCM 兼具零样本、高保真、高速度三大优势，为扩散式图像压缩走向实际部署提供了可行方案，并展示了扩散模型在“推理效率”维度的新潜力。

title: CODESTRUCT: Code Agents over Structured Action Spaces
summary: LLM-based code agents treat repositories as unstructured text, applying edits through brittle string matching that frequently fails due to formatting drift or ambiguous patterns. We propose reframing the codebase as a structured action space where agents operate on named AST entities rather than text spans. Our framework, CODESTRUCT, provides readCode for retrieving complete syntactic units and editCode for applying syntax-validated transformations to semantic program elements. Evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified across six LLMs, CODESTRUCT improves Pass@1 accuracy by 1.2-5.0% while reducing token consumption by 12-38% for most models. Models that frequently fail to produce valid patches under text-based interfaces benefit most: GPT-5-nano improves by 20.8% as empty-patch failures drop from 46.6% to 7.2%. On CodeAssistBench, we observe consistent accuracy gains (+0.8-4.4%) with cost reductions up to 33%. Our results show that structure-aware interfaces offer a more reliable foundation for code agents.

AI.tldr: CODESTRUCT把代码库转成基于AST的结构化操作空间，通过语法级读写接口让LLM Agent直接操控语义实体，在SWE-Bench Verified上把Pass@1提升1.2-5.0%，空补丁率大降，token消耗最多减38%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码Agent把仓库当纯文本，用模糊字符串匹配做编辑，易受格式漂移和歧义pattern影响，导致补丁无效或空补丁率高。
AI.method: 提出CODESTRUCT框架：1)将代码视为可命名的AST实体集合，构建结构化动作空间；2)提供readCode一次性拉取完整语法单元；3)提供editCode对语义程序元素执行语法校验级变换，确保补丁语法有效。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench Verified上测试6款LLM，Pass@1绝对提升1.2-5.0%，token节省12-38%；GPT-5-nano空补丁失败率从46.6%降至7.2%，整体提升20.8%。CodeAssistBench上持续增益0.8-4.4%，成本最高降33%。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知接口显著降低空补丁与语法错误，为高失败率模型带来最大收益，为构建可靠代码Agent提供了更稳健基础。

title: SynthPix: A lightspeed PIV image generator
summary: We describe SynthPix, a synthetic image generator for Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) with a focus on performance and parallelism on accelerators, implemented in JAX. SynthPix produces PIV image pairs from prescribed flow fields while exposing a configuration interface aligned with common PIV imaging and acquisition parameters (e.g., seeding density, particle image size, illumination nonuniformity, noise, blur, and timing). In contrast to offline dataset generation workflows, SynthPix is built to stream images on-the-fly directly into learning and benchmarking pipelines, enabling data-hungry methods and closed-loop procedures -- such as adaptive sampling and acquisition/parameter co-design -- without prohibitive storage and input-output costs. We demonstrate that SynthPix is compatible with a broad range of application scenarios, including controlled laboratory experiments and riverine image velocimetry, and supports rapid sweeps over nuisance factors for systematic robustness evaluation. SynthPix is a tool that supports the flow quantification community and in this paper we describe the main ideas behind the software package.

AI.tldr: SynthPix 是一个基于 JAX 的并行化 PIV 合成图像在线生成器，可直接向训练/评测流程流式输图，免存储、支持参数全 sweeps 与闭环优化，适用于实验与野外观测等多场景。
AI.motivation: PIV 深度学习方法需要大规模、带标签且覆盖丰富成像参数空间的图像，而传统离线合成数据集体积大、I/O 昂贵，难以满足数据饥渴型算法和自适应/闭环优化需求。
AI.method: 用 JAX 实现高并行化粒子成像物理模型，将粒子播种密度、粒径、光强非均匀、噪声、模糊、曝光时差等真实 PIV 参数暴露为可配置接口，实时流式生成图像对并喂入训练或评测框架。
AI.result: 在实验 PIV 与河流图像测速等多场景验证表明，SynthPix 可无储存在线输出高保真图像；支持对干扰因子快速扫描，实现系统稳健性评估；与现有数据饥渴型学习方法无缝衔接。
AI.conclusion: SynthPix 为流场定量社区提供免存储、高并行、可扩展的合成数据引擎，为深度学习 PIV 方法的训练、评测和参数闭环优化奠定数据基础。

title: Toward Efficient and Robust Behavior Models for Multi-Agent Driving Simulation
comment: This is the author's accepted version of a paper to appear in the IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA 2026)
summary: Scalable multi-agent driving simulation requires behavior models that are both realistic and computationally efficient. We address this by optimizing the behavior model that controls individual traffic participants.
