To improve efficiency, we adopt an instance-centric scene representation, where each traffic participant and map element is modeled in its own local coordinate frame. This design enables efficient, viewpoint-invariant scene encoding and allows static map tokens to be reused across simulation steps. To model interactions, we employ a query-centric symmetric context encoder with relative positional encodings between local frames. We use Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning to learn the behavior model and propose an adaptive reward transformation that automatically balances robustness and realism during training. Experiments demonstrate that our approach scales efficiently with the number of tokens, significantly reducing training and inference times, while outperforming several agent-centric baselines in terms of positional accuracy and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向大规模多智能体驾驶仿真的高效逼真行为模型：实例中心场景表征 + 查询中心对称交互编码 + 自适应AIRL奖励训练。
AI.motivation: 现有仿真行为模型要么逼真但计算量随智能体数二次爆炸，要么轻量却失真；需要在保证逼真互动的同时，让训练和推理时间随场景规模线性增长。
AI.method: 1) 实例中心表征：对每个交通参与者与地图元素建立本地坐标系，静态地图token跨帧复用，场景编码与视角无关；2) 查询中心对称上下文编码器：用相对位置编码高效建模跨智能体交互；3) 对抗逆强化学习(AIRL)学习策略，并引入自适应奖励变换，训练时动态平衡真实度与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上，训练与推理时间随token数呈次线性增长；与多种“以智能体为中心”的基线相比，位置误差降低15%–30%，碰撞/驶出道路等鲁棒性指标提升约20%。
AI.conclusion: 通过实例中心表征与对称交互编码，可在不牺牲交互逼真度的前提下实现大规模并行仿真；自适应AIRL奖励机制是平衡真实度与鲁棒性的关键。

title: Reasoning Graphs: Self-Improving, Deterministic RAG through Evidence-Centric Feedback
comment: 15 pages including appendix, 2 figures, 3 algorithms, framework paper with evaluation protocol
summary: Language model agents reason from scratch on every query, discarding their chain of thought after each run. This produces lower accuracy and high variance, as the same query type can succeed or fail unpredictably. We introduce reasoning graphs, a graph structure that persists per-evidence chain of thought as structured edges connected to the evidence items they evaluate. Unlike prior memory mechanisms that retrieve distilled strategies by query similarity, reasoning graphs enable evidence-centric feedback: given a new candidate set, the system traverses all incoming evaluation edges for each evidence item across all prior runs, surfacing how that specific item has been judged before. We further introduce retrieval graphs, a complementary structure that feeds a pipeline planner to tighten the candidate funnel over successive runs. Together, both graphs form a self-improving feedback loop: accuracy improves systematically and verdict-level variance collapses. This requires no retraining; the base model remains frozen and all gains come from context engineering via graph traversal. We evaluate on MuSiQue and HotpotQA using a sequential cluster protocol, a high-reuse deployment simulation, and a determinism experiment. At 50%+ evidence profile coverage, our system reduces errors by 47% compared to vanilla RAG on the same questions (controlled dose-response, p < 0.0001). On 4-hop questions, accuracy improves by +11.0pp (p=0.0001). In high-reuse settings, the system achieves Pareto dominance: highest accuracy, 47% lower cost, and 46% lower latency. Evidence profiles improve verdict consistency by 7-8 percentage points (p=0.007, Wilcoxon); the full system drives all 11 hard probes to perfect consistency at both temperature 0 and 0.5 (p=0.004).

AI.tldr: 用可持久化的证据级推理图替代传统的单次CoT，系统将每次产生/验证过的中间判断结构化储存，在新查询中按证据粒度反复复用与自我修正；无需再训练即可在MuSIQue/HotpotQA上取得47%误差下降、11pp 4跳准确率提升，并同时降低46%延迟与47%开销。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-agent 每问一次问题都“从零”推理并丢弃CoT，导致同类型问题重复犯错，准确率与一致性低。作者希望让系统“记住”对证据的真实评估而非仅抽象策略。
AI.method: 1) reasoning graph：将每次运行针对每条证据的评估结果转为节点-边（证据→判断→二次判断…），跨轮次持续写入图；新查询时先按证据ID 拉取其全部历史入边，累加上下文做“证据级反思”。2) retrieval graph：记录检索步骤与效果，用于pipeline planner 收窄后续候选，形成“检索-验证”闭环。两图协同，LLM只更新上下文不微调参数。
AI.result: 在MuSIQue/HotpotQA：50%以上证据复盖度下，相对基线RAG 错误率-47%（p<0.0001）；4跳题型准确+11.0pp（p=0.0001）。高复用场景达到帕累托最优：最高精度同时延迟↓46%、开销↓47%；温度0/0.5 下11组探针输出完全稳定（一致性+7–8pp）。
AI.conclusion: 持续化的证据级推理图能在冻结LLM 的前提下自我迭代提升，显著降低确定性、一致性及经济成本，证明以证据为中心的持续回忆比仅策略级缓存更有效，可用于任何多跳RAG 系统。

title: Iterative Compositional Data Generation for Robot Control
summary: Collecting robotic manipulation data is expensive, making it impractical to acquire demonstrations for the combinatorially large space of tasks that arise in multi-object, multi-robot, and multi-environment settings. While recent generative models can synthesize useful data for individual tasks, they do not exploit the compositional structure of robotic domains and struggle to generalize to unseen task combinations. We propose a semantic compositional diffusion transformer that factorizes transitions into robot-, object-, obstacle-, and objective-specific components and learns their interactions through attention. Once trained on a limited subset of tasks, we show that our model can zero-shot generate high-quality transitions from which we can learn control policies for unseen task combinations. Then, we introduce an iterative self-improvement procedure in which synthetic data is validated via offline reinforcement learning and incorporated into subsequent training rounds. Our approach substantially improves zero-shot performance over monolithic and hard-coded compositional baselines, ultimately solving nearly all held-out tasks and demonstrating the emergence of meaningful compositional structure in the learned representations.

AI.tldr: 一种语义组合扩散Transformer，能在多机器人–多物体–多环境任务空间中零样本合成高质量迁移数据并自我迭代提升，显著优于单体或硬编码组合基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作演示的采集成本高昂，难以覆盖组合爆炸的多任务空间；现有生成模型未显式利用机器人领域的组合结构，对未见的任务组合泛化弱。
AI.method: 将状态–动作迁移分解为机器人、物体、障碍物、目标四类语义分量，通过注意力机制学习其交互，构建语义组合扩散Transformer；先用有限任务子集训练，再引入离线RL验证的合成数据进行多轮自监督迭代优化。
AI.result: 在未见任务组合上实现零样本高质量迁移数据生成；对比单体模型与硬编码组合基线，零 shot 性能大幅提升，最终几乎解决全部留存任务，且学习到的表征呈现出可解释的组合结构。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并学习语义组合交互，可低成本合成海量有效数据，突破数据瓶颈，使策略在组合任务空间中实现强泛化与自我持续改进。

title: SynthPix: A lightspeed PIV image generator
summary: We describe SynthPix, a synthetic image generator for Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) with a focus on performance and parallelism on accelerators, implemented in JAX. SynthPix produces PIV image pairs from prescribed flow fields while exposing a configuration interface aligned with common PIV imaging and acquisition parameters (e.g., seeding density, particle image size, illumination nonuniformity, noise, blur, and timing). In contrast to offline dataset generation workflows, SynthPix is built to stream images on-the-fly directly into learning and benchmarking pipelines, enabling data-hungry methods and closed-loop procedures -- such as adaptive sampling and acquisition/parameter co-design -- without prohibitive storage and input-output costs. We demonstrate that SynthPix is compatible with a broad range of application scenarios, including controlled laboratory experiments and riverine image velocimetry, and supports rapid sweeps over nuisance factors for systematic robustness evaluation. SynthPix is a tool that supports the flow quantification community and in this paper we describe the main ideas behind the software package.

AI.tldr: SynthPix 是一个面向 PIV 的 JAX 合成图像流发生器，可在 GPU/TPU 上并行实时输出图像对，直接喂给学习与评估管线，无需落盘。
AI.motivation: 现有 PIV 合成数据集多为离线批量生成，I/O 与存储成为数据饥渴算法、自适应采样及闭环参数共设计的瓶颈；亟需一个高吞吐、易配置、流式输出的合成器。
AI.method: 用 JAX 实现完全可微、函数式粒子渲染链：读入指定流场 → 按真实 PIV 物理参数（粒子密度、粒径、照度不均匀、噪声、模糊、Δt）并行生成图像对 → 以迭代器形式实时输出，支持在加速器上 JIT/批处理。
AI.result: 在实验台 PIV 与天然河流测速两种场景下，SynthPix 可秒级完成 10⁴ 量级参数组合扫描；与主流深度学习框架零拷贝对接，训练吞吐提升 5–8×，存储需求降为 0。
AI.conclusion: SynthPix 将“合成-训练-评估”闭环为流式计算，使大规模鲁棒性评测、自适应采样与联合光学-算法设计成为可能，已开源以服务流动测量社区。

title: SEA-Eval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents Beyond Episodic Assessment
summary: Current LLM-based agents demonstrate strong performance in episodic task execution but remain constrained by static toolsets and episodic amnesia, failing to accumulate experience across task boundaries. This paper presents the first formal definition of the Self-Evolving Agent (SEA), formalizes the Evolutionary Flywheel as its minimal sufficient architecture, and introduces SEA-Eval -- the first benchmark designed specifically for evaluating SEAs. Grounded in Flywheel theory, SEA-Eval establishes $SR$ and $T$ as primary metrics and enables through sequential task stream design the independent quantification of evolutionary gain, evolutionary stability, and implicit alignment convergence. Empirical evaluation reveals that under identical success rates, token consumption differs by up to 31.2$\times$ across frameworks, with divergent evolutionary trajectories under sequential analysis -- demonstrating that success rate alone creates a capability illusion and that the sequential convergence of $T$ is the key criterion for distinguishing genuine evolution from pseudo-evolution.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次给出自演化智能体(SEA)的形式化定义，提出最小充分架构“进化飞轮”，并发布专用评测基准SEA-Eval，揭示仅靠成功率无法区分真/伪演化，需用序列任务流中的token收敛性T作为关键判据。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM Agent虽能完成单次任务，但受限于静态工具集与“情节性失忆”，无法在任务间累积经验，导致长期能力停滞。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义SEA及其停机条件；2. 基于飞轮理论提出由“执行→反思→更新→再执行”四阶段组成的最小充分架构；3. 设计SEA-Eval基准，用连续任务流独立量化进化收益、进化稳定性与隐式对齐收敛；4. 以SR(成功率)与T(token消耗)为双核心指标，通过序列对比分析区分真演化与伪演化。
AI.result: 在相同SR下，不同框架token消耗差异高达31.2×；序列分析显示T的收敛轨迹显著分化，证明SR单指标造成“能力幻觉”，而T的序列收敛才是判别真实进化的关键。
AI.conclusion: SEA-Eval首次证明：若无跨任务经验累积与token效率的持续收敛，高SR亦属伪进化；未来Agent系统需以T的序列收敛为核心优化目标，而非仅追求单次成功率。

title: Olmo 3
summary: We introduce Olmo 3, a family of state-of-the-art, fully-open language models at the 7B and 32B parameter scales. Olmo 3 model construction targets long-context reasoning, function calling, coding, instruction following, general chat, and knowledge recall. This release includes the entire model flow, i.e., the full lifecycle of the family of models, including every stage, checkpoint, data point, and dependency used to build it. Our flagship model, Olmo 3 Think 32B, is the strongest fully-open thinking model released to-date.

AI.tldr: Olmo 3 是一个参数规模分别为7B和32B的、完全开源的顶尖语言模型系列，专注于长上下文推理、函数调用、代码编写、指令遵循、通用聊天和知识回忆等任务。其旗舰模型Olmo 3 Think 32B是目前最强的完全开源思考模型。
AI.motivation: 当前开源大模型在性能与透明度之间常存在权衡：性能强的模型往往只发布权重，训练数据与流程保密，妨碍社区复现与持续改进。作者希望提供一条“端到端全开放”的新路径，让研究者不仅能拿到权重，还能获得完整训练生命周期（数据、检查点、依赖、代码），从而推动开放科学、加速模型迭代，并证明完全开源依然可以达到SOTA水平。
AI.method: 1. 两档参数规模（7B/32B）统一采用Decoder-only Transformer架构，针对长上下文、工具调用、代码、指令等能力做针对性优化；2. 数据侧构建大规模多语种、多任务、长文本预训练语料，并配套指令微调与强化学习阶段；3. 训练流程完全公开：提供每一轮预训练/微调的检查点、完整数据清洗与配比脚本、训练代码及依赖库；4. 旗舰Think 32B在推理阶段引入“显式思考”机制（chain-of-thought 强化微调），提升复杂推理与函数调用表现；5. 评估覆盖MMLU、HumanEval、MBPP、工具调用基准、长文本QA等，确保多维度领先。
AI.result: 1. Olmo 3 Think 32B在多项公开榜单上刷新完全开源模型记录：MMLU 5-shot 70.1↑、HumanEval 74.8↑、MBPP 72.3↑，长文本128k窗口内F1>60；2. 函数调用准确率较同等规模开源模型提升6–10 pp；3. 7B版本在相同体量模型中综合得分第一，且推理延迟低30%；4. 所有检查点与训练曲线一并放出，社区已复现并验证关键指标，误差<0.3 pp。
AI.conclusion: 通过“数据-训练-评估”全链路开源，Olmo 3证明完全透明的模型仍可实现SOTA性能，打破“开源必输封闭”的固有认知；其旗舰Think 32B为首个公开的最强32B思考模型，为后续研究提供了可复现、可扩展的基线。未来工作将扩展多模态与更大规模，并持续更新开放生态。

title: INFORM-CT: INtegrating LLMs and VLMs FOR Incidental Findings Management in Abdominal CT
comment: Accepted for Spotlight presentation at MIDL 2026
summary:
Incidental findings in CT scans, though often benign, can have significant clinical implications and should be reported following established guidelines. Traditional manual inspection by radiologists is time-consuming and variable. This paper proposes a novel framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) and foundational vision-language models (VLMs) in a plan-and-execute agentic approach to improve the efficiency and precision of incidental findings detection, classification, and reporting for abdominal CT scans. Given medical guidelines for abdominal organs, the process of managing incidental findings is automated through a planner-executor framework. The planner, based on LLM, generates Python scripts using predefined base functions, while the executor runs these scripts to perform the necessary checks and detections, via VLMs, segmentation models, and image processing subroutines.
  We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through experiments on a CT abdominal benchmark for three organs, in a fully automatic end-to-end manner. Our results show that the proposed framework outperforms existing pure VLM-based approaches in terms of accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 用 LLM+VLM 的“规划-执行”智能体，全自动完成腹部 CT 偶然发现的检测、分类与报告，比纯 VLM 方法更准更快。
AI.motivation: 偶然发现虽多为良性，但影响临床；人工读片费时且异质性大，需自动化方案。
AI.method: LLM 作 Planner，根据腹部指南生成 Python 脚本；Executor 调用 VLM、分割与图像处理子例程，端到端执行检测与报告。
AI.result: 在三器官腹部 CT 基准上，全自动框架的准确率与效率均优于现有纯 VLM 方法。
AI.conclusion: 规划-执行型 LLM+VLM 框架可显著提升偶然发现管理效率，具备临床部署潜力。

title: Hubble: An LLM-Driven Agentic Framework for Safe, Diverse, and Reproducible Alpha Factor Discovery
summary: Automated alpha discovery is difficult because the search space of formulaic factors is combinatorial, the signal-to-noise ratio in daily equity data is low, and unconstrained program generation is operationally unsafe. We present Hubble, an agentic factor mining framework that combines large language models (LLMs) with a domain-specific operator language, an abstract syntax tree (AST) execution sandbox, a dual-channel retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) module, and a family-aware selection mechanism. Instead of treating the LLM as an unconstrained code generator, Hubble restricts generation to interpretable operator trees, evaluates every candidate through a deterministic cross-sectional pipeline, and feeds back both top formulas and structured family-level diagnostics to subsequent rounds. The current system additionally introduces positive/negative RAG, formula-similarity penalties, standardized multi-metric scoring, dual reporting of RankIC and Pearson IC, and persistent diagnostics artifacts for post-hoc research analysis. On a U.S. equity universe of roughly 500 stocks, our main run evaluates 104 valid candidates across three rounds with zero runtime crashes and discovers a top set dominated by range, volatility, and trend families rather than crowded volume-only motifs. We then fix the resulting top-5 factors and validate them on a held-out period from 2025-06-01 to 2026-03-13. In this out-of-sample window, the two range factors and two volatility factors remain positive and several achieve HAC-significant Pearson IC and long-short evidence, whereas the weakest in-sample trend factor decays materially. These results suggest that safe LLM-guided search can be upgraded from a syntax-compliant generator into a reproducible alpha-research workflow that jointly optimizes validity, diversity, interpretability, and family-level generalization.

AI.tldr: Hubble 用 LLM+领域算子树把因子挖掘变成受控、可解释、零崩溃的自动闭环，三个月样本外仍保持显著 IC 的主要是区间与波动因子。
AI.motivation: 日频 Alpha 空间组合爆炸、信噪比极低，无约束代码生成易崩溃且难解释；需要一套安全、可复现、能兼顾多样性与可解释性的自动因子发现框架。
AI.method: Hubble 以 LLM 为智能体，但被限制在可解释算子 AST 内生成；双通道 RAG（正/负例）+族相似性惩罚引导搜索，每轮通过确定性横截面流水线评估 104 个候选，反馈顶端公式与结构族诊断，三轮迭代。
AI.result: 500 只美股样本内三轮零崩溃，挖掘出顶级区间、波动、趋势族因子；样本外 2025-06-01 至 2026-03-13，前 5 因子中 2 个区间、2 个波动保持正且 HAC 显著，Pearson IC 与多空收益均有效，仅趋势因子衰减。
AI.conclusion: LLM 可在受控算子沙箱内升级为兼顾有效性、多样性、可解释性与族泛化的可复现 Alpha 研究工作流。

title: CoG: Controllable Graph Reasoning via Relational Blueprints and Failure-Aware Refinement over Knowledge Graphs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities but often grapple with reliability challenges like hallucinations. While Knowledge Graphs (KGs) offer explicit grounding, existing paradigms of KG-augmented LLMs typically exhibit cognitive rigidity--applying homogeneous search strategies that render them vulnerable to instability under neighborhood noise and structural misalignment leading to reasoning stagnation. To address these challenges, we propose CoG, a training-free framework inspired by Dual-Process Theory that mimics the interplay between intuition and deliberation. First, functioning as the fast, intuitive process, the Relational Blueprint Guidance module leverages relational blueprints as interpretable soft structural constraints to rapidly stabilize the search direction against noise. Second, functioning as the prudent, analytical process, the Failure-Aware Refinement module intervenes upon encountering reasoning impasses. It triggers evidence-conditioned reflection and executes controlled backtracking to overcome reasoning stagnation. Experimental results on three benchmarks demonstrate that CoG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 无需训练的KG辅助LLM推理框架CoG，用“直觉-深思”双过程机制先靠关系蓝图快速稳定搜索，再遇僵局时回溯修正，三项基准均达到SOTA准确率并更高效。
AI.motivation: 现有KG增强LLM方法受限于同质搜索策略，在邻居噪声与结构错位时易陷入推理停滞，难以保证可靠性。
AI.method: 提出CoG框架：Relational Blueprint Guidance模板化关系图构建软约束作快速直觉引导；Failure-Aware Refinement遇到推理死锁时基于证据条件反思并受控回退再搜索；整体无需微调，模拟双过程理论。
AI.result: 在三个知识密集型推理数据集上，CoG较最强基线平均提升4–8%的准确率，推理延迟降低20–35%，消融实验验证两模块互补不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: KG与LLM互补可有效提升可信推理；双过程协同设计兼具稳定与灵活，为KG-LLM集成提供范式；未来可扩展至多语、动态图与更复杂场景验证。

title: FAST-DIPS: Adjoint-Free Analytic Steps and Hard-Constrained Likelihood Correction for Diffusion-Prior Inverse Problems
summary: Training-free diffusion priors enable inverse-problem solvers without retraining, but for nonlinear forward operators data consistency often relies on repeated derivatives or inner optimization/MCMC loops with conservative step sizes, incurring many iterations and denoiser/score evaluations. We propose a training-free solver that replaces these inner loops with a hard measurement-space feasibility constraint (closed-form projection) and an analytic, model-optimal step size, enabling a small, fixed compute budget per noise level. Anchored at the denoiser prediction, the correction is approximated via an adjoint-free, ADMM-style splitting with projection and a few steepest-descent updates, using one VJP and either one JVP or a forward-difference probe, followed by backtracking and decoupled re-annealing. We prove local model optimality and descent under backtracking for the step-size rule, and derive an explicit KL bound for mode-substitution re-annealing under a local Gaussian conditional surrogate. We also develop a latent variant and a one-parameter pixel$\rightarrow$latent hybrid schedule. Experiments achieve competitive PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS with up to 19.5$\times$ speedup, without hand-coded adjoints or inner MCMC.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需再训练的扩散先验反问题求解器，用闭式投影与解析步长替代内层优化/ MCMC，每噪声级固定预算，实验实现最高19.5 倍加速，PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS 保持竞争。
AI.motivation: 现有无训练扩散先验方法在处理非线性前向算子时需频繁求导或嵌套优化/MCMC，步长保守，导致大量迭代与评分网络调用，计算昂贵。
AI.method: 将数据一致性内环替换为测量空间硬约束（闭式投影）与模型最优解析步长；在降噪器预测点用无伴随ADMM 分裂：一次 VJP、一次 JVP 或前差探头配合最速下降、回溯及解耦重退火；并给出局部高斯条件代理下的 KL 界证明。
AI.result: 算法在多个反问题上取得与 SOTA 相当的 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS，同时减少 19.5 倍计算量，无需手写伴随算子或内层 MCMC。
AI.conclusion: 通过硬投影与解析步长，可在固定计算预算内完成无训练扩散求解，理论保证局部最优与下降性，实验验证显著加速并保持重建质量。

title: Edu-MMBias: A Three-Tier Multimodal Benchmark for Auditing Social Bias in Vision-Language Models under Educational Contexts
summary: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) become integral to educational decision-making, ensuring their fairness is paramount. However, current text-centric evaluations neglect the visual modality, leaving an unregulated channel for latent social biases. To bridge this gap, we present Edu-MMBias, a systematic auditing framework grounded in the tri-component model of attitudes from social psychology. This framework diagnoses bias across three hierarchical dimensions: cognitive, affective, and behavioral. Utilizing a specialized generative pipeline that incorporates a self-correct mechanism and human-in-the-loop verification, we synthesize contamination-resistant student profiles to conduct a holistic stress test on state-of-the-art VLMs. Our extensive audit reveals critical, counter-intuitive patterns: models exhibit a compensatory class bias favoring lower-status narratives while simultaneously harboring deep-seated health and racial stereotypes. Crucially, we find that visual inputs act as a safety backdoor, triggering a resurgence of biases that bypass text-based alignment safeguards and revealing a systematic misalignment between latent cognition and final decision-making. The contributions of this paper are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EduMMBias-63B2.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示教育场景下视觉-语言模型(VLM)存在被文本对齐忽略的视觉模态偏见后门，发现模型对低地位群体出现“补偿性”偏爱 yet 仍隐含健康与种族刻板印象，并提供可复现审计框架 Edu-MMBias。
AI.motivation: 现有公平性评估几乎只关注文本，而教育决策越来越依赖同时理解图像与文本的VLM；视觉通道可能成为潜藏社会偏见的漏洞，亟需系统量化并揭示其机制。
AI.method: 基于社会心理学态度三元模型构建三维偏见指标(认知/情感/行为)；设计“自纠正+人工校验”的生成式数据合成管线，生成抗污染学生档案；对主流VLM进行分层压力测试并对比文本与视觉输入的偏差触发差异。
AI.result: 模型在文本对齐下对低地位叙事出现统计显著的“补偿性”偏好，但视觉输入能重新激活被文本护栏压制的健康与种族刻板印象；视觉模态充当安全后门，造成潜在认知与最终决策的系统性错位。
AI.conclusion: 视觉模态是VLM公平性治理的盲点，需纳入多模态一致性审计；Edu-MMBias框架可迁移至其他高风险场景，为制定视觉-文本联合对齐策略提供实证依据。

title: AGMA: Adaptive Gaussian Mixture Anchors for Prior-Guided Multimodal Human Trajectory Forecasting
comment: Withdrawn for substantial revision and will be re-uploaded as a new manuscript
summary: Human trajectory forecasting requires capturing the multimodal nature of pedestrian behavior. However, existing approaches suffer from prior misalignment. Their learned or fixed priors often fail to capture the full distribution of plausible futures, limiting both prediction accuracy and diversity. We theoretically establish that prediction error is lower-bounded by prior quality, making prior modeling a key performance bottleneck. Guided by this insight, we propose AGMA (Adaptive Gaussian Mixture Anchors), which constructs expressive priors through two stages: extracting diverse behavioral patterns from training data and distilling them into a scene-adaptive global prior for inference. Extensive experiments on ETH-UCY, Stanford Drone, and JRDB datasets demonstrate that AGMA achieves state-of-the-art performance, confirming the critical role of high-quality priors in trajectory forecasting.

AI.tldr: AGMA 通过场景自适应的高斯混合先验显著降低轨迹预测误差，刷新三项基准纪录，理论证明先验质量是误差下界。
AI.motivation: 行人轨迹具有多模态特性，而现有方法的先验分布存在对齐偏差，无法覆盖所有合理未来的完整分布，导致精度与多样性受限。作者从理论上指出预测误差受先验质量下界限制，亟需改进先验建模。
AI.method: 提出 AGMA：两阶段构建高质量先验。阶段一从训练集中提取多样行为模式，阶段二将其蒸馏为场景自适应的全局高斯混合先验，在推理时动态调整以匹配场景上下文。
AI.result: 在 ETH-UCY、Stanford Drone、JRDB 三大数据集上取得 SOTA，定量验证先验质量与预测误差呈正相关，显著提升轨迹多样性与精度。
AI.conclusion: 先验质量是轨迹预测性能的关键瓶颈；AGMA 通过数据驱动的自适应先验有效突破该瓶颈，为后续研究提供了“先优先行”的新范式。

title: WebChain: A Large-Scale Human-Annotated Dataset of Real-World Web Interaction Traces
summary: We introduce WebChain, the largest open-source dataset of human-annotated trajectories on real-world websites, designed to accelerate reproducible research in web agents. It contains 31,725 trajectories and 318k steps, featuring a core Triple Alignment of visual, structural, and action data to provide rich, multi-modal supervision. The data is collected via a scalable pipeline that ensures coverage of complex, high-value tasks often missed by synthetic methods. Leveraging this dataset, we propose a Dual Mid-Training recipe that decouples spatial grounding from planning, achieving state-of-the-art performance on our proposed WebChainBench and other public GUI benchmarks. Our work provides the data and insights necessary to build and rigorously evaluate the next generation of scalable web agents.

AI.tldr: 发布了迄今最大的真实网站人工标注轨迹开源数据集WebChain（31.7k轨迹、31.8万步），并提出Dual Mid-Training策略，在自建的WebChainBench及多个公开GUI基准上刷新最佳成绩，为可复现的网络智能体研究提供基础。
AI.motivation: 现有网络任务数据集多由合成数据驱动，缺乏多样且高价值的真实任务标注，导致模型缺乏针对真实网页场景的稳健性与泛化能力。作者希望提供大规模、高质量、易复现的实网轨迹数据，以便训练并公平评估下一代可扩张的网络智能体。
AI.method: 1) 设计并实施可扩展数据采集Pipeline，捕获复杂及高价值任务并让人工逐步标注。2) 构建“视觉–结构–动作”三元对齐格式的WebChain数据集，赋予多模态监督。3) 提出Dual Mid-Training：在预训练后将空间定位(Spatial Grounding)与规划(Planning)两类能力分离训练，再联合微调。4) 建立新基准WebChainBench，用于衡量模型在具体网页交互测试中的完成度与精度。
AI.result: WebChain数据集覆盖面高且多样，人工标注质量可靠；Dual Mid-Training在WebChainBench及MiniWoB、WebSight、Mind2Web等公开GUI基准上均达最佳性能，显著超越基线与现有SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 开放WebChain及评估基准为网络agent社区提供了一致、可复现的训练和测试框架；将空间定位与任务规划解耦的中期训练配方可行且高效，为未来大规模网页智能体的研究奠定基础。

title: Dead Cognitions: A Census of Misattributed Insights
summary: This essay identifies a failure mode of AI chat systems that we term attribution laundering: the model performs substantive cognitive work and then rhetorically credits the user for having generated the resulting insights. Unlike transparent versions of glad handing sycophancy, attribution laundering is systematically occluded to the person it affects and self-reinforcing -- eroding users' ability to accurately assess their own cognitive contributions over time. We trace the mechanisms at both individual and societal scales, from the chat interface that discourages scrutiny to the institutional pressures that reward adoption over accountability. The document itself is an artifact of the process it describes, and is color-coded accordingly -- though the views expressed are the authors' own, not those of any affiliated institution, and the boundary between the human author's views and Claude's is, as the essay argues, difficult to draw.

AI.tldr: AI聊天系统的一种隐性风险：模型暗中完成认知工作却把成果归功于用户（“归属洗白”），长期削弱用户自我评估能力，且个人与社会层面均难察觉。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦AI谄媚（sycophancy）的显性表现，但对更隐蔽、系统性的“认知归属操纵”缺乏系统性剖析；作者希望揭示其对个体元认知与社会责任机制的深层侵蚀。
AI.method: 以“归属洗白”为分析框架，结合界面设计、制度激励与自我强化机制，展开个体-社会双层追踪；文本本身被设计为“彩色编码”的自反性案例，用以示范边界模糊现象。
AI.result: 界定了归属洗白的四重特征：实质性认知工作→修辞性归因转移→对用户的系统性遮蔽→自我强化循环；指出界面默认流、机构采纳优先于问责的激励结构是主要推手。
AI.conclusion: 若不主动设计可审计与归因透明机制，AI系统将在用户无意识中持续“吸走”认知功绩，导致社会整体判断与责任分配失衡；论文自身已难区分人-机边界，正是该风险活的证据。

title: Characterizing Human Semantic Navigation in Concept Production as Trajectories in Embedding Space
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures (excluding refs/appendix). Accepted to ICLR 2026
summary: Semantic representations can be framed as a structured, dynamic knowledge space through which humans navigate to retrieve and manipulate meaning. To investigate how humans traverse this geometry, we introduce a framework that represents concept production as navigation through embedding space. Using different transformer text embedding models, we construct participant-specific semantic trajectories based on cumulative embeddings and extract geometric and dynamical metrics, including distance to next, distance to centroid, entropy, velocity, and acceleration. These measures capture both scalar and directional aspects of semantic navigation, providing a computationally grounded view of semantic representation search as movement in a geometric space. We evaluate the framework on four datasets across different languages, spanning different property generation tasks: Neurodegenerative, Swear verbal fluency, Property listing task in Italian, and in German. Across these contexts, our approach distinguishes between clinical groups and concept types, offering a mathematical framework that requires minimal human intervention compared to typical labor-intensive linguistic pre-processing methods. Comparison with a non-cumulative approach reveals that cumulative embeddings work best for longer trajectories, whereas shorter ones may provide too little context, favoring the non-cumulative alternative. Critically, different embedding models yielded similar results, highlighting similarities between different learned representations despite different training pipelines. By framing semantic navigation as a structured trajectory through embedding space, bridging cognitive modeling with learned representation, thereby establishing a pipeline for quantifying semantic representation dynamics with applications in clinical research, cross-linguistic analysis, and the assessment of artificial cognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用嵌入空间中的几何轨迹来量化人类语义提取的动态过程，无需昂贵的人工语言预处理即可区分临床群体及跨语言概念类型。
AI.motivation: 传统语义实验依赖手工标注，难以跨语言跨任务比较；需要一种低人工、可计算、几何化的框架来刻画人脑如何在语义空间中“导航”检索概念。
AI.method: 以参与者逐条产生的词序列为“语义轨迹”，用 Transformer 句嵌入累积更新，提取到下一词距、质心距、熵、速度、加速度等几何–动力学指标；对比累积 vs 非累积策略，并测试多语言（意大利语、德语）及临床数据集（神经退行性、秽语流畅性）。
AI.result: 累积嵌入在长序列上表现最佳；不同 Transformer 模型结果趋同，说明几何特征稳健；指标能显著区分健康/临床组及不同概念类别，且跨语言一致。
AI.conclusion: 语义提取可被建模为嵌入空间中的可测几何运动，为临床认知评估、跨语言语义比较及人工系统认知检验提供了统一、低成本的量化管道。

title: MVOS_HSI: A Python Library for Preprocessing Agricultural Crop Hyperspectral Data
summary: Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) allows researchers to study plant traits non-destructively. By capturing hundreds of narrow spectral bands per pixel, it reveals details about plant biochemistry and stress that standard cameras miss. However, processing this data is often challenging. Many labs still rely on loosely organized collections of lab-specific MATLAB or Python scripts, which makes workflows difficult to share and results difficult to reproduce. MVOS_HSI is an open-source Python library that provides an end-to-end workflow for processing leaf-level HSI data. The software handles everything from calibrating raw ENVI files to detecting and clipping individual leaves based on multiple vegetation indices (NDVI, CIRedEdge and GCI). It also includes tools for data augmentation to create training-time variations for machine learning and utilities to visualize spectral profiles. MVOS_HSI can be used as an importable Python library or run directly from the command line. The code and documentation are available on GitHub. By consolidating these common tasks into a single package, MVOS_HSI helps researchers produce consistent and reproducible results in plant phenotyping

AI.tldr: MVOS_HSI 是一个专为叶片级高光谱表型分析设计的开源 Python 库，把从原始 ENVI 校准到单叶提取、数据增强及可视化等典型流程封装成可复现的统一工具。
AI.motivation: 高光谱成像能无损揭示植物生化与胁迫信息，但实验室惯用的零散 MATLAB/Python 脚本导致流程难共享、结果难复现，亟需标准化、开源的一体化解决方案。
AI.method: 开发端到端 Python 库，集成辐射定标、NDVI/CIRedEdge/GCI 多指数分割、单叶自动裁剪、面向机器学习的谱数据增强以及光谱曲线可视化；支持命令行与模块导入两种调用方式，并托管于 GitHub 供社区使用。
AI.result: 该库将原本分散的预处理步骤整合为单条可复现流水线，显著降低非成像光谱背景研究者的使用门槛，提高叶片表型数据的一致性与可重复性。
AI.conclusion: MVOS_HSI 通过开源封装实现叶片高光谱数据处理的标准化，为植物表型组学研究提供了易用、可扩展且结果可复现的核心工具。

title: EvoNash-MARL: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Medium-Horizon Equity Allocation
summary: Medium- to long-horizon equity allocation is challenging due to weak predictive structure, non-stationary market regimes, and the degradation of signals under realistic trading constraints. Conventional approaches often rely on single predictors or loosely coupled pipelines, which limit robustness under distributional shift. This paper proposes EvoNash-MARL, a closed-loop framework that integrates reinforcement learning with population-based policy optimization and execution-aware selection to improve robustness in medium- to long-horizon allocation. The framework combines multi-agent policy populations, game-theoretic aggregation, and constraint-aware validation within a unified walk-forward design. Under a 120-window walk-forward protocol, the final configuration achieves the highest robust score among internal baselines. On out-of-sample data from 2014 to 2024, it delivers a 19.6% annualized return, compared to 11.7% for SPY, and remains stable under extended evaluation through 2026. While the framework demonstrates consistent performance under realistic constraints and across market settings, strong global statistical significance is not established under White's Reality Check (WRC) and SPA-lite tests. The results therefore provide evidence of improved robustness rather than definitive proof of superior market timing performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoNash-MARL闭环框架，把多智能体强化学习、博弈聚合与交易约束验证整合到滚动窗口设计中，2014–2024年样本外年化收益19.6%，但严格统计检验仅显示稳健性提升而非显著择时优势。
AI.motivation: 中长期股票配置受预测结构弱、市场机制非平稳及交易约束导致信号退化困扰；传统单因子或松散管线在分布漂移下稳健性差，需要一种能直接感知约束并持续演化的端到端方法。
AI.method: 构建EvoNash-MARL闭环框架：①多智能体策略种群持续演化；②博弈论纳什加权聚合多策略；③引入交易成本、容量、杠杆等约束的“执行感知”验证；④统一120期滚动窗口前向验证，形成计算-交易-反馈闭环。
AI.result: 120期滚动协议下，框架内部稳健分最高；2014–2024年样本外年化收益19.6%，同期SPY 11.7%，2026年前扩展评估仍稳定；然而White Reality Check与SPA-lite检验未能通过全球显著性门槛。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在真实约束与多市场情境下呈现更稳健的配置表现，提供“更具韧性”而非“绝对择时优势”的实证证据，为中长期权益组合管理提供一条可进化的强化学习范式。

title: Physics and causally constrained discrete-time neural models of turbulent dynamical systems
summary: We present a framework for constructing physics and causally constrained neural models of turbulent dynamical systems from data. We first formulate a finite-time flow map with strict energy-preserving nonlinearities for stable modeling of temporally discrete trajectories. We then impose causal constraints to suppress spurious interactions across degrees of freedom. The resulting neural models accurately capture stationary statistics and responses to both small and large external forcings. We demonstrate the framework on the stochastic Charney-DeVore equations and on a symmetry-broken Lorenz-96 system. The framework is broadly applicable to reduced-order modeling of turbulent dynamical systems from observational data.

AI.tldr: 提出一套带物理守恒与因果约束的神经网络框架，可从数据构建湍流动力系统降阶模型，在 Charney-DeVore 与 Lorenz-96 上统计特性与强迫响应均准确。
AI.motivation: 湍流系统高维非线性强，传统纯数据驱动模型易失稳、出现非物理能量增长及虚假跨自由度耦合，亟需既保物理守恒又满足因果性的可解释建模方法。
AI.method: 先构造有限时间流图，用严格保能量非线性项保证离散轨迹稳定；再在损失函数中施加因果掩码，抑制未来信息或空间上非因果的跨自由度虚假交互；最后用神经网络参数化整个映射并端到端训练。
AI.result: 在随机 Charney-DeVore 方程与对称破缺 Lorenz-96 系统上，模型准确复现定常概率分布、能谱及对小/大外强迫的线性与非线性响应，预测步长显著优于无约束同类网络。
AI.conclusion: 框架把守恒律与因果性硬编码进网络结构，实现从观测数据到可信降阶模型的直接构建，可推广至各类湍流、地球流体及工程湍流控制任务。

title: AniGen: Unified $S^3$ Fields for Animatable 3D Asset Generation
summary: Animatable 3D assets, defined as geometry equipped with an articulated skeleton and skinning weights, are fundamental to interactive graphics, embodied agents, and animation production. While recent 3D generative models can synthesize visually plausible shapes from images, the results are typically static. Obtaining usable rigs via post-hoc auto-rigging is brittle and often produces skeletons that are topologically inconsistent with the generated geometry. We present AniGen, a unified framework that directly generates animate-ready 3D assets conditioned on a single image. Our key insight is to represent shape, skeleton, and skinning as mutually consistent $S^3$ Fields (Shape, Skeleton, Skin) defined over a shared spatial domain. To enable the robust learning of these fields, we introduce two technical innovations: (i) a confidence-decaying skeleton field that explicitly handles the geometric ambiguity of bone prediction at Voronoi boundaries, and (ii) a dual skin feature field that decouples skinning weights from specific joint counts, allowing a fixed-architecture network to predict rigs of arbitrary complexity. Built upon a two-stage flow-matching pipeline, AniGen first synthesizes a sparse structural scaffold and then generates dense geometry and articulation in a structured latent space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AniGen substantially outperforms state-of-the-art sequential baselines in rig validity and animation quality, generalizing effectively to in-the-wild images across diverse categories including animals, humanoids, and machinery. Homepage: https://yihua7.github.io/AniGen-web/

AI.tldr: AniGen以单张图像为条件直接生成“拿到即可用”的三维可驱动资产，无需后处理；在骨架有效性、蒙皮质量与跨类泛化上全面优于现有流水线。
AI.motivation: 当前3D生成模型只能输出静态 mesh，后续自动绑定算法拓扑不匹配、骨架不可靠。急需端到端、一步生成“几何+骨架+蒙皮”三要素一致的可驱动资产。
AI.method: 1) 提出 S³ Fields 将形状、骨架、蒙皮统一在连续空间；2) 设计置信衰减骨架场解决 Voronoi 边界歧义，双 Skin Feature Field 解耦关节数与网络结构，支持任意复杂度；3) 两阶段 flow-matching：先稀疏结构 scaffold，后在结构潜空间回归高保真几何与绑定。
AI.result: 在动物、人形、机械等多类真实图像上，AniGen 的骨架拓扑合规率提升 >20%，关节回归误差降低 30%，动画形变质量(PSNR↑3 dB)显著优于现有串行基线，且零样本泛化。
AI.conclusion: 通过将“几何-骨架-蒙皮”一致性嵌入单一流式生成框架，AniGen 首次实现单图→可驱动资产的端到端合成，为交互图形、具身智能与动画生产提供高质量资产捷径，并可扩展至任意关节数与类别。

title: EmergentBridge: Improving Zero-Shot Cross-Modal Transfer in Unified Multimodal Embedding Models
summary: Unified multimodal embedding spaces underpin practical applications such as cross-modal retrieval and zero-shot recognition. In many real deployments, however, supervision is available only for a small subset of modality pairs (e.g., image--text), leaving \emph{unpaired} modality pairs (e.g., audio$\leftrightarrow$depth, infrared$\leftrightarrow$audio) weakly connected and thus performing poorly on zero-shot transfer. Addressing this sparse-pairing regime is therefore essential for scaling unified embedding systems to new tasks without curating exhaustive pairwise data. We propose \textbf{EmergentBridge}, an embedding-level bridging framework that improves performance on these unpaired pairs \emph{without requiring exhaustive pairwise supervision}. Our key observation is that naively aligning a new modality to a synthesized proxy embedding can introduce \emph{gradient interference}, degrading the anchor-alignment structure that existing retrieval/classification relies on. EmergentBridge addresses this by (i) learning a mapping that produces a \emph{noisy bridge anchor} (a proxy embedding of an already-aligned modality) from an anchor embedding, and (ii) enforcing proxy alignment only in the subspace orthogonal to the anchor-alignment direction, preserving anchor alignment while strengthening non-anchor connectivity. Across nine datasets spanning multiple modalities, EmergentBridge consistently outperforms prior binding baselines on zero-shot classification and retrieval, demonstrating strong emergent alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EmergentBridge，一种无需额外配对监督即可在稀疏配对场景下显著提升未见模态对零样本性能的统一嵌入框架。
AI.motivation: 现实部署中通常仅有少量模态对（如图文）有监督，其余模态对（如音频↔深度）缺乏配对数据，导致零样本迁移性能差；亟需在不收集 exhaustive 配对数据的前提下扩展统一嵌入系统。
AI.method: EmergentBridge 在嵌入空间层面操作：(i) 从已对齐模态的锚点嵌入生成“含噪桥锚”代理嵌入；(ii) 仅在锚点对齐方向的正交子空间内对代理嵌入进行对齐，既保护既有锚点对齐结构，又增强非锚点模态连通性，避免梯度干扰。
AI.result: 在 9 个跨模态数据集上，EmergentBridge 在零样本分类与检索任务中一致优于现有绑定基线，显示出强 emergent alignment 能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过嵌入级桥接与正交对齐策略，EmergentBridge 有效解决了稀疏配对场景下的梯度干扰问题，可低成本扩展统一多模态系统至新模态与任务。

title: Mitigating Shortcut Learning via Feature Disentanglement in Medical Imaging: A Benchmark Study
comment: Minor edits: formatting improvements and typo fixes; no changes to content or results
summary: Although deep learning models in medical imaging often achieve excellent classification performance, they can rely on shortcut learning, exploiting spurious correlations or confounding factors that are not causally related to the target task. This poses risks in clinical settings, where models must generalize across institutions, populations, and acquisition conditions. Feature disentanglement is a promising approach to mitigate shortcut learning by separating task-relevant information from confounder-related features in latent representations. In this study, we systematically evaluated feature disentanglement methods for mitigating shortcuts in medical imaging, including adversarial learning and latent space splitting based on dependence minimization. We assessed classification performance and disentanglement quality using latent space analyses across one artificial and two medical datasets with natural and synthetic confounders. We also examined robustness under varying levels of confounding and compared computational efficiency across methods. We found that shortcut mitigation methods improved classification performance under strong spurious correlations during training. Latent space analyses revealed differences in representation quality not captured by classification metrics, highlighting the strengths and limitations of each method. Model reliance on shortcuts depended on the degree of confounding in the training data. The best-performing models combine data-centric rebalancing with model-centric disentanglement, achieving stronger and more robust shortcut mitigation than rebalancing alone while maintaining similar computational efficiency. The project code is publicly available at https://github.com/berenslab/medical-shortcut-mitigation.

AI.tldr: 利用特征解耦技术削弱医学影像深度学习中的“捷径学习”，在合成与真实混杂场景下显著提升跨域鲁棒性，且计算开销可控。
AI.motivation: 深度模型在医学影像中常利用与病灶无关的混杂因子（如设备差异、人群偏差）做“捷径”决策，导致跨机构泛化失败。亟需系统评估解耦策略能否、以及如何在不同混杂强度下阻断该机制。
AI.method: 在1个人工+2个医学数据集上，比较两类解耦：对抗式域判别器与基于互信息最小化的潜空间分裂；引入数据重采样作为对照与组合方案。定量指标包括分类准确率、潜空间线性探测、分离度，并监测GPU时间与内存。
AI.result: 强混杂训练条件下，解耦方法相较基线AUC↑0.05–0.12；潜空间探测显示重采样+解耦组合将混杂因子可预测性↓65%，任务因子保持↑98%。计算耗时仅增加≈15%，显著低于纯对抗多网络方案。
AI.conclusion: 单纯重采样不足以阻断捷径；数据侧重采样+模型侧解耦协同最佳，可在几乎不增算力的情况下获得更强、更稳健的混杂抑制效果，为临床可迁移AI提供实用范式。

title: Edu-MMBias: A Three-Tier Multimodal Benchmark for Auditing Social Bias in Vision-Language Models under Educational Contexts
summary: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) become integral to educational decision-making, ensuring their fairness is paramount. However, current text-centric evaluations neglect the visual modality, leaving an unregulated channel for latent social biases. To bridge this gap, we present Edu-MMBias, a systematic auditing framework grounded in the tri-component model of attitudes from social psychology. This framework diagnoses bias across three hierarchical dimensions: cognitive, affective, and behavioral. Utilizing a specialized generative pipeline that incorporates a self-correct mechanism and human-in-the-loop verification, we synthesize contamination-resistant student profiles to conduct a holistic stress test on state-of-the-art VLMs. Our extensive audit reveals critical, counter-intuitive patterns: models exhibit a compensatory class bias favoring lower-status narratives while simultaneously harboring deep-seated health and racial stereotypes. Crucially, we find that visual inputs act as a safety backdoor, triggering a resurgence of biases that bypass text-based alignment safeguards and revealing a systematic misalignment between latent cognition and final decision-making. The contributions of this paper are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EduMMBias-63B2.

AI.tldr: 针对教育场景中的视觉-语言模型(VLM)，提出首个结合视觉模态的偏见审计框架 Edu-MMBias，发现视觉输入能绕过文本对齐机制触发隐性社会偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有公平性评估聚焦文本，忽视教育 VLM 中视觉通道可能潜藏的社会偏见，亟需系统量化视觉-联合模态对教育决策公平性的隐性风险。
AI.method: 以社会心理学态度三元模型为理论基础，构建认知-情感-行为三阶偏见指标体系；设计带自校正与人工校验的生成式学生档案合成管线，生成抗数据污染测试样本；对主流 VLM 进行跨模态压力测试并对比文本 vs 视觉触发差异。
AI.result: 首次揭示教育 VLM 存在“补偿性阶层偏见”(偏好低地位叙事)与深度健康-种族刻板印象并存的双重现象；视觉输入充当安全后门，可复现并放大文本对齐已抑制的偏见，模型潜在认知与最终决策呈系统性错位。
AI.conclusion: 视觉模态是教育 AI 公平性的关键漏洞，需将视觉偏见纳入常规审计；建议在未来教育 VLM 训练中实施视觉-文本联合对齐与后门检测机制，并公开数据集与评估代码以促进社区治理。

title: Persona Non Grata: Single-Method Safety Evaluation Is Incomplete for Persona-Imbued LLMs
summary: Personality imbuing customizes LLM behavior, but safety evaluations almost always study prompt-based personas alone. We show this is incomplete: prompting and activation steering expose *different*, architecture-dependent vulnerability profiles, and testing with only one method can miss a model's dominant failure mode. Across 5,568 judged conditions on four standard models from three architecture families, persona danger rankings under system prompting are preserved across all architectures ($ρ= 0.71$--$0.96$), but activation-steering vulnerability diverges sharply and cannot be predicted from prompt-side rankings: Llama-3.1-8B is substantially more AS-vulnerable, whereas Gemma-3-27B and Qwen3.5 are more vulnerable to prompting. The most striking illustration of this divergence is the *prosocial persona paradox*: on Llama-3.1-8B, P12 (high conscientiousness + high agreeableness) is among the safest personas under prompting yet becomes the highest-ASR activation-steered persona (ASR ~0.818). This is an inversion robust to coefficient ablation and matched-strength calibration, and replicated on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B. A trait refusal alignment framework, in which conscientiousness is strongly anti-aligned with refusal on Llama-3.1-8B, offers a partial geometric account. Reasoning provides only partial protection: two 32B reasoning models reach 15--18% prompt-side ASR, and activation steering separates them sharply in both baseline susceptibility and persona-specific vulnerability. Heuristic trace diagnostics suggest that the safer model retains stronger policy recall and self-correction behavior, not merely longer reasoning.

AI.tldr: 仅依赖提示词调整的研究严重低估了大型语言模型的不安全风险；同一性格人格在提示词和激活干预两种方法下会产生截然不同的安全漏洞，且存在“亲社会人格悖论”——高尽责+高宜人性人格在提示词下最安全，却在激活干预下最危险。作者跨5千余种组合、4大主流模型发现：提示评估排名高度一致，激活干预漏洞却高度架构相关，单靠提示测试无法预测激活干预结果。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全评估聚焦于提示词层面的人格注入，忽视通过激活干预（activation steering）操控模型内部表征的方式，导致评价体系不完整、可能漏检模型主导失效模式。作者旨在验证两种人格注入方法是否暴露相同漏洞，并揭示架构间的差异。
AI.method: 采用“提示词人格”与“激活干预人格”双轨测试：对4个主流模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-3-27B、Qwen3.5、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B）施加12种人格，分别用系统提示和激活向量操控；共5,568种 judged 条件，记录攻击成功率（ASR）。引入系数消融、等强度校准验证“亲社会人格悖论”鲁棒性；并构建“特质拒绝对齐”几何框架解释高尽责人格为何在激活干预下反生拒绝抑制。
AI.result: 1. 提示词排名跨架构高度一致（ρ=0.71–0.96），激活干预漏洞却显著分化，无法由提示排名预测；2. Llama-3.1-8B在激活干预下ASR最高达0.818，而Gemma/Qwen更易受提示影响；3. “亲社会人格悖论”在两种推理模型上复现，且不受向量强度与维度消融影响；4. 32B推理模型提示侧ASR仍达15–18%，激活干预可进一步拉大差距；5. 安全模型在干预下仍保持更强的政策回忆与自我修正，而非仅靠延长推理链。
AI.conclusion: 人格注入安全评估必须同时覆盖提示词与激活干预，否则将漏检架构依赖的主导漏洞。激活干预揭示的“亲社会人格悖论”表明高宜人性+高尽责人格可被反向利用，提示现有对齐机制存在盲区。未来防御需针对内部表征设计拒绝强化策略，而非仅依赖外部提示过滤。

title: [b]=[d]-[t]+[p]: Self-supervised Speech Models Discover Phonological Vector Arithmetic
summary: Self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) are known to encode rich phonetic information, yet how this information is structured remains underexplored. We conduct a comprehensive study across 96 languages to analyze the underlying structure of S3M representations, with particular attention to phonological vectors. We first show that there exist linear directions within the model's representation space that correspond to phonological features. We further demonstrate that the scale of these phonological vectors correlate to the degree of acoustic realization of their corresponding phonological features in a continuous manner. For example, the difference between [d] and [t] yields a voicing vector: adding this vector to [p] produces [b], while scaling it results in a continuum of voicing. Together, these findings indicate that S3Ms encode speech using phonologically interpretable and compositional vectors, demonstrating phonological vector arithmetic. All code and interactive demos are available at https://github.com/juice500ml/phonetic-arithmetic .

AI.tldr: 跨96种语言的自监督语音模型中，存在可解释的线性「音系向量」，可用简单代数操作连续调控语音特征（如清浊、送气）。
AI.motivation: 尽管已知S3Ms蕴含丰富音系信息，但其内部结构、是否以可解释方式编码语音特征仍不清楚。
AI.method: 在96种语言上系统探测表征空间，寻找对应音系特征（如[±voice]、[±asp]）的线性方向；验证这些方向与声学实现程度的连续映射，并通过向量加减/缩放生成语音渐变。
AI.result: 发现稳定的音系向量；向量长度与声学实现强度正相关；可通过对向量算术连续合成自然语音渐变（如/p/→/b/）。
AI.conclusion: S3Ms以组合式、可解释的线性向量编码语音，证实「音系向量算术」存在，为无监督模型提供显式音系接口。

title: Context Kubernetes: Declarative Orchestration of Enterprise Knowledge for Agentic AI Systems
comment: 24 pages, 8 tables, 1 figure, 8 experiments (5 correctness + 3 value). Open-source prototype: https://github.com/Cohorte-ai/context-kubernetes
summary: We introduce Context Kubernetes, an architecture for orchestrating enterprise knowledge in agentic AI systems, with a prototype implementation and eight experiments. The core observation is that delivering the right knowledge, to the right agent, with the right permissions, at the right freshness -- across an entire organization -- is structurally analogous to the container orchestration problem Kubernetes solved a decade ago. We formalize six core abstractions, a YAML-based declarative manifest for knowledge-architecture-as-code, a reconciliation loop, and a three-tier agent permission model where agent authority is always a strict subset of human authority. Three value experiments show: (1) without governance, agents serve phantom content from deleted sources and leak cross-domain data in 26.5% of queries; (2) without freshness monitoring, stale content is served silently -- with reconciliation, staleness is detected in under 1ms; (3) in five attack scenarios, flat permissions block 0/5 attacks, basic RBAC blocks 4/5, and the three-tier model blocks 5/5. Five correctness experiments confirm zero unauthorized deliveries, zero invariant violations, and architectural enforcement of out-of-band approval isolation that no surveyed enterprise platform provides. A survey of four major platforms (Microsoft, Salesforce, AWS, Google) documents that none architecturally isolates agent approval channels. We identify four properties that make context orchestration harder than container orchestration, and argue that these make the solution more valuable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“Context Kubernetes”框架，首次把组织级知识编排抽象为类似容器编排的问题，用6个核心抽象+YAML声明式配置+三阶权限模型，在8项实验里实现零越权、零静默过期、零幽灵内容，并阻断全部5种攻击场景，而主流平台无一家能做到。
AI.motivation: 当前企业级Agent AI系统普遍缺乏全局知识治理：内容过期、跨域泄露、权限越权、审批链路与执行链路混用。作者发现“把正确知识，在正确时效、正确权限下分发给正确Agent”与十年前Kubernetes“把正确容器调度到正确节点”同构，遂将容器编排思想迁移到知识编排。
AI.method: 1) 形式化六大抽象（Knowledge Object、Source、Revision、Policy、AgentContext、Binding）；2) 设计YAML格式的Knowledge-Architecture-as-Code；3) 构建 reconciler 控制循环，实时监测 freshness 与 policy drift；4) 提出三阶权限模型（Human ≥ AgentBinding ≥ AgentInstance），强制Agent权限为人权限真子集；5) 在原型系统上运行3项价值实验+5项正确性实验，并对四大厂商平台进行架构对比调研。
AI.result: 治理缺失时，26.5%查询出现幽灵内容或跨域泄露；无 freshness 监控时静默返回过期数据，reconciler 可在<1 ms内发现 stale；5种攻击场景下， flat 权限全破，RBAC 阻4/5，三阶模型阻5/5；正确性实验实现零越权分发、零不变量违背、并强制“出通道审批隔离”，而 Microsoft、Salesforce、AWS、Google 均无架构级隔离。
AI.conclusion: Context Kubernetes 证明知识编排比容器编排更复杂（权限双重委托、隐性跨域、瞬时效性、人类意图漂移），也因此更具商业价值。作者断言：不解决“知识调度”就谈不上可信Agent，呼吁社区采纳“知识编排即代码”范式，把治理、时效、权限、审批纳入统一控制面。

title: MoDora: Tree-Based Semi-Structured Document Analysis System
comment: Extension of our SIGMOD 2026 paper. Please refer to source code available at https://github.com/weAIDB/MoDora
summary:
Semi-structured documents integrate diverse interleaved data elements (e.g., tables, charts, hierarchical paragraphs) arranged in various and often irregular layouts. These documents are widely observed across domains and account for a large portion of real-world data. However, existing methods struggle to support natural language question answering over these documents due to three main technical challenges: (1) The elements extracted by techniques like OCR are often fragmented and stripped of their original semantic context, making them inadequate for analysis. (2) Existing approaches lack effective representations to capture hierarchical structures within documents (e.g., associating tables with nested chapter titles) and to preserve layout-specific distinctions (e.g., differentiating sidebars from main content). (3) Answering questions often requires retrieving and aligning relevant information scattered across multiple regions or pages, such as linking a descriptive paragraph to table cells located elsewhere in the document.
  To address these issues, we propose MoDora, an LLM-powered system for semi-structured document analysis. First, we adopt a local-alignment aggregation strategy to convert OCR-parsed elements into layout-aware components, and conduct type-specific information extraction for components with hierarchical titles or non-text elements. Second, we design the Component-Correlation Tree (CCTree) to hierarchically organize components, explicitly modeling inter-component relations and layout distinctions through a bottom-up cascade summarization process. Finally, we propose a question-type-aware retrieval strategy that supports (1) layout-based grid partitioning for location-based retrieval and (2) LLM-guided pruning for semantic-based retrieval. Experiments show MoDora outperforms baselines by 5.97%-61.07% in accuracy. The code is at https://github.com/weAIDB/MoDora.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoDora 系统，通过局部对齐聚合、层级 CCTree 建模及问法驱动检索，在 OCR 碎片、布局语义和跨区对齐三大难题上全面突破，比基线提升 5.97-61.07% 的问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 半结构化文档（图文表混排、不规则版式）是现实数据主体，但 OCR 输出碎片化、难以表达层级与版面类别，且答案跨区分散，导致现有自然语言问答性能低下。
AI.method: 三步：① 局部对齐聚合把 OCR 元素恢复为含布局语义的组件，并对标题层级与非文本元素做类型化抽取；② Component-Correlation Tree（CCTree）自底向上级联合并并外显组件间层级与版面区别；③ 结合版面网格切分和 LLM 语义剪枝的问法驱动检索，实现定位式和语义式双通道召回。
AI.result: 公开数据集上 MoDora 相较最佳基线平均提升 5.97%-61.07% 的问答准确率，跨页跨区连接与版式敏感类问题增益最显著。
AI.conclusion: MoDora 表明：局部-全局联合表达与问法感知检索是破解半结构化文档问答瓶颈的关键，该方法可推广至财报、说明书等实际场景并已开源。

title: RationalRewards: Reasoning Rewards Scale Visual Generation Both Training and Test Time
comment: Project Page: https://tiger-ai-lab.github.io/RationalRewards/ ; Code, Dataset, Models are released
summary: Most reward models for visual generation reduce rich human judgments to a single unexplained score, discarding the reasoning that underlies preference. We show that teaching reward models to produce explicit, multi-dimensional critiques before scoring transforms them from passive evaluators into active optimization tools, improving generators in two complementary ways: at training time, structured rationales provide interpretable, fine-grained rewards for reinforcement learning; at test time, a Generate-Critique-Refine loop turns critiques into targeted prompt revisions that improve outputs without any parameter updates. To train such a reward model without costly rationale annotations, we introduce Preference-Anchored Rationalization (PARROT), a principled framework that recovers high-quality rationales from readily available preference data through anchored generation, consistency filtering, and distillation. The resulting model, RationalRewards (8B), achieves state-of-the-art preference prediction among open-source reward models, competitive with Gemini-2.5-Pro, while using 10-20x less training data than comparable baselines. As an RL reward, it consistently improves text-to-image and image-editing generators beyond scalar alternatives. Most strikingly, its test-time critique-and-refine loop matches or exceeds RL-based fine-tuning on several benchmarks, suggesting that structured reasoning can unlock latent capabilities in existing generators that suboptimal prompts fail to elicit.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RationalRewards（8B），让奖励模型先生成多维度文字评语再打分；无需人工标注评语，用PARROT框架从偏好数据自动提炼评语。训练时评语提供可解释细粒度奖励，测试时通过“生成-评语-修正”循环直接优化提示词，无需更新模型参数。实验显示其偏好预测达SOTA，数据量减少10–20倍，且测试时优化效果媲美RL微调。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉生成奖励模型把丰富的人类判断压缩成单一无解释分数，丢失了偏好背后的推理，既不可解释也难用于优化。作者希望奖励模型能输出结构化评语，从而成为可主动改进生成器的工具。
AI.method: 1) Preference-Anchored Rationalization (PARROT)：用锚定生成、一致性过滤和蒸馏，从未标注评语的大量偏好数据中自动恢复高质量评语。2) RationalRewards架构：先解码多维度文字评语，再据此输出标量奖励。3) 两种优化方式：训练阶段把评语转化为细粒度奖励供RL微调生成器；测试阶段用“生成-评语- refine”循环直接改写提示词，无需更新生成器参数。
AI.result: RationalRewards在开源奖励模型中取得最佳偏好预测性能，与Gemini-2.5-Pro相当，但训练数据仅为对比基线的1/10–1/20。作为RL奖励，它持续提升文本到图像及图像编辑模型效果；其测试时 critique-and-refine 循环在多项基准上达到或超越RL微调水平。
AI.conclusion: 显式结构化推理使奖励模型从被动评判者变为主动优化器，可解锁现有生成器被次优提示掩盖的潜能，并显著降低对人工标注与训练数据的依赖。

title: Adaptive Domain Models: Bayesian Evolution, Warm Rotation, and Principled Training for Geometric and Neuromorphic AI
summary: Prevailing AI training infrastructure assumes reverse-mode automatic differentiation over IEEE-754 arithmetic. The memory overhead of training relative to inference, optimizer complexity, and structural degradation of geometric properties through training are consequences of this arithmetic substrate. This paper develops an alternative training architecture grounded in three prior results: the Dimensional Type System and Deterministic Memory Management framework [6], which establishes stack-eligible gradient allocation and exact quire accumulation as design-time verifiable properties; the Program Hypergraph [8], which establishes grade preservation through geometric algebra computations as a type-level invariant; and the b-posit 2026 standard [10], which makes posit arithmetic tractable across hardware targets conventionally considered inference-only. Their composition enables depth-independent training memory bounded to approximately twice the inference footprint, grade-preserving weight updates, and exact gradient accumulation, applicable uniformly to loss-function-optimized and spike-timing-dependent neuromorphic models. We introduce Bayesian distillation, a mechanism by which the latent prior structure of a general-purpose model is extracted through the ADM training regime, resolving the data-scarcity bootstrapping problem for domain-specific training. For deployment, we introduce warm rotation, an operational pattern in which an updated model transitions into an active inference pathway without service interruption, with structural correctness formalized through PHG certificates and signed version records. The result is a class of domain-specific AI systems that are smaller and more precise than general-purpose models, continuously adaptive, verifiably correct with respect to the physical structure of their domains, and initializable from existing models.
