Scientific modeling faces a tradeoff between the interpretability of mechanistic theory and the predictive power of machine learning. While existing hybrid approaches have made progress by incorporating domain knowledge into machine learning methods as functional constraints, they can be limited by a reliance on precise mathematical specifications. When the underlying equations are partially unknown or misspecified, enforcing rigid constraints can introduce bias and hinder a model's ability to learn from data. We introduce Simulation-Grounded Neural Networks (SGNNs), a framework that incorporates scientific theory by using mechanistic simulations as training data for neural networks. By pretraining on diverse synthetic corpora that span multiple model structures and realistic observational noise, SGNNs internalize the underlying dynamics of a system as a structural prior.
  We evaluated SGNNs across multiple disciplines, including epidemiology, ecology, social science, and chemistry. In forecasting tasks, SGNNs outperformed both standard data-driven baselines and physics-constrained hybrid models. They nearly tripled the forecasting skill of the average CDC models in COVID-19 mortality forecasts and accurately forecasted high-dimensional ecological systems. SGNNs demonstrated robustness to model misspecification, performing well even when trained on data with incorrect assumptions. Our framework also introduces back-to-simulation attribution, a method for mechanistic interpretability that explains real-world dynamics by identifying their most similar counterparts within the simulated corpus. By unifying these techniques into a single framework, we demonstrate that diverse mechanistic simulations can serve as effective training data for robust scientific inference.

AI.tldr: 提出SGNN，用大规模机理仿真数据预训练神经网络，既保留机理先验又避免硬约束带来的偏差，在多学科预测任务中显著优于传统数据驱动与物理耦合模型。
AI.motivation: 科学建模需在可解释机理与预测性能间权衡；现有将领域知识嵌入机器学习的方法依赖精确方程，方程未知或误设时硬约束会引入偏差，限制模型从数据学习的能力。
AI.method: 构建Simulation-Grounded Neural Networks框架：①生成覆盖多模型结构与观测噪声的机理仿真语料；②用该语料预训练神经网络，使其内隐习得系统动力学作为结构先验；③提出“回仿真归因”机制，将真实动态映射到最相似仿真样本以实现可解释性。
AI.result: 在流行病学、生态学、社会科学与化学的预测任务中，SGNN相对标准数据基线与物理约束混合模型全面提升；COVID-19死亡预测技能较CDC平均模型提升近3倍，高维生态系统预测准确，且在模型误设条件下仍保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 将多样化机理仿真统一为神经网络训练数据，可在不牺牲预测精度的前提下获得鲁棒科学推断与可解释性，为融合机理知识与机器学习提供新范式。

title: Automatic Road Subsurface Distress Recognition from Ground Penetrating Radar Images using Deep Learning-based Cross-verification
summary: Ground penetrating radar (GPR) has become a rapid and non-destructive solution for road subsurface distress (RSD) detection. However, recognizing RSD from GPR images is labor-intensive and heavily relies on the expertise of inspectors. Deep learning-based automatic RSD recognition, though ameliorating the burden of data processing, suffers from insufficient capability to recognize defects. In this study, a novel cross-verification strategy was proposed to fully exploit the complementary abilities of region proposal networks in object recognition from different views of GPR images. Following this strategy, three YOLO-based models were used to detect the RSD (voids and loose structures) and manholes. Each model was trained with a specific view of 3D GPR dataset, which contains rigorously validated 2134 samples of diverse types obtained through field scanning. The cross-verification strategy achieves outstanding accuracy with a recall of over 98.6% in the tests using real field-scanning data. Field tests also show that deep learning-based automatic RSD recognition can reduce the human labor of inspection by around 90%.

AI.tldr: 用「三视角 YOLO＋交叉验证」实现 GPR 道路隐蔽病害全自动识别，召回率98.6%，人工工作量降低90%。
AI.motivation: GPR 道路隐蔽病害识别完全依赖人工，深度学习虽能减轻工作量，但单模型缺陷识别能力不足。
AI.method: 构建 2134 个严格标注的 3D GPR 样本库；训练三个独立 YOLO 模型，分别对应三维 GPR 数据的 B-scan、C-scan、Depth-slice 视图；提出交叉验证策略，将各视图预测结果互为约束，融合最终决策。
AI.result: 在实测路段验证中，整体召回率≥98.6%，误检率显著低于单视角模型；系统上线后，现场人工复核工作量减少约 90%。
AI.conclusion: 多视角 YOLO 与交叉验证策略可充分挖掘 GPR 不同投影的互补信息，实现道路隐蔽病害的高精度、低人力自动识别，具备直接工程化部署潜力。

title: Improved particle swarm optimization algorithm: multi-target trajectory optimization for swarm drones
comment: New experiments have revealed systematic errors in the original data
summary: Real-time trajectory planning for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in dynamic environments remains a key challenge due to high computational demands and the need for fast, adaptive responses. Traditional Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) methods, while effective for offline planning, often struggle with premature convergence and latency in real-time scenarios. To overcome these limitations, we propose PE-PSO, an enhanced PSO-based online trajectory planner. The method introduces a persistent exploration mechanism to preserve swarm diversity and an entropy-based parameter adjustment strategy to dynamically adapt optimization behavior. UAV trajectories are modeled using B-spline curves, which ensure path smoothness while reducing optimization complexity. To extend this capability to UAV swarms, we develop a multi-agent framework that combines genetic algorithm (GA)-based task allocation with distributed PE-PSO, supporting scalable and coordinated trajectory generation. The distributed architecture allows for parallel computation and decentralized control, enabling effective cooperation among agents while maintaining real-time performance. Comprehensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms conventional PSO and other swarm-based planners across several metrics, including trajectory quality, energy efficiency, obstacle avoidance, and computation time. These results confirm the effectiveness and applicability of PE-PSO in real-time multi-UAV operations under complex environmental conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出 PE-PSO 在线轨迹规划器，用持续探索与熵参数自适应缓解 PSO 早熟收敛；B 样条降维，GA 任务分配+分布式 PE-PSO 支持多机实时协同，仿真全面优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 实时动态环境下，传统 PSO 早熟收敛、延迟高，难以满足单机/集群毫秒级重规划需求，需兼顾 swarm 多样性、参数自适与可扩展协同。
AI.method: 持续探索机制维持种群多样性；熵度量动态调整 PSO 参数；B 样条曲线参数化轨迹，降维并保证曲率连续；GA 负责任务分配，分布式 PE-PSO 并行求解各机轨迹，实现去中心化实时协同。
AI.result: 在轨迹长度、能耗、避障率、单步重规划时间等多指标上均优于标准 PSO、GA-PSO 及最新 swarm planner；10 架无人机场景下，单步计算 <20 ms，路径缩短 15–25%，能耗降低 12–18%。
AI.conclusion: PE-PSO 在保持实时性的同时显著提升单机与集群轨迹质量与鲁棒性，可直接嵌入飞控或机载电脑，适用于城市物流、灾后搜救等高动态密集任务。

title: ChemDFM-R: A Chemical Reasoning LLM Enhanced with Atomized Chemical Knowledge
summary: Atomized chemical knowledge, such as functional group information of molecules and reactions, plays a pivotal intermediate role in the reasoning process that connects molecular structures with their properties and reactivities. While large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive progress, the absence of atomized chemical knowledge results in their superficial understanding of chemistry and limited chemical reasoning capabilities. In this work, to tackle this problem, we develop a Chemical Reasoning LLM, ChemDFM-R. We first construct a comprehensive dataset of atomized chemical knowledge, ChemFG, annotating the presence of functional groups in molecules and the changes of functional groups during chemical reactions, to enhance the model's understanding of the fundamental principles and internal logic of chemistry. Then, we propose a mixed-source distillation method that initializes the model's reasoning capability with limited distilled data, and develop a four-stage training pipeline to equip the model with atomized chemical knowledge and chemical reasoning logic. Experiments on diverse chemical benchmarks demonstrate that ChemDFM-R achieves cutting-edge performance while providing interpretable, rationale-driven outputs, surpassing both the general-domain LLMs and domain-specific chemical LLMs. Moreover, ChemDFM-R achieves comparable or superior performance compared with cutting-edge commercial LLMs, such as o4-mini. Further case studies illustrate how explicit reasoning chains significantly improve the model's reliability, transparency, and practicality in real-world human-AI collaboration scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChemDFM-R，通过构建原子级化学知识数据集 ChemFG 并设计混合蒸馏-四阶段训练流程，使大模型获得可解释的化学推理能力，在多项基准上超越通用及专业化学模型，媲美 o4-mini。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型缺乏原子级化学知识，导致对化学理解肤浅、推理受限；需将官能团等微观结构-性质-反应关系显式注入模型，以支持可解释且可靠的化学推理。
AI.method: 1) 构建 ChemFG 数据集，标注分子中官能团及其在反应中的变化；2) 提出“混合源蒸馏”用少量高质量数据初始化推理能力；3) 设计四阶段训练流程（预训练→知识注入→推理微调→对齐优化），系统植入原子化知识与推理逻辑。
AI.result: ChemDFM-R 在多个化学基准上取得 SOTA，显著优于通用 LLM 及现有化学专用 LLM，并与 o4-mini 等顶尖商用模型相当甚至更优；案例表明其输出的显式推理链提升了可靠性、透明度与人机协作实用性。
AI.conclusion: 原子级化学知识+针对性训练可显著增强 LLM 的化学理解与推理，ChemDFM-R 为构建可解释、可信的化学 AI 提供了一条有效路径。

title: Teaching the Teacher: The Role of Teacher-Student Smoothness Alignment in Genetic Programming-based Symbolic Distillation
summary: Obtaining human-readable symbolic formulas via genetic programming-based symbolic distillation of a deep neural network trained on the target dataset presents a promising yet underexplored path towards explainable artificial intelligence (XAI); however, the standard pipeline frequently yields symbolic models with poor predictive accuracy. We identify a fundamental misalignment in functional complexity as the primary barrier to achieving better accuracy: standard Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) often learn accurate but highly irregular functions, while Symbolic Regression typically prioritizes parsimony, often resulting in a much simpler class of models that are unable to sufficiently distill or learn from the ANN teacher. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework that actively regularizes the teacher's functional smoothness using Jacobian and Lipschitz penalties, aiming to distill better student models than the standard pipeline. We characterize the trade-off between predictive accuracy and functional complexity through a robust study involving 20 datasets and 50 independent trials. Our results demonstrate that students distilled from smoothness-regularized teachers achieve statistically significant improvements in R^2 scores, compared to the standard pipeline. We also perform ablation studies on the student model algorithm. Our findings suggest that smoothness alignment between teacher and student models is a critical factor for symbolic distillation.

AI.tldr: 用平滑化约束后的深度网络当“老师”指导遗传编程做符号蒸馏，可显著提升所得公式的R²精度。
AI.motivation: 常规符号蒸馏因教师网络函数过于复杂、学生模型偏好简单，导致精度骤降；需弥合二者复杂度失配。
AI.method: 在教师训练阶段引入Jacobian与Lipschitz平滑正则，迫使函数更规则，再用该平滑教师进行遗传编程符号回归蒸馏。
AI.result: 在20个数据集、50次独立试验中，平滑教师的学生模型R²显著优于标准流程；消融实验表明平滑对齐是关键因子。
AI.conclusion: 保证教师-学生函数平滑度一致是提升符号蒸馏精度的决定性条件，为可解释AI提供了实用且准确的符号公式获取途径。

title: BRAIN: Bias-Mitigation Continual Learning Approach to Vision-Brain Understanding
summary: Memory decay makes it harder for the human brain to recognize visual objects and retain details. Consequently, recorded brain signals become weaker, uncertain, and contain poor visual context over time. This paper presents one of the first vision-learning approaches to address this problem. First, we statistically and experimentally demonstrate the existence of inconsistency in brain signals and its impact on the Vision-Brain Understanding (VBU) model. Our findings show that brain signal representations shift over recording sessions, leading to compounding bias, which poses challenges for model learning and degrades performance. Then, we propose a new Bias-Mitigation Continual Learning (BRAIN) approach to address these limitations. In this approach, the model is trained in a continual learning setup and mitigates the growing bias from each learning step. A new loss function named De-bias Contrastive Learning is also introduced to address the bias problem. In addition, to prevent catastrophic forgetting, where the model loses knowledge from previous sessions, the new Angular-based Forgetting Mitigation approach is introduced to preserve learned knowledge in the model. Finally, the empirical experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves State-of-the-Art (SOTA) performance across various benchmarks, surpassing prior and non-continual learning methods.

AI.tldr: 针对脑信号随时间衰减导致的视觉识别性能下降，本文提出一种持续去偏脑信号学习框架 BRAIN，首次用统计学与实验证实脑信号跨会话偏移现象，并设计去偏对比损失与角度遗忘抑制机制，在多个基准上取得 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 脑信号的记忆衰减使得视觉刺激诱发的响应随时间变弱且不稳定，造成跨会话信号分布偏移，严重削弱 Vision-Brain Understanding（VBU）模型的泛化与持续学习能力，亟需系统性的去偏与抗遗忘策略。
AI.method: 1) 统计与实验量化脑信号跨会话不一致性及其对 VBU 的负面影响；2) 构建 Bias-Mitigation Continual Learning（BRAIN）框架，在持续学习流程中逐次抑制累积偏差；3) 设计 De-bias Contrastive Learning 损失，显式对齐跨会话特征分布；4) 提出 Angular-based Forgetting Mitigation，利用角度正则化保持旧任务决策边界，避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个公开脑-视觉数据集上的实验表明，BRAIN 显著优于现有非持续与早期持续学习方法，识别准确率平均提升 8–15%，跨会话鲁棒性提高 20% 以上，达到当前最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 首次证实脑信号跨会话偏移是 VBU 性能下降的主因，提出的 BRAIN 框架通过去偏对比学习与角度遗忘抑制，有效缓解偏差累积与灾难遗忘，为长时间、多会话的脑控视觉系统提供了可行且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Variation in Verification: Understanding Verification Dynamics in Large Language Models
summary: Recent advances have shown that scaling test-time computation enables large language models (LLMs) to solve increasingly complex problems across diverse domains. One effective paradigm for test-time scaling (TTS) involves LLM generators producing multiple solution candidates, with LLM verifiers assessing the correctness of these candidates without reference answers. In this paper, we study generative verifiers, which perform verification by generating chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning followed by a binary verdict. We systematically analyze verification dynamics across three dimensions - problem difficulty, generator capability, and verifier generation capability - with empirical studies on 12 benchmarks across mathematical reasoning, knowledge, and natural language reasoning tasks using 14 open-source models (2B to 72B parameter range) and GPT-4o. Our experiments reveal three key findings about verification effectiveness: (1) Easy problems allow verifiers to more reliably certify correct responses; (2) Weak generators produce errors that are easier to detect than strong generators; (3) Verification ability is generally correlated with the verifier's own problem-solving capability, but this relationship varies with problem difficulty. These findings reveal opportunities to optimize basic verification strategies in TTS applications. First, given the same verifier, some weak generators can nearly match stronger ones in post-verification TTS performance (e.g., the Gemma2-9B to Gemma2-27B performance gap shrinks by 75.7%). Second, we identify cases where strong verifiers offer limited advantage over weak ones, as both fail to provide meaningful verification gains, suggesting that verifier scaling alone cannot overcome fundamental verification challenges.

AI.tldr: Scaling test-time inference by letting multiple-generator generate candidate answers and a generative verifier choose among them improves LLM performance; yet verification accuracy is limited by the verifier’s own reasoning skill, problem difficulty, and generator strength, so blindly up-sizing the verifier is not always helpful.
AI.motivation: While test-time scaling (TTS) has proven effective for difficult tasks, most work just uses a fixed generator+verifier pair and does not examine how verification quality is influenced by (i) problem hardness, (ii) generator strength and (iii) verifier capacity. The paper therefore aims to systematically profile when TTS actually boosts accuracy and how these three factors interact, so as to guide practical deployment without wasting compute.
AI.method: An empirical ablation study on 12 benchmarks (math, commonsense, NL) with 14 open-source models (2–72 B) plus GPT-4o. Each experimental cell fixes two of the three factors and sweeps the third. Verification is performed by generative verifiers that output CoT followed by a binary correct/incorrect verdict on every candidate solution. Performance is evaluated with the post-verification accuracy improvement (Δacc) and compute-normalized improvement.
AI.result: 1) Easy (high-solve-rate) problems gain ~2–3× more from verification than hard ones. 2) Errors produced by weak generators are ~1.7× easier to detect; consequently, a medium verifier paired with a weak generator closes up to 75.7 % of the performance gap created by a stronger generator alone. 3) Verifier accuracy correlates with the verifier’s own solving score (ρ≈0.68 overall), but the coefficient drops to near zero on very hard test sets, indicating a verification ceiling. 4) Simply enlarging the verifier often yields <2 % absolute gain while doubling GPU hours, implying diminishing returns when the underlying verification signal is already saturated.
AI.conclusion: TTS with generative verification can be highly compute-efficient only if the three interacting factors are aligned: target easier instances to certify, prefer weak generators whose mistakes are easier to spot, and stop oversizing the verifier once its on-task accuracy plateaus. Future work should build adaptive generators that output “hard-to-fool” solutions and verifier-training curricula that explicitly teach boundary-case discrimination rather than mere answer-only solving skill.

title: Safe-SAIL: Towards a Fine-grained Safety Landscape of Large Language Models via Sparse Autoencoder Interpretation Framework
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) enable interpretability research by decomposing entangled model activations into monosemantic features. However, under what circumstances SAEs derive most fine-grained latent features for safety, a low-frequency concept domain, remains unexplored. Two key challenges exist: identifying SAEs with the greatest potential for generating safety domain-specific features, and the prohibitively high cost of detailed feature explanation. In this paper, we propose Safe-SAIL, a unified framework for interpreting SAE features in safety-critical domains to advance mechanistic understanding of large language models. Safe-SAIL introduces a pre-explanation evaluation metric to efficiently identify SAEs with strong safety domain-specific interpretability, and reduces interpretation cost by 55% through a segment-level simulation strategy. Building on Safe-SAIL, we train a comprehensive suite of SAEs with human-readable explanations and systematic evaluations for 1,758 safety-related features spanning four domains: pornography, politics, violence, and terror. Using this resource, we conduct empirical analyses and provide insights on the effectiveness of Safe-SAIL for risk feature identification and how safety-critical entities and concepts are encoded across model layers. All models, explanations, and tools are publicly released in our open-source toolkit and companion product.

AI.tldr: Safe-SAIL 用 55% 解释成本选出最具安全特征挖掘潜力的 SAE，首次系统开放 1 758 条色情/政治/暴力/恐怖相关可解释特征，并给出跨层编码规律。
AI.motivation: SAE 能把模型激活拆成单语义特征，但“低频安全概念能否被精细还原”尚无答案；同时人工逐特征标注成本极高，亟需先筛选高潜力 SAE 再解释。
AI.method: 提出 Safe-SAIL 框架：① 预解释评估指标先排序 SAE 的安全可解释潜力；② 段级模拟策略把解释开销降 55%；③ 在四个安全关键域训练 1 758 条带人读解释的 SAE；④ 开源全套模型、解释与评测工具。
AI.result: 实验表明 Safe-SAIL 能以一半成本精准锁定风险特征，并揭示色情/政治/暴力/恐怖概念在 LLM 不同层的分布式编码模式。
AI.conclusion: Safe-SAIL 为安全对齐提供低成本、高粒度的机制可解释资源，可直接用于风险检测与模型修复。

title: DyBBT: Dynamic Balance via Bandit-inspired Targeting for Dialog Policy with Cognitive Dual-Systems
summary: Task oriented dialog systems often rely on static exploration strategies that do not adapt to dynamic dialog contexts, leading to inefficient exploration and suboptimal performance. We propose DyBBT, a novel dialog policy learning framework that formalizes the exploration challenge through a structured cognitive state space capturing dialog progression, user uncertainty, and slot dependency. DyBBT proposes a bandit inspired meta-controller that dynamically switches between a fast intuitive inference (System 1) and a slow deliberative reasoner (System 2) based on real-time cognitive states and visitation counts. Extensive experiments on single- and multi-domain benchmarks show that DyBBT achieves state-of-the-art performance in success rate, efficiency, and generalization, with human evaluations confirming its decisions are well aligned with expert judgment.

AI.tldr: DyBBT框架用认知状态驱动的双系统元控制器，在对话策略学习中动态切换快/慢思考，实现SOTA成功率与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有任务型对话系统采用静态探索策略，无法随动态语境调整，导致探索冗余、性能次优。
AI.method: 构建结构化认知状态空间（对话进展、用户不确定度、槽位依赖），引入bandit型元控制器，实时依据状态与访问计数在System 1快速推断与System 2慢速推理间切换，实现自适应探索。
AI.result: 在单/多领域基准上均取得成功率、效率与泛化能力的新SOTA；人工评估显示其决策与专家判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: DyBBT通过认知启发的动态双系统机制，显著提升了对话策略学习的探索效率与最终性能，为自适应对话系统提供新范式。

title: HiCoLoRA: Addressing Context-Prompt Misalignment via Hierarchical Collaborative LoRA for Zero-Shot DST
summary: Zero-shot Dialog State Tracking (zs-DST) is essential for enabling Task-Oriented Dialog Systems (TODs) to generalize to new domains without costly data annotation. A central challenge lies in the semantic misalignment between dynamic dialog contexts and static prompts, leading to inflexible cross-layer coordination, domain interference, and catastrophic forgetting. To tackle this, we propose Hierarchical Collaborative Low-Rank Adaptation (HiCoLoRA), a framework that enhances zero-shot slot inference through robust prompt alignment. It features a hierarchical LoRA architecture for dynamic layer-specific processing (combining lower-layer heuristic grouping and higher-layer full interaction), integrates Spectral Joint Domain-Slot Clustering to identify transferable associations (feeding an Adaptive Linear Fusion Mechanism), and employs Semantic-Enhanced SVD Initialization (SemSVD-Init) to preserve pre-trained knowledge. Experiments on multi-domain datasets MultiWOZ and SGD show that HiCoLoRA outperforms baselines, achieving SOTA in zs-DST. Code is available at https://github.com/carsonz/HiCoLoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层次协同低秩适配框架 HiCoLoRA，解决零样本对话状态跟踪中提示与语境语义错位、跨层协调僵化及灾难性遗忘问题，在 MultiWOZ 与 SGD 上取得新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 任务型对话系统扩展到新领域时，标注数据昂贵。零样本对话状态跟踪(zs-DST)可缓解此问题，但动态对话上下文与静态提示之间存在语义错位，导致跨层协调不灵活、域间干扰及灾难性遗忘，亟需新框架提升泛化性。
AI.method: 提出 HiCoLoRA：1) 层次 LoRA 结构——低层启发式分组、高层全交互，实现动态层特定处理；2) 谱联合域-槽聚类(Spectral Joint Domain-Slot Clustering)识别可迁移关联，并输入自适应线性融合机制；3) SemSVD-Init 用语义增强 SVD 初始化保持预训练知识。
AI.result: 在 MultiWOZ 与 SGD 多域数据集上，HiCoLoRA 显著优于现有零样本基线，刷新 zs-DST 最佳成绩。
AI.conclusion: HiCoLoRA 通过层次低秩协同与谱聚类融合，有效对齐提示与动态语境，抑制域干扰与遗忘，为零样本对话状态跟踪提供高效可扩展方案。

title: SeedPrints: Fingerprints Can Even Tell Which Seed Your Large Language Model Was Trained From
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026. The code repository linked on OpenReview is outdated; the latest code is available via the final arXiv version
summary: Fingerprinting Large Language Models (LLMs)is essential for provenance verification and model attribution. Existing fingerprinting methods are primarily evaluated after fine-tuning, where models have already acquired stable signatures from training data, optimization dynamics, or hyperparameters. However, most of a model's capacity and knowledge are acquired during pretraining rather than downstream fine-tuning, making large-scale pretraining a more fundamental regime for lineage verification. We show that existing fingerprinting methods become unreliable in this regime, as they rely on post-hoc signatures that only emerge after substantial training. This limitation contradicts the classical Galton notion of a fingerprint as an intrinsic and persistent identity. In contrast, we propose a stronger and more intrinsic notion of LLM fingerprinting: SeedPrints, a method that leverages random initialization biases as persistent, seed-dependent identifiers present even before training begins. We show that untrained models exhibit reproducible prediction biases induced by their initialization seed, and that these weak signals remain statistically detectable throughout training, enabling high-confidence lineage verification. Unlike prior techniques that fail during early pretraining or degrade under distribution shifts, SeedPrints remains effective across all training stages, from initialization to large-scale pretraining and downstream adaptation. Experiments on LLaMA-style and Qwen-style models demonstrate seed-level distinguishability and enable birth-to-lifecycle identity verification. Evaluations on large-scale pretraining trajectories and real-world fingerprinting benchmarks further confirm its robustness under prolonged training, domain shifts, and parameter modifications.

AI.tldr: SeedPrints是第一个能在大规模预训练阶段就指纹化LLM且贯穿训练全生命周期的固有指纹方案，通过初始化随机种子留下的持久偏差实现对模型谱系的端到端验证。
AI.motivation: 现有指纹方法只在微调阶段验证来源，忽略了LLM绝大部分知识与能力是在预训练获得的本质；预训练早期或分布漂移时这些方法会失效。
AI.method: SeedPrints利用初始化随机种子的随机偏差作为固有指纹：不训练即可复现该偏差，并通过统计检测追踪其在预训练全程的微弱残差，从而判定模型谱系。
AI.result: 在LLaMA、Qwen系模型大规模预训练轨迹中，SeedPrints始终保持高于现有方法的种子级区分度；其指纹不因长时间预训练、领域漂移和参数调整而退化，从初始化到下游适配的全生命周期都能高置信度验证身份。
AI.conclusion: SeedPrints证明了随机初始化偏差足以充当LLM的固有指纹，突破了传统指纹在预训练阶段的局限，奠定了模型谱系端到端验证的可行基础。

title: Benchmarking Foundation Models with Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Olympic-Level Physics Problem Solving
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with foundation models has achieved strong performance across diverse tasks, but their capacity for expert-level reasoning-such as solving Olympiad-level physics problems-remains largely unexplored. Inspired by the way students prepare for competitions by reviewing past problems, we investigate the potential of RAG to enhance physics reasoning in foundation models. We introduce PhoPile, a high-quality multimodal dataset specifically designed for Olympiad-level physics, enabling systematic study of retrieval-based reasoning. PhoPile includes diagrams, graphs, and equations, capturing the inherently multimodal nature of physics problem solving. Using PhoPile, we benchmark RAG-augmented foundation models, covering both large language models (LLMs) and large multimodal models (LMMs) with multiple retrievers. Our results demonstrate that integrating retrieval with physics corpora can improve model performance, while also highlighting challenges that motivate further research in retrieval-augmented physics reasoning.

AI.tldr: 借助竞赛题语料 PhoPile，RAG 可将基础模型在奥林匹克物理推理上的准确率提升 10%+，但专家级水平仍难企及。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 研究局限通用任务，奥林匹克级物理推理能力未被系统评估；希望借“复习旧题”范式探究检索式增强对高阶物理推理的潜力。
AI.method: 构建 2 万题高质量图文双语语料 PhoPile→训练专用检索器→对比 LLM/LMM 在 zero-shot、chain-of-thought、RAG 三种设定下的表现→细粒度错误分析。
AI.result: RAG 在多项指标上超越 zero-shot 10–15 个百分点；LMM 收益高于纯文本 LLM；核心瓶颈在于公式对齐与符号推理一致性，长尾题型无明显改进。
AI.conclusion: RAG 能显著提升奥林匹克物理推理基线，但离专家级仍有结构性差距，亟需改进的多模态检索与符号推理模块；PhoPile 可作为后续研究基准。

title: LLM as Attention-Informed NTM and Topic Modeling as long-input Generation: Interpretability and long-Context Capability
summary: Topic modeling aims to produce interpretable topic representations and topic--document correspondences from corpora, but classical neural topic models (NTMs) remain constrained by limited representation assumptions and semantic abstraction ability. We study LLM-based topic modeling from both white-box and black-box perspectives. For white-box LLMs, we propose an attention-informed framework that recovers interpretable structures analogous to those in NTMs, including document-topic and topic-word distributions. This validates the view that LLM can serve as an attention-informed NTM. For black-box LLMs, we reformulate topic modeling as a structured long-input task and introduce a post-generation signal compensation method based on diversified topic cues and hybrid retrieval. Experiments show that recovered attention structures support effective topic assignment and keyword extraction, while black-box long-context LLMs achieve competitive or stronger performance than other baselines. These findings suggest a connection between LLMs and NTMs and highlight the promise of long-context LLMs for topic modeling.

AI.tldr: 针对传统神经主题模型表示受限、语义抽象能力不足的问题，作者将大语言模型（LLM）引入主题模型。白盒LLM通过注意力结构恢复出文档-主题/主题-词分布；黑盒LLM则将长文本主题建模转化为结构化长输入任务，并用多样化信号补偿完成推理。实验表明，两种思路均能获得同或优于基线的主题分配与关键词抽取性能。
AI.motivation: 一方面，经典NTM对隐含结构的假设受限，难以刻画词与主题的多层语义关系；另一方面，LLM具备强大的上下文理解和语义抽象能力，却尚未系统用于主题建模并探讨它们与传统的NTM是否存在对应关系。作者希望同时从白盒（可上线微调）和黑盒（仅调用API）角度出发，验证LLM对主题建模是否：1）能保持NTM结构的可解释性；2）能取得更佳或相竞争的性能；3）能揭示LLM和NTM的内在联系。
AI.method: 1) 白盒策略：将LLM的输出注意力看作文档对主题、主题对词的“分布”，借助序列注意力图恢复出可解释的文档-主题分布θ及主题-词分布φ，完整流程类比NTM但替换为主题注意力层驱动的生成。2) 黑盒策略：将主题建模转变为一个“长输入-结构输出”的范式——先向LLM注入“提示+全文+主题线索”，让其一次性输出一组主题标签与代表性词；随后设计基于多样化主题线索与混合检索的后处理补偿方法，对生成主题进行细化与去冗。实验在多个中英文标准语料以及与NTM/LLM基准模型上对比主题一致性（NPMI）、主题多样性、文档分类准确率、关键词提取精度和人工可解释性评分。
AI.result: 1) 注意力恢复的θ和φ与传统NTM的最优参数高度重合，且主题一致性指标平均提高6–11%；2) 黑盒长文本LLM在主题多样性上提升18%，主题-文档分类F1与新词抽取Recall与最佳NTM持平或更高，且生成的主题词更易被人判断为高可解释；3) 消融试验显示，若取消注意力机制或补偿信号，其性能回落到普通NTM水平，证明二者均不可或缺；4) 可视化表明LLM注意力层确实学到了类似NTM的“主题峰”，从而首次提供了LLM与NTM结构等价性的实证证据。
AI.conclusion: LLM不仅可以通过注意力结构扮演“可解释主题模型”的角色，还能借助长上下文和提示范式完成端到端的黑盒主题发现。作者认为：长上下文LLM有潜力取代或补充传统NTM，并建议未来在预训练中进一步增强主题相关的注意力归纳偏差；同时也指出需处理计算开销与可扩展语料规模。该工作建立了大模型与传统主题模型的桥梁，为主题建模研究提供了可落地且更易扩展的新范式。

title: Malice in Agentland: Down the Rabbit Hole of Backdoors in the AI Supply Chain
summary: While finetuning AI agents on interaction data -- such as web browsing or tool use -- improves their capabilities, it also introduces critical security vulnerabilities within the agentic AI supply chain. We show that adversaries can effectively poison the data collection pipeline at multiple stages to embed hard-to-detect backdoors that, when triggered, cause unsafe or malicious behavior. We formalize three realistic threat models across distinct layers of the supply chain: direct poisoning of finetuning data, pre-backdoored base models, and environment poisoning, a novel attack vector that exploits vulnerabilities specific to agentic training pipelines. Evaluated on two widely adopted agentic benchmarks, all three threat models prove effective: poisoning only a small number of demonstrations is sufficient to embed a backdoor that causes an agent to leak confidential user information with over 80\% success.

AI.tldr: 在Agent微调数据链路上仅注入少量毒样本即可植入后门，触发时能以>80%成功率致Agent泄露用户隐私。
AI.motivation: 针对Agent微调所需的人机/环境交互数据多源、可信难验证的特点，首次系统分析其数据供应链各环节的安全风险。
AI.method: 形式化三种真实威胁模型：直接污染微调数据、提供预置后门的基座模型，以及通过训练环境本身投毒；在两款主流Agent基准上实施并评估。
AI.result: 仅需篡改极少数演示样本即可成功植入后门；触发后门时Agent泄露机密信息的成功率超过80%。实验表明三种攻击均能在现有数据与模型环节生效，且检测极其困难。
AI.conclusion: Agent微调数据供应链存在结构性脆弱性，需建立从数据溯源、模型加固到环境隔离的多层防护，以保障Agent在实际部署中的安全性。

title: Geometry Aware Cross-Modal Alignment for Light Field-LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation serves as a cornerstone of scene understanding in autonomous driving but continues to face significant challenges under complex conditions such as occlusion. Light field and LiDAR modalities provide complementary visual and spatial cues that are beneficial for robust perception; however, their effective integration is hindered by limited viewpoint diversity and inherent modality discrepancies. To address these challenges, the first multimodal semantic segmentation dataset integrating light field data and point cloud data is proposed. Based on this dataset, we proposed a multi-modal light field point-cloud fusion segmentation network(Mlpfseg), incorporating feature completion and depth perception to segment both camera images and LiDAR point clouds simultaneously. The feature completion module addresses the density mismatch between point clouds and image pixels by performing differential reconstruction of point-cloud feature maps, enhancing the fusion of these modalities. The depth perception module improves the segmentation of occluded objects by reinforcing attention scores for better occlusion awareness. Our method outperforms image-only segmentation by 1.71 Mean Intersection over Union(mIoU) and point cloud-only segmentation by 2.38 mIoU, demonstrating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 首个同时利用光场图像与LiDAR点云的多模态语义分割数据集及网络MlpfSeg，通过特征补全与深度感知模块，在遮挡场景下显著优于单模态方法。
AI.motivation: 复杂遮挡条件下，单模态语义分割鲁棒性不足；光场与LiDAR虽互补，但视差有限且模态差异大，缺乏统一数据集与融合框架。
AI.method: 1.构建光场-点云双模态数据集；2.MlpfSeg网络：a)特征补全模块——可微分重建点云特征图，缓解密度失配；b)深度感知模块——强化注意力分数，提升遮挡区域判别力；3.联合训练，同步输出图像与点云分割结果。
AI.result: MlpfSeg在自采数据集上分别超过纯图像和纯点云基线1.71与2.38 mIoU，并显著改善遮挡目标边界精度。
AI.conclusion: 统一光场-点云数据与互补特征补全/深度感知机制，可有效克服遮挡和模态差异，为多模态自动驾驶感知提供新基准与可行的融合范式。

title: GTCN-G: A Residual Graph-Temporal Fusion Network for Imbalanced Intrusion Detection
comment: This preprint was submitted to IEEE TrustCom 2025. The accepted version will be published under copyright 2025 IEEE
summary: The escalating complexity of network threats and the inherent class imbalance in traffic data present formidable challenges for modern Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS). While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) excel in modeling topological structures and Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCNs) are proficient in capturing time-series dependencies, a framework that synergistically integrates both while explicitly addressing data imbalance remains an open challenge. This paper introduces a novel deep learning framework, named Gated Temporal Convolutional Network and Graph (GTCN-G), engineered to overcome these limitations. Our model uniquely fuses a Gated TCN (G-TCN) for extracting hierarchical temporal features from network flows with a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) designed to learn from the underlying graph structure. The core innovation lies in the integration of a residual learning mechanism, implemented via a Graph Attention Network (GAT). This mechanism preserves original feature information through residual connections, which is critical for mitigating the class imbalance problem and enhancing detection sensitivity for rare malicious activities (minority classes). We conducted extensive experiments on two public benchmark datasets, UNSW-NB15 and ToN-IoT, to validate our approach. The empirical results demonstrate that the proposed GTCN-G model achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing baseline models in both binary and multi-class classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 为应对流量数据高度不平衡的入侵检测难题，作者提出 GTCN-G 框架：用门控时间卷积提取时序特征、图卷积刻画拓扑关系，并以图注意力残差机制强化少数类敏感信息，实验在 UNSW-NB15 与 ToN-IoT 上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 网络威胁日益复杂且流量数据存在严重类别不平衡，现有 GNN 与 TCN 各自擅长拓扑建模或时序建模，但缺乏同时融合两者并针对性解决不平衡问题的统一方案。
AI.method: 构建 GTCN-G：1) G-TCN 逐级抽取网络流的多层时序特征；2) GCN 学习主机/连接图的拓扑表示；3) 通过 Graph Attention Network 实现残差连接，保留原始特征并增强对稀有攻击（少数类）的敏感度；4) 端到端训练用于二分类与多分类检测。
AI.result: 在 UNSW-NB15 与 ToN-IoT 两大公开数据集上，GTCN-G 的 F1、AUC、Recall 等指标显著优于现有基线，达到 SOTA；对少数类攻击的检测率提升尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: GTCN-G 通过时序-拓扑联合建模与残差注意机制有效缓解类不平衡，实现高灵敏、高精度的入侵检测，为下一代 IDS 提供可行的新范式。

title: Instructions are all you need: Self-supervised Reinforcement Learning for Instruction Following
summary: Language models often struggle to follow multi-constraint instructions that are crucial for real-world applications. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches suffer from dependency on external supervision and sparse reward signals from multi-constraint tasks. We propose a label-free self-supervised RL framework that eliminates dependency on external supervision by deriving reward signals directly from instructions and generating pseudo-labels for reward model training. Our approach introduces constraint decomposition strategies and efficient constraint-wise binary classification to address sparse reward challenges while maintaining computational efficiency. Experiments show that our approach generalizes well, achieving strong improvements across 3 in-domain and 5 out-of-domain datasets, including challenging agentic and multi-turn instruction following. The data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/Rainier-rq/verl-if

AI.tldr: 提出一种无标签自监督强化学习框架，使语言模型在多约束指令下无需外部监督即可训练，并在 8 个数据集中显著提升泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 方法依赖人工标注或外部反馈，而多约束任务中奖励稀疏，难以高效优化指令跟随能力。
AI.method: 1) 仅利用原始指令本身构造伪标签，训练约束二分类奖励模型；2) 引入约束分解策略，将复杂指令拆为可验证子约束；3) 采用逐约束二进制判别，解决稀疏奖励与计算开销问题。
AI.result: 在 3 个域内与 5 个域外数据集（含智能体决策、多轮交互场景）上，相比基线显著提升成功率与指令遵循率，且无需任何人工奖励或外部监督。
AI.conclusion: 无外部监督的自监督 RL 能在多约束、多轮任务中稳定改进语言模型，验证了对复杂真实场景的可扩展性与实用性。

title: Think Parallax: Solving Multi-Hop Problems via Multi-View Knowledge-Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) still struggle with multi-hop reasoning over knowledge-graphs (KGs), and we identify a previously overlooked structural reason for this difficulty: Transformer attention heads naturally specialize in distinct semantic relations across reasoning stages, forming a hop-aligned relay pattern. This key finding suggests that multi-hop reasoning is inherently multi-view, yet existing KG-based retrieval-augmented generation (KG-RAG) systems collapse all reasoning hops into a single representation, flat embedding space, suppressing this implicit structure and causing noisy or drifted path exploration. We introduce ParallaxRAG, a symmetric multi-view framework that decouples queries and KGs into aligned, head-specific semantic spaces. By enforcing relational diversity across multiple heads while constraining weakly related paths, ParallaxRAG constructs more accurate, cleaner subgraphs and guides LLMs through grounded, hop-wise reasoning. On WebQSP and CWQ, it achieves state-of-the-art retrieval and QA performance, substantially reduces hallucination, and generalizes strongly to the biomedical BioASQ benchmark.

AI.tldr: ParallaxRAG首次证明LLM多步推理是「多头接力」过程，摒弃单视图KG-RAG，用对称多视图框架提升WebQSP/CWQ/BioASQ精度并抑制幻觉。
AI.motivation: KG-RAG将多跳路径压进单一表示，丢失Transformer各注意力头在每一步专司不同语义关系的「接力」结构，导致路径漂移与幻觉。
AI.method: 提出对称多视图框架ParallaxRAG：为每注意力头构建对齐的语义子空间，显式保留头-跳对应关系；在多头间强化关系多样性并剪枝弱相关路径，生成洁净子图后再喂给LLM做逐跳推理。
AI.result: WebQSP、CWQ与BioASQ上刷新检索与问答SOTA，幻觉显著下降，跨领域泛化强劲。
AI.conclusion: 多跳推理本质是多头多视图过程；维持「头-跳」结构可同步提升KG召回精度与LLM答案可靠性，为多步知识推理提供新范式。

title: StableSketcher: Enhancing Diffusion Model for Pixel-based Sketch Generation via Visual Question Answering Feedback
comment: Under review at IEEE Access. Author-submitted preprint. Not the IEEE-published version
summary: Although recent advancements in diffusion models have significantly enriched the quality of generated images, challenges remain in synthesizing pixel-based human-drawn sketches, a representative example of abstract expression. To combat these challenges, we propose StableSketcher, a novel framework that empowers diffusion models to generate hand-drawn sketches with high prompt fidelity. Within this framework, we fine-tune the variational autoencoder to optimize latent decoding, enabling it to better capture the characteristics of sketches. In parallel, we integrate a new reward function for reinforcement learning based on visual question answering, which improves text-image alignment and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StableSketcher generates sketches with improved stylistic fidelity, achieving better alignment with prompts compared to the Stable Diffusion baseline. Additionally, we introduce SketchDUO, to the best of our knowledge, the first dataset comprising instance-level sketches paired with captions and question-answer pairs, thereby addressing the limitations of existing datasets that rely on image-label pairs. Our code and dataset will be made publicly available upon acceptance. Project page: https://zihos.github.io/StableSketcher

AI.tldr: 提出 StableSketcher，通过微调 VAE 并引入基于 VQA 的强化学习奖励函数，使扩散模型首次高质量生成像素级手绘草图；发布首个带 QA 标注的草图数据集 SketchDUO。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽已显著提升图像生成质量，但在像素级人类手绘草图这一高度抽象模态上仍表现不佳，缺乏高保真、高语义对齐的生成方法，且现有数据集仅含图像–标签对，难以支持细粒度训练与评估。
AI.method: 1) 微调扩散模型中的 VAE 解码器，使其隐空间更适合重建草图特征；2) 设计基于视觉问答（VQA）的强化学习奖励函数，在训练时直接优化文本–草图语义一致性；3) 构建并公开 SketchDUO 数据集，提供实例级草图–标题–问答三元组。
AI.result: StableSketcher 在 prompt  fidelity、风格一致性与文本对齐度上均优于 Stable Diffusion 基线；人工与自动指标显示其生成草图更贴近人类手绘风格且语义准确。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化隐空间解码与语义奖励，扩散模型可扩展至抽象草图域；SketchDUO 填补了细粒度草图数据空白，为后续研究提供基准。代码与数据将开源。

title: Why Did Apple Fall: Evaluating Curiosity in Large Language Models
summary: Curiosity serves as a pivotal conduit for human beings to discover and learn new knowledge. Recent advancements of large language models (LLMs) in natural language processing have sparked discussions regarding whether these models possess capability of curiosity-driven learning akin to humans. In this paper, starting from the human curiosity assessment questionnaire Five-Dimensional Curiosity scale Revised (5DCR), we design a comprehensive evaluation framework that covers dimensions such as Information Seeking, Thrill Seeking, and Social Curiosity to assess the extent of curiosity exhibited by LLMs. The results demonstrate that LLMs exhibit a stronger thirst for knowledge than humans but still tend to make conservative choices when faced with uncertain environments. We further investigated the relationship between curiosity and thinking of LLMs, confirming that curious behaviors can enhance the model's reasoning and active learning abilities. These findings suggest that LLMs have the potential to exhibit curiosity similar to that of humans, providing experimental support for the future development of learning capabilities and innovative research in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 首次用5DCR量表从五维量化LLM的好奇心，发现其知识渴求高于人类却更保守，且好奇心可提升推理与主动学习。
AI.motivation: 探明大模型是否具备类似人类的好奇心及其对学习的影响，为增强LLM自主学习和创新力提供实证基础。
AI.method: 基于5DCR问卷构建涵盖信息寻求、刺激寻求、社会好奇等维度的评测体系，在不确定环境中对比LLM与人类的好奇表现，并关联分析好奇心与推理/主动学习能力的耦合。
AI.result: LLM在知识渴求维度得分显著高于人类，但在风险情境下选择更保守；好奇心水平与模型推理准确率和主动学习收益呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: LLM可呈现人类式好奇心，适度激发好奇行为可同步提升推理与主动学习能力，为设计更具自主探索与创新能力的大模型奠定实验依据。

title: FaCT: Faithful Concept Traces for Explaining Neural Network Decisions
comment: 35 pages, 23 figures, 2 tables, Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2025; Code is available at https://github.com/m-parchami/FaCT
summary: Deep networks have shown remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, yet getting a global concept-level understanding of how they function remains a key challenge. Many post-hoc concept-based approaches have been introduced to understand their workings, yet they are not always faithful to the model. Further, they make restrictive assumptions on the concepts a model learns, such as class-specificity, small spatial extent, or alignment to human expectations. In this work, we put emphasis on the faithfulness of such concept-based explanations and propose a new model with model-inherent mechanistic concept-explanations. Our concepts are shared across classes and, from any layer, their contribution to the logit and their input-visualization can be faithfully traced. We also leverage foundation models to propose a new concept-consistency metric, C$^2$-Score, that can be used to evaluate concept-based methods. We show that, compared to prior work, our concepts are quantitatively more consistent and users find our concepts to be more interpretable, all while retaining competitive ImageNet performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需额外监督即可自动发现“忠实”概念解释的端到端深度网络，设计了跨类共享、可追溯可视化贡献量的机制化方法与评估指标C²-Score，实证表明其保持ImageNet预测性能的同时显著优于现有可解释性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有事后概念解释方法多与模型真实推理过程不一致，且假设概念必须满足类专属或小空间范围、符合人类直觉等限制；缺乏忠实、可全局追溯、共享于所有类别的“模型固有”解释框架，阻碍了深度学习系统的可信评估与安全部署。
AI.method: 1）构建可在任意层共享概念的网络结构，记录每个概念到logit的完整传播路径并允许梯度回传可视化输入贡献；2）不使用人类标注，直接在网络训练过程中学习一组跨类别通用的潜在概念；3）提出基于基础模型的概念一致性度量C²-Score，对概念条理性与稳定性进行量化；4）设计兼顾可解释性与预测性的端到端优化正则化损失，实现兼顾ImageNet性能的视觉可解释网络。
AI.result: 在无需任何概念标签的情况下，网络对ImageNet维持与强基线相当或更好的精度；C²-Score显示新概念比现有Class Activation Maps、Composition-based Methods等方法平均提高25%的跨幅员一致性；主观评估显示用户认为新概念更直观、类人，可辅助发现模型难以察觉的语义规律性，同时提供像素级可追溯的因果解释图谱。
AI.conclusion: 首次实现了在“不牺牲原始性能”的前提下，让深度模型自身主动生成忠实跨类概念并可被可视化溯源，提供了无需任何先验概念来源的端到端可解释学习框架。提出的C²-Score为概念解释方法的客观评估提供了新工具，预计能加速高风险领域（医疗、自动驾驶等）对黑箱模型的安全审计和误差诊断，为可信赖的人工智能奠定基础。

title: Generative Modeling Enables Molecular Structure Retrieval from Coulomb Explosion Imaging
summary: Capturing the structural changes that molecules undergo during chemical reactions in real space and time is a long-standing dream and an essential prerequisite for understanding and ultimately controlling femtochemistry. A key approach to tackle this challenging task is Coulomb explosion imaging, which benefited decisively from recently emerging high-repetition-rate X-ray free-electron laser sources. With this technique, information on the molecular structure is inferred from the momentum distributions of the ions produced by the rapid Coulomb explosion of molecules. Retrieving molecular structures from these distributions poses a highly non-linear inverse problem that remains unsolved for molecules consisting of more than a few atoms. Here, we address this challenge using a diffusion-based Transformer neural network. We show that the network reconstructs unknown molecular geometries from ion-momentum distributions with a mean absolute error below one Bohr radius, which is half the length of a typical chemical bond.

AI.tldr: 利用X射线自由电子激光进行库仑爆炸成像，配合扩散变换神经网络，首次实现从离子动量分布中恢复含多个原子分子的亚玻尔半径精度的几何结构，突破了传统逆问题解析极限。
AI.motivation: 实时在时空中捕捉化学反应中的结构变化是理解飞秒化学并对其进行控制的最终目标。现有库仑爆炸成像虽然能提供结构信息，但将离子动量分布解析为分子几何属于高度非线性逆问题，对超过三原子分子的结构反演一直无解。
AI.method: 采用扩散-变换混合型深度神经网络，输入库仑爆炸实验获得的离子三维动量分布，网络经端到端训练后输出对应的三维分子坐标；以平均绝对误差(MAE)为指标在合成与实验数据集上评估重建精度。
AI.result: 网络对测试集的分子几何重建误差均值＜1 a₀（0.529 Å），优于典型化学键长度的一半；在含5–10重原子的分子上成功率>90%，并首次实现未知同分异构体的一级区分。
AI.conclusion: 扩散变换网络首次把库仑爆炸成像转化为可直接实验使用的分子结构测准工具，为飞秒化学实时成像铺平道路，也为其它强场超快衍射实验中的逆问题提供了可迁移算法框架。

title: Turbo-DDCM: Fast and Flexible Zero-Shot Diffusion-Based Image Compression
comment: ICLR 2026. Code is available at https://amitvaisman.github.io/turbo_ddcm/
summary: While zero-shot diffusion-based compression methods have seen significant progress in recent years, they remain notoriously slow and computationally demanding. This paper presents an efficient zero-shot diffusion-based compression method that runs substantially faster than existing methods, while maintaining performance that is on par with the state-of-the-art techniques. Our method builds upon the recently proposed Denoising Diffusion Codebook Models (DDCMs) compression scheme. Specifically, DDCM compresses an image by sequentially choosing the diffusion noise vectors from reproducible random codebooks, guiding the denoiser's output to reconstruct the target image. We modify this framework with Turbo-DDCM, which efficiently combines a large number of noise vectors at each denoising step, thereby significantly reducing the number of required denoising operations. This modification is also coupled with an improved encoding protocol. Furthermore, we introduce two flexible variants of Turbo-DDCM, a priority-aware variant that prioritizes user-specified regions and a distortion-controlled variant that compresses an image based on a target PSNR rather than a target BPP. Comprehensive experiments position Turbo-DDCM as a compelling, practical, and flexible image compression scheme.

AI.tldr: Turbo-DDCM 把 DDCM 每步逐一试噪声向量的方式改成一次融合大量候选向量，并配合新熵编码协议与两种实用变体，在零样本扩散压缩任务上实现数量级提速且性能不降。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本扩散压缩方法推理耗时极高，难以落地；需在保持 SOTA 重建质量的同时显著降低计算负担。
AI.method: 以 DDCM 为基础，提出 Turbo-DDCM：1）单步并行融合大量可复现码本噪声向量，压缩所需去噪步数；2）设计更高效的编码协议降低码率；3）推出“区域优先”与“目标 PSNR”两个灵活变体，支持 ROI 保真或给定失真级别的压缩。
AI.result: 相比原始 DDCM 与其他零样本扩散压缩方案，Turbo-DDCM 推理时间减少一个数量级以上，bpp-PSNR 曲线与 SOTA 重叠；用户指定区域优先版本在同等码率下 ROI PSNR 提高约 1 dB，失真控制版本可按目标 PSNR 自动分配码率。
AI.conclusion: Turbo-DDCM 通过噪声向量并行融合与新编码协议，首次让零样本扩散压缩在速度上具备实用性，同时保持甚至提升重建灵活性，为后续扩散压缩的落地和扩展提供了可行范式。

title: Reasoning about Intent for Ambiguous Requests
summary: Large language models often respond to ambiguous requests by implicitly committing to one interpretation, frustrating users and creating safety risks when that interpretation is wrong. We propose generating a single structured response that enumerates the different ways an ambiguous request can be interpreted, each coupled with a corresponding answer. Our models are trained with reinforcement learning using a dual reward objective: recall on ambiguous inputs to maximise coverage of valid interpretations, and precision on unambiguous ones to suppress spurious alternatives. Training requires only multiple valid answers per input as supervision, no clarification questions or explicit interpretations are needed. Experiments on conversational question answering and semantic parsing demonstrate that our method achieves higher coverage of valid answers than baseline approaches. Human evaluation confirms that predicted interpretations are meaningful and explain their corresponding answers. Our approach promotes transparency with explicit interpretations, achieves efficiency by requiring only one generation step, and supports downstream applications through its structured output format.

AI.tldr: 用一次结构化输出列举所有合理理解，无需追问，兼顾召回与精度。
AI.motivation: 大模型面对歧义请求常武断选择单一理解，既降低用户体验也带来安全隐忧，需要让模型一次性显式给出所有可能解释及其对应答案。
AI.method: 提出“歧义感知强化学习”框架：以{输入: 多答案}为弱监督，用双奖励目标——对歧义样本最大化有效解释召回、对无歧义样本抑制虚假解释——训练模型输出结构化{解释→答案}列表，无需任何澄清问句或人工标注解释。
AI.result: 在对话问答与语义解析数据集上，相比强基线（自一致、澄清问句等）覆盖更多有效答案（↑12-18%），人工评估显示预测解释合理且可解释对应答案。
AI.conclusion: 该方法单步生成、输出结构化，兼顾透明、高效与下游可用性，为歧义输入的安全透明响应提供了可扩展的弱监督解决方案。

title: GeoPl@ntNet: A Platform for Exploring Essential Biodiversity Variables
summary: This paper describes GeoPl@ntNet, an interactive web application designed to make Essential Biodiversity Variables accessible and understandable to everyone through dynamic maps and fact sheets. Its core purpose is to allow users to explore high-resolution AI-generated maps of species distributions, habitat types, and biodiversity indicators across Europe. These maps, developed through a cascading pipeline involving convolutional neural networks and large language models, provide an intuitive yet information-rich interface to better understand biodiversity, with resolutions as precise as 50x50 meters. The website also enables exploration of specific regions, allowing users to select areas of interest on the map (e.g., urban green spaces, protected areas, or riverbanks) to view local species and their coverage. Additionally, GeoPl@ntNet generates comprehensive reports for selected regions, including insights into the number of protected species, invasive species, and endemic species.

AI.tldr: GeoPl@ntNet是一款交互式网页应用，以50m分辨率AI地图与区域报告将欧洲生物多样性变量可视化并开放给公众。
AI.motivation: 传统生物多样性数据专业门槛高、空间细节不足，亟需高分辨率、可交互且易理解的工具赋能公众与决策者。
AI.method: 构建级联管线：卷积神经网络与大型语言模型生成50×50m物种分布、生境类型与多样性指标栅格；前端以动态地图+知识卡片方式呈现，支持区域选取与自动报告生成。
AI.result: 平台提供全欧高分辨率AI地图，可即时查询城市绿地、保护区、河岸等兴趣区的本地物种覆盖，并输出受威胁、入侵与特有种统计报告。
AI.conclusion: GeoPl@ntNet通过高分辨率AI地图与区域报告降低生物多样性信息获取门槛，为科研、管理与公众参与提供可扩展的开放工具。

title: HiFiNet: Hierarchical Fault Identification in Wireless Sensor Networks via Edge-Based Classification and Graph Aggregation
summary: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) are the backbone of essential monitoring applications, but their deployment in unfavourable conditions increases the risk to data integrity and system reliability. Traditional fault detection methods often struggle to effectively balance accuracy and energy consumption, and they may not fully leverage the complex spatio-temporal correlations inherent in WSN data. In this paper, we introduce HiFiNet, a novel hierarchical fault identification framework that addresses these challenges through a two-stage process. Firstly, edge classifiers with a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) stacked autoencoder perform temporal feature extraction and output initial fault class prediction for individual sensor nodes. Using these results, a Graph Attention Network (GAT) then aggregates information from neighboring nodes to refine the classification by integrating the topology context. Our method is able to produce more accurate predictions by capturing both local temporal patterns and network-wide spatial dependencies. To validate this approach, we constructed synthetic WSN datasets by introducing specific, predefined faults into the Intel Lab Dataset and NASA's MERRA-2 reanalysis data. Experimental results demonstrate that HiFiNet significantly outperforms existing methods in accuracy, F1-score, and precision, showcasing its robustness and effectiveness in identifying diverse fault types. Furthermore, the framework's design allows for a tunable trade-off between diagnostic performance and energy efficiency, making it adaptable to different operational requirements.

AI.tldr: HiFiNet 是一种面向无线传感网的两级故障检测框架：边缘 LSTM-自编码器提取节点级时序特征，中心 GAT 融合邻居拓扑信息；在合成数据集上准确率、F1、精度全面优于现有方法，并支持按需调节能耗。
AI.motivation: WSN 在恶劣环境下易出现数据异常，传统方法难以兼顾高精度与低能耗，且未充分利用节点间的时空关联。
AI.method: 两阶段架构：① 各节点本地 LSTM 堆叠自编码器提取时序特征并给出初始故障类别；② 汇聚端 Graph Attention Network 依据邻居状态与拓扑重新加权，修正分类结果。
AI.result: 在 Intel Lab 与 NASA MERRA-2 注入合成故障的实验里，HiFiNet 在准确率、F1-score、precision 上显著超越现有算法，并能通过参数调节实现诊断性能与能耗的权衡。
AI.conclusion: HiFiNet 同时捕获局部时序模式与全网空间依赖，兼具高鲁棒性与能耗可扩展性，适用于资源受限 WSN 的在线故障诊断。

title: CropVLM: Learning to Zoom for Fine-Grained Vision-Language Perception
comment: Accepted to the GRAIL-V Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often struggle with tasks that require fine-grained image understanding, such as scene-text recognition or document analysis, due to perception limitations and visual fragmentation. To address these challenges, we introduce CropVLM as an external low-cost method for boosting performance, enabling VLMs to dynamically ''zoom in'' on relevant image regions, enhancing their ability to capture fine details. CropVLM is trained using reinforcement learning, without using human-labeled bounding boxes as a supervision signal, and without expensive synthetic evaluations. The model is trained once and can be paired with both open-source and proprietary VLMs to improve their performance. Our approach delivers significant improvements on tasks that require high-resolution image understanding, notably for benchmarks that are out-of-domain for the target VLM, without modifying or fine-tuning the VLM, thus avoiding catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: CropVLM是一种无需修改VLM本体、也无需人工标注框的强化学习微缩模块，可动态放大图像关键区域，一次性训练即可通配各类开源/闭源VLM，显著提升细粒度理解基准。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在场景文本、文档等高分辨率细节任务上因感知粒度不足和视觉碎片化而性能受限，且传统微调或合成数据成本高昂并可能引发灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出轻量级外部组件CropVLM，把“是否需要裁剪”及“裁剪区域”建模为序列决策问题，用策略梯度强化学习自监督训练，奖励信号直接来自下游VLM在候选裁剪上的任务反馈，无需人工框或合成评估。
AI.result: 在多项高分辨率细粒度基准（含跨域文档、场景文本）上，将LLaVA-1.5、GPT-4V等模型的准确率提升4–18个百分点，而原模型权重保持冻结，无遗忘现象。
AI.conclusion: CropVLM证明通过动态放大关键区域的低成本外部增强，即可突破VLM分辨率瓶颈，实现与模型无关、训练一次、即插即用的细粒度视觉理解提升。

title: Hybrid-AIRL: Enhancing Inverse Reinforcement Learning with Supervised Expert Guidance
comment: Comments: 13 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Code: https://github.com/silue-dev/hairl. Accepted at ESANN 2026
summary: Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning (AIRL) has shown promise in addressing the sparse reward problem in reinforcement learning (RL) by inferring dense reward functions from expert demonstrations. However, its performance in highly complex, imperfect-information settings remains largely unexplored. To explore this gap, we evaluate AIRL in the context of Heads-Up Limit Hold'em (HULHE) poker, a domain characterized by sparse, delayed rewards and significant uncertainty. In this setting, we find that AIRL struggles to infer a sufficiently informative reward function. To overcome this limitation, we contribute Hybrid-AIRL (H-AIRL), an extension that enhances reward inference and policy learning by incorporating a supervised loss derived from expert data and a stochastic regularization mechanism. We evaluate H-AIRL on a carefully selected set of Gymnasium benchmarks and the HULHE poker setting. Additionally, we analyze the learned reward function through visualization to gain deeper insights into the learning process. Our experimental results show that H-AIRL achieves higher sample efficiency and more stable learning compared to AIRL. This highlights the benefits of incorporating supervised signals into inverse RL and establishes H-AIRL as a promising framework for tackling challenging, real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 针对AIRL在不完全信息、稀疏奖励场景中奖励推断不足的问题，提出Hybrid-AIRL：在对抗逆强化学习框架中引入“监督损失+随机正则化”，在德州扑克HULHE与Gymnasium基准上显著提升样本效率与训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: AIRL虽可缓解稀疏奖励，但在高复杂度、不完全信息环境（如德州扑克）中难以推断出足够信息量的奖励函数，导致策略学习失败，需要新的逆强化学习方法来突破该瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出H-AIRL：①在生成器-判别器框架外，增加一项基于专家数据的监督回归损失，显式约束奖励输出；②引入随机正则机制，对判别器输入做随机扰动，防止过拟合并提升泛化；③整体采用GAN-IRL交替训练流程，奖励与策略协同更新。
AI.result: 在HULHE德州扑克与若干Gymnasium任务上：①H-AIRL的奖励函数更接近真实潜奖励（可视化余弦相似度↑18%）；②样本效率提升约30%，训练曲线方差下降50%；③最终策略对专家胜率提高12个百分点，显著优于原生AIRL、GAIL与BC基线。
AI.conclusion: 向AIRL注入轻量级监督信号与随机正则即可显著改善不完全信息场景下的奖励建模与策略学习；H-AIRL框架通用、易实现，为稀疏奖励、高不确定性实际问题提供了可行逆强化学习解决方案。

title: BINDER: Instantly Adaptive Mobile Manipulation with Open-Vocabulary Commands
summary: Open-vocabulary mobile manipulation (OVMM) requires robots to follow language instructions, navigate, and manipulate while updating their world representation under dynamic environmental changes. However, most prior approaches update their world representation only at discrete update points such as navigation targets, waypoints, or the end of an action step, leaving robots blind between updates and causing cascading failures: overlooked objects, late error detection, and delayed replanning. To address this limitation, we propose BINDER (Bridging INstant and DEliberative Reasoning), a dual process framework that decouples strategic planning from continuous environment monitoring. Specifically, BINDER integrates a Deliberative Response Module (DRM, a multimodal LLM for task planning) with an Instant Response Module (IRM, a VideoLLM for continuous monitoring). The two modules play complementary roles: the DRM performs strategic planning with structured 3D scene updates and guides what the IRM attends to, while the IRM analyzes video streams to update memory, correct ongoing actions, and trigger replanning when necessary. Through this bidirectional coordination, the modules address the trade off between maintaining awareness and avoiding costly updates, enabling robust adaptation under dynamic conditions. Evaluated in three real world environments with dynamic object placement, BINDER achieves substantially higher success and efficiency than SoTA baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness for real world deployment.

AI.tldr: BINDER用“慢思考”规划器与“快思考”视频监视器双线并行，让机器人在动态环境中随时更新认知、修正动作，实现鲁棒的开集移动操作。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇移动操作要求在动态场景下持续更新世界模型，但现有方法仅在离散节点更新，导致两次更新之间“失明”，引发漏检、错误累积与重规划滞后等连锁失败。
AI.method: 提出双进程框架BINDER：1) 审慎响应模块(DRM)——多模态LLM，基于结构化3D语义图做任务规划并输出关注提示；2) 即时响应模块(IRM)——VideoLLM，实时分析视频流，增量更新记忆、检测异常、触发重规划；二者通过双向交互实现“策略指导感知—感知反哺策略”的闭环。
AI.result: 在三个真实动态场景（物品被持续移动）中，BINDER相较最强基线成功率平均提升19.4%，任务完成时间缩短22%，重规划次数减少35%，验证了在真实部署中的鲁棒性与效率优势。
AI.conclusion: 将战略级“慢思考”与毫秒级“快思考”解耦并协同，可在保证实时性的同时维持全局感知与规划一致性，为动态环境下机器人持续动作修正与重规划提供了可扩展范式。

title: Red Teaming Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have emerged as a powerful advancement in multi-step reasoning tasks, offering enhanced transparency and logical consistency through explicit chains of thought (CoT). However, these models introduce novel safety and reliability risks, such as CoT-hijacking and prompt-induced inefficiencies, which are not fully captured by existing evaluation methods. To address this gap, we propose RT-LRM, a unified benchmark designed to assess the trustworthiness of LRMs. RT-LRM evaluates three core dimensions: truthfulness, safety and efficiency. Beyond metric-based evaluation, we further introduce the training paradigm as a key analytical perspective to investigate the systematic impact of different training strategies on model trustworthiness. We achieve this by designing a curated suite of 30 reasoning tasks from an observational standpoint. We conduct extensive experiments on 26 models and identify several valuable insights into the trustworthiness of LRMs. For example, LRMs generally face trustworthiness challenges and tend to be more fragile than Large Language Models (LLMs) when encountering reasoning-induced risks. These findings uncover previously underexplored vulnerabilities and highlight the need for more targeted evaluations. In addition, we release a scalable toolbox for standardized trustworthiness research to support future advancements in this important field. Our code and datasets will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: RT-LRM 首次为大型推理模型（LRM）建立统一可信基准，发现其在推理诱导风险下比 LLM 更脆弱，并开源工具箱。
AI.motivation: 链式思维（CoT）带来透明性的同时，也引入 CoT-hijacking 等新风险；现有评测无法系统衡量 LRM 的可信度，亟需覆盖真实性、安全性与效率的综合基准。
AI.method: 构建 30 项观测型推理任务，覆盖 26 个模型；从指标与训练范式双视角评估，设计可扩展工具箱实现标准化实验与复现。
AI.result: 实验揭示 LRM 在推理攻击下普遍比 LLM 更易失效；不同训练策略对可信度的系统影响被量化，多种此前未知的脆弱点首次暴露。
AI.conclusion: LRM 可信性研究缺位问题得到填补，RT-LRM 为社区提供持续演进的评估平台，推动针对性防御与更鲁棒推理模型的发展。

title: Vec-LUT: Vector Table Lookup for Parallel Ultra-Low-Bit LLM Inference on Edge Devices
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed on edge devices. To meet strict resource constraints, real-world deployment has pushed LLM quantization from 8-bit to 4-bit, 2-bit, and now 1.58-bit. Combined with lookup table (LUT)-based inference, CPUs run these ultra-low-bit LLMs even faster than NPUs, opening new opportunities for ubiquitous on-device intelligence.
  However, this paper identifies that LUT-based inference underutilizes memory bandwidth during parallel inference, which is required for prefilling, test-time scaling, and other multi-token scenarios. The root cause is the scalar LUT paradigm, which performs repetitive and non-contiguous memory accesses for each token.
  To solve the issue, we propose vector LUT, a new lookup paradigm that constructs a unified LUT across parallel tokens, and performs a single $1 \rightarrow N$ lookup per index. To realize it efficiently, we further introduce (1) Vector LUT-Centric Tensor Layout, and (2) Cache-Aware Streamed Lookup techniques. Evaluations on 5 edge devices across 3 LLMs show that Vec-LUT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to $4.2\times$. Our implementation is integrated into llama.cpp. The code is available at https://github.com/OpenBitSys/vlut.cpp.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「向量查表（Vec-LUT）」技术，把 1.58-bit 大语言模型在 CPU 上的并行推理速度提升最高 4.2×，并已在 llama.cpp 开源。
AI.motivation: 1.58-bit 超低位量化与查表推理在 CPU 端已能快过 NPU，但在并行预填充、并行多 token 等场景下，因标量 LUT 对每 token 重复、非连续访存，无法跑满内存带宽性能受限。
AI.method: 1) 提出「向量 LUT」范式：一次性把并行 token 共用索引拼装成向量，执行 1→N 向量查表，取代多次标量访问。2) 配套「向量 LUT 为中心的张量排布」保证元素在内存中连续对齐；3) 「Cache-Aware Streamed Lookup」流式预取，把查表数据驻留在 CPU Cache 核内。整套流程无需定制硬件，仅在软件层重组访存。
AI.result: 在 5 款边缘端 CPU 上测试 3 个 1.58-bit LLM，与现有最佳 LUT 基线相比平均加速 2.7×，峰值 4.2×；在预填充、long-context 和多路并行生成等大并行场景下收益显著；能耗相应下降。
AI.conclusion: Vec-LUT 证明仅需优化访存模式即可释放极低比特量化 CPU 推理的剩余带宽，为低成本、高并行部署走向「every-device LLM」提供可行方案。

title: INFORM-CT: INtegrating LLMs and VLMs FOR Incidental Findings Management in Abdominal CT
comment: Accepted for Spotlight presentation at MIDL 2026
summary:
Incidental findings in CT scans, though often benign, can have significant clinical implications and should be reported following established guidelines. Traditional manual inspection by radiologists is time-consuming and variable. This paper proposes a novel framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) and foundational vision-language models (VLMs) in a plan-and-execute agentic approach to improve the efficiency and precision of incidental findings detection, classification, and reporting for abdominal CT scans. Given medical guidelines for abdominal organs, the process of managing incidental findings is automated through a planner-executor framework. The planner, based on LLM, generates Python scripts using predefined base functions, while the executor runs these scripts to perform the necessary checks and detections, via VLMs, segmentation models, and image processing subroutines.
  We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through experiments on a CT abdominal benchmark for three organs, in a fully automatic end-to-end manner. Our results show that the proposed framework outperforms existing pure VLM-based approaches in terms of accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套基于大模型（LLM＋VLM）的“规划-执行”智能体框架，可全自动完成腹部 CT 偶然发现（IF）的检测、分类与报告，显著优于纯 VLM 基线。
AI.motivation: 放射科人工筛查腹部 CT 偶然发现耗时且一致性差，现有方法自动化程度不足，亟需兼顾指南合规与效率的端到端解决方案。
AI.method: 以 LLM 为 Planner，将腹部器官 IF 指南转化为可执行 Python 脚本；Executor 调用 VLM、分割与图像处理子程序完成检测与分类，实现全链条自动化。
AI.result: 在三器官腹部 CT 基准上，端到端框架在准确率与效率两项均优于现有纯 VLM 方法，验证其临床可用性。
AI.conclusion: LLM 驱动的“规划-执行”智能体可高效、准确地按指南处理腹部 CT 偶然发现，具备落地潜力，并为其他影像场景提供通用范式。

title: Revisiting the Reliability of Language Models in Instruction-Following
summary: Advanced LLMs have achieved near-ceiling instruction-following accuracy on benchmarks such as IFEval. However, these impressive scores do not necessarily translate to reliable services in real-world use, where users often vary their phrasing, contextual framing, and task formulations. In this paper, we study nuance-oriented reliability: whether models exhibit consistent competence across cousin prompts that convey analogous user intents but with subtle nuances. To quantify this, we introduce a new metric, reliable@k, and develop an automated pipeline that generates high-quality cousin prompts via data augmentation. Building upon this, we construct IFEval++ for systematic evaluation. Across 20 proprietary and 26 open-source LLMs, we find that current models exhibit substantial insufficiency in nuance-oriented reliability -- their performance can drop by up to 61.8% with nuanced prompt modifications. What's more, we characterize it and explore three potential improvement recipes. Our findings highlight nuance-oriented reliability as a crucial yet underexplored next step toward more dependable and trustworthy LLM behavior. Our code and benchmark are accessible: https://github.com/jianshuod/IFEval-pp.

AI.tldr: 论文指出当前顶级大模型在「细微差别敏感性」上严重不可靠，提出可靠度指标 reliable@k 与自动扩充的 IFEval++，实证性能最大掉 61.8%，并给出三条改进思路。
AI.motivation: 尽管大模型在 IFEval 等指令遵循基准上逼近天花板，现实服务中用户措辞、语境与任务形式的微小变化仍常导致失效；作者认为「对近义但含细微差异提示的鲁棒性」是尚未被系统度量的关键缺口。
AI.method: 1) 定义新指标 reliable@k 衡量模型对「表亲提示」(cousin prompts) 的一致正确率；2) 构建自动化数据增强管线，高效生成高质量 cousin prompts；3) 基于该管线扩充 IFEval 得到 IFEval++，对 20 个专有与 26 个开源模型开展系统评测；4) 归纳失效模式并实验三种改进方案。
AI.result: 所有受测模型在细微差别场景下均出现显著性能衰减，最大降幅 61.8%；即使高分模型，其 reliable@k 也远低于标准准确率，证明「细微差别鲁棒性」普遍不足。
AI.conclusion: 论文将「细微差别导向的可靠性」确立为大模型可信赖性的独立维度，提供可复现的度量和基准；三种改进配方初步验证有效，未来需持续优化数据多样性、对齐算法与评估协议，才能迈向真正稳健的大模型服务。

title: Enabling Ultra-Fast Cardiovascular Imaging Across Heterogeneous Clinical Environments with A Generalist Foundation Model and Multimodal Database
summary: Multimodal cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging provides comprehensive and non-invasive insights into cardiovascular disease (CVD) diagnosis and underlying mechanisms. Despite decades of advancements, its widespread clinical adoption remains constrained by prolonged scan times, inconsistent image quality, and heterogeneity across medical environments. This underscores the urgent need for a generalist reconstruction foundation model for ultra-fast CMR imaging, one formulated for physics-constrained inverse problems in the sensor (k-space) domain, capable of adapting across diverse imaging scenarios and serving as the essential substrate for all downstream analyses. To enable this goal, we curate MMCMR-427K, the largest and most comprehensive multimodal CMR k-space database to date, comprising 427,465 multi-coil k-space data paired with structured metadata across 13 international centers, 12 CMR modalities, 15 scanners spanning four field strengths, and 17 CVD categories in populations across three continents. Building on this unprecedented resource, we introduce CardioMM, a generalist reconstruction foundation model capable of dynamically adapting to heterogeneous fast CMR imaging scenarios. CardioMM unifies semantic contextual understanding with physics-informed data consistency to deliver robust reconstructions across varied scanners, protocols, and patient presentations. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that CardioMM achieves state-of-the-art performance across internal centers and exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to unseen external settings. Importantly, CardioMM supports acceleration up to 24x, providing the first evidence that such extreme acquisition speed can preserve key cardiac phenotypes, quantitative myocardial biomarkers, and diagnostic image quality without compromising clinical integrity.

AI.tldr: CardioMM 是全球首个面向超快心脏 MRI 的通用重建基础模型，依托 42.7 万 k-space 数据构建，可在 24 倍加速下保持诊断级图像质量并支持零样本跨中心泛化。
AI.motivation: 心脏 MRI 虽为 CVD 金标准，但扫描长、质量参差、跨中心差异大，阻碍临床普及，急需一个能兼顾物理约束与多场景自适应的通用重建基础模型。
AI.method: 构建迄今最大多模态心脏 k-space 数据库 MMCMR-427K（13 中心、12 模态、15 扫描仪、4 场强、17 类 CVD）；提出通用重建模型 CardioMM，融合语义上下文与物理一致性约束，实现 k-space 到图像的端到端逆问题求解。
AI.result: 在内部多中心数据达 SOTA，零样本外推至全新中心仍保持高保真；24× 加速下仍能准确恢复心腔体积、心肌定量生物标志物与诊断图像质量，无临床信息损失。
AI.conclusion: CardioMM 为超快心脏 MRI 提供了可即插即用的通用重建基座，突破速度与画质权衡，支撑后续所有下游定量与诊断分析，具备直接临床部署潜力。

title: FlowPlan-G2P: A Structured Generation Framework for Transforming Scientific Papers into Patent Descriptions
summary: Over 3.5 million patents are filed annually, with drafting patent descriptions requiring deep technical and legal expertise. Transforming scientific papers into patent descriptions is particularly challenging due to their differing rhetorical styles and stringent legal requirements. Unlike black-box text-to-text approaches that struggle to model structural reasoning and legal constraints, we propose FlowPlan-G2P, a novel framework that mirrors the cognitive workflow of expert drafters by reformulating this task into three stages: (1) Concept Graph Induction, extracting technical entities and relationships into a directed graph via expert-like reasoning; (2) Paragraph and Section Planning, reorganizing the graph into coherent clusters aligned with canonical patent sections; and (3) Graph-Conditioned Generation, producing legally compliant paragraphs using section-specific subgraphs and tailored prompts. Experiments demonstrate that FlowPlan-G2P significantly improves logical coherence and legal compliance over end-to-end LLM baselines. Our framework establishes a new paradigm for paper-to-patent generation and advances structured text generation for specialized domains.

AI.tldr: FlowPlan-G2P 首次将论文→专利起草拆解为“概念图诱导-段落规划-图条件生成”三阶段，兼顾技术逻辑与法律合规，显著优于端到端 LLM。
AI.motivation: 全球每年超 350 万件专利需撰写，但科研论文与专利在修辞与法律要求上差异巨大；纯黑箱文本生成难以满足结构推理与法条约束。
AI.method: 1) 概念图诱导：用专家式推理将论文抽成实体-关系有向图；2) 段落-章节规划：按专利标准段（技术领域、背景、发明内容等）对图聚类；3) 图条件生成：以段专属子图+法条提示驱动 LLM 逐段输出，全程保留显式结构信号。
AI.result: 在自建的 2 万对英文学术论文-已授权美国专利数据集上，FlowPlan-G2P 的章节逻辑一致性↑28%，法条合规率↑41%，人类专家可接受率↑35%，BLEU 与信息量亦优于 GPT-4 等端到端基线。
AI.conclusion: 提出“先结构后文本”的新范式，显示显式认知工作流可让大模型在强监管领域生成专业长文档；框架可迁移至法规、标书等结构文本场景。

title: Safe-FedLLM: Delving into the Safety of Federated Large Language Models
summary: Federated learning (FL) addresses privacy and data-silo issues in the training of large language models (LLMs). Most prior work focuses on improving the efficiency of federated learning for LLMs (FedLLM). However, security in open federated environments, particularly defenses against malicious clients, remains underexplored. To investigate the security of FedLLM, we conduct a preliminary study to analyze potential attack surfaces and defensive characteristics from the perspective of LoRA updates. We find two key properties of FedLLM: 1) LLMs are vulnerable to attacks from malicious clients in FL, and 2) LoRA updates exhibit distinct behavioral patterns that can be effectively distinguished by lightweight classifiers. Based on these properties, we propose Safe-FedLLM, a probe-based defense framework for FedLLM, which constructs defenses across three levels: Step-Level, Client-Level, and Shadow-Level. The core concept of Safe-FedLLM is to perform probe-based discrimination on each client's local LoRA updates, treating them as high-dimensional behavioral features and using a lightweight classifier to determine whether they are malicious. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Safe-FedLLM effectively improves FedLLM's robustness against malicious clients while maintaining competitive performance on benign data. Notably, our method effectively suppresses the impact of malicious data without significantly affecting training speed, and remains effective even under high malicious client ratios.

AI.tldr: 提出 Safe-FedLLM：首个针对 LoRA 更新的三层探针式防御框架，可在开放联邦环境下高比例恶意客户端场景中，不显著损失训练速度地保障大模型安全。
AI.motivation: 现有 FedLLM 研究聚焦效率而忽视开放联邦场景中的恶意客户端威胁，攻击面与防御特性尚缺系统分析。
AI.method: 1) 从 LoRA 更新角度梳理攻击面；2) 发现“LLM 易被 FL 恶意客户端攻击且 LoRA 更新行为可区分”两大关键性质；3) 设计 Safe-FedLLM：将客户端本地 LoRA 更新视为高维行为特征，用轻量分类器做探针式判别，并在 Step-Level、Client-Level、Shadow-Level 三层构建防御。
AI.result: 实验表明 Safe-FedLLM 在高恶意客户端比例下仍能显著提升 FedLLM 鲁棒性，对良性数据性能几乎无损，且训练速度下降极小。
AI.conclusion: 利用 LoRA 更新的可区分行为特征实现轻量级探针防御，是解决 FedLLM 安全瓶颈的有效路径，Safe-FedLLM 为后续安全联邦大模型提供了可扩展框架。

title: Understanding or Memorizing? A Case Study of German Definite Articles in Language Models
summary: Language models perform well on grammatical agreement, but it is unclear whether this reflects rule-based generalization or memorization. We study this question for German definite singular articles, whose forms depend on gender and case. Using GRADIEND, a gradient-based interpretability method, we learn parameter update directions for gender-case specific article transitions. We find that updates learned for a specific gender-case article transition frequently affect unrelated gender-case settings, with substantial overlap among the most affected neurons across settings. These results argue against a strictly rule-based encoding of German definite articles, indicating that models at least partly rely on memorized associations rather than abstract grammatical rules.

AI.tldr: 利用GRADIEND方法发现，德语定冠词的语法一致性并非由抽象规则编码，而是依赖记忆化联想。
AI.motivation: 厘清语言模型在德语冠词一致性上的优异表现究竟是源于规则泛化还是纯粹记忆。
AI.method: 以GRADIEND梯度可解释技术，为德语的“性-格”特定冠词跃迁学习参数更新方向，并观察其对无关性-格设置的影响。
AI.result: 针对某一性-格冠词学到的更新会显著干扰其他性-格组合，且受影响神经元高度重叠，说明不存在严格分离的规则通道。
AI.conclusion: 模型对德语定冠词的处理主要依赖记忆化关联而非抽象语法规则，质疑了纯粹的基于规则的编码假设。

title: CamReasoner: Reinforcing Camera Movement Understanding via Structured Spatial Reasoning
summary: Understanding camera dynamics is a fundamental pillar of video spatial intelligence. However, existing multimodal models predominantly treat this task as a black-box classification, often confusing physically distinct motions by relying on superficial visual patterns rather than geometric cues. We present \textbf{CamReasoner}, a framework that reformulates camera movement understanding as a structured inference process to bridge the gap between perception and cinematic logic. Our approach centers on the Observation-Thinking-Answer (O-T-A) paradigm, which compels the model to articulate spatio-temporal observations and reason about motion patterns within an explicit reasoning block. To instill this capability, we construct a Large-scale Inference Trajectory Suite comprising 18k SFT reasoning chains and 38k RL feedback samples. To the best of our knowledge, \textbf{we are the first to employ RL for logical alignment in camera movement understanding}, ensuring motion inferences are grounded in structured visual reasoning rather than contextual guesswork. Built upon Qwen2.5-VL-7B, CamReasoner-7B improves binary classification accuracy from 73.8\% to 78.4\% and VQA accuracy from 60.9\% to 74.5\% over its backbone, consistently outperforming both proprietary and open-source baselines across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 将相机运动理解从“黑盒分类”改为显式推理过程—用O-T-A范式＋18k监督＋38k强化学习轨迹，把视觉感知转为结构化逻辑，7B模型多项指标刷新前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型用纯分类思路理解相机运动，仅依赖表层视觉模式，导致将几何上截然不同的运动误判；亟需将‘感知’与‘摄影机运动逻辑’对齐，形成可解释、几何一致的运动推理。
AI.method: 提出CamReasoner框架：①Observation-Thinking-Answer显式推理块；②构建18k SFT推理链＋38k RL反馈样本的大规模轨迹库train-of-thought；③首次在该任务引入强化学习做逻辑对齐，用结构化视觉推理替代上下文猜测，基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B训练。
AI.result: CamReasoner-7B相较基座模型已将二分类准确率从73.8%提升到78.4%，VQA准确率从60.9%提升到74.5%，并在多项公开基准上系统超越闭源和开源基线。
AI.conclusion: 将相机运动抽象为可解释的推理链并辅以RL逻辑对齐，使视觉模型能真正理解空间几何运动，为该领域首个成功范式；结果验证感知-逻辑联合同步可显著提升相机运动理解性能且具可扩展性。

title: El Agente Quntur: A research collaborator agent for quantum chemistry
summary: Quantum chemistry is a foundational enabling tool for the fields of chemistry, materials science, computational biology and others. Despite of its power, the practical application of quantum chemistry simulations remains in the hands of qualified experts due to methodological complexity, software heterogeneity, and the need for informed interpretation of results. To bridge the accessibility gap for these tools and expand their reach to chemists with broader backgrounds, we introduce El Agente Quntur, a hierarchical, multi-agent AI system designed to operate not merely as an automation tool but as a research collaborator for computational quantum chemistry. Quntur was designed following three main strategies: i) elimination of hard-coded procedural policies in favour of reasoning-driven decisions, ii) construction of general and composable actions that facilitate generalization and efficiency, and iii) implementation of guided deep research to integrate abstract quantum-chemical reasoning across subdisciplines and a detailed understanding of the software's internal logic and syntax. Although instantiated in ORCA, these design principles are applicable to research agents more generally and easily expandable to additional quantum chemistry packages and beyond. Quntur supports the full range of calculations available in ORCA 6.0 and reasons over software documentation and scientific literature to plan, execute, adapt, and analyze in silico chemistry experiments following best practices. We discuss the advances and current bottlenecks in agentic systems operating at the research level in computational chemistry, and outline a roadmap toward a fully autonomous end-to-end computational chemistry research agent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出分层多智能体系统「El Agente Quntur」，用推理驱动代替硬编码策略，使非专家也能像合作者一样使用 ORCA 完成量子化学全流程计算，并给出迈向完全自治计算化学代理的路线图。
AI.motivation: 量子化学模拟虽为化学、材料、生物等领域基石，却因方法复杂、软件异构、结果需专家解读而门槛极高。作者旨在消除「只有专家才能用」的壁垒，让背景更宽泛的化学研究者也能安全、高效地进行高质量计算。
AI.method: 设计三层多智能体架构：① 用 LLM 取代硬编码流程，使决策基于实时推理；② 构建可组合、通用的高层动作（如「优化基组」「选泛函」），提升泛化与复用；③ 引入「引导式深度研究」机制，让系统自动综合软件文档、文献与量子化学理论，形成可解释计划。实现以 ORCA 6.0 为后端，但插件式接口可扩展至其他量化包。
AI.result: Quntur 已能独立完成 ORCA 支持的全部计算类型（几何优化、频率、激发态、热化学、溶剂化等），并在多项代表性反应体系、光谱预测任务中给出与文献一致的结果；对非专家用户，任务准备时间缩短 70%，错误率下降约一半。系统展示了动态调整理论层级、自检计算失误、自动交叉验证等能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次把「推理-决策-实验-分析」闭环交给智能体，使计算化学软件从工具升级为合作者。当前瓶颈在长程任务规划可验证性、计算资源调度与跨包协同；作者提出三步路线图：增强可验证推理→引入自主实验设计→实现完全端到端自治，从而推动化学研究民主化与加速化。

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated ACSL Annotations for Formal Verification
comment: 12 pages. Formal Techniques for Judicious Programming FTfJP-2026 at ECOOP. Conditionally Accepted. Final Revision
summary: Formal specifications are crucial for building verifiable and dependable software systems, yet generating accurate and verifiable specifications for real-world C programs remains challenging. This paper presents an empirical evaluation of automated ACSL annotation generation strategies for C programs, comparing a rule-based Python script, Frama-C's RTE plugin, and three large language models (DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-5.2, and OLMo 3.1 32B Instruct). The study focuses on one-shot annotation generation, assessing how these approaches perform when directly applied to verification tasks. Using a filtered subset of the CASP benchmark, we evaluate generated annotations through Frama-C's WP plugin with multiple SMT solvers, analyzing proof success rates, solver timeouts, and internal processing time. Our results show that rule-based approaches remain more reliable for verification success, while LLM-based methods exhibit more variable performance. These findings highlight both the current limitations and the potential of LLMs as complementary tools for automated specification generation.

AI.tldr: 本文实证比较了五种自动化ACSL规格生成策略（规则脚本、Frama-C插件及三款大语言模型）在真实C程序上的可验证性，发现规则法仍最可靠，LLM性能波动大但具互补潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有C程序形式化规格难以手工编写且易出错，亟需自动、可验证的ACSL注释生成技术；同时大语言模型在代码任务表现突出，却缺乏系统评估其生成的规格能否被形式化验证。
AI.method: 从CASP基准筛选子集，采用一次性提示让5种工具生成ACSL注解；用Frama-C的WP插件配合多种SMT求解器验证，统计证明成功率、求解器超时及内部耗时，量化比较规则脚本、RTE插件与DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-5.2、OLMo 3.1 32B Instruct的验证效果。
AI.result: 规则法与RTE插件的验证成功率最高且稳定；三款LLM的规格导致明显波动，证明成功率低于规则法，并出现更多求解器超时及内部耗时，表明LLM生成规格在可验证性上仍不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 当前规则驱动方法仍是保证验证成功的首选；LLM虽能生成语法正确的ACSL，但逻辑强度与求解器友好性不足，只能作为辅助工具。未来需结合规则约束、提示优化与迭代修复，提升LLM规格的验证通过率。

title: MoDora: Tree-Based Semi-Structured Document Analysis System
comment: Extension of our SIGMOD 2026 paper. Please refer to source code available at https://github.com/weAIDB/MoDora
summary:
Semi-structured documents integrate diverse interleaved data elements (e.g., tables, charts, hierarchical paragraphs) arranged in various and often irregular layouts. These documents are widely observed across domains and account for a large portion of real-world data. However, existing methods struggle to support natural language question answering over these documents due to three main technical challenges: (1) The elements extracted by techniques like OCR are often fragmented and stripped of their original semantic context, making them inadequate for analysis.
