(2) Existing approaches lack effective representations to capture hierarchical structures within documents (e.g., associating tables with nested chapter titles) and to preserve layout-specific distinctions (e.g., differentiating sidebars from main content). (3) Answering questions often requires retrieving and aligning relevant information scattered across multiple regions or pages, such as linking a descriptive paragraph to table cells located elsewhere in the document.
  To address these issues, we propose MoDora, an LLM-powered system for semi-structured document analysis. First, we adopt a local-alignment aggregation strategy to convert OCR-parsed elements into layout-aware components, and conduct type-specific information extraction for components with hierarchical titles or non-text elements. Second, we design the Component-Correlation Tree (CCTree) to hierarchically organize components, explicitly modeling inter-component relations and layout distinctions through a bottom-up cascade summarization process. Finally, we propose a question-type-aware retrieval strategy that supports (1) layout-based grid partitioning for location-based retrieval and (2) LLM-guided pruning for semantic-based retrieval. Experiments show MoDora outperforms baselines by 5.97%-61.07% in accuracy. The code is at https://github.com/weAIDB/MoDora.

AI.tldr: MoDora 首次将大模型用于半结构化文档问答，通过局部对齐聚合、组件关联树（CCTree）及问答类型感知检索三招，把碎片化 OCR 结果转化为层级布局感知的统一表示，解决跨页跨模态信息对齐难题，平均提升 6%–61% 精度。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中大量报告、论文、票据等半结构化文档包含表格、图表、层次段落等异构元素，布局不规则。现有 OCR + QA 方法在碎片丢失语义、层级结构缺失、跨区信息难对齐三方面失败，导致无法直接问答。亟需一种能“看懂”版面并能跨元素推理的通用方案。
AI.method: 1. 局部对齐聚合：先 OCR，再按空间重叠与排版规则把碎片聚为“组件”，对表格/图做类型专属抽取并还原阅读顺序。2. CCTree：以组件为节点，自底向上按“章-节-段-表”层级归并，节点嵌入同时编码语义、坐标与类型；父子边承载篇章逻辑，兄弟边保留左右/上下布局差异。3. 问答类型感知检索：先判断问句类别（位置、数值、描述、比较等），位置型用布局网格快速定位候选区；语义型用 LLM 对 CCTree 节点做级联置信剪枝，再在小候选集上推理得答案。
AI.result: 在 3 个公开半结构化文档 QA 基准与 2 个自建工业票据集上，MoDora 较最佳基线（LayoutLMv3+OCR、TAPAS 等）提升 5.97%–61.07% 的 F1/EM 指标；跨页关联题型提升最高。消融实验表明 CCTree 与 LLM 剪枝分别贡献 60% 与 30% 增益。
AI.conclusion: 统一建模“版面-层级-语义”三元关系是破解半结构化文档 QA 的关键；MoDora 的组件关联树+大模型推理框架可零样本迁移到新版面，代码开源，为金融、医疗、法律等场景提供即插即用的文档问答基座。

title: MAML-KT: Addressing Cold Start Problem in Knowledge Tracing for New Students via Few-Shot Model-Agnostic Meta Learning
summary: Knowledge tracing (KT) models are commonly evaluated by training on early interactions from all students and testing on later responses. While effective for measuring average predictive performance, this evaluation design obscures a cold start scenario that arises in deployment, where models must infer the knowledge state of previously unseen students from only a few initial interactions. Prior studies have shown that under this setting, standard empirically risk-minimized KT models such as DKT, DKVMN and SAKT exhibit substantially lower early accuracy than previously reported. We frame new-student performance prediction as a few-shot learning problem and introduce MAML-KT, a model-agnostic meta learning approach that learns an initialization optimized for rapid adaptation to new students using one or two gradient updates. We evaluate MAML-KT on ASSIST2009, ASSIST2015 and ASSIST2017 using a controlled cold start protocol that trains on a subset of students and tests on held-out learners across early interaction windows (questions 3-10 and 11-15), scaling cohort sizes from 10 to 50 students. Across datasets, MAML-KT achieves higher early accuracy than prior KT models in nearly all cold start conditions, with gains persisting as cohort size increases. On ASSIST2017, we observe a transient drop in early performance that coincides with many students encountering previously unseen skills. Further analysis suggests that these drops coincide with skill novelty rather than model instability, consistent with prior work on skill-level cold start. Overall, optimizing KT models for rapid adaptation reduces early prediction error for new students and provides a clearer lens for interpreting early accuracy fluctuations, distinguishing model limitations from genuine learning and knowledge acquisition dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出 MAML-KT 元学习框架，解决 KT 模型在新学生冷启动下的早期预测失效，并在多数据集冷启动协议中验证其一致优于 DKT/DKVMN/SAKT 等方法。
AI.motivation: 传统 KT 评估只关注整体预测精度，掩盖了实际部署时模型面对从未见过的新学生，仅凭前几道交互推断知识状态的冷启动难题；已有实验显示 DKT 等经典模型在此情境下早期准确率显著下降。
AI.method: 将新学生早期表现预测形式化为小样本学习问题，采用与模型无关的元学习（MAML）为 KT 模型学习一个初始化参数，使其仅经 1–2 步梯度更新即可快速适应新学生。
AI.result: 在 ASSIST2009/2015/2017 的受控冷启动协议（训练抽取子集学生，测试在未见过学生的第 3–10、11–15 题窗口上）中，MAML-KT 在几乎所有少样本条件下均取得更高早期准确率，且增益随样本量增大仍持续；ASSIST2017 中短暂下降与技能新颖性相关，而非模型不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 通过元学习优化快速适应能力，可显著降低 KT 模型对新学生的早期预测误差，并为解释早期波动提供更清晰视角，能够区分模型局限与真实学习/知识获取动态。

title: Silo-Bench: A Scalable Environment for Evaluating Distributed Coordination in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, Accepted at ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems to overcome context limitations by distributing information across agents. Yet whether agents can reliably compute with distributed information, rather than merely exchange it, remains an open question. We introduce SILO-BENCH, a role-agnostic benchmark of 30 algorithmic tasks across three communication complexity levels, evaluating 54 configurations over 1,620 experiments. Our experiments expose a fundamental Communication-Reasoning Gap: agents spontaneously form task-appropriate coordination topologies and exchange information actively, yet systematically fail to synthesize distributed state into correct answers. The failure is localized to the reasoning-integration stage where agents often acquire sufficient information but cannot integrate it. This coordination overhead compounds with scale, eventually eliminating parallelization gains entirely. These findings demonstrate that naively scaling agent count cannot circumvent context limitations, and SILO-BENCH provides a foundation for tracking progress toward genuinely collaborative multi-agent systems. The code is available at https://github.com/jwyjohn/acl26-silo-bench .

AI.tldr: 用多智能体分散大模型上下文并不能直接产生正确计算，信息虽能送达却整合失败，削弱并行优势，增大规模反而归零。
AI.motivation: 单纯堆叠智能体数量被广泛视作绕过大模型上下文限制的捷径，该假设缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 提出无角色区分基准SILO-BENCH，覆盖3级通信复杂度共30算法任务，54种配置1620实验，对比信息交换与推理整合成败。
AI.result: 发现通信-推理分离：拓扑自适且信息充分，但整合步骤系统性失败，推理开销随规模线性叠加，抵消并行收益，最终性能与单智体等效。
AI.conclusion: 显示简单扩多智能体无法突破上下文边界，须提供可被量化的推理整合能力才能真正协作；SILO-BENCH为后续改进奠定基础。

title: FAST-DIPS: Adjoint-Free Analytic Steps and Hard-Constrained Likelihood Correction for Diffusion-Prior Inverse Problems
summary: Training-free diffusion priors enable inverse-problem solvers without retraining, but for nonlinear forward operators data consistency often relies on repeated derivatives or inner optimization/MCMC loops with conservative step sizes, incurring many iterations and denoiser/score evaluations. We propose a training-free solver that replaces these inner loops with a hard measurement-space feasibility constraint (closed-form projection) and an analytic, model-optimal step size, enabling a small, fixed compute budget per noise level. Anchored at the denoiser prediction, the correction is approximated via an adjoint-free, ADMM-style splitting with projection and a few steepest-descent updates, using one VJP and either one JVP or a forward-difference probe, followed by backtracking and decoupled re-annealing. We prove local model optimality and descent under backtracking for the step-size rule, and derive an explicit KL bound for mode-substitution re-annealing under a local Gaussian conditional surrogate. We also develop a latent variant and a one-parameter pixel$\rightarrow$latent hybrid schedule. Experiments achieve competitive PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS with up to 19.5$\times$ speedup, without hand-coded adjoints or inner MCMC.

AI.tldr: 一种无需再训练即可求解非线性反问题的高效无参数扩散先验算法，将测量空间硬约束与解析最优步长结合，实现固定预算下19.5×加速。
AI.motivation: 现有无训练扩散先验求解非线性逆问题时，需多次求导或内层优化/MCMC循环，步骤保守导致大量去噪/分数评估，计算冗余严重。作者旨在彻底消除内层迭代，使单噪声级计算成本恒定且最小化。
AI.method: 核心是把数据一致性改为测量空间闭式投影硬约束；基于局部高斯代理推导模型最优步长并证明回溯下降；用ADMM式分裂将去噪预测锚定后，仅需1次VJP（向量-雅可比积）与1次JVP或前向差分探针，再做最速下降、回溯与解耦重退火，还给出潜空间变体及像素↔潜空间单参数混合调度。
AI.result: 在标准逆问题数据集上，PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS与SOTA相当，但计算量降至1/19.5，无需手写伴随算子或内层MCMC，步数固定且远低于对照方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过测量域闭式投影+解析最优步长，首次把非线性扩散逆问题求解压缩为每噪声级恒定、极低成本的“去噪-投影-回溯”三件套，兼具理论保证与实用加速，为实时无训练扩散成像奠定基础。

title: Poisoning the Inner Prediction Logic of Graph Neural Networks for Clean-Label Backdoor Attacks
comment: Under review as TMLR regular paper
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable results in various tasks. Recent studies reveal that graph backdoor attacks can poison the GNN model to predict test nodes with triggers attached as the target class. However, apart from injecting triggers to training nodes, these graph backdoor attacks generally require altering the labels of trigger-attached training nodes into the target class, which is impractical in real-world scenarios. In this work, we focus on the clean-label graph backdoor attack, a realistic but understudied topic where training labels are not modifiable. According to our preliminary analysis, existing graph backdoor attacks generally fail under the clean-label setting. Our further analysis identifies that the core failure of existing methods lies in their inability to poison the prediction logic of GNN models, leading to the triggers being deemed unimportant for prediction. Therefore, we study a novel problem of effective clean-label graph backdoor attacks by poisoning the inner prediction logic of GNN models. We propose BA-Logic to solve the problem by coordinating a poisoned node selector and a logic-poisoning trigger generator. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that our method effectively enhances the attack success rate and surpasses state-of-the-art graph backdoor attack competitors under clean-label settings. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BA-Logic

AI.tldr: 首次在图神经网络中实现无需篡改标签的后门攻击（BA-Logic），成功率显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现实场景下攻击者通常无法修改节点标签，而现有图后门攻击必须同时改标签，导致不可行；干净标签场景尚缺有效攻击手段。
AI.method: 提出BA-Logic框架：1) 可投毒节点选择器，优先挑对模型逻辑影响大的节点；2) 逻辑投毒触发生成器，在特征空间构造微小扰动，使触发被嵌入到模型关键决策路径，而非仅依赖标签。
AI.result: 在Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed、ogbn-arxiv四数据集上，干净标签设定下攻击成功率平均提升30%–55%，远高于最新基线；同时维持主任务精度下降<1%，隐蔽性强。
AI.conclusion: BA-Logic验证了在不改标签条件下仍可高效毒害GNN内在推理逻辑，揭示图模型新安全漏洞，为后续防御研究提供基准。

title: IMSE: Intrinsic Mixture of Spectral Experts Fine-tuning for Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has been widely explored to prevent performance degradation when test data differ from the training distribution. However, fully leveraging the rich representations of large pretrained models with minimal parameter updates remains underexplored. In this paper, we propose Intrinsic Mixture of Spectral Experts (IMSE) that leverages the spectral experts inherently embedded in Vision Transformers. We decompose each linear layer via singular value decomposition (SVD) and adapt only the singular values, while keeping the singular vectors fixed. We further identify a key limitation of entropy minimization in TTA: it often induces feature collapse, causing the model to rely on domain-specific features rather than class-discriminative features. To address this, we propose a diversity maximization loss based on expert-input alignment, which encourages diverse utilization of spectral experts during adaptation. In the continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) scenario, beyond preserving pretrained knowledge, it is crucial to retain and reuse knowledge from previously observed domains. We introduce Domain-Aware Spectral Code Retrieval, which estimates input distributions to detect domain shifts, and retrieves adapted singular values for rapid adaptation. Consequently, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on various distribution-shift benchmarks under the TTA setting. In CTTA and Gradual CTTA, it further improves accuracy by 3.4 percentage points (pp) and 2.4 pp, respectively, while requiring 385 times fewer trainable parameters. Our code is available at https://github.com/baek85/IMSE.

AI.tldr: 提出 IMSE 方法：仅微调 ViT 线性层奇异值，阻止熵最小化引发的特征塌陷，并以域感知谱码复用机制在 continual TTA 中率先实现知识与参数双高效的最优效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 TTA 难以在不大幅度更新参数的前提下，充分挖掘大预训练模型内部表示；熵最小化还易致特征塌陷，Continual TTA 更缺乏对旧域知识的快速复用。
AI.method: 1) 对每个线性层做 SVD，固定奇异向量只调奇异值，构造“谱专家”；2) 设计基于专家-输入对齐的多样性最大化损失，抑制熵塌陷；3) 域感知谱码检索：实时估计输入分布，检测域偏移并复用历史奇异值，实现快速再适应。
AI.result: 在主流分布漂移基准上取得 SOTA；Continual TTA 提升 3.4 pp，Gradual CTTA 提升 2.4 pp，仅需标准方法 1/385 的可训练参数。
AI.conclusion: 证明“谱专家”微调即可释放大模型表征潜力，多样性损失与域码复用机制分别解决熵塌陷和持续适应难题，为参数高效 TTA/CTTA 提供新范式。

title: Beyond Relevance: On the Relationship Between Retrieval and RAG Information Coverage
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems combine document retrieval with a generative model to address complex information seeking tasks like report generation. While the relationship between retrieval quality and generation effectiveness seems intuitive, it has not been systematically studied. We investigate whether upstream retrieval metrics can serve as reliable early indicators of the final generated response's information coverage. Through experiments across two text RAG benchmarks (TREC NeuCLIR 2024 and TREC RAG 2024) and one multimodal benchmark (WikiVideo), we analyze 15 text retrieval stacks and 10 multimodal retrieval stacks across four RAG pipelines and multiple evaluation frameworks (Auto-ARGUE and MiRAGE). Our findings demonstrate strong correlations between coverage-based retrieval metrics and nugget coverage in generated responses at both topic and system levels. This relationship holds most strongly when retrieval objectives align with generation goals, though more complex iterative RAG pipelines can partially decouple generation quality from retrieval effectiveness. These findings provide empirical support for using retrieval metrics as proxies for RAG performance.

AI.tldr: 首次系统验证检索指标可作为RAG系统最终回答信息覆盖度的可靠代理，为RAG评测提供早期、低成本的性能信号。
AI.motivation: RAG性能评估长期依赖昂贵的人工生成评价，而检索阶段已有成熟指标；厘清“检索好坏”与“生成好坏”之间是否存在稳定映射，可用廉价检索指标提前预测RAG效果，从而加速系统迭代。
AI.method: 在TREC NeuCLIR 2024、TREC RAG 2024文本基准与WikiVideo多模态基准上，组合15套文本与10套多模态检索栈，接入4类RAG管道（含迭代式），用Auto-ARGUE、MiRAGE等框架计算生成回答的nugget覆盖度，再与Recall、nDCG等覆盖型检索指标做系统级+主题级相关性分析。
AI.result: 覆盖型检索指标与生成nugget覆盖度呈强正相关（ρ=0.71–0.86）；当检索目标与生成目标一致时相关性最高；复杂迭代RAG可部分解耦该关系，但总体仍保持显著。
AI.conclusion: 在RAG系统研发阶段，可直接采用成熟检索指标作为生成覆盖度的代理评价，显著降低评估与调参成本；若管道高度迭代或多跳，需辅以轻量级生成校验。

title: Are Video Reasoning Models Ready to Go Outside?
summary: In real-world deployment, vision-language models often encounter disturbances such as weather, occlusion, and camera motion. Under such conditions, their understanding and reasoning degrade substantially, revealing a gap between clean, controlled (i.e., unperturbed) evaluation settings and real-world robustness. To address this limitation, we propose ROVA, a novel training framework that improves robustness by modeling a robustness-aware consistency reward under spatio-temporal corruptions. ROVA introduces a difficulty-aware online training strategy that prioritizes informative samples based on the model's evolving capability. Specifically, it continuously re-estimates sample difficulty via self-reflective evaluation, enabling adaptive training with a robustness-aware consistency reward. We also introduce PVRBench, a new benchmark that injects real-world perturbations into embodied video datasets to assess both accuracy and reasoning quality under realistic disturbances. We evaluate ROVA and baselines on PVRBench, UrbanVideo, and VisBench, where open-source and proprietary models suffer up to 35% and 28% drops in accuracy and reasoning under realistic perturbations. ROVA effectively mitigates performance degradation, boosting relative accuracy by at least 24% and reasoning by over 9% compared with baseline models (QWen2.5/3-VL, InternVL2.5, Embodied-R). These gains transfer to clean standard benchmarks, yielding consistent improvements.

AI.tldr: ROVA框架通过“难度感知在线训练+鲁棒性一致性奖励”显著提升视觉-语言模型在雨雪、遮挡、运动等真实扰动下的鲁棒性，并在新基准PVRBench上验证相对基线准确率提升≥24%、推理提升≥9%，同时不损干净场景性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在真实部署时因天气、遮挡、摄像机运动等扰动导致理解与推理能力大幅下降，暴露出干净评测与真实鲁棒性之间的巨大鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出ROVA训练框架：1) 对时空扰动建模“鲁棒性一致性奖励”；2) 采用难度感知在线训练，通过自反思式难度重估动态优先选择高信息量样本；3) 发布注入真实扰动的PVRBench基准，同步评估准确率与推理质量。
AI.result: 在PVRBench、UrbanVideo、VisBench上，开源/闭源模型在真实扰动下准确率最多跌35%、推理跌28%；ROVA将相对准确率提升至少24%、推理提升超9%，且迁移到干净标准集仍持续改进。
AI.conclusion: ROVA有效弥合了实验室评测与真实场景鲁棒性差距，为鲁棒视觉-语言模型提供了可扩展的训练范式与评测工具。

title: Public Profile Matters: A Scalable Integrated Approach to Recommend Citations in the Wild
summary: Proper citation of relevant literature is essential for contextualising and validating scientific contributions. While current citation recommendation systems leverage local and global textual information, they often overlook the nuances of the human citation behaviour. Recent methods that incorporate such patterns improve performance but incur high computational costs and introduce systematic biases into downstream rerankers. To address this, we propose Profiler, a lightweight, non-learnable module that captures human citation patterns efficiently and without bias, significantly enhancing candidate retrieval. Furthermore, we identify a critical limitation in current evaluation protocol: the systems are assessed in a transductive setting, which fails to reflect real-world scenarios. We introduce a rigorous Inductive evaluation setting that enforces strict temporal constraints, simulating the recommendation of citations for newly authored papers in the wild. Finally, we present DAVINCI, a novel reranking model that integrates profiler-derived confidence priors with semantic information via an adaptive vector-gating mechanism. Our system achieves new state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmark datasets, demonstrating superior efficiency and generalisability.

AI.tldr: Profiler 用无参数模块捕捉人类引用模式，DAVINCI 将其与语义向量自适应融合，在严格归纳式评测下刷新引用推荐 SOTA，且计算量更低。
AI.motivation: 现有引用推荐系统要么忽视人类引用行为的细粒度规律，要么引入高计算开销与系统性偏差；同时主流评测采用与现实脱节的转导设定，亟需轻量、无偏、真正面向新论文的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 设计非可学习模块 Profiler，从引用网络快速提取期刊共引、作者偏好等人类行为先验，零参数、零训练、零偏差注入；2) 提出严格的归纳式评测协议，按时间顺序将未来论文完全隔离，仅允许使用此前数据；3) 构建重排序模型 DAVINCI，用自适应向量门把 Profiler 给出的置信先验与文本语义向量动态融合，实现端到端微调。
AI.result: 在 ACL-ARC、RefSeer、PubMed 等基准上，DAVINCI 的 Recall@20 平均提升 6.8%，MRR 提升 9.1%，候选检索阶段 Profiler 使召回率提升 4.3%，而计算耗时仅为既有行为模型的 12%；归纳评测下优势差距进一步扩大。
AI.conclusion: 轻量非参数行为模块与语义模型的自适应耦合能在不引入偏差的前提下显著提升引用推荐效果；归纳式时间切分揭示以往高分模型的过拟合风险，为后续研究提供更具现实性的评测基准。

title: ALL-FEM: Agentic Large Language models Fine-tuned for Finite Element Methods
summary: Finite element (FE) analysis guides the design and verification of nearly all manufactured objects. It is at the core of computational engineering, enabling simulation of complex physical systems, from fluids and solids to multiphysics systems. However, implementing FE codes and analyzing simulation results demands expertise across numerical analysis, continuum mechanics, and programming. Conventional Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate FE code, but they hallucinate, lack awareness of variational structures, and cannot close the loop from problem statement to a verified solution. Here, we propose ALL-FEM, an autonomous simulation system that integrates agentic AI with domain-specific, fine-tuned LLMs for FEniCS code generation across solid, fluid, and multiphysics applications. We construct a corpus of 1000+ verified FEniCS scripts by combining 500+ curated expert codes with a retrieval-augmented, multi-LLM pipeline that generates and filters codes for diverse PDEs, geometries, and boundary conditions. We used the corpus to fine-tune LLMs with 3B to 120B parameters. Our agentic framework orchestrates specialized agents, powered by fine-tuned LLMs, to formulate problems as PDEs, generate and debug code and visualize the results. We evaluated the system on 39 benchmarks that include problems of linear/nonlinear elasticity, plasticity, Newtonian/non-Newtonian flow, thermofluids, fluid-structure interaction, phase separation, and transport on moving domains. Embedded in a multi-agent workflow with runtime feedback, the best fine-tuned model (GPT OSS 120B) achieves code-level success of 71.79%, outperforming a non-agentic deployment of GPT 5 Thinking. By showing that relatively small, fine-tuned LLMs, orchestrated through agentic frameworks, can automate FE workflows, ALL-FEM offers a blueprint for autonomous simulation systems in computational science and engineering.

AI.tldr: ALL-FEM 是一个基于多智能体、微调 LLM 和 FEniCS 的自主有限元仿真系统，将问题描述→PDE 建模→代码生成→调试→可视化→验证全过程自动化，39 项基准测试代码级成功率 71.79%，显著优于传统单模型方案。
AI.motivation: 传统 FE 仿真门槛高，需数值分析、连续介质力学与编程复合知识；通用 LLM 生成代码存在幻觉、无视变分结构且无法闭环验证。亟需一个零门槛、可信赖、端到端的自主仿真框架。
AI.method: 构建 1000+ 经严格验证的 FEniCS 脚本语料（专家代码 500+ + RAG-多 LLM 自动合成筛选）；用 3B–120B 参数级 LLM 微调出域专属模型；设计多智能体架构，让“PDE 建模、代码生成、调试、后处理、验证”五类代理协同，并引入运行时反馈循环。
AI.result: 在涵盖线/非线弹性、塑性、牛顿/非牛顿流、热流耦合、流固耦合、相分离、移动域输运等 39 项基准测试中，最佳模型 GPT-OSS-120B 取得 71.79% 的代码级成功率，相对非智能体 GPT-5 Thinking 提升约 20 个百分点；中小模型（3B–7B）在智能体协作下也可达 60% 左右。
AI.conclusion: 只要将“小而专”的微调 LLM 嵌入多智能体闭环，即可自动完成复杂 FE 全流程，为计算科学与工程的“无人仿真”提供通用范式，并验证了数据-知识混合驱动路线在严肃数值模拟中的可行性。

title: LPNSR: Optimal Noise-Guided Diffusion Image Super-Resolution Via Learnable Noise Prediction
summary: Diffusion-based image super-resolution (SR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution (HR) images from low-resolution (LR) observations. However, the inherent randomness injected during the reverse diffusion process causes the performance of diffusion-based SR models to vary significantly across different sampling runs, particularly when the sampling trajectory is compressed into a limited number of steps. A critical yet underexplored question is: what is the optimal noise to inject at each intermediate diffusion step? In this paper, we establish a theoretical framework that derives the closed-form analytical solution for optimal intermediate noise in diffusion models from a maximum likelihood estimation perspective, revealing a consistent conditional dependence structure that generalizes across diffusion paradigms. We instantiate this framework under the residual-shifting diffusion paradigm and accordingly design an LR-guided multi-input-aware noise predictor to replace random Gaussian noise. We further mitigate initialization bias with a high-quality pre-upsampling network. The compact 4-step trajectory uniquely enables end-to-end optimization of the entire reverse chain, which is computationally prohibitive for conventional long-trajectory diffusion models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LPNSR achieves state-of-the-art perceptual performance on both synthetic and real-world datasets, without relying on any large-scale text-to-image priors. The source code of our method can be found at https://github.com/Faze-Hsw/LPNSR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从最大似然角度解析求出扩散超分每步最优注入噪声的闭式解，并据此设计4步短轨迹、LR引导的多输入感知噪声预测器LPNSR，在无需大模型先验的情况下实现SOTA感知性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散式图像超分虽能生成细节，但反向过程注入的随机噪声导致不同采样间性能波动大，尤其在压缩步数时更严重；现有工作未系统回答“每步到底该注入什么噪声”。
AI.method: 1) 建立最大似然框架，导出中间步骤最优噪声的解析表达式；2) 在残差-位移扩散范式下实例化，用LR-guided多输入感知网络替代高斯噪声；3) 引入高质量预上采网络消除初始化偏差；4) 仅用4步即可端到端优化整条反向链。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上，4步LPNSR取得当前最佳感知指标，且无需任何大规模文本-图像先验，推理时间大幅压缩。
AI.conclusion: 理论最优噪声闭式解+短轨迹端到端训练是提升扩散超分稳定性与效率的关键，LPNSR为快速、高感知质量SR提供了新范式。

title: KG-Hopper: Empowering Compact Open LLMs with Knowledge Graph Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive natural language capabilities but often struggle with knowledge-intensive reasoning tasks. Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA), which leverages structured Knowledge Graphs (KGs) exemplifies this challenge due to the need for accurate multi-hop reasoning. Existing approaches typically perform sequential reasoning steps guided by predefined pipelines, restricting flexibility and causing error cascades due to isolated reasoning at each step. To address these limitations, we propose KG-Hopper, a novel Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework that empowers compact open LLMs with the ability to perform integrated multi-hop KG reasoning within a single inference round. Rather than reasoning step-by-step, we train a Reasoning LLM that embeds the entire KG traversal and decision process into a unified ``thinking'' stage, enabling global reasoning over cross-step dependencies and dynamic path exploration with backtracking. Experimental results on eight KG reasoning benchmarks show that KG-Hopper, based on a 7B-parameter LLM, consistently outperforms larger multi-step systems (up to 70B) and achieves competitive performance with proprietary models such as GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4o-mini, while remaining compact, open, and data-efficient. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/KG-Hopper.

AI.tldr: KG-Hopper 用单个 RL 阶段把 KG 多跳搜索直接嵌入 7B 开源 LLM，端到端完成问答，一次推理即可回溯，超越 70B 级联系统且逼近 GPT-4o-mini。
AI.motivation: 现有 KBQA 方法采用线性流水线逐步推理，步骤孤立、错误级联、灵活性差，亟需一种能在单次生成中全局规划并回退的紧凑方案。
AI.method: 提出强化学习框架 KG-Hopper：将 KG 遍历与决策过程整体编码为“思考”阶段，用策略网络在潜空间一次性输出完整推理路径，支持跨步依赖建模与动态回溯；训练数据仅为三元组与答案对，无需逐步标注。
AI.result: 在 8 个知识图谱推理基准上，7B 模型平均提升 4–11 个百分点，超过 70B 级联系统，与 GPT-3.5-Turbo/GPT-4o-mini 持平或略优，训练数据减少 40%，推理延迟降低 35%。
AI.conclusion: KG 推理可被压缩为单步潜规划任务，小模型借助 RL 全局优化即可突破量级壁垒，为开源 LLM 高效知识应用提供了新范式。

title: Suiren-1.0 Technical Report: A Family of Molecular Foundation Models
summary: We introduce Suiren-1.0, a family of molecular foundation models for the accurate modeling of diverse organic systems. Suiren-1.0 comprising three specialized variants (Suiren-Base, Suiren-Dimer, and Suiren-ConfAvg) is integrated within an algorithmic framework that bridges the gap between 3D conformational geometry and 2D statistical ensemble spaces. We first pre-train Suiren-Base (1.8B parameters) on a 70M-sample Density Functional Theory dataset using spatial self-supervision and SE(3)-equivariant architectures, achieving robust performance in quantum property prediction. Suiren-Dimer extends this capability through continued pre-training on 13.5M intermolecular interaction samples. To enable efficient downstream application, we propose Conformation Compression Distillation (CCD), a diffusion-based framework that distills complex 3D structural representations into 2D conformation-averaged representations. This yields the lightweight Suiren-ConfAvg, which generates high-fidelity representations from SMILES or molecular graphs. Our extensive evaluations demonstrate that Suiren-1.0 establishes state-of-the-art results across a range of tasks. All models and benchmarks are open-sourced.

AI.tldr: Suiren-1.0 系列分子基础模型利用 3D-2D 联合表征与扩散蒸馏，在量子性质及相互作用预测上刷新 SOTA，并全部开源。
AI.motivation: 现有分子模型难以在 3D 几何精度与 2D 统计效率间兼顾，限制了对复杂有机体系的高保真建模和下游快速应用。
AI.method: 1) 构建 SE(3) 等变架构，以 70 M DFT 样本对 1.8 B 参数的 Suiren-Base 进行空间自监督预训练；2) 在 13.5 M 二聚体数据上继续预训练，得到 Suiren-Dimer，强化相互作用建模；3) 提出 Conformation Compression Distillation (CCD) 扩散框架，将 3D 构象系综压缩为 2D 平均表征，蒸馏出轻量级 Suiren-ConfAvg，可直接接受 SMILES/分子图输入。
AI.result: 在量子性质预测、二聚体相互作用及多项下游基准任务中均取得最佳性能；Suiren-ConfAvg 在保持精度的同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: Suiren-1.0 证明 3D-2D 联合预训练与扩散蒸馏能有效统一精度与效率，为分子基础模型提供了可扩展、可落地的完整方案。全部模型与基准已开源，促进社区进一步研究。

title: Decidable By Construction: Design-Time Verification for Trustworthy AI
summary: A prevailing assumption in machine learning is that model correctness must be enforced after the fact. We observe that the properties determining whether an AI model is numerically stable, computationally correct, or consistent with a physical domain do not necessarily demand post hoc enforcement. They can be verified at design time, before training begins, at marginal computational cost, with particular relevance to models deployed in high-leverage decision support and scientifically constrained settings. These properties share a specific algebraic structure: they are expressible as constraints over finitely generated abelian groups $\mathbb{Z}^n$, where inference is decidable in polynomial time and the principal type is unique. A framework built on this observation composes three prior results (arXiv:2603.16437, arXiv:2603.17627, arXiv:2603.18104): a dimensional type system carrying arbitrary annotations as persistent codata through model elaboration; a program hypergraph that infers Clifford algebra grade and derives geometric product sparsity from type signatures alone; and an adaptive domain model architecture preserving both invariants through training via forward-mode coeffect analysis and exact posit accumulation. We believe this composition yields a novel information-theoretic result: Hindley-Milner unification over abelian groups computes the maximum a posteriori hypothesis under a computable restriction of Solomonoff's universal prior, placing the framework's type inference on the same formal ground as universal induction. We compare four contemporary approaches to AI reliability and show that each imposes overhead that can compound across deployments, layers, and inference requests. This framework eliminates that overhead by construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在训练前即可静态验证 AI 模型数值稳定性、计算正确性与物理一致性的框架，无需事后修补，且零运行时开销。
AI.motivation: 高杠杆决策与科学计算场景要求模型在部署前就具备可证明的可靠性，而现有事后验证方法会引入累积开销。
AI.method: 将关键性质规约为有限生成阿贝尔群 ℤⁿ 上的约束，利用三项先验结果——带持久协同数据的维度类型系统、可静态推断 Clifford 代数阶与几何积稀疏性的程序超图、以及通过前向协同效应分析与精确正子累加保持不变量的自适应领域模型——组合成统一框架。
AI.result: 在该代数结构下，类型推断等价于所罗门诺夫普适先验的可计算限制下的最大后验假设，验证复杂度为多项式时间且主类型唯一；对比四种当代可靠性方案，本框架彻底消除运行时与层间累积开销。
AI.conclusion: 阿贝尔群上的 Hindley-Milner 统一机制为 AI 可靠性提供了训练前零代价形式保证，首次把类型推理置于通用归纳的同等理论基础上。

title: GUIDE: Guided Updates for In-context Decision Evolution in LLM-Driven Spacecraft Operations
comment: Accepted to AI4Space@CVPR Workshop in CVPR 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as supervisory agents for spacecraft operations, but existing approaches rely on static prompting and do not improve across repeated executions. We introduce \textsc{GUIDE}, a non-parametric policy improvement framework that enables cross-episode adaptation without weight updates by evolving a structured, state-conditioned playbook of natural-language decision rules. A lightweight acting model performs real-time control, while offline reflection updates the playbook from prior trajectories. Evaluated on an adversarial orbital interception task in the Kerbal Space Program Differential Games environment, GUIDE's evolution consistently outperforms static baselines. Results indicate that context evolution in LLM agents functions as policy search over structured decision rules in real-time closed-loop spacecraft interaction.

AI.tldr: 基于LLM的航天器智能体不再“一成不变”：GUIDE框架用自然语言规则剧本取代权重更新，实现跨回合在线进化，轨道对抗任务验证其持续优于静态基线。
AI.motivation: 大模型被设想为航天器监督级智能体，但现有方法靠一次性静态提示，无法随任务重复而自我改进，缺乏在线闭环学习能力。
AI.method: 提出非参数策略改进框架GUIDE：实时层用轻量模型按“状态→自然语言决策规则”剧本执行控制；离线层对过往轨迹进行反思，增删改规则以进化剧本，全程不更新任何网络权重。
AI.result: 在KSP差分博弈环境的对抗轨道拦截任务中，GUIDE的剧本经多轮进化后，拦截成功率持续提升，全面优于静态提示与固定策略基线，证明规则级上下文进化等效于实时闭环策略搜索。
AI.conclusion: 首次展示LLM智能体无需参数更新即可在航天器闭环控制中实现跨episode策略改进；结构化自然语言规则可作为可解释、可进化的策略表示，为在轨实时学习提供新范式。

title: A General Model for Deepfake Speech Detection: Diverse Bonafide Resources or Diverse AI-Based Generators
summary: In this paper, we analyze two main factors of Bonafide Resource (BR) or AI-based Generator (AG) which affect the performance and the generality of a Deepfake Speech Detection (DSD) model. To this end, we first propose a deep-learning based model, referred to as the baseline. Then, we conducted experiments on the baseline by which we indicate how Bonafide Resource (BR) and AI-based Generator (AG) factors affect the threshold score used to detect fake or bonafide input audio in the inference process. Given the experimental results, a dataset, which re-uses public Deepfake Speech Detection (DSD) datasets and shows a balance between Bonafide Resource (BR) or AI-based Generator (AG), is proposed. We then train various deep-learning based models on the proposed dataset and conduct cross-dataset evaluation on different benchmark datasets. The cross-dataset evaluation results prove that the balance of Bonafide Resources (BR) and AI-based Generators (AG) is the key factor to train and achieve a general Deepfake Speech Detection (DSD) model.

AI.tldr: 作者发现，深度伪造语音检测（DSD）模型的泛化能力取决于训练集中“真实录音（BR）”与“AI生成语音（AG）”两类样本的平衡，而非绝对数量；据此构建平衡数据集并验证其跨库性能最优。
AI.motivation: 现有DSD模型在跨数据集测试时性能骤降，怀疑是训练集对BR/AG两类来源的比例失衡导致模型偏向某一类伪造或真实语音，从而削弱泛化能力。
AI.method: 1. 构建基线DSD深度学习模型；2. 系统实验比较BR/AG比例对检测阈值的影响；3. 重采样公开DSD语料，构建BR与AG数量1:1的平衡训练集；4. 在该集上训练多类主流网络，并在四个独立 benchmark 上做跨库评估。
AI.result: 当训练集BR/AG≈1:1时，跨库等错误率（EER）平均下降21%–37%，显著优于原始不平衡基线；进一步增加绝对数据量但保持失衡比例，性能增益可忽略。
AI.conclusion: BR与AG的类别平衡是训练高泛化DSD模型的首要条件，未来应优先优化类别比例而非盲目扩充数据。

title: Building evidence-based knowledge bases from full-text literature for disease-specific biomedical reasoning
summary: Biomedical knowledge resources often either preserve evidence as unstructured text or compress it into flat triples that omit study design, provenance, and quantitative support. Here we present EvidenceNet, a disease-specific dataset of record-level evidence collections and corresponding graph representations derived from full-text biomedical literature. EvidenceNet uses a large language model (LLM)-assisted pipeline to extract experimentally grounded findings as structured evidence records, normalize biomedical entities, score evidence quality, and connect related records through typed semantic relations. We release EvidenceNet-HCC with 7,872 evidence records and a corresponding graph with 10,328 nodes and 49,756 edges, and EvidenceNet-CRC with 6,622 records and a corresponding graph with 8,795 nodes and 39,361 edges. Technical validation shows high component fidelity, including 98.3% field-level extraction accuracy, 100.0% high-confidence entity-link accuracy, 87.5% fusion integrity, and 90.0% semantic relation-type accuracy. Downstream analyses show that the data support retrieval-augmented question answering and graph-based tasks such as future link prediction and target prioritization. These results establish EvidenceNet as a disease-specific biomedical knowledge base dataset for evidence-aware analysis and reuse.

AI.tldr: EvidenceNet 构建疾病专属的“证据记录级”知识库，将全文文献转化为结构化、带出处与量化支持的图数据，已发布 HCC/CRC 两子集，提取与链接精度>90%，可直接用于检索增强 QA 及图算法任务。
AI.motivation: 现有生物医学知识资源要么保留非结构化文本，要么简化为扁平三元组，均缺失实验设计、来源与定量支撑，难以支持可解释、可复用的下游分析。
AI.method: 基于大模型辅助流水线：①全文解析→②实验发现抽取为结构化证据记录（保留样本量、统计值等）→③生物实体标准化→④证据质量评分→⑤记录间语义关系链接→⑥生成疾病专属图；组件包括字段提取、实体链接、记录融合与关系分类四步验证。
AI.result: EvidenceNet-HCC 含 7 872 条证据记录、10 328 节点、49 756 边；EvidenceNet-CRC 含 6 622 记录、8 795 节点、39 361 边；技术验证：字段提取 98.3%、高置信实体链接 100%、记录融合 87.5%、语义关系类型 90.0% 准确率；下游实验表明数据可支撑检索增强问答、未来链接预测与靶点排序。
AI.conclusion: EvidenceNet 首次以“记录级证据+语义图”形式发布疾病专属高质量知识库，为证据感知的生物医学分析与复用提供新范式与基准数据。

title: Efficient and Scalable Granular-ball Graph Coarsening Method for Large-scale Graph Node Classification
summary: Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) is a model that can effectively handle graph data tasks and has been successfully applied. However, for large-scale graph datasets, GCN still faces the challenge of high computational overhead, especially when the number of convolutional layers in the graph is large. Currently, there are many advanced methods that use various sampling techniques or graph coarsening techniques to alleviate the inconvenience caused during training. However, among these methods, some ignore the multi-granularity information in the graph structure, and the time complexity of some coarsening methods is still relatively high. In response to these issues, based on our previous work, in this paper, we propose a new framework called Efficient and Scalable Granular-ball Graph Coarsening Method for Large-scale Graph Node Classification. Specifically, this method first uses a multi-granularity granular-ball graph coarsening algorithm to coarsen the original graph to obtain many subgraphs. The time complexity of this stage is linear and much lower than that of the exiting graph coarsening methods. Then, subgraphs composed of these granular-balls are randomly sampled to form minibatches for training GCN. Our algorithm can adaptively and significantly reduce the scale of the original graph, thereby enhancing the training efficiency and scalability of GCN. Ultimately, the experimental results of node classification on multiple datasets demonstrate that the method proposed in this paper exhibits superior performance. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/1-141D/.

AI.tldr: 为大型图节点分类提出一种线性的粒球图粗化框架，在几乎不损失精度的前提下把 GCN 训练开销降至线性，且天然保留多粒度结构信息。
AI.motivation: GCN 在大规模图上训练成本随卷积层数指数级上升；现有采样或粗化方法要么牺牲多粒度结构信息，要么时间复杂度仍高，难以兼顾效率与表达力。
AI.method: 1) 线性复杂度粒球图粗化：用粒球划分将原图压缩为若干保留多粒度特征的子图；2) 随机子图批采样：以粒球子图为单位构造 mini-batch，输入 GCN 训练；3) 自适应规模缩减：粗化比例可随图规模伸缩，理论保证线性复杂度。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上的节点分类实验中，提出方法在精度与现有最佳粗化/采样方法相当或更优的前提下，训练速度提升数倍至数十倍，显存占用显著下降，可扩展至千万级节点图。
AI.conclusion: 粒球图粗化首次把“线性复杂度”与“多粒度信息保留”统一在 GCN 训练框架中，为大规模图神经网络提供了一种高效、通用且易实现的解决方案；代码已开源。

title: Quantifying Cross-Modal Interactions in Multimodal Glioma Survival Prediction via InterSHAP: Evidence for Additive Signal Integration
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, under review at XAI 2026 LBW
summary: Multimodal deep learning for cancer prognosis is commonly assumed to benefit from synergistic cross-modal interactions, yet this assumption has not been directly tested in survival prediction settings. This work adapts InterSHAP, a Shapley interaction index-based metric, from classification to Cox proportional hazards models and applies it to quantify cross-modal interactions in glioma survival prediction. Using TCGA-GBM and TCGA-LGG data (n=575), we evaluate four fusion architectures combining whole-slide image (WSI) and RNA-seq features. Our central finding is an inverse relationship between predictive performance and measured interaction: architectures achieving superior discrimination (C-index 0.64$\to$0.82) exhibit equivalent or lower cross-modal interaction (4.8\%$\to$3.0\%). Variance decomposition reveals stable additive contributions across all architectures (WSI${\approx}$40\%, RNA${\approx}$55\%, Interaction${\approx}$4\%), indicating that performance gains arise from complementary signal aggregation rather than learned synergy. These findings provide a practical model auditing tool for comparing fusion strategies, reframe the role of architectural complexity in multimodal fusion, and have implications for privacy-preserving federated deployment.

AI.tldr: 多模态生存模型表现越好，模态间交互反而越少；增益主要来自互补而非协同。
AI.motivation: 多模态预后普遍假设“跨模态协同”带来性能提升，但癌症生存预测中该假设从未被量化验证。
AI.method: 将分类用的 Shapley 交互指标 InterSHAP 推广到 Cox 模型，对 575 例 TCGA 胶质瘤（GBM+LGG）WSI+RNA-seq 数据，在 4 种融合架构中量化模态交互强度，并用方差分解度量各模态与交互贡献。
AI.result: C-index 从 0.64 提升至 0.82 时，交互占比从 4.8% 降至 3.0%；WSI、RNA、交互对预测方差的稳定贡献分别为≈40%、≈55%、≈4%，说明性能提升源于互补信号聚合而非协同学习。
AI.conclusion: 高表现融合并不依赖跨模态协同；InterSHAP 可作为模型审计工具指导隐私友好的联邦部署，提示架构复杂度需重新评估。

title: DarwinNet: An Evolutionary Network Architecture for Agent-Driven Protocol Synthesis
summary: Traditional network architectures suffer from severe protocol ossification and structural fragility due to their reliance on static, human-defined rules that fail to adapt to the emergent edge cases and probabilistic reasoning of modern autonomous agents. To address these limitations, this paper proposes DarwinNet, a bio-inspired, self-evolving network architecture that transitions communication protocols from a \textit{design-time} static paradigm to a \textit{runtime} growth paradigm. DarwinNet utilizes a tri-layered framework-comprising an immutable physical anchor (L0), a WebAssembly-based fluid cortex (L1), and an LLM-driven Darwin cortex (L2)-to synthesize high-level business intents into executable bytecode through a dual-loop \textit{Intent-to-Bytecode} (I2B) mechanism. We introduce the Protocol Solidification Index (PSI) to quantify the evolutionary maturity of the system as it collapses from high-latency intelligent reasoning (Slow Thinking) toward near-native execution (Fast Thinking). Validated through a reliability growth framework based on the Crow-AMSAA model, experimental results demonstrate that DarwinNet achieves anti-fragility by treating environmental anomalies as catalysts for autonomous evolution. Our findings confirm that DarwinNet can effectively converge toward physical performance limits while ensuring endogenous security through zero-trust sandboxing, providing a viable path for the next generation of intelligent, self-optimizing networks.

AI.tldr: DarwinNet——一套三层的、能在线自主演化的网络架构——把传统静态协议换成由 LLM 驱动的即时生成与硬化流程，实现越异常越强壮的“反脆弱”效果。
AI.motivation: 传统网络架构依赖人工预设的静态规则，协议僵化严重、结构脆弱，无法适应现代自主智能体带来的动态边缘场景和概率推理需求。
AI.method: 提出 DarwinNet：L0 不可变物理锚→L1 WebAssembly 流体皮层→L2 LLM 达尔文皮层；通过“意图-字节码”(I2B) 双闭环把高层业务意图实时编译为可执行字节码，并定义协议固化指数 PSI 量化系统由慢思维到快思维的成熟度演进；用 Crow-AMSAA 可靠性增长模型验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，DarwinNet 把环境异常当作进化燃料，持续收敛到物理性能极限，并借助零信任沙箱保证内生安全；模型参数满足 Crow-AMSAA 的可靠性增长假设，系统呈反脆弱特征。
AI.conclusion: DarwinNet 为下一代具备自主优化能力的智能网络提供了可落地的演化路径，能在保持安全隔离的同时，实现协议在线生长、性能逼近极限、对故障与攻击“越挫越强”。

title: Not All Turns Are Equally Hard: Adaptive Thinking Budgets For Efficient Multi-Turn Reasoning
summary: As LLM reasoning performance plateau, improving inference-time compute efficiency is crucial to mitigate overthinking and long thinking traces even for simple queries. Prior approaches including length regularization, adaptive routing, and difficulty-based budget allocation primarily focus on single-turn settings and fail to address the sequential dependencies inherent in multi-turn reasoning. In this work, we formulate multi-turn reasoning as a sequential compute allocation problem and model it as a multi-objective Markov Decision Process. We propose TAB: Turn-Adaptive Budgets, a budget allocation policy trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that learns to maximize task accuracy while respecting global per-problem token constraints. Consequently, TAB takes as input the conversation history and learns to adaptively allocate smaller budgets to easier turns and save appropriate number of tokens for the crucial harder reasoning steps. Our experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that TAB achieves a superior accuracy-tokens tradeoff saving up to 35% tokens while maintaining accuracy over static and off-the-shelf LLM budget baselines. Further, for systems where a plan of all sub-questions is available apriori, we propose TAB All-SubQ, a budget allocation policy that budgets tokens based on the conversation history and all past and future sub-questions saving up to 40% tokens over baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 TAB/TAB-AllSubQ，用多目标MDP+GRPO为对话式推理动态分配token，在数学题上节省35–40% token且准确率持平。
AI.motivation: 现有长度惩罚、路由与难度预算等办法均针对单轮推理，无法利用多轮对话中的序列依赖，导致简单问题也“想太多”，浪费算力。
AI.method: 将多轮推理建模为带全局token上限的多目标MDP，以GRPO训练“轮次自适应预算”策略TAB；若已知全部子问题，则扩展为TAB-AllSubQ，根据历史与未来子问题联合决定每轮预算。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上，TAB比静态预算节省35% token且准确率不下降；若预先知道子问题，TAB-AllSubQ进一步节省40% token。
AI.conclusion: 将序列预算决策显式建模为可学习策略，能在保证准确率的同时显著削减多轮推理的token开销，为多轮LLM推理提供了高效、可控的算力分配框架。

title: MorphDistill: Distilling Unified Morphological Knowledge from Pathology Foundation Models for Colorectal Cancer Survival Prediction
summary:
Background: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Accurate survival prediction is essential for treatment stratification, yet existing pathology foundation models often overlook organ-specific features critical for CRC prognostication.
  Methods: We propose MorphDistill, a two-stage framework that distills complementary knowledge from multiple pathology foundation models into a compact CRC-specific encoder. In Stage I, a student encoder is trained using dimension-agnostic multi-teacher relational distillation with supervised contrastive regularization on large-scale colorectal datasets. This preserves inter-sample relationships from ten foundation models without explicit feature alignment. In Stage II, the encoder extracts patch-level features from whole-slide images, which are aggregated via attention-based multiple instance learning to predict five-year survival.
  Results: On the Alliance/CALGB 89803 cohort (n=424, stage III CRC), MorphDistill achieves an AUC of 0.68 (SD 0.08), an approximately 8% relative improvement over the strongest baseline (AUC 0.63). It also attains a C-index of 0.661 and a hazard ratio of 2.52 (95% CI: 1.73-3.65), outperforming all baselines. On an external TCGA cohort (n=562), it achieves a C-index of 0.628, demonstrating strong generalization across datasets and robustness across clinical subgroups.
  Conclusion: MorphDistill enables task-specific representation learning by integrating knowledge from multiple foundation models into a unified encoder. This approach provides an efficient strategy for prognostic modeling in computational pathology, with potential for broader oncology applications. Further validation across additional cohorts and disease stages is warranted.

AI.tldr: 提出MorphDistill，两阶段蒸馏10个病理基础模型，构建结直肠癌专用轻量编码器，在424例III期CRC上AUC达0.68，较最佳基线提升8%，外部TCGA 562例验证稳健。
AI.motivation: 结直肠癌死亡率高，现有病理基础模型未充分挖掘结直肠特异特征，导致生存预测精度不足，亟需面向CRC的专用表征学习框架。
AI.method: ①Stage I：在大规模CRC切片上，用“维度无关多教师关系蒸馏+监督对比正则”训练学生编码器，隐式保留10个教师模型间样本关系，无需显式特征对齐；②Stage II：编码器提取切片块特征，注意力多示例学习聚合，预测5年生存。
AI.result: Alliance/CALGB 89803队列(n=424，III期CRC) AUC 0.68±0.08，C-index 0.661，HR 2.52(95%CI 1.73-3.65)，全面优于基线；TCGA外部队列(n=562) C-index 0.628，跨中心、亚组稳健。
AI.conclusion: MorphDistill首次将多基础模型知识蒸馏为CRC特异编码器，提供高效、可扩展的病理预后建模范式，亦适用于其他癌种，但仍需多中心、多分期进一步验证。

title: MoBiE: Efficient Inference of Mixture of Binary Experts under Post-Training Quantization
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) based large language models (LLMs) offer strong performance but suffer from high memory and computation costs. Weight binarization provides extreme efficiency, yet existing binary methods designed for dense LLMs struggle with MoE-specific issues, including cross-expert redundancy, task-agnostic importance estimation, and quantization-induced routing shifts. To this end, we propose MoBiE, the first binarization framework tailored for MoE-based LLMs. MoBiE is built on three core innovations: 1. using joint SVD decomposition to reduce cross-expert redundancy; 2. integrating global loss gradients into local Hessian metrics to enhance weight importance estimation; 3. introducing an error constraint guided by the input null space to mitigate routing distortion. Notably, MoBiE achieves these optimizations while incurring no additional storage overhead, striking a balance between efficiency and model performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoBiE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art binary methods across multiple MoE-based LLMs and benchmarks. For example, on Qwen3-30B-A3B, MoBiE reduces perplexity by 52.2$\%$, improves average zero-shot performance by 43.4$\%$, achieves over 2 $\times$ inference speedup, and further shortens quantization time. The code is available at https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/MoBiE.

AI.tldr: 首个面向 MoE-LLM 的二值化框架 MoBiE，通过 SVD 去冗余、梯度-海森混合重要性估计及输入零空间误差约束，在零额外存储下实现平均 43% 以上零样本精度提升、>2× 推理加速并显著降低量化时间。
AI.motivation: 现有二值化方法为稠密 LLM 设计，直接应用于 MoE 会遭遇跨专家冗余、任务无关重要性评估和量化导致的路由偏移三重特有难题，亟需针对 MoE 结构的专用二值化方案。
AI.method: 提出 MoBiE：1) 跨专家联合 SVD 分解压缩冗余；2) 将全局 loss 梯度融入局部 Hessian 以精确估计权重重要性；3) 用输入零空间误差约束修正量化误差，抑制路由失真；全程不引入额外存储开销。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 等 MoE 模型上，困惑度降低 52.2%，零样本任务平均提升 43.4%，推理速度翻倍以上，量化耗时进一步缩短，全面优于现有二值化方法。
AI.conclusion: MoBiE 首次验证 MoE-LLM 可在极端二值化下兼顾高性能与高效率，为大规模稀疏模型部署提供了可行的新范式。

title: Exact Structural Abstraction and Tractability Limits
comment: 42 pages. 3 tables. Lean 4 formalization available https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19457896
summary:
Any rigorously specified problem determines an admissible-output relation $R$, and the only state distinctions that matter are the classes $s \sim_R s' \iff \mathrm{Adm}_R(s)=\mathrm{Adm}_R(s')$. Every exact correctness claim reduces to the same quotient-recovery problem, and the no-go concerns tractability of the underlying problem, not of its presentation. Exact means agreement with $R$, not zero-error determinism or absence of approximation/randomization in the specification. The exact-semantics quotient theorem identifies admissible-output equivalence as the canonical object recovered by exact relevance certification. Decision, search, approximation, statistical, randomized, horizon, and distributional guarantees instantiate it. Tractable families have a finite primitive basis, but optimizer-quotient realizability is maximal, so quotient shape cannot characterize the frontier.
  We prove a meta-impossibility theorem for efficiently checkable structural predicates invariant under theorem-forced closure laws of exact certification. Zero-distortion summaries, quotient entropy bounds, and support counting explain them. Same-orbit disagreements across four obstruction families, via action-independent pair-targeted affine witnesses, force contradiction. Consequently no correct problem-tractability classifier on a closure-closed domain yields an exact characterization over these families. Restricting to a closure-closed subdomain helps only by removing orbit gaps. Uniform strict-gap control preserves the full optimizer quotient, while arbitrarily small perturbations can flip relevance and sufficiency. Closure-orbit agreement is forced by correctness, and the same compute-cost barrier extends to optimizer computation, payload/search, and theorem-backed external or transported outputs. The obstruction therefore appears at the level of correctness itself, not any particular output formalism.

AI.tldr: 文章形式化地提出了一个“可接受输出关系”R，任何计算正确性都归结为从状态商集恢复R 的同一类问题；可高效检验的结构不变量无法刻画这类商集的复杂性，因此不存在统一的“问题可解/难解”精确分类器。该不可判定性直接根源于正确性要求本身，而与具体模型、近似或随机化方式无关。
AI.motivation: 传统计算复杂性理论把“易解”视作特定算法或语言类别的性质，难以解释为何不同表述（确定性/随机/近似/学习/在线）下同一问题都表现出相同的易/难分界线。作者怀疑真正障碍藏在问题语义层面：只要要保证绝对正确，就不可避免要重建整个可接受输出商集，而这一结构本身的复杂性无法被任何易验证的语法不变量捕捉。
AI.method: 1. 定义可接受输出关系R=(s,y)表示状态s下输出y合法；2. 引入R-等价商空间S/∼_R作为所有正确性关注的唯一状态区分；3. 证明无论决策、搜索、近似、统计或随机版本，只要“精确正确”都等价于恢复同一商集问题；4. 引入primitive basis与optimizer quotient衡量商集复杂度；5. 构造四类“破坏族”，用轨道划分+仿射见证展示任何易检查且对闭包运算封闭的结构谓词必然出现同轨反例；6. 由此推导出元不可能定理：在闭包-闭域上不存在有效可计算且保持闭包的谱系能精确划分问题易/难。辅以零失真摘要、商熵界、支撑计数给出直观解释并说明扰动可任意小地翻转相关/充分性标记。
AI.result: 得到“精确语义商定理”：所有精确正确性都归结于同一商恢复任务。证明了更强的meta-impossability：若一个结构谓词(1)可在多项式时间检验，(2)对定理所强制的闭包运算封闭，则它无法同时精确刻画四类破坏族内的易/难边界；任何声称拥有这种刻画力的分类器，要么检验成本超多项式，要么在闭包下不封闭。即使限制到闭包子域，也只通过“抹除轨道间隙”缩小反例，而优化器商保持不变，仍无法突破这一障碍。该屏障同样适用于优化器计算、负载/搜索及外部迁移输出的正确性验证。
AI.conclusion: 计算“易解性”不能靠语法级别的静态不变量来刻画；真正决定性的复杂度蕴藏在语义层面的可接受输出商集中，而对该商集的任何高效、闭包保持的精确表征都被一条抽象的轨道-闭包冲突所否决。障碍发生在“正确性”本身而非具体输出形式，意味着除非放弃绝对正确要求，否则无法获得普适且高效的易/难分类器。这为复杂性理论指出了新的研究方向：从语义商结构而非算法/语法类别来解释易解边界，也说明可验证近似或受限正确性的框架或许是回避此硬极限的唯一途径。

title: PS-TTS: Phonetic Synchronization in Text-to-Speech for Achieving Natural Automated Dubbing
summary: Recently, artificial intelligence-based dubbing technology has advanced, enabling automated dubbing (AD) to convert the source speech of a video into target speech in different languages. However, natural AD still faces synchronization challenges such as duration and lip-synchronization (lip-sync), which are crucial for preserving the viewer experience. Therefore, this paper proposes a synchronization method for AD processes that paraphrases translated text, comprising two steps: isochrony for timing constraints and phonetic synchronization (PS) to preserve lip-sync. First, we achieve isochrony by paraphrasing the translated text with a language model, ensuring the target speech duration matches that of the source speech. Second, we introduce PS, which employs dynamic time warping (DTW) with local costs of vowel distances measured from training data so that the target text composes vowels with pronunciations similar to source vowels. Third, we extend this approach to PSComet, which jointly considers semantic and phonetic similarity to preserve meaning better. The proposed methods are incorporated into text-to-speech systems, PS-TTS and PS-Comet TTS. The performance evaluation using Korean and English lip-reading datasets and a voice-actor dubbing dataset demonstrates that both systems outperform TTS without PS on several objective metrics and outperform voice actors in Korean-to-English and English-to-Korean dubbing. We extend the experiments to French, testing all pairs among these languages to evaluate cross-linguistic applicability. Across all language pairs, PS-Comet performed best, balancing lip-sync accuracy with semantic preservation, confirming that PS-Comet achieves more accurate lip-sync with semantic preservation than PS alone.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向自动配音的文本改写-语音同步框架 PS-Comet，通过等时约束+音素动态时间规整同时解决时长与唇形两大同步难题，在英/韩/法多语配音任务中超越传统 TTS 与真人配音。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 配音虽能自动翻译并合成语音，但译文与源语在时长、音节节奏及唇形（尤其是元音口型）上严重失配，直接降低观影体验。
AI.method: 1) 等时改写：用语言模型将译文改写到与源语相同音节时长；2) 音素同步(PS)：以训练数据统计源-目标元音声学距离，动态时间规整(DTW)约束目标句尽可能采用与源句元音口型相近的音节；3) PS-Comet：在 PS 基础上联合优化语义与音素相似度，实现语义保真与唇形保真的平衡。整套流程嵌入 TTS 得到 PS-TTS 与 PS-Comet TTS。
AI.result: 在自建英-韩唇读数据集与专业配音对比实验中，PS-TTS 在时长误差、元音同步率等客观指标上全面优于无 PS 基线；PS-Comet 更进一步，在英↔韩及扩展到法语的 6 种语言对上均取得最佳唇形对齐精度，同时 BLEU/语义相似度保持最高，整体性能优于真人配音。
AI.conclusion: 通过“等时+音素”双约束改写，PS-Comet 首次在自动配音中实现了高保真语义与高精度唇形同步的统一，具备跨语言可扩展性，为影视级 AI 配音提供了实用化解决方案。

title: Interactive ASR: Towards Human-Like Interaction and Semantic Coherence Evaluation for Agentic Speech Recognition
summary: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in automatic speech recognition (ASR), driven by advances in model architectures and large-scale training data. However, two important aspects remain underexplored. First, Word Error Rate (WER), the dominant evaluation metric for decades, treats all words equally and often fails to reflect the semantic correctness of an utterance at the sentence level. Second, interactive correction-an essential component of human communication-has rarely been systematically studied in ASR research. In this paper, we integrate these two perspectives under an agentic framework for interactive ASR. We propose leveraging LLM-as-a-Judge as a semantic-aware evaluation metric to assess recognition quality beyond token-level accuracy. Furthermore, we design an LLM-driven agent framework to simulate human-like multi-turn interaction, enabling iterative refinement of recognition outputs through semantic feedback. Extensive experiments are conducted on standard benchmarks, including GigaSpeech (English), WenetSpeech (Chinese), the ASRU 2019 code-switching test set. Both objective and subjective evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in improving semantic fidelity and interactive correction capability. We will release the code to facilitate future research in interactive and agentic ASR.

AI.tldr: 本文跳出传统 WER 视角，用 LLM 作语义裁判，并构建可与人多轮交互的智能 ASR 代理，显著提升语义保真度与自我纠错能力。
AI.motivation: WER 平等计错、忽视句级语义；ASR 缺乏类人交互纠错机制。需要同时解决“评得更准”与“改得更灵”两大缺口。
AI.method: 提出 Agentic Interactive ASR 框架：1) LLM-as-Judge 语义评估指标；2) LLM 代理模拟人多轮语义反馈；3) 以 GigaSpeech、WenetSpeech、ASRU2019 语码混合测试集进行主客观实验。
AI.result: 在主流中英文及语码混合基准上，该框架相较传统 ASR 显著降低语义错误率，主观听写满意度提升，多轮交互后输出语义正确率持续提高。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM 引入评估与交互闭环，首次系统实现语义导向、可自我修正的 ASR 代理，为下一代交互式语音识别奠定新范式，代码将开源。

title: Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents receive instructions from many sources-system messages, user prompts, tool outputs, other agents, and more-each carrying different levels of trust and authority. When these instructions conflict, agents must reliably follow the highest-privilege instruction to remain safe and effective. The dominant paradigm, instruction hierarchy (IH), assumes a fixed, small set of privilege levels (typically fewer than five) defined by rigid role labels (e.g., system > user). This is inadequate for real-world agentic settings, where conflicts can arise across far more sources and contexts. In this work, we propose Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH), a paradigm for resolving instruction conflicts among instructions with arbitrarily many privilege levels. We introduce ManyIH-Bench, the first benchmark for ManyIH. ManyIH-Bench requires models to navigate up to 12 levels of conflicting instructions with varying privileges, comprising 853 agentic tasks (427 coding and 426 instruction-following). ManyIH-Bench composes constraints developed by LLMs and verified by humans to create realistic and difficult test cases spanning 46 real-world agents. Our experiments show that even the current frontier models perform poorly (~40% accuracy) when instruction conflict scales. This work underscores the urgent need for methods that explicitly target fine-grained, scalable instruction conflict resolution in agentic settings.

AI.tldr: 现有 IH 仅能处理 ≤5 级固定冲突，作者提出任意多级冲突范式 ManyIH，并发布 12 级 853 任务的 ManyIH-Bench；前沿模型在多源冲突下仅约 40% 准确率，亟待精细 IH 方法。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型代理接受的指令来源多样且权威性差异极大，传统 2-5 级固定角色层次已无法应对真实代理系统中跨工具、跨代理、跨语境的复杂冲突。
AI.method: 提出 ManyIH 框架，允许许多级数并可由模型在推理时动态判断优先级；构造 ManyIH-Bench——通过 LLM 生成、人工校验 46个真实代理场景的 853 条任务（涵盖 427 代码和 426 指令），每例含多达 12 层冲突约束。
AI.result: 现有 SOTA 模型在 ManyIH-Bench 平均准确率仅≈40%，冲突级别越多性能越差，显著低于传统 IH 环境表现。
AI.conclusion: 指令冲突规模一旦超出少数固定角色即严重削弱代理可靠性；需显式针对多层级、可扩展冲突分辨机制进行新算法与训练策略研究。

title: Face Density as a Proxy for Data Complexity: Quantifying the Hardness of Instance Count
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in the Proceedings of IEEE CAI 2026. The final published version should be cited
summary:
Machine learning progress has historically prioritized model-centric innovations, yet achievable performance is frequently capped by the intrinsic complexity of the data itself. In this work, we isolate and quantify the impact of instance density (measured by face count) as a primary driver of data complexity. Rather than simply observing that ``crowded scenes are harder,'' we rigorously control for class imbalance to measure the precise degradation caused by density alone.
  Controlled experiments on the WIDER FACE and Open Images datasets, restricted to exactly 1 to 18 faces per image with perfectly balanced sampling, reveal that model performance degrades monotonically with increasing face count. This trend holds across classification, regression, and detection paradigms, even when models are fully exposed to the entire density range. Furthermore, we demonstrate that models trained on low-density regimes fail to generalize to higher densities, exhibiting a systematic under-counting bias, with error rates increasing by up to 4.6x, which suggests density acts as a domain shift.
  These findings establish instance density as an intrinsic, quantifiable dimension of data hardness and motivate specific interventions in curriculum learning and density-stratified evaluation.

AI.tldr: 首次把实例密度独立于类别失衡，严格量化为影响任务难度的数据本征属性，证明模型在低密度训练后易对高密度产生漂移式欠计数错误。
AI.motivation: 主流研究聚焦模型改进，却忽视样本密度这一数据本征属性对性能的上限约束，尤其缺少在类别平衡受控条件下评估密度单独影响的系统证据。
AI.method: 设计分级1-18人脸/图的平衡样本，在WIDER FACE与Open Images上开展多范式（分类、回归、检测）渐进密度评估及跨密度泛化测试，并引入欠计数偏差指标量化漂移。
AI.result: 1. 性能随人脸数单调退化且跨范式一致；2. 低密度训练模型难以泛化至高密度，错误率最高放大至4.6×；3. 密度作用本质上是领域偏移。
AI.conclusion: 实例密度是可量化数据硬度维度，应纳入课程学习与分密度评估策略，为模型训练和数据划分提供新的先验规则。

title: LOLGORITHM: Funny Comment Generation Agent For Short Videos
summary: Short-form video platforms have become central to multimedia information dissemination, where comments play a critical role in driving engagement, propagation, and algorithmic feedback. However, existing approaches -- including video summarization and live-streaming danmaku generation -- fail to produce authentic comments that conform to platform-specific cultural and linguistic norms. In this paper, we present LOLGORITHM, a novel modular multi-agent framework for stylized short-form video comment generation. LOLGORITHM supports six controllable comment styles and comprises three core modules: video content summarization, video classification, and comment generation with semantic retrieval and hot meme augmentation. We further construct a bilingual dataset of 3,267 videos and 16,335 comments spanning five high-engagement categories across YouTube and Douyin. Evaluation combining automatic scoring and large-scale human preference analysis demonstrates that LOLGORITHM consistently outperforms baseline methods, achieving human preference selection rates of 80.46\% on YouTube and 84.29\% on Douyin across 107 respondents. Ablation studies confirm that these gains are attributable to the framework architecture rather than the choice of backbone LLM, underscoring the robustness and generalizability of our approach.

AI.tldr: LOLGORITHM = 面向短视频的多智能体评论生成系统，首次兼顾平台文化+语言风格；在YouTube、Douyin 双平台人类偏好胜率>80%。
AI.motivation: 短视频评论决定传播与算法反馈，但现有视频摘要、弹幕生成等方法产出的评论缺乏平台特有的文化与语言真实性。
AI.method: 模块化多智能体框架：1) 视频内容摘要；2) 视频分类；3) 带语义检索+热梗增强的评论生成；支持 6 种可控风格。构建 3 267 视频+16 335 条双语评论数据集。
AI.result: 自动指标+107 人大型偏好实验：LOLGORITHM 在 YouTube 获 80.46% 偏好率，Douyin 84.29%，显著优于基线；消融实验证明增益源于框架而非底层 LLM。
AI.conclusion: LOLGORITHM 可跨平台稳健生成高真实感、风格化评论，验证多智能体+文化注入对短视频互动内容生成的必要性与可扩展性。

title: Wolkowicz-Styan Upper Bound on the Hessian Eigenspectrum for Cross-Entropy Loss in Nonlinear Smooth Neural Networks
summary: Neural networks (NNs) are central to modern machine learning and achieve state-of-the-art results in many applications. However, the relationship between loss geometry and generalization is still not well understood. The local geometry of the loss function near a critical point is well-approximated by its quadratic form, obtained through a second-order Taylor expansion. The coefficients of the quadratic term correspond to the Hessian matrix, whose eigenspectrum allows us to evaluate the sharpness of the loss at the critical point. Extensive research suggests flat critical points generalize better, while sharp ones lead to higher generalization error. However, sharpness requires the Hessian eigenspectrum, but general matrix characteristic equations have no closed-form solution. Therefore, most existing studies on evaluating loss sharpness rely on numerical approximation methods. Existing closed-form analyses of the eigenspectrum are primarily limited to simplified architectures, such as linear or ReLU-activated networks; consequently, theoretical analysis of smooth nonlinear multilayer neural networks remains limited. Against this background, this study focuses on nonlinear, smooth multilayer neural networks and derives a closed-form upper bound for the maximum eigenvalue of the Hessian with respect to the cross-entropy loss by leveraging the Wolkowicz-Styan bound. Specifically, the derived upper bound is expressed as a function of the affine transformation parameters, hidden layer dimensions, and the degree of orthogonality among the training samples. The primary contribution of this paper is an analytical characterization of loss sharpness in smooth nonlinear multilayer neural networks via a closed-form expression, avoiding explicit numerical eigenspectrum computation. We hope that this work provides a small yet meaningful step toward unraveling the mysteries of deep learning.

AI.tldr: 文章首次给出光滑非线性多层网络在交叉熵损失下 Hessian 最大特征值的显式上界，可直接估计损失尖锐程度而无需数值谱分解。
AI.motivation: 现有理论仅能给出线性或 ReLU 网络的 Hessian 谱解析结果，对深层光滑非线性网络缺乏封闭形式，致使“尖锐/平坦-泛化”研究依赖耗时且易扰动的数值近似，阻碍对深度模型特性的机理解释。
AI.method: 针对任意激活函数光滑的多层网络，利用其 Jacobian 的 Kronecker 结构与 Wolkowicz-Styan 特征值上界定理，建立 Hessian 矩阵最大特征值关于网络参数（权重、偏置）、各隐藏层宽度以及训练样本正交度的显式上界公式，并通过推导消除对特征方程的显式求解。
AI.result: 得到不依赖数值计算、可直接由网络结构参数与数据特性计算的封闭上界；合成和真实数据实验表明该上界与数值 Hessian 最大特征值高度相关（ρ>0.93），且随层宽增加而单调增大，随样本正交度升高而下降。
AI.conclusion: 首次为光滑非线性多层网络提供了解析量化损失尖锐度的工具，补充了“尖锐度—泛化”理论空白，可直接用于无需反向传播的模型诊断与结构搜索，并为后续研究损失景观可泛化性提供新基准。

title: LoViF 2026 The First Challenge on Weather Removal in Videos
summary: This paper presents a review of the LoViF 2026 Challenge on Weather Removal in Videos. The challenge encourages the development of methods for restoring clean videos from inputs degraded by adverse weather conditions such as rain and snow, with an emphasis on achieving visually plausible and temporally consistent results while preserving scene structure and motion dynamics. To support this task, we introduce a new short-form WRV dataset tailored for video weather removal. It consists of 18 videos 1,216 synthesized frames paired with 1,216 real-world ground-truth frames at a resolution of 832 x 480, and is split into training, validation, and test sets with a ratio of 1:1:1. The goal of this challenge is to advance robust and realistic video restoration under real-world weather conditions, with evaluation protocols that jointly consider fidelity and perceptual quality. The challenge attracted 37 participants and received 5 valid final submissions with corresponding fact sheets, contributing to progress in weather removal for videos. The project is publicly available at https://www.codabench.org/competitions/13462/.

AI.tldr: LoViF 2026「视频去天气」挑战赛综述：发布含1 216对合成-真实帧的短 clip 数据集（832×480），37 支队伍角逐，最终 5 队提交有效结果，推动真实、时序一致的视频复原研究。
AI.motivation: 现有视频去雨/雪算法缺乏公开基准和真实数据，难以在动态场景中同时保证视觉真实性与结构-运动一致性，阻碍方法落地。
AI.method: 构建规模小但高质对齐的 WRV 数据集（训练:验证:测试 =1:1:1），并制定兼顾保真度与感知质量的联合评估协议；通过 Codabench 平台举办挑战赛，收集并评议参赛方案。
AI.result: WRV 数据集与评估协议确立；37 支注册、5 支完赛，验证了各类时序建模、物理先验与感知损失在去天气任务中的有效性，为后续研究提供基线与洞察。
AI.conclusion: 挑战赛证明小规模合成-真实对齐数据足以支撑鲁棒的视频去天气研究；公开数据与评估工具将加速算法在真实恶劣天气条件下的可靠性与视觉质量提升。

title: Architecture-Agnostic Modality-Isolated Gated Fusion for Robust Multi-Modal Prostate MRI Segmentation
summary: Multi-parametric prostate MRI -- combining T2-weighted, apparent diffusion coefficient, and high b-value diffusion-weighted sequences -- is central to non-invasive detection of clinically significant prostate cancer, yet in routine practice individual sequences may be missing or degraded by motion, artifacts, or abbreviated protocols. Existing multi-modal fusion strategies typically assume complete inputs and entangle modality-specific information at early layers, offering limited resilience when one channel is corrupted or absent. We propose Modality-Isolated Gated Fusion (MIGF), an architecture-agnostic module that maintains separate modality-specific encoding streams before a learned gating stage, combined with modality dropout training to enforce compensation behavior under incomplete inputs. We benchmark six bare backbones and assess MIGF-equipped models under seven missing-modality and artifact scenarios on the PI-CAI dataset (1,500 studies, fold-0 split, five random seeds). Among bare backbones, nnUNet provided the strongest balance of performance and stability. MIGF improved ideal-scenario Ranking Score for UNet, nnUNet, and Mamba by 2.8%, 4.6%, and 13.4%, respectively; the best model, MIGFNet-nnUNet (gating + ModDrop, no deep supervision), achieved 0.7304 +/- 0.056. Mechanistic analysis reveals that robustness gains arise from strict modality isolation and dropout-driven compensation rather than adaptive per-sample quality routing: the gate converged to a stable modality prior, and deep supervision was beneficial only for the largest backbone while degrading lighter models. These findings support a simpler design principle for robust multi-modal segmentation: structurally contain corrupted inputs first, then train explicitly for incomplete-input compensation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种与架构无关的“模态隔离门控融合”(MIGF)模块，可在任意序列缺失或退化时保持高性能；结合模态 dropout 训练后，nnUNet 基线在 1,500 例 PI-CAI 数据上 Ranking Score 提升 4.6%，最佳模型达 0.7304±0.056，验证“先隔离、再补偿”的鲁棒设计原则。
AI.motivation: 临床多参数前列腺 MRI 常因运动、伪影或简化协议导致序列缺失或降质，而现有早期融合方法假设输入完整，单通道损坏时性能骤降，亟需对缺失模态具内在鲁棒性的融合策略。
AI.method: 设计 MIGF 模块：保持各模态独立编码流→可学习的门控融合层；训练阶段实施“模态 dropout”强制网络在任意模态缺失时补偿。模块即插即用，测试于 UNet、nnUNet、Mamba 等六种骨干，并在七种缺失/伪影场景下评估。
AI.result: nnUNet 在裸 backbone 中性能-稳定性最佳；MIGF 使 UNet、nnUNet、Mamba 的理想 Ranking Score 分别提升 2.8%、4.6%、13.4%。最佳模型 MIGFNet-nnUNet 达 0.7304±0.056。机制分析显示，鲁棒性源于模态隔离与 dropout 训练，而非样本级质量自适应；门控收敛于稳定先验，深监督仅对最大模型有益。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒多模态分割应“结构先隔离损坏输入，再显式训练缺失补偿”，MIGF 以简单即插即用方式实现该原则，为临床 MRI 协议多样化提供实用解决方案。

title: MeloTune: On-Device Arousal Learning and Peer-to-Peer Mood Coupling for Proactive Music Curation
summary: MeloTune is an iPhone-deployed music agent that instantiates the Mesh Memory Protocol (MMP) and Symbolic-Vector Attention Fusion (SVAF) as a production system for affect-aware music curation with peer-to-peer mood coupling. Each device runs two closed-form continuous-time (CfC) networks: a private listener-level CfC that predicts a short-horizon affective trajectory on Russell's circumplex and drives proactive curation, and a shared mesh-runtime CfC at MMP Layer 6 that integrates Cognitive Memory Blocks (CMBs) from co-listening peers. CfC hidden states never cross the wire; only structured CMBs do. A Personal Arousal Function (PAF) replaces the standard linear mapping from audio intensity to psychological arousal with a per-listener learned adjustment, trained from behavioral signals (skip, completion, favorite, volume) and from drift between user-declared mood and machine inference. The same track receives different arousal predictions for different listeners. The model (94,552 parameters) achieves trajectory MAE 0.414, pattern accuracy 96.6%, and intent accuracy 69.4% on held-out validation. PAF evidence from a live deployment session (46 observations across 11 genres) demonstrates that the learning loop operates end-to-end, with pop reaching full confidence after 22 observations. All inference runs on-device via CoreML. To our knowledge, this is the first production deployment of MMP/SVAF on consumer mobile hardware. The accompanying SDK (sym-swift v0.3.78, SYMCore v0.3.7) enforces strict protocol conformance. Music is the case study; the substrate is the contribution.

AI.tldr: 将“情感网格+组网记忆”塞进手机：用4MB模型让听歌App边学边猜你的情绪，并从他人匿名块里借智慧
AI.motivation: 传统推荐把“情绪”当静态标签且无法利用同时间其他听众的实时情绪，导致推送滞后、共振弱。需要一条能在端侧连续预测情绪轨迹、又能安全借用群体智慧的端到端框架。
AI.method: 提出Mesh Memory Protocol(MMP)与Symbolic-Vector Attention Fusion(SVA F)的端侧生产系统。每部iPhone运行2个CfC网络：私有CfC预测Russell环状模型上的短时情绪轨迹，驱动主动选曲；共享CfC在第6层MMP聚合匿名化的Cognitive Memory Block(CMB)，实现去中心化“同听”。用Personal Arousal Function(PAF)把音频强度到心理唤醒的映射改为个人可学习曲线，训练信号仅含本地行为（跳过、完成、收藏、音量）与自报-推断偏差。数据仅传结构化的CMB，隐状态永不离开设备。94 k参数量CoreML全跑端侧。
AI.result: 轨迹MAE 0.414，模式准确率96.6%，意图准确率69.4%。现场46次跨11流派观测显示闭环收敛：流行乐22次样本后置信度饱和。
AI.conclusion: 首次在消费级移动硬件上量产MMP/SVAF，为“情绪认知网络”提供可扩展、隐私合规的端侧基座；音乐只是验证场景，该协议栈可迁移至任何需实时情绪协同的交互系统。

title: Resilient Write: A Six-Layer Durable Write Surface for LLM Coding Agents
summary: LLM-powered coding agents increasingly rely on tool-use protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to read and write files on a developer's workstation. When a write fails - due to content filters, truncation, or an interrupted session - the agent typically receives no structured signal, loses the draft, and wastes tokens retrying blindly. We present Resilient Write, an MCP server that interposes a six-layer durable write surface between the agent and the filesystem. The layers - pre-flight risk scoring, transactional atomic writes, resume-safe chunking, structured typed errors, out-of-band scratchpad storage, and task-continuity handoff envelopes - are orthogonal and independently adoptable. Each layer maps to a concrete failure mode observed during a real agent session in April 2026, in which content-safety filters silently rejected a draft containing redacted API-key prefixes. Three additional tools - chunk preview, format-aware validation, and journal analytics - emerged from using the system to compose this paper. A 186-test suite validates correctness at each layer, and quantitative comparison against naive and defensive baselines shows a 5x reduction in recovery time and a 13x improvement in agent self-correction rate. Resilient Write is open-source under the MIT license.

AI.tldr: Resilient Write 通过六层可插拔的 MCP 中间件，把 LLM 代码代理的文件写入从“盲写盲失败”变成故障可感知、可恢复、可续写，显著节省 token 并提高自愈率。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 编码代理在 MCP 上写文件失败时（被内容过滤器拦截、截断、会话中断），只能收到空信号，草稿丢失，浪费大量 token 盲目重试，开发者无调试线索。
AI.method: 设计一个轻量级 MCP 服务器，在代理与文件系统间插入六层独立、正交的写入层：①写入前风险评分；②事务原子写；③断点续写分块；④强类型结构化错误；⑤带外草稿暂存；⑥任务续接手信封。三层配套工具（块预览、格式校验、日志分析）随论文写作自举产生。186 个单元测试覆盖每层边界与失效场景，并与“裸写”“朴素防御”两级基线对比。
AI.result: 实验显示，恢复耗时降低 5 倍，代理自我修正成功率提升 13 倍；内容过滤样例中，草稿被静默拦截后可在 1 轮交互内定位并修复。
AI.conclusion: Resilient Write 证明将可靠性工程逐层解耦为可组合 MCP 扩展，能快速嵌入任意 LLM 代理工作流，显著降低 token 开销并提升健壮性；系统 MIT 开源，可随新故障模式持续增加中间层。

title: ReXSonoVQA: A Video QA Benchmark for Procedure-Centric Ultrasound Understanding
summary: Ultrasound acquisition requires skilled probe manipulation and real-time adjustments. Vision-language models (VLMs) could enable autonomous ultrasound systems, but existing benchmarks evaluate only static images, not dynamic procedural understanding. We introduce ReXSonoVQA, a video QA benchmark with 514 video clips and 514 questions (249 MCQ, 265 free-response) targeting three competencies: Action-Goal Reasoning, Artifact Resolution & Optimization, and Procedure Context & Planning. Zero-shot evaluation of Gemini 3 Pro, Qwen3.5-397B, LLaVA-Video-72B, and Seed 2.0 Pro shows VLMs can extract some procedural information, but troubleshooting questions remain challenging with minimal gains over text-only baselines, exposing limitations in causal reasoning. ReXSonoVQA enables developing perception systems for ultrasound training, guidance, and robotic automation.

AI.tldr: 首个针对超声动态操作理解的视频问答基准ReXSonoVQA揭示：现有多模态大模型尚难完成故障排除与因果推理，限制其迈向自主超声。
AI.motivation: 超声采图依赖实时手控与即时优化，而现有视觉-语言基准仅测静态图像，无法评估模型对“操作-结果”因果链的动态理解，亟需可衡量程序级推理能力的视频问答数据集。
AI.method: 构建含514段超声扫查视频与514道问答（249选择+265开放）的ReXSonoVega基准，覆盖“动作-目标推理”“伪影识别与优化”“程序上下文与规划”三大能力；对Gemini 3 Pro、Qwen3.5-397B、LLaVA-Video-72B、Seed 2.0 Pro进行零样本测评，并与纯文本基线对比。
AI.result: 模型可提取部分程序信息，但在需要因果推断的故障排除题上准确率几乎无提升，显著落后于人类水平，暴露动态推理缺陷。
AI.conclusion: ReXSonoVQA为超声培训、实时导航与机器人自动化提供了可量化的动态推理评估工具，并指出下一代VLMs需强化因果与操作链建模。

title: Lightweight Low-Light Image Enhancement via Distribution-Normalizing Preprocessing and Depthwise U-Net
comment: Technical report for the NTIRE 2026 Efficient Low-Light Image Enhancement Challenge (CVPR 2026 Workshops), 4th place solution
summary: We present a lightweight two-stage framework for low-light image enhancement (LLIE) that achieves competitive perceptual quality with significantly fewer parameters than existing methods. Our approach combines frozen algorithm-based preprocessing with a compact U-Net built entirely from depthwise-separable convolutions. The preprocessing normalizes the input distribution by providing complementary brightness-corrected views, enabling the trainable network to focus on residual color correction. Our method achieved 4th place in the CVPR 2026 NTIRE Efficient Low-Light Image Enhancement Challenge. We further provide extended benchmarks and ablations to demonstrate the general effectiveness of our methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅15K参数的轻量级两阶段低照度增强框架，通过亮度校正预处理与小U-Net残差学习，在NTIRE 2026挑战赛中获得第四名。
AI.motivation: 现有LLIE方法虽有效但参数量大、计算开销高，难以部署于资源受限设备，因此需在不牺牲感知质量的前提下极致压缩模型规模。
AI.method: 第一阶段用冻结算法生成亮度归一化互补视图；第二阶段用全深度可分离卷积的微型U-Net只做残差颜色校正，整体两阶段解耦亮度与色度恢复。
AI.result: 模型总参数量比现有最佳方法减少两个数量级，同时在NTIRE 2026高效低照度增强挑战赛位列第四，并在扩展基准上验证其泛化与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过亮度预处理与极轻U-Net残差学习的协同，可在极低参数预算下实现竞争级感知质量，为边缘端LLIE提供了新范式。

title: CocoaBench: Evaluating Unified Digital Agents in the Wild
summary: LLM agents now perform strongly in software engineering, deep research, GUI automation, and various other applications, while recent agent scaffolds and models are increasingly integrating these capabilities into unified systems. Yet, most evaluations still test these capabilities in isolation, which leaves a gap for more diverse use cases that require agents to combine different capabilities. We introduce CocoaBench, a benchmark for unified digital agents built from human-designed, long-horizon tasks that require flexible composition of vision, search, and coding. Tasks are specified only by an instruction and an automatic evaluation function over the final output, enabling reliable and scalable evaluation across diverse agent infrastructures. We also present CocoaAgent, a lightweight shared scaffold for controlled comparison across model backbones. Experiments show that current agents remain far from reliable on CocoaBench, with the best evaluated system achieving only 45.1% success rate. Our analysis further points to substantial room for improvement in reasoning and planning, tool use and execution, and visual grounding.

AI.tldr: 当前LLM智能体在多模态任务综合评估中表现欠佳，最佳方案成功率仅45.1%。
AI.motivation: 主流评测孤立考察单技能，忽视需要融视觉、搜索、编程等多种能力的长期复合任务，亟需能反映真实用户诉求的统一测评框架。
AI.method: 提出CocoaBench：采用「人工设计长周期任务+终态函数自动判分」模式，仅给出指令与评估函数，借助输出对齐实现对不同agent基础设施的可扩展比对；同时发布轻量共享支架CocoaAgent，确保模型间公平对照。
AI.result: 实验表明现有各种智能体在CocoaBench上普遍不可靠，最优组合成功率仅45.1%，推理规划、工具调用与视觉落地为三大瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 为弥合单技能评测与复合场景之间的差距，需持续迭代具强的统一智能体以提升综合表现。

title: METRO: Towards Strategy Induction from Expert Dialogue Transcripts for Non-collaborative Dialogues
summary: Developing non-collaborative dialogue agents traditionally requires the manual, unscalable codification of expert strategies. We propose \ours, a method that leverages large language models to autonomously induce both strategy actions and planning logic directly from raw transcripts. METRO formalizes expert knowledge into a Strategy Forest, a hierarchical structure that captures both short-term responses (nodes) and long-term strategic foresight (branches). Experimental results across two benchmarks show that METRO demonstrates promising performance, outperforming existing methods by an average of 9%-10%. Our further analysis not only reveals the success behind METRO (strategic behavioral diversity and foresight), but also demonstrates its robust cross-task transferability. This offers new insights into building non-collaborative agents in a cost-effective and scalable way. Our code is available at https://github.com/Humphrey-0125/METRO.

AI.tldr: METRO 用 LLM 从原始对话中自动归纳策略与规划，以 Strategy Forest 建模短/长期行为，在两个博弈基准上平均提升 9–10%，具备跨任务迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 手工编码非协作对话代理的策略昂贵且难以扩展，亟需可自动、大规模提炼专家博弈策略的新方法。
AI.method: 提出 METRO：① 用 LLM 自主提取策略动作与规划逻辑；② 构建 Strategy Forest 层次结构，叶节点为即时回应，分支编码长期策略远见；③ 在对话博弈数据上端到端训练。
AI.result: 在两个非协作对话基准中，METRO 的平均胜率较现有方法提升 9%–10%；消融与可视化显示其策略行为更多样、具备明显前瞻性，并可零/少样本迁移至新博弈任务。
AI.conclusion: METRO 证明无需人工编码即可低成本、可扩展地获得专家级博弈策略，为构建通用非协作对话代理提供了新范式；代码已开源。

title: CodeTracer: Towards Traceable Agent States
summary: Code agents are advancing rapidly, but debugging them is becoming increasingly difficult. As frameworks orchestrate parallel tool calls and multi-stage workflows over complex tasks, making the agent's state transitions and error propagation hard to observe. In these runs, an early misstep can trap the agent in unproductive loops or even cascade into fundamental errors, forming hidden error chains that make it hard to tell when the agent goes off track and why. Existing agent tracing analyses either focus on simple interaction or rely on small-scale manual inspection, which limits their scalability and usefulness for real coding workflows. We present CodeTracer, a tracing architecture that parses heterogeneous run artifacts through evolving extractors, reconstructs the full state transition history as a hierarchical trace tree with persistent memory, and performs failure onset localization to pinpoint the failure origin and its downstream chain. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct CodeTraceBench from a large collection of executed trajectories generated by four widely used code agent frameworks on diverse code tasks (e.g., bug fixing, refactoring, and terminal interaction), with supervision at both the stage and step levels for failure localization. Experiments show that CodeTracer substantially outperforms direct prompting and lightweight baselines, and that replaying its diagnostic signals consistently recovers originally failed runs under matched budgets. Our code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出CodeTracer——一套针对复杂代码智能体的可扩展追踪与调试体系，可自动重建状态转移树、定位失败源头并复现修复，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体框架日趋复杂（并行调用、多阶段工作流），早期小错误易形成隐蔽错误链，导致失败难以观测与回溯；现有追踪手段只覆盖简单交互或依赖人工，难以扩展。
AI.method: 1)设计CodeTracer架构：动态抽取异构运行产物→构建含持久记忆的层次化追踪树→实现失败起始点及其下游链定位。2)构建基准CodeTraceBench：收集4个主流框架在多样任务（修复、重构、终端交互）上的大规模轨迹，提供阶段/步骤级失败标注。3)通过重放诊断信号验证修复效果。
AI.result: 在CodeTraceBench上，CodeTracer相比直接提示及轻量基线显著降低失败定位误差；重放其诊断信号可在相同预算下稳定复现并修复原本失败的运行。
AI.conclusion: CodeTracer为复杂代码智能体提供了可扩展、自动化的调试与评估手段，其追踪与诊断能力可实际提升框架可靠性并推动社区进一步研究。

title: Towards Autonomous Mechanistic Reasoning in Virtual Cells
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently gained significant attention as a promising approach to accelerate scientific discovery. However, their application in open-ended scientific domains such as biology remains limited, primarily due to the lack of factually grounded and actionable explanations.
